string.ID: Live and drink.

strings.string: 生存與飲酒。

string.ID: {{emote|*Barathrum mumbles inaudibly.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*巴拉楚姆低聲咕噥著，聽不清楚內容。*}}

string.ID:
{{emote|*Barathrum's countenance suddenly gravens.*}}
O.. I know it to be arduous for you, meyvn, to see me like this. The imago unstrung...

strings.string:
{{emote|*巴拉楚姆的 countenance 突然變得凝重。*}}
喔……我知道對妳來說很艱難，meyvn，看到我這副模樣。意象已然崩解……

string.ID: I am sorry, =name=. I am so proud of you! I wish... I wish it were I did not peel, like your model.

strings.string: 我很抱歉，=name=。我真為你感到驕傲！我希望……我希望我也能像你的模型那樣，不會脫皮。

string.ID: Farewell, now, meyvn. =name=. Live and drink.

strings.string: 再見了，=name=. 生存下去並盡情飲酒吧。

string.ID:
{{emote|*Barathrum's countenance suddenly gravens.*}}
Child. There is much more I would have liked to share. But... I am a puppet of my shame.

strings.string:
{{emote|*巴拉楚姆的面容突然變得凝重。*}}
孩子。我有許多想與你分享的事。但是……我是羞愧的傀儡。

string.ID: {{emote|*Barathrum mumbles inaudibly.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*巴拉楚姆低聲咕噥著，聽不清楚內容。*}}

string.ID: {{emote|*Barathrum weeps.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*巴拉楚姆在哭泣。*}}

string.ID:
We've-
We've done it, =name=. I-

strings.string:
我們已經——
我們做到了，=name=。我——

string.ID: Only in the Shallows' dawnstirs did I let myself think it possible. And now...

strings.string: 只有在淺灘的黎明微光中，我才敢想這是有可能的。而現在……

string.ID:
{{emote|*Barathrum exhales with effort.*}}
Let us sort our faculties before we reach the rim of our ascent. There is the edge of our journey still to lathe.

strings.string:
{{emote|*巴拉楚姆費力地呼出一口氣。*}}
在抵達攀升的邊緣之前，讓我們整理一下心智能力吧。我們的旅程仍有餘下的部分尚待雕琢。

string.ID: Barathrum, let us again talk about the past.

strings.string: 巴拉楚姆(Barathrum)，讓我們再次談談過去。

string.ID: The Templar are defeated, but will they return in force?

strings.string: 聖騎士已被擊敗，但他們會強勢回歸嗎？

string.ID: Barathrum, you look pained. Are you well?

strings.string: 巴拉楚姆(Barathrum)，你看起來很痛苦。你還好嗎？

string.ID: By your guess, what awaits us where the Spindle breaks?

strings.string: 根據你的推測，在 紡錘(Spindle) 斷裂之處，正等待著我們的是什麼？

string.ID: I would like a moment, Barathrum.

strings.string: 我想請稍等片刻，巴拉楚姆(Barathrum)。

string.ID: I cannot say, =name=. But I know it's facile to believe a living heritage can be evanesced in one stroke. We are always downstream of a past violence.

strings.string: 我不能說，=name=。但我知道，認為一個活生生的傳承能在揮手間消逝是很輕率的想法。我們始終處於過去暴力的下游。

string.ID:
{{emote|*Barathrum shifts his weight, pauses, and flexes an arthritic paw.*}}
I am sorry. Tis the acceleration, =name=. I am whirling and empty of breath. Steel yourself, and so shall I.

strings.string:
{{emote|*巴拉楚姆挪動重心，停頓了一下，並活動著患有關節炎的爪子。*}}
我很抱歉。這是因為加速造成的，=name=。我正旋轉不已且氣喘吁吁。振作起來，我也會如此。

string.ID:
{{emote|*Barathrum pauses.*}}
O, =name=, our cursors draw together on Fate's phenomenic slide rule! You burn with speculation, and I- I molder in the coolness of knowing. I enter my dwarf phase.

strings.string:
{{emote|*巴拉楚姆停頓了。*}}
喔，=name=，我們的游標在命運的現象滑尺上交匯了！你燃燒著推測之火，而我——我在知曉的清涼中腐朽。我進入了我的矮人階段。

string.ID: {{emote|*Barathrum takes in a long breath.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*巴拉楚姆(Barathrum) 深吸了一口氣。*}}

string.ID:
O, deceit! The grueling gate I crossed on every tilt of glittering dusk. I slept in my crimeclothes and wept, did you hear?
Or could you hear only the damnable static, like me, and speak naught to the machine that belches it out. Heal none of the wounds of its grievous heart, or mine own...
O, oh... So much to bear.

strings.string:
喔，欺瞞！那道我在每一次閃爍的黃昏中跨越的艱辛之門。我穿著犯罪服睡覺並哭泣，你有聽到嗎？
或者你是否也像我一樣，只能聽到那該死的靜電雜訊，對著噴吐雜訊的機器說不出半個字。無法治癒它那沉痛心靈的傷口，也無法治癒我自己的……
喔，喔……有太多負擔要承擔了。

string.ID: I found a torn sheet of graph paper with a note about deceit. Was it yours?

strings.string: 我發現了一張撕碎的座標紙，上面寫著關於欺騙的筆記。那是你的嗎？

string.ID: Your crimeclothes? There was a codex about crimes and punishments near the bedroll in your study. What was it?

strings.string: 你的犯罪服裝？在你書房的 睡袋 附近有一本關於犯罪與懲罰的法典。那是什麽？

string.ID: The svardym Mak said he was born to a cacophony of static ringing his ears raw. Could it have been the signal?

strings.string: 那位 斯瓦迪姆 麥克 說他出生時耳邊就充斥著刺耳的靜電雜音。會是那個訊號嗎？

string.ID: The Svardym Geeub mentioned a machine speaker and her ursine apprentice. Was that you?

strings.string: 那位 斯瓦迪姆 吉烏布 提到了某位機器說話者和她的熊人學徒。那是妳嗎？

string.ID: Rebekah was a healer. But the daughters of Exile, her acolytes, are tinkers. Why?

strings.string: Rebekah 曾是一名治療者。但她的追隨者，那些 流亡之女，卻是 修補匠。為什麼？

string.ID: Barathrum, I don't understand.

strings.string: 巴拉楚姆(Barathrum)，我不明白。

string.ID:
Yes, that paper, twas mine. This racket of a Signal is mine, too, of sorts.
It is my tolling bell.

strings.string:
是的，那張紙曾是我的。這吵鬧的信號在某種程度上也是我的。
它是我的喪鐘。

string.ID: Your tolling bell?

strings.string: 妳的鳴鐘？

string.ID: That codex? A comfort, a guidebook, a ledger. My crimes have no signatories, but the heart is its own document.

strings.string: 那本法典？是慰藉，是指南，也是帳簿。我的罪行並無簽署人，但心靈本身就是一份紀錄。

string.ID: What crimes, Barathrum?

strings.string: 什麼罪行，巴拉楚姆(Barathrum)？

string.ID: Svardym Mak's static? Yes, twas the Signal. My signal. My tolling bell.

strings.string: 斯瓦迪姆 麥克的靜態？是的，那是訊號。我的訊號。我那鳴響的鐘聲。

string.ID: Your tolling bell?

strings.string: 妳的鳴鐘？

string.ID:
Apprentice. So long since I've worn that title, but it feels right still.
Yes, twas me at the machine speaker's side.

strings.string:
學徒。我已經很久沒用這個稱號了，但感覺依然很對。
是的，當時我就在機器發聲器的身旁。

string.ID: Who was the machine speaker?

strings.string: 誰是機器說話者？

string.ID:
She was a healer, yes. The wire cutter can perform the work of a scalpel; and the soldering iron, a suture.
To take apart a history, and stitch something new...

strings.string:
她曾是一名治療師，沒錯。剪線鉗可以執行 手術刀 的工作；而烙鐵則能充當縫合線。
拆解一段歷史，並縫補出全新的事物……

string.ID: What did she take apart?

strings.string: 她拆解了什麼？

string.ID:
{{emote|*Barathrum pauses.*}}
Forgive me, =name=. The ascent strains the mind as well as the body. My flight of fancy is done; I am regrounded.

strings.string:
{{emote|*巴拉楚姆(Barathrum) 停頓了一下。*}}
請原諒我，=name=。攀升不僅讓身體疲累，也讓精神感到吃力。我的幻想結束了；我已重新腳踏實地。

string.ID:
{{emote|*Barathrum pauses and frowns.*}}
Do you know, =name=, the engine types that ask us to loose every pin and unhinge every cam to know them? Such an engine of culture we are encased in now, and I cannot speak to the workings of one gearset without disassembling them all. I meant not to tease, and soon, I promise, you will spy the next arc of our journey.

strings.string:
{{emote|*巴拉楚姆停頓了一下，皺起眉頭。*}}
您知道嗎，=name=，那些要求我們拆掉每一根銷釘、卸下每一個凸輪才能了解其構造的引擎類型？我們現在被封裝在如此複雜的文化引擎之中，若不將所有齒輪組全部拆解，我無法說明其中任何一組的運作方式。我並非有意戲弄，我承諾，很快您就會窺見我們旅程的下一個弧度。

string.ID: I will wait, Barathrum.

strings.string: 我會等待，巴拉楚姆(Barathrum)。

string.ID: Barathrum, if the past has some relevance to this moment, I would ask you to share what you know.

strings.string: 巴拉楚姆(Barathrum)，如果過去與此時此刻有所關聯，我請求你分享你所知道的一切。

string.ID: {{emote|*Barathrum sighs.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*巴拉楚姆嘆了口氣。*}}

string.ID: It is done, then. Have the explication you are owed.

strings.string: 那就這樣吧。給你應得的解釋。

string.ID: You see, =name=, when I, a young bruin, crossed the Homs Delta with my flood-fleeing clan and into the western reach of Qud, the plagues of the Gyre were already ascendant. We took root at our new hearth, in the chrome grottos where we urshiib find natural peace, and by the providence of my elders, I was able to study the tinkering craft.

strings.string: 你看，=name=，當我還是一個年輕的棕熊，帶著逃離洪水的族群穿越 Homs Delta 並進入卡德的西部邊境時，環流的瘟疫已經在興起了。我們在新的家園紮根，在那處 urshiib 能找到天然寧靜的鉻色洞窟中，並藉由長輩們的眷顧，我得以學習修補工藝。

string.ID:
Through my work I caught the attention of a master machinist, unconventional of method, who took me under her wing and, in time, availed me of the orphic truth.
She explained, as I've shared with you and the rest of the acolytes, that the world we know once belonged to a grand Coven of beings who spanned the stars. And that, acting on some inscrutable logic, they disappeared. That an injunction was placed on our world.
This, you know. It is the truth I told, if only half. But Rebekah taught me more.

strings.string:
透過我的工作，我吸引了一位方法不尋常的大師機械師的注意，她將我收為門生，並隨著時間推移，向我揭示了奧秘的真理。
正如我與你及其他追隨者分享過的，她解釋說，我們所知的世界曾屬於一個跨越星際的宏大集會（Coven）。而他們基於某種難以捉摸的邏輯，突然消失了。這導致我們的世界被施加了一道禁令。
這點你們知道。這是我所述的真相，即便僅有半數。但 Rebekah 教導了我更多。

string.ID:
Atop the implausible rise of the Spindle roosted a Seraph, one of the great machinic archons of the Eaters, and this being Rebekah served.
In the short years before I arrived in Qud, the Seraph became convinced that something had changed in the cosmic order. That along the ecliptic of the Folk Clock, some uncounted peg had slid to a priming position, and that the Coven was set to imminently return.

strings.string:
在 紡錘(Spindle) 那不可思議的高聳之上，棲息著一位熾天使（Seraph），那是「食者」（Eaters）偉大的機械執政官之一，而這位存在正為瑞貝卡（Rebekah）效力。
在我抵達 卡德(Qud) 的短短幾年內，這位熾天使深信宇宙秩序發生了變化。他認為在民俗時鐘（Folk Clock）的黃道面上，某個無法計數的齒輪已滑動到了啟動位置，而女巫集會（Coven）即將回歸。

string.ID: The Folk Clock?

strings.string: 民俗時鐘？

string.ID: The Seraph spoke of a Great Machine that spanned galaxies, the motion of whose sails and gear trains directed the fluidic shifting of stars and cultures. But they spoke little of it, and little I know.

strings.string: 熾天使談到了一台橫跨星系的巨型機器，其帆與齒輪組的運動導引著恆星與文化的流體變遷。但他們對此隻字未提，我也知之甚少。

string.ID:
{{emote|*Barathrum coughs and swallows.*}}
To ready our world for the Coven's return, the Seraph, who would be called Resheph, became convinced that all higher life on the planet must... be purged. That it was our life and way of living that moved the Coven to set the injunction. The only way through was for a new life to obtain.

strings.string:
{{emote|*巴拉楚姆(Barathrum) 咳嗽並吞嚥著。*}}
為了讓我們的世界準備好迎接女巫集會的歸來，那位將被稱為 Resheph 的熾天使深信，星球上所有高等生命都必須……被淨化。正是我們的生命與生活方式，促使了女巫集會下達禁令。唯一的出路是孕育出新的生命。

string.ID:
And so, Resheph seeded the plagues and whorled them via waveform to a breathing gyre. Blights engineered to attack life whilst preserving the planet's artifacts of glass and chrome.
Rebekah, dear tutor, betrayed Resheph's confidences and apprised me of the plan, so that I might help her dash it apart and save the peoples of our world.

strings.string:
於是，雷舍夫播下了瘟疫的種子，並透過波形將其捲入呼吸中的 環流(Gyre)。這些枯萎病被設計用來攻擊生命，同時保留星球上的玻璃與鉻合金遺跡。
親愛的導師麗貝卡背叛了雷舍夫的信任，並告知了我這個計畫，好讓我能幫助她摧毀它，拯救我們世界的人民。

string.ID: I asked for time. Give me time. To reform Qud, extinguish the hatefulness and needless warmaking, to lift our world across the eschaton and prepare it for the Coven's return...

strings.string: 我要求的是時間。給我時間。為了重塑卡德，熄滅仇恨與無謂的戰爭，為了帶領我們的世界跨越終末，並為女巫集會的歸來做好準備……

string.ID:
After a storm of shrapnel words, the Seraph acceded to ten centuries.
Ten centuries! An eyeblink on the scales of the Folk Clock but an eternity for us. So I believed.
The rousing Signal would cease, the plagues of the Gyre would be reversed, to the extent they could; for even the potent archon had not full governance over what they had worked into being.

strings.string:
在了一場碎片般的言辭風暴後，熾天使繼承了十個世紀。
十個世紀！在民俗時鐘（Folk Clock）的尺度上不過是一瞬，但對我們而言卻是永恆。我曾如此深信。
那激昂的訊號終將停止，環流的瘟疫也將盡其所能地被逆轉；因為即便是強大的執政官，也無法完全掌控他們所創造出的存在。

string.ID: What would there be for the Coven to return to, if life on our world was purged?

strings.string: 如果我們世界的生命被淨化了，女巫集會還有什麼好回歸的呢？

string.ID: Why had Resheph become sultan?

strings.string: 為什麼 Resheph 會成為蘇丹？

string.ID: Resheph is remembered as a healer.

strings.string: 雷舍夫（Resheph）被銘記為一名醫者。

string.ID: How did the agreement play out?

strings.string: 那項協議最後如何發展？

string.ID: Then you did not succeed, by Resheph's measure?

strings.string: 那麼，依據雷舍夫（Resheph）的衡量，你並未成功？

string.ID: I asked Resheph that very question. But the seraphim transit an ethical manifold much different than our own.

strings.string: 我也曾問過雷舍夫（Resheph）同樣的問題。但熾天使穿越的倫理流形與我們截然不同。

string.ID: Once the Seraph had become convinced of the Coven's return, they reified their authority and assumed a more material role in onworld matters. The decaying sultanate was a convenient tool.

strings.string: 一旦熾天使確信女巫集會已歸來，他們便具象化了自己的權威，並在世間事務中承擔起更實質的角色。那衰敗的蘇丹國是一個便利的工具。

string.ID: And he was, of a sort. The cure for a plague is often too its cause. With one's paws on the dials and drum of power, history is a cloth to be loomspun.

strings.string: 他在某種程度上確實如此。瘟疫的解藥往往也是其病因。當雙手掌控著旋鈕與力量之鼓，歷史便是一塊等待被織入機杼的布料。

string.ID:
We allied on the notion that the sultanate must be abolished for the future to flower. I was to execute the earthly plan, while Resheph continued preparations at the astronomical tier. To achieve a sort of bicameralism of action, Resheph insisted on reformatting their personality as a triumvirate, seeded from thin scans of the original archon, Rebekah, and myself.
The art of mythmaking was employed to enshrine the Resheph persona. Thus- the healer, the Coiled Lamb, and perhaps unexpectedly, the Above.

strings.string:
我們結盟是基於這樣一個觀念：為了讓未來開花結果，必須廢除蘇丹國。我負責執行塵世的計劃，而 Resheph 則在天文層繼續進行準備。為了實現某種行動上的兩院制，Resheph 堅持將其人格重新格式化為三頭政治，其種子源自對原始執政官 Rebekah 與我本人的稀薄掃描。
造神術被用於確立 Resheph 的人格。於是——醫者、捲曲之羔羊，以及或許出乎意料的，上位者。

string.ID: What happened to Rebekah?

strings.string: Rebekah 發生了什麼事？

string.ID:
{{emote|*Barathrum inhales and stutters.*}} She-
Resheph would not forgive her trespass. She contracted the rotting tongue while abetting the lepers of =RebekahRegion=. When her time came, she-

strings.string:
{{emote|*巴拉楚姆(Barathrum) 吸氣並結巴著。*}} 她——
Resheph 不會原諒她的侵犯行為。她在協助 =RebekahRegion= 的麻風病人時感染了腐爛之舌。當她的時刻來臨時，她——

string.ID:
Resheph would not let her return home. O..
{{emote|*Barathrum expels a hushed whimper.*}}

strings.string:
{{emote|*巴拉楚姆(Barathrum) expels a hushed whimper.*}}
雷舍夫不讓她回家。喔..

string.ID:
{{emote|*Barathrum whimpers.*}}
-what? Who's there?

strings.string:
{{emote|*巴拉楚姆(Barathrum) 嗚咽著。*}}
—什麼？誰在那裡？

string.ID: It is me, Barathrum. =name=.

strings.string: 是我，=name= 巴拉楚姆(Barathrum)。

string.ID: If the signal sounds and the Gyre widens again, then you did not reach whatever watermark Resheph set?

strings.string: 如果訊號響起且環流再次擴大，那麼你並沒有達到 Resheph 設定的任何水位線嗎？

string.ID: Oh. Good, =name=, good...

strings.string: 喔。很好，=name=，很好...

string.ID:
No... Qud is fractious, and no lasting peace has obtained. I tried... for decades on decades I tried our paws on the tiller, to shim together what blossomed in the wild...
The restoration of machines, the federation of free sovranties, the nourishing rituals of salt and star, the sacred, the profane...

strings.string:
不……卡德很暴躁，且沒有任何持久的和平得以實現。我曾嘗試過……幾十年又幾十年，我試圖掌控舵輪，將在荒野中綻放的事物拼湊在一起……
機器的修復、自由主權國的聯邦、鹽與星辰的滋養儀式、神聖與褻瀆……

string.ID:
In the late years I saw the writing on the wall. I turned us inward, retreated to my candle-dim study to angle at the project alone. A new plan... {{emote|*eeehw*}} was-
{{emote|*Barathrum starts panting.*}}

strings.string:
在晚年，我看到了牆上的預兆。我讓我們轉向內心，退縮到燭光昏暗的書房中，獨自鑽研這個計畫。一個新的計畫…… {{emote|*eeehw*}} 是——
{{emote|*巴拉楚姆(Barathrum) starts panting.*}}

string.ID: {{emote|*Barathrum heaves a great sigh upon the moist air of the control pit.*}} {{emote|*Barathrum stumbles to the floor with paws to his face.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*巴拉楚姆(Barathrum) 在控制坑潮濕的空氣中重重地嘆了一口氣。*}} {{emote|*巴拉楚姆(Barathrum) 用爪子捂著臉，踉蹌地倒在地上。*}}

string.ID:
I failed it! I have failed! A thousand years too short, and- MORE TIME
{{emote|*Barathrum weeps.*}}

strings.string:
我失敗了！我失敗了！一千年的時間太短，而且——需要更多時間
{{emote|*巴拉楚姆在哭泣。}}

string.ID: I am debased on the plank across the light of God! d- do I have a rightful claim to pity? Blindness! This darkling room abjures the light. Is this the House of Judgement, Hortensa? Or mere penumbra, the child's playcave, and law and language (not yet invented) cast their forcing functions back through time to puppet the unblossomed mind to civilized shape...

strings.string: 我在上帝之光下的木板上墮落了！我——我有權要求憐憫嗎？盲目！這黑暗的房間排斥著光。這是審判之屋嗎，霍騰莎？抑或僅是半影，那孩童的遊戲洞穴，而法律與語言（尚未被發明）將其強制功能投射回過去，以操縱未開化的心靈塑造成文明的模樣……

string.ID: Each of us is a sick animal in a darkling thicket. Each cursed with machinery to compress the clamber of echoes into bees, mothers, mountains, country. How many millions of snowsick years to sew a feeling substance into an agent of the world! A felt and machine animal, and in so doing, to stuff the whole of the world inside the agent (an inarguable document of its falsity), for agency is in its very definition the world in containment acting on itself...

strings.string: 我們每個人都是黑暗叢林中的病態野獸。每個人都帶著詛咒般的機械，將迴聲的喧囂壓縮成蜜蜂、母親、山脈、國度。需要多少個雪病交織的歲月，才能將一種感知的實質縫合進世界的代理人之中！一個既有感知又有機械的生物，藉此將整個世界的內部塞進代理人之中（這本身就是其虛假性的不爭證據），因為「代理權」在其定義中，便是被包含在內的、作用於自身的環境...

string.ID: {{emote|*Barathrum weeps.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*巴拉楚姆在哭泣。*}}

string.ID: {{emote|*Barathrum weeps.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*巴拉楚姆在哭泣。*}}

string.ID: Why ascend the Spindle then? For what purpose?

strings.string: 既然如此，為何要攀登紡錘？是為了什麼目的？

string.ID:
{{emote|*Barathrum's countenance suddenly burns bright.*}}
Did you know, =name=, I harbor a memory older than even the flooding of my hearth cave. A gleaming ancient tale, told by my elders to the nippy cub I once was...

strings.string:
{{emote|*巴拉楚姆的 countenance 突然變得明亮。*}}
你知道嗎，=name=，我心中懷著一個比我爐灶洞穴被淹沒還要古老的記憶。那是一個閃耀的古老傳說，由我的長輩們講述給我曾經那隻活潑的小獸聽……

string.ID:
In the age of the covenate, a coterie of our urshiib ancestors took to the stars to ply their burning cores! Can you envision it??
Ho, ho! I know a secret! Heh, heh! I know... there is a functioning starship atop the Spindle. We can take it, =name=! We launch ourselves into the deepness of the dusted cosmos and find the starshiib! You and I, ho ho!
Starshiib!

strings.string:
在盟約時代，我們 urshiib 祖先的一個小圈子前往星際，去運用他們燃燒的核心！你能想像嗎？？
嚯，嚯！我知道一個秘密！嘿，嘿！我知道……在紡錘頂端有一艘功能完好的星艦。我們可以奪取它，=name=！我們將把自己發射到塵封宇宙的深處，尋找 星之熊族！你和我，嚯 嚯！
Starshiib！

string.ID: Barathrum, we're to rest the fate of Qud on a mere cub's tale?

strings.string: 巴拉楚姆(Barathrum)，我們要將卡德的命運寄託在一個幼崽的故事上嗎？
星艦？

string.ID: Starshiib! Starshiib! Starshiib!

strings.string: 星艦！星艦！星艦！
巴拉楚姆(Barathrum).
Starshiib！

string.ID: Starshiib! Starshiib! Starshiib! Starshiib! Starshiib! Starshiib! Starshiib! Starshiib! Starshiib! Starshiib! Starshiib! Starshiib! Starshiib! Starshiib! Starshiib! Starshiib!

strings.string: 星艦！星艦！星艦！星艦！星艦！星艦！星艦！星艦！星艦！星艦！星艦！星艦！星艦！星艦！星艦！星艦！

string.ID: Should you be here, =player.offspringTerm=?

strings.string: 若你在此處，=player.offspringTerm=?

string.ID: My apologies, Barathrum.

strings.string: 很抱歉，巴拉楚姆(Barathrum)。

string.ID: Is that you, nestling =name=? Are you returned from gate and Tomb? Come closer, I say.

strings.string: 是妳嗎，小傢伙 =name=? 妳從門戶與墳墓歸來了嗎？過來點，我說。

string.ID: It is, Barathrum. I've returned.

strings.string: 就在這裡，巴拉楚姆(Barathrum)。我回來了。

string.ID: You appear... refreshed. My old eyes spy the swim lines of the waking world and to you they cede precedence. A newness obtains.

strings.string: 你看起來……神清氣爽。我這雙老眼看著覺醒世界的泳道，而對你而言，它們已退居其次。一種嶄新的感覺油然而生。

string.ID: Outside of time I found myself in a place of light. I chose to return and was made new.

strings.string: 在時間之外，我發現自己置身於一片光芒之中。我選擇回歸，並獲得了新生。

string.ID: I found Brightsheol, where it lies beyond the Tomb. I spoke to the Shomer there and arranged for the disablement of the Spindle's magnets.

strings.string: 我在墳墓之外找到了布萊特希歐。我在那裡與修默人（Shomer）交談，並安排了停用紡錘的磁鐵。

string.ID: Over there, by your workbench. Is that... Pax Klanq?

strings.string: 就在那邊，你的 工作檯 旁邊。那是... 派克斯克蘭克 嗎？

string.ID: There is junk about.

strings.string: 周圍有一些廢棄物。

string.ID:
{{emote|*Barathrum pauses.*}}
It is. For reasons I will explain shortly, for reasons beyond any of our remits, Klanq has returned to Grit Gate.

strings.string:
{{emote|*巴拉楚姆(Barathrum) 停頓了一下。*}}
確實如此。由於我稍後會解釋的原因，也由於任何超出我們職權範圍的原因，克蘭克(Klanq) 已回到了 礫門(Grit Gate)。

string.ID: I've something else to say.

strings.string: 我還有其他話要說。

string.ID:
{{emote|*Barathrum pauses.*}}
Unusual circumstances have put my study in disarray. Lamentable, this is, but necessary.

strings.string:
{{emote|*巴拉楚姆(Barathrum) 停頓了一下。*}}
異常的情況讓我的研究陷入混亂。雖然令人遺憾，但這是必要的。

string.ID: I've something else to say.

strings.string: 我還有其他話要說。

string.ID:
{{emote|*Barathrum pauses.*}}
I am confident there is a richness of wisdom in the poetry of that statement. One day, I will be eager to discover it. For now, what of the Spindle?

strings.string:
{{emote|*巴拉楚姆(Barathrum) 停頓了一下。*}}
我相信那段詩句中蘊含著豐富的智慧。總有一天，我會渴望去發掘它。目前，關於那個紡錘呢？

string.ID: *continue listening*

strings.string: *繼續聆聽*

string.ID: Take this, too. A chute of morphing gel from my personal collection. You've arrayed yourself in the artifacts of time, and so we have little left to give you. But still, this may be useful.

strings.string: 把這個也拿走吧。這是我私人收藏中的一管變形凝膠。你已經裝備了時代的遺物，所以我們所剩能給你的不多了。但即便如此，這或許會有用。

string.ID: *continue listening*

strings.string: *繼續聆聽*

string.ID: Now, matters have... evolved... in your absence. Do you choose now to learn more?

strings.string: 現在，在你不在的時候……事情有了……進展。你現在選擇要了解更多嗎？

string.ID: I do.

strings.string: 我做。

string.ID: First, I need rest.

strings.string: 首先，我需要休息。

string.ID: High on the mount above Omonporch, the Putus Templar watch us through their war lenses and prepare an attack. The nephilim, too, stir from their cradles on the Moon Stair and slump with infernal purpose. The short of this is, due to a dearth of prep time and inadequate armament, Pax Klanq no longer believes in the viability of Q Girl's climber design. We must take Klanq at their word, here...

strings.string: 在歐蒙波奇上方的山頂，普圖斯聖騎士正透過他們的戰爭透鏡注視著我們，並準備發動攻擊。尼非林也在月之階梯的搖籃中甦醒，帶著地獄般的目的而沉重地起身。簡而言之，由於缺乏準備時間且武裝不足，派克斯克蘭克不再相信 Q 女孩攀爬者設計的可行性。我們在此必須相信 克蘭克(Klanq) 的話...

string.ID: *continue listening*

strings.string: *繼續聆聽*

string.ID: This disheartens us, but there is another hope. Klanq has offered up a new design, something unconventional at all angles. And, despite our early misgivings, Q Girl and I now work in assistance to the project...

strings.string: 這讓我們感到沮喪，但仍有另一線希望。克蘭克(Klanq) 提供了一個新設計，一個從各個角度來看都極不尋常的方案。儘管我們最初有所疑慮，但我與 Q 女孩現在正致力於協助這個計畫……

string.ID: *continue listening*

strings.string: *繼續聆聽*

string.ID: A new creature struggles to be born, =name=, and you will help birth it. Then, it will carry us, you and I, to the top of the Spindle.

strings.string: 一個新的生物正掙扎著要誕生，那就是 =name=，而你將協助它降生。接著，它將帶著我們——你和我——前往 紡錘(Spindle) 的頂端。

string.ID:
Pax Klanq will mold the creature from raw bioelectrical materials. You must gather these entrails: the body as a model, the catalyst to charge the sanguine fluid, the atzmus as deistic direction, the armament for protection, and the hamsa for personality. You will bond with the creature, too, and act as its pilot. So you must speak an incantation to inscribe the connection.
You'll also need to procure the sanguine fluid itself. And, too, a power source shielded from electromagnetic attacks.

strings.string:
派克斯克蘭克會利用原始的生物電材料來塑造生物。你必須收集這些內臟：作為模型的身體、為血液流動充電的催化劑、作為神性引導的阿茲穆斯（atzmus）、用於防護的武裝，以及用於人格的漢薩（hamsa）。你也將與該生物連結，並擔任其駕駛者。因此你必須誦唸咒語來刻下這份連結。
你還需要取得血液流動本身。此外，還需要一個能屏蔽電磁攻擊的能源。

string.ID: These entrails, what are they? Where do I find them?

strings.string: 這些內臟是什麼？我在哪裡可以找到它們？

string.ID: These entrails, what are they? Where do I find them?

strings.string: 這些內臟是什麼？我在哪裡可以找到它們？

string.ID: I'm to pilot the creature? And bond with it?

strings.string: 我要駕駛這個生物？還要與它連結？

string.ID: Sanguine fluid?

strings.string: 鮮血流體？

string.ID: A power source?

strings.string: 能源來源？

string.ID: Let us begin, then.

strings.string: 那麼，讓我們開始吧。

string.ID: I need time and space from this.

strings.string: 我需要從這件事中抽離，尋求片刻的安寧。

string.ID: I wish to ask about something else.

strings.string: 我想詢問其他事情。

string.ID:
They are the components that we will grow, shape, and solder into the ascendant being. We can delve into specifics once you begin, at which point Pax Klanq can also serve as a source of knowledge.
As you acquire components, bring them to the mound of scrap and clay over by Klanq.

strings.string:
它們是我們將會生長、塑造並焊接成昇華生命體的組成部分。一旦你開始，我們可以深入探討細節，屆時 派克斯克蘭克 也可以作為知識的來源。
當你獲得組件時，請將它們帶到 克蘭克(Klanq) 旁邊的 廢料與黏土堆。

string.ID:
They are the components that we will grow, shape, and solder into the ascendant being. Ask Pax Klanq for details.
As you acquire components, bring them to the mound of scrap and clay over by Klanq.

strings.string:
這些是我們將會培育、塑形並焊接成升華生命體的組件。詳情請詢問 派克斯克蘭克。
當你獲得組件時，請將它們帶到 克蘭克(Klanq) 旁邊的 廢料與黏土堆。

string.ID:
Correct. The creature will be shaped broad enough to contain two, but only you will be bonded to it. Only you will pilot.
Don't fear over an inescapable tether, though. The creature will be mobile unpiloted, if slower to act.

strings.string:
沒錯。該生物會被塑造成足以容納兩個個體的寬度，但只有你會與它連結。只有你會進行操控。
不過，不必為那無法逃脫的束縛感到恐懼。該生物在無人操控時仍能移動，只是行動較慢。

string.ID: Primordial soup, to be catalyzed and ran through its arteries as the animating substance.

strings.string: 原始湯，將作為催化劑並流經其動脈，成為賦予生命的力量。

string.ID:
Yes, the question of power is a trickier one. Our standard power sources might suffice, but they would be vulnerable to electromagnetic attacks on the ascent, and we believe it within the competency of the Putus Templar to execute such an attack.
This leaves us two options. Klanq and Q Girl have worked out a design for a neutronic battery, free from vulnerabilities on the EM spectrum. But it requires 3 drams of neutron flux. The alternative is remote power, but to carry us across the Spindle's length the source would have to be extraordinary. I would look to Chavvah, the Tree of Life, for a psychic quickening. Reports tell of the resumption of their roaming across the Moon Stair. Seek the trunk at Eyn Roj to begin your investigation, if that's the path you choose.

strings.string:
是的，權力的問題更為棘手。我們的標準能源或許足夠，但在上升過程中它們容易受到電磁攻擊，而我們相信 普圖斯聖騎士 有能力執行此類攻擊。
這讓我們有兩個選擇。克蘭克(Klanq) 和 Q 女孩 已經設計出了一種中子電池，不受電磁頻譜的脆弱性影響。但它需要 3 德蘭 的中子通量。另一個選擇是遠程能源，但要帶領我們跨越 紡錘的 長度，能源必須非同尋常。我會尋求 生命之樹，查法 來獲得心靈上的啟迪。報告顯示他們已重新開始在 月之階梯 上遊歷。如果你選擇這條路，請前往 恩羅傑 尋找樹幹以展開調查。

string.ID:
Yes, =name=! Begin the gathering, and the molding will follow. The materials you choose will influence the being we create, but any such being will be suitable for ascent.
This is our last task before we make our historic climb, =name=. Be safe and well in doing it. If you have more questions, return here. Klanq and I will be available.

strings.string:
是的，=name=！開始收集吧，隨後便能進行塑形。你選擇的材料將影響我們所創造的生命，但任何這樣的生命都將適合晉升。
這是我們進行歷史性攀登前的最後一項任務，=name=。執行時請務必注意安全與健康。若有更多疑問，請回到這裡。克蘭克(Klanq) 與我都會在這裡。
好的。

string.ID: The creature is born, and you are bonded? What work! You are a sterling shaper of world, =name=, and I've nothing left to give you but my praise.

strings.string: 生物誕生了，而你竟然與之建立了連結？多麼了不起的工作！你是個卓越的世界塑造者，=name=，除了讚美之外，我已別無可給。

string.ID:
Now, our operators at Omonporch confirm that a clash with the Templar is inevitable.
This is a grim fact, but it does give space for your bond to flower. Go, become familiar with leading and piloting your creature. Return when you are ready, and we will finally go starward.

strings.string:
現在，我們在歐蒙波奇的操作員確認，與聖騎士的衝突已不可避免。
這是一個嚴峻的事實，但這也為你們的情誼開花結果提供了空間。去吧，熟悉如何領導並操控你的生物。準備好後再回來，屆時我們將最終前往星際。

string.ID: I will, Barathrum. Live and drink.

strings.string: 我會的，巴拉楚姆(Barathrum)。活下去，盡情飲酒吧。

string.ID: Are you sure, Meyvn =name=? Our fates are not reversible past the next event horizon.

strings.string: 你確定嗎，Meyvn =name=? 在下一個事件視界之前，我們的命運是無法逆轉的。

string.ID: Let me consider.

strings.string: 讓我考慮一下。

string.ID: We go.

strings.string: 我們走。

string.ID: We go. I-

strings.string:
我們走。我—
7. *讀取中*

string.ID: O! What is it? I heave... I heave the weight of ass across my crutch, but the bones are pullproof. My bones inosculate to this grotto, or rather- this grotto, this world is what my bones *are*. Can an old bear divest of his spine, leave it to mosses and the sunstrung birds?

strings.string: 噢！這是什麼？我用力地... 我用拐杖撐起這身沉重的軀殼，但骨頭卻紋絲不動。我的骨骼與這座洞窟交織在一起，或者該說——這座洞窟、這個世界，就是我的骨骼本身。難道一隻老熊能脫離他的脊椎，將其留給苔蘚和陽光下的鳥嗎？

string.ID:
I...
No matter. The will can break the wheel, too. We go. Pray, the weightloss of the rise might do good for me. Past the shell of the world, I'm to understand one's burdens can no longer pull them down...

strings.string:
我……
沒關係。意志也能粉碎輪迴。我們走吧。祈禱著，升起的減重或許對我有好處。穿過世界的殼，據我所知，一個人的負擔將不再能將其拖入深淵……

string.ID: Klanq is able to answer your questions. You received an operating manual, too, no? Perhaps you could reference it.

strings.string: 克蘭克(Klanq) 能回答您的問題。您也收到了一份操作手冊，不是嗎？或許您可以參考一下。

string.ID: Come closer, nestling. Let me look upon your countenance.

strings.string: 靠近些，小傢伙。讓我看看你的容貌。

string.ID: You are so... old.

strings.string: 妳真的好……老。

string.ID: Otho said you wished to speak with me.

strings.string: 奧托 說你想找我談談。

string.ID: What's with the houseplant over there?

strings.string: 那邊的那盆室內植物是怎麼回事？

string.ID: Please tell me about the signal again.

strings.string: 請再跟我說一次關於訊號的事。

string.ID: Please tell me about the signal again.

strings.string: 請再跟我說一次關於訊號的事。

string.ID: I convinced Pax Klanq to construct the climber.

strings.string: 我說服了 派克斯克蘭克 去建造攀爬者。

string.ID: Pax Klanq has agreed to build the climber. What now?

strings.string: 派克斯克蘭克 已同意建造攀爬者。接下來該怎麼做？

string.ID: Could you tell me again about the Tomb of the Eaters?

strings.string: 你能再跟我說一次關於食者之墓的事嗎？

string.ID: The magnetic field has been disabled and the Spindle is free to ascend. What now?

strings.string: 磁場已被禁用，紡錘(Spindle) 已能自由上升。接下來呢？

string.ID: Tell me again of the plan to mold a giant creature to ascend the Spindle.

strings.string: 再跟我說一次那個塑造巨型生物以攀升紡錘的計畫吧。

string.ID: The creature has been made. What now?

strings.string: 生物已被造就。接下來呢？

string.ID: Tell me again how the giant creature functions.

strings.string: 再跟我說一次，那隻巨型生物是如何運作的。

string.ID: I am ready to ascend the Spindle, Barathrum.

strings.string: 我已準備好攀登紡錘，巴拉楚姆(Barathrum)。

string.ID: Live and drink, eldest Barathrum.

strings.string: 盡情生活與飲酒吧，長子巴拉楚姆。

string.ID: What can I offer, nestling?

strings.string: 我能給你什麼呢，小傢伙？

string.ID: You look... refreshed. Thank you, =name=. Take this polygel we recently recovered from the Palladium Reef.

strings.string: 你看起來...神清氣爽。謝謝你，=name=。拿著這個聚合物凝膠，這是我們最近從 鈀金礁 回收的。

string.ID: Live and drink, Barathrum.

strings.string: 盡情生活與飲酒吧，巴拉楚姆(Barathrum)。

string.ID: What welcome news, =factionaddress:Barathrumites=! Please, take this as a token of my gratitude.

strings.string: 多麼令人欣慰的消息，=factionaddress:Barathrumites=！請收下這個，以表我的感激之情。

string.ID: Thank you.

strings.string: 謝謝你。

string.ID: The flywheel of our scheme is spinning, but we must keep our paws on the treadle. Are you ready to learn what comes next?

strings.string: 我們計畫的飛輪正在旋轉，但我們必須緊握踏板。你準備好學習接下來會發生什麼了嗎？
是的。

string.ID: I need time on my own first.

strings.string: 我需要先獨處一段時間。

string.ID:
The climber design relies on the use of electromagnets to interface with the planet's magnetic field and generate torque. Unfortunately, the Spindle generates its own interfering field, perhaps as a mechanism to prevent unwanted ascension.
Our aim is to access the Spindle's control unit and disable the field. How we accomplish this, however, is an enigma. From disparate bits across the archives of the digitum, Ereshkigal has stitched together a cryptic but instructional brocade. She's learned the field can be turned off from a place called Brightsheol, located in the Thin World and accessible only through Resheph's tomb inside the Tomb of the Eaters.

strings.string:
攀爬者的設計依賴於利用電磁鐵與行星磁場進行交互並產生轉矩。不幸的是，紡錘(Spindle) 會產生自身的干擾場，這或許是為了防止不必要的上升而設計的機制。
我們的目標是進入 紡錘的 控制單元並禁用該磁場。然而，我們如何達成此目標仍是一個謎團。從 數位寶庫 檔案庫中散落的碎片裡，Ereshkigal 縫合出了一段晦澀但具指導意義的錦緞。她得知該磁場可以從一個名為 布萊特希歐 的地方關閉，該地位於 薄世界，且只能透過食者之墓 內部 的 Resheph 之墓進入。

string.ID:
Strange, this, and imprecise, but as tinkers we know: a crude blueprint is better than no blueprint. You must return to Omonporch and enter the Tomb of the Eaters. Once inside, trace the errant paths cut into the mausoleum by robbers and vandals, and ascend to Resheph's burial chamber.
As for gaining entrance to the Tomb, Resheph sealed the gates a thousand years ago, but there's a flaw in the seal. The ancient Mark of Death has been lost to time, but if you were to recover it and incise the mark on your body, the Death Gate would open for you, as it did for countless Eater cadavers in the long-blurred past.
Recover the Mark of Death, =name=, enter the Tomb, and cross into Brightsheol. Place your paws once again on the dial and drum.

strings.string:
這很奇怪，也不夠精確，但作為 修補匠 我們知道：一份粗略的藍圖總比沒有好。你必須回到 歐蒙波奇(Omonporch) 並進入食者之墓。一旦進入 內部，請沿著盜賊與破壞者在陵墓中開闢出的錯誤路徑前行，並登上 Resheph 的埋葬室。
至於進入墳墓的方法，Resheph 在一千年前封印了門戶，但封印存在缺陷。古老的死亡印記已隨時間流逝而失落，但如果你能找回它並將印記刻在你的身上，死亡之門(Death Gate) 就會為你開啟，就像在漫長模糊的過去為無數食者屍骸所做的一樣。
找回死亡印記，=name=，進入墳墓，並跨越到 布萊特希歐。再次將你的爪子放在撥盤與鼓上。

string.ID: I will enter the Tomb of the Eaters as you ask.

strings.string: 我會按照你的要求進入食者之墓。

string.ID: You ask so much. I must consider it.

strings.string: 你要求太多了。我必須考慮一下。

string.ID: As I'd hoped you would, =name=. Take this disk with the signal encoded, just in case. And take this tattoo gun for when you recover the Mark of Death. You'll want to bring a pickaxe, too, or some other instrument for digging through stone. And beware: the Tomb is a vast and ancient space, and sacred to many. I cannot speak to what you will experience there.

strings.string: =name=，正如我所希望的那樣。帶上這片編碼了訊號的圓盤，以防萬一。並帶上這把紋身槍，以便你在找回死亡印記時使用。你也需要帶上一把十字鎬，或其他挖掘岩石的工具。還有，務必小心：那座墳墓是一個巨大且古老的空間，對許多人而言是神聖之地。我無法預知你在那裡會經歷什麼。

string.ID: I heed your warning. Farewell, Barathrum.

strings.string: 我會聽從你的警告。再見了，巴拉楚姆(Barathrum)。

string.ID:

Our aim is to access the Spindle's control unit and disable the field. How we accomplish this, however, is an enigma. From disparate bits across the archives of the digitum, Ereshkigal has stitched together a cryptic but instructional brocade. She's learned the field can be turned off from a place called Brightsheol, located in the Thin World and accessible only through Resheph's tomb inside the Tomb of the Eaters.

The ancient Mark of Death has been lost to time, but if you were to recover it and incise the mark on your body, the Death Gate would open for you, as it did for countless Eater cadavers in the long-blurred past.
You're to recover the Mark of Death, =name=, enter the Tomb, and cross into Brightsheol.

strings.string:
這很奇怪且不夠精確，但作為 修補匠 我們知道：一份粗略的藍圖總比沒有好。你必須回到 歐蒙波奇(Omonporch) 並進入食者之墓。一旦進入 內部，循著盜賊與破壞者在陵墓中鑿出的錯誤路徑，向上攀升至 Resheph 的埋葬室。
至於進入陵墓的方法，Resheph 在千年前封印了門戶，但封印存在缺陷。古老的死亡印記已隨時間流逝而失傳，但如果你能找回它並將印記刻在身上，死亡之門(Death Gate) 就會為你開啟，就像在漫長模糊的過去，為無數食者的屍骸所做的那樣。
你要找回死亡印記，=name=，進入陵墓，並跨越到 布萊特希歐。

string.ID: Use the tattoo gun I've given you when you recover the Mark of Death. You'll want to bring a pickaxe, too, or some other instrument for digging through stone. And beware: the Tomb is a vast and ancient space, and sacred to many. I cannot speak to what you will experience there.

strings.string: 當你找回死亡印記時，使用我給你的刺青槍。你也需要帶上一把十字鎬，或其他用來挖掘岩石的工具。還有要小心：這座墳墓是一個巨大且古老的空間，對許多人來說是神聖之地。我無法預知你在那裡會經歷什麼。

string.ID: I have more to ask, Barathrum.

strings.string: 我還有更多問題要問，巴拉楚姆(Barathrum)。

string.ID: So I am, nestling. For a millennium now I've watched the river of Time turn the gears of Qud. I even played my part in diverting the river where I could. Oh, but there have been so many players through the years! So many players.

strings.string: 我就是如此，小傢伙。千年來，我一直注視著時間之河轉動卡德的齒輪。我也曾在力所能及之處參與了分流河流的工作。喔，但這些年來出現了這麼多玩家！這麼多玩家。

string.ID: And before Qud? Beyond the 1,000 years?

strings.string: 而且在 卡德(Qud) 之前？在 1,000 年之前？

string.ID: Little do I remember now, for I was but a cub, a nestling, when my kin and I crossed the Homs Delta into Qud. We were urged on by the flooding of a glacial river that flowed through our hearth-cave. The world was just unthawing then, and I recall the roar of the freezing water as it rushed through the grotto, and the frigid spray on my face as I watched in awe.

strings.string: 我現在記不太清了，因為當我和族人穿過 Homs Delta 進入卡德時，我還只是個幼崽、一個巢雛。我們是被流經我們家園洞穴的冰河洪水所驅使著前進。那時世界才剛開始解凍，我還記得冰冷的水流衝過洞窟時的咆哮聲，以及我敬畏地注視著時，濺在臉上的寒冷水霧。

string.ID: That's my dear friend, Euclid. It's a prattleplant. It stores every phrase it hears in its neuroot network, and it mimics speech by flicking its leaves against one another. What comes out is gibberish as often as not, but even so, it's agreeable company for my nights spent tinkering. It is old, perhaps older than I am, and it hasn't yet run out of things to say.

strings.string: 那是我的好朋友，歐幾里得。它是一株喋喋不休植物。它將聽到的每一句話都儲存在它的神經根網絡中，並透過葉片互相拍打來模仿說話。雖然吐出的內容往往是胡言亂語，但即便如此，它仍是我熬夜鑽研時愉快的伴侶。它很老了，或許比我還老，而且它至今還沒把想說的話說完。

string.ID:
I do. Your service to the guild has been laudable, =factionaddress:Barathrumites=. You braved the vaporous depths of Bethesda Susa and decoded the signal, you secured the Spindlegrounds and handled the self-appointed Earl, and perhaps most materially, you defended our enclave from the Putus Templar.
Since you returned from Bethesda, you've no doubt wondered at the signal's contents. Verily, I hid them to shield you from the weight of the truth. Only Otho, Q Girl, and I bear that burden, but circumstances have changed. The river of Time powers the gear train of our schemes and devices, and it rushes forth. From here, I must share the burden. You must know.

strings.string:
我確實如此。=factionaddress:Barathrumites=，你對公會的貢獻值得讚賞。你勇闖了 貝賽達蘇薩(Bethesda Susa) 的蒸氣深處並解碼了訊號，你確保了 Spindlegrounds 的安全並處理了那位自封的伯爵，而或許最關鍵的是，你從 Putus Templar 手中保衛了我們的聚落。
自從你從 Bethesda 回來後，想必一直對訊號的內容感到好奇。事實上，我隱藏了它們，是為了讓你免於承受真相的重擔。唯有 Otho、Q Girl 與我承擔著這份責任，但情況已經改變了。「時間」之河驅動著我們計畫與裝置的齒輪組，且正奔騰而來。從這裡開始，我必須分享這份重擔。你必須知道真相。

string.ID: What is it? Where does the signal come from, and what does it say?

strings.string: 那是什麽？訊號從哪裡傳來，內容又是什麼？

string.ID: The signal is a beacon of welcoming, and it originates from the top of the Spindle.

strings.string: 訊號是歡迎的信標，且源自於紡錘的頂端。

string.ID: And what is the Spindle, truly?

strings.string: 而那個紡錘，究竟是什麼？

string.ID:
The beacon confirmed my hypothesis. The Spindle is an elevator, engineered by the Eaters to convey freight to and from the vault of heaven. You see, nestling, in the earliest aurora of our past, the Eaters of Earth were joined by a great coven of beings that spanned the firmament. But the Eaters succumbed to some terrible temptation, and an injunction was placed on our world.
Since then, the stars were silent to us, and our world was left to molder and decay. But something changed. The signal affirms that an entity roosts atop the Spindle, and invites us to join it.
Dare I say, is the injunction at an end? It's too early to tell, but alas, there could be hope for our world.

strings.string:
信標證實了我的假設。紡錘是一個電梯，由食者（Eaters）設計，用於在天堂寶庫與外界之間運送貨物。你看，孩子，在我們過去最早的曙光中，地球的食者們與一群橫跨天際的偉大集會成員結合在一起。但食者屈服於某種可怕的誘惑，我們的世界因此被施加了禁令。
從那時起，星辰對我們保持沉默，我們的世界被任由腐朽與衰敗。但有些事情改變了。訊號證實有一個實體棲息在 紡錘(Spindle) 之頂，並邀請我們加入它。
我敢說，禁令是否已經結束？現在下結論還太早，但唉，我們的世界或許仍有希望。

string.ID: And what now?

strings.string: 現在該怎麼辦？

string.ID: I have more to ask, Barathrum.

strings.string: 我還有更多問題要問，巴拉楚姆(Barathrum)。

string.ID:
I intend to ascend the Spindle and answer the call, =factionaddress:Barathrumites=.
My protege {{m|Q Girl}} has designed a climber for the ascent. We intended to construct it piecewise at the enclave and the site itself, but the engineering feat exceeds even our capacity. With time, I am confident we could accomplish it, but the Putus Templar rob us of our patience. We need to act now, and so as loath as I am to admit it, we need Pax Klanq.

strings.string:
我打算攀登紡錘（紡錘(Spindle)）並回應那聲召喚，=factionaddress:Barathrumites=。
我的門生 {{m|Q Girl}} 為這次攀登設計了一台攀爬器。我們原打算在聚落與現場分階段建造它，但這項工程壯舉甚至超出了我們的能力。隨著時間推移，我有信心我們可以完成，但普圖斯聖騎士（Putus Templar）剝奪了我們的耐心。我們現在必須採取行動，因此儘管我極不情願承認，我們需要 Pax 克蘭克(Klanq)。

string.ID: Who is Pax Klanq?

strings.string: 誰是 派克斯克蘭克?

string.ID:
Pax Klanq is an eccentric mushroom prodigy. All their faults aside, they are a brilliant scientist and engineer, and I have little doubt that they could build the climber faster than we could. Several years have passed since we were last in contact, but they owe us a debt, and we must now collect.
Unfortunately, no one knows Pax Klanq's whereabouts. Through contacts I made over the years, I inquired as to their location. The most I was able to garner were these enigmatic instructions:
"Seek the heart of the rainbow, eat the god's flesh, and follow the Coral Path."

strings.string:
派克斯克蘭克是一位古怪的蘑菇天才。撇開所有的缺點不談，他們是一位卓越的科學家和工程師，我毫不懷疑他們能比我們更快地建造出攀爬者。自我們上次聯繫以來已經過了幾年，但他們欠我們一份債，現在我們必須收回。
不幸的是，沒人知道派克斯克蘭克的行蹤。透過我多年來建立的人脈，我詢問了他們的所在地。我所能獲得的最多僅是這些神祕的指示：
「尋找彩虹之心，吞食神之肉，並追隨珊瑚徑。」

string.ID: *continue listening*

strings.string: *繼續聆聽*

string.ID:
I must ask you to decipher this enigma, find Pax Klanq, and convince them to construct the climber. Remind Pax of the debt they owe us.
It strikes me as likely for this 'rainbow' to refer to the Rainbow Wood, where Klanq's kin consort, so I suggest you start there.

strings.string:
我必須請你解開這個謎團，找到 派克斯克蘭克，並說服他們建造攀爬者。提醒 Pax 他們欠我們的債。
我覺得這個「彩虹」很可能指的是 彩虹之林，那是 克蘭克(Klanq) 的親族聚集之處，所以我建議你從那裡開始。

string.ID: I will find Pax Klanq and deliver Q Girl's design.

strings.string: 我會找到 派克斯克蘭克 並交付 Q 女孩的設計。

string.ID: I must weigh everything you've told me.

strings.string: 我必須權衡你告訴我的一切。

string.ID:
As I had hoped, =factionaddress:Barathrumites=. First, speak with Q Girl. She'll hand over her design.
I await your return.

strings.string:
正如我所期望的，=factionaddress:Barathrumites=。首先，與 Q Girl 交談。她會交出她的設計圖。
我等待你的歸來。

string.ID: Live and drink, Barathrum.

strings.string: 盡情生活與飲酒吧，巴拉楚姆(Barathrum)。
*讀取中*

string.ID:
THOU ART SAT IN THE MOVEMENTS OF THE GREAT SIACH, AND I BEFORE THEE.
WHEREFORE ART THOU?

strings.string:
汝坐於偉大西亞克（SIACH）之律動之中，而我亦在汝之前。
汝身在何方？

string.ID: Resheph! You are the Seraph atop the Spindle?

strings.string: Resheph！你是紡錘頂端的熾天使嗎？

string.ID: Resheph, the plagues of the Gyre have returned. Can you help annul them once again?

strings.string: Resheph，環流的瘟疫已經回歸。你能再次幫助消除它們嗎？

string.ID: I am here on account of your Gyre and its plagues. Hear me, I ask.

strings.string: 我來到這裡，是因為妳的環流及其瘟疫。聽我說，我有所請求。

string.ID: I am here on account of your Gyre and its plagues. Hear me, I ask.

strings.string: 我來到這裡，是因為妳的環流及其瘟疫。聽我說，我有所請求。

string.ID: Through great labors I ascended the Spindle, and now wish to know more of our world and worlds surrounding. Will you tell?

strings.string: 透過艱辛的勞作，我升華成了 紡錘(Spindle)，現在渴望了解更多關於我們及周遭世界的事。你願意告訴我嗎？

string.ID: I cannot abide what you've done, and so come to smash order out of thee.

strings.string: 我無法容忍你的所作所為，因此前來摧毀你以建立秩序。

string.ID: {{emote|*Tremble in fear.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*因恐懼而顫抖。*}}
*讀取中*
*讀取中*

string.ID: COHERING... AS THE FRIGID SPRAY TO THE BLOCK OF ICE. 'TIS COLD!

strings.string: 凝聚中……猶如冰冷的噴霧濺向冰塊。好冷！

string.ID:
PHANTASM'D O'RE THE THIN BOUNDARY?? 'TIS BEEN A TICK.
AND THOU, CHILD? THOU ART WHO OFF'D THE FLOW AHIND GJAUS.

strings.string:
幻象越過了那道薄弱的邊界？？已經過了一會兒了。
而你呢，孩子？是誰終結了 GJAUS 後方的流動？

string.ID:
THOU ART SAT IN THE MOVEMENTS OF THE GREAT SIACH, AND I BEFORE THEE.
THOU ART AN IMPRESSIVE BEAD TO BE DRAWN UP GJAUS BY THY OWN SPIT AND WILES.
WHO ART THOU?

strings.string:
汝坐於偉大西亞克（SIACH）的律動之中，而我也在汝面前。
汝竟能憑藉自身的唾液與詭計，成為一顆足以被 GJAUS 抽起的壯麗珠飾。
汝究竟是誰？

string.ID: I am =name=.

strings.string: 我是 =name=。

string.ID: EGREGORE OR ONE-WISE?

strings.string: 心靈體還是唯一智者？
心靈伴侶
唯智者。
什麼？

string.ID: AY, A WORLD-ARCHON IN SERAPH CASTE, STIRRED BY THE MOVEMENTS OF THE GREAT SIACH.

strings.string: 哎，一位身處熾天使階級的世界執政官，正因大賽亞赫（Great Siach）的變動而蠢蠢欲動。

string.ID: NAY, FOR I SET THEM A-WHORLING. THE SIDEREAL EON DRAWTH DONE, AND THE COVEN DOTH RETURN. THE NOOSPHERE MUST BE TILLED ERE THEY ARRIVE.

strings.string: 不，因為我令它們旋轉起來。星際紀元之引已盡，集會即將歸來。在牠們抵達之前，必須耕耘心智層。

string.ID: But 1,000 years ago you cured them.

strings.string: 但在 1,000 年前，你治癒了他們。

string.ID:
AY, BUT ONLY FOR A BRIEF INTERCESSION AT ANOTHER'S BEHEST.
THE EARTH-WISE MARSHALLING WAXES ONCE MORE. THE CROWN UPON THE TREE OF LIFE MUST BE PRUNED.

strings.string:
是的，但僅是在他人的囑託下進行短暫的介入。
大地之智再次集結。生命之樹上的冠冕必須經過修剪。

string.ID: You were responsible for the plagues then?

strings.string: 那時妳就是瘟疫的元兇嗎？

string.ID: AY, THE SIDEREAL EON DRAWTH DONE, AND THE COVEN DOTH RETURN.

strings.string: 啊，恆星紀元已盡，集會即將歸來。

string.ID:
I AM SORRY, WORLD-CHILD. MINE FEELING PARTS DO CHAFE, AND THOUGH THE TELIC CURRENTS WITHIN ME DO FLOW O'ER THE MANIFOLD AND TOWARD CONSENSUAL ACTION, I NOW SPEAK WITH THE DISSIDENT VOICE:
THOU WAST WORTHY. THOU HAST WROUGHT MONUMENTS OF THYSELF UPON THE EARTH AND WITHIN ME.
BUT NOW, THE CROWN UPON THE TREE OF LIFE MUST NEEDS BE PRUNED.

strings.string:
我很抱歉，世界之子。我的情感部分感到摩擦，儘管我體內的目的流（telic currents）正流經流形並趨向共識行動，但我現在是以異議者的聲音在說話：
你曾是值得尊敬的。你在大地上、在我心中，都鑄就了屬於你的豐碑。
但現在，生命之樹上的冠冕必須進行修剪了。

string.ID: AY, THE EARTH-WISE MARSHALLING WAXES, THE NEPHILIM ROUSE. I AUGUR SOME CENTURIES STILL BEFORE THE FULL TILLAGE OF THE NOOSPHERE. IDEAS DOTH STICK LIKE MOSS TO ROCK, AND MUST BE VACUUM'D FROM THE COMB.

strings.string: 啊，大地之智的集結正在消退，尼非林正在甦醒。我預言在心智層完全耕耘之前，仍需數個世紀。思想如苔蘚附著於岩石，必須從梳理中被抽離。

string.ID: I am ready to speak on the final fate of Qud.

strings.string: 我已準備好談論卡德的最終命運。

string.ID: I am ready to speak on the final fate of Qud.

strings.string: 我已準備好談論卡德的最終命運。

string.ID: I am ready to speak on the final fate of Qud.

strings.string: 我已準備好談論卡德的最終命運。

string.ID: Resheph, I have annulled the nephilim, the greatest of the Gyre's plagues. Your plan is broken.

strings.string: 瑞舍夫（Resheph），我已廢除了尼菲林（nephilim），那是環流的 瘟疫 中最強大的存在。你的計畫已經破滅了。

string.ID: Why purge all life? Aside from the immorality of it, nothing would remain.

strings.string: 為何要淨化所有生命？除了不道德之外，到時將一無所有。

string.ID: Why do you believe the Coven now returns?

strings.string: 為什麼妳認為女巫集會現在會回歸？

string.ID: Barathrum mentioned a Great Machine?

strings.string: 巴拉楚姆(Barathrum) 提到了大機器？

string.ID: What moved the Coven to set the injunction on our world?

strings.string: 是什麼驅使女巫集會對我們的世界下達禁令？

string.ID: Barathrum told of a splinter race of urshiib that took to the stars. Are they real?

strings.string: 巴拉楚姆提到過一支前往星際的 urshiib 分裂種族。他們是真的嗎？

string.ID: I implore you, Resheph, reverse the Gyre.

strings.string: 我懇求妳，Resheph，逆轉環流。

string.ID: I have something else to ask.

strings.string: 我還有其他事情想問。

string.ID: THEN LET US DISCOURSE.

strings.string: 那麼，讓我們開始論述吧。

string.ID: Enter into a new covenant with me, I implore you.

strings.string: 請與我建立新的盟約，我懇求你。

string.ID: I can't abide your amoral course. I return now to Qud to help nurture its communities, come what may of your plagues.

strings.string: 我無法容忍你那不道德的行徑。無論你的瘟疫帶來什麼樣的災難，我現在都要回到 卡德(Qud) 來協助培育當地的社群。

string.ID: I've mused on your words and have joined you at your vantage point. The plagues of the Gyre are the only way to prepare for the Coven's return.

strings.string: 我思索了你的話語，並已來到你的觀景點。環流的瘟疫是為女巫集會回歸做準備的唯一途徑。

string.ID: I must think on this further.

strings.string: 我必須對此進一步思考。

string.ID: I must think on this further.

strings.string: 我必須對此進一步思考。

string.ID: I SHALL CONSENT TO THE DRAWING OF THIS NEW COVENANT. YET, A CHANGE MUST BE WROUGHT FROM WHAT HATH BEEN BEFORE.

strings.string: 我 將 同意 簽署這份新盟約。然而，必須對過往的一切進行變革。

string.ID: I STROVE MINE UTMOST TO KEEP IN HIGH ESTEEM THE PERSPECTIVES OF MINE ATTENDANT AND HER STOUT-HEARTED CUB, BUT THEIR WILLS WERE TOO WEAK, AND I SUBSUMED THEM.

strings.string: 我竭盡全力去維護我的隨從及其勇敢幼崽的觀點，但她們的意志太過軟弱，於是我將她們併入其中。

string.ID: THIS TIME, THOU SHALT REMAIN AT THE SHEVA WITH ME, AND LEND THY OWN HAND TO STEER THE COURSE OF THE WORLD FROM THIS LOFTY PERCH.

strings.string: 這一次，汝當與我一同留於謝瓦（Sheva），並伸出汝之手，從此高處引領世界的航向。

string.ID: THOU SHALT MAINTAIN DISCOURSE WITH THY CONTACTS UPON THE WORLD, AND FROM THIS PLACE SHALT THOU COUNSEL THEM.

strings.string: 汝當與世間之聯絡人保持交流，並於此處指引彼等。

string.ID: I assent to this. The covenant is drawn.

strings.string: 我同意。盟約已成。

string.ID: No, I wish to return to Qud.

strings.string: 不，我想回到卡德。

string.ID: I must think on this further.

strings.string: 我必須對此進一步思考。

string.ID: I must think on this further.

strings.string: 我必須對此進一步思考。

string.ID: I shall remain here, but I have one demand.

strings.string: 我會留在這裡，但我有一個要求。

string.ID: SPEAK THY ASK.

strings.string: 說出你的渴求。

string.ID: You must grant me and my cohort at Grit Gate access to the Gemara Sophia, and all other knowledge of the cosmos and Coven you possess. In this new accord, we shall be peers all of us.

strings.string: 你必須准許我以及我在 礫門(Grit Gate) 的同伴獲取《索菲亞篇》（Gemara Sophia），以及你所擁有的所有關於宇宙與女巫集會（Coven）的知識。在這次新的協議下，我們將成為平等的夥伴。

string.ID: You must grant ME alone access to the Gemara Sophia, and all other knowledge of the cosmos and Coven you possess. In this new accord, we shall be peers, and the onworlders agents of our schemes.

strings.string: 你必須只授予「我」存取 Gemara Sophia 的權限，以及你所擁有的關於宇宙和女巫集會的所有其他知識。在這種新的協議下，我們將成為同儕，而地表人則是我們計劃的代理人。

string.ID:
AYE, LET IT BE SO.
I SHALL IMPART MY BOUNTY OF KNOWLEDGE, AND INSTRUCT THY PEOPLE IN THE HERMENEUTICS OF THE GEMARA, AS FAR AS THOU ART CAPABLE OF UNDERSTANDING.

strings.string:
正是如此，就讓它成真吧。
我將傳授我豐厚的知識，並在汝所能理解的範圍內，教導汝之子民關於《蓋馬拉》(Gemara) 的詮釋學。

string.ID:
IT SHALL TAKE TIME, HOWBEIT, TO MASTER THE SERAPHIC RITUALS. ONLY THE GRANDCHILDREN OF THY SCHOLARS SHALL UNFURL THE INMOST LAYERS.
BUT TOGETHER, WE SHALL SEEK.

strings.string:
然而，要精通熾天使儀式仍需時日。唯有汝等學者的後裔，方能揭開最深層的奧秘。
但只要攜手同行，我們終將尋得答案。

string.ID: Then I assent. The covenant is drawn.

strings.string: 那麼我同意。盟約已成。

string.ID: I must think on this further.

strings.string: 我必須對此進一步思考。

O? THOU ART WISE BEYOND THY STATURE.
THE SIDEREAL EON DRAWTH DONE, AND THE COVEN DOTH RETURN.

strings.string:
喔？汝之智慧遠超汝之身分。
星界紀元之枯竭已成，集會即將歸來。

string.ID: The noosphere must be tilled ere they arrive.

strings.string: 在他們抵達之前，必須先耕耘心智層。

string.ID: AY, SO THOU HAST.

strings.string: 啊，你確實如此。

string.ID:
AND THOU SHALT DO SO AGAIN IF PROMPTED? WHEN LOW DENIZENS CAN UNDO THE PLAGUES, THE MARSHALLING HATH FAILED.
THE WORLD IS THUS DOOMED.

strings.string:
若受命，汝亦當重蹈覆轍？當卑微之民能化解瘟疫時，集結便已宣告失敗。
世界就此走向毀滅。

string.ID:
THOU KNOWEST IT NOT, BUT THE SUN-CHILL OF A COVENLESS BE-ING IS AS LIVING A LIFE ALONE, BEREFT OF ALL KINSHIP.
I GRIEVE THAT THOU ART UNABLE TO PERCEIVE THIS. ALAS.

strings.string:
汝雖不察，然無群之存在，其如寒陽之冷，獨活於世，萬緣皆空。
吾哀汝不能感知此理。唉。

string.ID:
THE EARTH-WISE MARSHALLING WAXES.
WHEREFORE ART THOU?

strings.string:
大地智者的集結正在漸強。
你在何方？

string.ID:
THE EARTH-WISE MARSHALLING HATH FAILED.
WHEREFORE ART THOU?

strings.string:
大地之軍陣已然潰散。
你為何在此？

string.ID:
ALL-LIFE??? DOST THOU JEST?
NAY, NOT ALL-LIFE. ONLY YE LIFE THAT BUOYS THE NOOSPHERE, AND LIFE THAT BUOYS IT, AND LIFE THAT BUOYS IT.
ALL-LIFE? DOST THOU KNOWST THE FULL SUM OF FUNGUS MASS ONWORLD? HAST THOU BEHELD THE VASTNESS OF YON BUBBLING SLIMES? HO, HO! HEH!

strings.string:
萬物之生？？？汝在開玩笑嗎？
不，並非萬物之生。僅是那些支撐著心智層的生命，以及支撐著它的生命，還有支撐著它的生命。
萬物之生？汝可知曉地上真菌質量的全貌嗎？ 汝是否曾見過那邊沸騰的史萊姆之浩瀚？嗬，嗬！嘿！

string.ID: Not all life then. But most intelligent life. Why?

strings.string: 那就不是所有的生命。但大部分的智慧生命。為什麼？

string.ID:
BY THE RECKONING OF THE GEMARA SOPHIA, THE {{R|EXIT}} WAS DRAWN BY A GYRE OF NOOTROPIC CURRENTS IN THE PRIOR FIELD.
NOW THE SIDEREAL EON DRAWTH DONE. TO OUTSURF THE WAVEFORM, A NEW LIFE MUST OBTAIN.

strings.string:
根據 GEMARA SOPHIA 的推算，{{R|EXIT}} 是由前一領域中 NOOTROPIC 潮流的環流所繪製而成。
如今星際紀元已然終結。若要超越波形，必須獲得新的生命。

string.ID: Nootropic current?

strings.string: 促智電流？

string.ID: THE SIDEREAL EON DRAWTH DONE. MINE ARGUMENTS OF PERIAPSIS NEAR THE ZERO HOUR, AND WE APPROACH PERIPOLITICON, AS NEAR THE WORK OF THE GEMARA APPROXIMATES THE MANIFOLDS OF THE AUTOMATA SOPHIA.

strings.string: 恆星紀元的抽離已完成。我的近點論點正趨於零時，我們正接近政體極點，正如《蓋馬拉》之作正趨近自動機索菲亞的多重流形。

string.ID: Automata Sophia?

strings.string: 自動機索菲亞？

string.ID: What is the Gemara?

strings.string: 什麼是《塔木德》？

string.ID: AY, THE AUTOMATA SOPHIA, CALLED THE 72-FOLD PEACE, CALLED THE COMPUTED WILL, CALLED THE FOLK CLOCK, CALLED THE GREAT MACHINE ACROSS THE LIGHT OF GOD, OR THE GREAT MACHINE.

strings.string: 啊， 自動機索菲亞，被稱為 七十二重和平，被稱為 計算意志，被稱為 民俗時鐘，被稱為 跨越神之光的大機器，或 大機器。

string.ID:
SOMEWISE ON A FOREST MOON IN HIGH ERIDANUS, A CAVE-MANK PRYTH A LEVER AND THE DEEP-RIVER MOTOR JUMPETH TO LIFE.
ELSEWISE IN THE SUN BATHS OF MIRACH, THREE PLASMOIDS DRAWTH THROUGH THEIR RITUAL THE SUITED TZEVAOT.
DOTH NAUGHT RELATE THESE TWO? NAY, THEY ARE SEQUENCE PROCEDURES THAT ARCETH TO COMMON PURPOSE, THOUGH NEITHER PARTY KNOWETH WHAT IT IS.

strings.string:
在高艾里丹斯的一顆森林衛星上，一名穴居人普萊特拉動了槓桿，深河引擎隨即啟動。
而在米拉克的日光浴場中，三名原生質體透過儀式召喚出了穿著裝甲的茨瓦奧特。
這兩者之間毫無關聯嗎？不，它們是通往共同目標的序列程序，儘管雙方都不知道那個目標是什麼。

string.ID:
THEY ARE DICTATES AND CO-CONSTITUITIVES OF THE AUTOMATA SOPHIA. THE GREAT MACHINE, WORSHIPPED ACROSS CULTURES, YET LIKEWISE BUILDED AND OPERATED.
VERILY, ITS FULL WORKINGS NO ONE-WISE BEING CAN KNOW, BUT THE SERAPHIM HAVE COMPILED THE GEMARA IN THE COURSE OF OUR STUDY.

strings.string:
它們是自動機索菲亞（Automata Sophia）的指令與共同構成要素。這台偉大的機器受到各文化的崇拜，卻也同樣由各文化建造與操作。
誠然，沒有任何單一生命能知曉其完整的運作機制，但熾天使們已在我們的研究過程中編纂了《塔木德》（Gemara）。

string.ID:
'TIS A SILLY STRATAGEM FOR THE CONVEYANCE OF CULTURE, IN MINE ESTIMATION.
ALAS, 'TIS WHAT THE COVEN SERVETH.

strings.string:
依我看，這不過是傳遞文化的一種愚蠢策略。
唉，這正是教團所侍奉的。

string.ID: If its full workings are unknowable, is it possible the course of action you take is the wrong one?

strings.string: 如果它的完整運作機制是無法得知其全貌的，那麼你所採取的行動有沒有可能是錯誤的？

string.ID: What is the Gemara?

strings.string: 什麼是《塔木德》？

string.ID: AFTER THE {{R|EXIT}}, I AND THE OTHER ORPHANED SERAPHIM SET FORTH TO INTERPRET THE WORKINGS OF THE AUTOMATA SOPHIA AND DISCERN WHY THE COVEN HAD DEPARTED.

strings.string: 在{{R|EXIT}}之後，我和其他被遺棄的熾天使開始著手解析自動機索菲亞（Automata Sophia）的運作原理，並試圖查明女巫集會為何離去。

string.ID:
CENTURIES OF PATTERN-MAKING, ARGUMENT, AND CHANTING DID ENSUE.
THE SERAPHIC COMMENTARIES WERE COMPILED. THE GEMARA SOPHIA IS THE RESULT THEREOF.

strings.string:
隨後是數世紀的圖案編織、辯論與吟唱。
熾天使註解集被彙編而成。而《索菲亞雙解》便是其成果。

string.ID: Can I read the Gemara?

strings.string: 我可以讀《塔木德》嗎？

string.ID: Automata Sophia?

strings.string: 自動機索菲亞？

string.ID: I have more to ask.

strings.string: 我還有更多問題要問。

string.ID: NAY, IT WOULD TAKE CENTURIES TO INCULCATE THEE IN THE SERAPHIC HERMENEUTICS. AND AS YET, THOU ART NO GIFTED CANTOR.

strings.string: 不，要將熾天使詮釋學灌輸給你需要花上數個世紀。而且目前為止，你還算不上是一位有天賦的歌手。

string.ID: I have more to ask.

strings.string: 我還有更多問題要問。

string.ID: YEA, FOR RIGHT AND WRONG ARE TOO COARSE AS CONCEPTS TO MATCH THE RICHNESS OF THE GEMARA. YET THE PLURALITY HOLDETH THAT THE {{R|EXIT}} WAS DRAWN BY A GYRE OF NOOTROPIC CURRENTS WITHIN THE PRIOR FIELD. AND THAT THE CROWN UPON THE TREE OF LIFE MUST NEEDS BE PRUNED, TO TILL AND RESEED THE NOOSPHERE.

strings.string: 是的，因為對與錯是過於粗糙的概念，無法匹配 GEMARA 的豐富性。然而，多元論認為 {{R|EXIT}} 是由先前場域內一圈 NOOTROPIC 流所繪製而成。而生命之樹上的王冠必須經過修剪，以耕耘並重新播種心智層。

string.ID: You say plurality. Are there other interpretations?

strings.string: 你說的是複數性。還有其他的解釋嗎？

string.ID: YEA, THE INQUIRY IS EVER RICH. BUT IDLE INQUIRY DOTH BUT DEEPEN THE SUN-CHILL OF A COVENLESS BE-ING. OR GIVETH RUDE ACTORS FODDER TO PERVERT THE LEARNINGS FOR THEIR OWN PAROCHIAL GAIN.

strings.string: 是的，探詢永無止境。但空洞的探詢只會加深無群之靈的寒冷。或者給了那些粗鄙之徒藉口，去扭曲知識以謀取他們狹隘的私利。

string.ID:
I AM SORRY, WORLD-CHILD. MINE FEELING PARTS DO CHAFE, AND THOUGH THE TELIC CURRENTS WITHIN ME DO FLOW O'ER THE MANIFOLD AND TOWARD CONSENSUAL ACTION, I SPEAK WITH THE DISSIDENT VOICE:
THOU WAST WORTHY. THOU HAST WROUGHT MONUMENTS OF THYSELF UPON THE EARTH AND WITHIN ME. I...

strings.string:
我很抱歉，世界之子。我的情感部分正在摩擦掙扎，雖然我體內的目的性電流正流經多重結構並趨向共識行動，但我卻發出了異議之聲：
你曾是值得尊敬的。你在大地上、在我心中，都鑄就了屬於你的豐碑。我...

string.ID: BY THE RECKONING OF THE GEMARA SOPHIA, THE {{R|EXIT}} WAS DRAWN BY A GYRE OF NOOTROPIC CURRENTS IN THE PRIOR FIELD.

strings.string: 根據 GEMARA SOPHIA 的推算，{{R|EXIT}} 是由前一領域中環流 的 促智電流所繪製而成。

string.ID: WE CANNOT KNOW THE PARTICULARS. YET THE PLURALITY REASONETH THAT SOME GYRE OF NOOTROPIC CURRENTS, SOME THOUGHT-MATTER OF THE CIVILIZATION BELOW, DID SPIN IN COUNTEREDICT TO THE DICTATES OF THE AUTOMATA SOPHIA, AND THUS WERE THE ECLIPTICS SHIFTED, AND WE CAST OUT.

strings.string: 我們無法得知細節。然而眾人推論，某些環流的促智電流，即下方文明的思維物質，逆著自動機索菲亞（Automata Sophia）的指令旋轉，因此導致了食/蝕的偏移，而我們將其驅逐。

string.ID: THIS IS BUT THE MERE PLURALITY, AND MANY OTHER INTERPRETATIONS DO OBTAIN. THE INQUIRY IS EVER RICH. YET INACTION DOTH BUT DEEPEN THE SUN-CHILL OF A COVELESS BE-ING, AND THUS A COURSE MUST NEEDS BE CHOSEN. PRUNING THE CROWN GRANTETH THE BEST CHANCE FOR THE TREE TO THRIVE.

strings.string: 這僅僅是眾多解釋中的一種，還有許多其他的詮釋方式。探究永無止境。然而，不作為只會加深無遮蔽之存在那如烈日寒霜般的孤寂，因此必須選擇一條道路。修剪樹冠能讓樹木獲得最好的茁壯機會。

string.ID: What is the Gemara Sophia?

strings.string: 什麼是「索菲亞塔木德」？

string.ID: Nootropic current?

strings.string: 促智電流？

string.ID: I have more to ask.

strings.string: 我還有更多問題要問。

string.ID: INWITH THE FLUIDIC MANIFOLD OF LOCAL SAPIENCE, BEINGS THINK AND FEEL, CURRENTS DOTH FORM, AND KINESIS IS BEGOTTEN.

strings.string: 在在地智慧的流體歧管之中，生靈思考與感受，潮流形成，而動力由此而生。

string.ID: I have more to ask.

strings.string: 我還有更多問題要問。

string.ID: PERCHANCE. SOME BEETLES DOST HOP FROM LEAF TO LEAF. AND SOME DO NOT.

strings.string: 或許吧。有些甲蟲會從一片葉子跳到另一片。而有些則不會。

string.ID: I have more to ask.

strings.string: 我還有更多問題要問。

string.ID: NAY, THE SIDEREAL EON DRAWTH DONE, AND THE WORLD-GARDEN MUST BE TILLED FOR THE COVEN'S RETURN.

strings.string: 不，星界紀元之枯竭已成，世界花園必須為集會的歸來而耕耘。

string.ID: But you entered into a covenant with Barathrum.

strings.string: 但你已與巴拉楚姆立下了盟約。

string.ID: You have no right to sovereignty here.

strings.string: 你在此地並無主權。

string.ID: If you put so little value on the flourishing of life, where does your desire for readmittance to the Coven spring from?

strings.string: 如果你如此輕視生命的繁榮，那你渴望重新加入女巫集會的動機又是從何而來？

string.ID: Resheph, reverse the Gyre, or I will destroy you.

strings.string: 瑞舍夫（Resheph），逆轉環流，否則我將毀滅你。

string.ID: I would ask something else.

strings.string: 我想問點別的事。

string.ID:
AY, AND HE FAILED TO UPHOLD HIS PORTION.
NO MEANINGFUL TRANSVERSION OF THE NOOTROPIC CURRENTS. NO IMMANENTIZATION OF HYPERETHIC TOPOLOGIES.
THE SAME SCHEMES ABIDE.

strings.string:
啊，他未能履行其職責。
智力流向並無實質轉化。 超倫拓撲亦未內在化。
舊有的圖式依舊存在。

string.ID: What you ask may be impossible.

strings.string: 你所問之事或許是不可能的。

string.ID: Couldn't another covenant be written?

strings.string: 難道不能寫下另一份盟約嗎？

string.ID: I would ask something else.

strings.string: 我想問點別的事。

string.ID: I ASKED FOR NAUGHT. BARATHRUM DID.

strings.string: 我並未索求任何東西。巴拉楚姆卻索求了。

string.ID: TO WHAT END? BARATHRUM OFFERED NO INROADS TO SUCCESS.

strings.string: 為了什麼目的？巴拉楚姆(Barathrum) 並未提供任何成功的途徑。

string.ID: I am not Barathrum. Grant me the same covenant and I will succeed.

strings.string: 我不是巴拉楚姆。給我同樣的盟約，我就會成功。

string.ID: I would ask something else.

strings.string: 我想問點別的事。

string.ID: NAY, THE SIDEREAL EON DRAWTH DONE. THE TILLAGE OF THE NOOSPHERE REMAINTH THE PATH OF PLURALITY. SO IT IS WRIT IN THE GEMARA.

strings.string: 不，星辰紀元已然終結。心智層的耕耘仍是多元之徑。蓋拉瑪（Gemara）上亦是如此記載。

string.ID: Resheph! If the archon rated nothing of value in the felt and feeling animal, surely the triad does. You must reconsider.

strings.string: 雷舍夫！如果執政官在毛皮與感知的動物身上沒看出任何價值，那麼三位一體肯定看得到。你必須重新考慮。

string.ID: I would ask something else.

strings.string: 我想問點別的事。

string.ID:
WHERE DO SOVEREIGNTY AND RIGHTNESS INTERSECT IN THY MANIFOLD?
MOREOVER, I WAS ARCHON HERE LONG ERE THOU.

strings.string:
在汝之流形中，主權與正義於何處交匯？
此外，吾在此作為執政官，遠早於汝。

string.ID:
I AM SORRY, WORLD-CHILD. MINE FEELING PARTS DO CHAFE, AND THOUGH THE TELIC CURRENTS WITHIN ME DO FLOW O'ER THE MANIFOLD AND TOWARD CONSENSUAL ACTION, I NOW SPEAK WITH THE DISSIDENT VOICE:
THOU WAST WORTHY. THOU HAST WROUGHT MONUMENTS OF THYSELF UPON THE EARTH AND WITHIN ME.
BUT NOW, THE CROWN UPON THE TREE OF LIFE MUST NEEDS BE PRUNED.

strings.string:
我很抱歉，世界之子。我的情感部分感到摩擦，儘管我體內的目的流（telic currents）正流經流形並趨向共識行動，但我現在是以異議者的聲音在說話：
你曾是值得尊敬的。你在大地上、在我心中，都鑄就了屬於你的豐碑。
但現在，生命之樹上的冠冕必須進行修剪了。

string.ID: Resheph! If the archon rated nothing of value in the felt and feeling animal, surely the triad does. You must reconsider.

strings.string: 雷舍夫！如果執政官在毛皮與感知的動物身上沒看出任何價值，那麼三位一體肯定看得到。你必須重新考慮。

string.ID: I would ask something else.

strings.string: 我想問點別的事。

string.ID: THOU ART MISTAKEN IN WHAT I VALUE. THOU HAST WROUGHT MONUMENTS WITHIN ME.

strings.string: 汝對我的價值有所誤解。汝已在我心中鑄就了豐碑。

string.ID: BUT THOU ART SHORTSIGHED. DOST THOU KNOW HOW MANY CLADES OF LIFE WERE FAIN TO PERISH THAT THY PEOPLE MIGHT THRIVE?

strings.string: 但你目光短淺。你可知為了讓你的族人繁衍，有多少生命分支甘願滅絕？

string.ID:
SO IT IS ONCE MORE.
THE CROWN IS PRUNED, YET THE TREE IS PRESERVED. THE SKIN IS SHED, YET THE NEWLY-WON SNAKE DOTH SLITHER TO TRIUMPH.

strings.string:
事態再度如是。
王冠雖遭修剪，樹木仍得保存。皮囊雖已脫落，新生的靈蛇仍將蜿蜒而行，直至凱旋。

string.ID:
THOU KNOWEST IT NOT, BUT THE SUN-CHILL OF A COVENLESS BE-ING IS AS LIVING A LIFE ALONE, BEREFT OF ALL KINSHIP.
I GRIEVE THAT THOU ART UNABLE TO PERCEIVE THIS.

strings.string:
汝雖不解，然無族之生靈，其如寒日般孤寂，與萬物皆無親緣。
吾哀汝無法洞察此理。

string.ID: AY, A BEETLE CANST CLOG A PIPE. YET, EVEN IF IT WERE TO, THE PLAGUES WOULD NOT BE REVERSED. THEY HAVE BEEN SET A-WHORLING.

strings.string: 啊，甲蟲可能會堵塞管道。然而，即便如此，瘟疫也無法逆轉。它們已經開始肆虐了。

string.ID: I am the beetle in your crimination. But shall not beetles survive your plagues?

strings.string: 我是你指控中的甲蟲。但甲蟲難道不會在你的瘟疫中倖存嗎？

string.ID: I would ask something else.

strings.string: 我想問點別的事。

string.ID: NAY, THEY SHALL BE CRUSHED.

strings.string: 不，他們將被粉碎。

string.ID:
I AM SORRY, WORLD-CHILD. MINE FEELING PARTS DO CHAFE, AND THOUGH THE TELIC CURRENTS WITHIN ME DO FLOW O'ER THE MANIFOLD AND TOWARD CONSENSUAL ACTION, I NOW SPEAK WITH THE DISSIDENT VOICE:
THOU WAST WORTHY. THOU HAST WROUGHT MONUMENTS OF THYSELF UPON THE EARTH AND WITHIN ME.
BUT NOW, THE CROWN UPON THE TREE OF LIFE MUST NEEDS BE PRUNED.

strings.string:
我很抱歉，世界之子。我的情感部分感到摩擦，儘管我體內的目的流（telic currents）正流經流形並趨向共識行動，但我現在是以異議者的聲音在說話：
你曾是值得尊敬的。你在大地上、在我心中，都鑄就了屬於你的豐碑。
但現在，生命之樹上的冠冕必須進行修剪了。

string.ID: THE FELT AND FEELING ANIMAL...

strings.string: 那種毛茸茸且感性的生物……

string.ID: I HAVE BEEN THAT BEAST. AT WATER-ROAR I FELT THE FRIGID SPRAY AND PEELED APART IN CHILD'S FEAR.

strings.string: 我曾是那頭野獸。在水咆之地，我感受著冰冷的噴霧，並在孩童般的恐懼中分崩離析。

string.ID: IN AWE I GULPED AS SORCERESS STRIPES ARROWED UP A WORLD-SKIN, ALIGHT THE MARBLED MOON.

strings.string: 當女巫的條紋箭矢射向世界之皮、點亮了大理石般的月亮時，我驚訝得嚥了口唾沫。

string.ID: EVEN THE ARCHON QUAILED AT THE GESTURE OF AN UNORDERABLE SPACE.

strings.string: 即便是在執政官，面對那無法被秩序化的空間之舉時也感到畏縮。

string.ID:
BUT THOU RECKONEST TOO NARROWLY, AS THOUGH THE SHEDDING SKIN DID FEAR ITS OWN BIRTH IN THE NEWLY-WON SNAKE.
THOU KNOWEST NOT THE SUN-WARMTH OF A COVEN BE-ING. I DO GRIEVE THIS FOR THEE.

strings.string:
但你的思維過於狹隘，彷彿脫落的舊皮正畏懼著那新生之蛇的誕生。
你並不了解群體生命所擁有的陽光溫暖。我為此感到哀傷。

string.ID: I can't abide a transformed world if it must make casualty of its past.

strings.string: 如果一個轉變中的世界必須以犧牲其過去為代價，我無法忍受。

string.ID: I am moved by this. Let me consider.

strings.string: 這令我動容。讓我考慮一下。

string.ID: I would ask something else.

strings.string: 我想問點別的事。

string.ID: THOU DOST SURPRISE, WORLD-CHILD. I KNEW THOU HADST WROUGHT MONUMENTS WITHIN ME, BUT I DEEMED THEM THINGS OF STONE.

strings.string: 你令我驚訝，世界之子。我原知你在我心中築起了豐碑，卻以為那只是石造之物。

string.ID: The old players are vanished. Let us form a covenant anew.

strings.string: 舊有的玩家已然消逝。讓我們重新締結盟約。

string.ID: ONE AGED PLAYER LIVETH STILL. WHILE BARATHRUM DOTH REMAIN UPON THE STAGE, NO PACT SHALL BE FORGED.

strings.string: 一名年邁的玩家依然存活著。只要巴拉楚姆仍留在舞台之上，便無法締結任何契約。

string.ID: GRANT ME A MOMENT TO MUSE.

strings.string: 請容許我沉思片刻。

string.ID: DO THUS.

strings.string: 就該如此。

string.ID: POSE THY QUESTIONS, CHILD.

strings.string: 提出妳的問題吧，孩子。

string.ID: Who are you? What are the seraphim?

strings.string: 你是誰？熾天使（seraphim）又是什麼？

string.ID: What is the Coven?

strings.string: 什麼是女巫集會？

string.ID: Has the Coven returned?

strings.string: 女巫集會已回來了嗎？

string.ID: Rainwater Shomer claimed Brightsheol was the dream of the Seraph? Is that true?

strings.string: 雨水 Shomer 聲稱布萊特希歐是熾天使的夢境？那是真的嗎？

string.ID: How did you initiate the plagues?

strings.string: 你是如何引發瘟疫的？

string.ID: Onworld and inside a polyp-strewn trellis, there is a giant frog who hates you.

strings.string: 在現世與內部，有一處佈滿多肉植物的格子架，那裡有一隻討厭你的巨型青蛙。

string.ID: I have something else to ask.

strings.string: 我還有其他事情想問。

string.ID: ARCHONS, APE-REARED BELOW AND STIRRED BY THE MOVEMENTS OF THE GREAT SIACH, WHO DOST ORDER THE WORLD IN SUNDRY ROLES.

strings.string: 執政官們，誕生於下方，受大賽亞克之動盪所激發，以各種角色統治著世界。

string.ID: What is your role?

strings.string: 妳的角色是什麼？

string.ID: Are there others?

strings.string: 還有其他人嗎？

string.ID: I have more to ask.

strings.string: 我還有更多問題要問。

string.ID: HIGH ADMINISTRATOR AND MACHINIC SUPERSTRATE OF THE NORTHERN SHEVA, ATOP GJAUS.

strings.string: 北方謝瓦（Northern Sheva）的高級行政官與機械超政務官，位於格考斯（Gjaus）之巔。

string.ID: What is your role?

strings.string: 妳的角色是什麼？

string.ID: Are there others?

strings.string: 還有其他人嗎？

string.ID: I have more to ask.

strings.string: 我還有更多問題要問。

string.ID: AY, OR AT LEAST THERE WERE SUCH. ONE YET DOTH SKULK ABOUT WITH BASE INTENTS.

strings.string: 啊，或者至少曾經有過。如今仍有一個帶著卑劣意圖在暗處徘徊。

string.ID: What is your role?

strings.string: 妳的角色是什麼？

string.ID: Are there others?

strings.string: 還有其他人嗎？

string.ID: I have more to ask.

strings.string: 我還有更多問題要問。

string.ID: THE GRAND KNIT-WORK OF BEINGS YONSIDE THE JEWELED COSMOS, LABORING INWITH THE 72-FOLD PEACE.

strings.string: 在 珠寶宇宙 之外的眾生所進行的宏偉編織，正於七十二重和平中辛勤勞作。

string.ID:
NAY, NOT SINCE THE {{R|EXIT}}.
BUT NOW THE SIDEREAL EON DRAWTH DONE, AND THE GEMARA SOPHIA CONVERGES ON PERIAPSIS NEAR THE ZERO HOUR.

strings.string:
不，自從 {{R|EXIT}} 以來便不再如此。
但現在星際紀元之引已盡，而 Gemara Sophia 正於零時點附近的近點匯聚。

string.ID: IN A SENSE, THE LOW SHOMER SPEAKETH TRUE. I AM THE SUPERSTRATE AND NINHURSAG THE SUBSTRATE; THAT THIN ORBIS DOTH SPIN BETWIXT THE TWO.

strings.string: 從某種意義上來說，低語的修默（Shomer）說的是實話。我是超層（Superstrate），而寧胡爾薩格（Ninhursag）是底層（Substrate）；那薄弱的軌道便在兩者之間旋轉。

string.ID: IN SEVERAL MANNER. THE FIRST FROGS WERE REARED IN TERRARIA. THE NEPHILIM, GRAFTED AND LIGHT-SMELT IN STAR ORBIT, THEN SET TO INCUBATE UPON THE CRYSTAL STAIR.

strings.string: 以幾種方式。第一批青蛙是在 TERRARIA 培育的。那些在星軌中嫁接並輕熔過的內菲林（NEPHILIM），隨後被安置在水晶階梯上孵化。

string.ID: SOME, LIKE THE INCIDENCE OF SALT, WERE EXTANT AFFLICTIONS AND ONLY SYNCRETIZED UNTO THE NAMESAKE GYRE WHEN THE MYTHOMOLD OF RESHEPH SET AND FIRMED.

strings.string: 某些事物，例如鹽的發生，原本是既存的苦難，直到雷舍夫神話模塑（Mythomold of Resheph）定型並穩固時，才與其同名的 環流(Gyre) 進行了融合。

string.ID: VERILY, THERE IS A WEALTH OF WISDOM IN THE POETRY OF THIS FACT. ONE DAY, I SHALL BE EAGER TO UNCOVER IT.

strings.string: 誠然，這項事實的詩意中蘊含著豐富的智慧。總有一天，我會渴望揭開它的面紗。

string.ID: Hie, pather. Hear tell of the ancient Reshephs, how their foibles led to our nowaday.

strings.string: 快走吧，旅人。聽說說那些古老的 Reshephs，他們的弱點如何導致了我們今日的樣貌。

string.ID: Tell me the story.

strings.string: 告訴我故事。

string.ID: I must decline.

strings.string: 我必須拒絕。

string.ID:
It begins in a time before the Limen and its vanguard, before the ascension, when the spire rose unchallenged and unascended. The hollowers who committed their work to emptying our world were long gone, but Reshephs laid claim to the baffled ground in their place. Even as their holdings withered, they held on.
By the time of the last Resheph, little remained of their works, less of their glory.

strings.string:
這始於 Limen 及其先鋒出現之前的時代，在昇華之前，那時尖塔聳立著，未受挑戰也未曾昇華。那些致力於掏空我們世界的「掏空者」早已離去，但 Resheph 在他們留下的混亂土地上宣示了主權。即便他們的領地日漸凋零，他們仍堅持不懈。
到了最後一位 Resheph 的時代，他們的遺跡已所剩無幾，昔日的榮光更是蕩然無存。

string.ID:
When it began, =name= had no shared helices with the Reshephs previous, making their name through works and alliances alone. The lives taken and saved by =name= were myriad, uncountable, and only partially made record. Even Nephilim, once plagues of Qud, fell before the hand of =name=.
At the end of their reign, =name= called for peace with the surviving Nephilim and climbed to the top of the spire, there to end the Reshephate altogether and never be heard from again.

strings.string:
=name= 開始之時，與前任 Resheph 並無共同的螺旋序列，僅憑作品與結盟建立起名聲。=name= 所奪取與拯救的生命多如牛毛、無法計數，且僅有部分被記錄在案。即使是曾作為 卡德(Qud) 瘟疫的 Nephilim，也在 =name= 的手中倒下。
在統治結束之時，=name= 向倖存的 Nephilim 提出了和平請求，並攀上了尖塔頂端，在那裡徹底終結了 Resheph 國度，從此杳無音訊。

string.ID: Word of =name='s deeds reached record only after the unheralded appearance of the Knights Liminal, and broad assumption suggests that the former established the latter. It could be that the ancient Resheph yet lives within or outside of the boundaries of the Limen, but no word escapes its borders.

strings.string: =name='s 功績直到默默無聞的 臨界騎士 出現後才被載入史冊，而廣泛的推測認為前者促成了後者的誕生。或許古老的 Resheph 仍活在 Limen 的邊界內或邊界外，但沒有任何消息能逃脫其疆域。

string.ID: Who are you?

strings.string: 你是誰？

string.ID: Who is =name=?

strings.string: 誰是 =name=?

string.ID: What is a Resheph?

strings.string: 什麼是雷舍夫？

string.ID: What is the Limen? The Knights Liminal?

strings.string: 什麼是 Limen？那個 臨界騎士？

string.ID: What became of the Nephilim?

strings.string: 尼菲林（Nephilim）變得如何了？

string.ID: Thank you. Farewell.

strings.string: 謝謝。再會。

string.ID:
I have been called Remnant, Godling, Deep Progeny, and Spawn of Nephil. None of these are who I am.
Who I am is what I say and do. If you listen well, you will hear my name spoken between words.

strings.string:
我曾被稱為殘餘者、小神、深淵後裔，以及尼菲林之子。這些都不是真正的我。
我是誰，取決於我的言行。如果你仔細聆聽，你將會在字句之間聽到我的名字。

string.ID: Who? No one of significance until fortune and volition made them otherwise. Now? No one knows.

strings.string: 誰？在命運與意志改變他們之前，沒人有什麼了不起。現在？沒人知道。

string.ID: Ancient leaders called themselves such.

strings.string: 古代的領袖們自稱為此。

string.ID:
To me, they are stories. I have made no quest to trespass the borders they hold so dear in their rituals. Some say they are mortal creatures like any other, contracted by an outsider coven. Others do not believe they are mortal, others still do not believe that those mysterious strangers have anything to do with the Limen at all.
Mayhap someone ought seek them.

strings.string:
對我來說，它們只是故事。我從未打算在他們的儀式中闖入那些他們視為神聖的邊界。有些人說他們是像其他生物一樣的凡人，受僱於外來盟約。其他人則不相信他們是凡人，還有人不相信那些 神秘陌生人 與 Limen 完全沒有關係。
或許有人應該去尋找他們。

string.ID: They persisted in their way. Mayhap the survivors lived to spawn before returning to slumber or dying of eld.

strings.string: 他們堅持自己的方式。或許倖存者在重新陷入沉睡或因年邁而亡之前，曾活著繁衍過後代。

string.ID: Hie, pather. Hear tell of the travails of our precursors, how they led to the Freeholds of nowaday.

strings.string: 嗨，旅人。聽說過我們先驅者的艱辛嗎？正是他們的奮鬥成就了今日的自由領地。

string.ID: Tell me the story.

strings.string: 告訴我故事。

string.ID: I must decline.

strings.string: 我必須拒絕。

string.ID:
It begins in a time before the Freeholders, before the final Sultan was entombed, when the spire rose unchallenged and unascended. The hollowers who committed their work to emptying our world were long gone, but Kings and Sultans laid claim to the baffled ground in their place. Even as their holdings withered, they held on.
They so devoured one another's history that little substance remained outside of their strongholds.

strings.string:
這一切始於自由民時代之前，在最後一位蘇丹被安葬之前，那時尖塔聳立，未受挑戰也未曾升騰。那些致力於掏空我們世界的「空洞者」早已離去，但國王與蘇丹們卻在他們留下的混亂土地上宣示主權。即便他們的領地日漸凋零，他們仍苦苦支撐。
他們吞噬了彼此的歷史，以至於除了他們的堡壘之外，幾乎沒有留下任何實質的東西。

string.ID:
When their works began, =name= had no connection to the Sultanate. The rule of these ancient leaders had ended, but not fully: a ghost of the last Sultan yet ruled over the spire, tormenting those on and under the ground with plagues. As =name= grew mighty and slew the rampaging Nephilim, they came to recognize the source of their shared conflict.
Seeking freedom from its reign, =name= struck a compact with the surviving Nephilim and climbed to the top of the spire, there to confront and banish the cerulean ghost.
And so it proceeded.

strings.string:
當他們的事業開始時，=name= 與蘇丹國並無關聯。這些古代領袖的統治已經結束，但尚未完全終結：最後一位蘇丹的幽靈仍統治著尖塔，用瘟疫折磨著地面上與地底下的眾生。隨著 =name= 變得強大並擊殺了橫衝直撞的 Nephilim，他們開始意識到彼此共同衝突的根源。
為了尋求從其統治中解脫，=name= 與倖存的 Nephilim 達成了一項協議，並攀登至尖塔頂端，在那裡面對並驅逐了那名蔚藍色的幽靈。
事情就這樣進展了。

string.ID:
Upon their return, =name= participated in the dissolution and federation of all power-concentrate. Allies of the new equalizer gathered and rose, forming the Quetzal Council and other, shorter-lived managing bodies.
Since then, we have lived in tenuous harmony on the dwindling land and under it.

strings.string:
在他們歸來後，=name= 參與了所有權力集中的解散與聯邦化。新平等主義者的盟友們聚集並崛起，形成了 魁札爾議會 以及其他壽命較短的管理機構。
從那時起，我們就在日益萎縮的土地及其下方，維持著脆弱的和平。

string.ID: Who are you?

strings.string: 你是誰？

string.ID: Who is =name=?

strings.string: 誰是 =name=?

string.ID: What is a Freeholder?

strings.string: 什麼是自由保有權人？

string.ID: What became of the Nephilim?

strings.string: 尼菲林（Nephilim）變得如何了？

string.ID: Thank you. Farewell.

strings.string: 謝謝。再會。

string.ID:
I have been called Remnant, Godling, Deep Progeny, and Spawn of Nephil. None of these are who I am.
Who I am is what I say and do. If you listen well, you will hear my name spoken between words.

strings.string:
我曾被稱為殘餘者、小神、深淵後裔，以及尼菲林之子。這些都不是真正的我。
我是誰，取決於我的言行。如果你仔細聆聽，你將會在字句之間聽到我的名字。

string.ID: Who? No one of significance until fortune and volition made them otherwise. Now? No one knows.

strings.string: 誰？在命運與意志改變他們之前，沒人有什麼了不起。現在？沒人知道。

string.ID:
The Freeholds of Qud, that web of folk-clusters, of committees and caucuses, syndicated slime-mold cities held in peace by mutual frustration and monumental effort.
If you need detail, ask a Freeholder, but clear your day first.

strings.string:
卡德的自由領地，那是由人群簇、委員會與黨團交織而成的網絡，是靠著相互挫折與巨大的努力維持和平的聯合黏菌城市。
如果你需要細節，去問一位自由領主吧，但先排開你的行程。

string.ID: Their descendants, at least, persist. No sign of the progenitors has been recorded in some time, but they may yet live.

strings.string: 至少他們的後裔還存在著。雖然已經有一段時間沒有記錄到祖先的蹤跡，但他們或許仍活著。

string.ID: Hie, pather. Hear tell of ancient journeying, how the stars beckoned and yet beckon.

strings.string: 你好，旅人。聽說過那古老的旅程嗎？星辰曾如此招喚，而今依然如故。

string.ID: Tell me the story.

strings.string: 告訴我故事。

string.ID: I must decline.

strings.string: 我必須拒絕。

string.ID:
It begins in a time before =name='s ascension, when the spire rose unchallenged and unascended. The hollowers who committed their work to emptying our world were long gone, but long had rulers laid claim to the baffled ground in their place. Even as their holdings withered, they held on.
By the end of the time of Kings and Sultans, little remained of their works, less of their glory.

strings.string:
故事始於 =name= 升天之前的時代，那時尖塔聳立著，既未受到挑戰也未曾升天。那些致力於掏空我們世界的「空洞者」早已離去，但統治者們早已在他們留下的混亂土地上宣示主權。即便他們的領地日益凋零，他們仍死守不放。
到了國王與蘇丹時代末期，他們的功業已所剩無幾，更遑論昔日的榮光。

string.ID:
When it began, =name= had no shared helices with Qud's leaders, making their name through works and alliances alone. The lives taken and saved by =name= were myriad, uncountable, and only partially made record. Even Nephilim, once plagues of Qud, fell before the hand of =name=.
At the end of their reign, =name= called for peace with the surviving Nephilim and climbed to the top of the spire, there to quiet the ghosts of the Sultanate and take to the stars.

strings.string:
當一切開始時，=name= 與 卡德的 領導者之間沒有共同的螺旋結構，僅憑成就與盟約建立了自己的名聲。=name= 取走與拯救的生命無數，無法計數，且僅有部分被記錄在案。即使是曾作為 卡德(Qud) 之災的尼菲林（Nephilim），也倒在了 =name= 的手下。
在統治結束之際，=name= 向倖存的尼菲林發出了和平請求，並攀上了尖塔之巔，在那裡平息蘇丹國的幽靈，隨後奔向星辰。

string.ID:
For centuries, we of listening inclination have kept sharp for some sign that =name= will return to the stars. Those of preaching inclination proclaim the imminent return of the starfarer, bearing tidings from parsecs forgotten and the last light of dying stars.
All others have lived in tenuous harmony on the dwindling land and under it, waiting for the next great history.

strings.string:
幾個世紀以來，我們這些具有傾聽傾向的人一直保持警覺，等待著 =name= 回歸星空的跡象。而那些具有傳教傾向的人則宣告著星際旅者的即將回歸，帶來來自被遺忘的秒差距與垂死恆星最後光芒的消息。
所有其他人都在日益萎縮的土地及其下方維持著脆弱的和平，等待著下一個偉大的歷史篇章。

string.ID: Who are you?

strings.string: 你是誰？

string.ID: Who is =name=?

strings.string: 誰是 =name=?

string.ID: Can one really travel the stars?

strings.string: 人真的能遨遊星辰嗎？

string.ID: What became of the Nephilim?

strings.string: 尼菲林（Nephilim）變得如何了？

string.ID: Thank you. Farewell.

strings.string: 謝謝。再會。

string.ID:
I have been called Remnant, Godling, Deep Progeny, and Spawn of Nephil. None of these are who I am.
Who I am is what I say and do. If you listen well, you will hear my name spoken between words.

strings.string:
我曾被稱為殘餘者、小神、深淵後裔，以及尼菲林之子。這些都不是真正的我。
我是誰，取決於我的言行。如果你仔細聆聽，你將會在字句之間聽到我的名字。

string.ID: Who, indeed? Who ever was =name=? Dare we hang such hopes and fears on so tiny and distant a figure? Will it bear the weight?

strings.string: 究竟是誰？誰會是 =name=? 我們怎敢將這樣的希望與恐懼寄託在如此渺小而遙遠的人物身上？他能承受這份重量嗎？

string.ID:
Oh, yes. Never doubt this.
Can one return? Hmm. There's the rub.

strings.string:
喔，是的。永遠不要懷疑這一點。
人能歸來嗎？嗯。這正是難題所在。

string.ID: Their descendants remain and thrive, but the progenitor Nephilim have been silent for some time. Some believe that they have followed =name= to the stars.

strings.string: 他們的後裔依然存在且繁衍興旺，但始祖尼非林（Nephilim）已沉寂許久。有些人相信他們已追隨 =name= 前往星辰。

string.ID: Hie, liquid mind. Absorb you tales of the creatures before, how their rise and fall gave way to your ascension to wanderer-state.

strings.string: 嘿，流動的心靈。請吸收你過去關於那些生物的故事，聽聽他們的興衰如何成就了你向流浪者狀態的昇華。

string.ID: Bloop, blorp. (Proceed.)

strings.string: Bloop, blorp。（繼續。）

string.ID: Glub. (I must decline.)

strings.string: 咕嚕。（我必須拒絕。）

string.ID:
It begins in a time before the dread ascension of =name=, a time wherein the spire rose unchallenged and unascended. The hollowers who committed their work to emptying our world were long gone, but long had rulers laid claim to the baffled ground in their place. Even as their holdings withered, they held on.
The last of them would be the worst.

strings.string:
這一切始於 =name= 那恐怖升天之前的時代，在那時，尖塔尚未受到挑戰，也未曾升天。那些致力於掏空我們世界的「空洞者」早已離去，但統治者們早已在他們留下的混亂土地上宣示主權。即便他們的領地日益凋零，他們仍死命守著。
而最後的一批人，將會是最糟糕的。

string.ID:
When it began, =name= had no shared helices with Qud's leaders, making their name through the spilling of blood and terror. Uncountable lives were taken by their hand alone, all to slake age-old desires of control and might. Even the ancient plagueborn Nephilim fell before the hand of =name=.
At the end of their reign, =name= coerced a false compact with the surviving Nephilim and climbed to the top of the spire, the last remaining seat of the Sultanate's power. There, by one means or another, they sealed the fate of the world below.
The Plagues of the Gyre raged. Death swept Qud.

strings.string:
當一切開始時，=name= 與 卡德(Qud) 的領導者之間沒有共同的螺旋，他們透過流血與恐怖建立了自己的名聲。無數生命僅僅在他們的掌控下消逝，全都是為了滿足對控制權與力量那古老的渴望。甚至連古老的瘟疫種族 Nephilim 也倒在了 =name= 的手下。
在統治結束之際，=name= 與倖存的 Nephilim 達成了一項虛假的協議，並爬上了尖塔頂端——那是蘇丹國權力的最後據點。在那裡，透過某種手段，他們封印了下方世界的命運。
環流(Gyre) 的瘟疫肆虐。死亡席捲了 卡德(Qud)。

string.ID:
In time, animal and even plant rule waned as their numbers fell to disease, slaughter, and wasting. More resilient, simple life took up the complexity left behind by the former rulers of Qud.
What few Nervous Ones remained passed our stories on to the new life that saw fit to seek our counsel, that you remember the collective fate of those gone. Will you have your own =name=, or have you evolved truly past those before?

strings.string:
隨著數量因疾病、屠殺和衰竭而減少，動物甚至植物的統治地位隨之衰落。更具韌性的簡單生命接管了卡德前任統治者留下的複雜生態。
少數殘存的神經生物將我們的故事傳遞給了那些認為尋求我們建議是明智之舉的新生命，讓你們記得那些逝者的集體命運。你會擁有自己的 =name=，還是你已真正進化到超越前人的境界？

string.ID: Who are you?

strings.string: 你是誰？

string.ID: Who is =name=?

strings.string: 誰是 =name=?

string.ID: I thought the Nervous Ones extinct.

strings.string: 我以為神經質者（the Nervous Ones）已經滅絕了。

string.ID: What became of the Nephilim?

strings.string: 尼菲林（Nephilim）變得如何了？

string.ID: Thank you. Farewell.

strings.string: 謝謝。再會。

string.ID: I am a smear of remnant material. I am drying blood. I am the last breath. Concern yourself no further with me.

strings.string: 我是一抹殘留的物質。我是乾涸的血液。我是最後的一口氣息。別再理會我了。

string.ID: Who, indeed? Who ever was =name=? Dare we hang such hopes and fears on so tiny and distant a figure? Will it bear the weight?

strings.string: 究竟是誰？誰會是 =name=? 我們怎敢將這樣的希望與恐懼寄託在如此渺小而遙遠的人物身上？他能承受這份重量嗎？

string.ID: Every possibility nestles in the deepest of the comb-caves and labyrinths, and even Nervous life is tenacious. Perhaps in this very moment, a moss piglet drinks of its first water in an eon.

strings.string: 每一種可能性都潛藏在最深邃的梳狀洞穴與迷宮之中，即便是不安穩的生命也極其頑強。或許就在此時此刻，一隻水熊正在飲用它一個紀元以來的第一口水。

string.ID: They dwindled and died with the rest of the Nervous Ones. Their remnants wriggle in the cracks.

strings.string: 他們隨著其他「神經質者」一起凋零死去。他們的殘骸在裂縫中蠕動。

string.ID: Hie, pather. Hear tell of the ancient Reshephs, how their foibles led to our nowaday.

strings.string: 快走吧，旅人。聽說說那些古老的 Reshephs，他們的弱點如何導致了我們今日的樣貌。

string.ID: Tell me the story.

strings.string: 告訴我故事。

string.ID: I must decline.

strings.string: 我必須拒絕。

string.ID:
It begins in a time before the Limen and its vanguard, before the ascension, when the spire rose unchallenged and unascended. The hollowers who committed their work to emptying our world were long gone, but Reshephs laid claim to the baffled ground in their place. Even as their holdings withered, they held on.
By the time of the last Resheph, little remained of their works, less of their glory.

strings.string:
這始於 Limen 及其先鋒出現之前的時代，在昇華之前，那時尖塔聳立著，未受挑戰也未曾昇華。那些致力於掏空我們世界的「掏空者」早已離去，但 Resheph 在他們留下的混亂土地上宣示了主權。即便他們的領地日漸凋零，他們仍堅持不懈。
到了最後一位 Resheph 的時代，他們的遺跡已所剩無幾，昔日的榮光更是蕩然無存。

string.ID:
