When it began, =name= had no shared helices with the Reshephs previous, making their name through works and alliances alone. The lives saved and otherwise changed by =name= were myriad, uncountable, and only partially made record. When they spoke, even the plagues of Qud listened.
At the end of their reign, =name= made a compact with the Nephilim that they should never vex the creatures of Qud again. So done, they climbed to the top of the spire, there to end the Reshephate altogether and never be heard from again.

strings.string:
當一切開始時，=name= 與先前的 Resheph 並無共同的螺旋，僅憑藉著作品與盟約建立起名聲。受 =name= 拯救或改變的生命多如牛毛、無法計數，且僅有部分被記錄下來。當他們發言時，甚至連卡德的瘟疫都會側耳傾聽。
在統治結束之際，=name= 與尼菲林（Nephilim）達成協議，承諾不再騷擾卡德的生物。完成此約後，他們攀上了尖塔之巔，在那裡徹底終結了 Resheph 統治，從此銷聲匿跡。

string.ID: Word of =name='s deeds reached record only after the unheralded appearance of the Knights Liminal, and broad assumption suggests that the former established the latter. It could be that the ancient Resheph yet lives within or outside of the boundaries of the Limen, but no word escapes its borders.

strings.string: =name='s 功績直到默默無聞的 臨界騎士 出現後才被載入史冊，而廣泛的推測認為前者促成了後者的誕生。或許古老的 Resheph 仍活在 Limen 的邊界內或邊界外，但沒有任何消息能逃脫其疆域。

string.ID: Who are you?

strings.string: 你是誰？

string.ID: Who is =name=?

strings.string: 誰是 =name=?

string.ID: What is a Resheph?

strings.string: 什麼是雷舍夫？

string.ID: What is the Limen? The Knights Liminal?

strings.string: 什麼是 Limen？那個 臨界騎士？

string.ID: What became of the Nephilim?

strings.string: 尼菲林（Nephilim）變得如何了？

string.ID: Thank you. Farewell.

strings.string: 謝謝。再會。

string.ID:
I have been called Inheritor, Godling, Spirechild, Nephiling. They are all fitting names, but none complete or sufficient.
As it is with you, I am the convergence of past-ripples into present-force. As it is with you, I am deeds done and the intention toward deeds yet to be done.

strings.string:
我曾被稱為繼承者、小神、尖塔之子、尼非林。這些都是貼切的名字，但都不完整或足夠。
正如你一樣，我是過去漣漪匯聚成現在力量的交匯點。正如你一樣，我是已完成的行為，也是對尚未完成之行為的意圖。

string.ID: Who? No one of significance until fortune and volition made them otherwise. Now? No one knows.

strings.string: 誰？在命運與意志改變他們之前，沒人有什麼了不起。現在？沒人知道。

string.ID: Ancient leaders called themselves such.

strings.string: 古代的領袖們自稱為此。

string.ID:
To me, they are stories. I have made no quest to trespass the borders they hold so dear in their rituals. Some say they are mortal creatures like any other, contracted by an outsider coven. Others do not believe they are mortal, others still do not believe that those mysterious strangers have anything to do with the Limen at all.
Mayhap someone ought seek them.

strings.string:
對我來說，它們只是故事。我從未打算在他們的儀式中闖入那些他們視為神聖的邊界。有些人說他們是像其他生物一樣的凡人，受僱於外來盟約。其他人則不相信他們是凡人，還有人不相信那些 神秘陌生人 與 Limen 完全沒有關係。
或許有人應該去尋找他們。

string.ID:
They lived.
Simply a part of the world now, no longer a cilice scourging the Earth, they lived as the creatures they were. Descendants of their offspring may walk on and under Qud. Mayhap the first ones yet live. Mayhap they slumber. Mayhap they will rage again one day, to disrupt a stagnant world.

strings.string:
他們活了下來。
現在僅僅是世界的一部分，不再是鞭笞大地的苦行衣，他們以原本的生物形態生活著。他們的後代可能會在 卡德(Qud) 的地上或地下行走。或許最初的那些人仍活著。或許他們正在沉睡。或許有一天他們會再次憤怒，去打破一個停滯的世界。

string.ID: Hie, pather. Hear tell of the travails of our precursors, how they led to the Freeholds of nowaday.

strings.string: 嗨，旅人。聽說過我們先驅者的艱辛嗎？正是他們的奮鬥成就了今日的自由領地。

string.ID: Tell me the story.

strings.string: 告訴我故事。

string.ID: I must decline.

strings.string: 我必須拒絕。

string.ID:
It begins in a time before the Freeholders, before the final Sultan was entombed, when the spire rose unchallenged and unascended. The hollowers who committed their work to emptying our world were long gone, but Kings and Sultans laid claim to the baffled ground in their place. Even as their holdings withered, they held on.
They so devoured one another's history that little substance remained outside of their strongholds.

strings.string:
這一切始於自由民時代之前，在最後一位蘇丹被安葬之前，那時尖塔聳立，未受挑戰也未曾升騰。那些致力於掏空我們世界的「空洞者」早已離去，但國王與蘇丹們卻在他們留下的混亂土地上宣示主權。即便他們的領地日漸凋零，他們仍苦苦支撐。
他們吞噬了彼此的歷史，以至於除了他們的堡壘之外，幾乎沒有留下任何實質的東西。

string.ID:
When their works began, =name= had no connection to the Sultanate. The rule of these ancient leaders had ended, but not fully: a ghost of the last Sultan yet ruled over the spire, tormenting those on and under the ground with plagues. As =name= grew mighty and challenged the rampaging Nephilim, they came to recognize the source of their shared conflict.
Seeking freedom from the reign of the Sultan, =name= struck a compact with the Nephilim and climbed to the top of the spire, there to confront and banish the cerulean ghost.
And so it proceeded.

strings.string: 當他們的事業開始時，=name= 與蘇丹國並無關聯。這些古代領袖的統治已經結束，但尚未完全終結：最後一位蘇丹的幽靈仍統治著尖塔，以瘟疫折磨著地面上與地底下的眾人。隨著 =name= 變得強大並挑戰橫衝直撞的尼菲林時，他們開始意識到彼此衝突的根源。

string.ID:
Upon their return, =name= participated in the dissolution and federation of all power-concentrate. Allies of the new equalizer gathered and rose, forming the Quetzal Council and other, shorter-lived managing bodies.
Since then, we have lived in tenuous harmony on the dwindling land and under it.

strings.string:
在他們歸來後，=name= 參與了所有權力集中的解散與聯邦化。新平等主義者的盟友們聚集並崛起，形成了 魁札爾議會 以及其他壽命較短的管理機構。
從那時起，我們就在日益萎縮的土地及其下方，維持著脆弱的和平。

string.ID: Who are you?

strings.string: 你是誰？

string.ID: Who is =name=?

strings.string: 誰是 =name=?

string.ID: What is a Freeholder?

strings.string: 什麼是自由保有權人？

string.ID: What became of the Nephilim?

strings.string: 尼菲林（Nephilim）變得如何了？

string.ID: Thank you. Farewell.

strings.string: 謝謝。再會。

string.ID:
I have been called Inheritor, Godling, Spirechild, Nephiling. They are all fitting names, but none complete or sufficient.
As it is with you, I am the convergence of past-ripples into present-force. As it is with you, I am deeds done and the intention toward deeds yet to be done.

strings.string:
我曾被稱為繼承者、小神、尖塔之子、尼非林。這些都是貼切的名字，但都不完整或足夠。
正如你一樣，我是過去漣漪匯聚成現在力量的交匯點。正如你一樣，我是已完成的行為，也是對尚未完成之行為的意圖。

string.ID: Who? No one of significance until fortune and volition made them otherwise. They died without title, or perhaps did not die at all. Tales abound, and thus far no one has stepped forth to renounce or affirm them.

strings.string: 誰？在運氣與意志改變他們之前，沒人是顯赫的人物。他們死時沒有頭銜，或者根本就沒死。傳說層出不窮，而到目前為止還沒有人站出來否認或證實這些說法。

string.ID:
The Freeholds of Qud, that web of folk-clusters, of committees and caucuses, syndicated slime-mold cities held in peace by mutual frustration and monumental effort.
If you need detail, ask a Freeholder, but clear your day first.

strings.string:
卡德的自由領地，那是由人群簇、委員會與黨團交織而成的網絡，是靠著相互挫折與巨大的努力維持和平的聯合黏菌城市。
如果你需要細節，去問一位自由領主吧，但先排開你的行程。

string.ID:
They lived.
Simply a part of the world now, no longer a cilice scourging the Earth, they lived as the creatures they were. Descendants of their offspring walk on and under Qud. Mayhap the first ones yet live. Mayhap they slumber, to wake again when needed.

strings.string:
他們活了下來。
如今僅僅是世界的一部分，不再是鞭笞大地的苦行者，他們以原本的生物形態生存著。他們的後代在卡德之上與之下行走。或許最初的那些人仍活著。或許他們正在沉睡，待到需要之時再次醒來。

string.ID: Hie, pather. Hear tell of ancient journeying, how the stars beckoned and yet beckon.

strings.string: 你好，旅人。聽說過那古老的旅程嗎？星辰曾如此招喚，而今依然如故。

string.ID: Tell me the story.

strings.string: 告訴我故事。

string.ID: I must decline.

strings.string: 我必須拒絕。

string.ID:
It begins in a time before =name='s ascension, when the spire rose unchallenged and unascended. The hollowers who committed their work to emptying our world were long gone, but long had rulers laid claim to the baffled ground in their place. Even as their holdings withered, they held on.
By the end of the time of Kings and Sultans, little remained of their works, less of their glory.

strings.string:
故事始於 =name= 升天之前的時代，那時尖塔聳立著，既未受到挑戰也未曾升天。那些致力於掏空我們世界的「空洞者」早已離去，但統治者們早已在他們留下的混亂土地上宣示主權。即便他們的領地日益凋零，他們仍死守不放。
到了國王與蘇丹時代末期，他們的功業已所剩無幾，更遑論昔日的榮光。

string.ID:
When it began, =name= had no shared helices with Qud's leaders, making their name through works and alliances alone. The lives taken and saved by =name= were myriad, uncountable, and only partially made record. When they spoke, even the plagues of Qud listened.
At the end of their reign, =name= made a compact with the Nephilim that they should never vex the creatures of Qud again. So done, they climbed to the top of the spire and boarded an ancient vessel, thereby to travel the star-dusted expanse.

strings.string:
當一切開始時，=name= 與 卡德(Qud) 的領導者之間沒有共同的螺旋基因，僅憑成就與結盟建立名聲。=name= 所奪取與拯救的生命多如牛毛、無法計數，且僅有部分被記錄下來。當他們發言時，連卡德的瘟疫都會側耳傾聽。
在統治結束之際，=name= 與尼菲林（Nephilim）達成協議，承諾不再騷擾卡德的生物。完成此約後，他們攀上尖塔頂端，登上一艘古老的 容器，從而前往星塵漫天的廣袤疆域。

string.ID:
For centuries, we of listening inclination have kept sharp for some sign that =name= will return to the stars. Those of preaching inclination proclaim the imminent return of the starfarer, bearing tidings from parsecs forgotten and the last light of dying stars.
All others have lived in tenuous harmony on the dwindling land and under it, waiting for the next great history.

strings.string:
幾個世紀以來，我們這些具有傾聽傾向的人一直保持警覺，等待著 =name= 回歸星空的跡象。而那些具有傳教傾向的人則宣告著星際旅者的即將回歸，帶來來自被遺忘的秒差距與垂死恆星最後光芒的消息。
所有其他人都在日益萎縮的土地及其下方維持著脆弱的和平，等待著下一個偉大的歷史篇章。

string.ID: Who are you?

strings.string: 你是誰？

string.ID: Who is =name=?

strings.string: 誰是 =name=?

string.ID: Can one really travel the stars?

strings.string: 人真的能遨遊星辰嗎？

string.ID: What became of the Nephilim?

strings.string: 尼菲林（Nephilim）變得如何了？

string.ID: Thank you. Farewell.

strings.string: 謝謝。再會。

string.ID:
I have been called Inheritor, Godling, Spirechild, Nephiling. They are all fitting names, but none complete or sufficient.
As it is with you, I am the convergence of past-ripples into present-force. As it is with you, I am deeds done and the intention toward deeds yet to be done.

strings.string:
我曾被稱為繼承者、小神、尖塔之子、尼非林。這些都是貼切的名字，但都不完整或足夠。
正如你一樣，我是過去漣漪匯聚成現在力量的交匯點。正如你一樣，我是已完成的行為，也是對尚未完成之行為的意圖。

string.ID: Who, indeed? Who ever was =name=? Dare we hang such hopes and fears on so tiny and distant a figure? Will it bear the weight?

strings.string: 究竟是誰？誰會是 =name=? 我們怎敢將這樣的希望與恐懼寄託在如此渺小而遙遠的人物身上？他能承受這份重量嗎？

string.ID:
Oh, yes. Never doubt this.
Can one return? Hmm. There's the rub.

strings.string:
喔，是的。永遠不要懷疑這一點。
人能歸來嗎？嗯。這正是難題所在。

string.ID:
They lived.
Simply a part of the world now, no longer a cilice scourging the Earth, they lived as the creatures they were. Descendants of their offspring walk on and under Qud. It's said that they ascended to the stars to find =name=, but it seems equally plausible that they may have returned to their slumber in the depths.

strings.string:
他們活了下來。
現在僅僅是世界的一部分，不再是鞭笞大地的苦行者，而是以其原本的生物形態生存著。他們的後代在卡德之上與之下行走。據說他們升向星空去尋找 =name=，但同樣有可能的是，他們或許已回歸深淵中的沉睡。

string.ID: Hie, liquid mind. Absorb you tales of the creatures before, how their rise and fall gave way to your ascension to wanderer-state.

strings.string: 嘿，流動的心靈。請吸收你過去關於那些生物的故事，聽聽他們的興衰如何成就了你向流浪者狀態的昇華。

string.ID: Bloop, blorp. (Proceed.)

strings.string: Bloop, blorp。（繼續。）

string.ID: Glub. (I must decline.)

strings.string: 咕嚕。（我必須拒絕。）

string.ID:
It begins in a time before the dread ascension of =name=, a time wherein the spire rose unchallenged and unascended. The hollowers who committed their work to emptying our world were long gone, but long had rulers laid claim to the baffled ground in their place. Even as their holdings withered, they held on.
The last of them would be the worst.

strings.string:
這一切始於 =name= 那恐怖升天之前的時代，在那時，尖塔尚未受到挑戰，也未曾升天。那些致力於掏空我們世界的「空洞者」早已離去，但統治者們早已在他們留下的混亂土地上宣示主權。即便他們的領地日益凋零，他們仍死命守著。
而最後的一批人，將會是最糟糕的。

string.ID:
When it began, =name= had no shared helices with Qud's leaders, making their name through the spilling of blood and terror. Uncountable lives were taken by their hand alone, all to slake age-old desires of control and might.
Perhaps hunger turned to malice, or the adoption of a greater principle, or simple boredom. Whatever the reason, =name= formed a fast alliance with the ancient plagueborn Nephilim, ascended the spire, and sealed the fate of the world below.
The Plagues of the Gyre raged unchecked.

strings.string:
當一切開始時，=name= 與 卡德的 領導者之間沒有任何共同螺旋，其名聲是透過流血與恐怖建立起來的。僅憑他們之手就奪走了無數生命，全都是為了滿足對控制與權力的古老渴望。
或許是飢渴轉化為惡意，或是採納了某種更高的原則，亦或單純是無聊。無論原因為何，=name= 與古老的瘟疫生 Nephilim 迅速結盟，攀上了尖塔，並封印了下方世界的命運。
環流(Gyre) 的瘟疫肆虐不止。

string.ID:
In time, animal and even plant rule waned as their numbers fell to disease, slaughter, and wasting. More resilient, simple life took up the complexity left behind by the former rulers of Qud.
What few Nervous Ones remained passed our stories on to the new life that saw fit to seek our counsel, that you remember the collective fate of those gone. Will you have your own =name=, or have you evolved truly past those before?

strings.string:
隨著數量因疾病、屠殺和衰竭而減少，動物甚至植物的統治地位隨之衰落。更具韌性的簡單生命接管了卡德前任統治者留下的複雜生態。
少數殘存的神經生物將我們的故事傳遞給了那些認為尋求我們建議是明智之舉的新生命，讓你們記得那些逝者的集體命運。你會擁有自己的 =name=，還是你已真正進化到超越前人的境界？

string.ID: Who are you?

strings.string: 你是誰？

string.ID: Who is =name=?

strings.string: 誰是 =name=?

string.ID: I thought the Nervous Ones extinct.

strings.string: 我以為神經質者（the Nervous Ones）已經滅絕了。

string.ID: What became of the Nephilim?

strings.string: 尼菲林（Nephilim）變得如何了？

string.ID: Thank you. Farewell.

strings.string: 謝謝。再會。

string.ID:
I am history's leftovers, an inheritor of nothing, a bit of marginalia in a burned tome.
That I have persisted to witness this day leaves me in awe. It is extraordinary.

strings.string:
我是歷史的殘餘，一無所繼承者，是燒毀卷軸中一點微不足道的邊注。
我竟能存活至今見證這一天，令我感到敬畏。這是非凡的。

string.ID: Who, indeed? Who ever was =name=? Dare we hang such hopes and fears on so tiny and distant a figure? Will it bear the weight?

strings.string: 究竟是誰？誰會是 =name=? 我們怎敢將這樣的希望與恐懼寄託在如此渺小而遙遠的人物身上？他能承受這份重量嗎？

string.ID: Every possibility nestles in the deepest of the comb-caves and labyrinths, and even Nervous life is tenacious. Perhaps in this very moment, a moss piglet drinks of its first water in an eon.

strings.string: 每一種可能性都潛藏在最深邃的梳狀洞穴與迷宮之中，即便是不安穩的生命也極其頑強。或許就在此時此刻，一隻水熊正在飲用它一個紀元以來的第一口水。

string.ID:
They played their role so well, and lived in power for a time.
If they had any illusion that they would be spared the fate =name= determined for life on Qud, it surely died before the great beings themselves. Mayhap they went to ground and survived. Mayhap their spawn persisted.

strings.string:
他們演得非常好，並一度掌握權力。
如果他們曾幻想自己能免於 =name= 為卡德（Kade）上的生命所決定的命運，那種幻想肯定在偉大存在們面前幻滅了。或許他們隱藏起來生存了下來。或許他們的後代延續了下去。

string.ID: Once in the fullness of time there met the Fool of the Gyre and a wanderer. The Fool offered a tale of the Reshephs, and the wanderer sat to hear.

strings.string: 曾幾何時，在時光的盡頭， 旋渦之愚者 與一名流浪者相遇。 愚者講述了一個關於 Reshephs 的故事， 流浪者坐下來聆聽。

string.ID: Tell me the tale.

strings.string: 告訴我那個故事。

string.ID: I must decline.

strings.string: 我必須拒絕。

string.ID:
Ere the limen, ere ascension, when the spire rose lonely strong, the Reshephs ruled the hollow land devouring one another as they saw fit.
Qud held no mysterious borders, grasped no guiding hands -- at least, none the denizens could grasp. So they knew.

strings.string:
在門檻之前，在昇華之前， 當尖塔孤傲地聳立時， 雷舍夫（Reshephs）統治著這片空洞之地， 隨心所欲地 互相吞噬。
卡德(Qud) 並沒有神秘的邊界， 也沒有指引之手—— 至少，居民們無法掌握任何指引。 他們如此認知。

string.ID:
None hailed =name= and =name= hailed none but with word and blade deed and disregard they stood apart and above
To push back the Gyre, to spill of Nephil ichor they took to the spire and quieted the Reshephate.

strings.string:
無人歌頌 =name= 而 =name= 亦不歌頌任何人 唯有以言辭與利刃 以行徑與漠視 他們屹立於眾人之上，超然物外
為了抵禦環流， 為了濺灑內菲爾的精血 他們前往尖塔 平息了雷謝法特。

string.ID:
Only silence on the ground met we benighted things until the Knights Liminal drew their lines upon the salt.
Unknowing, unseeing, waiting only to know who will spin us around next.

strings.string:
地面上唯有寂靜 我們遇見了被黑暗籠罩的事物 直到臨界騎士 在鹽地上劃出了他們的界線。
無知，無覺， 僅是等待著去知曉 下一個將把我們旋轉的人是誰。

string.ID: Who are you?

strings.string: 你是誰？

string.ID: Who is =name=?

strings.string: 誰是 =name=?

string.ID: What is a Resheph?

strings.string: 什麼是雷舍夫？

string.ID: What is the Limen? The Knights Liminal?

strings.string: 什麼是 Limen？那個 臨界騎士？

string.ID: Thank you. Farewell.

strings.string: 謝謝。再會。

string.ID:
Who, I? Only a fool, tra la, only a remnant scrap.
Only left-behind, only madness, only an echoing gyre.

strings.string:
誰，我？ 僅是個愚者，啦啦， 僅是一抹殘存的碎片。
僅是被遺忘者， 僅是瘋狂， 僅是一個迴盪的環流。

string.ID:
No one of fate, no one of blood, no one of importance, until, suddenly, someone of all of these things.
=name= is a dream from which we cannot awaken.

strings.string:
無人天命所歸， 無人血脈傳承， 無人舉足輕重， 直到某個瞬間，有人兼具了這一切。
=name= 是我們無法從中醒來的夢境。

string.ID: The Resheph, power-haver, ruler of souls, holder of land, authority made singular.

strings.string: 雷舍夫（Resheph），力量持有者， 靈魂之主， 土地守護者， 化為單一權威。

string.ID: O to step over a line one is not meant to cross to parts unknown and desired! O to be halted by chants and weapons and crushing shibboleth. O coven! O not coven? I only want to see!

strings.string: 噢，跨越那條 不該被逾越的界線 前往未知且渴望之境！ 噢，被吟唱與武器 以及沉重的口令所阻攔！ 噢，女巫集會！噢，不是女巫集會？ 我只想看看！

string.ID: Once in the fullness of time there met the Fool of the Gyre and a wanderer. The Fool offered stories of journeyers past and the wanderer sat to hear.

strings.string: 在時光的圓滿之際，遇見了 旋渦之愚者與一名流浪者。 愚者講述著往昔旅者的故事， 而流浪者坐下聆聽。

string.ID: Tell me the tale.

strings.string: 告訴我那個故事。

string.ID: I must decline.

strings.string: 我必須拒絕。

string.ID: Ere the Freeholds, ere ascension, when the spire rose lonely strong, Kings and Sultans ruled the hollow land devouring one another as they saw fit.

strings.string: 在自由領地建立前，在昇華之前， 當尖塔孤傲而強大地聳立時， 國王與蘇丹統治著這片空洞之地， 隨心所欲地 互相吞噬。

string.ID:
None hailed =name= and =name= hailed none but with word and blade deed and disregard they stood against old rule.
To push back the Gyre, to spill of Nephil ichor they took to the spire and quieted the remnants.

strings.string:
無人歌頌 =name= 而 =name= 亦不歌頌任何人 唯有以言辭與利刃 以行徑與漠視 他們反抗舊有的規律。
為了抵禦環流， 為了濺灑內菲爾的精血 他們前往尖塔 平息了殘餘之物。

string.ID:
Upon their return what power =name= wrested they called on allies to distribute and dissolve.
The Freeholders, new hollowers, the Quetzal Council, and other such fools.
Countless years of struggle centuries of change. We remember what we can and watch new and old die.

strings.string:
當他們歸來時 =name= 奪走了何種力量 他們召喚盟友 進行分配與消解。
自由持有者、 新空殼化者、 魁札爾議會， 以及其他類似的蠢貨。
無數年的掙扎 數世紀的變遷。 我們記住所能記住的一切 並注視著新舊交替的死亡。

string.ID: Who are you?

strings.string: 你是誰？

string.ID: Who is =name=?

strings.string: 誰是 =name=?

string.ID: What is a Freeholder?

strings.string: 什麼是自由保有權人？

string.ID: Thank you. Farewell.

strings.string: 謝謝。再會。

string.ID:
Who, I? Only a fool, tra la, only a remnant scrap.
Only left-behind, only madness, only an echoing gyre.

strings.string:
誰，我？ 僅是個愚者，啦啦， 僅是一抹殘存的碎片。
僅是被遺忘者， 僅是瘋狂， 僅是一個迴盪的環流。

string.ID:
No one of fate, no one of blood, no one of importance, until their return and the realization of their future.
=name= is a temple in memory upon which hopes are hung and rage is borne out.
Too great to be real, too foundational not to be, too contradictory to have ever existed.

strings.string:
無關天命， 無關血脈， 無關重要， 直到他們歸來 並實現其未來。
=name= 是為了紀念而建的寺廟， 希望寄託於此， 憤怒也在此宣洩。
偉大到不真實， 基石般不可或缺， 矛盾到從未存在過。

string.ID:
Freeholder: one who argues; bickerer.
Freeholder: a peer among peers among peers among peers tessellated thus until one must scream to be heard.

strings.string:
自由持有者： 爭辯者；吵鬧者。
自由持有者： 同儕中的同儕 在同儕之中的同儕之中 如此交織鑲嵌 直到人們必須嘶吼才能被聽見。

string.ID: Once in the fullness of time there met the Fool of the Gyre and a wanderer. The Fool offered stories spanning ground to sky and the wanderer sat to hear.

strings.string: 在漫長的歲月盡頭， 旋渦之愚者與一名流浪者相遇了。 愚者講述著橫跨大地與天空的故事， 而流浪者坐下來傾聽。

string.ID: Tell me the tale.

strings.string: 告訴我那個故事。

string.ID: I must decline.

strings.string: 我必須拒絕。

string.ID: Ere the struggles of our day, when the spire rose lonely strong, Sultans ruled the hollow land devouring one another as they saw fit.

strings.string: 在我們當代的鬥爭發生之前， 當尖塔孤傲地聳立時， 蘇丹們統治著這片荒蕪之地， 隨心所欲地 互相吞噬。

string.ID:
None hailed =name= and =name= hailed none but with word and blade deed and disregard they stood against old rule.
To push back the Gyre, to spill of Nephil ichor they took to the spire and quieted the remnants.

strings.string:
無人歌頌 =name= 而 =name= 亦不歌頌任何人 唯有以言辭與利刃 以行徑與漠視 他們反抗舊有的規律。
為了抵禦環流， 為了濺灑內菲爾的精血 他們前往尖塔 平息了殘餘之物。

string.ID:
Though =name= was gone our memories remained and the plagues receded and many rejoiced.
To this day eyes turn to the stars looking for a sign that our starfarer has deigned to return.
Countless years of struggle centuries of change. We remember what we can and watch new and old die.

strings.string:
雖然 =name= 已逝 我們的記憶依然留存 瘟疫也隨之退去 許多人因此歡欣鼓舞。
直到今日 眾人的目光仍投向星空 尋找著我們那星際航行者的徵兆 看他是否願意重返此地。
無數年的掙扎 數世紀的變遷。 我們記住所能記住的一切 並注視著新舊交替，生老病死。

string.ID: Who are you?

strings.string: 你是誰？

string.ID: Who is =name=?

strings.string: 誰是 =name=?

string.ID: Is it really possible to travel the stars?

strings.string: 真的有可能星際旅行嗎？

string.ID: Thank you. Farewell.

strings.string: 謝謝。再會。

string.ID:
Who, I? Only a fool, tra la, only a remnant scrap.
Only left-behind, only madness, only an echoing gyre.

strings.string:
誰，我？ 僅是個愚者，啦啦， 僅是一抹殘存的碎片。
僅是被遺忘者， 僅是瘋狂， 僅是一個迴盪的環流。

string.ID:
Starfarer, herald, disruptor, feared, revered, savior and abandoner.
=name= is a dream from which we will one day awaken.

strings.string:
星際旅者、先驅、擾亂者， 令人畏懼、受人崇敬， 救世主與拋棄者。
=name= 是我們終有一天會從中醒來的夢境。

string.ID:
Who cares?
Can one? Maybe. Can I? Surely not. Can YOU? Well. Prove it.

strings.string:
誰在乎？
有人能做到嗎？或許可以。 我能嗎？肯定不行。 你呢？嗯。 證明給我看。

string.ID: Once, after it all burst apart, the Fool of the Gyre met a wise jelly. They sat in the slag of the world and the Fool told the story of nowaday.

strings.string: 曾經，在一切崩解之後， 旋渦之愚者遇見了一塊智慧的水母。 他們坐在世界的殘渣之中， 而愚者訴說著當今的故事。

string.ID: Bloop, blorp. (Proceed.)

strings.string: Bloop, blorp。（繼續。）

string.ID: Glub. (I must decline.)

strings.string: 咕嚕。（我必須拒絕。）

string.ID: Ere the melting of everything, when the spire rose lonely strong, Creatures ruled the hollow land devouring one another as they saw fit.

strings.string: 萬物熔融之前， 當尖塔孤傲地聳立時， 生物統治著這片空洞之地， 隨心所欲地 互相吞噬。

string.ID:
None hailed =name= and =name= hailed none but with word and blade deed and disregard they stood against their kind.
To push back the Gyre, to spill of Nephil ichor they took to the spire and enacted a great betrayal.
Death of impossible scale reigned and we Nervous Ones fell, and as the Gyre swallowed us we sang to the last.

strings.string:
無人向 =name= 致敬 而 =name= 亦不向任何人致敬 但憑藉言語與利刃 行徑與漠視 他們對抗了自己的同類。
為了抵禦環流， 為了灑下尼菲林之血 他們前往尖塔 並實施了一場巨大的背叛。
規模宏大到無法想像的死亡降臨了 而我們這些「焦慮者」倒下了 當環流將我們吞噬時 我們唱到了最後。

string.ID:
Yet some remained in comb-cave and vault, we Nervous Ones, watching our successors burgeon:
You alveolates, you diatoms, you scum-blooms and gillcaps, you one-cells and slime-cities. rising glorious and shining out of our withering shadow.

strings.string:
然而有些人留在了 梳狀洞穴與地窖中， 我們這些神經質的人， 注視著我們的繼承者蓬勃發展：
你們這些肺泡生物、矽藻， 你們這些汙垢花與鰓帽， 你們這些單細胞與黏液城市。 在我們枯萎的陰影中 冉冉升起，光輝燦爛。

string.ID: Who are you?

strings.string: 你是誰？

string.ID: Who is =name=?

strings.string: 誰是 =name=?

string.ID: I thought the Nervous Ones extinct.

strings.string: 我以為神經質者（the Nervous Ones）已經滅絕了。

string.ID: Thank you. Farewell.

strings.string: 謝謝。再會。

string.ID:
I am the carcass of a fool made to jump and dance by a troupe of merry bacteria.
Do you like how I walk? Do you like how I talk? Do you like how my face disintegrates into salt?

strings.string:
我是一個愚者的殘骸 被一群歡快的細菌 操弄著跳躍與舞蹈。
你喜歡我的步態嗎？ 你喜歡我的談吐嗎？ 你喜歡我的臉龐 崩解成鹽的樣子嗎？

string.ID:
Determiner and fate.
More a thing of nature than a being of any kind.
More the context of our existence than anything in it.

strings.string:
決定因素與命運。
比起任何形式的存在， 更像是自然之物。
比起其中的任何事物， 更像是我們存在的背景。

string.ID:
Perhaps we are, perhaps we are. What wiggles in the hot soil? Flagella?
Or could it be a tail?

strings.string:
或許我們就是， 或許我們就是。 有什麼在熱土中蠕動？ 鞭毛嗎？
還是可能是條尾巴？

string.ID: O? What.. am I cohering? Curious! To fetch my notebook. But, o...

strings.string: 喔？我……在胡言亂語什麼？真奇妙！得去拿我的筆記本。但是，喔……

*讀取中*
*讀取中*
*讀取中*

string.ID: Aha, thy phantasm Magicks art crystalsibs to the shivers o' the skin of Avalon. And, thee? Moon King??

strings.string: 啊哈，你的幻象魔法對阿瓦隆（Avalon）皮膚的顫慄而言就像水晶姊妹一般。而你呢？月王（Moon King）？？

string.ID: Sapience? Hey! The time goes, since I have communed last, my adornments speak. Has interstate power been declared among the Codex people?

strings.string: 自我意識？嘿！ 自從我上次通靈以來，時光已逝，我的裝飾品正在訴說著。 編碼族（Codex people）之間是否已宣布了跨州權力？

string.ID: Who are you? What are you?

strings.string: 你是誰？你又是什麼？

string.ID: What is this place?

strings.string: 這是什麼地方？

string.ID: I ascended the Spindle to arrive at this place.

strings.string: 我攀登了紡錘才抵達此地。

string.ID: What 'interstate power'? Who are the 'Codex people'?

strings.string: 什麼「州際力量」？「法典族人」又是誰？

string.ID: Live and... drink?

strings.string: 活著，而且……喝酒？

string.ID: Gathered and spun, I emerge into {{zetachrome|Spoken Ionic Through Covalency Heart}}. What is... what are. I cannot. Finding no entry, for the rest is at home. A strand to you.

strings.string: 經過匯聚與紡織，我顯現於 {{zetachrome|共價心靈之口語離子}}。 這是什麼……是什麼。我無法理解。 找不到入口，因為餘下的皆已歸家。向你傳遞一絲連結。

string.ID: Greetings, Spoken Ionic Through Covalency Heart. I am =name=.

strings.string: 問候，透過共價心靈傳達的語言離子。我是 =name=。

string.ID: I like your jewelry.

strings.string: 我喜歡你的 珠寶。
滿心歡喜！

string.ID: I shiver at a magnanimity long since worn! Decorate you, decorate. Your adornments fascinate also, hey! Span of time across stars shines through it.

strings.string: 我為那早已磨損殆盡的寬宏大量而顫抖！裝飾你吧，裝飾你。你的裝飾也同樣令人著迷，嘿！ 跨越星辰的時間跨度在其中閃耀。

string.ID: Emerges this creature from soil, speaks adornment. Shaken carefully because thought was the line closed. Our remembers at home. Strand.

strings.string: 此生物自土壤中現身，言說著裝飾。 因思緒斷線而被小心地搖晃。 我們在故鄉回憶。絲線。

string.ID: By my adornments, it is the mat below and its home-havers. It is not? I offer a strand. This entry can be at home. Having all time and no entry-home, we addle.

strings.string: 憑藉吾之裝飾，乃是下方的墊子及其居者。 並非如此？我獻上一縷。此入口可作為歸處。 擁有所有時間卻無歸家之所，使人神智不清。

string.ID: How long have you been here?

strings.string: 你在這裡待多久了？

string.ID: I must offer a strand to you. Having not this entry, for I left it at home. At smallest... more than one hundred Codex cycle. Less than ten thousand. Big span. I offer you strands for this.

strings.string: 我必須為你提供一段線索。 因為我沒帶這個入口，我把它忘在家裡了。 至少……超過一百個法典週期（Codex cycle）。少於一萬個。 跨度很大。我為此向你提供線索。

string.ID: Hey! This one I have. Rootbound we to {{M|Star Orchid Temple}}, one of more. Here celebrate burn dust of the tail riders, mosaic innumerability.

strings.string: 嘿！這個我拿到了。 我們被束縛於 {{M|星蘭寺}}，眾多之地之一。 在此慶祝尾行者的燃塵，無數的馬賽克。

string.ID: Is there anyone else here?

strings.string: 這裡還有其他人嗎？

string.ID: For temple 'here' yes: {{zetachrome|Spoken Ionic Through Covalency Heart}} here. Also, you.

strings.string: 關於神廟「在此」： {{zetachrome|透過共價心臟說出的離子語}} 在此。 還有，你也在。

string.ID: But is there anyone else here on the Quay?

strings.string: 但在碼頭上還有其他人嗎？

string.ID: Offering adornment, No entry for this. My mat is small.

strings.string: 獻上裝飾， 此處不接受。 我的墊子很小。

string.ID: Your thirst is mine, my water is yours.

strings.string: 你的渴求即是我的，我的水亦是你的。

string.ID: Swap spittle?

strings.string: 交換唾液？

string.ID: Let's get to it.

strings.string: 我們開始吧。

string.ID: {{emote|licks lips}}

strings.string: {{emote|舔嘴唇}}

string.ID: My thirst is mine, your water is yours.

strings.string: 我的渴求是我的，你的水亦是你的。

string.ID: Thirst. Water. Drink.

strings.string: 口渴。水。喝。

string.ID: Slurp time.

strings.string: 吞噬時間。

string.ID: My water is thirst, your water is yours.

strings.string: 我的水是渴求，你的水是你的。

string.ID: Live and drink, =subject.waterRitualLiquid=-=player.siblingTerm=.

strings.string: 活著並飲下 =subject.waterRitualLiquid=，=player.siblingTerm=。

string.ID: I have some gossip that may interest you.

strings.string: 我有一些妳可能會感興趣的八卦。

string.ID: I have a secret to share with you.

strings.string: 我有個秘密想與你分享。

string.ID: Share a secret with me, =subject.waterRitualLiquid=-=pronouns.siblingTerm=.

strings.string: =subject.waterRitualLiquid=-=pronouns.siblingTerm=，跟我分享一個秘密吧。

string.ID: Would you teach me to craft =recipe=?

strings.string: 你會教我製作 =recipe=? 嗎？

string.ID: Would you teach me your ways?

strings.string: 你會教我你的方法嗎？

string.ID: I am a friend to fungi. Colonize me.

strings.string: 我是 真菌 的朋友。殖民我吧。

string.ID: I promise not to bother you again, =hermit=.

strings.string: 我保證不會再打擾你了，=hermit=。

string.ID: Would you gift me your =object.nameSingle=?

strings.string: 您願意把您的 =object.nameSingle=? 送給我嗎？

string.ID: Would you gift me your =object.nameSingle=?

strings.string: 您願意把您的 =object.nameSingle=? 送給我嗎？

string.ID: Teach me to think like a child again.

strings.string: 教我重新像孩子般思考。

string.ID: Would you teach me your ways?

strings.string: 你會教我你的方法嗎？

string.ID: Teach me a secret of the aggregate mind.

strings.string: 教導我關於聚合心智的秘密。

string.ID:
=subject.T= =verb:grab= your hand and you close your eyes. You find =player.reflexive= in a darkling thicket. =subject.T= =verb:tug= you over roots of braided nether, until finally you stumble into a glade. Others are here. You take their hands as =subject.t= took yours.
After a moment or an eon, you awaken knowing =mutation.name=.

strings.string:
=subject.T= 抓住 妳的手，而妳閉上了雙眼。妳發現 =player.reflexive= 置身於一片幽暗的灌木叢中。=subject.T= 妳穿過由編織根系組成的網，直到最後妳踉蹌地走進一片林間空地。其他人也在這裡。妳握住他們的手，就像 =subject.t= 握住妳的手一樣。
經過片刻或永恆後，妳醒來時得知了 =mutation.name=。

string.ID: Would you share the favorite dish of your people?

strings.string: 你願意分享你們族人的最愛菜餚嗎？

string.ID: Teach me to cook one of your signature dishes.

strings.string: 教我做一道你們的招牌菜吧。

string.ID: I would ask you to join me, =subject.waterRitualLiquid=-=pronouns.siblingTerm=.

strings.string: 我想請求你加入我，=subject.waterRitualLiquid=-=pronouns.siblingTerm=。

string.ID: Live and drink, =subject.waterRitualLiquid=-=pronouns.siblingTerm=.

strings.string: 活下去並暢飲吧，=subject.waterRitualLiquid=-=pronouns.siblingTerm=。

string.ID: {{g|[end the water ritual]}}

strings.string: {{g|[結束水之儀式]}}

string.ID: Let's trade.

strings.string: 來交易吧。

string.ID: I'm looking for work.

strings.string: 我在找工作。

string.ID: Do you have work that needs doing?

strings.string: 你有什麼需要處理的工作嗎？

string.ID: My services are available if you have work to offer.

strings.string: 如果你有工作要交辦，我的服務隨時待命。

string.ID: Is there work around here?

strings.string: 這附近有工作嗎？

string.ID: Speak to =subject.listDirectionsTo#questGivers=.

strings.string: 與 =subject.listDirectionsTo#questGivers= 交談。

string.ID: Talk to =subject.listDirectionsTo#questGivers=.

strings.string: 與 =subject.listDirectionsTo#questGivers= 交談。

string.ID: Find =subject.listDirectionsTo#questGivers=.

strings.string: 尋找 =subject.listDirectionsTo#questGivers=。

string.ID: Thank you. I have more to ask.

strings.string: 謝謝。我還有其他問題想問。

string.ID: What is your name?

strings.string: 你叫什麼名字？

string.ID: What is your name, =pronouns.formalAddressTerm=?

strings.string: 請問您的尊姓大名，=pronouns.formalAddressTerm=?

string.ID: What may I call you, =pronouns.formalAddressTerm=?

strings.string: 請問該如何稱呼您，=pronouns.formalAddressTerm=？

string.ID: What are you called, =pronouns.formalAddressTerm=?

strings.string: 您的稱謂是，=pronouns.formalAddressTerm=？

string.ID: I am =name=, =pronouns.formalAddressTerm=. What is your name?

strings.string: 我是 =name=， =pronouns.formalAddressTerm=。請問您的名字是？

string.ID: I am =name=, =pronouns.formalAddressTerm=. What may I call you?

strings.string: 我是 =name=，您的 =pronouns.formalAddressTerm=。請問該如何稱呼您？

string.ID: You may call me =subject.refname=.

strings.string: 你可以稱呼我為 =subject.refname=。

string.ID: My name is =subject.refname=.

strings.string: 我的名字是 =subject.refname=。

string.ID: I am called =subject.refname=.

strings.string: 我的名字是 =subject.refname=。

string.ID: They call me =subject.refname=.

strings.string: 他們稱呼我為 =subject.refname=。

string.ID: Thank you, =pronouns.formalAddressTerm=.

strings.string: 謝謝您，=pronouns.formalAddressTerm=。

string.ID: My thanks, =pronouns.formalAddressTerm=.

strings.string: 多謝，=pronouns.formalAddressTerm=。

string.ID: Pleased to meet you, =pronouns.formalAddressTerm=.

strings.string: 很高興見到您，=pronouns.formalAddressTerm=。

string.ID: BASE SLYNTH REQUEST ACCEPT TEXT

strings.string: BASE 斯林斯 請求接受文本

string.ID: You have my thanks, friend.

strings.string: 謝謝你，朋友。

string.ID: I want to ask something else.

strings.string: 我想問點別的事。

string.ID: BASE SLYNTH REQUEST REJECT TEXT

strings.string: 基地 Slynth 請求遭拒文本

string.ID: I understand.

strings.string: 我明白了。

string.ID: BASE SLYNTH REQUEST TEXT

strings.string: BASE 斯林斯 請求文本

string.ID: I am.

strings.string: 我存在。

string.ID: If you would have them, yes.

strings.string: 如果你們有，那就好。

string.ID: BASE SLYNTH ABOUT TEXT

strings.string: BASE 斯林斯 關於文本

string.ID: They are not ready to choose yet.

strings.string: 他們還沒準備好做出選擇。

string.ID: BASE SLYNTH ARRIVED TEXT

strings.string: BASE 斯林斯 已抵達

string.ID: My thanks.

strings.string: 多謝了。

string.ID: BASE SLYNTH SETTLED TEXT

strings.string: BASE 斯林斯 已定居

string.ID: My thanks again.

strings.string: 再次感謝您。

string.ID: In my travels I encountered a people, the slynth, seeking a new home.

strings.string: 在我的旅途中，我遇到了一群正在尋找新家園的斯林斯。

string.ID: About the slynth...

strings.string: 關於那名 斯林斯...

string.ID: I see the slynth have arrived. How are they faring?

strings.string: 我看到斯林斯已經抵達了。他們過得如何？

string.ID: It's been a week. Are the slynth settled in?

strings.string: 已經過了一週了。那些斯林斯安頓好了嗎？

string.ID: There are no more words for us, wanderer.

strings.string: 我們之間已無話可說了，流浪者。

string.ID: =name=! Live and drink, pilgrim.

strings.string: =name=！活下去並盡情飲酒吧，朝聖者。

string.ID: =name=! Live and drink, pilgrim.

strings.string: =name=！活下去並盡情飲酒吧，朝聖者。

string.ID: I have visited the Six Day Stilt.

strings.string: 我曾造訪過六日高蹺。

string.ID:
Ah!
Tell me, =pronouns.formalAddressTerm=, was it the picture of wonder as I see it in my mind's eye? Were you beauty-struck by its truths?

strings.string:
啊！
告訴我，=pronouns.formalAddressTerm=，它是否如我在腦海中所見那般奇幻瑰麗？你是否也被它的真理所震撼？

string.ID: Truly breathtaking. How the glass glittered in the sun!

strings.string: 真令人屏息。玻璃在陽光下閃爍著光芒！

string.ID: To behold the Argent Fathers in simulacra... what revelation!

strings.string: 能見到白銀之父的擬像……這是何等的神啟！

string.ID: I saw only empty spectacle. Who can worship a hole in the ground?

strings.string: 我只看見了空洞的景象。誰會崇拜地底的一個洞呢？

string.ID:
So it's true! O Argent Fathers, how far-reaching your works!
... and my trinket? Did you cast it into the Sacred Well?

strings.string:
原來是真的！喔，銀色之父們，你們的功業竟如此深遠！
...那我的小玩意呢？你把它丟進了神聖之井嗎？

string.ID: I did.

strings.string: 我做了。

string.ID: Sadly, it was lost.

strings.string: 遺憾的是，它失蹤了。

string.ID: No, I took it apart or sold it or something.

strings.string: 沒有，我把它拆解了、賣掉了，或是做了什麼。

string.ID:
Moon and Sun! The Argent Fathers bless us, our paths are chromed and glistering.
You have my thanks, =pronouns.formalAddressTerm=. Bel shield you.

strings.string:
月亮與太陽啊！銀色之父保佑我們，我們的道路閃耀且光輝奪目。
承蒙您的感激，=pronouns.formalAddressTerm=。Bel 盾牌你。

string.ID: And you as well.

strings.string: 您也一樣。

string.ID:
Oh, I am leaden with this knowledge. Yet am I soothed by your pilgrimage.
Moon and Sun, I feel the warmth of the Kasaphescence yet. Praise the Argent Fathers.

strings.string:
噢，此知識令我沉重萬分。然而汝的朝聖撫慰了我。
月與日，我仍能感受到卡薩菲（Kasaphescence）的溫暖。讚美白銀之父。

string.ID:
Oh, how your words rasp my soul, =player.formalAddressTerm=. You abrade me.
Let us speak no more.

strings.string:
喔，您的話語令我的靈魂感到刺痛，=player.formalAddressTerm=。您磨損了我。
我們別再說了。

string.ID: Very well.

strings.string: 很好。

string.ID:
So you have seen the truth? Great are the machinations of our Argent Fathers!
Our meeting, a tiny Canticle. Fate dances in our shadows by their will and word.
Moon and sun, what a day! What a fine day. Praise Shekhinah!

strings.string:
所以你已經看見真相了？我們銀色之父的謀略真是偉大！
我們的相遇，不過是一段微小的讚歌。命運在他們的意志與言語下，於我們的陰影中起舞。
日月交輝，多麼美好的一天！多麼燦爛的一天。讚美謝基納（Shekhinah）！

string.ID: Praise Shekhinah!

strings.string: 讚美謝基納！

string.ID:
Wh-
My heart's sheen wanes to hear this of you. You abrade me, =player.formalAddressTerm=, I am scuffed.
What of my trinket, then? Did you cast it into the... "hole in the ground?"

strings.string:
唔——
聽到你這麼說，我心靈的光澤都黯淡了。你磨損了我，=player.formalAddressTerm=，我被刮傷了。
那麼我的小玩意呢？你把它扔進那個……「地洞」裡了嗎？

string.ID: Yes, I threw it in the hole.

strings.string: 是的，我把它扔進洞裡了。

string.ID: No, I lost it.

strings.string: 不，我弄丟了。

string.ID: I gave it to someone. Or sold it, perhaps.

strings.string: 我把它給了某人。或者，或許是賣掉了。

string.ID:
Well... the light of the Kasaphescence yet glimmers through your rasping edge.
I must, then, thank you.

strings.string:
嗯……卡薩斐斯光芒（Kasaphescence）仍透過你那粗糙的刃口閃爍著。
那麼，我必須感謝你了。

string.ID: You're welcome.

strings.string: 不客氣。

string.ID:
My stomach lurches and quavers at the shock of this knowledge.
If there is a lesson in your disregard, I will meditate upon it in my own time.
Let us speak no more.

strings.string:
得知這項知識的衝擊讓我胃部翻騰、顫抖。
如果你的漠視中蘊含著教訓，我會在空閒時自行冥想。
我們別再說了。

string.ID: As you say.

strings.string: 如您所言。

string.ID:
Ah, a pit opens under my stomach!
Let us speak no more, I beg you. You scuff me. Live and drink.

strings.string:
啊，我的腹部下方裂開了一個深坑！
求求你，我們別再說了。你弄髒了我。活下去，盡情飲酒吧。

string.ID: Wanderer and =pronouns.formalAddressTerm=! Have you journeyed yet to the Stilt, and seen the Sacred Well?

strings.string: 流浪者與 =pronouns.formalAddressTerm=！你是否已經前往高腳地（Stilt），並見過神聖之井（Sacred Well）了？

string.ID: Not yet, friend. Live and drink.

strings.string: 還沒，朋友。活下去並盡情飲酒吧。

string.ID: Wanderer! Do you venture northwise? Into the Great Desert and nearer the Six Day Stilt?

strings.string: 流浪者！你要向北冒險嗎？前往大沙漠，靠近六日高蹺？

string.ID: What is the Six Day Stilt?

strings.string: 什麼是 六日高蹺(Six Day Stilt)？

string.ID: Why do you ask?

strings.string: 你為何這樣問？

string.ID:
Ah! The great Mechanimist temple of glass, the sacred offering Well, and history in stone relief. Peopled by the Argent Fathers, in statue and light sculpture. And circled by the grand bazaar. I hear there are more people there than numbers in the void, and their chatter makes a sound wholly raw and new to the world.
Will you go there, and take my bauble? Will you offer it at the Well, where I cannot?

strings.string:
啊！那宏偉的玻璃機械主義神廟、神聖的祭品之井，以及石刻浮雕中的歷史。由銀色之父（Argent Fathers）組成，以雕像與 光影雕塑 呈現。周圍環繞著大市集。我聽說那裡的人口比虛空中的數字還要多，他們的嘈雜聲對這個世界來說是完全原始且新穎的聲音。
你會去那裡，帶走我的小玩意嗎？你會在井邊獻祭它，在我無法到達的地方？

string.ID: Your bauble?

strings.string: 你的小玩意？

string.ID: Argent Fathers?

strings.string: 銀色之父？

string.ID: Why can you not go?

strings.string: 為什麼你不能去？

string.ID: I will make the journey.

strings.string: 我將踏上旅程。

string.ID: I cannot commit to this. Live and drink.

strings.string: 我無法承諾此事。活下去，盡情飲水吧。

string.ID:
Yes! My neighbor-kin tire of the tale. I was scything the vine when the flat of my blade turned something loose from the soil. My heart has stirred before at the sight of chrome, but to free a small splinter myself, to slide a bead on the abacus of Beauty...
Will you go, then? And offer my bauble at the Well?

strings.string:
沒錯！我的鄰居親族都聽膩了這個故事。我當時正在收割藤蔓，刀刃的平整面翻開了土壤中的某件東西。看到鉻金屬時，我的心曾悸動過，但能親手釋放出一小塊碎片，在美學的算盤上滑落一顆珠子……
那麼，你會去嗎？並將我的小玩意兒獻給深井？

string.ID: Why can you not go?

strings.string: 為什麼你不能去？

string.ID: What is the Six Day Stilt again?

strings.string: 那個 六日高蹺(Six Day Stilt) 又是什麼來著？

string.ID: I will make the journey.

strings.string: 我將踏上旅程。

string.ID: I cannot commit to this. Live and drink.

strings.string: 我無法承諾此事。活下去，盡情飲水吧。

string.ID:
I am no rector, understand, but They are the molders of chrome. The gods under Shekhinah who wrought metal edifices from the raw Kasaphescence.
Will you go?

strings.string:
請明白，我並非牧師，但「祂們」是鉻金屬的塑造者。是在 Shekhinah 麾下，從原始的 Kasaphescence 中鑄造出金屬建築的神祇。
你要走嗎？

string.ID: Perhaps. Why?

strings.string: 或許吧。為什麼？

string.ID: I cannot commit to this. Live and drink.

strings.string: 我無法承諾此事。活下去，盡情飲水吧。

string.ID: I would ask you make an offering at the sacred Well of my bauble. Moon and sun, I beg you!

strings.string: 我會要求你在我的寶物於 神聖之井 進行祭獻。月亮與太陽，我懇求你們！

string.ID: Why can you not go?

strings.string: 為什麼你不能去？

string.ID: What is the Six Day Stilt?

strings.string: 什麼是 六日高蹺(Six Day Stilt)？

string.ID: I will make the journey.

strings.string: 我將踏上旅程。

string.ID: I cannot commit to this. Live and drink.

strings.string: 我無法承諾此事。活下去，盡情飲水吧。

string.ID:
Friend, I would be a smoldering heap, cooked to death by the ray of a dawnglider! I would be a slug-riddled corpse by the rifles of the Issachari!
There is no kindness in the Great Desert, and little more in the canyons. I cannot go and live.

strings.string:
朋友，我會變成一堆燃燒的灰燼，被 黎明滑翔者 的光線烤死！我會變成一個佈滿蛞蝓的屍體，死於 伊薩查里（Issachari）的步槍之下！
大沙漠中沒有仁慈，峽谷中也沒多少。我無法前往並生存下去。

string.ID: What is the Six Day Stilt again?

strings.string: 那個 六日高蹺(Six Day Stilt) 又是什麼來著？

string.ID: I will make the journey.

strings.string: 我將踏上旅程。

string.ID: I cannot commit to this. Live and drink.

strings.string: 我無法承諾此事。活下去，盡情飲水吧。

string.ID:
Moon and sun, =pronouns.formalAddressTerm=! You have my deep and many-sided thanks. Here, take the trinket now. And if you're to ever return, let us visit again.
Live and drink!

strings.string:
月亮與太陽，=pronouns.formalAddressTerm=! 我對您表達深厚且多方面的謝意。來，現在把這件小飾品拿走。如果您日後再次歸來，讓我們再會吧。
生存並飲酒！

string.ID:
Yes! My neighbor-kin tire of the tale. I was scything the vine when the flat of my blade turned it loose from the soil. My heart has stirred before at the sight of chrome, but to free a small splinter myself, to slide a bead toward the beam on the abacus of Beauty...
Will you go, then? And offer my bauble at the Well?

strings.string:
是的！我的鄰里親族已聽膩了這個故事。我正在收割藤蔓時，刀刃的側面將它從土壤中鬆脫了下來。看到鉻金屬時，我的心曾悸動過，但親手釋放一小塊碎片，讓一顆珠子滑向美之算盤上的光束……
那麼，你要去嗎？並在井邊獻上我的小玩意兒？

string.ID:
Yes! My neighbor-kin tire of the tale. I was supping on summer offal when I noticed something glinting in the guts. My heart has stirred before at the sight of chrome, but to free a small splinter myself, to slide a bead on the abacus of Beauty...
Will you go, then? And offer my bauble at the Well?

strings.string:
沒錯！我的鄰里親族都聽膩了這個故事。我正在享用夏天的內臟時，注意到腸胃裡閃爍著某種東西。看到鉻金屬時，我的心曾悸動過，但能親手取出那小小的碎片，在美學的算盤上撥動一顆珠子……
那麼，你會去嗎？並在深井處獻上我的小玩意？

string.ID:
Friend, I would be a smoldering heap, cooked to death by the ray of a dawnglider! I would be a slug-riddled corpse by the rifles of the Issachari!
There is no kindness in the Great Desert. I cannot go and live.

strings.string:
朋友，我會變成一堆餘燼，被 黎明滑翔者 的光束烤成焦炭！我會變成一具被伊斯查里步槍射得滿是蛞蝓孔洞的屍體！
大沙漠中沒有仁慈。我無法前往並生存下去。

string.ID:
Yes! My neighbor-kin tire of the tale. I was wrenching moisture from a banner when I kicked something 'neath the salt. My heart has stirred before at the sight of chrome, but to free a small splinter myself, to slide a bead on the abacus of Beauty...
Will you go, then? And offer my bauble at the Well?

strings.string:
是的！我的鄰里親族都聽膩了這個故事。我當時正在從旗幟上擰出水分，結果踢到了鹽層下的某樣東西。我曾因看到鉻金屬而心潮澎湃，但能親手釋放出一小塊碎片，在美學的算盤上撥動一顆珠子……
那麼，你會去嗎？並在井邊獻上我的小玩意兒？

string.ID:
Friend, I would be a smoldering heap, cooked to death by the ray of a dawnglider! I would be a slug-riddled corpse by the rifles of my kinsfolk!
There is no kindness deep in the Great Desert. I cannot go and live.

strings.string:
朋友，我會變成一堆冒煙的殘骸，被 黎明滑翔者 的光線燒成焦炭！我會變成一具佈滿蛞蝓的屍體，死於同胞的步槍之下！
大沙漠之中沒有深藏的仁慈。我無法前往並生存下去。

string.ID:
Yes! My neighbor-kin tire of the tale. I fished it out a mound of pig stool. My heart has stirred before at the sight of chrome, but to free a small splinter myself, to slide a bead on the abacus of Beauty...
Will you go, then? And offer my bauble at the Well?

strings.string:
是的！我的鄰里親族已聽膩了這個故事。我是從一堆豬糞堆裡把它撈出來的。我曾因看見鉻金屬而心動，但若能親手取出這小小的碎片，在美感算盤上滑動一顆珠子……
那麼，你會去嗎？並在井邊獻上我的小玩意？

string.ID:
Friend, I would be a smoldering heap, cooked to death by the ray of a dawnglider! I would be a slug-riddled corpse by the rifles of the Issachari!
There is no kindness in the Great Desert. I cannot go and live.

strings.string:
朋友，我會變成一堆餘燼，被 黎明滑翔者 的光束烤成焦炭！我會變成一具被伊斯查里步槍射得滿是蛞蝓孔洞的屍體！
大沙漠中沒有仁慈。我無法前往並生存下去。

string.ID: -mm. Mmm? =player.FormalAddressTerm=.

strings.string: -嗯。嗯？=player.FormalAddressTerm=。

string.ID: {{emote|*Elder Irudad smiles.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*長老 伊魯達德 微笑著。*}}

string.ID:
{{emote|*Elder Irudad smiles.*}}
Come in- come sit 'neath the cool shade, 'cross a pillow there.

strings.string:
{{emote|*長者 伊魯達德 微笑。*}}
進來吧——過來坐在那涼爽的陰影下，靠著那邊的枕頭。

string.ID:
{{emote|*Elder Irudad smiles.*}}
Live and drink, =name=. Come, sit with me.

strings.string:
{{emote|*Elder 伊魯達德 微笑著。*}}
活下去並盡情飲酒吧，=name=。來，坐到我身邊。

string.ID:
-mm. Mmm? =player.FormalAddressTerm=?
{{emote|*Elder Irudad smiles.*}}
Live and drink. Come in- come sit 'neath the cool shade, 'cross a pillow there. And welcome to Joppa.
You may drink of our freshwater, too, and quench your thirst.

strings.string:
-mm. 嗯？=player.FormalAddressTerm=?
{{emote|*長者 伊魯達德 微笑。*}}
活著並盡情飲用吧。進來吧——過來坐在那邊涼爽的陰影下，靠著枕頭坐。歡迎來到 約帕(Joppa)。
你也可以飲用我們的淡水，解解渴。

string.ID: I'm back from Red Rock with the corpse of a pale spiderling. Elder, would you examine it?

strings.string: 我從 紅岩 回來了，帶著一具蒼白的幼蛛屍體。長老，您能檢查一下嗎？

string.ID: What is this place, Joppa?

strings.string: 這個地方叫作 約帕(Joppa)，是什麼樣的地方？

string.ID: Do you sell wares here?

strings.string: 這裡有賣東西嗎？

string.ID: I'm looking for work.

strings.string: 我在找工作。

string.ID: I'm looking for work.

strings.string: 我在找工作。

string.ID: Can you tell me about the Gyre and the Girsh nephilim again?

strings.string: 你能再跟我說說關於環流和吉爾什 nephilim 的事嗎？

string.ID: What can you tell me about the Six Day Stilt?

strings.string: 關於六日高蹺，你能告訴我些什麼？

string.ID: Argyve wants me to meet the Barathrumites.

strings.string: 阿吉夫 想要我去找 巴拉楚姆信徒。

string.ID:
-this? The oasis-hamlet. 'Neath the shelf of the world. A million breaths of salt the wind heaves over the Great Salt Desert Moghra'yi. And to the east, the rotting jungles of Qud.
Here in the crack between the two, watervine can grow, and we grow it. mmm, =player.formalAddressTerm=.

strings.string:
-這個嗎？綠洲村落。就在世界的邊緣之下。微風在 莫格拉伊(Moghra'yi) 大鹽漠上掀起百萬次的鹹味呼吸。而在東邊，則是卡德 那腐爛的 叢林。
就在兩者之間的裂隙中，可以生長 水藤，而我們也種植著它。嗯，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

string.ID: Can you tell me about Qud?

strings.string: 你能跟我說說關於 卡德(Qud) 的事嗎？

string.ID:
-mm, there? Land slopes up and is toothed in chrome steeples, ageless things. Looming over the old-earth tunnels, pillowed in rotting jungle and fungus groves. And broken against the mounts of the north, they are, in the shadow of the Spindle...
There are people, friends, communities. And friends-to-noone, too. History is thick as the high salt sun, =player.formalAddressTerm=, and where the past is ground up like matz meal, a mix of life sets in.
-mm, adventurous ones set off for their own splinter of artifact. To both Fates, life and death...

strings.string:
-mm，在那裡嗎？土地向上傾斜，佈滿了鉻鋼尖塔，那是永恆之物。它們聳立在舊地球隧道之上，枕在腐爛的叢林與真菌林中。而在北方的山脈旁，它們破碎地矗立著，就在紡錘的陰影之中...
那裡有人們、朋友們、社群。也有不屬於任何人的孤獨者。歷史如高鹽之陽般厚重，=player.formalAddressTerm=，而當過去被磨碎得如同瑪札粉末時，一種生命的混合體便隨之成形。
-mm，冒險者們為了各自的一塊神器碎片而啟程。面對著兩極命運，生與死...

string.ID: -here? Speak to my daughter through the east door, for herbs. And sitting Tam in the southeast has all manner of trinket, against his chests o' drawers.

strings.string: ——這裡？透過東門向我的女兒詢問草藥。而坐在東南方的 塔姆 有各種小玩意，就放在他的抽屜櫃旁。

string.ID:
-mm, work? The farmers are plagued by cave vermin. You might speak to Mehmet o' there, by the southern watervine patch.
And Argyve, too, =player.formalAddressTerm=. The tinker. Always looking for trinkets to wire between, heh. Go through his hut of sheet metal, to the southwest.

strings.string:
-mm，工作？農夫們正受洞穴害蟲之苦。妳或許可以去南邊的水藤叢找梅赫梅特談談。
還有阿吉夫，=player.formalAddressTerm=。那位修補匠。總是想著要把各種小玩意兒接在一起，呵。穿過他那座由金屬片搭成的小屋，就在西南方。

string.ID: -mm, work? Try Argyve, =player.formalAddressTerm=. The tinker. Always looking for trinkets to wire between, heh. Go through his hut of sheet metal, to the southwest.

strings.string: -嗯，工作嗎？試著找阿吉夫，=player.formalAddressTerm=。那位 修補匠。他總是在尋找能串接的小玩意兒，嘿。去西南方那間由金屬片搭建的小屋看看吧。

string.ID: -ahh, mm, such spectacle. The statues within, a revelation to the eyes. Chandlers enough to drain your skins dry 'twixt Shallows and Beetle Moon.

strings.string: -啊，嗯，多麼壯觀的景象。內部的雕像簡直是視覺的啟示。從淺灘到甲蟲月之間，足以讓你耗盡皮囊的燈具供應充足。

string.ID: -mm, Barathrumites. Strange draft o'those bearfolk. They, mm, hah. They care not overly for outsiders. I hope Argyve sold you not a better welcome than you'll have.

strings.string: -嗯，巴拉楚姆信徒。那些熊族人真奇怪。他們，嗯，哈。他們不太在意外來者。我希望阿吉夫沒有給你比你即將得到的更好的歡迎。

string.ID:
-this? Oh? Oh...
{{emote|*Elder Irudad pauses for several minutes.*}}
Warted leg? mm. Foul smell of sour gum? mmm. Moon and sun....
A girshling? This is a girshling.

strings.string:
-這個？喔？喔...
{{emote|*Elder 伊魯達德 停頓了幾分鐘。*}}
疣狀腿？嗯。酸膠的惡臭？嗯嗯。月亮與太陽....
A 吉什林？這是一個 吉什林。

string.ID: What's a girshling?

strings.string: 什麼是 吉什林？

string.ID:
Creature of plague, =player.formalAddressTerm=. mmm. This one...
{{emote|*Elder Irudad pauses.*}}
This one covered in slick and muscled out the bilge hose of sleeping Agolgot, in the cave under the Cloaca...
-mm, but here? Girshling this far west? There must be hundreds for one to reach... mm, does the Gyre widen again??

strings.string:
瘟疫生物，=player.formalAddressTerm=。嗯。這個……
{{emote|*長者伊魯達德停頓了一下。*}}
這個全身覆蓋著黏液且肌肉發達的傢伙，曾從睡夢中的阿格爾戈特的汙水管中竄出，就在下水道下方的洞穴裡……
—嗯，但這裡？吉什林竟然在這麼西邊的地方？要到達這裡必須經過數百個……嗯，環流會再次擴大嗎？？
環流(Gyre)?

string.ID: I talked to a strange figure next to the girshling.

strings.string: 我跟吉什林旁邊的一個奇怪身影交談過。

string.ID: There was a strange figure shadowing the creature...

strings.string: 有一個奇怪的身影在跟蹤那個生物...

string.ID: I noticed the creature has had its fangs removed.

strings.string: 我注意到這隻生物的獠牙已被拔除。

string.ID:
{{emote|*Elder Irudad pauses.*}}
-mm, plagues. Of our great grandsires many-times-over. Salt, darkness, svardym-frog... Girshling.

strings.string:
{{emote|*Elder 伊魯達德 停頓了一下。*}}
-嗯，瘟疫。我們偉大的祖先們經歷過無數次的。鹽、黑暗、斯瓦迪姆-青蛙... 吉什林。

string.ID:
{{emote|*Elder Irudad pauses.*}}
-mm, =player.formalAddressTerm=. Do not like to sour the air with a harsh word! But this tiding bites my liver like acid. mm, must ask Nima for an elixir of yuckwheat...

strings.string:
{{emote|*長老 Irudad 停頓了一下。*}}
-mm，=player.formalAddressTerm=。我不喜歡用惡言讓空氣變得凝重！但這個消息像強酸一樣刺痛我的肝臟。mm，必須向 Nima 討要一劑噁心小麥（yuckwheat）精華液……

string.ID: I talked to a strange figure next to the girshling.

strings.string: 我跟吉什林旁邊的一個奇怪身影交談過。

string.ID: There was a strange figure shadowing the creature...

strings.string: 有一個奇怪的身影在跟蹤那個生物...

string.ID: I noticed the creature has had its fangs removed.

strings.string: 我注意到這隻生物的獠牙已被拔除。

string.ID: I am sorry to cause pain, Elder.

strings.string: 我很抱歉造成您的痛苦，長老。

string.ID: -mm, oh? In dyed robes, flashing gestures of hand? And ranting about pipe milk? A gyre wight, must be. They about worship the Girsh nephilim as gods.

strings.string: -嗯，喔？穿著染色的長袍，手勢誇張？還在喋喋不休地談論管奶？一定是個 旋渦亡靈。他們大概把 吉爾什 nephilim 當作神來崇拜吧。

string.ID: Girsh nephilim?

strings.string: 吉爾什(Gilsch) 是尼菲林(nephilim) 嗎？

string.ID:
{{emote|*Elder Irudad pauses.*}}
-mm, nephilim. Seventh plague. Girsh titans born on the Moon Stair, and quickened to life to eat our young. Sultan Resheph drove them back a chiliad ago, away to slumber. mm, do they rouse?

strings.string:
{{emote|*長者 伊魯達德 停頓了一下。*}}
—嗯，尼非林（nephilim）。第七災厄。誕生於 月之階梯 的 吉爾什 泰坦，被賦予生命以吞噬我們的幼崽。蘇丹 雷舍夫（Resheph）在一千年前將他們擊退，令其陷入沉睡。嗯，他們醒了嗎？

string.ID: -mm, oh? A gyre wight, must be. They bind the teeth right up to their own gums, to make a show for the Girsh nephilim.

strings.string: -嗯，喔？一定是個 旋渦亡靈。他們把牙齒一直鑲嵌到牙齦上，好向 吉爾什 nephilim 展示。

string.ID: Girsh nephilim?

strings.string: 吉爾什(Gilsch) 是尼菲林(nephilim) 嗎？

string.ID:
-mm? No, =player.formalAddressTerm=! Your finding is rich in value to us. We are poor farmers, and sharpen our vinereapers is all we can do. But others? Perhaps more.
Take these prickly-boons as thanks. mm, I will not soon forget this, =name=. Leave me now to muse, kindly...

strings.string:
-mm？不，=player.formalAddressTerm=! 您的發現對我們來說價值連城。我們只是貧苦的農民，能做的只有磨利我們的藤蔓收割者。但其他人呢？或許能做得更多。
請收下這些刺棘恩賜作為謝禮。mm，我不會很快忘記這件事的，=name=。請讓我獨自沉思吧，拜託了……

string.ID:
-mm, yes? Plagues, a chiliad old. Seven such: girshlings, darkness. mm, svardym-frog...
Ah, nephilim, too, =player.formalAddressTerm=. Girsh titans who eat the young of kith and kin. Sultan Resheph drove them under the earth, but do they stir??

strings.string:
-嗯，是嗎？瘟疫，已存在了千年以上。有七種：吉什林、黑暗。嗯，斯瓦迪姆-青蛙...
啊，還有尼菲林，=player.formalAddressTerm=. 吉爾什巨人們，他們吞食同胞與親族的幼崽。蘇丹 Resheph 將他們驅逐至地底，但他們是否還在蠢蠢欲動呢？

string.ID: -mm, oh? You're wondering if they might come to Joppa, then?

strings.string: -嗯，喔？你在想他們是否會來到約帕嗎？

string.ID: mm, I am for you, =name=. Any friend of yours is too a friend of Joppa, and if those friends desire shelter I wouldn't dare turn them away. I only hope these lilypad-folk have the patience for a farmer's life. -mm, not as exciting here as it was in the Palladium Reef.

strings.string: 嗯，我支持你，=name=。你的任何朋友也都是約帕的朋友，如果那些朋友需要庇護，我不敢拒之門外。我只希望這些蓮葉族能有耐心過農夫的生活。—嗯，這裡不像鈀金礁那樣刺激。

string.ID: You have my thanks, Elder.

strings.string: 謝謝您，長老。

string.ID: -mm, blessings upon your generous heart, =name=. I mean no slight to these slynth, but it is too great a favor you ask of the people of Joppa.

strings.string: -嗯，願祝福降臨於您慷慨的心靈，=name=。我並非要輕視這些斯林斯，但您對約帕人民提出的請求實在太過沉重了。

string.ID: Have you spoken to the slynth, =name=? I am curious to hear what destination they choose.

strings.string: 你跟那位 斯林斯, =name= 說過話了嗎？我很好奇他們會選擇前往哪裡。

string.ID:
-mm, your luminous friends are settling in quite well.
There is yet a pall of ennui among some, but such is the case for any party of brave migrants. Ah, they will find their ground or their path, all in time. Some farmers show some small discomfort but that will pass in time.

strings.string:
-mm，妳那些發光的朋友們適應得相當不錯。
雖然有些人仍籠罩在無聊的陰霾中，但任何勇敢的移民團體都會遇到這種情況。啊，隨著時間推移，他們會找到自己的立足點或道路。有些農夫表現出些微的不適，但那也會隨時間消逝。

string.ID: My thanks, Elder.

strings.string: 多謝您，長老。

string.ID:
-mm, ah, =name=. Come see how the slynth have become a part of Joppa!
Some cared not for the slow pace of our lives and struck out on their own, and with their thews and wits I have no doubt they will live to find purpose. mm, others are welcome to grow and flourish here in our marshes.

strings.string:
-mm，啊，=name=。快來看看斯林斯是如何成為 約帕(Joppa) 的一部分！
有些人不喜歡我們緩慢的生活步調而自立門戶，憑藉他們的肌肉與智慧，我毫不懷疑他們能活下去並找到目標。mm，其他人也歡迎在我們的沼澤中成長與繁榮。

string.ID: My thanks again, Elder.

strings.string: 再次感謝您，長老。

string.ID: Live and drink, =name=. Any news from Red Rock?

strings.string: 盡情生活與飲酒吧，=name=。有紅岩的消息嗎？

string.ID: Yes. I found the vermin and bits of gnawed watervine. I carry one's corpse with me.

strings.string: 是的。我發現了害蟲和被啃食的水藤碎片。我隨身帶著其中一具屍體。

string.ID: None yet.

strings.string: 尚未有。

string.ID: Live and drink, =name=.

strings.string: 盡情生活與飲酒吧，=name=。

string.ID: Taste what on the wind today, =name=?

strings.string: 今日風中傳來了什麼味道，=name=？

string.ID: Moon and sun, =name=.

strings.string: 月亮與太陽，=name=。

string.ID: I can taste lime, =name=. And mayhaps gallium?

strings.string: 我嚐到了石灰的味道，=name=。或許還有鎵？

string.ID: Aye, the pest-vanquisher! Live and drink, =name=.

strings.string: 啊，害蟲剋星！活下去並盡情暢飲吧，=name=。

string.ID: A waterhand? Aye. Live and drink, traveller.

strings.string: 水手？是的。活下去並盡情飲酒吧，旅人。

string.ID: I am called =name=.

strings.string: 我被稱為 =name=。

string.ID: Can you tell me about your village, Joppa?

strings.string: 你能跟我說說你的村莊，約帕(Joppa) 嗎？

string.ID: I am in search of work.

strings.string: 我在尋找工作。

string.ID: Mehmet, the tongue says. Live and drink, =name=.

strings.string: 「梅赫梅特，」舌頭說道。「活下去並盡情飲用吧，=name=。」

string.ID: Watervine farm in the lap of the marsh. You've sucked the moisture out a vinewafer, yea? We tend the plant here.

strings.string: 在沼澤懷抱中的水藤農場。你吸乾了一張藤蔓薄餅的濕氣，對吧？我們在這裡照料這種植物。

string.ID:
Wind off the Great Desert cools a touch and gives up moisture. Just enough. A tongue can taste a hundred kinds of wind, y'know?
Anywhile, that's where my wandering mind goes. More's about Joppa I say speak to our Elderfriend. Irudad. Up northwise the path.

strings.string:
從大沙漠吹來的風稍微涼爽了一些，並帶有些許濕氣。剛剛好而已。你知道嗎？舌頭可以嚐出上百種不同的風味。
總之，我的思緒就飄到了那裡。關於約帕的事，我建議去跟我們的長老之友伊魯達德談談。路在北邊。

string.ID:
Aye? I have it, then.
Somethin' is eating our watervine, 'round Beetle Moon. Q-ruun says he saw a creature, spider-like, slinking in the brine. But no cave spider would dare get so near Warden's stomps.
I tasted a bit of red fleck in the pool. Shale, like we find in the soil by Red Rock...

strings.string:
是嗎？那我拿到了。
有些東西正在啃食我們在甲蟲月附近的 水藤。Q-ruun 說他看到一個像蜘蛛般的生物，在鹽水中潛行。但沒有任何 洞穴蜘蛛 會敢靠近典獄長的腳步範圍。
我在池中嚐到了一點紅色斑點。是頁岩，就像我們在 紅岩 旁的土壤中發現的那種……

string.ID:
Hike there, will you? To Red Rock. Just about two parasangs north of Joppa.
Kill the vermin and bring one's corpse back, for seein' what it is. Elder will take care to pay you after, waterhand.

strings.string:
去那裡走一趟，好嗎？去 紅岩。就在 約帕(Joppa) 以北大約兩個 帕拉桑 的地方。
殺掉那些害蟲並把屍體帶回來，好讓我們看看是什麼東西。長老會負責在事後付錢給你，水手。

string.ID: I will do as you ask.

strings.string: 我會照你要求的去做。

string.ID: I'm not interested.

strings.string: 我沒興趣。
是啊。

string.ID:
Oh? Oh. {{emote|*Mehmet pauses.*}}
Don't like the look o' that thing. Best bring it to Elder. Hut's northwise up the path.

strings.string:
喔？喔。{{emote|*梅赫梅特 pauses.*}}
我不喜歡那東西的樣子。最好把它帶給長老。小屋在小徑北邊。

string.ID: As you say.

strings.string: 如您所言。
=generic=

string.ID: =player.apparentSpecies=? We are greeted! What do you desire?

strings.string: =player.apparentSpecies=? 我們受到了問候！您有什麼願望？

string.ID: I am =name=. Who are you?

strings.string: 我是 =name=。你是誰？

string.ID: Do you live here?

strings.string: 您住在這裡嗎？

string.ID: What kind of creature are you?

strings.string: 你是哪種生物？

string.ID: I desire nothing. Live and drink.

strings.string: 我別無所求。生存並飲水。

string.ID: It is a pleasure to know this, =player.apparentSpecies= =player.formalAddressTerm= =name=! I am Tam.

strings.string: 能得知這件事真是榮幸，=player.apparentSpecies= =player.formalAddressTerm= =name=! 我是塔姆。

string.ID:
Joppa is my home, yes.
I walked Moghra'yi in the caravans of my brethren and the saltback, but upon meeting Elder Irudad, knew at once to settle down here. You will understand, =player.formalAddressTerm= =player.apparentSpecies=, if you speak to him.

strings.string:
約帕(Joppa) 是我的家，沒錯。
我曾隨同兄弟與鹽背獸（saltback）的商隊穿梭於 莫格拉伊(Moghra'yi)，但在遇見長老 Irudad 後，便立刻知道要在此定居。如果你去跟他談談，你就會明白，=player.formalAddressTerm= =player.apparentSpecies=。

string.ID: I am dromad, =player.apparentSpecies= =player.formalAddressTerm=. Some say saltstrider. Do you know this?

strings.string: 我是 dromad，=player.apparentSpecies= =player.formalAddressTerm=。有人說我叫鹽步者（saltstrider）。你聽說過嗎？

string.ID: I do.

strings.string: 我做。

string.ID: I do not.

strings.string: 我不。

string.ID: My people have walked the salt for thousands of years, meeting every creature that lives and thinks. From Pale Sea to the marsh of Joppa, and under the Hanging Hills, our chests are drawn.

strings.string: 我的族人已在鹽原上行走了數千年，遇見了每一種生存與思考的生物。從蒼白海到 約帕(Joppa) 的沼澤，以及懸掛丘陵之下，我們的胸襟寬廣。

string.ID: =player.apparentSpecies=? We are greeted! What do you desire?

strings.string: =player.apparentSpecies=? 我們受到了問候！您有什麼願望？

string.ID: What kind of creature are you?

strings.string: 你是哪種生物？

string.ID: I desire nothing. Live and drink.

strings.string: 我別無所求。生存並飲水。

string.ID: I am dromad, =player.apparentSpecies= =player.formalAddressTerm=. Some say saltstrider. Do you know this?

strings.string: 我是 dromad，=player.apparentSpecies= =player.formalAddressTerm=。有人說我叫鹽步者（saltstrider）。你聽說過嗎？

string.ID:
Psst!
Hey, can I interest you in some Consortium wares?

strings.string:
噓！
嘿，想看看財團的商品嗎？

string.ID: Welcome a-Joppa, friend. Stay peacelike, and we stay friends, hyeh? You make trouble, it's my work a-split you open like a croc.

strings.string: 歡迎你，a-約帕(Joppa)，朋友。保持和平，我們就是朋友，好嗎？如果你惹麻煩，我的工作就是把你像隻 鱷魚 一樣撕裂。

string.ID: Elder's over my right shoulder, chemist a-left. I ask you pick one or turn around. I en't here for chat.

strings.string: 長老在我右肩後，化學家在左邊。我叫你選一個或轉過身去。我不是來這裡聊天的。

string.ID: Live and drink, yonderling.

strings.string: 活著並盡情暢飲吧，小傢伙。

string.ID: {{emote|*Yrame grunts.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*伊萊姆 咕嚕一聲。*}}

string.ID: {{emote|*Yrame nods.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*伊萊姆點了點頭。*}}

string.ID: What follows, then?

strings.string: 那麼，接下來呢？

string.ID: Got an eyeful, heh?

strings.string: 看得很過癮，嘿？

string.ID: Well. They en't ended you yet.

strings.string: 好吧。他們還沒把你搞定。

string.ID: I must search the Rustwells.

strings.string: 我必須搜尋鏽井（Rustwells）。

string.ID: Mehmet has bade me travel to Red Rock.

strings.string: 梅赫梅特 命我前往 紅岩。

string.ID: I depart for Grit Gate soon.

strings.string: 我很快就要前往礫門了。

string.ID: I journey North, to the Six Day Stilt.

strings.string: 我正向北旅行，前往 六日高蹺(Six Day Stilt)。

string.ID: Who are you?

strings.string: 你是誰？

string.ID: What is a Warden?

strings.string: 什麼是典獄長？

string.ID: Called Yrame, Warden a-Joppa. I kill trouble. Don't be trouble.

strings.string: 叫我伊萊姆，約帕的典獄長。我剷除麻煩。別成為麻煩。

string.ID: Nigh every settlement a-Qud keeps a Warden. We snuff threats to the peace.

strings.string: 幾乎每個 a-卡德(Qud) 的定居點都留有一名守衛。我們會剷除對和平的威脅。

string.ID: Out East? Uegh. Wouldn't go, I. Git ta Qudzu. Like as rust the pauldrons right off a-shoulders.

strings.string: 往東走？呃。我才不去。去 Qudzu 就好。就像鏽蝕掉肩膀上的護肩一樣。

string.ID: Up North? En't far. See them baboons, you put one's light out for me.

strings.string: 往北走？不遠。看到那些狒狒，幫我熄滅其中一個的光芒。

string.ID: Don't say? Well. Fates favor your feet, hyeh.

strings.string: 不說嗎？好吧。命運眷顧你的腳步，嘿。

string.ID: If you don't get dry-roasted by the fire snakes, ought be a time of times. Better hit all the food stalls for samples, hyeh?

strings.string: 如果你沒被火蛇烤乾的話，這應該會是個好時光。最好去所有的食物攤位拿點試吃，嗯？

string.ID: Ahh, there is a new face. I am Nima Ruda, town apothecary. If your feet point to Qud, you'll need some of my wares before you go.

strings.string: 啊，有個新面孔。我是 尼瑪·魯達，城鎮裡的 藥劑師。如果你的腳步正邁向 卡德(Qud)，出發前你可能需要買點我的貨。

string.ID: Live and drink, wayfarer.

strings.string: 活著並盡情飲酒吧，旅人。

string.ID: Time and rest are the surest way to dress a wound, but my wares can help if you're in a hurry.

strings.string: 時間與休息是處理傷口最穩妥的方法，但如果你趕時間，我的商品也能幫上忙。

string.ID: The Fates watch you, =player.formalAddressTerm=.

strings.string: 命運正注視著您，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

string.ID: Don't let your nostrums run dry on the road. I have what you need.

strings.string: 別讓妳的靈藥在路上用盡了。我有妳需要的東西。

string.ID: What wares do you offer?

strings.string: 你提供什麼貨物？

string.ID: Where are you from?

strings.string: 你從哪裡來？

string.ID: Witchwood for pain, bandages for bleeding, yuckwheat and honey for when your guts act up. Coldcaps when I can find them. Why not take a look?

strings.string: 巫術木用於止痛，繃帶用於止血，惡臭麥和蜂蜜用於腸胃不適時。若能找到的話，就帶些冷帽菇。要不要看看？

string.ID: I grew up right here in Joppa, daughter of the Elder and all. Spent some years delving, but gave it up after a few near escapes and nearly deadly wounds. I'm better suited to herbalism anyway, and my father worries less.

strings.string: 我在約帕長大，是長老的女兒。曾花幾年時間在地下探險，但在幾次死裡逃生和幾乎致命的傷勢後就放棄了。反正我更適合草藥學，我父親也比較不擔心。

string.ID: Will you inherit leadership of Joppa from your father?

strings.string: 你會從父親手中繼承 約帕(Joppa) 的領導權嗎？

string.ID: Fates forfend. I would hardly like to lead a village and run a shop at the same time.

strings.string: 命運不允許。我可不想同時領導一個村莊又經營一家商店。

string.ID: Fair enough. Live and drink.

strings.string: 好吧。盡情生活與飲酒吧。

string.ID: Live and drink, traveler. Moist starapples for the road?

strings.string: 活下去並盡情暢飲吧，旅人。要來點濕潤的 星蘋果 路上吃嗎？

string.ID: Mind the trees, =player.formalAddressTerm=. They ain't yours.

strings.string: 留意那些 樹木，=player.formalAddressTerm=。它們不屬於你。

string.ID: Now you keep your eyes off my young, =player.formalAddressTerm=.

strings.string: 現在，把你的眼睛從我的年輕人身上移開，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

string.ID: Can't go wrong with starapples, =player.formalAddressTerm=. Good for what ails ya.

strings.string: 吃星蘋果準沒錯，=player.formalAddressTerm=。對任何小毛病都有療效。

string.ID: You know how to make starapple jam? If not, you can buy it from me.

strings.string: 你知道怎麼做星蘋果果醬嗎？如果不會，可以跟我買。

string.ID: Spread starapple on yer matz! It's proof against thirst and harm alike.

strings.string: 在你的餅乾上抹滿星蘋果！它既能防渴，也能防傷害。

string.ID: See my whiskers? Starapples. They'll boost your virility threefold.

strings.string: 看到我的鬍鬚了嗎？那是星蘋果。它們能讓你的精力提升三倍。

string.ID: Live and drink, traveler. Are you hungry?

strings.string: 盡情生活與飲酒吧，旅人。你餓了嗎？

string.ID: Git ta pig mud. Mud?

strings.string: \n去豬圈泥巴裡吧。泥巴？
嗯？

string.ID: Mind the pig leavins, =player.formalAddressTerm=.

strings.string: 小心豬渣，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

string.ID: Now don't you go breaking my fence.

strings.string: 現在可別弄壞我的籬笆。

string.ID: You best not hurt my critters.

strings.string: 你最好別傷害我的小動物。

string.ID: I en't filthy. I'm muddy. Big difference.

strings.string: 我不是髒亂，我是沾滿泥土。這差別很大。

string.ID: It's get meat here or risk a slugsnout ball in the gut. Your choice, =player.formalAddressTerm=.

strings.string: 要在這裡弄到肉，不然就要冒著肚子裡塞進一顆 蛞蝓鼻 的風險。由您決定，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

string.ID: Good clean meat! Well. Clean as it gets.

strings.string: 好鮮美的肉！嗯，算得上是乾淨了。

string.ID: Moon and sun, =player.formalAddressTerm=.

strings.string: 月亮與太陽，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

string.ID: Now don't you fret. My crabs are docile as dogs.

strings.string: 現在別擔心。我的 螃蟹 跟 狗 一樣溫順。

string.ID: Get close if you like, they don't pinch.

strings.string: 如果你想的話可以靠近點，牠們不會夾人。

string.ID: You ever run into one of these in the wild? The lengths some folks will go for a crab leg!

strings.string: 你曾在野外遇過這種東西嗎？有些人為了隻蟹腿竟然能做到這種地步！

string.ID: I hand-reared each one of these critters. They've had a life of luxury.

strings.string: 這些小生物都是我親手撫養的。它們過著奢侈的生活。

string.ID: Stressed crab means tough crab meat. Buy domesticated meat.

strings.string: 壓力大的螃蟹意味著肉質堅實。買馴化的肉吧。

string.ID: Ain't they precious? Cute little buggers.

strings.string: 他們不是很珍貴嗎？可愛的小傢伙。

string.ID: My crabs are as gentle as can be. Delicious, too.

strings.string: 我的螃蟹非常溫順。而且很好吃。

string.ID: They say we'll all be crabs, eventually.

strings.string: 他們說我們最終都會變成螃蟹。

string.ID: Need something?

strings.string: 需要什麼嗎？
嗯。

string.ID: Sorry bout the smell.

strings.string: 抱歉，味道有點臭。

string.ID: Watch for blood puddles.

strings.string: 留意血泊。

string.ID: No lie, I love my job.

strings.string: 沒騙你，我愛我的工作。

string.ID: Leeches. Blood. If that's what you want, I got what you want.

strings.string: 水蛭、血液。如果你想要那些，我這裡正好有。

string.ID: I feed these critters what blood the ranchers have to spare.

strings.string: 我用牧場主多餘的血來餵養這些小傢伙。

string.ID: Sorry. Lost focus a bit. What do you need?

strings.string: 抱歉。稍微分心了一下。你需要什麼？

string.ID: Blood tastes all right, but I can't fathom living on it.

strings.string: 血液的味道還行，但我無法想像靠它維生。

string.ID: By the Eaters, I'm exhausted. May I help you?

strings.string: 天啊，我累壞了。需要幫忙嗎？

string.ID: Please don't open the gate.

strings.string: 請不要打開大門。

string.ID: I beg you. Do not release the cats.

strings.string: 我求你了。千萬不要放走那隻 貓。

string.ID: I'll buy your shiniest things, if you'll sell them.

strings.string: 如果你願意賣的話，我會買下你最閃亮的東西。

string.ID: I'm a cat herder. My parents were cat herders. Their parents were cat herders, and their parents. I don't understand why we do what we do but it is all I know.

strings.string: 我是一名 牧貓人。我的父母是 牧貓人。他們的父母也是 牧貓人，他們的父母亦然。我不明白我們為何如此行事，但這是我所知的一切。

string.ID: I've a glimmer of light for sale if you need one, wanderer.

strings.string: 流浪者，如果你需要的話，我這裡有微光可以出售。

string.ID: The cats are not for sale.

strings.string: 貓是不出售的。

string.ID: I'm like to faint from this heat.

strings.string: 這熱氣快讓我昏厥了。

string.ID: Mind your footing! Ha ha ha!

strings.string: 小心腳下！哈哈哈！

string.ID: Takes a simple person to tend a simple creature. I don't mind it.

strings.string: 只有單純的人才能照料單純的生物。我不介意。

string.ID: Bless this mess and bless you, =player.formalAddressTerm=.

strings.string: 祝福這片混亂，也祝福你，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

string.ID: What can I do for you? Need slime?

strings.string: 我能為你做什麼？需要黏液嗎？

string.ID: Have you ever taken a swig of slime? It's not half bad!

strings.string: 你喝過黏液嗎？味道其實還不賴！

string.ID: I keep my amoebas happy! Or, you know, whatever they got in place of happy.

strings.string: 我讓我的變形蟲很開心！或者，你知道的，用來代替「開心」的那些感覺。

string.ID: See how their skin glisters in the salt sun? Lovely.

strings.string: 看著他們的皮膚在鹽之陽光下閃爍，多麼美妙。

string.ID: Now don't you dare pop my amoeba.

strings.string: 你敢弄壞我的變形蟲看看。

string.ID: I think I got all the puddles, but watch for slime all the same.

strings.string: 我想我已經清理了所有的水窪，但還是要留意黏液。

string.ID: Step in. Take shelter from the salt.

strings.string: 進來吧。躲避這鹽雨。

string.ID: What mazes and mandalas could be crafted by human hands that hope to surpass what nature wrought eons before our creation?

strings.string: 人類之手若渴望超越萬古前自然所造之物，究竟能打造出怎樣的迷宮與曼陀羅？

string.ID: How sublime, the striations of the snail shell. And such a lovely word, striation.

strings.string: 蝸牛殼上的紋理多麼壯麗。而「紋理」這個詞也真好聽。

string.ID: I think often upon the gyre, from Resheph's gospels. Why do you imagine it is so named?

strings.string: 我經常思考 Resheph 福音中的環流。你認為它為何如此命名？

string.ID: Even in the imperfections of a spiral shell we see the perfection of nature.

strings.string: 即便是在螺旋殼的不完美之中，我們也能看見大自然的完美。

string.ID: My snails aren't so suited to this climate. Some days I spend more water keeping them properly slimy than I make in sales.

strings.string: 我的蝸牛不太適應這種氣候。有些日子我為了讓牠們保持黏糊糊的狀態所消耗的水，比我賣出的貨物賺到的還多。

string.ID: Snails find the spiral of another shell familiar and comforting. Should you wear one, they will look upon you favorably.

strings.string: 蝸牛會覺得另一個螺旋形殼非常熟悉且令人安心。如果你佩戴著它，牠們會對你投以善意的目光。

string.ID: There is kinship from mollusk to mollusk. What secrets do they know that we do not?

strings.string: 軟體動物之間存在著親緣關係。它們知道哪些我們所不知道的秘密？

string.ID: What d'ya want.

strings.string: 你想幹嘛。

string.ID: Goat meat keeps good. Buy some afore you head back to the salt.

strings.string: 羊肉可以保存很久。在回鹽地之前買一些吧。

string.ID: What, you need a menu? I got goat meat and goat jerky.

strings.string: 什麼，你需要菜單嗎？我有山羊肉和山羊乾肉。

string.ID: I hate my goats and they hate me, but we both hate every other body more.

strings.string: 我討厭我的山羊，牠們也討厭我，但我們都更討厭其他所有的軀體。

string.ID: Absolutely miserable weather. Whatcha want?

strings.string: 天氣糟透了。有什麼事嗎？

string.ID: Meat for sale.

strings.string: 肉品出售中。

string.ID: Goats ain't fun to travel with, but they're good protection.

strings.string: 跟山羊一起旅行並不有趣，但牠們是很好的守護者。

string.ID: I didn't ask for this life, but here we are. Wanna buy something?

strings.string: 我並未渴求這種生活，但現狀就是如此。想買點什麼嗎？

string.ID: Some say beetle jerky is too sour. I say, learn to cook!

strings.string: 有人說甲蟲乾太酸了。我說，去學學怎麼煮吧！

string.ID: Look at their chitin! See the sheen? Means they're healthy.

strings.string: 看看他們的幾丁質！看到那層光澤了嗎？這代表牠們很健康。

string.ID: Beetles are fine companions, but don't leave your backpack and your pet beetlebum in the same room.

strings.string: 甲蟲是很好的夥伴，但別把你的背包和你的寵物甲蟲放在同一個房間裡。

string.ID: Nothing wrong with beetle meat. Come, try it.

strings.string: 甲蟲肉沒什麼不好。來，試試看。

string.ID: Beetle jerky holds its own. You learn to appreciate the aftertaste.

strings.string: 甲蟲肉乾也挺不錯的。你會學會欣賞那種回甘。

string.ID: Meat, fresh and preserved alike, all at reasonable prices.

strings.string: 無論是新鮮肉類還是醃製肉類，價格都非常合理。

string.ID: Come to see my beasts? All hale and well-fed, I assure you.

strings.string: 來看看我的野獸嗎？我向你保證，牠們全都壯碩且餵飽了。

string.ID: Live and eat honey.

strings.string: 活著並享用蜂蜜吧。

string.ID: Oh, look. It is a not-bear. Greetings, not-bear.

strings.string: 喔，看啊。是一隻非熊生物。你好，非熊生物。

string.ID: Live and drink, little friend.

strings.string: 活下去，盡情暢飲吧，小友。

string.ID: I would enjoy some honey.

strings.string: 我想要來點蜂蜜。
{{emote|*哼唧聲*}}
{{emote|*吸鼻子*}}
{{emote|*窸窣聲*}}

string.ID: {{emote|*heavy sigh*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*沉重地嘆息*}}
{{emote|*嘆氣*}}

string.ID: Oh my, what a cute not-bear. Greetings, cute not-bear.

strings.string: 喔天哪，多麼可愛的非熊生物。你好啊，可愛的非熊生物。
喔。
唔。

string.ID: Hmm. Oh! Greetings.

strings.string: 嗯。喔！你好。
怎麼了？

string.ID: Excuse me.

strings.string: 失禮了。

string.ID: Oh. Live and drink, not-bear.

strings.string: 喔。活著並盡情暢飲吧，非熊者。

string.ID: I cannot decide which I like best: berries, meat, or honey? I simply cannot decide.

strings.string: 我無法決定我最喜歡哪一種：莓果、肉類，還是蜂蜜？我真的無法決定。

string.ID: Glowfish are not the tastiest food, but they are the prettiest.

strings.string: 發光魚雖然不是最美味的食物，但它們是最漂亮的。

string.ID: I once traveled over a mountain, believing I would see something that I had not seen before once past the summit. I was disappointed to find that the other side of the mountain bore a striking resemblance to the one I'd just left. What is the purpose of mountains?

strings.string: 我曾翻越一座山脈，以為越過巔峰後就能看到前所未見的景象。令我失望的是，山的另一側與我剛離開的那一側驚人地相似。山脈的意義究竟為何？

string.ID: Live and eat honey, bear friend.

strings.string: 活下去並享用蜂蜜吧，熊友。
嗯。
獵物。
嗯嗯嗯嗯。

string.ID: I'm hungry.

strings.string: 我餓了。

string.ID: Live and... be eaten.

strings.string: 生存下去……然後被吃掉。

string.ID: {{emote|*licks lips*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*舔嘴唇*}}
肉。

string.ID: Keep your distance, friend.

strings.string: 保持距離，朋友。

string.ID: {{emote|*nods mutely*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*默默地向你點頭*}}

string.ID: Shh. Listen.

strings.string: 噓。聽著。

string.ID: I am peaceful.

strings.string: 我是和平的。

string.ID: Any dangers?

strings.string: 有危險嗎？

string.ID: {{emote|*ignores you*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*無視你*}}

string.ID: Let's not linger together.

strings.string: 我們別待在一起太久了。

string.ID: May the Eaters gift you.

strings.string: 願噬者賜福予你。

string.ID: Scrap for goods?

strings.string: 用廢料換物資嗎？

string.ID: I might be willing to trade.

strings.string: 我也許願意交易。

string.ID: {{emote|*shakes =pronouns.possessive= head*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*搖了搖 =pronouns.possessive= 頭部*}}

string.ID: {{emote|*puts a finger to =pronouns.possessive= lips*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*將手指放在 =pronouns.possessive= 唇邊*}}

string.ID: I'm armed. Don't try anything.

strings.string: 我身上有武器。別耍花樣。

string.ID: {{emote|*tenses as you approach*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*隨著你的靠近而變得緊繃*}}

string.ID: Found anything good?

strings.string: 有發現什麼好東西嗎？

string.ID: Finders keepers.

strings.string: 得者為王。

string.ID: Lot of good stuff down here. Lots of bad stuff too.

strings.string: 這裡有很多好東西。也有很多壞東西。

string.ID: Live and drink, wayfarer.

strings.string: 活著並盡情飲酒吧，旅人。

啊哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈！

string.ID: ...live and drink.

strings.string: ...活著，而且喝酒。

string.ID: By the sun, you're ugly.

strings.string: 看在太陽的分上，你長得真醜。

string.ID: Pick a direction and walk in it.

strings.string: 選定一個方向並朝那裡走去。

string.ID: What do you want, lack-salt?

strings.string: 你想要什麼，缺鹽鬼？

string.ID: Got nothing to say to a lack-salt.

strings.string: 沒話跟一個缺鹽者說。

string.ID: Keep your eyes moving, lack-salt.

strings.string: 眼睛放亮點，缺鹽鬼。

string.ID: Hey lack-salt. How much water you got? No, don't ever answer that question.

strings.string: 嘿，缺鹽的。你有多少水？不，千萬別回答那個問題。

string.ID: Be respectful of the red-and-white and we will get along.

strings.string: 對紅白兩色保持尊重，我們就能相處融洽。

string.ID: Keep your mouth covered, or the brine air will cure your lungs to jerky.

strings.string: 遮好你的嘴，否則鹹濕的空氣會把你的肺變成肉乾。

string.ID: Stay warm, lack-salt.

strings.string: 保持溫暖，缺鹽者。

string.ID: Stay dry, lack-salt.

strings.string: 保持乾燥，缺鹽的傢伙。

string.ID: Glory to Shekhinah.

strings.string: 榮耀歸於 Shekhinah。

string.ID: Humble before my Fathers, I walk.

strings.string: 在我的父輩面前，我謙卑而行。

string.ID: Live and drink, traveler. Show mercy to a weary pilgrim.

strings.string: 活下去並盡情暢飲吧，旅人。對疲憊的朝聖者展現仁慈吧。

string.ID: Praise be upon Nisroch, who shelters us stiltseekers.

strings.string: 讚美尼斯洛克，祂庇護著我們這些高柱尋求者。

string.ID: Live and drink, traveler.

strings.string: 活著並盡情飲酒吧，行者。

string.ID: Live and drink, wayfarer.

strings.string: 活著並盡情飲酒吧，旅人。

string.ID: Come. Browse my wares, =player.formalAddressTerm=!

strings.string: 來吧。看看我的商品，=player.formalAddressTerm=！

string.ID: I see my wares catch your eye, =player.formalAddressTerm=. They can be yours.

strings.string: 我看見我的商品吸引了您的目光，=player.formalAddressTerm=。它們可以歸您所有。

string.ID: Live and drink, =player.formalAddressTerm=.

strings.string: 盡情生活與飲酒吧，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

string.ID: I have what you need, =player.formalAddressTerm=.

strings.string: =player.formalAddressTerm=，我有你需要的東西。

string.ID: Ah, =player.formalAddressTerm=, thank the Eaters that you have found Qud's only honest shopkeep.

strings.string: 啊，=player.formalAddressTerm=，感謝食者（Eaters）保佑，您找到了卡德的唯一一位誠實店主。

string.ID: On my honor, =player.formalAddressTerm=, my goods are of only the highest quality and I offer a fair trade.

strings.string: 我以名譽擔保，=player.formalAddressTerm=，我的貨物品質極佳，且交易公平。

string.ID: Welcome, traveler.

strings.string: 歡迎你，旅人。

string.ID: Welcome, =player.formalAddressTerm=. How may I serve you today?

strings.string: 歡迎，=player.formalAddressTerm=。今天有什麼可以為您服務的嗎？

string.ID: Do your waterskins grow heavy, =player.formalAddressTerm=?

strings.string: 你的水袋變重了嗎，=player.formalAddressTerm=？

string.ID: =player.FormalAddressTerm=, I beseech you. Enter.

strings.string: =player.FormalAddressTerm=，我懇求您。請進。

string.ID: Buy something, will you?

strings.string: 買點東西吧，好嗎？

string.ID: May you find shade and vittle, =player.formalAddressTerm=.

strings.string: 願你找到陰涼與糧食，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

string.ID: Be quick about it.

strings.string: 動作快點。

string.ID: By the Eaters, have you ever seen so much treasure?

strings.string: 天啊，以吞噬者之名，你見過這麼多的寶藏嗎？

string.ID: Live and drink, traveler. Welcome to the Stilt.

strings.string: 盡情生活與飲酒吧，旅人。歡迎來到高腳木屋。

string.ID: Praise be to Shekhinah! O, sovereign Fathers... at last, I am here!

strings.string: 讚美謝希納！噢，至高無上的父神們……我終於抵達了！

string.ID: This is the Six Day Stilt, huh. It's... colossal, beautiful. I see why the chrome stewards gather here.

strings.string: 這就是「六日高蹺(Six Day Stilt)」嗎，呵。它真...宏偉、壯麗。我明白為什麼鉻色執事會聚集於此了。

string.ID: So... many... folks....
Is it true what they say? That it's a petrified kraken?

strings.string: 傳聞是真的嗎？那是塊石化的克拉肯嗎？

string.ID: What a grand bazaar! What's in each of these tents?

strings.string: 多麼壯觀的市集！這些帳篷裡分別裝著什麼？

string.ID: Live and drink, wardens.

strings.string: 盡情生活與飲酒吧，守衛。

string.ID: You are among friends here, pilgrim. Stay peaceful.

strings.string: 朝聖者，你在這裡如同置身於友人之間。保持和平吧。

string.ID:
Then you're not of the faith =player.reflexive=, huh? Me neither. Do go inside, though. She's a beauty. Got dyed glass high in her rafters, she does. And two marvelous carvings on the wings. Plus a light-sculpture of a god. Hear the sermon, too, as you like. The high priest is persuasive, but not half as persuasive as the cathedral herself. In beauty there is power, you know.
Either way, while you're in the cathedral or on the Stiltgrounds, stay peaceful.

strings.string:
所以你並不屬於 =player.reflexive= 的信仰，哈？我也不是。不過還是去 內部 看看吧。那裡很美。她的椽樑上裝飾著染色玻璃。翅膀上有兩件精美的雕刻。還有一個神靈的光影雕塑。隨你喜好，也可以聽聽佈道。大祭司很有說服力，但遠不及這座大教堂本身。你知道的，美之中蘊含著力量。
無論如何，當你在大教堂或高腳地（Stiltgrounds）時，請保持和平。

string.ID:
Aye, aye. The clamor of it all can overwhelm.
The glowcrows say 'twas a bird-god who taught folks to gather like this, in large flocks. So blame birds.

strings.string:
遵命，遵命。這一切的喧囂確實令人不知所措。
發光烏鴉說，是某位鳥神教會人們要像這樣成群結隊地聚集。所以就把責任推給鳥吧。

string.ID:
Who knows? I've wondered it myself. Sometimes she'll catch my eye, when the moon's silver-bright, and she's there bearing down on the flats.
Whatever she is, she's gigantic. And old. Real old. Way older than the cathedral the Mechanimists built inside her.

strings.string:
誰知道呢？我自己也曾好奇過。有時當月亮銀光閃爍，而她正朝著平原走來時，她會與我目光交會。
無論她是什麼，她都非常巨大。而且很老，真的非常老。比機械主義者在她內部建造的大教堂還要古老得多。

string.ID:
Are you mad? You think I keep a tally of every shopkeeper that steps foot on the Stiltgrounds? They come and go as they please. You've got merchants of all types here. Winesellers, honey hawkers, bookbinders, cobblers.
Have a look around for =player.reflexive=. Following the road around the Stilt. There's tents the whole way round.

strings.string:
妳瘋了嗎？妳以為我會記錄每一個踏足高架地的人嗎？他們隨心所欲地來去。這裡有各種各樣的商人。酒販、蜂蜜小販、裝訂師、鞋匠。
為 =player.reflexive= 四處看看吧。沿著高架地的道路走，沿途到處都是帳篷。

string.ID: Live and learn, wanderer. Have you come across any books or scrolls in your travels? Do you care to donate one to the cathedral library? Whenever you return, you may speak to me and read anything you've donated.

strings.string: 活下去並學習吧，流浪者。你在旅途中有沒有遇到任何書籍或卷軸？你願意捐贈一本給大教堂圖書館嗎？每當你回來時，都可以與我交談，並閱讀你所捐贈的一切。
是的。

string.ID: Where is the library?

strings.string: 圖書館在哪裡？

string.ID: What use is a library in this salt den? Or in the marshes, strangled by wild plants and poisoned by the glow? Wouldn't a stash of vinereapers serve us better?

strings.string: 在這座鹽穴裡，圖書館有什麼用？或者在那些被野植物纏繞、被光芒毒害的沼澤中呢？囤積一些藤收割者（vinereapers）不是對我們更有幫助嗎？

string.ID: Not today. Live and drink, chronicler.

strings.string: 今天不行。活著吧，盡情飲酒吧，編年史家。

string.ID: You imagine they will thrive here at the Stiltgrounds, among the faithful?

strings.string: 你以為他們能在高腳地，在這些信徒之中繁榮發展嗎？

string.ID: I do.

strings.string: 我做。

string.ID: This wouldn't be the first time the Stiltgrounds have hosted refugees, =name=, and make no mistake: it is a burden upon the church, Catechists and Protectors in particular.
