But your words echo loud in our hearts as our hallways. Some in our number will see the slynth as the chosen of chosen, and if I speak to them first, everyone else will take it as Shekhinah's will. Which, arguably, it would be. Tell the slynth that the Mechanimists will have them.

strings.string: 這並不是高架地第一次收容難民，=name=，而且請別誤會：這對教會而言是一項負擔，尤其是對教理學家和保護者而言。但你的話語在我們心中迴盪，如同我們的走廊一般。我們中的某些人會將斯林斯視為天選之選，如果我先與他們交談，其他人就會將其視為謝基納的旨意。可以說，事實也確實如此。告訴斯林斯，機械主義者會接手他們的。

string.ID: You have my thanks, Sheba.

strings.string: 謝謝妳，Sheba。

string.ID: I mean no slight to these slynth folk, =name=, but the Stiltgrounds have hosted refugees before and it is a substantial burden upon our stewards. Our resources and space are scant, and I must request that you find another home for them. May the Kasaphescence shine upon them, and you, in this endeavor.

strings.string: 我並非要輕視這些 斯林斯 人，=name=，但高腳地曾接待過難民，這對我們的管理員來說是沉重的負擔。我們的資源與空間都非常有限，所以我必須請求你為他們另尋家園。願 Kasaphescence 之光照耀他們，也照耀你在這項任務中的努力。

string.ID: =name=, bless you. Have you brought tidings of the slynth?

strings.string: =name=，祝您平安。您帶來了關於斯林斯的的消息嗎？

string.ID:
Praise be to Shekhinah, =name=, your slynth friends are hard workers and quick learners!
I can't help but feel a bit concerned at their ethic, and who in the church might take advantage of it. I hope to foster an interest in reading in them if I can, before they are taught incuriosity. Perhaps a book club?

strings.string:
讚美 謝基納(Shekhinah)，=name=，妳的 斯林斯友人 是勤奮且學習迅速的人！
我不禁對他們的職業道德感到有些擔憂，以及教會中誰可能會利用這一點。如果可以的話，我希望在他們被教導變得缺乏好奇心之前，培養他們對閱讀的興趣。或許辦個讀書會？

string.ID: My thanks, chronicler.

strings.string: 多謝你，編年史家。

string.ID:
Live and learn, =name=.
The slynth are settling in as folk do. I see some flank the Priests and Catechists with empty eye, but some have proven hungry for knowledge. I have established a weekly Canticle study group, and its numbers grow each meeting.
Praise be to Shekhinah for this meeting, =name=.

strings.string:
活到老學到老，=name=。
斯林斯 正像一般人一樣安頓下來。我看到有些人空洞地注視著祭司和教理教師，但也有一些人證明了自己對知識充滿渴望。我建立了一個每週一次的詠唱研究小組，成員人數在每次會議中都在增加。
感謝 Shekhinah 促成了這次會面，=name=。

string.ID: My thanks again, chronicler.

strings.string: 再次感謝您，編年史家。

string.ID: Oh, we're in but the first phase of its foundation. The church has amassed a splendid collection of scripts through the years. Glorious Shekhinah, praise be upon Him, gifted us with several caches. The eremites work day and night reproducing them in the scriptorium, and I have taken it upon myself to beseech travelers, for the rarest finds often come from the least likely places.

strings.string: 噢，我們才剛進入建設的第一階段。多年來，教會累積了大量精彩的經卷。榮耀的謝希納（Shekhinah）——讚美歸於祂——賜予了我們好幾處藏寶點。隱修者們在抄寫室日以繼夜地複製這些經卷，而我則自薦去懇求旅人，因為最罕見的發現往往來自最意想不到的地方。

string.ID: I will donate a book.

strings.string: 我要捐贈一本書。

string.ID: What use is a library in this salt den? Or in the marshes, strangled by wild plants and poisoned by the glow? Wouldn't a stash of vinereapers serve us better?

strings.string: 在這座鹽穴裡，圖書館有什麼用？或者在那些被野植物纏繞、被光芒毒害的沼澤中呢？囤積一些藤收割者（vinereapers）不是對我們更有幫助嗎？

string.ID: Live and drink, chronicler.

strings.string: 活著並盡情暢飲吧，編年史家。

string.ID:
You share the pessimism of my kin, and several of the priests as well. My heart hears you, but listen to my words, and maybe you will come to feel as I do.
To devalue wisdom is to devalue the Kasaphescence. She shines in the void, refracting light, illuminating those around her. So does the written wisdom of our elders.
The machinery of chromium is complex in its divinity. Don't we do a disservice to our Fathers when we remain ignorant of it, of our past, of our future? Don't we deserve the joy of knowing? Bless Eschelstadt II, first Child, for he believes as I do.

strings.string:
你和我同胞的悲觀主義一樣，幾位祭司也是如此。我的心能聽見你的聲音，但請聽我的話，也許你會產生與我相同的感受。
貶低智慧就是貶低卡薩菲森斯（Kasaphescence）。她在虛空中閃耀，折射光線，照亮周圍的人。我們長輩的書面智慧亦是如此。
鉻合金的機械結構在其神聖性中極其複雜。當我們對它、對我們的過去、對我們的未來一無所知時，難道不是對我們的父輩們造成了損害嗎？難道我們不配擁有知曉的喜悅嗎？祝福艾舍爾施塔特 II，長子，因為他的信仰與我一致。

string.ID: I will donate a book.

strings.string: 我要捐贈一本書。

string.ID: Where is the library?

strings.string: 圖書館在哪裡？

string.ID: Live and drink, chronicler.

strings.string: 活著並盡情暢飲吧，編年史家。

string.ID: Peace and health in the light of the Star, pilgrim. Brood with me on the life of Resheph, if you are willing.

strings.string: 願星光為您帶來和平與健康，朝聖者。若您願意，請與我一同沉思雷舍夫（Resheph）的一生。

string.ID: I am.

strings.string: 我存在。

string.ID: Who is Resheph?

strings.string: 雷舍夫(Resheph) 是誰？

string.ID: What's inside the tent?

strings.string: 帳篷的內部是什麼？

string.ID: Live and drink, priest.

strings.string: 生存與飲酒吧，祭司。

string.ID:
A spiritual patron of kith and kin, who did so much for us, and who leads me and others like me to the path of healing. For, above all, he was a healer. He dressed the wounds of the sick and rid the land of the plagues of the Gyre.
He was also a sultan, but he was the last sultan. He unbricked the walls of monocracy so we could pick berries in the orchards they hid.

strings.string:
他是族群與親眷的精神贊助者，為我們付出了許多，並引領我和像我一樣的人走向療癒之路。因為，最重要的是，他是一位醫者。他包紮病人的傷口，並清除土地上環流 的瘟疫。
他也是一位蘇丹，但他是最後一位蘇丹。他拆毀了獨裁統治的圍牆，好讓我們能在那些牆壁所隱藏的果園裡採摘漿果。

string.ID: I've more to ask.

strings.string: 我還有更多問題要問。

string.ID: Live and drink, priest.

strings.string: 生存與飲酒吧，祭司。

string.ID:
A quiet shrine to the Coiled Lamb, centuries old. Tucked away here, outside the marble parapets and cloaked in the dust of time, it's lost to those who'd sneer at the veneration of Resheph over other fathers.
Step inside and voice a prayer, if you are willing.

strings.string:
一座供奉給捲曲羔羊（Coiled Lamb）的寧靜 神龕，已有數百年歷史。它隱藏於此，在大理石女兒牆之外，籠罩在時間的塵埃中，對於那些會對崇拜 Resheph 而非其他父親之舉嗤之以鼻的人來說，它是失落的存在。
如果你願意，請 內部 一步並低聲祈禱。

string.ID: I've more to ask.

strings.string: 我還有更多問題要問。

string.ID: Live and drink, priest.

strings.string: 生存與飲酒吧，祭司。

string.ID: Don't breathe in too deep, =player.formalAddressTerm=, I've set some glue to dry.

strings.string: 別吸得太深，=player.formalAddressTerm=，我放了一些膠水正在乾燥。

string.ID: Live and drink, but please do it elsewhere. I fear spills.

strings.string: 儘管生活與飲酒，但請去別處。我擔心弄灑了。

string.ID: Greetings, =player.formalAddressTerm=. Feel free to examine my books closely.

strings.string: 問候您，=player.formalAddressTerm=。請隨意仔細查看我的書籍。

string.ID: Please inspect only the quality of the letters. I am not a librarian.

strings.string: 請只檢查字體的品質。我不是圖書管理員。

string.ID: These books can weather the salt and jungle alike.

strings.string: 這些書無論是面對鹽分還是叢林都能經久耐用。

string.ID: I assure you, the smell fades once the glue is dry.

strings.string: 我向你保證，膠水乾了之後味道就會消失。

string.ID: I've books for trade, if you're interested.

strings.string: 我有書可以交易，如果你感興趣的話。

string.ID: Everything I sell is the product of many hours of toil.

strings.string: 我所販售的一切，都是經過無數小時辛勤勞作的成果。

string.ID: Come closer, so I can see your face.

strings.string: 靠近點，好讓我看清你的臉。

string.ID: Ink runs in my very veins, =player.formalAddressTerm=.

strings.string: 墨水在我的血管中流淌，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

string.ID: If you're looking to read, I have what you need.

strings.string: 如果你想找書讀，我有你需要的東西。

string.ID: Please be gentle with the parchment.

strings.string: 請對這份羊皮紙溫柔一點。

string.ID: Do be quick, =player.formalAddressTerm=, as I've much work to do.

strings.string: 請動作快點，=player.formalAddressTerm=，因為我有許多工作要做。

string.ID: Live and drink, reader.

strings.string: 生存與飲酒吧，讀者。

string.ID: Come here. No, closer. Don't mind the bees, they rarely sting.

strings.string: 過來這裡。不，再靠近一點。別在意那些蜜蜂，牠們很少螫人。

string.ID: Don't be afraid to approach. The bees rarely sting.

strings.string: 別害怕靠近。蜜蜂很少會螫人。

string.ID: Care for some beejuice?

strings.string: 要來點蜂汁嗎？

string.ID: Drink a dram of honey every morning, Slog itself couldn't make you sick.

strings.string: 每天早上喝一小杯蜂蜜，就算 斯洛格 本身也讓你生不了病。

string.ID: You know, bees communicate by dancing. Got a whole language.

strings.string: 你知道嗎，蜜蜂是透過跳舞來溝通的。有一套完整的語言。

string.ID: Without bees, all life in Qud would eventually die.

strings.string: 如果沒有蜜蜂，卡德的所有生命最終都會枯竭。

string.ID: Bees are smarter than you think. They got that hive mind, see.

strings.string: 蜜蜂比你想像的要聰明。牠們擁有集體意識，明白嗎。

string.ID: I eat honey matz every morning and I ain't been sick in decades.

strings.string: 我每天早上都吃蜂蜜瑪札（honey matz），幾十年來都沒生過病。

string.ID: We'd all be dead without bees, you know.

strings.string: 你知道的，要是沒有蜜蜂，我們全都得死。

string.ID: Use your gadgets hard, don't you? I can fix them.

strings.string: 你很常使用你的小玩意兒吧？我可以修理它們。

string.ID: I can repair, recharge, and identify whatever you have! Within reason.

strings.string: 我可以修理、充電並鑑定你擁有的任何東西！只要在合理範圍內。

string.ID: If you've got anything you can't make heads or tails of it, give it here.

strings.string: 如果你有任何搞不清楚頭緒的東西，就把它交給我吧。

string.ID: You've got to respect a machine. Machines bite harder than any croc.

strings.string: 你必須尊重機器。機器的咬合力比任何 鱷魚 都還要強烈。

string.ID: You a maker?

strings.string: 你是製造者嗎？

string.ID: Take out what you've busted and I'll jury-rig it for a fair price.

strings.string: 把你弄壞的東西拿出來，我會以合理的價格幫你修好它。

string.ID: Need scrap?

strings.string: 需要廢料嗎？

string.ID: You get used to the nicks and burns, after years working with spark and solder.

strings.string: 在與火花和焊錫打交道的多年後，你已經習慣了那些劃痕與灼傷。

string.ID: They say some folks can talk to machines. I say we all can, if we listen right.

strings.string: 他們說有些人能與機器對話。我說我們都能，只要聽法正確。

string.ID: My fees for battery charging depend how empty the battery is when you bring it to me.

strings.string: 我收取的電池充電費用，取決於你把電池拿來時的電量剩餘多少。

string.ID: Absolutely no refunds or returns on scrap.

strings.string: 廢料一律不退款，也不接受退貨。

string.ID: I would prefer not to interrupt this task long.

strings.string: 我不想耽擱這項任務太久。

string.ID: How my joints ache! Buy something to justify my pain.

strings.string: 我的關節好痛！買點東西來補償我的痛苦吧。

string.ID: Unfinished schematics are obviously not for sale. Everything else is.

strings.string: 未完成的設計圖顯然是不出售的。其他的都賣。

string.ID: Disturb the trash if you must, but do not touch any of my papers.

strings.string: 如果你一定要的話，隨便你翻弄垃圾，但別碰我的任何文件。

string.ID: Are you a tinker? Surely I have something you wish to build.

strings.string: 你是修補匠嗎？我肯定有你想建造的東西。

string.ID: If you've the wits to build, I've got something you want.

strings.string: 如果你有建造的智慧，我就有你想要的東西。

string.ID: I have lost much to my dedication. Help me gain anew, =player.formalAddressTerm=.

strings.string: 我因我的奉獻而失去了許多。請幫我重新獲得，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

string.ID: So help me, Argent Fathers, if someone has changed the order of my papers...

strings.string: 願銀父們保佑我，如果有人動過我的文件順序的話……

string.ID: Please, =player.formalAddressTerm=, buy a schematic. I'm sure it will be of use to you.

strings.string: 請買份設計圖吧，=player.formalAddressTerm=。我相信它對您會有幫助的。

string.ID: Even if you can't make a thing now, you could gain the insight later.

strings.string: 即使你現在無法製作某樣東西，之後也可以獲得相關的見解。

string.ID: I've the cure for what ails you.

strings.string: 我有能治癒你病痛的方法。

string.ID: You don't look so good. You need more yuckwheat and honey in your diet.

strings.string: 你看起來不太好。你的飲食中需要攝取更多惡臭麥和蜂蜜。

string.ID: In the market for a tonic, =player.formalAddressTerm=? Spend water now or blood later, your choice.

strings.string: 正在尋找補藥嗎，=player.formalAddressTerm=? 現在花水錢，以後才不用流血，隨你選擇。

string.ID: Prickly-boons and yuckwheat for trade.

strings.string: 交易品為刺果與 惡臭麥。

string.ID: Cook your meals with yuckwheat if you feel sick. Catch a disease early enough and you can kill it.

strings.string: 如果你覺得不舒服，就用惡臭麥來煮飯吧。及早發現疾病，你就能將其擊殺。

string.ID: If you came for the humble pie, you had best not have led any mind-hunters here.

strings.string: 如果你是為了謙卑派而來，最好不要帶任何心靈獵人到這裡。

string.ID: "Ease the pain, addle the brain." Be careful when you chew witchwood bark.

strings.string: 「緩解痛苦，混淆心智。」咀嚼女巫木皮時要小心。

string.ID: Don't eat the hoarshrooms too fast, now.

strings.string: 嘿，別吃太快那些霜菇。

string.ID: Have you got enough tonics?

strings.string: 你的補劑夠用嗎？

string.ID: Got a fungal infection? You'll want one of my spray bottles to apply the cure.

strings.string: 得了真菌感染？你會需要一個我的噴霧瓶來塗抹治療藥劑。

string.ID: Get your hands on the Corpus Choliys for disease and fungus cures.

strings.string: 去弄到 科普斯·喬利斯(Corpus Choliys)，用來治療疾病和真菌。

string.ID: I've the cure for what ails you.

strings.string: 我有能治癒你病痛的方法。

string.ID: You don't look so good. You need more yuckwheat and honey in your diet.

strings.string: 你看起來不太好。你的飲食中需要攝取更多惡臭麥和蜂蜜。

string.ID: Cook your meals with yuckwheat if you feel sick. Catch a disease early enough and you can kill it.

strings.string: 如果你覺得不舒服，就用惡臭麥來煮飯吧。及早發現疾病，你就能將其擊殺。

string.ID: "Ease the pain, addle the brain." Be careful when you chew witchwood bark.

strings.string: 「緩解痛苦，混淆心智。」咀嚼女巫木皮時要小心。

string.ID: Best not leave town without some bark and bandages, wayfarer.

strings.string: 旅人，最好別在沒帶些樹皮和 繃帶的情況下離開城鎮。

string.ID: Live and drink. Keeping well, I hope?

strings.string: 生存並飲水。希望你一切安好？

string.ID: How are you feeling today, =player.formalAddressTerm=?

strings.string: 您今天感覺如何，=player.formalAddressTerm=？

string.ID: Moon and sun, =player.formalAddressTerm=. Keeping healthy?

strings.string: 月亮與太陽，=player.formalAddressTerm=。保持健康嗎？

string.ID: I tell you, =player.formalAddressTerm=, my recipes come from years of experience. There's none the like.

strings.string: 我告訴你，=player.formalAddressTerm=，我的配方來自多年的經驗。無人能及。

string.ID: Finest food for parasangs! Finest food in Qud! Recipes and samples!

strings.string: 給帕拉桑（parasangs）最頂級的食物！卡德最頂級的食物！食譜與樣品！

string.ID: I will share my food-secrets with you, =player.formalAddressTerm=, if you're willing to make it worth my while.

strings.string: =player.formalAddressTerm=，如果你願意讓這件事值得我出手，我就會與你分享我的美食秘訣。

string.ID: Do you cook, =player.formalAddressTerm=? So long as you aren't the type to throw whatever local debris you find in the pot, I have wares for you.

strings.string: =player.formalAddressTerm=? 您會下廚嗎？只要您不是那種把隨處撿到的在地碎屑都丟進鍋子裡的類型，我這裡就有您需要的貨物。

string.ID: Not a word of lie, I studied under a chef who studied under Agate Severance Star herself. That's why my recipes are the best.

strings.string: 絕非謊言，我曾師從一位 廚師，而那位 廚師又是師從 瑪瑙斷裂之星(Agate Severance Star) 本人。這就是為什麼我的食譜是最好的。

string.ID: Try my recipe. You'll believe =player.reflexive= to be judging the Carbide Chefs in the Kitchen Heptagon itself.

strings.string: 試試我的食譜。你會發現 =player.reflexive= 簡直是在對著廚房七角形裡的碳化物 廚師 本身進行品評。

string.ID: Cookbooks are best named from the heart. Those who ridicule the name of a cookbook have lost their sense of wonder.

strings.string: 食譜 最好從心底命名。那些嘲笑 食譜 名稱的人，已經失去了他們對奇蹟的感知力。

string.ID: Live and eat, =player.formalAddressTerm=.

strings.string: 生存並進食吧，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

string.ID: Live and drink, =player.formalAddressTerm=.

strings.string: 盡情生活與飲酒吧，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

string.ID: Smell a bit strong? That's how you know it's good.

strings.string: 味道有點重嗎？這正是好貨的證明。

string.ID: You can preserve almost anything. Al... most.

strings.string: 你幾乎可以保存任何東西。幾...乎可以。

string.ID: Preserved ingredients cook better, safer.

strings.string: 保存過的食材煮起來更好吃，也更安全。

string.ID: Everything I sell is safe to eat as it is.

strings.string: 我賣的所有東西都可以直接食用，非常安全。

string.ID: Welcome, =player.formalAddressTerm=. Need vittle?

strings.string: 歡迎，=player.formalAddressTerm=。需要食物嗎？

string.ID: Crave a bit of salt, =player.formalAddressTerm=, or a load of salt?

strings.string: =player.formalAddressTerm=，想要來點鹽，還是要一大堆鹽？

string.ID: Nothing sadder than a cookfire and nothing to cook over it.

strings.string: 沒有比營火更令人悲哀的，也沒有比沒東西可以烤更讓人沮喪的。

string.ID: Are you a chef, =player.formalAddressTerm=? My vittles are of the highest quality.

strings.string: 您是一位廚師嗎，=player.formalAddressTerm=？我的食物品質是最高等級的。

string.ID: Nourishment for the road, =player.formalAddressTerm=?

strings.string: =player.formalAddressTerm=，這是旅途中的補給品。

string.ID: Greetings, =player.formalAddressTerm=.

strings.string: 問候您，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

string.ID: Live and drink deeply, =player.formalAddressTerm=.

strings.string: 盡情生活與暢飲吧，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

string.ID: Ah, =player.formalAddressTerm=, please come in.

strings.string: 啊，=player.formalAddressTerm=，請進。

string.ID: My wares are sweet and strong, =player.formalAddressTerm=. Care to try them?

strings.string: 我的貨物香甜且醇厚，=player.formalAddressTerm=。要試試看嗎？

string.ID: Tell me, =player.formalAddressTerm=, is there any sight more sad than a hookah tent without wine?

strings.string: 告訴我，=player.formalAddressTerm=，還有什麼景象比沒有酒的 水煙壺 帳篷更令人悲傷嗎？

string.ID: Wine, cheese, bread. =player.FormalAddressTerm=, tell me, is there anything else you truly need?

strings.string: 葡萄酒、起司、麵包。=player.FormalAddressTerm=，告訴我，還有什麼是您真正需要的嗎？

string.ID: The kipper and I both know that the finest ingredient is time.

strings.string: 鯡魚和我都知道，最頂級的食材就是時間。

string.ID: Greetings, =player.formalAddressTerm=. Try some rose wine? One rose is fair, but as you may know from hanging around the Stiltgrounds, five is death.

strings.string: 問候，=player.formalAddressTerm=。要來點玫瑰酒嗎？喝一杯還算合理，但正如你在高腳地（Stiltgrounds）周旋時所知，喝五杯就是送命。
液體...

string.ID: Aren't they beautiful, =player.formalAddressTerm=? The bottles, the phials, the light shining through them.

strings.string: 它們很美，不是嗎，=player.formalAddressTerm=？那些 瓶子、小瓶，還有透射其中的光芒。

string.ID: Live and drink, but not everything. Some things you don't drink.

strings.string: 活著並盡情飲用，但並非所有東西都能喝。有些東西是不該入口的。

string.ID: Is there any state of form so fine as a liquid?

strings.string: 還有比液態更完美的狀態嗎？

string.ID: Pouring, decanting, collecting, mixing. I adore my calling.

strings.string: 傾倒、分裝、收集、混合。我熱愛我的天職。

string.ID: If it flows, I desire it. You should too, =player.formalAddressTerm=.

strings.string: 如果它流動，我就渴望它。你也應該如此，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

string.ID: Do you ever stop and think about fluids? Are they not divine?

strings.string: 你是否曾停下來思考過液體？難道它們不是神聖的嗎？

string.ID: Someday I will plumb the depths of Bethesda Susa, that I may meet the Alchemist.

strings.string: 總有一天我會深入探尋貝賽達蘇薩的深處，好讓我能遇見煉金術士。

string.ID: Live and drink, and collect, and combine...

strings.string: 盡情生活、飲酒、收集，還有組合……

string.ID: Hold, aristocrat! I have wares to claim your interest.

strings.string: 等等，貴族！我有能引起您興趣的貨物。

string.ID: My implants are acquired peaceably, I assure you.

strings.string: 我向您保證，我的植入物都是和平取得的。

string.ID: How becoming you look, Aristocrat! But you could be more becoming.

strings.string: 你看起來真體面，貴族！但你可以變得更體面。

string.ID: Tire of your legs? Arms? Hands? See what I have that fits you.

strings.string: 覺得你的腿累了嗎？手臂？雙手？看看我有什麼適合你。

string.ID: Luxury internal adornments for the discerning Aristocrat.

strings.string: 為眼光敏銳的貴族準備的奢華內部裝飾。

string.ID: No additional sterilisation required, of course.

strings.string: 當然，不需要額外的消毒程序。

string.ID: Quality implants for sale at reasonable prices!

strings.string: 優質植入物，價格公道！

string.ID: You strike me as an Aristocrat who knows the value of artisanal organs.

strings.string: 你給我的感覺像是一位懂得手工器官價值的貴族。

string.ID: I recommend everything I carry. Not all at once, of course.

strings.string: 我推薦我攜帶的所有物品。當然，不是一次全部推薦。

string.ID: Hope you'll "becoming" back, ha ha.

strings.string: 希望你會「歸來」，哈哈。

string.ID: Live and drink, Aristocrat.

strings.string: 活著並盡情暢飲吧，貴族。

string.ID: Kill anyone valuable?

strings.string: 要殺掉任何有價值的人嗎？

string.ID: You look dangerous. Ever go hunting for parts?

strings.string: 你看起來很危險。曾去獵取零件嗎？

string.ID: Got guts?

strings.string: 有膽量嗎？

string.ID: Can you imagine sticking one of these things inside you? Disgusting.

strings.string: 你能想像把這東西塞進你的 內部 嗎？真噁心。

string.ID: I've plenty water if you've got implants to sell.

strings.string: 如果你有植入物要賣，我有充足的水。

string.ID: Always check becoming nook shelves for parts.

strings.string: 務必檢查 蛻變角落 的架子以尋找零件。

string.ID: Y'ain't peeled open any Sons or Daughters, have you?

strings.string: 你還沒剝開過任何子嗣（Sons or Daughters）吧？

string.ID: Less I know about where my stock comes from, the better.

strings.string: 我對我的貨源來源知道得越少，就越好。

string.ID: I'll still take parts you ain't washed off, it's fine.

strings.string: 就算你身上沒洗乾淨的零件我也收，沒關係。

string.ID: If you can butcher a boar, you can do the same to a man. Just ain't meat you're looking for.

strings.string: 如果你能屠宰野豬，你也能對人做同樣的事。只是你尋找的不僅僅是肉而已。

string.ID: My best customers don't ask questions. My best stock asked too many.

strings.string: 我最好的顧客從不問問題。我最好的貨物卻問得太多了。

string.ID: Need something to complete your ensemble, =player.formalAddressTerm=?

strings.string: 需要一些東西來完善你的裝束嗎，=player.formalAddressTerm=？

string.ID: With a good hat, =player.formalAddressTerm=, you'll last longer in the salt sun.

strings.string: 戴上好帽子，=player.formalAddressTerm=，你在鹽之陽光下才能撐得更久。

string.ID: Peruse my wares, =player.formalAddressTerm=. Adorn your head or heads.

strings.string: 請瀏覽我的商品，=player.formalAddressTerm=。裝飾你的頭部或多個頭部吧。

string.ID: Greetings, =player.formalAddressTerm=. Care for a new topper?

strings.string: 問候您，=player.formalAddressTerm=。想來個新的帽飾嗎？

string.ID: You need a new hat, =player.formalAddressTerm=. Or a helmet, if that's the life you lead.

strings.string: 你需要一頂新帽子，=player.formalAddressTerm=。或者如果你過著那種生活，也需要一個 頭盔。

string.ID: If you're passing through baboon country, you'll want to protect your head, =player.formalAddressTerm=.

strings.string: 如果你要經過狒狒領地，你得保護好你的頭，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

string.ID: Live and drink, =player.formalAddressTerm=.

strings.string: 盡情生活與飲酒吧，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

string.ID: Hello, hello, =player.formalAddressTerm=, let's get your weary feet covered.

strings.string: 哈囉，哈囉，=player.formalAddressTerm=，來讓你的雙腳不再疲憊吧。

string.ID: Come in, =player.formalAddressTerm=, and let me 'shoe' you around, ha ha!

strings.string: 進來吧，=player.formalAddressTerm=，讓我帶你四處「巡視」一下，哈哈！

string.ID: Boots! Shoes! Slippers! Sabatons! How would you prefer to cover your feet, =player.formalAddressTerm=?

strings.string: 靴子！鞋子！拖鞋！重型足甲！您想如何遮蓋您的雙腳，=player.formalAddressTerm=？

string.ID: Even as high-quality as my products are, =player.formalAddressTerm=, I don't suggest you go walking in the fracti to test them out.

strings.string: 即便我的產品品質再高，=player.formalAddressTerm=，我也不建議您去 裂縫 裡走動來測試它們。

string.ID: Anything you need to ask 'a boot', =player.FormalAddressTerm=? Just a little cobbler's joke, there.

strings.string: 有什麼想問「靴子」的嗎，=player.FormalAddressTerm=? 只是個鞋匠的小玩笑罷了。

string.ID: Hot sands out there, =player.formalAddressTerm=. Is your footwear protecting you?

strings.string: 外面的沙子很燙，=player.formalAddressTerm=。你的鞋子有保護到你嗎？

string.ID: Hello, =player.formalAddressTerm=! Care to be shod?

strings.string: 您好，=player.formalAddressTerm=! 有興趣穿上鞋子嗎？

string.ID: Walk a few parasangs in my shoes, =player.formalAddressTerm=, and you'll wonder how you ever did otherwise.

strings.string: =player.formalAddressTerm=，若你能設身處地替我走幾段路，你就會納悶以前自己到底是怎麼活過來的。

string.ID: Live and drink, =player.formalAddressTerm=.

strings.string: 盡情生活與飲酒吧，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

string.ID: Please, =player.formalAddressTerm=, do come in. Take your time browsing my wares.

strings.string: 請進，=player.formalAddressTerm=。慢慢挑選我的商品吧。

string.ID: Welcome, =player.formalAddressTerm=, to the sole bastion of class in this wretched place.

strings.string: 歡迎，=player.formalAddressTerm=，來到這片悲慘之地中唯一保有格調的堡壘。

string.ID: Please knock the sand from your feet, =player.formalAddressTerm=. It gets everywhere.

strings.string: 請拍掉腳上的沙子，=player.formalAddressTerm=。它們會沾得到處都是。

string.ID: Ah, =player.formalAddressTerm=, I can certainly help you.

strings.string: 啊，=player.formalAddressTerm=，我當然可以幫您。

string.ID: How may I clothe you, =player.formalAddressTerm=?

strings.string: 我該如何為您提供衣物，=player.formalAddressTerm=？

string.ID: Now, =player.formalAddressTerm=, I know you must have an eye for fashion, if you're here.

strings.string: 那麼，=player.formalAddressTerm=，既然你來了這裡，我想你一定對時尚很有眼光。

string.ID: Oh dear. Who dressed you, =player.formalAddressTerm=? Let me help you, please.

strings.string: 喔天哪。是誰把你穿成這樣的，=player.formalAddressTerm=? 請讓我幫您。

string.ID: Live and drink, =player.formalAddressTerm=.

strings.string: 盡情生活與飲酒吧，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

string.ID: {{emote|*silent nod*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*默默點頭*}}

string.ID: Careful. It's hot.

strings.string: 小心。這很燙。

string.ID: =player.FormalAddressTerm=. Need protection?

strings.string: =player.FormalAddressTerm=. 需要保護嗎？

string.ID: Be quick about it, eh?

strings.string: 動作快點，好嗎？
問候。
嗯？

string.ID: I've got my eye on you.

strings.string: 我正盯著你呢。

string.ID: Leather, ring, and plate, to keep you alive.

strings.string: 皮革、指環與板甲，能讓你保命。

string.ID: Don't get near the hearth.

strings.string: 別靠近壁爐。

string.ID: =player.FormalAddressTerm=. Live and drink.

strings.string: =player.FormalAddressTerm=。盡情生活與飲酒吧。

string.ID: Hand-coats for sale! Spare your digits the indignity of early removal!

strings.string: 手套出售中！別讓你的手指遭受過早脫落的屈辱！

string.ID: Best protect your hands, =player.formalAddressTerm=. You don't know how much you need them until a madpole takes one.

strings.string: 最好保護好你的雙手，=player.formalAddressTerm=。在被 瘋狂池鼠 奪走其中一隻之前，你不會知道它們有多重要。

string.ID: Light gloves, heavy gloves, gauntlets. Don't let your hands go bare, =player.formalAddressTerm=.

strings.string: 輕手套、重手套、護手。別讓您的雙手赤裸著，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

string.ID: One size fits all, =player.formalAddressTerm=. If I sell it to you, it fits.

strings.string: 尺寸通用，=player.formalAddressTerm=。只要我賣給你，就一定合身。

string.ID: How do I get my gloves so supple? I'll never tell.

strings.string: 我該如何讓我的 手套 如此柔軟？我永遠不會告訴你。

string.ID: Moving on soon, =player.formalAddressTerm=? My gloves and gauntlets need no maintenance, so finely are they crafted.

strings.string: 很快就要繼續前進了，=player.formalAddressTerm=? 我的 手套 與護手不需要維護，它們的工藝是如此精湛。

string.ID: Live and eat, =player.formalAddressTerm=.

strings.string: 生存並進食吧，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

string.ID: Live and drink, =player.formalAddressTerm=.

strings.string: 盡情生活與飲酒吧，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

string.ID: You can't go wrong with my slugspitters, =player.formalAddressTerm=.

strings.string: =player.formalAddressTerm=，我的蛞蝓噴吐者絕不會讓你失望。

string.ID: Guns, guns, guns! Don't they just make you smile?

strings.string: 槍、槍、槍！難道它們不會讓你露出笑容嗎？

string.ID: =player.FormalAddressTerm=, I tell you: there is no defense like a good, and distant, offense.

strings.string: =player.FormalAddressTerm=，我告訴你：沒有什麼防禦比主動且遠程的進攻更有效了。

string.ID: Ahh, I love the smell of cordite. You know, that sulfury smell? Accelerants make a fine perfume, if you ask me.

strings.string: 啊，我好喜歡硝石的味道。你知道嗎，就是那種硫磺味？依我看，助燃劑可是很棒的香水。

string.ID: You know, =player.formalAddressTerm=, I once had an traveler from Yawningmoon tell me my shop smelled of home. Now I want to visit! Hah!

strings.string: 你知道嗎，=player.formalAddressTerm=，我曾有個來自雅溫蒙的旅人告訴我，我的店聞起來有家的味道。現在我想去看看！哈哈！

string.ID: May you find adequate cover and more loot than you can carry, =player.formalAddressTerm=.

strings.string: 願你能找到充足的掩護，並獲得多到拿不下的戰利品，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

string.ID: I used to be a wayfarer like you, =player.formalAddressTerm=, but old wounds slow you down. Cherish the time while you have it.

strings.string: =player.formalAddressTerm=，我也曾像你一樣是個旅人，但舊傷會拖慢你的腳步。趁現在還來得及，好好珍惜這段時光。

string.ID: I wish I could allow you to test my wares in the shop, =player.formalAddressTerm=, but walk a parasang in any direction and you'll find a target.

strings.string: 我真希望能在店裡讓 =player.formalAddressTerm= 您試用我的商品，但只要往任何方向走上一個帕桑格的距離，您就會發現目標。

string.ID: Might not want to touch anything on the workbenches, =player.formalAddressTerm=.

strings.string: 可能最好不要碰工作台上的任何東西，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

string.ID: Live, drink, and shoot, =player.formalAddressTerm=, in whichever order you like.

strings.string: 活下去、飲酒、開火，=player.formalAddressTerm=，隨你喜歡的順序。

string.ID: Need something blown up, =player.formalAddressTerm=?

strings.string: 需要炸掉什麼東西嗎，=player.formalAddressTerm=？

string.ID: Grenades do no good sitting in a pack. Don't forget to use them.

strings.string: 手榴彈放在背包裡沒什麼用。別忘了使用它們。

string.ID: =player.FormalAddressTerm=, there is little you can't solve with a well-thrown grenade... as long as you don't stand too close.

strings.string: =player.FormalAddressTerm=，只要不站得太近，幾乎沒有什麼問題是扔一顆手榴彈解決不了的……

string.ID: Defoliant and fungicide are perfectly safe, but you may wish to avoid breathing too deeply all the same.

strings.string: 除葉劑和殺真菌劑非常安全，不過建議還是別吸得太深。

string.ID: Can I serve you something explosive, =player.formalAddressTerm=?

strings.string: 我可以為您提供一些具爆炸性的東西嗎，=player.formalAddressTerm=？

string.ID: You'll be back, =player.formalAddressTerm=, provided you don't blow =player.reflexive= up.

strings.string: =player.formalAddressTerm=，只要別把=player.reflexive=炸上天，你總會回來的。

string.ID: Greetings, =player.formalAddressTerm=. Be careful with my wares as you peruse them.

strings.string: 問候您，=player.formalAddressTerm=。在瀏覽我的商品時請務必小心。

string.ID: How is your throwing arm, =player.formalAddressTerm=? Barring that, do you feel lucky?

strings.string: =player.formalAddressTerm=，妳的投擲手臂還好嗎？除此之外，妳覺得自己運氣如何？

string.ID: It's a dangerous job, =player.formalAddressTerm=, but well worth it.

strings.string: 這是一份危險的工作，=player.formalAddressTerm=，但非常值得。

string.ID: The vintners say that 'one rose is fair, but five is death'. I can sell you blossoms that mean death no matter the number.

strings.string: 那些 釀酒師 說過「一朵玫瑰尚可，五朵便是死神」。無論數量多少，我都能賣給你代表死亡的花朵。

string.ID: Live and drink, =player.formalAddressTerm=.

strings.string: 盡情生活與飲酒吧，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

string.ID: There's a shape in every stone waiting to be brought out.

strings.string: 每一塊石頭中都蘊藏著一個等待被雕琢出的形狀。

string.ID: If you bend the light just so, it frays into brilliance.

strings.string: 只要你以特定的方式折射光線，它就會綻放出燦爛的光芒。

string.ID: I can wait years for the inspiration to craft another figurine. I have before.

strings.string: 為了尋求製作下一個小雕像的靈感，我可以等上好幾年。我以前也曾這麼做過。

string.ID: What manner of jewel are our eyes, to skew light into thought?

strings.string: 我們的眼睛是何等奇特的珠寶，竟能將光線扭曲成思想？

string.ID: Enter, =player.formalAddressTerm=, and behold my jewels and figurines.

strings.string: 進來吧，=player.formalAddressTerm=，看看我的珠寶與小雕像。

string.ID: Uncrafted jewels and metals buy and sell for the same cost, but my art's price tag is up to me.

strings.string: 未經加工的珠寶與金屬買賣價格相同，但我藝術品的定價由我決定。

string.ID: Every statuette is a tribute, of a kind, but not every tribute is received well.

strings.string: 每一尊小雕像在某種程度上都是一種致敬，但並非所有的致敬都會受到歡迎。

string.ID: Wouldn't these make a fine conversation piece for a water ritual?

strings.string: 這些東西拿來當作 水之儀式 的談資不是很好嗎？

string.ID: Beautiful baubles and gleaming gemstones over here!

strings.string: 這邊有精美的飾品和閃亮的寶石！

string.ID: A well-polished and well-picked gem, no matter how rough, is as beautiful a work of art as any figurine.

strings.string: 一顆經過精細拋光與挑選的寶石，無論多麼粗糙，都與任何小雕像一樣是美麗的藝術品。

string.ID: Lean in close to see the detail. No, don't touch.

strings.string: 湊近一點看細節。不，別碰。

string.ID: Within my gemstones there burns a brighter fire than in some hearts.

strings.string: 在我的寶石之中，燃燒著比某些人心靈更熾熱的火焰。

string.ID: Water-wealth means nothing if you cannot carry it. Need jewels?

strings.string: 如果你帶不走水財，那它就毫無意義。需要珠寶嗎？

string.ID: Friend, I have precious metals and jewels to adorn or trade.

strings.string: 朋友，我有珍貴的金屬與珠寶可以用於裝飾或交易。

string.ID: Raw metals and gems buy and sell for a fixed water-cost.

strings.string: 原礦與寶石以固定的水資源成本進行買賣。

string.ID: Come, wanderer, change some of that heavy water for a pocketful of riches.

strings.string: 來吧，流浪者，用你口袋裡的財富來換取一些重水。

string.ID: Water Barons don't adorn themselves with water, after all.

strings.string: 畢竟水霸並不會用清水來裝飾自己。

string.ID: {{emote|*mumbling*}} ...exceeding mass thresholds, perhaps a ganglionic teleprojector fitted with suspensors...

strings.string: {{emote|*喃喃自語*}} ...或許是超過了質量閾值，一個配備了懸浮器的神經節遠距投影儀...

string.ID: Oh, I didn't notice you there. That's because I was ignoring you.

strings.string: 喔，我沒注意到你在那裡。那是因為我故意無視你。

string.ID: {{emote|*mumbling*}} ...waste heat from the thermo cask? Or centrifugal extraction to the p-density of sunslag...

strings.string: {{emote|*喃喃自語*}} ...來自熱能桶的廢熱？還是離心萃取到太陽渣的 p-密度...

string.ID: Where can I find a cave?

strings.string: 哪裡可以找到洞穴？

string.ID: I'm not interested.

strings.string: 我沒興趣。

string.ID: There are caves everywhere, you dolt! Scoop the surface of the marsh, or head on east to the rust wells, or wander into the Desert for all I care...

strings.string: 到處都是洞窟，你這個笨蛋！挖開沼澤的地表，或者向東前往 鏽蝕之井，或者隨你去沙漠裡流浪也好……

string.ID: I will return with your knickknack.

strings.string: 我會帶著你的小玩意兒回來。

string.ID: I'm not interested.

strings.string: 我沒興趣。

string.ID: You're standing in my light! What do you want?

strings.string: 你擋到我的光了！你要什麼？

string.ID: Here is your knickknack.

strings.string: 這是你的小玩意兒。

string.ID: Nothing. I will return with your knickknack.

strings.string: 沒事。我會帶著你的小玩意兒回來。

string.ID: Ah, mmm, hmmm. Are you a useful one, after all? Go fetch me another!

strings.string: 啊，嗯，哼哼。你終究還是個有用的人嗎？再去幫我弄一個來！

string.ID: If I must.

strings.string: 如果非得如此不可的話。

string.ID: Ah, mmm, hmmm. Are you a useful one, after all? Go fetch me another!

strings.string: 啊，嗯，哼哼。你終究還是個有用的人嗎？再去幫我弄一個來！

string.ID: Here is your knickknack.

strings.string: 這是你的小玩意兒。

string.ID: If I must.

strings.string: 如果非得如此不可的話。

string.ID:
{{emote|*Argyve whistles.*}}
Impressive, you! Maybe you're fit to poke around my workshop and swap scrap with me. I have been wanting another apprentice. So unfortunate about Skref, what with the disembowelment and all. Take a seat, there.

strings.string:
{{emote|*阿吉夫吹口哨。*}}
令人印象深刻，你這傢伙！或許你適合在我 的工作坊 裡到處看看，並跟我交換廢料。我一直想要另一個學徒。Skref 那件事真是太不幸了，畢竟還發生了被掏出內臟之類的事。在那邊坐下吧。

string.ID:
{{emote|*Argyve raises both eyebrows.*}}
Now, to screw the nut on the bolt with an explanation! I'm on the cusp, you see. A grand discovery. The Weirdwire Conduit is near assembled, and once it is, we'll be able to chat with anyone... in instant time! from here to the Yd Freehold. But before I can finish, I need wire. As much as you can find... at least two hundred feet. You should be able to scavenge it from the rust wells.

strings.string:
{{emote|*阿吉夫同時挑起了雙眉。*}}
現在，解釋得真是莫名其妙！我正處於關鍵時刻，你瞧。一項偉大的發現。「怪異電線導管」即將組裝完成，一旦完成，我們就能與任何人進行交流……即時通訊！從這裡一直到伊德自由領。但在我完成之前，我需要電線。越多越好……至少兩百英尺。你應該可以從鏽蝕之井那裡搜刮到。

string.ID: I'll fetch you your wire.

strings.string: 我去幫你拿你的線。

string.ID: I'm not interested.

strings.string: 我沒興趣。

string.ID: The wire! Give it to me!

strings.string: 電線！把它給我！

string.ID: Take the wire.

strings.string: 拿走這條電線。

string.ID: I don't have enough yet.

strings.string: 我還不夠錢。

string.ID:
{{emote|*Argyve hoots*}}
Yes, yes! Beautiful wire! -oh, before I forget, I repaired an old recoiler for you. Use it whenever you wish to hop back to Joppa quickly. Now, give me a few moments to attach the wire...

strings.string:
{{emote|*阿吉夫 咕咕叫著*}}
沒錯，沒錯！漂亮的電線！——喔，趁我還沒忘記，我幫你修好了一個舊的回彈器。你想快速跳回 約帕(Joppa) 時隨時可以使用它。現在，給我一點時間把電線接上……

string.ID: I will return.

strings.string: 我會回來的。

string.ID: It's working! Genius! Genius! Noise in the static- I hear it! I hear!... what's this? What *is* that? Wait...

strings.string: 成功了！天才！真是天才！靜電中的雜音——我聽到了！我聽到了！……這是什麼？那到底*是什麼*？等等……

string.ID: It's repeating itself...

strings.string: 它在不斷重複...

string.ID: {{emote|*Argyve mumbles to himself for several minutes.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*阿吉夫低聲自語了好幾分鐘。*}}

string.ID: Apprentice! Come, here! Something strange is occurring. The Conduit is picking up a signal, some sort of repeating transmission. I cannot decipher it, however. I lack cryptogull eggs and, well, never you mind! I have a great task for you, my apprentice. Do you accept it?

strings.string: 學徒！過來，這裡！發生了一些奇怪的事。傳導器（Conduit）接收到了一個訊號，某種重複的傳輸。但我無法解碼它。我缺少加密鷗蛋（cryptogull eggs），唉，算了，別在意！我有一項重任要交給你，我的學徒。你接受嗎？

string.ID: Can I know what it is?

strings.string: 我能知道那是什麽嗎？

string.ID: -yes. You must seek out Barathrum the Old, the eldest and wisest tinker alive. He lives with his followers the Barathrumites under the arch of Grit Gate to the northeast, in the jungle-strangled ruins of Qud. He will know what to make of the signal.

strings.string: -是的。你必須尋找年長的巴拉楚姆，他是現存最年長且最睿智的 修補匠。他與他的追隨者 巴拉楚姆信徒 居住在東北方 礫門(Grit Gate) 的拱門之下，位於卡德那被 叢林 糾纏的 遺跡 中。他會知道該如何解讀這個訊號。

string.ID: Who are these Barathrumites?

strings.string: 這些 巴拉楚姆信徒 是誰？

string.ID: I require no further information. I will go.

strings.string: 我不需要更多資訊了。我走了。

string.ID: Disciples of Barathrum. Mostly urshiib, like their mentor- quilled albino bears who prefer their candle-dim caves to the sun-salted surface of the jungle. A thousand years ago Barathrum and his kin crossed the Homs Delta into the rusting heart of Qud. He has spent centuries peeling the chrome shells off time's artifacts in his workshop. If he cannot decipher the signal, no one can.

strings.string: 巴拉楚姆的信徒。大多是 urshiib，就像他們的導師——羽毛覆蓋的白化熊，他們比起被陽光鹽化的叢林地表，更喜歡那種燭光昏暗的洞穴。一千年前，巴拉楚姆和他的族人穿過 Homs 三角洲，進入了卡德鏽跡斑斑的核心。他在自己的工作坊裡花了幾個世紀，剝開時間遺物的鉻殼。如果他無法解讀那個訊號，就沒人能做到了。

string.ID: I accept the task, Argyve.

strings.string: 我接受這個任務，阿吉夫。

string.ID: I must think on this.

strings.string: 我必須思考一下這件事。

string.ID: Farewell, Argyve.

strings.string: 再見，阿吉夫。

string.ID:
Splendid! Perfect! Let me record the signal to disk, which you'll need to guard with your life, I'm afraid.
I'll rig up a droid scrambler for you, too. You see, the Barathrumites have programmed a troupe of waydroids to guard the approach to Grit Gate. With the scrambler, you'll needn't worry about them. Wait there.

strings.string:
太棒了！完美！讓我將訊號記錄到磁碟中，恐怕你得拼死守護它才行。
我也會為你架設一台機器人擾亂器。你看，巴拉斯魯姆教徒（Barathrumites）編程了一群路徑機器人來守衛前往碎石之門（礫門(Grit Gate)）的入口。有了擾亂器，你就不用擔心它們了。在那裡等著。

string.ID: {{emote|*Argyve mumbles to himself for several minutes.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*阿吉夫低聲自語了好幾分鐘。*}}

string.ID: Here you are. Now, go! Off with you! May you live long enough to do my bidding. Away, away!

strings.string: 你在這裡。現在，走吧！快離開！願你能活得夠久，以完成我的囑託。走吧，走開！

string.ID: Farewell, Argyve.

strings.string: 再見，阿吉夫。

string.ID: The Barathrumites say I must plumb a cave called Golgotha before joining them.

strings.string: 巴拉楚姆信徒說在加入他們之前，我必須探索一個叫做髑髏地的洞穴。

string.ID: Argyve, I am no apprentice. The Barathrumites call me =factionaddress:Barathrumites= now.

strings.string: Argyve，我不是學徒。現在巴拉斯魯姆教派（Barathrumites）稱呼我為 =factionaddress:Barathrumites=。

string.ID: Need anything, Argyve?

strings.string: 需要什麼嗎，阿吉夫？

string.ID: Farewell, Argyve.

strings.string: 再見，阿吉夫。

string.ID: My apprentice! What?

strings.string: 我的學徒！怎麼了？

string.ID: Who are the Barathrumites again?

strings.string: 那些「巴拉楚姆信徒」到底是誰來著？

string.ID:
Did they, now? Well you're not MY =factionaddress:Barathrumites=!
Grit Gate is not Joppa, you pridesome solder-nail, and in this house you are apprentice still.
Now, what did you want? Be quick!

strings.string:
是嗎？哼，你可不是「我的」=factionaddress:Barathrumites=！
砂礫之門（礫門(Grit Gate)）可不是約帕(Joppa)（約帕(Joppa)），你這自大的釘鐵兵，在這屋子裡你還只是個學徒。
好了，你想幹嘛？快點！

string.ID:
-what?
No, no, I'm far too engrossed to see to your curiosity. I'm sure the Barathrumites have something for you to do.

strings.string:
-什麼？
不，不，我正忙得不可開交，沒空理會你的好奇心。我相信 =巴拉楚姆信徒= 有事可以讓你去做。

string.ID:
Welcome to Grit Gate. I am Otho, Barathrum's steward. I apologize for the manner of our introduction, but we must take precautions. Qud is a very unforgiving place.
You demonstrate tremendous promise to have returned from Golgotha with such inexperience. Take this firearm as your reward. It bears the mark of our finest gunsmith, Sparafucile. Take this bracelet, as well.
Return when you are ready to discuss the signal.

strings.string:
歡迎來到礫門。我是奧托，巴拉楚姆的管家。我很抱歉以這種方式與您介紹，但我們必須採取預防措施。卡德是一個非常不留情面的地方。
在如此缺乏經驗的情況下還能從髑髏地歸來，展現了巨大的潛力。請收下這把槍械作為獎勵。它帶有我們最優秀的槍械師斯帕拉福西爾的印記。也請收下這條手鍊。
當您準備好討論信號時再回來。

string.ID: Thank you. I will return.

strings.string: 謝謝。我會再回來的。

string.ID:
Welcome to Grit Gate. I am Otho, Barathrum's steward. I apologize for the manner of our introduction, but we must take precautions. Qud is a very unforgiving place.
I am pleased to see that you've returned with the waydroid, though you still know little of the dangers you bear. Take this firearm as your reward. It bears the mark of our finest gunsmith, Sparafucile.
Return when you are ready to discuss the signal.

strings.string:
歡迎來到礫門。我是奧托，巴拉楚姆的 管事。我很抱歉以這種方式與您見面，但我們必須採取預防措施。卡德是一個非常不留情面的地方。
很高興看到你帶著 waydroid 回來，儘管你對自己所承載的危險仍知之甚少。拿這把槍械作為你的獎勵吧。它印有我們最優秀的 槍械師 斯帕拉福西爾 的標記。
當你準備好討論信號時再回來。

string.ID: Thank you. I will return.

strings.string: 謝謝。我會再回來的。

string.ID:
Welcome to Grit Gate. I am Otho, Barathrum's steward. I apologize for the manner of our introduction, but we must take precautions. Qud is a very unforgiving place.
You are worthy to study with us. Take these.
Return when you are ready to discuss the signal.

strings.string: 你值得與我們一同研習。收下這些。

string.ID: Thank you. I will return.

strings.string: 謝謝。我會再回來的。

string.ID:
It takes more than a willing spirit to be trusted here, wayfarer.
Prove your worth and bring us a waydroid, and we will have more to speak of.

strings.string:
旅人，要在這裡獲得信任，光有滿腔熱忱是不夠的。
證明你的價值並為我們帶回一台 Waydroid，到時我們就有更多話可說了。

string.ID: Are you ready to discuss the signal?

strings.string: 你準備好討論那個訊號了嗎？
是的。
不。

string.ID:
The signal is a repeat transmission being broadcast from an unknown source.=V0tinkeraddendum= One of our tinkers, {{m|Q Girl}}, discovered it while rigging a long wave detector. Unfortunately, it's encrypted, and we do not have the means here to decrypt it. You may be of some help in this matter, however.
We've long known the location of a fully functioning {{W|baetyl}} within the bowels of the great hall {{C|Bethesda Susa}}. The Mechanimists have consecrated the site around it and built a temple there. Q Girl claims to have developed a means to decrypt the signal, but she needs the computing power of the baetyl. If you can infiltrate the Mechanimist compound, you may be able to engage the baetyl and decode the signal.

strings.string:
該訊號是從未知來源廣播的重複傳輸內容。=V0tinkeraddendum= 我們的一位 修補匠，{{m|Q 女孩}}，在架設長波偵測器時發現了它。不幸的是，它是加密過的，我們這裡沒有解密的手段。不過，你或許能在這件事上提供一些幫助。
我們早就知道一個功能完好的 {{W|baetyl}} 就位於大殿 {{C|貝賽達蘇薩(Bethesda Susa)}} 的深處。機械主義者已經在該地點周圍進行了聖化並建造了一座神廟。Q 女孩聲稱她已開發出一種解密訊號的方法，但她需要 聖碑 的運算能力。如果你能潛入機械主義者的營地，你或許就能啟動 聖碑 並解碼訊號。

string.ID: What is a baetyl?

strings.string: 什麼是貝提爾？

string.ID:
They are antique stones located in certain places deep within the caverns of Qud. We believe they are some sort of hyper-advanced machines built by the Eaters. Often one claims to possess a sentience of its own. However, most of them have gone haywire in the eons since their creation; it is rare indeed to discover one whose circuitry is wholly uncorroded.
The Mechanimists worship this one as an idol, and they will protect it at all costs. You will need to find a way through their host to the baetyl itself.
Do you believe you can accomplish this task?

strings.string:
它們是位於卡德深處某些地點的古老石塊。我們相信它們是噬者所建造的某種超先進機器。通常，有人聲稱它擁有自主意識。然而，自其創造以來的漫長歲月中，大多數都已失控；要發現一個電路完全未受腐蝕的個體實屬罕見。
機械主義者將此物視為偶像崇拜，並會不惜一切代價保護它。你需要找到穿過他們的群眾前往貝提爾（baetyl）本身的方法。
你相信你能完成這項任務嗎？

string.ID: Yes, I do.

strings.string: 是的，我確實如此。

string.ID: I must think on this task.

strings.string: 我必須考慮一下這項任務。

string.ID:
Good, =factionaddress:Barathrumites=. Speak to {{m|Q Girl}} in the workshop. She'll encode her instructions for the baetyl onto a copy of the disk.
There's one more thing. The baetyl is located beneath the ancient cryobarrios of the Eaters. Time has worked to erode the mechanisms that contain their cryogenic mist. That freezing vapor billows out of the chambers freely now, cooling the entire cavern. You will want to procure warm clothing to protect =player.reflexive=.
The spoils of the Mechanimists are yours to keep. Remember, =factionaddress:Barathrumites=, Barathrum will look kindly upon your service.

strings.string:
很好，=factionaddress:Barathrumites=。去工作坊與 {{m|Q Girl}} 對話。她會將關於貝提爾（baetyl）的指示編碼到磁碟副本中。
還有一件事。貝提爾位於食者（Eaters）古老的冷凍室（cryobarrios）下方。時間侵蝕了那些封存其低溫霧氣的機制。現在，那股冰冷的蒸氣正從艙室中肆意湧出，使整個洞穴都變得寒冷。你必須取得保暖衣物來保護 =player.reflexive=。
機械主義者（Mechanimists）的戰利品將歸你所有。記住，=factionaddress:Barathrumites=，巴拉楚姆(Barathrum)（巴拉楚姆(Barathrum)）會對你的服務表示嘉許。

string.ID: I will return with the data, Steward.

strings.string: 我會帶著數據回來，管家。

string.ID: Luck be with you in the lair of Bethsaida, =factionaddress:Barathrumites=.

strings.string: 願好運與你同在，於貝賽達（Bethsaida）的巢穴中，=factionaddress:Barathrumites=。

string.ID: I will return with the data, Steward.

strings.string: 我會帶著數據回來，管家。

string.ID: You return. Have you succeeded in decoding the signal?

strings.string: 你回來了。解碼信號成功了嗎？
是的。

string.ID: Well done, =factionaddress:Barathrumites=. Present the disk.

strings.string: 做得好，=factionaddress:Barathrumites=。呈上磁碟。

string.ID: [Give Otho the disk]

strings.string: [把磁碟交給 奧托]

string.ID: I must bring the decoded signal to Barathrum immediately. Return in a few hours. By then I'll have discussed our next course of action with Barathrum and will have further instructions for you.

strings.string: 我必須立即將解碼後的訊號帶回巴拉楚姆。幾小時後再回來。到那時，我已與巴拉楚姆討論過我們下一步的行動，並會為你提供進一步的指示。

string.ID: As you say, steward.

strings.string: 如您所言，管家。

string.ID: =factionaddress:Barathrumites|capitalize=, I have no further instructions for you yet. Return soon.

strings.string: =factionaddress:Barathrumites|capitalize=，我目前還沒有進一步的指示要給你。請儘快回來。

string.ID: As you say, steward.

strings.string: 如您所言，管家。

string.ID: =name=, I've brought the decoded signal to Barathrum, and he's finished musing on it. We have fresh instructions for you, =factionaddress:Barathrumites=. Are you ready to hear them?

strings.string: =name=，我已經把解碼後的訊號帶到 巴拉楚姆(Barathrum) 那裡了，他已經對此思考完畢。我們有新的指示要給你，=factionaddress:Barathrumites=。你準備好聽了嗎？
是的。

string.ID:
Barathrum needs you for an undertaking of great importance. You must journey to {{C|Omonporch}} far to the north. There the Spindle stretches from earth to sky. Unfortunately, a troublesome merchant from the Consortium of Phyta has relocated there and declared xerself Earl of Omonporch. We need you to broker a deal so that we may lease control of the Spindle. Failing that, you'll need to dispose of the self-appointed Earl.
Be careful on your approach to Omonporch, =factionaddress:Barathrumites=. So far east into the reaches of Qud, the Putus Templar lie in wait.

strings.string:
巴拉楚姆(Barathrum) 需要你執行一項極其重要的任務。你必須前往遙遠北方的 {{C|歐蒙波奇(Omonporch)}}。在那裡，紡錘(Spindle)（紡錘(Spindle)）從大地延伸至天空。不幸的是，一名來自 Phyta 財團（植物聯盟(Consortium of Phyta)）的麻煩商人搬到了那裡，並自封為 歐蒙波奇(Omonporch) 的伯爵。我們需要你去促成一項交易，好讓我們能租下紡錘的控制權。如果失敗了，你就得除掉那位自命不凡的伯爵。
前往 歐蒙波奇(Omonporch) 的途中請務必小心，=factionaddress:Barathrumites=。在 Qud 如此偏東的邊陲之地，Putus 聖騎士（Putus Templar）正潛伏著伺機而動。

string.ID: Who are the Putus Templar?

strings.string: 誰是 普圖斯聖騎士？

string.ID: What is the purpose of this?

strings.string: 這是為了什麼目的？

string.ID: I will secure the Spindle for Barathrum.

strings.string: 我會為巴拉楚姆奪取紡錘。

string.ID: I must think on this task.

strings.string: 我必須考慮一下這項任務。

string.ID:
The Putus Templar, or the Sons and Daughters, as they call themselves, are an order of knights who claim descendancy from the Eaters, the ancient folk who wrought the chrome halls of Qud. Beware them, for while they despise all mutants, they harbor a special malice for Barathrum.
Take care that you do not find =player.reflexive= inside one of their slave pens.

strings.string:
普圖斯聖騎士，或者稱他們為「子嗣」，是一個自稱是 Eaters 後裔的騎士團，這群古老民族建造了卡德的鉻合金大廳。小心他們，因為雖然他們鄙視所有突變者，但他們對巴拉楚姆懷有特殊的惡意。
務必小心，不要讓 =player.reflexive= 內部 發現你身處他們的奴隸圈之中。

string.ID: What is the purpose of this?

strings.string: 這是為了什麼目的？

string.ID: I will secure the Spindle for Barathrum.

strings.string: 我會為巴拉楚姆奪取紡錘。

string.ID: I must think on this task.

strings.string: 我必須考慮一下這項任務。

string.ID:
That will be revealed to you in due time.
Do not forget your place, =factionaddress:Barathrumites=.

strings.string:
時機成熟時，一切都會向你揭曉。
不要忘記你的身份，=factionaddress:Barathrumites=。

string.ID: Who are the Putus Templar?

strings.string: 誰是 普圖斯聖騎士？

string.ID: I will secure the Spindle for Barathrum.

strings.string: 我會為巴拉楚姆奪取紡錘。

string.ID: I must think on this task.

strings.string: 我必須考慮一下這項任務。

string.ID:
It's as I feared, =name=. Grit Gate is being assailed. The Putus Templar must have followed you back from Omonporch.
Let us use the precious little time we have before they arrive to prepare our defenses.

strings.string:
正如我所擔心的，=name=。礫門正遭受攻擊。那些普圖斯聖騎士一定跟著你從歐蒙波奇追過來了。
趁他們抵達前，讓我們利用僅剩的寶貴時間做好防禦準備。

string.ID: What can I do?

strings.string: 我能做什麼？

string.ID: Go to the mainframe room and scan the shale surrounding Grit Gate for anomalies. Now, =name=!

strings.string: 前往主機房，並掃描格里特之門（礫門(Grit Gate)）周圍的頁岩是否存在異常。現在，=name=!

string.ID: I'll go now.

strings.string: 我現在走了。

string.ID:
With the chrome key card I gave you, you now have access to our power grid. There are chain laser emplacements and force projectors across the enclave. Use Ereshkigal's reconnaissance to decide which defenses to enable. You can also broadcast an overclock command or activate Rodanis Y by interfacing with Ereshkigal.
Be mindful of the amperage draw, though. If you overdraw the grid, you could cause brownouts.
Act quickly, =name=! The Templar near us even as we speak.

strings.string:
有了我給你的鉻合金鑰匙卡，你現在可以存取我們的電網。整個飛地都佈署了鏈式雷射陣列和 力場投影儀。利用 Ereshkigal 的偵察來決定啟用哪些防禦設施。你也可以透過與 Ereshkigal 介面連接來廣播超頻指令或啟動 羅達尼斯 Y。
不過，請留意電流消耗。如果你過度抽取電網電力，可能會導致電壓下降。
動作快點，=name=！就在我們談話時，身旁的聖騎士正朝這裡走來。

string.ID: I'll do my best to defend Grit Gate.

strings.string: 我會盡全力守護礫門。

string.ID: That rumbling... what was it? An explosion? Hmm...

strings.string: 那陣隆隆聲……是什麼？爆炸嗎？嗯……

string.ID: What are you thinking, Otho?

strings.string: 你在想什麼，奧托？

string.ID:
Grave thoughts, =name=. Listen to me now. Take this key card, go to Ereshkigal's room, and-- oh, that's the mainframe. It's what she prefers to be called.
Go to her room, access Ereshkigal, and scan the shale surrounding the enclave for anomalies. I've asked her to ready her sensors.
Update me with what you learn. You may use the intercom in the northeast corner of Ereshkigal's room to deliver your update.
Go, quickly! I'd soon be disabused of my fears.

strings.string:
沉重的思緒，=name=。現在聽我說。拿著這張感應卡，去 Ereshkigal 的房間，然後——喔，那是主機。那是她更喜歡的稱呼。
去她的房間，存取 Ereshkigal，並掃描飛地周圍的頁岩是否有異常。我已經要求她準備好感測器了。
隨時向我回報你的發現。你可以使用 Ereshkigal 房間東北角的對講機來傳送報告。
快去！我希望能盡快消除我的恐懼。

string.ID: I'll go now.

strings.string: 我現在走了。

string.ID:
You can still activate our defenses, =name=. There are chain laser emplacements and force projectors across the enclave. Use Ereshkigal's reconnaissance to decide which defenses to enable. You can also broadcast an overclock command or activate Rodanis Y by interfacing with Ereshkigal.
Be mindful of the amperage draw, though. If you overdraw the grid, you could cause brownouts.

strings.string:
你仍然可以啟動我們的防禦系統，=name=。整個飛地都佈署了連鎖雷射陣地與力場投影器。利用艾瑞修卡格爾（Ereshkigal）的偵察功能來決定要啟用哪些防禦設施。你也可以透過與艾瑞修卡格爾介面連接，來廣播超頻指令或啟動羅達尼斯 Y（Rodanis Y）。
不過，請留意電流消耗。如果你過度抽取電網電力，可能會導致電壓驟降。

string.ID: I'll do my best to defend Grit Gate.

strings.string: 我會盡全力守護礫門。

string.ID: Have you secured the Spindle yet?

strings.string: 你拿到紡錘了嗎？

string.ID: Yes, the Spindle is ours.

strings.string: 是的，紡錘是我們的。

string.ID: No, not yet.

strings.string: 不，還沒。

string.ID: Leave me alone for a moment, =factionaddress:Barathrumites=. I have duties to attend.

strings.string: 讓我一個人靜一下，=factionaddress:Barathrumites=。我還有公務要處理。

string.ID: I will return later, Otho.

strings.string: 我稍後會回來，奧托。

string.ID: That is sterling news, =factionaddress:Barathrumites=. I'll go inform Barathrum straightaway.

strings.string: 那是個極好的消息，=factionaddress:Barathrumites=。我立刻就去通知 巴拉楚姆(Barathrum)。

string.ID:
Furthermore, I spoke with Barathrum. He praised your handling of the Earl of Omonporch, and he thanks you for the bravery you exhibited in defending Grit Gate.
The attack today reminds us: for too long have we put our faith in the isolation of our guild and the preoccupations of the Putus Templar. The looming threat of another attack impels Barathrum to accelerate his plans, and with them, your position in our guild.
You are raised to Disciple, =player.formalAddressTerm=. Barathrum wishes to speak with you immediately.

strings.string:
此外，我與 巴拉楚姆(Barathrum) 交談過了。他讚許你對 歐蒙波奇(Omonporch) 伯爵的處理方式，並感謝你在守衛 礫門(Grit Gate) 時所展現的勇氣。
今日的攻擊提醒了我們：長期以來，我們過於依賴公會的孤立性以及 Putus Templar 的關注。另一波攻擊迫在眉睫的威脅促使 巴拉楚姆(Barathrum) 加速他的計畫，也隨之提升了你在公會中的地位。
你已被晉升為 Disciple，=player.formalAddressTerm=。巴拉楚姆(Barathrum) 希望立即與你交談。
此外，我與 巴拉楚姆(Barathrum) 交談過了。他讚許你處理 歐蒙波奇(Omonporch) 伯爵的方式，也感謝你在守衛 礫門(Grit Gate) 時所展現的勇氣。
今天的攻擊提醒了我們：我們將信任寄託於公會的孤立以及 普圖斯聖騎士 的專注太久了。另一次攻擊迫在眉睫的威脅促使 巴拉楚姆(Barathrum) 加速他的計畫，也隨之改變了你在公會中的地位。
=player.formalAddressTerm=，你已被晉升為弟子。巴拉楚姆(Barathrum) 希望立即與你交談。

string.ID: He wishes to speak to me? Barathrum himself?

strings.string: 他想跟我說話？巴拉楚姆(Barathrum) 本人嗎？

string.ID:
I spoke with Barathrum. He praised your handling of the Earl of Omonporch, and he thanks you for the bravery you exhibited in defending Grit Gate.
The attack today reminds us: for too long have we put our faith in the isolation of our guild and the preoccupations of the Putus Templar. The looming threat of another attack impels Barathrum to accelerate his plans, and with them, your position in our guild.
You are raised to Disciple, =player.formalAddressTerm=. Barathrum wishes to speak with you immediately.

strings.string:
我與 巴拉楚姆(Barathrum) 談過了。他讚賞你處理 歐蒙波奇(Omonporch) 伯爵的方式，並感謝你在保衛 礫門(Grit Gate) 時展現出的勇氣。
今天的攻擊提醒了我們：我們將信仰寄託於公會的孤立以及 普圖斯聖騎士 的專注太久了。另一次攻擊即將到來的威脅促使 巴拉楚姆(Barathrum) 加速他的計畫，也隨之加速了你在我們公會中的地位。
你已被晉升為學徒，=player.formalAddressTerm=。巴拉楚姆(Barathrum) 希望立即與你交談。

string.ID: He wishes to speak to me? Barathrum himself?

strings.string: 他想跟我說話？巴拉楚姆(Barathrum) 本人嗎？

string.ID: He wishes to speak to me? Barathrum himself?

strings.string: 他想跟我說話？巴拉楚姆(Barathrum) 本人嗎？

string.ID: Yes, =factionaddress:Barathrumites=. Take this key and follow the stairs down to his study. He awaits.

strings.string: 是的，=factionaddress:Barathrumites=。拿著這把鑰匙，沿著樓梯往下走到他的書房。他在那裡等著你。

string.ID: Thank you, Otho.

strings.string: 謝謝你，奧托。

string.ID: Yes, =factionaddress:Barathrumites=. Follow the stairs down to his study. He awaits.

strings.string: 是的，=factionaddress:Barathrumites=。沿著樓梯往下走，到他的書房。他在那裡等著。

string.ID: Thank you, Otho.

strings.string: 謝謝你，奧托。

string.ID: I am busy, wayfarer. Please talk to Mafeo in the trade square if you need something.

strings.string: 我很忙，旅人。如果你有需要，請去交易廣場找 馬費歐。

string.ID:
=factionaddress:Barathrumites|capitalize=! You have my deepest gratitude. Few =player.personTerm|pluralize= could have defended Grit Gate so deftly.
Now, give me time to assess our losses and consult with Barathrum. Return soon.

strings.string:
=factionaddress:Barathrumites|capitalize=！我對您致以最深切的謝意。很少有 =player.personTerm|pluralize= 能如此靈巧地守住碎石之門（礫門(Grit Gate)）。
現在，請給我一些時間來評估我們的損失並與巴拉楚姆（巴拉楚姆(Barathrum)）商議。儘快回來。

string.ID: Live and drink, Otho.

strings.string: 生存並飲水，奧托。

string.ID: Given the circumstances, this is a remarkable lack of destruction. Your defense of Grit Gate was first-class, =name=.

strings.string: 考慮到目前的狀況，這真是令人驚嘆的低破壞程度。 =name=，你對 礫門(Grit Gate) 的防禦表現是頂尖水準。

string.ID: Thank you for the update, Otho.

strings.string: 謝謝你的更新，奧托。

string.ID: Much was lost, but such is what I expected. Once again, thank you for efforts, =name=.

strings.string: 損失了很多，但這也是我的預料之中。再次感謝妳的努力，=name=。

string.ID: Thank you for the update, Otho.

strings.string: 謝謝你的更新，奧托。

string.ID: Such tremendous loss. I wonder if more could have been done to prevent it.

strings.string: 如此巨大的損失。我在想是否能採取更多措施來防止這種事發生。

string.ID: Thank you for the update, Otho.

strings.string: 謝謝你的更新，奧托。

string.ID: Yes, =name=?

strings.string: 是的，=name=?

string.ID: Live and drink, steward.

strings.string: 盡情生活與飲酒吧，管家。

string.ID: Be straightforward, disciple. You mean to ask if we will house them.

strings.string: 直說吧，弟子。你是想問我們是否會收留他們。

string.ID: I am uncertain that you know the enormity of what you ask me, =name=. Nonetheless, I cannot deny what you have done for our order. These slynth must be tested as you were, but should they show the mettle and drive set by your example, we will accept them as apprentices.

strings.string: 我不確定你是否知道你的要求有多麼巨大，=name=。儘管如此，我無法否認你為我們的教團所做的一切。這些 斯林斯 必須像你一樣接受考驗，但若他們展現出你所樹立的勇氣與動力，我們將接納他們成為學徒。

string.ID: You have my thanks, Otho.

strings.string: 多謝你的幫助，奧托。

string.ID: You have grown bold beyond your station. What you have asked of us you have not earned. If you must ask again, become worthier first.

strings.string: 你的膽量已經超越了你的地位。你向我們要求的東西是你尚未贏得的。如果你一定要再問一次，請先變得更有價值。

string.ID: Has this slynth situation been settled yet?

strings.string: 這場 斯林斯 事態解決了嗎？

string.ID:
I did not expect to admit this, disciple, but the refugees have met my expectations. Like you, they have shown more than a willing spirit in work and curiosity both.
The slynth have promise, and you may have been right to bring them to us.

strings.string:
弟子，我沒想到要承認這一點，但難民們達到了我的預期。就像你一樣，他們在工作與好奇心方面都展現出了超越單純熱忱的精神。
這些 斯林斯 前景看好，或許你把他們帶給我們是對的。

string.ID: My thanks, Otho.

strings.string: 多謝了，奧托。

string.ID:
Live and drink, disciple.
You will be pleased to know that the slynth have proven themselves worthy of apprentice status. They will reside here for as long as they uphold and serve the tenets of our order.

strings.string:
生活與飲酒吧，弟子。
你會很高興得知，斯林斯已證明自己值得成為學徒。只要他們秉持並服務於我們教團的教義，就會一直居住在此。

string.ID: My thanks again, Otho

strings.string: 再次感謝你，奧托

string.ID:
It's as I feared, =name=. Grit Gate is being assailed. The Putus Templar must have followed you back from Omonporch.
Let us use the precious little time we have before they arrive to prepare our defenses.

strings.string:
正如我所擔心的，=name=。礫門正遭受攻擊。那些普圖斯聖騎士一定跟著你從歐蒙波奇追過來了。
趁他們抵達前，讓我們利用僅剩的寶貴時間做好防禦準備。

string.ID: What can I do?

strings.string: 我能做什麼？

string.ID:
With the chrome key card I gave you, you now have access to our power grid. There are chain laser emplacements and force projectors across the enclave. Use Ereshkigal's reconnaissance to decide which defenses to enable. You can also broadcast an overclock command or activate Rodanis Y by interfacing with Ereshkigal.
Be mindful of the amperage draw, though. If you overdraw the grid, you could cause brownouts.
Act quickly, =name=! The Templar near us even as we speak.

strings.string:
有了我給你的鉻合金鑰匙卡，你現在可以存取我們的電網。整個飛地都佈署了鏈式雷射陣列和 力場投影儀。利用 Ereshkigal 的偵察來決定啟用哪些防禦設施。你也可以透過與 Ereshkigal 介面連接來廣播超頻指令或啟動 羅達尼斯 Y。
不過，請留意電流消耗。如果你過度抽取電網電力，可能會導致電壓下降。
動作快點，=name=！就在我們談話時，身旁的聖騎士正朝這裡走來。

string.ID: I'll do my best to defend Grit Gate.

strings.string: 我會盡全力守護礫門。

string.ID: {{emote|*loud static*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*巨大的靜電聲*}}

string.ID: Quetzal! Who are you, stranger?

strings.string: Quetzal！你是誰，陌生人？

string.ID: I must be going.

strings.string: 我該走了。

string.ID: It's time to fight, =name=. Are you with me?

strings.string: 該戰鬥了，=name=。你願意與我並肩作戰嗎？

string.ID: I am.

strings.string: 我存在。

string.ID: Quetzal, quetzal, quetzal! Welcome to the workshop, =player.formalAddressTerm=.

strings.string: Quetzal, 羽蛇, 羽蛇！歡迎來到 工作坊，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

string.ID: Barathrum asked me to deliver your blueprints to Pax Klanq.

strings.string: 巴拉楚姆(Barathrum) 叫我把你的藍圖送到 派克斯克蘭克 那裡。

string.ID: Did you feel that rumbling, Q Girl?

strings.string: 妳感覺到那陣隆隆聲了嗎，Q 女孩？

string.ID: What does 'quetzal' mean?

strings.string: '羽蛇' 是什麼意思？

string.ID: Your hair is a quasar of red ochre and indigo.

strings.string: 你的頭髮宛如紅赭石與靛藍交織的類星體。

string.ID: Do you like my goggles?

strings.string: 你喜歡我的 護目鏡 嗎？

string.ID: There must be a hundred gadgets here. What are you working on?

strings.string: 這裡一定有上百個小玩意。你在研究什麼？

string.ID: Otho informs me that you have a method for decoding the signal. Can you encode your instructions for the baetyl onto this disk?

strings.string: 奧托 告訴我你有一種解碼訊號的方法。你能將你對貝提爾（baetyl）的指令編碼到這張磁碟上嗎？

string.ID: Live and drink, tinker.

strings.string: 活下去並盡情暢飲吧，修補匠。

string.ID: Yikes! Yes! The intensity was too great to be the result of one of my experiments. What was it, I wonder?

strings.string: 哎呀！沒錯！那種強度太強烈了，不可能是我的實驗產生的結果。我在想，那究竟是什麼呢？

string.ID: Live and drink, tinker.

strings.string: 活下去並盡情暢飲吧，修補匠。

string.ID: It's a word I say out of excitement. Sort of a semantic extension of the feeling I get when I see a quetzal. Oh, a quetzal is a pretty bird in the trogon family. I tend to incorporate things I like into my idiolect.

strings.string: 這是我因興奮而脫口而出的一個詞。算是我看到鳳尾綠咬鵑時那種感覺的語義延伸。喔，鳳尾綠咬鵑是鳳鳥科中一種很漂亮的鳥。我傾向於將我喜歡的事物融入我的個人用語中。

string.ID: Live and drink, tinker.

strings.string: 活下去並盡情暢飲吧，修補匠。

string.ID: Quetzal! Thank you, thank you. What a poetic metaphor! You're a regular Shakesprig, aren't you?

strings.string: Quetzal！謝謝你，謝謝你。多麼詩意的隱喻！你簡直是個「莎克斯普里格」，不是嗎？

string.ID: Live and drink, tinker.

strings.string: 活下去並盡情暢飲吧，修補匠。

string.ID: Yes, yes, yes. They are so quetzal!

strings.string: 是的，是的，是的。牠們真是色彩斑斕！

string.ID: Live and drink, tinker.

strings.string: 活下去並盡情暢飲吧，修補匠。

string.ID: Live and drink, tinker.

strings.string: 活下去並盡情暢飲吧，修補匠。

string.ID: I do, brave friend. I'll imprint them now.

strings.string: 我明白，勇敢的朋友。我現在就將它們印刻下來。

string.ID: Thank you, Q Girl.

strings.string: 謝謝妳，Q 女孩。

string.ID: Here they are, brave friend. Good luck!

strings.string: 他們就在這裡，勇敢的朋友。祝你好運！

string.ID: Thank you, Q Girl.

strings.string: 謝謝妳，Q 女孩。

string.ID: {{emote|*Sparafucile lifts one brow, giving you a wary look.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*斯帕拉福西爾 挑起一邊眉毛，警惕地看著你。*}}

string.ID: I'll be going.

strings.string: 我要走了。

string.ID: {{emote|*Sparafucile gives =pronouns.possessive= carbine a once-over and gives you a resolute nod.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*斯帕拉福西爾檢查了一下 =pronouns.possessive= 卡賓槍，並對你堅定地點了點頭。*}}

string.ID: *nod back*

strings.string: *點頭回應*

string.ID: {{emote|*Sparafucile gives you a resolute nod.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*斯帕拉福西爾 對你堅定地點了點頭。*}}

string.ID: *nod back*

strings.string: *點頭回應*

string.ID: {{emote|*Sparafucile nods.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*斯帕拉福西爾點了點頭。*}}

string.ID: Greetings, Sparafucile.

strings.string: 問候，斯帕拉福西爾。

string.ID: *nod back*

strings.string: *點頭回應*

string.ID: {{emote|*Sparafucile raises one long-fingered hand in greeting.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*斯帕拉福西爾 舉起一隻長指的手示好。*}}

string.ID: Do you know anything about Bethesda Susa?

strings.string: 你對 貝賽達蘇薩(Bethesda Susa) 有所了解嗎？

string.ID: Did you feel that rumbling, Sparafucile?

strings.string: 你有感覺到那陣隆隆聲嗎，斯帕拉福西爾？

string.ID: Have you ever met Pax Klanq?

strings.string: 你曾遇見過 派克斯克蘭克 嗎？

string.ID: I must enter Brightsheol through the Tomb of the Eaters.

strings.string: 我必須透過食者之墓進入布萊特希歐。

string.ID: What do you think of Klanq's presence?

strings.string: 你對 克蘭克(Klanq) 的出現有何看法？

string.ID: Your carbine is as fine an instrument as I have ever wielded.

strings.string: 您的 卡賓槍 是我所用過的極佳器械。

string.ID: Your pistol is as fine an instrument as I have ever wielded.

strings.string: 你的 手槍 是我所用過的極佳工具。

string.ID: You are a bear of few words.

strings.string: 你真是個寡言的熊。

string.ID: Are you happy living in this cave, away from the sun and open sky?

strings.string: 妳喜歡住在這座洞穴裡，遠離太陽與廣闊的天空嗎？

string.ID: Live and drink, harm-artisan.

strings.string: 活著並盡情暢飲吧，傷害工匠。

string.ID: {{emote|*Sparafucile frowns. After several moments of paper-shuffling, he presents you with a charcoal drawing depicting a gelatinous creature in the shape of a gumdrop. Sketches below depict the ooze enveloping a bipedal figure, then falling through the floor.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*斯帕拉福西爾 皺起眉頭。經過片刻的翻找紙張後，他向你展示了一幅木炭畫，描繪著一個形狀像軟糖的膠狀生物。下方的素描描繪了那團黏液包圍了一個雙足生物，接著穿透地板墜落。*}}

string.ID: An ooze that can melt through the floor...

strings.string: 一種可以融穿地板的黏液……

string.ID: {{emote|*Sparafucile furrows his brow for a few moments, then shakes his head, sighs, and offers you a shrug. He puts a paw on your shoulder and squeezes.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*斯帕拉福西爾皺了幾下眉頭，然後搖搖頭，嘆了口氣，對你聳了聳肩。他把爪子放在你的肩膀上捏了捏。*}}

string.ID: Fair enough, friend.

strings.string: 好吧，朋友。

string.ID:
{{emote|*Sparafucile instructs you to wait, and spends a minute or so rifling through the papers and scraps scattered across =pronouns.possessive= workbench. At last =pronouns.subjective= produces a graphite sketch of a cylinder, an expertly-rendered specular revealing its surface to be shiny like glass. The detail of the cylinder's contents are indistinct and dark, but somehow menacing.*}}
{{emote|*Sparafucile points to the glass and makes a breaking motion, then draws a thumb across =pronouns.possessive= throat.*}}

strings.string:
{{emote|*斯帕拉福西爾指示你等待，並花了一分鐘左右翻閱散落在 =pronouns.possessive= 工作檯上的文件與碎片。最後，=pronouns.subjective= 拿出了一張圓柱體的石墨素描，其專業的鏡面渲染顯示出表面像玻璃一樣光滑。圓柱體內容物的細節模糊且陰暗，卻隱約透著威脅感。*}}
{{emote|*斯帕拉福西爾指著玻璃並做出破碎的手勢，然後用拇指劃過 =pronouns.possessive= 喉嚨。*}}

string.ID: I'll have to be careful of... glass tubes?

strings.string: 我必須小心那些……玻璃管？

string.ID: {{emote|*Sparafucile gives you a warm smile and a firm nod. Pressing both pointers to their respective thumbs, =pronouns.subjective= taps these finger-circles together before =pronouns.possessive= chest and rotates both hands in place until the smallest of =pronouns.possessive= long fingers touch. Finally, =pronouns.subjective= gestures toward the other Barathrumites working at their stations.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*斯帕拉福西爾對你露出溫暖的微笑並堅定地向你點頭。將兩根食指按在各自的大拇指上，=pronouns.subjective= 在 =pronouns.possessive= 胸前輕敲這些指環，然後原地旋轉雙手，直到 =pronouns.possessive= 最纖細的手指相觸。最後，=pronouns.subjective= 向其他正在崗位工作的 巴拉楚姆信徒 做了一個手勢。*}}

string.ID: I don't understand. Can you explain aloud?

strings.string: 我不明白。你能大聲解釋一下嗎？

string.ID: You are happy because you are with your family?

strings.string: 因為能與家人在一起，所以感到很幸福嗎？

string.ID: If I might change the subject...

strings.string: 如果我可以換個話題的話……

string.ID: {{emote|*Sparafucile smiles. =pronouns.Subjective= raises a flat hand to =pronouns.possessive= chin and lowers it in your direction.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*斯帕拉福西爾 微笑。=pronouns.Subjective= 將平放的手舉至 =pronouns.possessive= 下巴處，並朝著你的方向放下。*}}

string.ID: You are welcome.

strings.string: 不客氣。

string.ID: {{emote|*With a nod, Sparafucile waits for you to continue, keeping =pronouns.possessive= eyes focused on your lips.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*Sparafucile 點了點頭，等待你繼續說下去，=pronouns.possessive= 眼神始終注視著你的雙唇。*}}

string.ID: Why are you staring at my mouth?

strings.string: 你為什麼盯著我的嘴看？

string.ID: {{emote|*Sparafucile places a closed fist over =pronouns.possessive= mouth, then taps =pronouns.possessive= ear, then muzzle with one long finger.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*斯帕拉福西爾 將握緊的拳頭放在 =pronouns.possessive= 嘴部上方，接著用一根長指點了點 =pronouns.possessive= 耳朵，然後是口鼻。*}}

string.ID: You are... unable to hear or speak.

strings.string: 你... 無法聽說或說話。

string.ID: {{emote|*Smiling a bit, Sparafucile nods.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*微微一笑，斯帕拉福西爾點了點頭。*}}

string.ID: Is your condition a result of your work?

strings.string: 你的狀況是因為你的工作造成的嗎？

string.ID: Yet you are an expert in your field? How inspiring!

strings.string: 然而您卻是您領域的專家？真是令人振奮！

string.ID: {{emote|*Sparafucile shakes =pronouns.possessive= head.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*斯帕拉福西爾搖了搖 =pronouns.possessive= 頭。*}}

string.ID: Your condition is lifelong?

strings.string: 你的狀況是終身的嗎？

string.ID: Thank you for your clarity and patience, tinkerfriend.

strings.string: 謝謝你的清晰與耐心，小修補匠朋友。

string.ID: {{emote|*Sparafucile nods.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*斯帕拉福西爾點了點頭。*}}

string.ID: {{emote|*Sparafucile nods grimly.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*斯帕拉福西爾 嚴肅地點了點頭。}}

string.ID: {{emote|*With a small smile of gratitude, Sparafucile taps his chin with a flat hand and lowers it toward you like a drawbridge.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*帶著一絲感激的微笑，斯帕拉福西爾 用平坦的手掌輕輕敲了敲下巴，然後像吊橋一樣將手向您放下。*}}

string.ID: {{emote|*Sparafucile averts =pronouns.possessive= gaze and heaves a tired sigh.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*斯帕拉福西爾 避開了 =pronouns.possessive= 的目光，並沉重地嘆了一口氣。*}}

string.ID: I merely asked...

strings.string: 我只是問問而已...

string.ID: I apologize for my carelessness.

strings.string: 我很抱歉，是我粗心了。

string.ID: {{emote|*Sparafucile gives you a wan smile and a thumbs-up.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*斯帕拉福西爾對你露出一抹蒼白的微笑，並豎起了大拇指。*}}

string.ID: {{emote|*=pronouns.Subjective= nods slowly, smirking.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*=pronouns.Subjective= 緩慢地點頭，露出了壞笑。*}}

string.ID: Is... there any advice you can give me about going to meet him?

strings.string: 關於去見他……你有什麼建議可以給我嗎？

string.ID: So anyway...

strings.string: 總之……

string.ID: {{emote|*Sparafucile shrugs, still smirking.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*斯帕拉福西爾 shrugs, still smirking.*}}

string.ID: Let us speak of other things.

strings.string: 讓我們聊聊別的事吧。

string.ID: {{emote|*Sparafucile stares at you as if you have grown an additional, substantially uglier head, which you have not.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*斯帕拉福西爾盯著你，彷彿你長出了一顆額外且醜陋得多的頭，但事實並非如此。*}}

string.ID: I'll... be going then.

strings.string: 那我就... 先走了。

string.ID:
{{emote|*Sparafucile makes an 'L' shape with both hands, thumbs facing down and fingers pointed toward one another, before flipping both hands so =pronouns.possessive= thumbs face up. =pronouns.Subjective= then raises a closed fist to =pronouns.possessive= mouth, thumb out, and mimes drinking from it.*}}
{{emote|*This done, =pronouns.subjective= nods once more and turns back to =pronouns.possessive= work.*}}

strings.string:
{{emote|*Sparafucile 用雙手比出「L」型，大拇指朝下且手指相對，接著翻轉雙手使 =pronouns.possessive= 的大拇指朝上。隨後 =pronouns.Subjective= 將握拳舉至 =pronouns.possessive= 的嘴邊，大拇指向外，並做出從中飲用的動作。*}}
{{emote|*完成這些動作後，=pronouns.subjective= 再次點頭，並轉身回到 =pronouns.possessive= 的工作之中。*}}

string.ID:
Oh. Are you lost, =player.formalAddressTerm=?
I don't mind that you're here, but I was not expecting anyone.

strings.string:
喔。您迷路了嗎，=player.formalAddressTerm=?
我不介意您在這裡，但我沒料到會有人來。

string.ID: Is this it, I wonder?

strings.string: 我在想，就是這裡了嗎？

string.ID: Not today.

strings.string: 今天不行。

string.ID: What do you think of Klanq's visit?

strings.string: 你覺得 克蘭克(Klanq) 的拜訪怎麼樣？

string.ID: Good to see you, Iseppa. Let's chat.

strings.string: 很高興見到你，伊塞帕。來聊聊吧。

string.ID:
I don't know.
Klanq's opacity is alluring, frustrating, and dangerous. Like Klanq, my thoughts on Klanq evade easy explanation.
What you build together will be amazing. Craft well.

strings.string:
我不知道。
克蘭克(Klanq) 的晦澀令人著迷、挫敗且危險。就像 克蘭克(Klanq) 一樣，我對 克蘭克(Klanq) 的想法也難以簡單解釋。
你們共同建造的東西將會很驚人。好好工藝吧。

string.ID: Well, I should go. Live and drink.

strings.string: 好了，我該走了。盡情生活，盡情飲酒吧。

string.ID:
These are the final chapters of this story, =name=, and likely of many stories more too.
It will be well to see the other side of all this, one way or another.

strings.string:
這是這個故事的最後幾章了，=name=，也可能是許多其他故事的終章。
無論如何，親眼見證這一切的另一面會是件好事。

string.ID: I must enter Brightsheol through the Tomb of the Eaters.

strings.string: 我必須透過食者之墓進入布萊特希歐。

string.ID: Let's talk, Iseppa.

strings.string: 我們談談吧，伊塞帕。

string.ID: It will. Live and drink.

strings.string: 會的。活著，並盡情暢飲。

string.ID:
You're going to the Thin World? I confess to some measure of envy.
I have dreamt many times of disappearing into a cool ocean of information, shaking the cruft of my physical form from newly-freed quills. If that came of my waking life, would I then dream as chore-doing Iseppa in her chambers? Perhaps it's best I don't know.

strings.string:
你要前往薄世界？我不得不承認，我有些羨慕。
我曾多次夢見自己消失在涼爽的資訊海洋中，將肉體形態的塵垢從新獲得自由的刺上抖落。如果那是我清醒生活後的結果，那我是否會像在寢室裡做著雜務的伊塞帕那樣做夢？或許不知道才是最好的。

string.ID: Very well, Iseppa. Live and drink.

strings.string: 很好，伊塞帕。盡情生活，盡情飲酒吧。

string.ID: Do you know anything about Bethesda Susa?

strings.string: 你對 貝賽達蘇薩(Bethesda Susa) 有所了解嗎？

string.ID: What do you know about Omonporch and the self-appointed Earl?

strings.string: 關於 歐蒙波奇(Omonporch) 和那位自封的伯爵，你了解多少？

string.ID: Did you feel that rumbling, Iseppa?

strings.string: 妳感覺到那陣隆隆聲了嗎，伊塞帕？

string.ID: Have you ever met Pax Klanq?

strings.string: 你曾遇見過 派克斯克蘭克 嗎？

string.ID: What are you working on, Iseppa?

strings.string: 你在忙些什麼呢，伊塞帕？

string.ID: Are you tired?

strings.string: 你累了嗎？

string.ID: I wish to know more about you.

strings.string: 我想多了解一些關於你的事。

string.ID: I do like you, Iseppa.

strings.string: 我挺喜歡你的，伊塞帕。

string.ID: Thank you, =name=. I like you too.

strings.string: 謝謝你，=name=。我也很喜歡你。

string.ID: What can you tell me about the other Barathrumites?

strings.string: 關於其他的巴拉楚姆信徒，你能告訴我些什麼？

string.ID:
Bethesda Susa is an antipodal place, a gallery of life and death and the stages between. Its depths prolong life and end it early, remove life from the flow of days or return it.
It will seek to make you late. Take care you come back on time.

strings.string:
貝賽達蘇薩是一個對跖之地，是生命、死亡及其過渡階段的藝廊。其深處能延續生命，亦能使其早逝，將生命從時光的流轉中抹除，或使其回歸。
它會試圖讓你遲到。務必小心準時歸來。

string.ID:
Though I adore the sights and smells of Omonporch, its bug problem becomes distracting.
If I'm to travel there, I always bring something they cannot zip away from.

strings.string:
雖然我愛慕歐蒙波奇的景色與氣味，但那裡的蟲害問題令人分心。
如果我要去那裡旅行，我總是會帶些牠們無法遁逃的東西。

string.ID:
Yes. That was not the voice of the caverns.
It feels like one of my nightmares come to life at last.

strings.string:
是的。那並非洞穴的聲音。
感覺就像我其中一個噩夢終於成真了。

string.ID:
I have not.
I would, however, love to meet him. He seems a fun fungus.
But I daren't go. I fear the sludges.

strings.string:
我沒有。
不過，我很想見見他。他看起來像個有趣的真菌。
但我不敢去。我害怕 污泥怪。

string.ID: You fear sludge?

strings.string: 你在害怕污泥嗎？

string.ID: I see.

strings.string: 我明白了。

string.ID:
I fear sludges, the kind you may no longer describe with 'some'. Born of the ancient stuff of existence, possessed of malice and wanting nothing more than to eat whatever they can, and they can eat whatever. It is even worse when they drink.
Take care with them.

strings.string:
我害怕 污泥怪，那種你再也無法用「某些」來形容的存在。牠們誕生於存在之古老物質，懷揣惡意，除了吞噬任何能吃到的東西外別無所求，而且牠們什麼都能吃。當牠們進食液體時甚至更加可怕。
與牠們相處時要小心。

string.ID:
I am always tired, =player.formalAddressTerm=.
My sleep comes in fits and starts, and always with ghastly visions. Sometimes my rest must be coaxed along with medicine.

strings.string:
我總是感到疲憊，=player.formalAddressTerm=。
我的睡眠斷斷續續，且總是伴隨著恐怖的幻象。有時我必須依靠藥物才能入睡。

string.ID: You have prophetic visions in your sleep?

strings.string: 你在睡夢中會有預言般的幻象嗎？

string.ID: I see. That seems difficult.

strings.string: 我明白了。那似乎很困難。
喔。

string.ID:
Mm-hmm.
{{emote|*Iseppa yawns.*}}

strings.string:
嗯哼。
{{emote|*伊塞帕 打了個哈欠。*}}

string.ID:
I am Iseppa, and she is me.
I've given thought to being someone else, but never enough to try.

strings.string:
我是伊塞帕，而她就是我。
我也曾考慮過成為別人，但從未深思到足以付諸行動。

string.ID: I am contemplating the distinction between animal and rock. Why are they different? How much like a rock must an animal be when it ceases to be an animal?

strings.string: 我正在思考動物與岩石之間的區別。為什麼它們不同？當一個動物不再是動物時，它必須變得多像岩石？

string.ID: I am considering the window of consciousness through which each of us views the universe. What happens to it when we die?

strings.string: 我正在思考每個人觀察宇宙的意識之窗。當我們死亡時，它會發生什麼事？

string.ID: I am taking inventory of my faculties, and looking for any that I might not previously have considered.

strings.string: 我正在盤點我的能力，並尋找任何我先前未曾考慮過的潛能。

string.ID: I am considering the thought as a discrete object. I wish to determine whether I am able to think a single thought only, and to determine how to distinguish it from another thought in the same vein.

strings.string: 我正將這個念頭視為一個獨立的客體。我希望確定自己是否僅能思考單一的念頭，並試圖釐清如何將其與同類型的另一個念頭區分開來。

string.ID: I am considering the determination of goodness and badness in a thing, and how it is determined. The interaction between data and subjective evaluation, and the values that guide us that we cannot put to words.

strings.string: 我正在思考事物善惡的判定，以及其判定的方式。數據與主觀評價之間的互動，以及那些我們無法用言語表達、引導著我們的價值觀。

string.ID: I am contemplating the Spindle's place in Qud, its position as a conceptual focal point. How much of what we know of the Spindle is the craft of those before us, carried forward?

strings.string: 我正在思考 紡錘的 在 卡德(Qud) 中的地位，以及它作為一個概念焦點的位置。我們所知關於 紡錘(Spindle) 的知識，有多少是前人傳承下來的技藝？

string.ID: I am considering narrative inheritances. The stories we were told when our minds were more putty-like, the follies that shaped who we are, that shape the whole of Qud.

strings.string: 我正在思考敘事繼承。那些在我們心智尚且柔軟時被訴說的故事，那些塑造了我們、並形塑了整個 卡德(Qud) 的愚行。

string.ID: Oh. It looks like you are sorting screws and fasteners.

strings.string: 喔。你看起來正在分類螺絲和緊固件。

string.ID: Have you come to any conclusions?

strings.string: 你有得出什麼結論嗎？

string.ID: I shall leave you to it. Live and drink, contemplatrix.

strings.string: 我就不打擾你了。活著並盡情暢飲吧，沉思者。
是的。

string.ID: But you're also doing the other thing.

strings.string: 但你也在做另一件事。

string.ID: I'll leave you to it.

strings.string: 我就不打擾你了。

string.ID: Not yet, but that's not the point.

strings.string: 還沒，但那不是重點。

string.ID: Oh, I see.

strings.string: 喔，我明白了。

string.ID: I'll leave you to it, then.

strings.string: 那我就不打擾你了。

string.ID: Who are you? Get out of my work space!

strings.string: 你是誰？離開我的工作空間！

string.ID: Sorry! I'm going!

strings.string: 抱歉！我走了！

string.ID: Innovation's sworn enemies have come knocking, =name=. Let us answer them.

strings.string: 創新的宿敵找上門了，=name=。讓我們給他們回應吧。

string.ID: Take care.

strings.string: 保重。

string.ID: =name=. Come in. Eat.

strings.string: =name=。進來吧。吃點東西。

string.ID: You seem more irritated than usual.

strings.string: 妳看起來比平常更煩躁。

string.ID: About your workshop...

strings.string: 關於你的 工作坊...

string.ID:
Otho has forbidden me from requesting a sample of Klanq. I am to refrain from being puffed on, to cultivate my own!
Are we yet researchers? Is subject consent no longer adequate ethical rigor? Let Klanq puff on Dardi!

strings.string:
奧托禁止我索取 克蘭克(Klanq) 的樣本。我必須克制自己不被吸食，而是要培育自己的！
我們現在還是研究員嗎？受試者的同意難道不再足以構成倫理嚴謹性了嗎？讓 克蘭克(Klanq) 去吸食達迪吧！

string.ID: Well, I should go. Live and drink.

strings.string: 好了，我該走了。盡情生活，盡情飲酒吧。

string.ID: Death to all subjugators who dare face us.

strings.string: 凡敢與我們對抗的征服者，皆應死。

string.ID: I must enter Brightsheol through the Tomb of the Eaters.

strings.string: 我必須透過食者之墓進入布萊特希歐。

string.ID: About your workshop...

strings.string: 關於你的 工作坊...

string.ID: Oh? Oh! Do pick up the mopango recipe for bone babka while you're there, won't you? I must know how they make it so dense.

strings.string: 喔？喔！既然你要去那裡，順便幫我帶一份 莫龐戈(Mopango) 的骨頭巴巴食譜好嗎？我一定要弄清楚他們是怎麼把它做得那麼紮實的。

string.ID:
{{emote|*Dardi addresses you without looking up from =pronouns.possessive= many workspaces, many of which billow smoke, steam, or some unknown miasma.*}}
Welcome to my laboratory, =name=. Rest and sustain =player.reflexive= before returning to your travels.

strings.string:
{{emote|*Dardi 甚至沒有抬頭看你，就對你說話了。四周是無數的工作台，其中許多正冒著煙、蒸汽或某種不明的瘴氣。*}}
歡迎來到我的實驗室，=name=。在繼續你的旅程之前，先休息一下並補充 =player.reflexive= 吧。 =pronouns.possessive=

string.ID: Do you know anything about Bethesda Susa?

strings.string: 你對 貝賽達蘇薩(Bethesda Susa) 有所了解嗎？

string.ID: What do you know about Omonporch and the self-appointed Earl?

strings.string: 關於 歐蒙波奇(Omonporch) 和那位自封的伯爵，你了解多少？

string.ID: Did you feel that rumbling, Dardi?

strings.string: 你有感覺到那陣隆隆聲嗎，達迪？

string.ID: Have you ever met Pax Klanq?

strings.string: 你曾遇見過 派克斯克蘭克 嗎？

string.ID: That smell from the oven is... indescribable.

strings.string: 烤箱傳出的那股味道……難以言喻。

string.ID: What are you working on?

strings.string: 你在忙什麼？

string.ID: Laboratory? You work in a kitchen.

strings.string: 實驗室？你在廚房工作啊。

string.ID: Live and drink, food-tinkerer.

strings.string: 活下去，盡情暢飲吧，食物改造者。

string.ID:
Yes! I have braved its wharf in the past, to gather precious convalessence for my experiments.
Are you going? Dress warmly and mind the trolls.

strings.string:
是的！我過去曾冒險前往其碼頭，為我的實驗收集珍貴的康復劑。
你要去嗎？穿暖些，並留意巨魔。

string.ID: Did you call this kitchen your laboratory?

strings.string: 你把這間廚房稱為你的實驗室嗎？

string.ID: Live and drink, food-tinkerer.

strings.string: 活下去，盡情暢飲吧，食物改造者。

string.ID:
Omonporch is a fine source of bananas, but I have little to say about self-appointed nobility.
Claimed authority has a heady aroma, but no broth beneath it. Let us simply appease Asphodel and leave xem to xyr fantasies.

strings.string:
歐蒙波奇是香蕉的好來源，但我對那些自封的貴族沒什麼好說的。
自稱的權威聞起來很香，卻沒有實質的內容。讓我們就這樣安撫阿斯福德爾，讓 xem 去追求 xyr 的幻想吧。

string.ID: Live and drink, food-tinkerer.

strings.string: 活下去，盡情暢飲吧，食物改造者。

string.ID:
My air-puffed pastry experiment collapsed thanks to that disturbance.
Whoever is responsible will pay dearly.

strings.string:
我的充氣酥皮實驗因為那次騷動而失敗了。
無論誰是罪魁禍首，都將付出沉重的代價。

string.ID: Live and drink, food-tinkerer.

strings.string: 活下去，盡情暢飲吧，食物改造者。

string.ID:
I have visited the rainbow wood but once, and there I sampled an array of strange foods, one of which allowed me an unusual lens through which to view the world. It was nothing like I had ever experienced, and I imagined such wondrous recipes. I wrote them all down as best I could, of course.
Sadly, once I returned to my ordinary frame of reference, my scribblings proved impossible to read. So it goes.

strings.string:
我曾造訪過一次 彩虹之林，在那裡我品嚐了一系列奇特的食物，其中一種讓我獲得了一種觀察世界的奇特視角。那是我從未有過的體驗，我甚至想像出了如此美妙的食譜。當然，我盡可能地將它們全都記錄了下來。
遺憾的是，一旦我回到原本的認知框架，我的筆記便變得無法辨識。事已至此，也只能如此了。
