string.ID: Live and drink, food-tinkerer.

strings.string: 活下去，盡情暢飲吧，食物改造者。

string.ID:
What you smell is Grit Gate's signature dish. The Porridge is a recipe passed down through generations of Barathrumites, and it is the food that inspired me to pursue my craft. Yes, outsiders quail at the intensity of the scent, for its flavor is as bold as its effects!
We use cuisine to channel lightning from our bodies! Other recipes may let us breathe fire, or learn the secrets of the Eaters. The Porridge is as precious a part of our legacy as the Barathrum Clock or the foaminator.

strings.string:
你聞到的味道是礫門的招牌菜。這款粥是巴拉楚姆信徒代代相傳的食譜，也是啟發我追求技藝的食物。是的，外來者會對那強烈的氣味感到畏縮，因為它的風味與其效果一樣強勁！
我們利用料理來引導體內的閃電！其他食譜或許能讓我們吐火，或習得食噬者的秘密。「粥」是我們傳承中如巴拉楚姆時鐘或泡沫產生器般珍貴的一部分。

string.ID: Live and drink, food-tinkerer.

strings.string: 活下去，盡情暢飲吧，食物改造者。

string.ID:
Oh, it changes by the hour, sometimes the minute. Preserve this, observe that, add anything, taste everything.
But the starapple of my eye, the Spindle up which I cast my ambitious gaze... is edible vapor. Food that you eat, food that you breathe. Sadly, to date the most I have managed is an herbed saline suspension. Salty air, if you will.

strings.string:
喔，它每小時都在變化，有時甚至是以分鐘計。保留這一切、觀察那一切、添加任何事物、品嚐每一種味道。
但我眼中最珍貴的星蘋果，我那雄心壯志所投射的紡錘（紡錘(Spindle)）……卻是可食用的蒸氣。那是你可以吃下的食物，也是你可以呼吸的食物。遺憾的是，到目前為止，我所能做出的最高成就僅是一份草本鹽水懸浮液。如果你願意的話，可以稱之為鹹味空氣。

string.ID: Vapor... and salt?

strings.string: 水蒸氣……還有鹽？

string.ID: Good luck with your experiments, then.

strings.string: 那麼，祝你的實驗好運。

string.ID: Well, I should be going.

strings.string: 好了，我該走了。

string.ID: Yes. The flavor, the breathability, all successful, but the barrier between flavor and food is in the calories, and they have yet eluded me. But it is only a matter of time. I am patient, and I am relentless.

strings.string: 是的。風味、透氣性，一切都很成功，但風味與食物之間的界限在於熱量，而它們至今仍讓我無法捉摸。但這只是時間問題。我有耐心，且永不放棄。

string.ID: Good luck, then.

strings.string: 那麼，祝你好運。

string.ID: I will leave you to it. Live and drink.

strings.string: 我就不打擾你了。活下去，盡情飲用吧。

string.ID:
I have no need for luck, but I appreciate your well-wishes nonetheless.
May your own endeavors drive you as mine drive me. Did you wish to speak of anything else?

strings.string:
我不需要運氣，但我還是很感謝你的祝福。
願你自己的事業也能如我的事業般驅動著你。你還想聊聊其他事情嗎？

string.ID: Live and drink, food-tinkerer.

strings.string: 活下去，盡情暢飲吧，食物改造者。

string.ID: Kitchen? You think this a mere kitchen?

strings.string: 廚房？你以為這僅僅是一間廚房嗎？

string.ID: It certainly looks like a kitchen.

strings.string: 這看起來確實很像個廚房。

string.ID: No, of course it's a laboratory, I wasn't thinking.

strings.string: 不，這當然是一間實驗室，是我沒想周全。

string.ID: Why don't I see myself out?

strings.string: 不用我送你出去了吧？

string.ID:
And I suppose the Stilt is a modest church, its great bazaar a junk sale?
Look about you. Every instrument you see is precision-calibrated, every tool handcrafted and built to last. In this room, sustenance and ingenuity come together to evolve cuisine itself, to shape not this culture alone but, over time, every culture. Is that kind of influence the product of a kitchen? Can a simple clay oven in the flower fields do what we do here? Has every kitchen an indelible influence over Qud?
{{emote|*He frowns.*}}
Should they? Should we not all?

strings.string:
我想說，高腳林（Stilt）只是一座不起眼的教堂，而它的巨大集市不過是場跳蚤市場？
看看你的四周。你所見到的每一件儀器都經過精密校準，每一件工具都是手工打造且經久耐用。在這個房間裡，生計與巧思結合在一起，演化出烹飪本身，不僅形塑了這種文化，隨著時間推移，更形塑了每一種文化。那樣的影響力是廚房的產物嗎？在 花田 裡一個簡單的 黏土烤爐 能做到我們在這裡所做的一切嗎？難道每一間廚房都對 卡德(Qud) 有著不可磨滅的影響嗎？
{{emote|*他皺起眉頭。*}}
他們應該這麼做嗎？難道我們不都應該嗎？
怎麼了？
不？

string.ID: I'm lost.

strings.string: 我迷路了。

string.ID: *mutter 'live and drink' while backing away*

strings.string: *一邊退後一邊咕噥著「活著與飲酒」*

string.ID:
But perhaps you are right, =player.formalAddressTerm=. Think for a moment.
Every ingredient in the soup of collective knowledge is a valuable one, and who am I to elevate myself over more humble pioneers? But! All the more reason for us to regard cuisine (and by extension, culture itself) to be a scientific endeavor, an ongoing trial-and-error, a blending of what we know and what we don't know, calling upon reality itself to be our guide.
You are more insightful than I realized, =name=. Thank you for this discussion. Did you need aught else?

strings.string:
但或許你是對的，=player.formalAddressTerm=。思考片刻吧。
集體知識這碗湯裡的每一種食材都是珍貴的，而我又是誰，竟敢把自己凌駕於更謙卑的先驅者之上？但是！這更有理由讓我們將烹飪（以及延伸出的文化本身）視為一項科學事業，一場持續不斷的試錯過程，一種將已知與未知融合的嘗試，並呼喚現實本身作為我們的嚮導。
你比我想像中更具洞察力，=name=。感謝這次討論。你還有其他需要嗎？

string.ID: Live and drink, food-tinkerer.

strings.string: 活下去，盡情暢飲吧，食物改造者。

string.ID: I propose an accord, =factionaddress:Barathrumites=: You remove =player.reflexive= from my sight immediately, and I will refrain from asking that Ereshkigal reduce you to your component atoms.

strings.string: 我提議達成協議，=factionaddress:Barathrumites=：你立刻從我眼前移除 =player.reflexive=，我就不會要求那位 Ereshkigal 將你還原成最原始的原子。

string.ID: I'm going, I'm going.

strings.string: 我走了，我走了。

string.ID: Not like this. After all we've accomplished...

strings.string: 不該是這樣的。畢竟我們已經成就了這麼多...

string.ID: Don't lose hope.

strings.string: 不要放棄希望。

string.ID: Ah. It's you again, returning from ever more unreturnable locales. Alive and come to bother the disagreeable urshiib.

strings.string: 啊。又是你，從那些更無法回頭的地方歸來。還活著，而且是來煩擾這討人厭的 urshiib。

string.ID: What do you think of Klanq's visit?

strings.string: 你覺得 克蘭克(Klanq) 的拜訪怎麼樣？

string.ID: Can we talk, Aloysius?

strings.string: 我們可以談談嗎，阿洛修斯？

string.ID:
I did not consider that my life could be further upturned. Truly, I have learned much and I hate it all.
Once you lot reach the spindle's apex, perhaps you could be convinced to stay there? Or perhaps I could go in your stead.

strings.string:
我沒想到我的生活還能被如此翻轉。真的，我學到了很多，而我討厭這一切。
一旦你們抵達 紡錘的 頂點，或許可以說服你們留在那裡？或者或許我可以代替你們前往。

string.ID: We will miss you too, Aloysius. Live and drink.

strings.string: 我們也會想念你的，阿洛修斯。盡情生活與飲酒吧。

string.ID:
I spent so long preparing for the eventuality that my home might be breached.
I was not ready. This sense of violation burns like electrocautery.

strings.string:
我花了這麼多時間準備家園可能被攻破的意外情況。
但我還沒準備好。這種被侵犯的感覺像電灼一樣灼痛。

string.ID: I must enter Brightsheol through the Tomb of the Eaters.

strings.string: 我必須透過食者之墓進入布萊特希歐。

string.ID: Can we talk, Aloysius?

strings.string: 我們可以談談嗎，阿洛修斯？

string.ID: Good. Shut the sarcophagus door behind you.

strings.string: 很好。記得把身後的 石棺 門關上。

string.ID: Perhaps I will.

strings.string: 或許我會。

string.ID:
Of course it was only a matter of time before you came to speak to me.
I don't suppose I can convince you to let me tend to my duties in peace? I know nothing of interest to a wayfarer. Each of my days is like the others; I maintain and protect my children, and this is enough. If I desire conversation, there is Ereshkigal.

strings.string:
你來找我談話，當然只是遲早的事。
我想我應該沒辦法說服你讓我安靜地履行職責吧？我所知道的一切對旅人來說都毫無趣味。我的每一天都如往常一般；守護並照料我的孩子們，這就足夠了。如果我渴望交談，還有 Ereshkigal 在。

string.ID: Do you know anything about Bethesda Susa?

strings.string: 你對 貝賽達蘇薩(Bethesda Susa) 有所了解嗎？

string.ID: What do you know about Omonporch and the self-appointed Earl?

strings.string: 關於 歐蒙波奇(Omonporch) 和那位自封的伯爵，你了解多少？

string.ID: Did you feel that rumbling, Aloysius?

strings.string: 你有感覺到那陣隆隆聲嗎，阿洛修斯？

string.ID: Have you ever met Pax Klanq?

strings.string: 你曾遇見過 派克斯克蘭克 嗎？

string.ID: You have children?

strings.string: 你有孩子嗎？

string.ID: You don't care for conversation?

strings.string: 你不喜歡交談嗎？

string.ID: Who is Ereshkigal?

strings.string: 伊蕾許卡蓋（Ereshkigal）是誰？

string.ID: Live and drink in peace, Aloysius.

strings.string: 平安地生活與飲酒吧，阿洛修斯。

string.ID:
Bethesda Susa is a vibrant and thriving ecosystem in which we have no place. That said, I certainly would not complain if someone were to clear out its Mechanimist infestation.
Should you travel there, watch your step. The fronds of a lurking beth can rapidly exsanguinate fleshy creatures such as we.

strings.string:
貝賽達蘇薩(Bethesda Susa) 是一個充滿活力且繁榮的生態系統，但我們在那裡沒有立足之地。話雖如此，如果有人能清除那裡的機械主義者侵害，我 certainly 不會抱怨。
如果你前往那裡，請小心腳下。潛伏的貝絲 的葉片能迅速抽乾像我們這種肉身生物的血液。

string.ID: Live and drink in peace, Aloysius.

strings.string: 平安地生活與飲酒吧，阿洛修斯。

string.ID:
I know that Omonporch is a miserable, hot place and Asphodel is a self-important churl.
I don't even like bananas.

strings.string:
我知道 歐蒙波奇(Omonporch) 是個悲慘且炎熱的地方，而 阿斯福德爾 是個自命不凡的粗漢。
我甚至不喜歡香蕉。

string.ID: Live and drink in peace, Aloysius.

strings.string: 平安地生活與飲酒吧，阿洛修斯。

string.ID: Yes, and I fear the worst. Hie to Ereshkigal. She will know what to do.

strings.string: 是的，我擔心最壞的情況發生。趕快去厄瑞絲基伽勒那裡吧。她會知道該怎麼做。

string.ID: Live and drink in peace, Aloysius.

strings.string: 平安地生活與飲酒吧，阿洛修斯。

string.ID:
I have met Pax Klanq. I was puffed on.
Candidly, I prefer fungi edible and inert.

strings.string:
我遇見了派克斯克蘭克。我被他欺負了。
坦白說，我更喜歡真菌類的可食用且無害的食物。

string.ID: Live and drink in peace, Aloysius.

strings.string: 平安地生活與飲酒吧，阿洛修斯。

string.ID: My chromelings, my machines, my crops. I tend to them and they tend to me.

strings.string: 我的鉻族人，我的機器，我的作物。我照料牠們，牠們也照料我。

string.ID: Live and drink in peace, Aloysius.

strings.string: 平安地生活與飲酒吧，阿洛修斯。

string.ID:
Speaking to other organics is as strenuous to me as any physical exercise.
My reclusiveness is not born of antipathy; I simply cannot converse as easily as you do and don't wish to learn how.

strings.string:
與其他有機生物交談對我而言就像任何體力運動一樣艱辛。
我的隱遁並非源於反感；我只是無法像你那樣輕鬆地交談，也不想學習如何做到。

string.ID: Live and drink in peace, Aloysius.

strings.string: 平安地生活與飲酒吧，阿洛修斯。

string.ID:
Ereshkigal is the mainframe computer of Grit Gate. She keeps watch through the thin world, as she would put it, while we maintain her presence in the thick world.
I feel as though she and I understand one another.

strings.string:
Ereshkigal 是礫門的主機電腦。她透過她所謂的「薄世界」進行監視，而我們則在厚實的世界中維持她的存在。
我覺得她與我之間心領神會。

string.ID: Live and drink in peace, Aloysius.

strings.string: 平安地生活與飲酒吧，阿洛修斯。

string.ID: =player.OffspringTerm=, who are you?

strings.string: =player.OffspringTerm=，你是誰？

string.ID: Stay safe, =name=. Please.

strings.string: 請保重，=name=。拜託了。

string.ID: Live and drink, Hortensa.

strings.string: 盡情生活與飲酒吧，霍騰莎。

string.ID:
=name=, you are back! I feared we would lose you in the Tomb, but you look better than well. Perhaps I should have had greater faith, or at least less worry.
Have you visited Barathrum's workshop, by the by? Klanq and Q Girl await you there.

strings.string:
=name=，你回來了！我曾擔心我們會在墳墓中失去你，但你看起來不僅是好轉，簡直是神采奕奕。或許我當初應該更有信心，或者至少少一點擔憂。
順帶一提，你有去過 巴拉楚姆的 工作坊 嗎？克蘭克(Klanq) 和 Q 女孩正在那裡等你。

string.ID: I have.

strings.string: 我有。

string.ID: Not yet.

strings.string: 尚未。

string.ID: Hie there now. Being tardy with Klanq carries risk, not so much from its offense as from its idle curiosity.

strings.string: 現在快走。遲延與 克蘭克(Klanq) 往來是有風險的，其風險不在於其攻擊性，而在於其閒置時的好奇心。

string.ID: Very well. Live and drink.

strings.string: 很好。盡情生活與飲酒吧。

string.ID: I am further relieved to know of another perspective looking upon this work. Klanq's presence here is vital, but it discomfits me: I cannot help but consider the introduction of chaos to an already chaotic endeavor to be a... conflagratory strategy.

strings.string: 得知有另一個觀點看待這項工作，我感到更加寬慰。克蘭克(Klanq) 在這裡的存在至關重要，但卻令我感到不安：我不禁認為在一個本就混亂的事業中引入混沌，是一種……煽動性的策略。

string.ID: I will exercise my best judgement. Live and drink.

strings.string: 我會運用我的判斷力。活下去，盡情飲酒吧。

string.ID: I drink in the sight of you, cub. Thank you for keeping safe.

strings.string: 小傢伙，注視著你令我陶醉。感謝你保持安全。

string.ID: I must enter Brightsheol through the Tomb of the Eaters.

strings.string: 我必須透過食者之墓進入布萊特希歐。

string.ID: Drink deeply of life, Hortensa. Let's talk.

strings.string: 盡情享受生命吧，霍騰莎。我們談談。

string.ID: You too. Live and drink.

strings.string: 你也是。活著，並盡情暢飲。

string.ID:
... I do not like this.
I know you will go. Please take care where you dig; mopango wanderers say the hot blood of Eater artifice yet runs in the guts of that place.

strings.string:
... 我不喜歡這樣。
我知道你會離去。請小心挖掘；莫龐戈(Mopango) 的流浪者說，食者人工造物的熱血至今仍流淌在那個地方的腹地之中。

string.ID: I thank you.

strings.string: 我謝謝你。

string.ID: Drink deeply of life, =player.offspringTerm=. Are you finding your way?

strings.string: 盡情享受生命吧，=player.offspringTerm=。你找到方向了嗎？

string.ID: Do you know anything about Bethesda Susa?

strings.string: 你對 貝賽達蘇薩(Bethesda Susa) 有所了解嗎？

string.ID: What do you know about Omonporch and the self-appointed Earl?

strings.string: 關於 歐蒙波奇(Omonporch) 和那位自封的伯爵，你了解多少？

string.ID: Did you feel that rumbling, Hortensa?

strings.string: 你有感覺到那陣隆隆聲嗎，霍騰莎？

string.ID: Have you ever met Pax Klanq?

strings.string: 你曾遇見過 派克斯克蘭克 嗎？

string.ID: Your hair is so gray! How long have you lived in Grit Gate?

strings.string: 你的頭髮都白了！你在 礫門(Grit Gate) 住多久了？

string.ID: Could you tell me about the other Barathrumites?

strings.string: 你能告訴我關於其他巴拉楚姆信徒的事嗎？

string.ID: Are you a liquid-tinker?

strings.string: 你是個液體修補匠嗎？

string.ID:
There are pools of convalessence there. You see, when cryogenic mist condenses, it forms a cool, luminous liquid that's restorative if you're able to bathe in it.
Oh! And in one of the ruined wards, the Alchemist keeps their shop. Who's the Alchemist, you ask? A sort of enigmatic figure -- amateur liquid-tinker, poet, merchant. Their methods aren't scientific, but they are useful if you're seeking a specific kind of liquid. Just be careful around them, =name=.

strings.string:
那裡有著康復池。你看，當低溫霧氣凝結時，會形成一種涼爽且發光的液體，如果你能浸泡其中，它具有修復功效。
喔！在其中一間廢棄病房裡，煉金術士（Alchemist）經營著他們的商店。你問誰是煉金術士？那是一個神祕的人物——業餘液體改造者、詩人、商人。他們的手段並不科學，但如果你正在尋找特定種類的液體，他們會很有用。在他們身邊要小心點，=name=。
那裡有康復池。你看，當 低溫薄霧 凝結時，會形成一種冰涼且發光的液體，如果你能浸泡其中，它具有修復功能。
喔！在其中一個廢墟區域中，煉金術士 經營著他們的店鋪。你問誰是 煉金術士？那是一個神祕的人物——業餘液體 修補匠、詩人、商人。他們的方法並不科學，但如果你正在尋找某種特定的液體，他們會很有用。只是在他們身邊要小心點，=name=。

string.ID: What do you know about Omonporch and the self-appointed Earl?

strings.string: 關於 歐蒙波奇(Omonporch) 和那位自封的伯爵，你了解多少？

string.ID: Did you feel that rumbling, Hortensa?

strings.string: 你有感覺到那陣隆隆聲嗎，霍騰莎？

string.ID: Have you ever met Pax Klanq?

strings.string: 你曾遇見過 派克斯克蘭克 嗎？

string.ID: Your hair is so gray! How long have you lived in Grit Gate?

strings.string: 你的頭髮都白了！你在 礫門(Grit Gate) 住多久了？

string.ID: Could you tell me about the other Barathrumites?

strings.string: 你能告訴我關於其他巴拉楚姆信徒的事嗎？

string.ID: Are you a liquid-tinker?

strings.string: 你是個液體修補匠嗎？

string.ID: Nothing other than a pet theory of mine that the Spindle is a liquid in laminar flow.

strings.string: 除了我的一個個人理論外，沒別的事了——那就是我覺得 紡錘(Spindle) 是處於層流狀態的液體。

string.ID: Do you know anything about Bethesda Susa?

strings.string: 你對 貝賽達蘇薩(Bethesda Susa) 有所了解嗎？

string.ID: Did you feel that rumbling, Hortensa?

strings.string: 你有感覺到那陣隆隆聲嗎，霍騰莎？

string.ID: Have you ever met Pax Klanq?

strings.string: 你曾遇見過 派克斯克蘭克 嗎？

string.ID: Your hair is so gray! How long have you lived in Grit Gate?

strings.string: 你的頭髮都白了！你在 礫門(Grit Gate) 住多久了？

string.ID: Could you tell me about the other Barathrumites?

strings.string: 你能告訴我關於其他巴拉楚姆信徒的事嗎？

string.ID: Are you a liquid-tinker?

strings.string: 你是個液體修補匠嗎？

string.ID: Yes! I was even provided with a brief premonition of it, as my workbench liquids are sensitive to small vibrations around the enclave.

strings.string: 是的！我甚至對此有了一絲預感，因為我的 工作檯 液體對封地周圍的微小震動非常敏感。

string.ID: Do you know anything about Bethesda Susa?

strings.string: 你對 貝賽達蘇薩(Bethesda Susa) 有所了解嗎？

string.ID: What do you know about Omonporch and the self-appointed Earl?

strings.string: 關於 歐蒙波奇(Omonporch) 和那位自封的伯爵，你了解多少？

string.ID: Have you ever met Pax Klanq?

strings.string: 你曾遇見過 派克斯克蘭克 嗎？

string.ID: Your hair is so gray! How long have you lived in Grit Gate?

strings.string: 你的頭髮都白了！你在 礫門(Grit Gate) 住多久了？

string.ID: Could you tell me about the other Barathrumites?

strings.string: 你能告訴我關於其他巴拉楚姆信徒的事嗎？

string.ID: Are you a liquid-tinker?

strings.string: 你是個液體修補匠嗎？

string.ID:
Oh, yes. You see, years and years ago, we were studying optics in the course of our research into laser technology. Barathrum was giving a lecture to some guest attendees, and...
Oh, I'd rather not talk about it.

strings.string:
喔，是的。你看，很多很多年前，我們在研究雷射技術的過程中正在研究光學。巴拉楚姆(Barathrum) 當時正在向一些賓客進行講座，然後……
喔，我不太想談論那件事。

string.ID: Do you know anything about Bethesda Susa?

strings.string: 你對 貝賽達蘇薩(Bethesda Susa) 有所了解嗎？

string.ID: What do you know about Omonporch and the self-appointed Earl?

strings.string: 關於 歐蒙波奇(Omonporch) 和那位自封的伯爵，你了解多少？

string.ID: Did you feel that rumbling, Hortensa?

strings.string: 你有感覺到那陣隆隆聲嗎，霍騰莎？

string.ID: Your hair is so gray! How long have you lived in Grit Gate?

strings.string: 你的頭髮都白了！你在 礫門(Grit Gate) 住多久了？

string.ID: Could you tell me about the other Barathrumites?

strings.string: 你能告訴我關於其他巴拉楚姆信徒的事嗎？

string.ID: Are you a liquid-tinker?

strings.string: 你是個液體修補匠嗎？

string.ID:
{{emote|*Hortensa chuckles.*}}
Years. Decades on decades. Centuries, perhaps. Most of these wet-earred cubs were merely sketches in their mothers' dreambooks when I arrived to study under Barathrum. We knew so little then, know so little now.

strings.string:
{{emote|*霍騰莎 輕笑著。*}}
歲月。十年又十年。或許還有數世紀。當我來到巴拉楚姆門下學習時，這些乳臭未乾的小傢伙僅僅是我母親夢境之書中的草稿而已。那時我們知之甚少，現在也知之甚少。

string.ID: Could you tell me about the other Barathrumites?

strings.string: 你能告訴我關於其他巴拉楚姆信徒的事嗎？

string.ID: Are you a liquid-tinker?

strings.string: 你是個液體修補匠嗎？

string.ID:
{{emote|*Hortensa chuckles.*}}
You are sharp, =name=. In a way that's what I am. But liquids are more willful than scrap. I can't solder them together; they would run away, hide in the shale cracks, slowly come apart and disappear. I moreso think of myself as a wisewoman in dialogue with them -- I manage their moods and phases. My notebooks are full of their quirks and caprices. It's a wonder, isn't it, how at just the right temperature and pressure the continuity of matter is smashed apart? How the gaseous butterfly flits out of the dense worm?

strings.string:
{{emote|*Hortensa 輕笑著。*}}
你很敏銳，=name=。在某種程度上，我也正是如此。但液體比廢料更有自主意識。我無法將它們焊接在一起；它們會逃走，躲進頁岩的裂縫中，慢慢分解並消失。我更傾向於將自己視為與它們對話的智者——我管理著它們的情緒與相位。我的筆記本裡寫滿了它們的怪癖與反覆無常。這很奇妙，不是嗎？在恰到好處的溫度與壓力下，物質的連續性是如何被粉碎的？氣態的蝴蝶又是如何從稠密的蠕蟲中翩然飛出的？

string.ID: How long have you lived in Grit Gate?

string.ID: Could you tell me about the other Barathrumites?

strings.string: 你能告訴我關於其他巴拉楚姆信徒的事嗎？

string.ID:

string.ID: Oh, I have such a precious vantage point on my sweet neighbor! When he achieves a moment of perfection in his craft -- a flawlessly spiraled barrel, a mound of powder measured to the grain -- he beams like the high salt sun. What a lovely smile.

strings.string: 喔，我對我那可愛的鄰居有著如此珍貴的觀察視角！當他在工藝中達到完美的瞬間——一個螺旋完美無瑕的槍管，一堆精確到每一粒粉末的火藥——他會像高空的鹽之陽光般燦爛。多麼迷人的笑容。

string.ID: She explodes like gas and dust in a quiet corner of the galaxy. Radiant. Revolutionary. She's a good listener and companion for supper, which you mightn't expect.

strings.string: 她在銀河系一個靜謐的角落如氣體與塵埃般爆裂。光輝奪目。具有革命性。她是一個很好的傾聽者，也是晚餐時理想的伴侶，這或許出乎你的意料。

string.ID: After supper I like to retreat to the library, take a storybook off the shelves, flop down on the chairbear, and lose myself in another world. Many of these worlds feature palaces, markets, gardens, ships. Many of those places have bells. When they do, I always think of Mafeo. More than anyone else, Mafeo could be a character in the bright world of a story, where this dusty place is itself confined to a mere storybook.

strings.string: 晚餐後我喜歡退到圖書館，從書架上取下一本故事書，癱倒在椅熊上，沉浸在另一個世界中。這些世界中有許多宮殿、市場、花園和船隻。其中許多地方都有鐘聲。每當聽到鐘聲，我總會想起馬費歐。比起其他人，馬費歐更像是明亮故事世界中的角色，而這個塵土飛揚的地方本身僅僅是一本故事書。

string.ID: I've instructed Neek since they were a lil' cub. What a strange one! Bouncey. Full of smiles. But brilliant in their own way. My favorite book in all the world is Neek's "Spiderwebs on Hoversleds". Who would have ever thought?

strings.string: 我從 尼克 還小的時候就在指導他們了。真是個奇怪的孩子！蹦蹦跳跳的，總是帶著笑容。但在他們自己的方式上卻非常聰明。全世界我最喜歡的一本書就是 尼克的《懸浮雪橇上的蜘蛛網》。誰能想到呢？

strings.string: 珍貴的謝姆（Shem）。他們對世界的看法比我們要廣闊得多。我們為自己創造了多麼重大的責任，而我卻一點也不想撤銷它！

string.ID: I've shared my honey with that prickly troglodyte for more years than I can count. I can't help but like him, and while he won't admit it, he feels the same about me.

strings.string: 我與那位刺頭穴居人分享蜂蜜的時間，長到我無法計算。我不禁喜歡他，雖然他不會承認，但他對我的感覺也一樣。

string.ID: She's a sphinx! So enigmatic that one. It's not entirely clear if she was there, waiting, when Q Girl succeeded at retreading the mainframe's guts, or if she sparked into being that very moment. Or was it some synthesis of the two?

strings.string: 她是一隻斯芬克斯！那樣的神祕莫測。當 Q 女孩 成功重新修復主機核心時，並不完全清楚她是否就在那裡等待著，或者是在那一刻才突然誕生。又或者，這是兩者的結合？

string.ID:
{{emote|*Shem whispers*}}
You're not supposed to be here. But I won't tell.

strings.string:
{{emote|*Shem 低聲說*}}
你不該出現在這裡。但我不會告發你。

string.ID: Should I hide in the library? I believe it's the clever thing to do.

strings.string: 我應該躲進圖書館嗎？我想那是聰明的做法。

string.ID: Stay safe, Shem.

strings.string: 保重，Shem。

string.ID: Approach. Be easy. You are my herefriend, my nowfriend.

strings.string: 靠近些。放輕鬆。你是我的在此友，我的當下友。

string.ID: Would you like to read me a story?

strings.string: 你願意讀個故事給我聽嗎？

string.ID: I know of so many other ways to be.

strings.string: 我知道還有許多其他的生存方式。

string.ID: Where does it end?

strings.string: 終點在哪裡？

string.ID: I live, but do I drink?

strings.string: 我活著，但我有在飲酒嗎？

string.ID: Would you like to eat vapor?

strings.string: 你想吃蒸氣嗎？

string.ID: Quetzal, I say.

strings.string: 我說，是奎札爾(Quetzal)。

string.ID: {{emote|*Shem nods.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*Shem點了點頭。*}}

string.ID: The gaseous butterfly flits out of the dense worm.

strings.string: 氣態蝴蝶從密集的蠕蟲中翩然飛出。

string.ID: I am sharp. I am handy.

strings.string: 我很銳利。我也很靈巧。

string.ID: {{emote|*Shem yawns.*}} I am yawning.

strings.string: {{emote|*Shem yawns.*}} 我在打哈欠。

string.ID: 'Immaculate Chrome' is my favorite.

strings.string: 「純淨鉻」是我的最愛。

string.ID: I'm glad you are safe, Shem.

strings.string: 我很高興妳平安無事，Shem。

string.ID: What do you think of Klanq's visit?

strings.string: 你覺得 克蘭克(Klanq) 的拜訪怎麼樣？

string.ID: You're a chromeling... that speaks? Can you understand me?

strings.string: 你是一個會說話的……鉻人？你能聽懂我在說什麼嗎？

string.ID: Why are you called Shem -1?

strings.string: 為什麼你被稱為 謝姆-1(Shem -1)？

string.ID: I am your friend, Shem.

strings.string: 我是你的朋友，Shem。

string.ID: Live and... remain ever rustless.

strings.string: 生存下去……並永遠保持不鏽。

string.ID: I am glad you are safe, =name=.

strings.string: 我很高興你是安全的，=name=。

string.ID: I wonder if the distributed consciousness of a fungal entity is similar to that of a distributed machine mind. I shall ask Father when he is not so busy.

strings.string: 我在想真菌實體的分布式意識是否與分布式機器心智相似。等父親不那麼忙時，我再問他。

string.ID: Is... is this a question trick? I suppose I cannot know what you intend. Can I understand you?

strings.string: 這……這是陷阱問題嗎？我想我無法得知你的意圖。我能理解你嗎？

string.ID: I just meant to ask if you're able to communicate. It seems so.

strings.string: 我只是想問你是否能夠溝通。看來是可以的。

string.ID: What kind words. It seems so with you, too.

strings.string: 多麼親切的話。對你來說似乎也是如此。

string.ID:
Would you like to hear? When I was first put together by Father and friends, I was Shem 2, the second iteration of the make-me project.
As I came along, scampered through the halls, listened to the stories Neek read me, climbed onto Sparafucile's workbench to have my screws replaced, I realized I was not what I could be. And so I downgraded myself to Shem 1.
That has happened three times.

strings.string:
你想聽嗎？當我最初由父親和朋友們組合起來時，我是 Shem 2，是「製造我」計畫的第二次迭代。
隨著我逐漸成長，在走廊間奔跑、聆聽 尼克 讀給我的故事、爬上 斯帕拉福西爾的 工作檯 更換螺絲，我意識到我並非我所能達到的高度。因此，我將自己降級為 Shem 1。
這種事已經發生過三次了。

string.ID: Are you worried that you're getting further away from your ideal self?

strings.string: 你是否擔心自己正逐漸背離理想中的自我？

string.ID: It's unclear to me that I should be.

strings.string: 我不確定我該是誰。

string.ID: I am your friend, =name=.

strings.string: 我是你的朋友，=name=。

string.ID: Who are you? What? Please, do not disturb me.

strings.string: 你是誰？什麼？請不要打擾我。

string.ID:
The Templar are assaulting the enclave? Oh dear, dear...
May our guns' lasers shine with the light of the Kasaphescence.

strings.string:
聖騎士正在襲擊飛地？喔天哪，天哪⋯⋯
願我們槍械的雷射能閃耀著卡薩費森斯（Kasaphescence）之光。

string.ID: I must go.

strings.string: 我必須走了。

string.ID:
Why, =name=, Brightsheol treated you well. There is a new gravity about you; your proverbial boots ring louder in the Annals with each step.
I imagine you're off to Teach's study? They're already at work down there.

strings.string:
哎呀，=name=，「布萊特希歐」對你一直很好。你身上散發著一種新的氣場；隨著你的每一步，你那諺語中的「靴子」在編年史中迴響得愈發響亮。
我猜你是要去 Teach 的研究室？他們已經在那下面忙碌了。

string.ID: What do you think of Klanq's presence?

strings.string: 你對 克蘭克(Klanq) 的出現有何看法？

string.ID: Light shine through you, Jacobo. Let's talk.

strings.string: 光芒照耀著你，雅各布。我們談談吧。

string.ID:
I admit a burning curiosity to see the joined imagination of our Q Girl and Pax Klanq, and no doubt yours as well. Watching such a creation burgeon from empty space to fullness of being would be a joyful entry in the chronicles of my life, but...
Too many fingers tangle in the honeypot, as my cubhood mentor would tell me.

strings.string:
我承認，對於看到我們的 Q 女孩與派克斯克蘭克結合後的想像力，我感到強烈的好奇，毫無疑問你也是。看著這樣的創造物從真空空間茁壯成長到生命的圓滿，將會是我生命編年史中一段愉悅的紀錄，但是……
正如我童年時期的導師所說，蜜罐裡的手指太多了，容易弄亂一切。

string.ID: So they do. Live and drink, Jacobo.

strings.string: 他們確實如此。活下去並盡情暢飲吧，雅各布。

string.ID:
Never before had the Templar broken so far through our defenses. We live a new reality now, one harder to weather.
Is there anything you need, =name=?

strings.string:
聖騎士從未如此深入地突破我們的防線。我們現在正處於一個新的現實，一個更難熬渡的現實。
有什麼是你需要的嗎，=name=？

string.ID: I must enter Brightsheol through the Tomb of the Eaters.

strings.string: 我必須透過食者之墓進入布萊特希歐。

string.ID: Light shine through you, Jacobo. Let's talk.

strings.string: 光芒照耀著你，雅各布。我們談談吧。

string.ID: No. Live and drink.

strings.string: 不。活著並飲酒吧。

string.ID:
My quills prickle with unease to hear you say such things.
Be certain to visit the village of Ezra. The Daughter of Exile who lives there is as good a tinker as any I know, and she always has surplus she's willing to sell.

strings.string:
聽到你說出這樣的話，我的刺因為不安而微微顫動。
務必去造訪以斯拉村。住在那裡的流亡者之女是我所知的極佳修補匠，而且她總是有多餘的物資願意出售。

string.ID: I thank you. Live and drink.

strings.string: 謝謝你。活著並飲酒吧。

string.ID: Light shine through you, friend.

strings.string: 願光芒照耀著你，朋友。

string.ID: Did you feel that rumbling, Jacobo?

strings.string: 你感覺到那陣隆隆聲了嗎，雅各布？

string.ID: Jacobo, do you have advice for entering Bethesda Susa?

strings.string: 雅各布，對於進入 貝賽達蘇薩(Bethesda Susa) 有什麼建議嗎？

string.ID: Is that... music... coming from your loudspeaker? It sounds like a bell echoing in the void backward through time.

strings.string: 那是……音樂嗎……從你的 擴音器 傳出來的？ 聽起來像是鐘聲在虛空中逆著時間迴盪。

string.ID: That chrome orb earring you're wearing. What's the meaning of it?

strings.string: 你戴著的那枚鉻球耳環，有什麼含義嗎？

string.ID: You have so many data disks.

strings.string: 你有這麼多數據磁碟。

string.ID: What can you tell me about Grit Gate?

strings.string: 關於礫門，你能告訴我些什麼嗎？

string.ID: The Temple of the Rock is cut off from the wider world, and I hear the Mechanimist colonists no longer recognize High Priest Eschelstadt. That said, if you are favored by the Mechanimists, if you are welcome in their holy places, then I've no doubt that Phinae Hoshaiah will grant you peaceful entry.

strings.string: 岩石神廟與外界隔絕了，我聽說機械主義者殖民者不再承認大祭司 Eschelstadt 的地位。話雖如此，如果你受到 機械主義者 的青睞，如果你在他們的聖地受歡迎，那麼我毫不懷疑 菲奈·霍沙亞 會允許你和平進入。

string.ID:
Beauty manifest, whose chromium shoals are Awe itself. In my belief system, She's the being from whom all metal was birthed, out in the ever-void. There are pieces of Her in every chrome belfry and every machine. Even bits of Her in our own blood.
For me, Her essence extends beyond mere metal. Anything that's ordered, She infuses: a poem, a mathematical proof, a clean workspace... so definitely not Q Girl's.

strings.string:
美之顯現，其鉻色魚群即是敬畏本身。在我的信仰體系中，她是誕生於永恆虛空、孕育了所有金屬的存在。在每一座鉻色鐘樓與每一台機器中，都有她的碎片。甚至連我們的血液中也含有她的痕跡。
對我而言，她的本質超越了單純的金屬。任何具有秩序的事物都注入了她的靈魂：一首詩、一個數學證明、一個整潔的工作空間……所以絕對不是 Q Girl 的那種。

string.ID:
Don't I know it. I've had to invent eight separate systems of organization to manage them all. At the moment I'm trying out a new one, Harmonices Spiralis. Spiral towers with heights increasing according to the harmonic series of numbers. It's... fine.
The problem is I'm always inscribing more disks. New contraptions. Reverse-engineered artifacts. It's a good problem to have, I suppose.
Take a look. See if any interest you.

strings.string:
我當然知道。為了管理這一切，我不得不發明了八套不同的組織系統。目前我正在嘗試一套新的系統，「諧波螺旋」。螺旋塔的高度會根據數字的諧波級數遞增。它……還行。
問題是我總是在刻寫更多的圓盤。新的裝置。逆向工程後的文物。我想，這算是一個幸福的煩惱吧。
瞧瞧看，看看有沒有任何你感興趣的東西。

string.ID:
We're a vibrant community here. A circle of monks mapping the outer lattices and raising viaducts where we need to.
We remain secluded to protect ourselves. Otho and Barathrum insist on it. They are wise, and I defer to them. My collaboration with Sheba Hag does cause them worry, but they tolerate it, bless their hearts.

strings.string:
我們這裡是一個充滿活力的社群。一群僧侶正在繪製外圍晶格，並在需要的地方架設高架橋。
為了保護自己，我們保持隱居狀態。奧托和巴拉楚姆堅持如此。他們很睿智，我聽從他們的意見。我與 Sheba Hag 的合作確實讓他們感到擔憂，但他們忍受了，願上天保佑他們。

strings.string: 這有點像是「尼克尷尬地盯著你」——不，我開玩笑的，嘿。我只是在「耍寶」。
什麼？

string.ID: Live and drink, friend.

strings.string: 盡情生活與飲酒吧，朋友。

string.ID:
It's sort of like this. You go to the baetyl. You talk to it and you say, "Look, where is every beaded bracelet in the jungle? Where is every beaded bracelet in the watervine marsh? Where is every beaded bracelet in the River Svy?"
Then it tells you and you go get the bracelets.

strings.string:
就像是這樣。妳去找貝提爾（baetyl）。妳跟它說：「聽著，叢林裡每一條串珠手鍊在哪？水藤沼澤裡的每一條串珠手鍊在哪？斯維河裡的每一條串珠手鍊在哪？」
然後它會告訴妳，接著妳就去把手鍊拿回來。

string.ID: Live and drink, friend.

strings.string: 盡情生活與飲酒吧，朋友。

string.ID: Asphodel!! I like xem. I get it. It's sort of like you don't want to be here, you don't want to there, you want to be somewhere else. Your own earldom, maybe.

strings.string: 阿斯福德爾!! 我喜歡 xem。我懂。這有點像是你不想待在這裡，也不想待在那裡，你想去別的地方。也許是屬於你自己的伯爵領。

string.ID: I see, Neek.

strings.string: 我明白了，尼克。

string.ID: Live and drink, friend.

strings.string: 盡情生活與飲酒吧，朋友。

string.ID: You felt it too! Every. rock. moved. Wooooooow! It's sort of like a community dance we all performed together. Mafeo. Sparafucile. The chromelings. The rocks. Everyone else.

strings.string: 你也感覺到了！每一塊。岩石。都動了。哇喔喔喔喔！這有點像我們大家一起跳的社區舞。馬費歐、斯帕拉福西爾、鉻人、岩石，還有其他所有人。

string.ID: Live and drink, friend.

strings.string: 盡情生活與飲酒吧，朋友。

string.ID: What's Pax Klanq?

strings.string: 派克斯克蘭克是什麼？
喔。

string.ID: Live and drink, friend.

strings.string: 盡情生活與飲酒吧，朋友。

string.ID:
Klanq. Klanq. Klanq. Klanq. Pax Klanq.
I would ask to go downstairs but there is not mush room there. Or there is but that's why there's not. It's like, “Neek doesn't need to hear about it.”

strings.string:
克蘭克(Klanq). 克蘭克(Klanq). 克蘭克(Klanq). 克蘭克(Klanq). 派克斯克蘭克。
我想要求下樓去，但那裡沒有蘑菇。或者那裡有，但這就是為什麼沒了。就像是，「尼克不需要聽說這件事」。
喔。

string.ID: Live and drink, friend.

strings.string: 盡情生活與飲酒吧，朋友。

string.ID: Live and drink, Neek.

strings.string: 盡情生活與飲酒吧，尼克。

string.ID:
It's like what I *don't* do is drink Hortensa's sludge soup samples. I drank them once and she saw me and just sort of smiled tactfully but I could tell on the inside she was like "WOOOOOOOOW" so I don't do it.
Neek winks at you! Ha ha ha. She knows I still do it.

strings.string:
就像我「不」會去喝 霍騰莎 的淤泥湯樣本一樣。我曾經喝過一次，她看到我時只是禮貌地微笑，但我能感覺到在 內部 她其實是在想「哇喔喔喔喔喔喔」，所以我現在不喝了。
尼克 對你眨了眨眼！哈哈哈哈。她知道我其實還在喝。

string.ID: Live and drink, Neek.

strings.string: 盡情生活與飲酒吧，尼克。

string.ID:
Neek, chanting: "RECTANGLE HAIR! RECTANGLE HAIR! RECTANGLE HAIR!"
It's sort of like when prehistoric lizards would grow big sails to regulate their body temperatures and you'd say, "I like it, but it looks so organically generated. What if you filed it into a sharp rectangle?"

strings.string:
尼克，正在吟唱：「矩形頭髮！矩形頭髮！矩形頭髮！」
這有點像是史前蜥蜴會長出巨大的帆來調節體溫，而你會說：「我喜歡它，但它看起來太有機生成了。如果把它修剪成銳利的矩形會怎樣？」

string.ID: You go and run at Q Girl and tap all the gadgets and tap her on the head. Then you sneak by Otho's office. Then you hug Shem -1 and you drag them to the library and read to them. Sometimes Barathrum and Hortensa are in there, and they smile at you. Then you get hungry and you roll toward the kitchen. You slurp honey from the vase and Dardi glares at you. You say, "I'm just 'jidding'." Then you climb the pipes and whisper to Aloysius, "Live and drink, live and drink, live and drink." Then you pat the chromelings on their heads. You say to Ereshkigal, "boom boom boom boom boom I love you." Then you sneak into storage and pat all the chromelings on their heads. You take a nap in the peptic chair. Then you get a bright idea and go back to your room to write it in your notebook.

strings.string: 你跑向 Q 女孩，按了按所有的裝置，然後拍拍她的頭。 接著你溜過 奧托的 辦公室。 然後你擁抱 謝姆-1(Shem -1)，把他們拖到圖書館讀書給他們聽。有時 巴拉楚姆(Barathrum) 和 霍騰莎 會在那裡，她們對你微笑。 接著你覺得餓了，朝著廚房滾過去。你從花瓶裡吸食蜂蜜，達迪 對你怒目而視。你說：「我只是在『開玩笑』。」 接著你爬上管線，對 阿洛修斯 低聲說：「活著喝吧，活著喝吧，活著喝吧。」 接著你拍拍鉻人（chromelings）的頭。你對 Ereshkigal 說：「砰砰砰砰砰 我愛妳。」 接著你溜進儲藏室，拍拍所有鉻人的頭。 你在 消化椅 上小睡了一會。 接著你靈光一現，回到房間把想法寫在筆記本裡。

string.ID: Live and drink, Neek.

strings.string: 盡情生活與飲酒吧，尼克。

string.ID:
{{B|[{{C|Voice transmitting through panel}}]}}
Be gone, wayfarer. This is no place for you.

strings.string:
{{B|[{{C|透過面板傳輸的聲音}}]}}
滾開吧，旅人。這裡不適合你待著。

string.ID: I come by way of Joppa. The elder Irudad calls me friend.

strings.string: 我是經由 約帕(Joppa) 前來的。長者 伊魯達德 稱呼我為朋友。

string.ID: Wait! My name is =name=. I've come into possession of a data disk stamped with a peculiar sigil. Does this have meaning to your order of tinkers? Might you examine it?

strings.string: 等等！我的名字是 =name=。我得到了一片印有奇特符文的數據磁碟。這對你們的修補匠教團有意義嗎？能否請您檢查一下？

string.ID: Wait! My name is =name=. I've come into possession of a data disk stamped with a peculiar sigil. Does this have meaning to your order of tinkers? Might you examine it?

strings.string: 等等！我的名字是 =name=。我得到了一片印有奇特符文的數據磁碟。這對你們的修補匠教團有意義嗎？能否請您檢查一下？

string.ID: I am a merchant, cave dweller. I wish only to trade.

strings.string: 我是一名商人，洞穴居民。我只想進行交易。

string.ID: Wait! My name is =name=. I bring a message from Argyve of Joppa.

strings.string: 等等！我的名字是 =name=。我帶來了來自約帕阿吉夫的消息。

string.ID: Wait! My name is =name=. The people of =villageZeroName= recently came into possession of a data disk, onto which a strange signal was recorded. At their behest I carry the disk with me. They say your tutelage is to be my reward.

strings.string: 等等！我的名字是 =name=。=villageZeroName= 的人們最近得到了一個 數據磁碟，上面記錄著一個奇怪的訊號。應他們的要求，我隨身帶著這片磁碟。他們說你的指導將會是給我的獎勵。

string.ID: [A slot opens from the center of the door and a metal tray slides out]

strings.string: [門中心開啟了一個槽位，一個金屬托盤滑了出來]

string.ID: [Place stamped disk in tray]

strings.string: [將蓋印磁碟放入托盤]

string.ID: [Place scratched disk in tray]

strings.string: [將刮傷的圓盤放入托盤]

string.ID: [Place disk in tray]

strings.string: [將磁碟放入托盤]

string.ID: Uh, I'll come back later with it.

strings.string: 呃，我稍後會帶著它回來。

string.ID:
[several minutes pass]
So you wish to study with us. Unfortunately, we require more than a willing spirit.
Qud is not =villageZeroName=. You will need to prove your worth, that you might not waste our time and efforts. Travel to the great cavern Golgotha to the north. Within its halls you will find a cache of dysfunctional waydroids.
Recover one, repair it, and return here. If we are satisfied with your work, you will be admitted to our order. Otherwise, you will not be.
Do you accept this arrangement?

strings.string:
[幾分鐘過去了]
所以你想跟我們一起學習。不幸的是，我們需要的不僅僅是滿腔熱忱。
卡德(Qud) 並非 =villageZeroName=。你需要證明自己的價值，以免浪費我們的時間與精力。前往北邊巨大的洞穴 髑髏地(Golgotha)。在它的殿堂中，你會發現一堆功能失常的 Waydroids。
找回一個，修理它，然後回到這裡。如果我們對你的成果感到滿意，你將被接納進入我們的教團。否則，你將無法加入。
你接受這個安排嗎？
是的。

string.ID: No, I'm not interested.

strings.string: 不，我沒興趣。

string.ID:
[several minutes pass]
The disk you bring is encoded with an important signal. To discuss it further, we must admit you to our order. Unfortunately, we require more than a willing spirit.
You will need to prove your worth, that you might not waste our time and efforts. Travel to the great cavern Golgotha to the north. Within its halls you will find a cache of dysfunctional waydroids.
Recover one, repair it, and return here. If we are satisfied with your work, you will be admitted as an apprentice. Otherwise, you will be turned away.
Do you accept this arrangement?

strings.string:
[幾分鐘過去了]
你帶來的圓盤編碼著一個重要的訊號。為了進一步討論，我們必須接納你進入我們的教團。遺憾的是，我們需要的不僅僅是滿腔熱忱。
You 你需要證明你的價值，以免浪費我們的時間與精力。前往北方的巨大洞穴 髑髏地(Golgotha)。在它的殿堂中，你會發現一堆功能失常的自動機（waydroids）。
回收一個，修理它，然後回到這裡。如果我們對你的工作感到滿意，你將被接納為學徒。否則，你將被拒之門外。
你接受這個安排嗎？
是的。

string.ID: No, I'm not interested.

strings.string: 不，我沒興趣。

string.ID:
[several minutes pass]
So it seems that you are indeed Argyve's apprentice. He wishes you to study with us. Unfortunately, we require more than a willing spirit.
Qud is not Joppa. You will need to prove your worth, that you might not waste our time and efforts. Travel to the great cavern Golgotha to the north. Within its halls you will find a cache of dysfunctional waydroids.
Recover one, repair it, and return here. If we are satisfied with your work, you will be admitted to our order. Otherwise, you will not be.
Do you accept this arrangement?

strings.string:
[幾分鐘過去了]
看來你確實是 Argyve 的學徒。他希望你能與我們一同研習。遺憾的是，我們需要的不僅僅是一腔熱血。
Qud 並非 約帕(Joppa)。你需要證明自己的價值，以免浪費我們的時間與精力。前往北方的巨大洞窟 髑髏地(Golgotha)。在那些大廳之中，你會發現一堆功能失常的 waydroids。
回收其中一個，將其修復，然後回到這裡。如果我們對你的成果感到滿意，你將被接納進入我們的教團。否則，你將無法加入。
你接受這個安排嗎？
是的。

string.ID: No, I'm not interested.

strings.string: 不，我沒興趣。

string.ID: Have you completed the task?

strings.string: 你完成任務了嗎？
是的。

string.ID: Not yet. But I require entrance to the city for the purposes of trade.

strings.string: 還沒。但我需要進入城市進行貿易。

string.ID: Welcome, wayfarer.

strings.string: 歡迎，旅人。

string.ID: I require entrance to the city.

strings.string: 我需要進入這座城市。

string.ID: Enter then, traveler.

strings.string: 進來吧，旅人。

string.ID:
[The slot opens from the center of the door. A bright red light shines through.]
[Several minutes pass.]
You may enter. Simply walk through the force barrier. Make your first two lefts and speak to Steward Otho in his office.

strings.string:
[門從中心向外開啟。一道亮紅色的光芒照射進來。]
[幾分鐘過去了。]
你可以進去了。直接走過 力場屏障 即可。在第一個路口連續左轉兩次，然後到辦公室找管家 奧托 談談。

string.ID:
I always knew this part of our story would come. Our efforts today determine the genre of the tale we tell. Is this a triumphant epic, or a tale of woe?
Fight well, =player.formalAddressTerm=.

strings.string:
我一直都知道我們故事的這部分終將到來。我們今天的努力決定了我們所講述的故事類型。這是一部凱旋的史詩，還是一個悲劇故事？
戰鬥得精彩些，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

string.ID: I will.

strings.string: 我會的。

string.ID:
Such interesting times we inhabit, =name=!
Good to see you well. Is there anything you need?

strings.string:
我們所處的時代真是如此有趣，=name=!
很高興看到你一切安好。有什麼你需要我幫忙的嗎？

string.ID: I must enter Brightsheol through the Tomb of the Eaters.

strings.string: 我必須透過食者之墓進入布萊特希歐。

string.ID: What do you think of the situation?

strings.string: 你對現狀有什麼看法？

string.ID: Not at this time. Live and drink.

strings.string: 現在還不行。盡情生活與飲酒吧。

string.ID:
What novelty, to shelter the mysterious Klanq! I have heard no stories of this tinker-fungus that could be described as dull, though ‘calamitous' could apply to more than one.
My mind tells tales of what might be brewing in the basement, but I am quite relieved to be out here rather than down there.

strings.string:
多麼新奇的發現，竟然能庇護那神祕的 克蘭克(Klanq)！我從未聽說過關於這種 修補匠-真菌 的傳說，它顯得平庸無奇，不過「災難性」這個詞或許可以用來形容不只一種事物。
我的腦海中浮現出地下室可能正在醞釀著什麼的景象，但我真的很慶幸自己是在這裡，而不是在下面。

string.ID: So they do. Live and drink, Mafeo.

strings.string: 他們確實如此。平安地生活與飲酒吧，馬費歐。

string.ID:
Coming from anyone else, I would ask that further japery be left to me.
But from you? I wouldn't startle to see you return wearing a Sultan's burial mask, having destroyed half a dozen invincible cherubim in the doing. Fates be with you.

strings.string:
如果是別人說的話，我會要求把進一步的戲弄留給我。
但如果是你？就算看到你戴著蘇丹的葬禮面具回來，並在過程中摧毀了半打無敵的小天使，我也不會感到驚訝。願命運與你同在。

string.ID: I thank you. Live and drink.

strings.string: 謝謝你。活著並飲酒吧。

string.ID: Welcome to Grit Gate, =factionaddress:Barathrumites=. Care to enhance the quality of your stay with a wise purchase?

strings.string: 歡迎來到碎石之門，=factionaddress:Barathrumites=。是否想透過明智的購買來提升您的住宿品質？

string.ID: I have been tasked to travel to Golgotha.

strings.string: 我接到了前往 髑髏地(Golgotha) 的任務。

string.ID: Do you know anything about Bethesda Susa?

strings.string: 你對 貝賽達蘇薩(Bethesda Susa) 有所了解嗎？

string.ID: What do you know about Omonporch and the self-appointed Earl?

strings.string: 關於 歐蒙波奇(Omonporch) 和那位自封的伯爵，你了解多少？

string.ID: Did you feel that rumbling, Mafeo?

strings.string: 你有感覺到那陣隆隆聲嗎，馬費歐？

string.ID: Have you ever met Pax Klanq?

strings.string: 你曾遇見過 派克斯克蘭克 嗎？

string.ID: What wares do you sell?

strings.string: 你販售什麼貨物？

string.ID: What is this place?

strings.string: 這是什麼地方？

string.ID: What kind of creature are you?

strings.string: 你是哪種生物？

string.ID: Live and drink, =pronouns.formalAddressTerm=.

strings.string: 生存並飲酒吧，=pronouns.formalAddressTerm=。

string.ID:
My condolences to your sense of smell, =player.formalAddressTerm=.
Golgotha is an execrable place in more ways than one, and I would advise you not to visit without a healthy stock of yuckwheat and honey. If you can cook, a meal with yuckwheat may banish a disease before it comes into its own. Bring salves or urberries, too, and mind your feet in the Cloaca.

strings.string:
=player.formalAddressTerm=，請對您的嗅覺表示哀悼。
髑髏地在多方面都是個糟糕的地方，我建議您在沒有充足的惡臭麥和蜂蜜的情況下不要前往。如果您會烹飪，一頓含有惡臭麥的餐點或許能在疾病發作前將其驅散。也請帶上藥膏或尿漿果，並在下水道（Cloaca）行走時留意您的腳步。

string.ID: Live and drink, Mafeo.

strings.string: 活著並暢飲吧，馬費歐。

string.ID: Bethesda Susa? Lovely, but a bit dangerous for a holiday destination. You'll want to bring bandages and warm clothing. Why not take a look at my stock in case something suits you?

strings.string: 貝賽達蘇薩(Bethesda Susa)？很迷人，但作為度假勝地有點危險。你會需要帶上繃帶和保暖衣物。不如看看我的庫存，說不定有適合你的東西？

string.ID: Live and drink, Mafeo.

strings.string: 活著並暢飲吧，馬費歐。

string.ID:
It's a lovely place, and the bananas are delicious.
As for the so-called Earl, well. I'm loath to recognize nobility to begin with, and I cannot decide whether Asphodel claiming xyr own title is better or worse than if xe inherited it.

strings.string:
那是一個美好的地方，香蕉也很好吃。
至於所謂的伯爵，嗯。我本就不屑於承認貴族地位，而且我也無法判斷 阿斯福德爾 聲稱擁有其頭銜，會比 xe 繼承它來得更好還是更糟。

string.ID: Live and drink, Mafeo.

strings.string: 活著並暢飲吧，馬費歐。

string.ID:
Nothing short of explosives or heavy equipment could have made such a sound.
Be ready for the worst, =player.formalAddressTerm=.

strings.string:
除了炸藥或重型設備，沒有任何東西能發出這種聲響。
做好最壞的打算，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

string.ID: Live and drink, Mafeo.

strings.string: 活著並暢飲吧，馬費歐。

string.ID:
The Rainbow Wood is a fair bit too dangerous for a casual promenade, but nothing compares to its beauty. Once, I viewed it from above by means of a gyrocopter, and I will never forget the sights that I saw.
Nor will I forget crashing to the ground because the gyrocopter broke, but every adventure has its complications, wouldn't you say?

strings.string:
彩虹之林對於隨意散步來說稍微有些危險，但沒有什麼能與它的美景相比。曾經，我曾藉由旋翼機從高空俯瞰它，我永遠不會忘記所見到的景象。
我也不會忘記因為旋翼機故障而墜落地面的經歷，但每場冒險都有其複雜之處，你不覺得嗎？

string.ID: Live and drink, Mafeo.

strings.string: 活著並暢飲吧，馬費歐。

string.ID:
Oh, I sell whatever sundries that meet my standards of quality, with some measure of curation. I try to ensure that my shelves carry a bit of many things, but you can count on finding more than enough ammunition and a few recoilers that can lead you back here in difficult times.
If you have anything in need of identification or repair, I can take care of that for you for a few drams as well.

strings.string:
喔，我販售任何符合我品質標準的雜貨，並經過一定的篩選。我盡力確保我的架上有多樣化的物品，但你可以放心，這裡有足夠的彈藥和一些後座力裝置，能在艱難時刻帶領你回到此地。
如果你有任何需要鑑定或修理的東西，我也能為你處理，只需收取少許酬勞。

string.ID: Live and drink, Mafeo.

strings.string: 活著並暢飲吧，馬費歐。

string.ID:
Why, this place is Grit Gate! O the vaulted halls, the glint of chrome, the gentle hum of chain turret emplacements!
There's nowhere like Grit Gate in the whole of Qud, =player.formalAddressTerm=. I've journeyed in my comparatively short time, but I always return here. The very air buzzes with knowledge, as well as quite a few other things.

strings.string:
哎呀，這裡就是砂礫之門（礫門(Grit Gate)）！喔，那拱頂大廳、鉻合金的光澤，還有連鎖砲塔陣地發出的輕微嗡鳴聲！
在整個庫德（Qud）之中，沒有任何地方能像砂礫之門一樣，=player.formalAddressTerm=。雖然我在相對較短的時間內旅歷各地，但我總會回到這裡。這裡的空氣中充滿了知識的律動，還有不少其他有趣的東西。

string.ID: Live and drink, Mafeo.

strings.string: 活著並暢飲吧，馬費歐。

string.ID:
We are called the Urshiib, =player.formalAddressTerm=.
Our kind are smarter than the average bear. Sharper, too, and a bit more handy.

strings.string: 我們被稱為 Urshiib，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

string.ID: Live and drink, Mafeo.

strings.string: 活著並暢飲吧，馬費歐。

string.ID: What is it?

strings.string: 那是什麽？

string.ID: Live and drink, =player.formalAddressTerm=.

strings.string: 盡情生活與飲酒吧，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

string.ID: Why did you come to Omonporch?

strings.string: 你為什麼來到 歐蒙波奇(Omonporch)？

string.ID: To make preparations, =player.formalAddressTerm=. Barathrum instructed us here after you secured the grounds.

strings.string: 為了進行準備，=player.formalAddressTerm=。在您確保了周邊安全後，巴拉楚姆(Barathrum) 指引我們來到這裡。

string.ID: Live and drink, friend.

strings.string: 盡情生活與飲酒吧，朋友。

string.ID: [The Baetyl emits an almost subliminal glow.]

strings.string: [貝提爾散發著一種近乎潛意識的微光。]

string.ID: [Insert Disk]

strings.string: [插入磁碟]
[離開]

string.ID: [Press tab or T to open trade]

strings.string: [按 Tab 或 T 開啟交易]
[離開]

string.ID: I am =name=. Who are you?

strings.string: 我是 =name=。你是誰？

string.ID: Why are you hiding in the bush?

strings.string: 你為什麼躲在灌木叢裡？

string.ID: Your twinblades are works of art. Where did you get them?

strings.string: 你的雙刃劍簡直是藝術品。你從哪裡弄來的？

string.ID: Crowsong, Deathwonder, a colony of ants eating me, the leaves, the light, and there on.

strings.string: 鴉歌、Deathwonder、一群正在啃食我的螞蟻、葉子、光線，還有更多更多。

string.ID: Hiding, no. Being grass. The feeling of animate being. Radiate inward like a turned out star.

strings.string: 躲藏，不。化身為草。那種生命體的感覺。像一顆向內放射的恆星般綻放。

string.ID: Why are you here, in Kyakukya?

strings.string: 你為什麼會在這裡，在恰庫恰？

string.ID: Death is the color of everything but sometimes it waves in bright ribbons, like here. The whittlers weigh their passing goods, and the walls are corpse eaters.

strings.string: 死亡是萬物的底色，但有時它會像這裡一樣，化作鮮豔的絲帶飄動。雕刻師們衡量著他們流轉的貨物，而牆壁則是食屍者。

string.ID: Tugged from the claws of one who had become a cord in time's silly carpet. I outrooted the hilts and sheathed the blades, and now I am he. I still have the nail dirt.

strings.string: 從那已成為時間愚蠢地毯中一根繩索之人的利爪中被拔出。我拔出了劍柄並收起刀刃，現在我就是他。我指甲縫裡仍留著髒污。

string.ID: Friend! Guns? Knives? Hats? Cucumbers?

strings.string: 朋友！槍？刀？帽子？小黃瓜？

string.ID: You're a member of the Consortium of Phyta, right? What do you know about the Earl of Omonporch?

strings.string: 您是植物聯盟的成員，對吧？關於歐蒙波奇伯爵，您知道些什麼？

string.ID: What are you? What's your story?

strings.string: 你是什麼？你的故事又是什麼？

string.ID: I'm Yurl, chandler and Consortium notary. As for my story, I've been growing out of this pot for a while now. Before that, I was in another pot.

strings.string: 我是尤爾，蠟燭商兼財團公證人。至於我的故事，我已經在這個罐子裡成長好一段時間了。在那之前，我在另一個罐子裡。
財團？

string.ID:
Yes, the Consortium of Phyta. We're a merchant fellowship of trees, vines, shrubs, weeds, flowers, herbs, cacti, algae -- most sorts of plants, really.
I can't say I trust any of them, but there is no doubting their usefulness. My shelves are full and the gossip flows.

strings.string:
是的，植物聯盟(Consortium of Phyta)。我們是一個由 樹木、藤蔓、灌木、雜草、花朵、草藥、仙人掌、藻類組成的商人同業公會——說實話，幾乎涵蓋了所有種類的植物。
我不敢說我信任他們中的任何一個，但他們的用處是毋庸置疑的。我的架子上堆滿了貨物，流言蜚語也傳得很快。

string.ID: What about fungi?

strings.string: 那真菌呢？

string.ID:
{{emote|*Yurl flicks a leaf in displeasure.*}}
What about fungi?

strings.string:
{{emote|*尤爾不悅地彈了一下葉子。*}}
那「真菌」呢？

string.ID: Are there any fungi in the Consortium?

strings.string: 財團（Consortium）裡有任何真菌嗎？

string.ID: Let's change the subject.

strings.string: 我們換個話題吧。
但是...

string.ID:
I am a gentleplant, -friend-. Uncross your roots and figure it out.
Live and DRINK.

strings.string:
我是一株溫和植物，-朋友-. 放鬆你的 根系，想清楚再說。
生存並飲水。

string.ID:
Asphodel the socialite? Asphodel the scoundrel? You can hate xym -- and I do -- but you have to admire xym (I don't).
The truth of it is that Plysago had the idea first, to lay claim to the Spindle per some precedent of law established in Abram's time. Of course, Plysago isn't around to make their case, are they?

strings.string:
社交名媛 阿斯福德爾？還是惡棍 阿斯福德爾？你可以痛恨 xym —— 我也是 —— 但你必須欽佩 xym（我並不這麼認為）。
事實是，Plysago 先想到了這個主意，根據 Abram 時期建立的某項法律先例，聲稱擁有 紡錘(Spindle) 的所有權。當然，Plysago 現在不在這裡為他們辯護，不是嗎？

string.ID: How can I convince Asphodel to lease the Spindle to Barathrum?

strings.string: 我該如何說服阿斯福德爾將紡錘租給巴拉楚姆？

string.ID:
Asphodel trades on reputation and favors. Xe is likely to want to leverage your connections, so be in good social standing with a few factions for xem to even consider it.
Now, alternatively, if you're loved by the Consortium, xe will feel the pressure to acquiesce. Xe has enough enemies among phyta.
Of course, where all else fails, you can always sharpen your shears, if you get my meaning.
{{emote|*Yurl winks with one of their leaves.*}}

strings.string:
阿斯福德爾 靠名聲與人情交易。Xe 很可能會想利用你的關係，所以你必須在幾個派系中擁有良好的社交地位，Xem 才會考慮這件事。
或者，如果你深受財團（Consortium）的愛戴，xe 就會感受到屈服的壓力。xe 在植物族群（phyta）中已經有足夠多的敵人了。
當然，如果其他方法都失敗了，你也可以隨時磨利你的剪刀，如果你明白我的意思的話。
{{emote|*尤爾 用其中一片葉子向你眨眼。*}}

string.ID: I see. Live and drink, Yurl.

strings.string: 我明白了。活著並飲酒吧，尤爾。

string.ID: Be ape-still and muse, wanderer, and welcome to my village, Kyakukya. Have some mulled mushroom cider!

strings.string: 像猿猴般靜止並沉思吧，流浪者，歡迎來到我的村莊，恰庫恰(Kyakukya)。來點熱香菇西打酒吧！

string.ID: You are... an albino ape.

strings.string: 你是……一隻白化猿。

string.ID: Why do you call it "your" village?

strings.string: 為什麼你稱它為「你的」村莊？

string.ID: What can you tell me about Kyakukya?

strings.string: 關於 恰庫恰(Kyakukya)，你能告訴我些什麼嗎？

string.ID: Is there work to be found here?

strings.string: 這裡有工作可以做嗎？

string.ID: Have you heard news of girshlings on Qud's surface? The watervine farmers of Joppa confirm it is true.

strings.string: 你有聽說關於卡德（Kade）表面上吉什林的消息嗎？約帕的 水藤農夫 已證實那是真的。

string.ID: I am at your service.

strings.string: 隨時聽候您的差遣。
正確！

string.ID:
Ah, bad habit. It's a possessive feeling I should work to scrub myself of, perhaps?
But I am its mayor, and I have been for some time. You see, years ago I deserted my people. We were of two different minds -- they desired nothing but to bludgeon everything to death, while I asked, "What is the nature of this thing we bludgeon? Or of the act itself?"
Recognizing that my answers lay elsewhere, I cast myself into the swell of the wilds, as a sailor from Perth with no windweird casts their ship to the whims of the Pale Sea!

strings.string:
啊，壞習慣。這是一種佔有欲，或許我應該努力除掉它？
但我可是這裡的市長，而且已經擔任一段時間了。你看，多年前我背棄了我的族人。我們的想法截然不同——他們只想把一切都砸死，而我卻問：「我們所砸的東西本質為何？或者說，行為本身又是什麼？」
意識到我的答案在別處後，我便投身於荒野的浪潮之中，就像一個沒有風巫的培斯水手，將船隻交給蒼白海的變幻莫測！

string.ID: *continue listening*

strings.string: *繼續聆聽*

string.ID: Some years later and twenty ago, I came upon these mushrooms huts and their goodly inhabitants. They are a people full of earthen poetry, and I was charmed by the warmth they welcomed me with. Surely, I owed my acceptance at first to the countenance I share with their mighty god, but they soon grew to love me, and I them. I've remained here ever since in contemplation of those questions that first stirred in me all those years ago.

strings.string: 幾年後，也就是二十年前，我偶然發現了這些 蕈類 小屋及其善良的居民。他們是一個充滿大地詩意的民族，我被他們迎接我的熱情所吸引。當然，起初能被接納，歸功於我與他們偉大神祇相似的面容，但他們很快便愛上了我，我也愛上了他們。從那時起，我就一直留在此地，沉思著多年前最初在我心中激起的那些問題。

string.ID:
We're watered by the river spray -- we pluck the fruit of the wood, and we hunt. The worshippers of Oboroqoru whittle and brood, too. They will pay you no mind unless you ask of them. Here you can be with friends, or muse alone.
If it's trade goods that interest you, take a gander at Yurl's wares in the northwest corner. The odd one Crowsong's, too, if you can scry them in the bush.
I must warn you, however; cast no villain's shadow on these grounds. Warden Indrix will be watching.

strings.string:
我們受河霧滋潤——採集林間果實，並進行狩獵。Oboroqoru 的信徒們也從事木雕與沉思。除非你主動詢問，否則他們不會理睬你。在這裡，你可以與友伴相聚，或是獨自冥想。
如果你對貿易商品感興趣，可以看看位於西北角的 Yurl 的貨物。若能在灌木叢中窺見 Crowsong 的奇特商品，也可以一瞧。
然而我必須警告你；切勿在這些土地上留下惡徒的陰影。典獄長 Indrix 將會監視著一切。

string.ID: Who is Yurl?

strings.string: 尤爾是誰？

string.ID: Who is Crowsong?

strings.string: 誰是 鴉歌？

string.ID: Who is Indrix?

strings.string: 因德里克斯是誰？

string.ID: I have some other questions.

strings.string: 我還有其他問題。

string.ID: Yurl is a harmless cucumber vine. They came to Kyakukya a few years ago after the last Consortium chandler, a wicked little hyacinth named Plysago, suffered something of an... accident. In Tarotep's defense, Plysago shouldn't have berated someone with claws so close in resemblance to pruning shears. At any length, Yurl stocks a plethora of goods; you will be satisfied with your visit.

strings.string: 尤爾是一株無害的小黃瓜藤。幾年前，在最後一位財團蠟燭商——一個名叫 Plysago 的邪惡小風信子遭遇了一場……意外後，他們來到了恰庫恰。為 Tarotep 辯解一下，Plysago 本就不該去羞辱一個擁有看起來極像修枝剪之利爪的人。無論如何，尤爾囤積了豐富的貨物；你的造訪定會滿意而歸。

string.ID: Oh, another of our dwellers. I won't speak to what Crowsong's deal is. Best you find them and ask yourself.

strings.string: 喔，又是我們的一位居民。我不想評論 鴉歌的 交易內容。最好你自己去找他們問清楚。

string.ID: Warden Indrix is one of the most ferocious warriors I've ever met. Once upon a time, he and his brothers gorged themselves on the flesh of beasts by starlight, but now I count myself lucky to call him my warden. Some believe he is of sour kind, though I assure you, he's but a victim of his goatish nature.

strings.string: 典獄長因德里克斯是我遇過最兇猛的戰士之一。曾幾何時，他和他的兄弟們在星光下飽食野獸之肉，但現在我慶幸能稱他為我的典獄長。有些人認為他是那種惡劣的種類，但我向你保證，他只是受困於其山羊般的本性而已。

string.ID: A waterhand, you are? Speak to my friend and warden Indrix. You'll find him patrolling the village.

strings.string: 你是個水手？去跟我的朋友兼守衛因德里克斯談談吧。你會發現他正在村莊巡邏。

string.ID: As far west as Joppa, you say? Oh, grim! Yes, we found the remains of pale-things in the mouth of Svy. Does the Gyre widen again? Hrmmmm.

strings.string: 你說最西邊到 約帕(Joppa) 為止嗎？喔，真慘！是的，我們在 Svy 的口中發現了蒼白生物的殘骸。環流是否再次擴張了？嗯……

string.ID: I don't imagine you brought me this information merely to observe. Are you suggesting that these slynth might take up residence here in my village?

strings.string: 我不認為你帶給我這些資訊只是為了觀察。你是說這些 斯林斯 可能會在此定居於我的村莊嗎？

string.ID: Coming from anyone else, =name=, I might refuse outright. Housing recently-sentient refugees is no mean favor, I think you'll agree. My people are slow to trust, as well, so I fear that the slynth may feel unwelcome for some time. But then, grafted branches grow the best starapples, do they not? Yes, your lilypad friends are welcome here if they wish.

strings.string: =name=，如果是別人來求我，我可能會直接拒絕。安置最近獲得意識的難民並非小恩小惠，我想你會同意的。我的人民也同樣不輕易信任他人，所以我擔心 斯林斯 可能會有一段時間感到不受歡迎。不過話說回來，嫁接的分支能長出最好的 星蘋果，不是嗎？是的，如果你的蓮葉朋友們願意，這裡歡迎他們。

string.ID: You have my thanks, mayor.

strings.string: 市長，謝謝你的幫忙。

string.ID: Had I no responsibility to represent my people, I might accept out of the goodness of my own heart alone. Sadly, I do not consider my heart, or even my mind, to be more important than my duty. Perhaps if you were a more renowned figure among my people, I would reconsider.

strings.string: 如果我沒有代表我族人的責任，我也許會僅憑自己的善意而接受。遺憾的是，我不認為我的心，甚至我的思想，比我的職責更重要。或許如果你是我族人中更具名望的人物，我會重新考慮。

string.ID: Have the slynth yet to choose a destination, =player.formalAddressTerm=?

strings.string: 斯林斯 尚未選擇目的地，=player.formalAddressTerm=？

string.ID:
Never has Kyakukya seen such bustle. These slynth are seem to be as good citizens as any, but I am at my limit with the stress of keeping track of everything.
Please check in again after some time, when I have my wits about me once again.

strings.string:
恰庫恰從未見過如此熱鬧的景象。這些斯林斯看起來和任何其他公民一樣是好公民，但我已經快要無法承受處理這一切的壓力了。
請稍後再回來找我，等我恢復清醒的時候。

string.ID: My thanks, Mayor.

strings.string: 謝謝您，市長。

string.ID:
Greetings once again, =name=. I am pleased to report that the settling-in of the slynth has gone well, more or less. The villagers are yet wary, but as some slynth have joined in the rituals and worship of Oboroqoru that wariness has waned somewhat.
They've settled in across the village over time. Crowsong has taught the basics of hunting to a select few, and I'll be teaching a cooking class once I can wrest aside the time.

strings.string:
再次向您問好，=name=。我很樂意報告說，斯林斯的定居情況大致上進展順利。村民們雖然仍保持警惕，但隨著一些斯林斯加入了對奧博羅科魯的祭祀與崇拜，那種警惕感已有所減輕。
隨著時間推移，他們已在村莊各處安頓下來。鴉歌已經向少數幾個人教授了狩獵的基本知識，一旦我能擠出時間，我也會開設烹飪課。

string.ID: My thanks again, Mayor.

strings.string: 再次感謝您，市長。

string.ID: Be nimble, wayfarer. Take in a draught of cider before leaving.

strings.string: 動作要敏捷，旅人。出發前先喝口蘋果酒吧。

string.ID: I am =name=. Who are you?

strings.string: 我是 =name=。你是誰？

string.ID: Why is the cider chunky?

strings.string: 為什麼這蘋果酒口感這麼粗糙？

string.ID: Is that a Naphtaali mask over there?

strings.string: 那邊那個是 納夫塔利 面具嗎？

string.ID: Live and drink, cider-friend.

strings.string: 活著並盡情暢飲吧，蘋果酒之友。

string.ID: I am called Erah. Branches part for you, =name=.

strings.string: 我被稱為埃拉。分支將為你開路，=name=。

string.ID: That'd be the mushrooms. Bit heartier, a-ye?

strings.string: 那是蕈類。比較耐吃，對吧？

string.ID: Why would you put mushrooms in cider?

strings.string: 為什麼要在蘋果酒裡放蕈類？

string.ID:
...
Bit heartier, a-ye?

strings.string:
...
更有嚼勁一點，對吧？

string.ID: Is. Was naphtaali once.

strings.string: 曾經是。納夫塔利曾是。

string.ID: Was? Not any more?

strings.string: 曾經有？現在沒有了？

string.ID: Let us speak of something else.

strings.string: 讓我們聊點別的吧。

string.ID: Mmm. Have cider?

strings.string: 嗯。有蘋果酒嗎？

string.ID: A-ye, quit. Lost most my minyan to goatfolk. The sower's eye fell upon us and so we fell too.

strings.string: 阿耶，停手吧。我大部分的民揚（minyan）都喪命於山羊族手中。播種者的目光落在我們身上，於是我們也隨之倒下。

string.ID: What is a minyan?

strings.string: 什麼是 minyan？

string.ID: What became of your Godhed?

strings.string: 你的神格（Godhed）後來怎麼了？

string.ID: May their memories bless you.

strings.string: 願他們的記憶祝福你。

string.ID: Let us speak of something else.

strings.string: 讓我們聊點別的吧。

string.ID:
As the very canopy, they will.
Thank you.

strings.string: 身為樹冠本身，他們會這麼做。

string.ID: Let us speak of something else.

strings.string: 讓我們聊點別的吧。

string.ID: Live and drink, ciderer.

strings.string: 活著並暢飲吧，蘋果酒釀者。

string.ID:
Pilgrims, drawn together by need and awe and inspiration. Tinkers and sodders and guards and scouts, alloyed under the pressure of lifeswork.
Family, like.

strings.string:
朝聖者們，因需求、敬畏與啟發而聚集在一起。修補匠、士兵、衛兵與偵察兵，在終身事業的壓力下熔鑄成一體。
猶如家人一般。

string.ID:
Don't know. Wrecked? Fled?
I crawled away, never looked back. That's the all of it.

strings.string:
不知道。毀滅了？逃走了？
我爬開了，從未回頭。事情就是這樣。

string.ID: Klanq puff at you. =MARKOVSENTENCE=

strings.string: 克蘭克(Klanq) 向你吐口水。=MARKOVSENTENCE=

string.ID: [begin pax quest]

strings.string: [開始派克斯任務]

string.ID: [pick a limb to infect]

strings.string: [選擇要感染的肢體]

string.ID: Klanq puff at you?

strings.string: 克蘭克(Klanq)（克蘭克(Klanq)）對你吐氣？

string.ID: Didn't you die?

strings.string: 你不是死了嗎？

string.ID: Aren't you supposed to be helping Barathrum in his study?

strings.string: 你不是應該在研究室幫忙 巴拉楚姆(Barathrum) 嗎？

string.ID: Excuse me?

strings.string: 請問？

string.ID: Why are you the color of coral? And why did the brick road outside only appear after I ate the Eater's fleshcap?

strings.string: 為什麼你的顏色像珊瑚一樣？還有，為什麼外面的磚路是在我吃了食者肉菇之後才出現的？

string.ID: I'm here to collect a debt for the Barathrumites.

strings.string: 我是來替 巴拉楚姆信徒 收債的。

string.ID: Fine. Puff away.

strings.string: 好吧。隨你便。

string.ID: No, thanks. Live and drink.

strings.string: 不用了，謝謝。活著並盡情飲酒吧。

string.ID: Klanq distribute! Cannot kill Klanq in a way that matters.

strings.string: 克蘭克(Klanq) 分配！無法以有效的方式殺死 克蘭克(Klanq)。

string.ID: Klanq distribute! Here, there.

strings.string: 克蘭克(Klanq) 分發！這裡，那裡。

string.ID: Klanq puff at you.

strings.string: 克蘭克(Klanq)（克蘭克(Klanq)）對你吐氣。

string.ID: Live and drink, mushroom.

strings.string: 盡情生活與飲酒吧，蘑菇。

string.ID: Klanq want no visitors, so Klanq relocate workshop. Half dimension away. Tasties alter viewing plane.

strings.string: 克蘭克(Klanq) 不想要訪客，所以 克蘭克(Klanq) 搬遷了工作坊。就在半個維度之外。美味的東西改變了視野平面。

string.ID: Live and drink, mushroom.

strings.string: 盡情生活與飲酒吧，蘑菇。

string.ID: Prickles? Klanq miss prickles.

strings.string: 刺刺？克蘭克(Klanq) 想念刺刺。

string.ID: Why do you owe... "prickles"... a debt?

strings.string: 為什麼你要欠……「刺頭」……一份債？

string.ID: Well, you can repay the debt now. Barathrum wants you to build something. A climber. He says only you can do it.

strings.string: 好吧，你現在可以償還債務了。巴拉楚姆(Barathrum) 想讓你建造某樣東西。一個攀爬者。他說只有你能做到。

string.ID: Klanq puff on prickles during lecture on light refraction. Prickles angry.

strings.string: 在關於光折射的講座中，克蘭克(Klanq)（克蘭克(Klanq)）對刺刺發出噗噗聲。刺刺很生氣。

string.ID: Klanq care little for debt.

strings.string: 克蘭克(Klanq) 並不在乎債務。

string.ID: But you owe Barathrum. He needs your help.

strings.string: 但你欠巴拉楚姆。他需要你的幫助。

string.ID: Klanq puff on debt.

strings.string: 克蘭克(Klanq) 為了債務而喘息。

string.ID: Is there anything I can do change your mind?

strings.string: 有什麼我可以做的能讓你改變主意嗎？

string.ID: Klanq think...

strings.string: 克蘭克(Klanq) 認為...

string.ID: Klanq got it! Klanq puff on you.

strings.string: 克蘭克(Klanq) 搞定了！克蘭克(Klanq) 要對你放個屁。

string.ID: Excuse me?

strings.string: 請問？

string.ID: Puff on yourself, mushroom. I'm leaving.

strings.string: 你自己噴吧，蘑菇。我要走了。

string.ID:
Klanq puff on you. You host Klanq. You spread Klanq for Klanq. Then your Klanq shrivels away.
Klanq puff on you, then Klanq build jalopy.

strings.string:
願 克蘭克(Klanq) 吹向你。你是 克蘭克(Klanq) 的宿主。你為 克蘭克(Klanq) 傳播 克蘭克(Klanq)。然後你的 克蘭克(Klanq) 會枯萎凋零。
願 克蘭克(Klanq) 吹向你，然後 克蘭克(Klanq) 建造破車。

string.ID: Fine. Puff away.

strings.string: 好吧。隨你便。

string.ID: Puff off. Bye.

strings.string: 滾開。掰。

string.ID: Klanq puff on you! Klanq build jalopy.

strings.string: 克蘭克(Klanq) 呸你！克蘭克(Klanq) 造破車。
呃。

string.ID:
Klanq puff on you...
..later. Now, Klanq pause puff for prickles favor.

strings.string:
克蘭克(Klanq) 祝福你...
..稍後。現在，願 克蘭克(Klanq) 暫停吹息以換取刺棘的眷顧。

string.ID: Is the Creature ready?

strings.string: 生物準備好了嗎？

string.ID: I am ready for the Creature to be moulded and catalyzed.

strings.string: 我已準備好讓生物被塑造並催化。

string.ID: Didn't you die?

strings.string: 你不是死了嗎？

string.ID: Can you tell me about the components I must gather?

strings.string: 你能告訴我必須收集哪些組件嗎？

string.ID: What should I know about the Creature?

strings.string: 關於這個生物，我應該知道些什麼？

string.ID: Do you live in Grit Gate now?

strings.string: 你現在住在礫門嗎？

string.ID: I would like to ask some questions about the large creature.

strings.string: 我想詢問一些關於那隻巨大生物的問題。

string.ID: Klanq distribute! Cannot kill Klanq in a way that matters.

strings.string: 克蘭克(Klanq) 分配！無法以有效的方式殺死 克蘭克(Klanq)。

string.ID: Materials ready? Circuits to solder. Klanq stir the soup?

strings.string: 材料準備好了嗎？電路待焊接。克蘭克(Klanq) 攪拌湯了嗎？
是的。

string.ID: You haven't provided the mound with all the necessary materials.

strings.string: 你還沒有為這座丘塚提供所有必要的材料。

string.ID: You don't have enough primordial soup.

strings.string: 你的原始湯（primordial soup）不足。

string.ID: Not yet.

strings.string: 尚未。

string.ID: Klanq stir! Come back three days and Creature arrive. Now, take operating manual.

strings.string: 克蘭克(Klanq) 攪動！三日後歸來，生物抵達。現在，拿著操作手冊。

string.ID: I'll return in three days.

strings.string: 我三天後會回來。

string.ID: No! Be back =mound.complete.days=.

strings.string: 不！=mound.complete.days=. 天後再回來。
好的。

string.ID: Soup, body, catalyst, atzmus, armament, incantation, hamsa, power source, soup. Ask component!

strings.string: 湯、身體、催化劑、阿特茲穆斯、武裝、咒語、hamsa、動力源、湯。詢問成分！

string.ID: Tell me about the soup.

strings.string: 跟我說說那碗湯。

string.ID: Tell me about the body.

strings.string: 跟我說說那個屍體。

string.ID: Tell me about the catalyst.

strings.string: 跟我說說關於催化劑的事。

string.ID: Tell me about the atzmus.

strings.string: 跟我說說關於 阿特茲穆斯 的事。

string.ID: Tell me about the armament.

strings.string: 跟我說說關於武裝的事。

string.ID: Tell me about the incantation.

strings.string: 跟我說說那個咒語的事。

string.ID: Tell me about the hamsa.

strings.string: 跟我說說關於法蒂瑪之手（hamsa）的事。

string.ID: Tell me about the power source.

strings.string: 告訴我關於能源的事。

string.ID: Where do I place components once they are gathered?

strings.string: 收集好組件後，我該把它們放在哪裡？

string.ID: I have something else to ask.

strings.string: 我還有其他事情想問。

string.ID: Primordial soup 20 drams. Act as Creature circulatory liquid. Catalyzed and boom! Animating substance. Electromagnets induce sinusoidal flow.

strings.string: 20 德蘭的原初濃湯。作為生物循環液使用。經催化後——砰！變成賦予生命物質。電磁鐵可誘導正弦流。

string.ID: Body of creature friend to form Creature after. Must follow you and be experience. No worry, friend not consumed in creation.

strings.string: 友伴生物之軀，以形塑後續生物。必須追隨你並成為經驗。別擔心，友伴不會在創造中被消耗。

string.ID: Three dram of pure liquid to catalyze soup and circulate nutrient. Liquid choice alter sanguine mixture, change Creature.

strings.string: 三打純液體用以催化湯品並循環營養。液體選擇會改變血液混合物，進而改變生物。

string.ID: Atzmus transcendental imprint of being. Pattern trait after creature part, crossed with Body.

strings.string: 存在之超越性印記。模式特徵繼承自生物部位，並與身體結合。

string.ID: Zetachrome weapon. Attune Creature to the martial art and shape metachrome fist-types in the fashion after.

strings.string: 齊塔鉻（Zetachrome）武器。將生物與武術進行調和，並依此方式塑造超鉻拳型。

string.ID: Words spoken from your experience and inscribed to form being-bond. First sounds heard in Creature's early dreambrain.

strings.string: 源自於你的經驗並刻印以形成存在連結的言語。是在生物早期夢境腦中聽到的第一聲響。

string.ID: Chosen token to palm-solder and orient with object-meaning, 5 lbs. or less. Like others, choice alters Creature trait and behavior.

strings.string: 被選中用於掌焊並與物體意義定向的代幣，5 磅或更輕。與其他代幣一樣，選擇會改變生物特徵與行為。

string.ID: Ascending Creature need mightful battery with rare electromagnet shielding. Purple prickles make neutron cell with 3 flux drams, or must find different source.

strings.string: 上升生物需要具備稀有電磁屏蔽功能的強大電池。紫色刺物可製成含有 3 德蘭 通量 的中子電池，否則必須尋找其他來源。

string.ID: Interact with scrap-clay mound. Then chat Klanq to solder circuits and stir the soup.

strings.string: 與廢棄黏土堆互動。接著與 克蘭克(Klanq) 交談來焊接電路並攪拌湯品。

string.ID: What ask! Klanq say.

strings.string: 「問什麼！」克蘭克(Klanq) 說。

string.ID: I will bond with the Creature. How does this work?

strings.string: 我要與該生物建立連結。這要怎麼運作？

string.ID: I am bonded with the Creature. How does this work?

strings.string: 我已與該生物建立連結。這要怎麼運作？

string.ID: Barathrum and I will ascend the Spindle inside the Creature?

strings.string: 巴拉楚姆和我將會升華至該生物的 紡錘(Spindle) 內部？

string.ID: Can the Creature wear equipment?

strings.string: 該生物可以裝備裝備嗎？

string.ID: What if it's damaged or destroyed?

strings.string: 如果它受損或被毀了怎麼辦？

string.ID: I have something else to ask.

strings.string: 我還有其他事情想問。

string.ID: Creature follow you like friend. Also, can enter Creature and take control. One friend fit inside with you.

strings.string: 生物會像朋友一樣跟隨你。此外，可以進入生物並取得控制權。一個朋友能與你在 內部 契合。

string.ID: Creature is large creature, can only wear gigantic gear. Like kraken or saltback.

strings.string: 生物體型巨大，只能裝備巨型裝備。例如克拉肯或鹽背獸。

string.ID: Prickles install reshaping nook in Court of Sultans at Omonporch. There, respackle Creature with one dram of sunslag. Or recall creature if lost.

strings.string: Prickles 在 歐蒙波奇(Omonporch) 的蘇丹庭院中安裝了 重塑角落。在那裡，使用一德蘭的太陽渣 重塑生物。或者召回遺失的生物。

string.ID: Yes! But before then, can walk around with creature. Talk, fight, sleep... the normal. Friend.

strings.string: 是的！但在那之前，可以跟生物一起走動。交談、戰鬥、睡覺……正常的事。朋友。

string.ID: Klanq live! Tragedy of jalopy invite Klanq to dimcandlespace. Klanq soften stone floor with plushes, dust shelves of boring jars with happy and spores. Prickles look at it.

strings.string: 克蘭克(Klanq) 万歲！這場破舊小車的悲劇邀請 克蘭克(Klanq) 前往暗燭空間。克蘭克(Klanq) 用絨毛墊軟化了石地板，用快樂與孢子塵封了無聊罐子的架子。Prickles 看著這一切。

string.ID: Impudent swine! You would bear that stygian charm in my presence?

strings.string: 無禮的豬猡！你竟敢在我面前佩戴那種冥界護身符？

string.ID: Make haste, traveller.

strings.string: 快點，旅人。

string.ID: Why are you called "pariah"?

strings.string: 為什麼你被稱為「賤民」？

string.ID: I am in search of work.

strings.string: 我在尋找工作。

string.ID: Live and drink, warden.

strings.string: 活下去並盡情暢飲吧，典獄長。

string.ID: Is Mamon dead? Have you recovered the talisman?

strings.string: Mamon 死了嗎？你拿回護身符了嗎？

string.ID: Yes. Mamon is dead and I possess the prism.

strings.string: 是的。Mamon 已死，而我擁有了稜鏡。

string.ID: Where will I find him again?

strings.string: 我還能在哪裡找到他？

string.ID: Not yet.

strings.string: 尚未。

string.ID: Live and drink, traveler.

strings.string: 活著並盡情飲酒吧，行者。

string.ID: Live and drink, warden.

strings.string: 活下去並盡情暢飲吧，典獄長。

string.ID: Speak nothing of that name to me. You are warned.

strings.string: 別在我面前提起那個名字。我警告過你了。

string.ID: I must insist; why are you called "pariah"?

strings.string: 我必須追問；為什麼你被稱為「賤民」？

string.ID: I am in search of work.

strings.string: 我在尋找工作。

string.ID: Live and drink, warden.

strings.string: 活下去並盡情暢飲吧，典獄長。

string.ID: Speak nothing of that name to me. You are warned.

strings.string: 別在我面前提起那個名字。我警告過你了。

string.ID: I must insist; why are you called "pariah"?

strings.string: 我必須追問；為什麼你被稱為「賤民」？

string.ID: Live and drink, warden.

strings.string: 活下去並盡情暢飲吧，典獄長。

string.ID: I will ravage your nubile heart!

strings.string: 我要蹂躪妳那青澀的心！

string.ID: Grrrraaaah! There is but one task I know to offer. It is most treacherous, and in all likelihood you will perish. Is your interest waned?

strings.string: 格拉啊啊啊！我所知道的任務只有一個。這極其險惡，而且你很有可能會喪命。你的興趣減退了嗎？

string.ID: No. Continue.

strings.string: 不。繼續。

string.ID: Yes. Goodbye.

strings.string: 是的。再見。

string.ID: There is a river just south of the village that runs an eastwardly course into the jungle. Along its bank lies a goatfolk village. There resides a mighty shaman, Mamon Souldrinker. He is in possession of a talisman of great power, an amaranthine prism that refracts the psyche of its handler in much the same way, as Mayor Nuntu has explained to me, a common prism refracts light. The thing is cursed, traveler. No man or goat may safely wield it for long. You must travel to the village and retrieve the prism from Mamon by any means necessary. Do you understand?

strings.string: 村莊正南方有一條河流，向東流向叢林。沿著河岸坐落著一個山羊族村莊。那裡住著一位強大的薩滿，馬蒙·靈飲（Mamon Souldrinker）。他擁有一件威力巨大的護身符，那是一枚永恆棱鏡，正如恩圖市長向我解釋的那樣，它能像普通稜鏡折射光線一樣折射持有者的心靈。這東西是被詛咒的，旅人。沒有人或山羊能安全地長期使用它。你必須前往村莊，並不擇手段地從馬蒙手中取回棱鏡。你明白嗎？

string.ID: Why don't you retrieve it yourself?

strings.string: 你為什麼不自己去拿呢？

string.ID: Yes. Is there anything else I should know?

strings.string: 是的。還有其他我該知道的事嗎？

string.ID: Because, traveler, Mamon is my elder brother. He would discern my presence before I could strike.

strings.string: 因為，旅人，Mamon 是我的兄長。在我出手之前，他就能察覺到我的存在。

string.ID: Is there anything else I should know?

strings.string: 還有其他我該知道的事嗎？

string.ID:
There is. Firstly, Mamon will likely have several goatfolk under his enthrallment, and they will protect him at all costs.
Secondly, take care to stay out of Mamon's reach, for his power is most potent when he may lay hands on you.
Finally, once you recover the prism, do not under any circumstances wield it. I needn't warn you of the consequences should you return to me bearing that charm.
That is all. Are you willing?

strings.string:
有的。首先，馬蒙很可能會有幾個山羊族在他的奴役之下，他們會不惜一切代價保護他。
其次，務必小心避開馬蒙的觸及範圍，因為當他能親手接觸你時，他的力量最強大。
最後，一旦你找回棱鏡，無論在任何情況下都不要使用它。如果妳帶著那件護身符回到我面前，我不需要再警告妳後果會是什麼。
就這些了。妳願意嗎？

string.ID: I am willing.

strings.string: 我願意。

string.ID: No, I would risk too much.

strings.string: 不，那樣風險太大了。

string.ID: Just south of the village, there's a river that runs an eastwardly course into the jungle. Follow it to the goatfolk village. There you will find Mamon.

strings.string: 就在村莊的正南方，有一條向東流向叢林的河流。沿著它走到山羊族村莊，你就能在那裡找到 Mamon。

string.ID: My thanks, warden.

strings.string: 謝謝你，守衛。

string.ID: Is it so? Only a ferocious warrior could have slain Mamon. You must be such a warrior. Now hand over the prism and choose your reward.

strings.string: 是嗎？只有兇猛的戰士才能殺死馬蒙（Mamon）。你一定就是那樣的戰士。現在，交出稜鏡並選擇你的獎勵吧。

string.ID: [Give the amaranthine prism to Warden Indrix]

strings.string: [將緋紅稜鏡交給典獄長 因德里克斯]

string.ID: No, warden. It is mine.

strings.string: 不，典獄長。這是我的。

string.ID: You! Are you come to attend his waking dream? Nor do I have cloven hooves, but, yes, a cloven mind.

strings.string: 你！是來參加他的清醒夢嗎？我雖然沒有裂蹄，但，是的，我有著分裂的心智。

string.ID: Who are you?

strings.string: 你是誰？

string.ID: What are you talking about?

strings.string: 你在說什麼？

string.ID: I must talk with the shaman Mamon Souldrinker.

strings.string: 我必須與薩滿 Mamon Souldrinker 對談。

string.ID: I must go.

strings.string: 我必須走了。

string.ID: Who am I? Who are you? What does it matter? You and I are nothing, the most insignificant afterthoughts of an amaranthine shade.

strings.string: 我是誰？你是誰？這有什麼關係？你和我都微不足道，不過是永恆陰影中最無足輕重的後念罷了。

string.ID: What are you talking about?

strings.string: 你在說什麼？

string.ID: I must talk with the shaman Mamon Souldrinker.

strings.string: 我必須與薩滿 Mamon Souldrinker 對談。

string.ID: I must go.

strings.string: 我必須走了。

string.ID: The amaranthine dream! The heights within ourselves we might yet reach with his guidance. There it is in all of us -- shades of our elder selves. Within each man, a goat. Within each goat, a man!

strings.string: 永恆的夢想！在祂的指引下，我們或許仍能達到內心的巔峰。它存在於我們所有人之中——我們長老自我的陰影。在每個人心中，都有隻山羊；在每隻山羊心中，都有個人！

string.ID: Who are you?

strings.string: 你是誰？

string.ID: I must talk with the shaman Mamon Souldrinker.

strings.string: 我必須與薩滿 Mamon Souldrinker 對談。

string.ID: I must go.

strings.string: 我必須走了。

string.ID: You don't talk with that mangoat -- you listen to him.

strings.string: 你不是在跟那隻芒果羊說話——你是在傾聽他的話。

string.ID: Who are you?

strings.string: 你是誰？

string.ID: What are you talking about?

strings.string: 你在說什麼？

string.ID: I must go.

strings.string: 我必須走了。

string.ID:
Liquids are better.
I prefer liquids.

strings.string:
液體比較好。
我更喜歡液體。

string.ID: Who are you?

strings.string: 你是誰？

string.ID: Live and drink, hermit.

strings.string: 活下去並盡情飲酒吧，隱士。

string.ID:
A connoisseur of liquids. Sure, I dabble in other states of matter.
But I prefer the shifting and tumbling of angleless motion.
Not too hot, not too cold, not too indeterminate.

strings.string:
液體鑑賞家。當然，我也涉獵其他物質狀態。
但我更偏好那種無角運動的變幻與翻騰。
不會太燙，不會太冷，也不會太不確定。

string.ID: Live and drink, hermit.

strings.string: 活下去並盡情飲酒吧，隱士。

string.ID: Welcome to Omonporch, traveler. Enjoy your visit to my earldom. Feast your eyes upon my tall and glorious Spindle. Take in the scent of roasted musa.

strings.string: 歡迎來到 歐蒙波奇(Omonporch)，旅人。盡情享受在我的伯爵領地的訪問吧。用你的雙眼瞻仰我高大且榮耀的 紡錘(Spindle)。細嗅烤มูซา（musa）的香氣。

string.ID: Are you truly the Earl of Omonporch?

strings.string: 你真的是 歐蒙波奇(Omonporch) 的伯爵嗎？

string.ID: Earl Asphodel, the Barathrumites request your permission to lease control of the Spindle. Their inquiries into the past have led them here.

strings.string: Earl 阿斯福德爾，這位 巴拉楚姆信徒 請求您的許可，以租借 紡錘(Spindle) 的控制權。他們對過去的探究引領他們來到此地。

string.ID: Live and drink, Earl.

strings.string: 活著並盡情享樂吧，Earl。

string.ID: Indubitably, for I've proclaimed it so! There was no Earl to tell me otherwise.

strings.string: 毫無疑問，因為我就是這麼宣告的！沒有任何伯爵能反駁我。

string.ID: Lease control of my Spindle, you say? Well, well... That's a colossal request. There's no simple price I can assign to such a thing. Were I to grant such a request, you would owe me a great debt. You and several of your allies.

strings.string: 你要租用我紡錘的控制權？呵呵……這可真是個巨大的請求。這種東西無法用簡單的價格來衡量。若我答應了這個請求，你將欠我一份巨債。你，還有你的幾位盟友。

string.ID: So you say. How can I appease you?

strings.string: 如你所言。我該如何讓你平息怒火？

string.ID: I will convene a council. The First Council of Omonporch. Send word to four of your allied factions. Have them send delegates. Together, perhaps, you can appease me.

strings.string: 我將召開議會。歐蒙波奇的第一議會。向您的四個盟友派系傳達消息，請他們派遣代表。或許，你們能藉此平息我的怒火。

string.ID: Hear me, Asphodel. I am a dear friend to the Consortium. I ask that you reconsider.

strings.string: 聽我說，阿斯福德爾。我是財團的摯友。我請求你重新考慮。

string.ID: Convene the council, then. I am willing.

strings.string: 那麼，召集議會吧。我願意。

string.ID: Not today, Asphodel. Live and drink.

strings.string: 今天不行，阿斯福德爾。活在當下，盡情飲酒。

string.ID: Oh... oh! It's you! You are a dear friend, indeed. Of course, of course! You and your bear friends are most welcome to my Spindle.

strings.string: 喔……喔！是你啊！你真是個親愛的朋友。當然，當然！你和你那些熊朋友非常歡迎來到我的紡錘。

string.ID: You are kind, Earl Asphodel. You have my thanks.

strings.string: 你很仁慈，Earl 阿斯福德爾。謝謝你。

string.ID: Greetings, my viceroy. Sit your rump on a cushion or lie your long back on a kline. Soak in the natural light.

strings.string: 問候，我的副王。請坐在墊子上，或將你長長的背靠在 克萊恩 上。沐浴在自然光中吧。
總督？

string.ID: Live and drink, Earl.

strings.string: 活著並盡情享樂吧，Earl。

string.ID:
That's right. I've leased your friends the Spindlegrounds and appointed you viceroy to oversee their operation.
Welcome to court, asphodelyte. You serve at my pleasure.

strings.string:
沒錯。我已經將紡錘地租給了你的朋友們，並任命你為副王以監督他們的運作。
歡迎來到宮廷，阿斯福德萊特。你的服務取決於我的意願。

string.ID: Live and drink, Earl.

strings.string: 活著並盡情享樂吧，Earl。

string.ID: Are you ready to begin negotiations?

strings.string: 你準備好開始談判了嗎？
是的。

string.ID: Not yet.

strings.string: 尚未。

string.ID: That was awful!

strings.string: 那太糟糕了！

string.ID: I am a servant of chaos. Live and drink.

strings.string: 我是混沌的僕從。活下去，盡情飲酒吧。

string.ID: Your friends may lease the Spindle, as we agreed.

strings.string: 正如我們約定的，你的朋友們可以租用 紡錘(Spindle)。

string.ID: Live and drink, Earl.

strings.string: 活著並盡情享樂吧，Earl。

string.ID: Delegates from your allied factions are on their way.

strings.string: 來自您盟友派系的代表正在趕來的路上。

string.ID: Live and drink, Earl.

strings.string: 活著並盡情享樂吧，Earl。

string.ID: Kneel before the Rock, =player.offspringTerm=.

strings.string: 在岩石面前下跪吧，=player.offspringTerm=。

string.ID: As the flaming sun warms the empty void, so the Rock warms us.

strings.string: 正如烈日溫暖空虛的虛空，岩石亦溫暖著我們。

string.ID: Be here, and be granted.

strings.string: 在此，並獲賜予。
阿耶？
高大族裔。

string.ID: You wandering? Be nimble.

string.ID: Don't be coy, =name=. Emboldened by your incursions into our village, you wish to fill it with your indigent foundlings on the weight of your reputation alone. Am I correct?

strings.string: 別賣關子了，=name=。受到您闖入我們村莊的鼓舞，您想僅憑您的名聲就將這裡填滿您那些貧困的孤兒。我說對了嗎？
