string.ID:
Live and drink, kendren. I am Hindriarch Keh; welcome to Bey Lah.
It's nearly unprecedented for one such as you to pass by our scouts unaccosted, but these are unprecedented circumstances. I have a task for you. Are you interested?

strings.string:
活著並盡情飲酒吧，肯德倫（kendren）。我是 希德里亞克·凱；歡迎來到 貝拉(Bey Lah)。
像你這樣的人能避開我們的偵查兵而不受騷擾，幾乎是前所未有的，但現在的情況也是前所未有的。我有一項任務要交給你。你有興趣嗎？

string.ID: Yes. Go on.

strings.string: 有的。請繼續說。
不。

string.ID:
Good.
We hindren are a close-knit and staid people, and our safety depends on our solidarity. In order to preserve our safety and culture, we ask that any of our number who leave us never come back. Recently, one such exile took the treasure of our village, a bracelet named Kindrish, with her when she left. None of our number can leave to get it back, or it will be a violation of the values that I have guarded, and the Hindriarchs before me, for countless generations.
Will you help us recover our treasure? We have a small cache of valuables we can offer as a reward.

strings.string:
很好。
我們 Hindren 是個關係緊密且嚴謹的民族，我們的安全取決於我們的團結。為了維護我們的安全與文化，我們要求任何離開我們的同胞都不要再回來。最近，其中一名流亡者在離開時，帶著我們村莊的寶藏——一條名為 Kindrish 的 手鍊。我們中沒有人可以為了奪回它而離開，否則將會違反我以及我之前的歷代 Hindriarchs 所守護的價值觀，這已持續了無數世代。
你會幫助我們找回我們的寶藏嗎？我們有一小筆貴重物品可以作為報酬。

string.ID: All right. I'll find your treasure.

strings.string: 好吧。我會幫你找到你的寶藏。

string.ID: No thank you. I don't care for this job.

strings.string: 不用了，謝謝。我對這份工作沒興趣。

string.ID:
Excellent. I will do my best to reward you to your satisfaction.
Though her name is sand in my mouth now, the exile who stole Kindrish is called Eskhind. She left a few weeks ago, and took her sister and brother with her. I don't know where she's gone, but Warden Neelahind might, as they were close friends as children.
Find the exile called Eskhind and retrieve Kindrish from her, even... even if the cost is the life of her and her siblings. Kindrish has been handed down over countless generations, and it belongs to my people, not any individual. Go, kendren. Speak to Warden Neelahind, and find out where Eskhind is hidden.

strings.string:
太好了。我會盡力給予你滿意的報酬。
雖然她的名字現在對我而言如口中之沙般令人厭惡，但那位偷走 Kindrish 的流亡者名叫 艾斯金德。她幾週前離開了，還帶走了她的兄弟姐妹。我不知道她去了哪裡，但 Warden 妮拉欣德(Neelahind) 可能知道，因為他們小時候是親密的朋友。
找到名為 艾斯金德 的流亡者並從她手中取回 Kindrish，即便……即便代價是她和她手足的性命。Kindrish 已傳承了無數世代，它屬於我的族人，而非任何個人。去吧，kendren。去找 Warden 妮拉欣德(Neelahind) 談談，查明 艾斯金德 躲藏在哪裡。

string.ID: As you say.

strings.string: 如您所言。

string.ID: Then I will thank you to leave as quickly as possible. I don't want the faundren to become used to our borders being permeable.

strings.string: 那麼，請你盡快離開。我不希望 陶德人（faundren）習慣我們的邊界是滲透性的。

string.ID: As you say. Live and drink.

strings.string: 如您所言。活著，且盡情飲酒。

string.ID:
You've found our treasure? I'll admit, kendren, I'm very impressed. Take this as thanks.
That said, the exile must answer for her crimes. There is further reward for you if you see this case through to the end.

strings.string:
你找到了我們的寶藏？我必須承認，肯德倫，我對你印象非常深刻。收下這個以表謝意。
話雖如此，流亡者必須為她的罪行負責。如果你能將此案貫徹到底，會有進一步的獎勵給你。

string.ID: Live and drink, Hindriarch.

strings.string: 活著，且盡情飲酒，欣德里亞克(Hindriarch)。

string.ID:
You've found our treasure? I'll admit, kendren, I'm very impressed.
Take this as thanks, and... well. I suppose you've earned your stay for a while. Just try not to give the faundren any ideas.

strings.string:
你找到了我們的寶藏？我必須承認，kendren，我對你印象非常深刻。
收下這個作為謝禮，還有……嗯。我想你已經贏得了暫時留下的資格。只要別讓 faundren 起什麼歪念就好。

string.ID: Live and drink, Hindriarch.

strings.string: 活著，且盡情飲酒，欣德里亞克(Hindriarch)。

string.ID: You're back. Have you found the exile and retrieved our treasure?

strings.string: 你回來了。找到那個流亡者並取回我們的寶藏了嗎？

string.ID: I have found Kindrish, but not Eskhind.

strings.string: 我找到了 Kindrish，但沒找到 艾斯金德。

string.ID: Eskhind is dead, but Kindrish was not on her body.

strings.string: 艾斯金德已死，但她的身上沒有 Kindrish。

string.ID: I have not.

strings.string: 我沒有。

string.ID: Perhaps you should get back to it rather than hanging around my village. Warden Neelahind may be able to help you.

strings.string: 或許你該回去忙你的，而不是在我村莊附近徘徊。典獄官 妮拉欣德(Neelahind) 或許能幫到你。

string.ID: As you say. Live and drink.

strings.string: 如您所言。活著，且盡情飲酒。

string.ID: Ayvah. She must have sold it. Tell no one about this. Please understand that I cannot reward you, as you did not complete the task I asked of you.

strings.string: Ayvah。她一定是把它賣了。別把這件事告訴任何人。請理解我無法獎勵你，因為你並沒有完成我交託給你的任務。

string.ID: Understandable. Live and drink.

strings.string: 可以理解。活下去，盡情飲用吧。

string.ID: Unacceptable. Prepare to die.

strings.string: 不可接受。準備受死吧。

string.ID: Why is an exile standing in my village? Are you trying to play me for a fool?

strings.string: 為什麼一名流亡者會站在我的村莊裡？你是想把我當傻瓜耍嗎？

string.ID: Hindriarch, I have found Kindrish, but Eskhind did not have it.

strings.string: 欣德里亞克(Hindriarch), 我找到了 Kindrish，但 艾斯金德 並沒有它。

string.ID: Eskhind claims to be wrongfully accused.

strings.string: 艾斯金德聲稱自己遭到了冤枉。

string.ID:
The pariah claims to be wrongfully accused, and you believe her?
She is obviously lying. Are all kendren so gullible?

strings.string:
那個被排斥者聲稱自己被冤枉了，而你竟然相信她？
她顯然在撒謊。難道所有的 kendren 都這麼好騙嗎？

string.ID: There is no proof that she is lying.

strings.string: 沒有證據顯示她在撒謊。

string.ID:
Fine! Go to the Warden, then, and have her solve this mystery.
But know this: until a thief is found and Kindrish is recovered, I cannot reward you. You get nothing. Live and drink, =player.formalAddressTerm=.

strings.string:
好吧！那就去找典獄長吧，讓她來解開這個謎團。
但請記住：在找到小偷並找回 Kindrish 之前，我無法獎勵你。你什麼也得不到。活下去並盡情飲酒吧，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

string.ID: ...live and drink.

strings.string: ...活著，而且喝酒。

string.ID: Why are you speaking to me? You have work to do.

strings.string: 你為什麼跟我說話？你有工作要做。

string.ID: Does this poem belong to you?

strings.string: 這首詩是你的嗎？

string.ID: I have questions for you.

strings.string: 我有問題要問你。

string.ID: Fine. What are they?

strings.string: 好吧。它們是什麼？

string.ID: Does this poem belong to you?

strings.string: 這首詩是你的嗎？

string.ID: Why was Eskhind exiled?

strings.string: 為什麼 艾斯金德 會被流放？

string.ID: Who is your bodyguard?

strings.string: 誰是你的保鏢？

string.ID: Is Neelahind a good warden?

strings.string: 妮拉欣德是一位優秀的守望者嗎？

string.ID: Why did you tell me Eskhind had a brother?

strings.string: 你為什麼告訴我艾斯金德有個兄弟？

string.ID: That's all. Live and drink.

strings.string: 就這樣了。活著，且盡情飲酒。

string.ID:
She exiled herself by leaving Bey Lah. Our codes demand that no hindren who leaves us ever return.
She knew this, and still she chose to leave.

strings.string:
她離開了 貝拉(Bey Lah)，這等於是自我流放。我們的準則要求，任何背棄我們的人都不得再歸。
她深知這一點，卻仍選擇離去。

string.ID: I have further questions.

strings.string: 我還有其他問題。

string.ID: I see. Live and drink.

strings.string: 我明白了。盡情生活，盡情飲酒。

string.ID:
Kesehind is a good boy. He lost his parents long ago, but has been like a son to me.
Now his axe-arm is strong where mine is not, and so he lends it.

strings.string:
凱塞欣德 is a good boy。他很久以前就失去了父母，但一直把我當成親生兒子看待。
現在他的斧手強壯得連我都望塵莫及，所以他會借給我使用。

string.ID: I have further questions.

strings.string: 我還有其他問題。

string.ID: I see. Live and drink.

strings.string: 我明白了。盡情生活，盡情飲酒。

string.ID:
Warden Neelahind attends to her duties admirably. She is not terribly assertive, but she need not be.
I'm surprised she's going along with this outsider-led investigation, but she always had a soft spot for the exile.

strings.string:
典獄長妮拉欣德出色地履行了她的職責。她並不十分強勢，但也不必如此。
我很驚訝她竟然配合這場由外來者主導的調查，但她一直對那位流亡者心存憐憫。

string.ID: I have further questions.

strings.string: 我還有其他問題。

string.ID: I see. Live and drink.

strings.string: 我明白了。盡情生活，盡情飲酒。

string.ID:
If you ask the exile, I'm sure she'll spin some kind of accusation that I believe gender to be an immutable prison, that I impose it on others.
She's lying. Our people have a long history of two-gender hindren called {{w|hartind}}, respected and consecrated. There is a proper path to gender variance in our society, of which the male exile could have availed himself years ago.
He never did, so I do not recognize him.

strings.string:
如果你去問那個流亡者，我敢肯定她會編造某種指控，說我認為性別是不可改變的牢籠，並強加於他人身上。
她在撒謊。我們族人有著悠久的雙性別希德倫（hindren）歷史，被稱為 {{w|hartind}}，受人尊敬且神聖不可侵犯。在我們的社會中，性別差異有其正當的路徑，那位男性流亡者多年前本可以利用這些路徑。
但他從未這麼做，所以我並不承認他的身份。

string.ID: I have further questions.

strings.string: 我還有其他問題。

string.ID: I... see. Live and drink.

strings.string: 我……明白了。活下去，盡情飲酒吧。

string.ID:
Poem? I detest poetry. Why would one go about learning to write only to use purposefully unclear language, choosing rhyme scheme over clarity?
Of course it's not mine. Take it back.

strings.string:
詩？我討厭詩歌。為什麼有人要花心思學習寫作，卻只為了使用刻意模糊的語言，並選擇押韻而非清晰度？
這當然不是我的。拿回去吧。

string.ID: I see. Live and drink.

strings.string: 我明白了。盡情生活，盡情飲酒。

string.ID:
Gone...
All gone...

strings.string:
沒了...
全都沒了...

string.ID: My condolences.

strings.string: 深表哀悼。

string.ID:
I have a terrible feeling that I've brought ill fortune to my village.
Perhaps it was a mistake to have hired you.

strings.string:
我有種糟糕的預感，我給我的村莊帶來了厄運。
或許雇用你是個錯誤。

string.ID: If you say so. Live and drink.

strings.string: 如果你這麼說的話。活下去並盡情暢飲吧。

string.ID:
They conspired against me. It is the only explanation.
You! Leave me alone.

strings.string:
他們密謀對付我。這是唯一的解釋。
你！離我遠點。

string.ID: You will find a way. Live and drink.

strings.string: 你會找到方法的。活下去，盡情飲酒吧。

string.ID:
I should have kept them apart.
I should have kept all of you apart.

strings.string:
我當初應該讓他們分開的。
我當初應該讓你們所有人分開的。

string.ID: You will find a way. Live and drink.

strings.string: 你會找到方法的。活下去，盡情飲酒吧。

string.ID:
Ah, you again. I'd been doing so well at forgetting your countenance.
Leave me be.

strings.string:
啊，又是你。我好不容易才快要忘記你的容貌了。
別來煩我。

string.ID: Fine. Live and drink.

strings.string: 好吧。活著並盡情享樂吧。

string.ID: You have a great deal of nerve to speak to me after what you've done.

strings.string: 在你做了那種事之後，竟然還有臉跟我說話。

string.ID:
You again?
It is only a matter of time until we are overtaken by hostile kendren. Your presence mocks our fate.

strings.string:
又是你？
敵對的肯德倫超越我們只是時間問題。你的存在是在嘲弄我們的命運。

string.ID: Hindriarch, I have found Kindrish.

strings.string: 欣德里亞克(Hindriarch)，我找到 Kindrish 了。

string.ID: You will find a way. Live and drink.

strings.string: 你會找到方法的。活下去，盡情飲酒吧。

string.ID:
Some help you are! Now our village lacks a warden.
How are we to protect ourselves?

strings.string:
你還真是有幫助啊！現在我們的村莊缺少一名守護者。
我們要如何保護自己？

string.ID: You will find a way. Live and drink.

strings.string: 你會找到方法的。活下去，盡情飲酒吧。

string.ID: Ah, welcome back to the village, =name=. You won't be staying long, will you?

strings.string: 啊，歡迎回到村莊，=name=。你不會待太久吧？

string.ID: No. Live and drink.

strings.string: 不。活著並飲酒吧。

string.ID:
While I appreciate your help, kendren, I would prefer that you not stay longer than you must.
The faundren might get ideas.

strings.string:
雖然我很感激你的幫助，kendren，但我希望你不要待得比必要的時間更久。
那些 faundren 可能會產生不必要的想法。

string.ID: Fine. Live and drink.

strings.string: 好吧。活著並盡情享樂吧。

string.ID: {{emote|*The warden's gaze is distant.*}} Esk...

strings.string: {{emote|*典獄長的目光顯得有些空洞。*}} 呃……

string.ID: *leave her be*

strings.string: *放她一馬*

string.ID: Follow the road =EskhindRoadDirection= to find the hollow tree where Esk and I used to play.

strings.string: 沿著 =EskhindRoadDirection= 的道路，就能找到 Esk 和我以前玩耍的那棵空心樹。

string.ID: Thank you.

strings.string: 謝謝你。

string.ID: {{emote|*The warden is lost in rumination.*}} It can't be. It simply can't be.

strings.string: {{emote|*典獄長陷入了沉思。*}} 這不可能。這絕對不可能。

string.Context: Conversation 妮拉欣德(Neelahind).Ruminating.Warden 妮拉欣德(Neelahind)?Choice.Text
string.ID: Warden Neelahind?

strings.string: 典獄長 妮拉欣德(Neelahind)？

string.ID: Kendren, do you... have any news of Eskhind, and Kindrish?

strings.string: Kendren，你有……關於 艾斯金德 和 Kindrish 的消息嗎？

string.Context: Conversation 妮拉欣德(Neelahind).Dead.Eskhind is dead.Choice.Text
string.ID: Eskhind is dead.

strings.string: 艾斯金德 已死。
不。

string.Context: Conversation 妮拉欣德(Neelahind).Warden 妮拉欣德(Neelahind)?.Text
string.ID: Ah! Yes. My apologies, kendren. Live and drink. I am Neelahind, Warden of Bey Lah. How... may I help you?

strings.string: 啊！是的。抱歉，kendren。請自便。我是 妮拉欣德(Neelahind)，貝拉(Bey Lah) 的守護者。我……能如何幫到汝？

string.Context: Conversation 妮拉欣德(Neelahind).Warden 妮拉欣德(Neelahind)?.Friends with EskhindChoice.Text
string.ID: Hindriarch Keh told me that you were once friends with Eskhind.

strings.string: 希德里亞克·凱 告訴我你曾經和 艾斯金德 是朋友。

string.Context: Conversation 妮拉欣德(Neelahind).Warden 妮拉欣德(Neelahind)?.EndChoice.Text
string.ID: I will return later.

strings.string: 我稍後會回來。

string.Context: Conversation 妮拉欣德(Neelahind).Friends with Eskhind.Text
string.ID:
We were... yes. We were close.
I can scarcely believe that she would be capable of doing such a thing. Stealing our greatest treasure? Eskhind wouldn't possibly... but if Grand-Doe says it, it must be so.

strings.string:
我們曾經……是的。我們曾經很接近。
我簡直不敢相信她竟然能做出這種事。偷走我們最珍貴的寶藏？艾斯金德不可能……但既然大鹿說了，那就一定是如此。

string.Context: Conversation 妮拉欣德(Neelahind).Friends with Eskhind.Where?Choice.Text
string.ID: Do you know where Eskhind and her siblings might have gone?

strings.string: 你知道 艾斯金德 和她的兄弟姊妹可能去了哪裡嗎？

string.Context: Conversation 妮拉欣德(Neelahind).Friends with Eskhind.欣德里亞克(Hindriarch) is lying?Choice.Text
string.ID: Is it possible that the Hindriarch is lying?

strings.string: 有沒有可能 欣德里亞克(Hindriarch) 在撒謊？

string.Context: Conversation 妮拉欣德(Neelahind).欣德里亞克(Hindriarch) is lying?.Text
string.ID: Wh—no! No! What? No, that's not possible! Ayvah, what an absurd idea!

strings.string: 什——不！不！什麼？不，這不可能！Ayvah，多麼荒謬的想法！

string.Context: Conversation 妮拉欣德(Neelahind).欣德里亞克(Hindriarch) is lying?.Why not?Choice.Text
string.ID: Why not?

strings.string: 為什麼不呢？

string.Context: Conversation 妮拉欣德(Neelahind).欣德里亞克(Hindriarch) is lying?.Where?Choice.Text
string.ID: Do you know where Eskhind and her siblings might have gone?

strings.string: 你知道 艾斯金德 和她的兄弟姊妹可能去了哪裡嗎？

string.ID:
Grand-Doe speaks only truth! Grand-Doe only ever speaks truth!
It's not possible. She didn't lie.

strings.string:
大牝鹿只說真話！大牝鹿永遠只說真話！
這不可能。她沒有撒謊。

string.Context: Conversation 妮拉欣德(Neelahind).Why not?.Anyone can lie.Choice.Text
string.ID: Anyone can lie.

strings.string: 任何人都可以撒謊。

string.ID: You ruminant people are impossible. I will find Eskhind myself.

strings.string: 你們這些反芻動物真難搞。我會親自去找 艾斯金德。

string.Context: Conversation 妮拉欣德(Neelahind).Anyone can lie..Text
string.ID:
No. It's not true, and I won't hear any more of your poisonous ideas, kendren. Consider the topic closed.
Do you actually have a question?

strings.string:
不。那不是真的，我不想再聽你那些有毒的想法了，kendren。就此打住吧。
您真的有問題要問嗎？

string.Context: Conversation 妮拉欣德(Neelahind).Anyone can lie..Where?Choice.Text
string.ID: Do you know where Eskhind and her siblings might have gone?

strings.string: 你知道 艾斯金德 和她的兄弟姊妹可能去了哪裡嗎？

string.Context: Conversation 妮拉欣德(Neelahind).Anyone can lie..EndChoice.Text
string.ID: Forget it. I don't need your help.

strings.string: 算了。我不需要你的幫助。

string.ID:
Oh. Esk and I, we had a place... there's a path to the =EskhindRoadDirection= that leads to the remains of a lightning-struck tree, made hollow by the fire from above. It was the furthest from the village either of us had ever been, until I attended my first warden's moot.
She and I would spend time there, back then. Perhaps she is there now, but I don't dare check.

strings.string:
喔。艾斯克和我，我們曾有個地方……有一條通往 =EskhindRoadDirection= 的小徑，通向一棵被雷擊中的樹殘骸，那棵樹被來自上方的火焰燒成了空心。那是我們兩人曾經離村莊最遠的地方，直到我參加了人生中第一次守望者集會。
那時候，她和我常在那裡度過時光。或許她現在就在那裡，但我不敢去確認。

string.ID: I'll look there, thank you.

strings.string: 我會去那裡看看，謝謝你。

string.Context: Conversation 妮拉欣德(Neelahind).Eskhind is dead..Text
string.ID:
Oh.
Oh.
Did... you recover Kindrish?

strings.string:
喔。
喔。
你... 找回了 Kindrish 嗎？

string.Context: Conversation 妮拉欣德(Neelahind).Eskhind is dead..No. I'm sorry.Choice.Text
string.ID: No. She must have sold the artifact.

strings.string: 不。她一定把那件神器賣掉了。

string.Context: Conversation 妮拉欣德(Neelahind).Eskhind is dead..No. The 欣德里亞克(Hindriarch) lied to you.Choice.Text
string.ID: No. The Hindriarch lied to you.

strings.string: 不。欣德里亞克騙了你。

string.Context: Conversation 妮拉欣德(Neelahind).Eskhind is dead..No, this was for fun.Choice.Text
string.ID: No, this was for fun.

strings.string: 不，這只是為了好玩。

string.Context: Conversation 妮拉欣德(Neelahind).Eskhind is dead..No. I'm sorry.Choice2.Text
string.ID: No. I'm sorry.

strings.string: 不。我很抱歉。

string.Context: Conversation 妮拉欣德(Neelahind).No. I'm sorry..Text
string.ID:
No... no, I can't... and the artifact is lost?
It was all for nothing... for nothing...

strings.string:
不……不，我做不到……難道神器就這樣失蹤了嗎？
這一切都白費了……全都白費了……

string.Context: Conversation 妮拉欣德(Neelahind).No. I'm sorry..EndChoice.Text
string.ID: I will leave you to your grief. Live and drink.

strings.string: 我不會打擾你的悲傷。活下去，盡情飲酒吧。

string.Context: Conversation 妮拉欣德(Neelahind).No. The 欣德里亞克(Hindriarch) lied to you..Text
string.ID:
No, it can't be... how. This place. This accursed village!
This whole village be damned!

strings.string:
不，這不可能...怎麼會這樣。這個地方。這個該死的村莊！
這整個村莊都該下地獄！

string.Context: Conversation 妮拉欣德(Neelahind).No. The 欣德里亞克(Hindriarch) lied to you..EndChoice.Text
string.ID: *back away slowly*

strings.string: *緩慢退後*

string.Context: Conversation 妮拉欣德(Neelahind).No, this was for fun..Text
string.ID: You monster! You monster! How dare you!

strings.string: 你這怪物！你這怪物！你竟敢！

string.Context: Conversation 妮拉欣德(Neelahind).No, this was for fun..EndChoice.Text
string.ID: You're next.

strings.string: 輪到你了。

string.ID:
Oh! Kendren, thank you, thank you! You've done so much for us. Here is a reward for your hard work.
Um, that said, there's still the matter of finding out who stole our treasure. It'd mean a great deal if you could still help with the resolution of the case.

strings.string:
喔！Kendren，謝謝你，謝謝你！你為我們做了這麼多。這是對你辛勤工作的獎勵。
嗯，話雖如此，還有找出誰偷走我們寶藏的問題。如果你能繼續協助解決此案，那將對我們意義重大。

string.ID: Understood. Live and drink.

strings.string: 明白了。活著，且盡情飲酒。

string.ID:
Wh-what's going on? Esk is here, a-and Grand-Doe seems very upset.
Would you please speak to her, kendren?

strings.string:
發、發生什麼事了？Esk 在這裡，而 Grand-Doe 看起來非常不悅。
請問妳能跟她談談嗎，kendren？

string.ID: I will.

strings.string: 我會的。

string.ID: Wait, why... why is Esk here? What's going on? Do you have Kindrish?

strings.string: 等等，為什麼……為什麼 Esk 會在這裡？發生了什麼事？你有 Kindrish 嗎？

string.ID: Yes, I do, but Eskhind didn't have it.

strings.string: 是的，我有，但 艾斯金德 沒有它。

string.Context: Conversation 妮拉欣德(Neelahind).Start2.No. Eskhind claims to be wrongfully accused.Choice.Text
string.ID: No. Eskhind claims to be wrongfully accused.

strings.string: 不。艾斯金德 聲稱自己被冤枉了。

string.ID: Ah, one moment...

strings.string: 啊，請稍等一下...

string.Context: Conversation 妮拉欣德(Neelahind).No. Eskhind claims to be wrongfully accused..Text
string.ID:
Oh.
But... what now?

strings.string:
喔。
但是……現在該怎麼辦？

string.Context: Conversation 妮拉欣德(Neelahind).No. Eskhind claims to be wrongfully accused..You're the Warden. You tell me.Choice.Text
string.ID: You're the Warden. You tell me.

strings.string: 你是典獄長。由你來告訴我。

string.Context: Conversation 妮拉欣德(Neelahind).No. Eskhind claims to be wrongfully accused..We will investigate and find the truth.Choice.Text
string.ID: We will investigate and find the truth.

strings.string: 我們會進行調查並找出真相。

string.Context: Conversation 妮拉欣德(Neelahind).No. Eskhind claims to be wrongfully accused..EndChoice.Text
string.ID: You are useless. I'll get to the bottom of this.

strings.string: 你真沒用。我會查出真相的。

string.Context: Conversation 妮拉欣德(Neelahind).You're the Warden. You tell me..Text
string.ID:
I... I don't know. Grand-doe usually resolves Bey Lah's disputes. I am present to defuse violence, or keep the peace through the threat of it.
What do you think?

strings.string:
我……我不知道。大鹿通常會解決 貝拉的 爭端。我的存在是為了化解暴力，或是透過暴力的威脅來維持和平。
你覺得呢？

string.Context: Conversation 妮拉欣德(Neelahind).You're the Warden. You tell me..We will investigate and find the truth.Choice.Text
string.ID: We will investigate and find the truth.

strings.string: 我們會進行調查並找出真相。

string.Context: Conversation 妮拉欣德(Neelahind).You're the Warden. You tell me..EndChoice.Text
string.ID: You are useless. I'll get to the bottom of this.

strings.string: 你真沒用。我會查出真相的。

string.Context: Conversation 妮拉欣德(Neelahind).We will investigate and find the truth..Text
string.ID:
Oh. Well, yes, that's... that's a good idea. You'll help, right? My axe-arm and conviction are strong, but deduction has never been my greatest strength.
I can answer questions about the people in town, if that would be helpful.

strings.string:
喔。嗯，是的，那……那是個好主意。你會幫忙的，對吧？我的斧手與信念雖然強大，但推理從來不是我最強項的領域。
如果對你有幫助的話，我可以回答關於鎮上居民的問題。

string.Context: Conversation 妮拉欣德(Neelahind).We will investigate and find the truth..Questioning NeelahindChoice.Text
string.ID: It would. Could you answer some questions now?

strings.string: 會的。你現在能回答幾個問題嗎？

string.Context: Conversation 妮拉欣德(Neelahind).We will investigate and find the truth..EndChoice.Text
string.ID: I will return when I have questions... or an accusation.

strings.string: 我有問題時……或是要提出指控時，會再回來。

string.ID:
Ah, =name=, live and drink!
Has your investigation reached a conclusion? Our fate is in your hands.

strings.string:
啊，=name=，盡情生活與飲酒吧！
你的調查有結論了嗎？我們的命運掌握在你的手中。

string.Context: Conversation 妮拉欣德(Neelahind).Fate.妮拉欣德(Neelahind) is giddyChoice.Text
string.ID: Not yet. How are you and Eskhind?

strings.string: 還沒。你和艾斯金德過得如何？

string.ID: Warden, I have found Kindrish.

strings.string: 典獄長，我找到了 Kindrish。

string.ID: Yes, I am ready to accuse the thief.

strings.string: 是的，我準備好指控那個小偷了。

string.ID: Not yet. May I ask you some questions?

strings.string: 還沒有。我可以問你一些問題嗎？

string.ID: No, I do not have enough evidence yet.

strings.string: 不，我還沒有足夠的證據。

string.Context: Conversation 妮拉欣德(Neelahind).妮拉欣德(Neelahind) is giddy.Text
string.ID:
Oh, =name=! I'm so happy!
I can scarcely believe she loves me, much less that... that we could be together. But it's true. Wherever we go from now on, we go together.

strings.string:
喔，=name=！我好開心！
我簡直不敢相信她愛我，更不用說……我們竟然能在一起。但這是真的。從今以後，無論我們去哪裡，我們都將同行。

string.Context: Conversation 妮拉欣德(Neelahind).妮拉欣德(Neelahind) is giddy.EndChoice.Text
string.ID: May your journeys favor you. Live and drink.

strings.string: 願你的旅程順遂。活著，盡情飲酒。

string.ID:
Oh dear, a mystery.
Perhaps I should have accepted Angohind's lessons after all.

strings.string:
喔天哪，真是個謎。
或許我當初終究該接受安戈欣德的教誨。

string.ID: I believe this poem was meant for you.

strings.string: 我相信這首詩是寫給你的。

string.ID: May I ask some questions about the suspects?

strings.string: 我可以針對嫌疑犯問幾個問題嗎？

string.ID: Patience, Warden. I'll get to the bottom of this.

strings.string: 耐心點，典獄長。我會查出真相的。

string.ID: Live and drink, kendren. Have you... come to a conclusion?

strings.string: 活著並暢飲吧，kendren。你是否……有了結論？

string.ID: I believe this poem was meant for you.

strings.string: 我相信這首詩是寫給你的。

string.ID: Yes, I am ready to accuse the thief.

strings.string: 是的，我準備好指控那個小偷了。

string.ID: Not yet. May I ask you some questions?

strings.string: 還沒有。我可以問你一些問題嗎？

string.ID: No, I do not have enough evidence yet.

strings.string: 不，我還沒有足夠的證據。

string.ID: I see. What is it?

strings.string: 我明白了。那是什麽？

string.ID: I discovered a patch of watervine stained red with blood, a sign of recent violence.

strings.string: 我發現了一叢被鮮血染紅的 {{color:red|一叢水藤}}，這是近期發生暴力事件的跡象。

string.ID: I'm still not completely certain. Let me ponder it more.

strings.string: 我還是不太確定。讓我再思考一下。

string.ID: Signs of =circumstance.influence=, seemingly hidden from the village. But that can't be your only evidence, can it? There's no culprit!

strings.string: =circumstance.influence= 的跡象，似乎隱藏在村莊之外。但這不可能是你唯一的證據吧？根本沒有犯罪者！

string.ID: I discovered a patch of watervine stained red with blood, a sign of recent violence.

strings.string: 我發現了一叢被鮮血染紅的 {{color:red|一叢水藤}}，這是近期發生暴力事件的跡象。

string.ID: I'm still not completely certain. Let me ponder it more.

strings.string: 我還是不太確定。讓我再思考一下。

string.ID: I'm afraid that well is poisoned due to your false accusation: =thief.name|strip= isn't the culprit.

strings.string: 恐怕那口井已經中毒了，因為你的指控是錯誤的：=thief.name|strip= 並不是罪魁禍首。

string.ID: Hmm. But the only fur there was from a hindren's pelt, and kendren warriors fight to the death. With no corpse and no other fur, it seems unlikely that a hindren fought an outsider.

strings.string: 嗯。但那裡唯一的皮毛來自於一名希德倫（hindren）的皮，而肯德倫（kendren）戰士總是戰鬥至死。既然沒有屍體也沒有其他皮毛，看來希德倫不太可能與外來者發生戰鬥。

string.ID: I'm afraid that makes no sense. Why would an outsider invite a trader to our village, when they could simply meet one outside of Bey Lah?

strings.string: 恐怕那說不通。為什麼外來者要邀請商人來到我們的村莊，而不是直接在 貝拉(Bey Lah) 之外與他們碰面呢？

string.ID: But weren't the rumors of sore throats in the village? That wouldn't have anything to do with kendren.

strings.string: 但村子裡不是有喉嚨痛的傳聞嗎？那應該跟 kendren 無關吧。

string.ID: Why wouldn't an outsider bring their own leather? It would better disguise Kindrish. It seems a lot of work to find and raid our leather stores.

strings.string: 為什麼外人不帶自己的皮革呢？那樣更能掩蓋 Kindrish 的身份。要尋找並劫掠我們的皮革儲藏室似乎非常費事。

string.ID: Bracers are a Bey Lah craft! It would make no sense for a kendren to have one, then throw it away in the village.

strings.string: 護腕是 貝拉(Bey Lah) 的工藝！一個 肯德倫(kendren) 擁有它，然後在村莊裡把它扔掉，這根本不合邏輯。

string.ID: Kesehind wields Ari, a battleaxe handed down through generations. It cannot break, and if it broke a weapon there would be scorch marks on it. This evidence does not hold up.

strings.string: 凱塞欣德 揮舞著 艾瑞(Ari)，一把代代相傳的戰斧。它不會折斷，而且如果有一件武器折斷了，上面應該會有燒焦的痕跡。這項證據站不住腳。

string.ID: There are few voices as low as Kesehind's in our village. Witnesses report a higher-pitched voice, don't they? They would know if Kesehind were speaking.

strings.string: 我們村莊裡很少有像 凱塞欣德的 聲音那麼低沉。目擊者報告說那是較高頻率的聲音，不是嗎？如果 凱塞欣德 在說話，他們一定會知道的。

string.ID: Oh, no, that wouldn't be Kesehind. He'd sooner die of fever than choke down a single stem of yuckwheat.

strings.string: 喔，不，那不會是凱塞欣德。他寧可死於熱病，也不願吞下一根惡臭麥。

string.ID: Oh, no, that wouldn't be Kesehind. He'd sooner die of fever than choke down a single stem of yuckwheat.

strings.string: 喔，不，那不會是凱塞欣德。他寧可死於熱病，也不願吞下一根惡臭麥。

string.ID: That would be nigh unto impossible for Kesehind. He cannot perform fine tasks by torchlight; his night vision is too poor.

strings.string: 那對 凱塞欣德 來說幾乎是不可能的。他無法在火光下進行精細的工作；他的夜視能力太差了。

string.ID: No, that can't be it. Eskhind hates everything about watervine and keeps a wide berth from it. If her blood was spilled, it would have happened nearer to the path.

strings.string: 不，不可能。艾斯金德 討厭 水藤 的一切，並且會刻意避開它。如果她的血被濺灑，那應該會發生在靠近路徑的地方。

string.ID: No, no. Eskhind makes the most of what few possessions she keeps, and if she traded a treasure for so much water, she'd never have lost track of any.

strings.string: 不，不。艾斯金德 會竭盡所能利用她僅有的少數財產，如果她會為了這麼多水而交易寶藏，她就不會弄丟任何東西了。

string.ID: Oh, no, Eskhind is deathly afraid of saltbacks. She would never get close enough to trade with a dromad merchent.

strings.string: 喔，不，艾斯金德 非常害怕鹽背獸。她絕不會靠近到足以與 駝獸 商人交易的程度。

string.ID: I doubt it. If Eskhind were sick, the last place she would stumble to evacuate her guts would be a watervine field.

strings.string: 我表示懷疑。如果 艾斯金德 生病了，她最後一個會為了排泄腸胃而踉蹌走進去的地方絕對不會是 水藤 田。

string.ID: I'm afraid that Eskhind has no idea how to use proper leatherworking tools, much less pay for a set so fine. This surely isn't hers.

strings.string: 恐怕 艾斯金德 並不知道如何使用正確的 皮革加工工具，更不用說支付這麼精美的一套工具了。這肯定不是她的。

string.ID: I know the rumor you mean, but villagers heard the clash of weapons. Keh is too old for a prolonged fight like that, so I do not believe it was her.

strings.string: 我知道你說的是哪個傳聞，但村民們聽到了兵器碰撞的聲音。Keh 太老了，無法進行那樣持久的戰鬥，所以我並不認為是她。

string.ID: Grand-Doe cannot swim, and panics even near the shallow pools of our paddies. I cannot imagine she would make splashing noises without adding screaming noises to them.

strings.string: 大鹿不會游泳，甚至在稻田的淺水池附近都會恐慌。我無法想像她在拍打水花時，不會同時發出尖叫聲。

string.ID: Copper causes Grand-Doe to break out in great welts. She would not have traded for it, and if she saw a trader drop it, surely she would have told them to pick it up. She hates mess.

strings.string: 銅會讓大牝鹿（Grand-Doe）全身起大腫塊。她絕不會拿這個來交易，如果她看到商人掉落它，肯定會叫他們撿起來。她討厭髒亂。

string.ID: I cannot bring myself to believe that Grand-Doe would allow anyone to stumble upon her own severed tongue. She would surely burn it as soon as she saw it.

strings.string: 我無法相信大牝鹿（Grand-Doe）會允許任何人偶然發現她的斷舌。她一旦看到，肯定會立刻將其焚毀。

string.ID: No, Grand-Doe is absolutely meticulous about work clutter. She wouldn't leave scraps lying about.

strings.string: 不，Grand-Doe 對工作雜物非常講究。她不會讓碎片隨處亂丟。
啊。

string.ID:
Oh. Yes, this does indicate that some kind of =motive.influence= transpired, and =thief.name|strip= was trying to hide it.
So what you're saying is....

strings.string:
喔。是的，這確實顯示發生了某種 =motive.influence=，而 =thief.name|strip= 正試圖隱瞞此事。
所以你的意思是……

string.ID: That's right. By concealing =all.influence=, it was =thief.name|strip= who stole Kindrish!

strings.string: 沒錯。透過隱藏 =all.influence=，偷走 Kindrish 的竟然是 =thief.name|strip=！

string.ID: I'm still not completely certain. Let me ponder it more.

strings.string: 我還是不太確定。讓我再思考一下。

string.ID:
The evidence is clear. In violation of sacred law and the will of her people, Eskhind stole the artifact called Kindrish from Bey Lah. She will be stripped of honor, stripped of water, and stripped from our oral histories. Never will her name be spoken here again, and she will never return... on pain of death.
And I... I will go with her. May my property be payment for the harm she has done to our people, and I will gladly pay it for the privilege of walking by her side.
I have no doubt that Bey Lah will thrive in my absence as it did before I became warden. Live and drink, my kin. Long may Hindriarch Keh lead you.

strings.string:
證據確鑿。艾斯金德違反了神聖法律與族人的意志，從 貝拉(Bey Lah) 手中偷走了名為 Kindrish 的神器。她將被剝奪榮譽、剝奪水源，並從我們的口述歷史中抹除。她的名字在此地絕不會再被提及，她也永遠不會回來……違者處死。
而我……我也將與她同行。願我的財產能作為她對我們族人所造成傷害的補償，我也很樂意為了能與她並肩而行付出這一切。
我毫不懷疑 貝拉(Bey Lah) 在我不在的情況下會像我成為典獄長之前那樣繁榮。生活吧，飲酒吧，我的同胞。願 希德里亞克·凱 長久地引領你們。

string.ID:
The evidence is clear. In violation of sacred law and the will of her people, Eskhind stole the artifact called Kindrish from Bey Lah. She will be stripped of honor, stripped of water, and stripped from our oral histories. Never will her name be spoken here again, and she will never return... on pain of death.
She could never hope to repay the harm caused by her actions, but we will grant her this last mercy: Bey Lah will forget her debt alongside her name.
Just is the leadership of Hindriarch Keh. Long may she live!

strings.string:
證據確鑿。艾斯金德違反了神聖法律與族人的意志，從貝拉手中竊取了名為 Kindrish 的神器。她將被剝奪榮譽、剝奪水源，並從我們的口述歷史中抹除。她的名字在此將不再被提及，且她永不得歸來……違者處死。
她永遠無法彌補其行為所造成的傷害，但我們將賜予她最後的仁慈：貝拉將連同她的名字一起忘記這份債務。
希德里亞克·凱的領導權現已確立。願她長壽！

strings.string:
證據確鑿。艾斯金德 違反了神聖法律與人民的意志，從 貝拉(Bey Lah) 手中偷走了名為 Kindrish 的神器。她將被剝奪榮譽、剝奪水源，並從我們的口述歷史中抹除。她的名字將不再被這裡提及，她也永遠不會回來……否則將處以死刑。
而我……我會跟她一起走。願我的財產能作為她對我們人民所造成傷害的賠償，我也很樂意支付這筆代價，以換取能與她並肩而行的特權。
願命運憐憫我們所有人。

string.ID:

She could never hope to repay the harm caused by her actions, but we will grant her this last mercy: Bey Lah will forget her debt alongside her name.
May the fates have mercy upon us all.

strings.string:
證據確鑿。艾斯金德 違反神聖法律並違背族人的意志，從 貝拉(Bey Lah) 處竊取了名為 Kindrish 的神器。她將被剝奪榮譽、剝奪水源，並從我們的口述歷史中抹除。她的名字將永遠不再被這裡提及，且她絕不允許回歸……違者處以死刑。
她永遠無法彌補其行為所造成的傷害，但我們將給予她最後的仁慈：貝拉(Bey Lah) 將連同她的名字一起忘卻這份債務。
願命運對我們所有人仁慈。

string.ID:
The evidence is clear: Eskhind did not steal Kindrish. In fact, I believe that no hindren was responsible for its theft, but one of the kendren who permeated our borders well before our investigator arrived. Any of them could have committed the theft.
Eskhind is free to go, and I'm... I'm going with her. I cannot serve under Hindriarch Keh while my beloved returns to exile.
I have no doubt that Bey Lah will thrive in my absence as it did before I became warden. Live and drink, my kin. Long may Hindriarch Keh lead you.

strings.string:
證據很明確：艾斯金德 並沒有偷走 Kindrish。事實上，我相信並非任何 hindren 該為此竊案負責，而是早在我們的調查員抵達之前，就已滲透我們邊境的 kendren 其中之一。他們之中任何人都有可能犯下竊盜罪。
艾斯金德 可以自由離開了，而我……我要跟她一起走。當我心愛的人重返流亡之途時，我無法繼續在 希德里亞克·凱 手下效力。
我毫不懷疑 貝拉(Bey Lah) 會在我不在的時候如我成為典獄長之前那樣茁壯成長。活下去並盡情飲酒吧，我的同胞。願 希德里亞克·凱 長久地領導你們。

string.ID:
The evidence is clear: Eskhind did not steal Kindrish. In fact, I believe that no hindren was responsible for its theft, but rather one of the kendren who permeated our borders well before our investigator arrived. Any of them could have committed the theft.
Eskhind helped us cleave to the path of justice. She is free to go, and her name will not be forgotten, but she must remain in exile.
Just is the leadership of Hindriarch Keh. Long may she live!

strings.string:
證據很明確：艾斯金德 並沒有偷走 Kindrish。事實上，我相信並非任何 hindren 應對其失竊負責，而是那些早在我們的調查員抵達前就已滲透我們邊界的 kendren。他們中的任何一個都有可能犯下盜竊罪。
艾斯金德 幫助我們堅持正義之路。她可以自由離開，她的名字不會被遺忘，但她必須保持流亡狀態。
希德里亞克·凱 的領導是公正的。願她長壽！

Goodbye. May the fates have mercy upon you.

strings.string:
證據很明確：艾斯金德並沒有偷走金德里什（Kindrish）。事實上，我相信並非任何希德倫對此竊案負責，而是那些在我們的調查員抵達前就已滲透我們邊境的肯德倫（kendren）。他們中的任何人都可能犯下竊盜罪。
艾斯金德可以自由離開了，而我……我要跟她一起走。當我心愛的人重返流亡時，我無法在希德里亞克·凱手下效力。
再見。願命運對你們仁慈。

string.ID:

Eskhind helped us cleave to the path of justice. She is free to go, and her name will not be forgotten, but she must remain in exile.

strings.string:
證據確鑿：艾斯金德 並未偷走 Kindrish。事實上，我相信並非任何一名 hindren 應對此次竊盜負責，而是早在我們的調查員抵達之前，就已滲透進我們邊境的 kendren 之一。他們中的任何人都可能犯下此罪。
艾斯金德 幫助我們堅持正義之路。她可以自由離去，她的名字也不會被遺忘，但她必須繼續流亡。
願命運對我們所有人仁慈。

string.ID:
The evidence is clear: Eskhind did not steal Kindrish. The crime was committed by none other than Grand-Doe's protector, Kesehind. He will be stripped of the ancestral axe he carries, stripped of his property, and stripped from our oral histories. Never will his name be spoken here again, and he will never return... on pain of death.
Moreover... Keh's attempt to pin blame on Eskhind without due process opened my eyes to her abuses of power. She need not leave Bey Lah, but she is Keh-hind once more-- stripped of her title and standing.
As for the hindriarchy, Eskhind will act as an interim leader until we figure out what to do next, as a people. May Hindriarch Esk lead us to a brighter future!

strings.string:
證據確鑿：艾斯金德 並未偷走 Kindrish。這場罪行是由大鹿的守護者，凱塞欣德 所犯下的。他將被剝奪攜帶的祖傳斧頭、剝奪其財產，並從我們的口述歷史中抹除。他的名字絕不會再在此被提及，他也絕不會再回來……違者處死。
此外……Keh 試圖在缺乏正當程序的情況下將罪名嫁禍給 艾斯金德，這讓我看清了她對權力的濫用。她不必離開 貝拉(Bey Lah)，但她再次變回了 凱欣德——被剝奪了她的頭銜與地位。
至於 欣德里亞克政權，在我們作為一個民族決定下一步該怎麼做之前，艾斯金德 將擔任臨時領導人。願 欣德里亞克(Hindriarch) Esk 引領我們走向更光明的未來！

string.ID:
The evidence is clear: Eskhind did not steal Kindrish. The crime was committed by none other than Grand-Doe's protector, Kesehind. He will be stripped of the ancestral axe he carries, stripped of his property, and stripped from our oral histories. Never will his name be spoken here again, and he will never return... on pain of death.
Moreover... Keh's attempt to pin blame on Eskhind without due process opened my eyes to her abuses of power. She need not leave Bey Lah, but she is Keh-hind once more-- stripped of her title and standing.
As for the hindriarchy, Eskhind will act as an interim leader until we figure out what to do next, as a people. May Hindriarch Esk lead us to a brighter future!

願命運對你仁慈。

string.ID:
The evidence is clear: Bey Lah's own Hindriarch has betrayed her people. She took our ancestral treasure as her own, pinning the crime on an exile she knew could not defend herself. For this treason, she is hereby stripped of title, stripped of property, stripped of home.
With the exile of Keh-Hind, the hindriarchy lies vacant, with no elders fit to take it. Eskhind will act as an interim leader until we figure out what to do next, as a people. May Hindriarch Esk lead us to a brighter future!

strings.string:
證據確鑿：貝拉的 欣德里亞克(Hindriarch) 背叛了她的族人。她將我們的祖傳寶藏據為己有，並將罪名嫁禍給一名她知道無法自辯的流亡者。因這項叛國罪，她在此被剝奪頭銜、剝奪財產、剝奪家園。
隨著 凱欣德 的流放，欣德里亞克政權陷入真空，沒有任何長老足以接任。艾斯金德 將擔任臨時領導人，直到我們作為一個族人想出下一步該怎麼做為止。願 欣德里亞克(Hindriarch) Esk 引領我們走向更光明的未來！

strings.string:
證據確鑿：貝拉(Bey Lah) 的親信 欣德里亞克(Hindriarch) 背叛了她的族人。她將我們的祖傳寶藏據為己有，並將罪名嫁禍給一位她知道無法自衛的流亡者。對於這項叛國罪，她在此被剝奪頭銜、剝奪財產、剝奪家園。
隨著 凱欣德 的流放，欣德里亞克體系（hindriarchy）目前處於空缺狀態，沒有任何長老足以接任。艾斯金德 將擔任臨時領導人，直到我們作為一個民族決定下一步該怎麼做。
我擔心未來將迎來黑暗時代。在接下來的日子裡，我們必須保持強大。

string.ID: My job here is done. Live and drink.

strings.string: 我的任務完成了。活下去，盡情飲酒吧。

string.ID:
For me? Are you sure?
But... this is a poem. In Esk's handwriting. Are you s-sure this is for me?

strings.string:
給我？你確定嗎？
但是⋯⋯這是一首詩。用艾斯的手寫的。你確、確定這是給我的嗎？

string.ID: Yes. Please read it.

strings.string: 是的。請讀一下。

string.ID: Perhaps I'm mistaken. Live and drink.

strings.string: 也許是我搞錯了。祝你生活愉快，盡情暢飲。

string.ID:
Oh.
Ayvah, she-- Eskhind wrote this about... me? How my head swims at these lavish words. If she wrote this and meant it for me, she must... love me.
But it can't be. Can it?

strings.string:
喔。
艾薇亞，她—— 艾斯金德 寫下了關於……我的這些話？看到這些華麗的辭藻，我感到一陣暈眩。如果她是寫給我的，且心意真誠，那她一定……愛著我。
但這不可能吧。對嗎？

string.ID: Can't it?

strings.string: 不行嗎？

string.ID: It is. Live and drink.

strings.string: 正是如此。盡情生活，盡情飲酒。

string.ID:
Kendren, you must understand. I spent so many years trying in vain to fall out of love with Eskhind. I thought it the only way to endure our adolescence, watching her poor attempts at courtship with other hindren.
I thought it the only way to endure her departure, as well. But she is returned, and she loves me. Ayvah. I am terrified to speak to her of this, but I must.
Thank you.

strings.string:
Kendren，你必須明白。我花了這麼多年徒勞地試圖不再愛上艾斯金德。我以為那是熬過我們青春期唯一的辦法，看著她對其他 hindren 那些拙劣的求偶嘗試。
我也以為那是熬過她離去唯一的辦法。但她回來了，而且她愛我。Ayvah。我好害怕跟她談論這件事，但我必須說。
謝謝你。

string.ID: Will this affect the investigation?

strings.string: 這會影響調查嗎？

string.ID: Live and drink, Neelahind.

strings.string: 活著並盡情飲酒吧，妮拉欣德(Neelahind)。

string.ID:
No. You are the one investigating, so my bias need not enter play. If you determine that Eskhind is guilty, I will heed your word and carry out a just sentence.
After that, I'm not sure.

strings.string:
不。你是調查者，所以我的偏見無需介入其中。如果你判定 艾斯金德 有罪，我會聽從你的話並執行公正的判決。
在那之後，我就不確定了。

string.ID: In that case, I have further questions.

strings.string: 既然如此，我還有進一步的問題。

string.Context: Conversation 妮拉欣德(Neelahind).Questioning 妮拉欣德(Neelahind).Text
string.ID: Of course, kendren. Ask away.

strings.string: 當然，肯德倫（kendren）。儘管問吧。

string.Context: Conversation 妮拉欣德(Neelahind).Questioning 妮拉欣德(Neelahind).妮拉欣德(Neelahind) on KehChoice.Text
string.ID: What can you tell me about Hindriarch Keh?

strings.string: 關於 希德里亞克·凱，你能告訴我些什麼？

string.Context: Conversation 妮拉欣德(Neelahind).Questioning 妮拉欣德(Neelahind).妮拉欣德(Neelahind) on EskhindChoice.Text
string.ID: What can you tell me about Eskhind?

strings.string: 關於 艾斯金德 你能告訴我些什麼？

string.Context: Conversation 妮拉欣德(Neelahind).Questioning 妮拉欣德(Neelahind).妮拉欣德(Neelahind) on KesehindChoice.Text
string.ID: What can you tell me about Kesehind?

strings.string: 關於 凱塞欣德 你能告訴我些什麼？

string.Context: Conversation 妮拉欣德(Neelahind).Questioning 妮拉欣德(Neelahind).妮拉欣德(Neelahind) on kendrenChoice.Text
string.ID: What do you know about the outsiders? The kendren?

strings.string: 你對那些外來者了解多少？還有那些 kendren？

string.Context: Conversation 妮拉欣德(Neelahind).Questioning 妮拉欣德(Neelahind).EndChoice.Text
string.ID: I should return to my investigation. Live and drink.

strings.string: 我該回去繼續我的調查了。活下去，盡情飲酒吧。

string.Context: Conversation 妮拉欣德(Neelahind).妮拉欣德(Neelahind) on Keh.Text
string.ID:
Keh is very wise and very careful, which makes up for her lack of strength or... tact. She always knows what's right, and she runs a very tight shift.
She hates clutter from work like nothing else and cleans up any mess she makes--unless it's a spill, then she makes Kesehind do it. It's because Grand-Doe has a terrible fear of standing pools of water, refusing to touch them. Copper and bronze afflict her with allergy-sores and she can't touch them. She's too old to spar with me, but her bow-arm still aims true.
That's all I can think of.

strings.string:
Keh 非常睿智且非常謹慎，這彌補了她力量的不足或……社交手腕的欠缺。她總是知道什麼才是正確的，而且她的值班管理非常嚴格。
她極度討厭工作產生的雜物，並且會清理自己製造的任何髒亂——除非是液體濺灑，那時她會讓 凱塞欣德 去處理。這是因為大母鹿對積水有著極大的恐懼，拒絕觸碰它們。銅和青銅會讓她產生過敏性潰瘍，所以她無法觸碰。她太老了，無法與我進行對練，但她的弓箭手感依然精準。
這就是我能想到的全部了。

string.Context: Conversation 妮拉欣德(Neelahind).妮拉欣德(Neelahind) on Keh.Questioning NeelahindChoice.Text
string.ID: I have another question, if you please.

strings.string: 如果可以的話，我還有另一個問題。

string.Context: Conversation 妮拉欣德(Neelahind).妮拉欣德(Neelahind) on Keh.EndChoice.Text
string.ID: Thank you, that will do. Live and drink.

strings.string: 謝謝，這樣就可以了。活下去，盡情飲酒吧。

string.Context: Conversation 妮拉欣德(Neelahind).妮拉欣德(Neelahind) on Eskhind.Text
string.ID:
Oh. She's, well, she's a good person with strong convictions, or has always seemed so. I suppose that isn't helpful.
Esk has a good eye for detail. She hates watervine so much that she avoids the paddies and won't eat matz without lah broth to make it taste better. Umm, she's afraid of saltbacks. She's good at foraging and terrible at crafting.
I've missed her so much.

strings.string:
喔。她，嗯，她是個信念堅定的好人，或者說一直以來看起來都是如此。我想這也沒什麼幫助。
Esk 對細節很有觀察力。她非常討厭 水藤，所以會避開稻田，而且如果不加 lah 湯讓味道變好，她就不吃 matz。嗯，她很怕鹽背獸。她擅長採集，但製作手藝很爛。
我好想她。

string.Context: Conversation 妮拉欣德(Neelahind).妮拉欣德(Neelahind) on Eskhind.Questioning NeelahindChoice.Text
string.ID: I have another question, if you please.

strings.string: 如果可以的話，我還有另一個問題。

string.Context: Conversation 妮拉欣德(Neelahind).妮拉欣德(Neelahind) on Eskhind.EndChoice.Text
string.ID: Thank you, that will do. Live and drink.

strings.string: 謝謝，這樣就可以了。活下去，盡情飲酒吧。

string.Context: Conversation 妮拉欣德(Neelahind).妮拉欣德(Neelahind) on Kesehind.Text
string.ID:
Kesehind is completely loyal to Grand-Doe. We used to be friends, but his disposition has become so sour since he was appointed her protector, and he's quite cold to me now. He can't see well in darkness. He's the holder of Ari, an unbreakable heirloom fire axe, and he's very skilled with it.
He's terribly finicky about food. He'll only eat bland food and meat, and... oh! Once, when he had a bad cough as a faundren, a caretaker tried to feed him yuckwheat, and he kicked her so hard it dislocated her jaw. Poor Elder Eselhind.

strings.string:
凱塞欣德 對 Grand-Doe 完全忠誠。我們曾是朋友，但自從他被任命為她的守護者後，他的性格變得非常乖戾，現在對我也很冷淡。他在黑暗中看不清東西。他是 艾瑞(Ari) 的持有者，那是一把無法摧毀的傳家寶戰斧，他使用起來非常熟練。
他對食物極其挑剔。他只吃清淡的食物和肉類，而且……喔！有一次，當他還是 faundren 且患有嚴重咳嗽時，一名看護試圖餵他吃 惡臭麥，結果他踢得對方好重，導致她的下顎脫臼了。可憐的長老 Eselhind。

string.Context: Conversation 妮拉欣德(Neelahind).妮拉欣德(Neelahind) on Kesehind.Questioning NeelahindChoice.Text
string.ID: I have another question, if you please.

strings.string: 如果可以的話，我還有另一個問題。

string.Context: Conversation 妮拉欣德(Neelahind).妮拉欣德(Neelahind) on Kesehind.EndChoice.Text
string.ID: Thank you, that will do. Live and drink.

strings.string: 謝謝，這樣就可以了。活下去，盡情飲酒吧。

string.Context: Conversation 妮拉欣德(Neelahind).妮拉欣德(Neelahind) on kendren.Text
string.ID: Oh, not very much. The only kendren who were allowed in the village before you are traders, and it's always a very big fuss when one comes by. It's been a while since that happened, though, so any kendren who have visited must have come in secret.

strings.string: 喔，沒多少。在你之前，村莊裡唯一被允許進入的肯德人（kendren）是商人，而且只要有一個人經過，都會引起很大的騷動。不過那已經是很久以前的事了，所以任何造訪過的肯德人一定是秘密進來的。

string.Context: Conversation 妮拉欣德(Neelahind).妮拉欣德(Neelahind) on kendren.Questioning NeelahindChoice.Text
string.ID: I have another question, if you please.

strings.string: 如果可以的話，我還有另一個問題。

string.Context: Conversation 妮拉欣德(Neelahind).妮拉欣德(Neelahind) on kendren.EndChoice.Text
string.ID: Thank you, that will do. Live and drink.

strings.string: 謝謝，這樣就可以了。活下去，盡情飲酒吧。

string.ID:
Live and drink, kendren.
Please forgive me; I am grateful that you opened my eyes, but the sight of you is yet a bitter leaf. Let me grieve my people in peace.

strings.string:
活下去並盡情飲酒吧，kendren。
請原諒我；我很感激你啟發了我的雙眼，但看見你依然如苦葉般令人難受。讓我安靜地哀悼我的族人吧。

string.ID: Does this poem belong to you?

strings.string: 這首詩是你的嗎？

string.ID: My condolences.

strings.string: 深表哀悼。

string.ID:
You've found our treasure? Thank you, kendren!
Please take this reward, we set it aside for just this purpose. I apologize if it's too little. Thank you so much, again.

strings.string:
你找到了我們的寶藏？謝謝你，肯德倫！
請收下這份獎勵，我們正是為了這個目的才將其留存。如果獎勵太少，我深感抱歉。再次非常感謝你。

string.ID: Live and drink, warden.

strings.string: 活下去並盡情暢飲吧，典獄長。

string.ID: There's a fear deep in my breast, kendren. What's to become of Bey Lah?

strings.string: 我的內心深處感到恐懼，kendren。貝拉會變得怎麼樣？

string.ID: Warden, I have found Kindrish.

strings.string: 典獄長，我找到了 Kindrish。

string.ID: Fine. Live and drink.

strings.string: 好吧。活著並盡情享樂吧。

string.ID:
Kendren! I mean, =name=! My heart sings to see you.
Thank you for clearing Esk's name. Thank you for bringing us together. You are always welcome here.

strings.string:
Kendren！我是說，=name=！見到你我心花怒放。
謝謝你為 Esk 洗清冤屈。謝謝你讓我們團結在一起。這裡永遠歡迎你。

string.ID: You're welcome. Live and drink.

strings.string: 不客氣。活著，並盡情飲酒。

string.ID: Ah! Kendren! =name=! I'm so happy! Live and drink.

strings.string: 啊！Kendren！=name=！我好開心！活下去，盡情飲酒吧。

string.ID: Live and drink, warden.

strings.string: 活下去並盡情暢飲吧，典獄長。

string.ID: =name=, it is good to see you. Rest and sup before you move on.

strings.string: =name=，很高興見到你。在繼續前行之前，先休息一下並用餐吧。

string.ID: I believe this poem was meant for you.

strings.string: 我相信這首詩是寫給你的。

string.ID: Live and drink, warden.

strings.string: 活下去並盡情暢飲吧，典獄長。

string.ID:
Kendren, thank you for clearing Esk's name!
You're so decisive. I wish I had that strength.

strings.string:
Kendren，謝謝你為 Esk 洗清冤屈！
你真是果斷。我真希望我也能有那樣的力量。

string.ID: I believe this poem was meant for you.

strings.string: 我相信這首詩是寫給你的。

string.ID:
Oh! Is this what... Esk!
I could have gone years unknowing that my love for her was returned. But this is her script, and these words describe me.
Ayvah, I have to speak to her! Thank you so much, kendren.

strings.string:
喔！這就是……艾斯克！
我本可能多年都不知道她也愛著我。但這是她的劇本，而這些文字描述的就是我。
艾薇亞，我必須跟她說話！非常感謝你，kendren。

string.ID: You're welcome. Live and drink.

strings.string: 不客氣。活著，並盡情飲酒。

string.ID:
Thank you again for opening my eyes, kendren.
I have trouble smiling for my grief, my loss. Nonetheless, Eskhind and I have a brighter future because of you, and we are together. The road is hazardous, but we will walk it in time.

strings.string:
再次感謝你開啟我的眼界，kendren。
因為我的悲痛與喪失，我難以展露笑容。儘管如此，因為你，艾斯金德 與我有了更光明的未來，我們在一起。道路雖然險阻，但我們會隨時間慢慢走下去。

string.ID: My condolences. Live and drink.

strings.string: 請節哀。活著，並盡情飲酒。

string.ID:
Kendren...
I have so much anger at what has been done, but you opened my eyes. Thank you.

strings.string:
Kendren...
對於所發生的一切，我感到無比憤怒，但你啟發了我。謝謝你。

string.ID: Ah, =name=. The sight of you is yet a bitter leaf, but you are welcome here.

strings.string: 啊，=name=。見到你仍如苦葉般令人不悅，但這裡歡迎你。

string.ID: Does this poem belong to you?

strings.string: 這首詩是你的嗎？

string.ID:
Kendren.
Forgive me for seeming ungrateful. I am more affected by Esk's return and departure than I knew. Please give me space.

strings.string:
肯德倫（Kendren）。
請原諒我的不知感恩。我對艾斯克（Esk）的歸來與離去所受到的影響，比我想像中的還要深。請給我一點空間。

string.ID: Does this poem belong to you?

strings.string: 這首詩是你的嗎？

string.ID:
What is this?
Poetry. In the exile's handwriting. Extolling love for... me, or someone very like me.
Is... is this a cruel joke? This cannot be real.

strings.string:
這是什麼？
詩句。出自流亡者的筆跡。讚美著對……我，或是與我很像的人的愛。
這……這是一個殘酷的玩笑嗎？這不可能是真的。

string.ID: It is real. Take the poem.

strings.string: 這是真的。收下這首詩吧。

string.ID: I must be mistaken. Live and drink.

strings.string: 一定是我搞錯了。活著，盡情飲酒吧。

string.ID:
She loved me.
She loved me and I ... I exiled her. Oh, my heart.
Kendren I, I am grateful that you have opened my eyes to the truth, but how dearly I wish you had intervened earlier. This poem serves only as a harsh reminder that I must give up everything for my duty.
Please. Please leave me be. My heart... Esk, my heart...

strings.string:
她愛過我。
她愛著我，而我……我放逐了她。噢，我的心。
Kendren I，我很感激你讓我看清了真相，但我多麼希望你能早點介入。這首詩僅僅是一個殘酷的提醒，告訴我必須為了職責放棄一切。
求你了。求你讓我一個人待著。我的心……Esk，我的心……

string.ID: Live and drink, kendren.

strings.string: 活下去，盡情飲酒吧，肯德倫（kendren）。

string.ID:
I must admit, =name=, that I can think of few notions more challenging to my people than to welcome a flower-people into our town. Some will see them as no better than walking lah.
But if the notion came from you, they might consider putting it to a vote, at least. If you'll stand by, I will call a referendum.

strings.string: 我必須承認，=name=，對我的族人來說，沒有比歡迎花人進入我們的城鎮更具挑戰性的想法了。有些人會認為他們不過是會走路的啦。

string.ID: Please do.

strings.string: 請便。

string.ID:
I'll have Warden Neelahind gather everyone as soon as they can spare the eyes and ears for it.
{{emote|*Hindriarch Esk canters away, voice already raised.*}} Hey, Warden!

strings.string:
我會讓典獄長 妮拉欣德(Neelahind) 在他們能抽身關注此事時盡快召集所有人。
{{emote|*欣德里亞克(Hindriarch) Esk 輕快地走開，聲音已經提高。*}} 嘿，典獄長！

string.ID: {{emote|The moments pass in hundreds, filled with dust and noise. Voices rise, hooves stamp the packed earth, and a fledgling democratic process takes its first faltering steps.}}

strings.string: {{emote|時光在塵埃與喧囂中流逝。人聲鼎沸，蹄聲踏著緊實的土地，一個初生的民主程序正邁出它那踉蹌的第一步。}}

string.ID: Hold there! Who are you? What do you want?

strings.string: 站住！你是誰？你想幹什麼？

string.ID: I am leaving.

strings.string: 我要離開了。

string.ID: Hold there! Who are you? What do you want?

strings.string: 站住！你是誰？你想幹什麼？

string.Context: Conversation Eskhind.Start2.欣德里亞克(Hindriarch) Keh sent me.Choice.Text
string.ID: I am =name=. Hindriarch Keh sent me.

strings.string: 我是 =name=。是 希德里亞克·凱 派我來的。

string.Context: Conversation Eskhind.Start2.Give back what you stole.Choice.Text
string.ID: I am justice. Give back what you stole.

strings.string: 我即是正義。把妳偷走的東西還回來。

string.ID: I am your worst nightmare. Prepare to die.

strings.string: 我是你最可怕的噩夢。準備受死吧。

string.ID: Nothing. Live and drink.

strings.string: 沒什麼。活下去，盡情飲酒吧。

string.Context: Conversation Eskhind.欣德里亞克(Hindriarch) Keh sent me..Text
string.ID: Keh? I'm shocked that she even deigned to speak my name. I am a pariah now, beneath discussion. Does she demand remuneration for the scant supplies I stole?

strings.string: 凱？我很震驚她竟然願意開口叫我的名字。我現在是個賤民，不值一提。她是在要求我偷走的那點微薄物資的補償嗎？

string.Context: Conversation Eskhind.欣德里亞克(Hindriarch) Keh sent me..You stole Kindrish.Choice.Text
string.ID: She says that you stole Kindrish, the village's treasure.

strings.string: 她說你偷走了村莊的寶藏——金德里什（Kindrish）。

string.Context: Conversation Eskhind.Give back what you stole..Text
string.ID: What I stole? I stole supplies to sustain myself and my sisters, nothing more, and little enough that no one would suffer for its absence. You would cut those from my hide?

strings.string: 我偷了什麼？我只是偷了一些足以維持我和姐妹們生存的物資，僅此而已，而且數量少到不會有人因為缺少這些而受苦。你竟然要從我的皮肉上割下這些東西？

string.Context: Conversation Eskhind.Give back what you stole..You stole Kindrish.Choice.Text
string.ID: No. You stole the treasure called Kindrish.

strings.string: 不。你偷走了名為 Kindrish 的寶藏。

string.ID:
{{emote|*Eskhind bursts into forced, nervous laughter*}}
Is that her angle? To claim that I stole Kindrish? Her influence must be waning more than even I knew.

strings.string:
{{emote|*艾斯金德 bursts into forced, nervous laughter*}}
那是她的手段嗎？聲稱是我偷走了 Kindrish？她的影響力衰退得比我預想的還要嚴重。

string.Context: Conversation Eskhind.You stole Kindrish..What are you saying?Choice.Text
string.ID: What are you saying?

strings.string: 你在說什麼？

string.Context: Conversation Eskhind.You stole Kindrish..You claim innocence?Choice.Text
string.ID: You claim innocence?

strings.string: 你聲稱自己是清白的？

string.Context: Conversation Eskhind.You stole Kindrish..I suspected this.Choice.Text
string.ID: A frame-up. I suspected this.

strings.string: 這是個陷阱。我早就懷疑了。

string.ID:
What do you imagine I am saying? The aging, ineffectual leader of a village in isolation. A system that strives to forget anyone who sees the outside, no matter how much its inhabitants strive for a better tomorrow.
Bey Lah's isolationism provides ideal patsies for any crime the Hindriarch chooses to commit.

strings.string:
你以為我在說什麼？一個與世隔絕的村莊裡，那種衰老且無能的領導者。一個竭力忘記任何目睹過外界之人，無論其居民如何努力追求更好的明天。
貝拉的 孤立主義 為 欣德里亞克(Hindriarch) 想要犯下的任何罪行都提供了理想的替罪羊。

string.Context: Conversation Eskhind.What are you saying?.You think Keh stole the treasure?Choice.Text
string.ID: You think Keh stole the treasure?

strings.string: 你認為 Keh 偷走了寶藏嗎？

string.Context: Conversation Eskhind.What are you saying?.Why should I believe you?Choice.Text
string.ID: Why should I believe you?

strings.string: 我為什麼要相信你？

string.Context: Conversation Eskhind.What are you saying?.What should I do?Choice.Text
string.ID: What do you expect me to do, then?

strings.string: 那你期望我做什麼？

string.ID:
Yes. I am falsely accused.
See, Bey Lah strives to forget anyone who sees the outside. The gerontocracy ensures that its leaders will always be aging and fearful. Pariahs like me can be easily accused of crimes committed by Keh or her cronies.

strings.string:
是的。我被誣陷了。
你看，貝拉正努力忘記任何看過外界的人。老人政治確保其領導者永遠在衰老且充滿恐懼。像我這樣的賤民很容易就會被指控犯下 Keh 或她的黨羽所犯下的罪行。

string.Context: Conversation Eskhind.You claim innocence?.You think Keh stole the treasure?Choice.Text
string.ID: You think Keh stole the treasure?

strings.string: 你認為 Keh 偷走了寶藏嗎？

string.Context: Conversation Eskhind.You claim innocence?.Why should I believe you?Choice.Text
string.ID: Why should I believe you?

strings.string: 我為什麼要相信你？

string.ID: Lies. You are trying to manipulate me.

strings.string: 謊言。你正試圖操縱我。

string.Context: Conversation Eskhind.You claim innocence?.What should I do?Choice.Text
string.ID: What do you expect me to do, then?

strings.string: 那你期望我做什麼？

string.ID:
Well, good. I would give you a prize for your insight, but times have been lean.
As you say, the Hindriarch is obviously framing me. As a pariah, I am an ideal patsy for Keh. Much as I love my people, they are weak of will and do not question the Grand-Doe.

strings.string:
嗯，很好。我本想因為你的洞察力而給你獎勵，但最近手頭有點緊。
正如你所說，欣德里亞克(Hindriarch) 顯然是在栽贓我。作為一名被排斥者，我是 Keh 最理想的替罪羊。儘管我深愛我的族人，但他們意志薄弱，不會質疑 Grand-Doe。

string.Context: Conversation Eskhind.I suspected this..You think Keh stole the treasure?Choice.Text
string.ID: You really think Keh stole the treasure?

strings.string: 你真的認為是 Keh 偷走了寶藏嗎？

string.Context: Conversation Eskhind.I suspected this..Why should I believe you?Choice.Text
string.ID: Why should I believe you?

strings.string: 我為什麼要相信你？

string.ID: Lies. You are trying to manipulate me.

strings.string: 謊言。你正試圖操縱我。

string.Context: Conversation Eskhind.I suspected this..What should I do?Choice.Text
string.ID: What can be done, then?

strings.string: 那麼，還有什麼辦法嗎？

string.Context: Conversation Eskhind.I suspected this..Eskhind is rudeChoice.Text
string.ID: You didn't need to be rude about it.

strings.string: 你沒必要對此如此無禮。

string.Context: Conversation Eskhind.You think Keh stole the treasure?.Text
string.ID:
Ay, you kendren are just as thick as the elders. I'd hoped otherwise.
Yes, I am suggesting that old Grand-Doe is trying to fool you, and the village as well. I'm not certain that she stole it herself, but an investigation might undermine her authority, and she cannot have that.

strings.string:
唉，你們這些肯德倫（kendren）跟長輩一樣笨。我原本還指望你們不一樣呢。
是的，我的意思是老的大鹿（Grand-Doe）正試圖愚弄妳，也在愚弄整個村莊。我不確定是不是她親手偷的，但調查可能會削弱她的權威，而她是不能容忍這種事的。

string.Context: Conversation Eskhind.You think Keh stole the treasure?.What should I do?Choice.Text
string.ID: What should I do, then?

strings.string: 那麼，我該怎麼做？

string.Context: Conversation Eskhind.You think Keh stole the treasure?.Eskhind is rudeChoice.Text
string.ID: You don't need to be so rude.

strings.string: 你沒必要這麼無禮。

string.Context: Conversation Eskhind.Why should I believe you?.Text
string.ID:
Why should you believe me? Well, why should you believe Keh? Ayvah, think about this!
I'm not asking you to give me your unconditional trust, understand? Only to extend to me the same level of trust you give Keh. Is that not reasonable? Is that not just?

strings.string:
你為什麼要相信我？好吧，你為什麼要相信 Keh？Ayvah，想一想啊！
我不是要求你給我無條件的信任，明白嗎？只是希望你能對我展現與對 Keh 同等的信任程度。這難道不合理嗎？這難道不公平嗎？

string.Context: Conversation Eskhind.Why should I believe you?.What should I do?Choice.Text
string.ID: What are you suggesting I do?

strings.string: 你建議我該怎麼做？

string.ID:
Ayvah. I'd wanted Grand-Doe to be wrong about you kendren, but perhaps you are all violent fools after all.
I'm not asking you to trust me, only to extend to me the same level of trust you give Keh. Is that not reasonable?

strings.string:
Ayvah。我本希望大鹿對你們這些肯德倫人的看法是錯的，但或許你們終究都是些暴力的蠢貨。
我並非要求你信任我，僅僅是希望你能給予我與 Keh 同等的信任。這很合理吧？

string.ID: What are you suggesting I do?

strings.string: 你建議我該怎麼做？

string.ID: You don't need to be so rude.

strings.string: 你沒必要這麼無禮。

string.ID: You've wasted enough of my time. Prepare to die.

strings.string: 你已經浪費了我足夠的時間。準備受死吧。

string.ID:
Rude? How dare--
No, I... I apologize for my rudeness. Please understand that we have lost so much by leaving Bey Lah. My mind is not in a gentle place, and being revisited by the tyranny I left behind is causing newly-closed wounds to open.
Forgive my tone, but please understand: I did not steal Kindrish. You are being used.

strings.string:
無禮？你竟敢——
不，我……我為我的無禮道歉。請理解，離開 貝拉(Bey Lah) 讓我們失去了太多。我的心境並不平靜，而那些我曾拋下的暴政再次襲來，正讓新癒合的傷口重新裂開。
原諒我的語氣，但請明白：我沒有偷走 Kindrish。你正被利用。

string.Context: Conversation Eskhind.Eskhind is rude.What should I do?Choice.Text
string.ID: What should I do?

strings.string: 我該怎麼做？

string.ID:
The proof is in the petals, kendren. You want justice? Find out what really happened.
If you find evidence, Warden Neelahind will support you. Speak to her. She is loyal to Grand-Doe, but more loyal to the truth.
I will return to the village and we will sort this out. The Hindriarch will have to tolerate my presence until my name is cleared.

strings.string:
證據就在花瓣之中，肯德倫（kendren）。你想要正義？那就去查清真相。
如果你找到了證據，典獄官 妮拉欣德(Neelahind) 會支持你。去找她談談吧。她效忠於大鹿（Grand-Doe），但更效忠於真相。
我會回到村莊，我們會把這件事解決掉。在我的名聲洗清之前，欣德里亞克(Hindriarch) 必須容忍我的存在。

string.ID: I'll look into this, but you'd better not go missing.

strings.string: 我會調查這件事，但你最好別失蹤。

string.ID: I will. Live and drink.

strings.string: 我會的。活下去並盡情飲酒吧。

string.ID: Go tell Keh that I will remain in Bey Lah until this is sorted.

strings.string: 去告訴 Keh，在事情解決之前，我會留在 貝拉(Bey Lah)。

string.ID: Very well. Live and drink.

strings.string: 很好。盡情生活與飲酒吧。

string.ID: Moon and Sun, =name=.

strings.string: 月亮與太陽，=name=。

string.ID: How are things with Neelahind?

strings.string: 妮拉欣德(Neelahind) 的情況如何？

string.ID: I have questions for you.

strings.string: 我有問題要問你。

string.ID: Wisdom and Will, Eskhind.

strings.string: 智慧與意志，艾斯金德。

string.ID:
Things are good. Better than I dreamed. I owe you so much for your intervention, =name=.
I still can't quite believe that my feelings are requited. I am at once elated and terrified. But this is good. My future is brighter now.
Thank you.

strings.string:
一切都很美好。比我夢想中的還要好。=name=，真的很感謝你的介入，我欠你太多了。
我還是不太敢相信我的心意得到了回應。我同時感到欣喜若狂又惶恐不安。但這是好事。我的未來現在變得更加光明了。
謝謝你。

string.ID: May it brighten even further. Live and drink.

strings.string: 願它能更加璀璨。活下去，盡情飲酒吧。

string.ID: What is it, kendren?

strings.string: 怎麼了，kendren？

string.ID: I have questions for you.

strings.string: 我有問題要問你。

string.ID: Does this crumpled sheet of paper belong to you?

strings.string: 這張揉皺的紙張是你的嗎？

string.ID: Nothing. Live and drink.

strings.string: 沒什麼。活下去，盡情飲酒吧。

string.ID: Ask away.

strings.string: 儘管問吧。

string.ID: Does this crumpled sheet of paper belong to you?

strings.string: 這張揉皺的紙張是你的嗎？

string.ID: Why did you leave Bey Lah?

strings.string: 你為什麼離開了 貝拉(Bey Lah)？

string.ID: Who might have stolen Kindrish?

strings.string: 誰可能會偷走 Kindrish？

string.ID: What evidence should I be looking for?

strings.string: 我應該尋找什麼樣的證據？

string.ID: You and the Warden were close, were you not?

strings.string: 你和典獄長關係很好，不是嗎？

string.ID: The Hindriarch mentioned that you have a brother. Where is he?

strings.string: 欣德里亞克提到你有個兄弟。他在哪裡？

string.ID: Nothing for now. Live and drink.

strings.string: 目前沒什麼。活著，然後飲用。

string.ID:
Why? Why did I leave a single parasang square piece of land upon which I was expected to live my entire life, forever obeying a woman whose sole qualification of rule is her gender and age? Why did I leave a place where we eat the same damned soup for nine out of ten meals and the height of occupational versatility is leatherworking?
The question isn't why I left, it's why I'm the only one who chose to do so, why none of my pleas were convincing to the hindren I love. If we would just open the borders, it would never have come to this.

strings.string:
為什麼？為什麼我要離開這僅有一平方帕桑格大小、預期我將終身居住的土地，永遠服從一個僅憑性別與年齡就擁有統治權的女人？為什麼我要離開一個十頓飯中有九頓都在吃同樣該死的湯，且職業多樣性的極限僅止於皮革加工的地方？
問題不在於我為什麼離開，而在於為什麼我是唯一選擇離開的人，為什麼我的所有懇求都無法說服我所愛的 hindren。如果我們當時只要開放邊界，事情就不會演變成這樣。

string.ID: Who might have stolen Kindrish?

strings.string: 誰可能會偷走 Kindrish？

string.ID: What evidence should I be looking for?

strings.string: 我應該尋找什麼樣的證據？

string.ID: You and the Warden were close, were you not?

strings.string: 你和典獄長關係很好，不是嗎？

string.ID: The Hindriarch mentioned that you have a brother. Where is he?

strings.string: 欣德里亞克提到你有個兄弟。他在哪裡？

string.ID: Nothing for now. Live and drink.

strings.string: 目前沒什麼。活著，然後飲用。

string.ID:
The Hindriarch is the most likely suspect, in my opinion. She might have kept it for herself or sold it. I've been suspicious of her pet bodyguard, Kesehind, for years--I wouldn't put it past him to steal the treasure himself.
That said, it might have been an outsider like you. I doubt any of the villagers had the nerve to steal such a valuable object, but I suppose it's faintly possible.
But it wasn't Neelahind. You won't find a purer heart in all of Qud than hers.

strings.string:
依我看，欣德里亞克(Hindriarch) 是最有嫌疑的人。她可能私藏了它，或者把它賣掉了。多年來我一直懷疑她的寵物保鏢 凱塞欣德——我不認為他會做不出偷走寶藏這種事。
話雖如此，也可能是像你這樣的局外人所為。我不認為村裡的任何人都膽敢偷竊如此珍貴的物品，但我想這還是有一絲可能的。
但絕不會是 妮拉欣德(Neelahind)。在整個 卡德(Qud)，你找不到比她更純潔的心靈了。

string.ID: Why did you leave Bey Lah?

strings.string: 你為什麼離開了 貝拉(Bey Lah)？

string.ID: What evidence should I be looking for?

strings.string: 我應該尋找什麼樣的證據？

string.ID: You and the Warden were close, were you not?

strings.string: 你和典獄長關係很好，不是嗎？

string.ID: The Hindriarch mentioned that you have a brother. Where is he?

strings.string: 欣德里亞克提到你有個兄弟。他在哪裡？

string.ID: Nothing for now. Live and drink.

strings.string: 目前沒什麼。活著，然後飲用。

string.ID:
Objects out of place, certainly. Bey Lah produces little and sees almost no violence, so signs of the outside world should be easy to find.
You may wish to talk to the villagers, too. My people are starved for entertainment, gossip travels fast, and we are all notoriously poor liars.

strings.string:
物品錯位的情況確實存在。貝拉(Bey Lah) 產出的東西很少，也幾乎沒見過暴力，所以外界的跡象應該很容易被發現。
你也或許想跟村民聊聊。我的族人極度渴望娛樂，八卦傳播得很快，而且我們全都以拙劣的謊言聞名。

string.ID: Why did you leave Bey Lah?

strings.string: 你為什麼離開了 貝拉(Bey Lah)？

string.ID: Who might have stolen Kindrish?

strings.string: 誰可能會偷走 Kindrish？

string.ID: You and the Warden were close, were you not?

strings.string: 你和典獄長關係很好，不是嗎？

string.ID: The Hindriarch mentioned that you have a brother. Where is he?

strings.string: 欣德里亞克提到你有個兄弟。他在哪裡？

string.ID: Nothing for now. Live and drink.

strings.string: 目前沒什麼。活著，然後飲用。

string.ID:
Yes. We were close. More than close.
If it tore my heart to ragged halves to leave my people behind, leaving Neelahind shredded it into scraps.

strings.string:
是的。我們曾很親近。不僅僅是親近。
如果說拋下族人讓我心碎成兩半，那麼離開 妮拉欣德則將我的心撕成了碎片。

string.ID: Why did you leave Bey Lah?

strings.string: 你為什麼離開了 貝拉(Bey Lah)？

string.ID: Who might have stolen Kindrish?

strings.string: 誰可能會偷走 Kindrish？

string.ID: What evidence should I be looking for?

strings.string: 我應該尋找什麼樣的證據？

string.ID: The Hindriarch mentioned that you have a brother. Where is he?

strings.string: 欣德里亞克提到你有個兄弟。他在哪裡？

string.ID: Nothing for now. Live and drink.

strings.string: 目前沒什麼。活著，然後飲用。

string.ID: I have no brother. My two sisters are all the blood family I can claim.

strings.string: 我沒有兄弟。我的兩位姊妹是我所能稱呼的所有血親。

string.ID: Keh seems to believe otherwise.

strings.string: Keh 似乎並不這麼認為。

string.ID: Why did you leave Bey Lah?

strings.string: 你為什麼離開了 貝拉(Bey Lah)？

string.ID: Who might have stolen Kindrish?

strings.string: 誰可能會偷走 Kindrish？

string.ID: What evidence should I be looking for?

strings.string: 我應該尋找什麼樣的證據？

string.ID: You and the Warden were close, were you not?

strings.string: 你和典獄長關係很好，不是嗎？

string.ID: Nothing for now. Live and drink.

strings.string: 目前沒什麼。活著，然後飲用。

string.ID:
Keh believes that she gets final say regarding who is a sister or brother. Regardless of what the sibling in question thinks.
That's part of why I left.

strings.string:
Keh 認為她擁有關於誰是姊妹或兄弟的最終決定權。無論該名手足如何想。
這也是我離開的部分原因。

string.ID: May I ask further questions?

strings.string: 我可以繼續提問嗎？

string.ID: Understood. Live and drink.

strings.string: 明白了。活著，且盡情飲酒。

string.ID:
Oh. Oh no. Yes, that's. That's mine.
I meant to burn it. I probably should have burned it. I wish I had burned it.
May I please have it back?

strings.string:
喔。喔不。是的，那是……那是我的。
我本打算燒掉它的。我可能應該燒掉它的。我真希望當時有把它燒掉。
可以請你把它還給我嗎？

string.ID: So you can burn it?

strings.string: 所以你可以燒掉它？

string.ID: Hmm. No, I think not.

strings.string: 嗯。不，我想不是。

string.ID:
You have me helpless. That poem is my clumsy expression of a deep truth that frightens me. It is a risk that I lacked the strength to take or leave.
My heart quails in your hands, kendren.

strings.string:
你讓我束手無策。那首詩是我對一個令我恐懼的深層真理所做的笨拙表達。這是一個我既缺乏力量去冒險，也無法選擇放棄的風險。
我的心在你的手中顫抖，kendren。

string.ID: You wish you had burned such a vital truth?

strings.string: 你希望自己當初燒毀了那樣至關重要的真相嗎？

string.ID: It shall quail a bit longer. Live and drink.

strings.string: 它還會再顫抖一陣子。活著，盡情飲酒。

string.ID:
No! Yes? I don't know.
Yes, I wish I burned it, but I wish I had given it. I wish I had never written it, or I had written it better, or I had simply confessed in person. I wish I had a harder heart.
I wish you would give it back, or burn it, or give it to her.

strings.string:
不！還是要？我不知道。
是的，我希望我燒掉了它，但我又希望我把它送出去了。我希望我從未寫下它，或者我寫得更好一點，或者我乾脆親自坦白。我希望我的心腸能更硬一些。
我希望你能把它還回來，或是燒掉它，或是把它交給她。

string.ID: If I do give it back, what will you do with it?

strings.string: 如果我把它還給你，你會拿它做什麼？

string.ID: I could give it to her.

strings.string: 我可以把它給她。

string.ID: This got a bit intense. Live and drink.

strings.string: 氣氛變得有點緊張了。活下去，盡情飲酒吧。

string.ID:
I was trying not to think too hard about any of this until you found my poem, so... I can't say.
But I can't ignore this sign of my cowardice, not after you found it.

strings.string:
在你發現我的詩之前，我一直試著不去深思這些事，所以……我也說不上來。
但在你發現它之後，我不能再忽視這份懦弱的證明了。

string.ID: Take the poem. Be brave.

strings.string: 收下這首詩。勇敢面對。

string.ID: Shall I deliver the poem for you?

strings.string: 需要我為你遞送那首詩嗎？

string.ID: I will think further on this.

strings.string: 我會再進一步考慮這件事。

string.ID:
Kendren... =name=. I will try.
I... thank you. Live and drink.

strings.string:
Kendren... =name=。我會試試看。
我... 謝謝你。活下去，盡情飲酒吧。

string.ID: Live and drink, Eskhind.

strings.string: 活下去，盡情飲酒吧，艾斯金德。

string.ID:
Deliver it? But how do you even know who--
Mm. Never mind. My head is spinning. I think that if... the poem were to find itself in the warden's hands, that would perhaps be a good thing. Maybe.

strings.string:
送去？但你怎麼會知道是誰——
唔。算了。我頭好暈。我想如果……那首詩落入典獄長手中，或許會是一件好事。也許吧。

string.ID: Then perhaps it will. Live and drink.

strings.string: 那麼或許會如此。祝你生活愉快，盡情暢飲。

string.ID: No, Eskhind. Take the poem. Be brave.

strings.string: 不，艾斯金德。拿走那首詩。勇敢一點。

string.ID:
I couldn't save them.
I tried. I tried to save them.

strings.string:
我沒能救他們。
我試過了。我真的試著要救他們。

string.ID: I think this poem is yours.

strings.string: 我想這首詩是你的。

string.ID: Condolences. Live and drink.

strings.string: 深表哀悼。生存與飲酒吧。

string.ID: I'm uneasy. What is this mounting dread? I cannot talk now.

strings.string: 我感到不安。這股不斷累積的恐懼感是什麼？我現在無法交談。

string.ID:
If it isn't the hero kendren, =name=.
Welcome back to Bey Lah! Stay as long as you like.

strings.string:
看看是誰，英雄 kendren, =name=。
歡迎回到 貝拉(Bey Lah)! 隨你待多久都可以。

string.ID: Hindriarch, I have found Kindrish.

strings.string: 欣德里亞克(Hindriarch)，我找到 Kindrish 了。

string.ID: How is life as Hindriarch?

strings.string: 作為 欣德里亞克(Hindriarch) 的生活如何？

string.ID: You're welcome. Live and drink.

strings.string: 不客氣。活著，並盡情飲酒。

string.ID:
Hah! Real justice? I never thought I'd see the like, not here. Well done!
I'll admit, I would have preferred to avoid becoming Hindriarch, but I'm hoping to bring my people to a more Democratic form of governance. Then I can vote myself out.

strings.string:
哈！真正的正義？我從沒想過能在這裡看到這種事。做得好！
我承認，我原本比較想避免變成 欣德里亞克(Hindriarch)，但我希望能帶領我的族人走向更民主的治理形式。到那時，我也能投票把自己罷免掉。

string.ID: Live and drink, Hindriarch.

strings.string: 活著，且盡情飲酒，欣德里亞克(Hindriarch)。

string.ID: Welcome back to Bey Lah, =name=. Stay as long as you like.

strings.string: 歡迎回到 貝拉(Bey Lah)，=name=。請盡情停留。

string.ID: I believe this poem is yours.

strings.string: 我想這首詩是你的。

string.ID: How is life as Hindriarch?

strings.string: 作為 欣德里亞克(Hindriarch) 的生活如何？

string.ID: Live and drink, Hindriarch.

strings.string: 活著，且盡情飲酒，欣德里亞克(Hindriarch)。

string.ID:
You have my gratitude for this exoneration, kendren. This worked out better than I expected thanks to you.
I'll admit, I would have preferred to avoid becoming Hindriarch, but I'm hoping to bring my people to a more Democratic form of governance. Then I can vote myself out.

strings.string:
感謝你對此事的洗清，kendren。多虧了你，事情的進展比我預期的還要好。
我承認，我原本更希望避免成為欣德里亞克，但我希望能帶領我的族人走向更民主的治理形式。到那時，我就能投票把自己罷免了。

string.ID: I believe this poem is yours.

strings.string: 我想這首詩是你的。

string.ID:
Oh! Well. For you to bring me this after returning me to Bey Lah...
{{emote|*she smiles.*}}
Message received, =name=. If I expect my people to face their fear of the unknown, I owe it to them to face mine.
I will confess my feelings to Neelahind, give her the poem I wrote, and accept whatever reply she has for me. Thank you again.

strings.string:
喔！好吧。在把我送回 貝拉(Bey Lah) 之後，你竟然還帶了這個給我……
{{emote|*她微笑著。*}}
我明白你的意思了，=name=。如果我要求我的族人去面對對未知的恐懼，那麼我也欠他們一個面對我自身恐懼的機會。
我會向 妮拉欣德(Neelahind) 告白，把那首我寫的詩送給她，並接受她給我的任何回應。再次感謝你。

string.ID: You're welcome. Live and drink.

strings.string: 不客氣。活著，並盡情飲酒。

string.ID:
Kendren! I am glad to see you.
Thank you again for bringing Neela around, and please forgive her reservation. She mourns the people she thought she knew, but our future will be brighter together.

strings.string:
Kendren！很高興見到你。
再次感謝你帶 Neela 過來，也請原諒她的拘謹。她在哀悼那些她以為認識的人，但只要我們在一起，未來會更加光明。

string.ID: Of course. Live and drink.

strings.string: 當然。盡情生活，盡情暢飲。

string.ID:
Kendren, thank you.
Things may seem grim, but I have a new strength with Neela by my side.

strings.string:
Kendren，謝謝你。
情況看似嚴峻，但有了 Neela 在我身邊，我擁有了新的力量。

string.ID:
Oh, it's you. Need to rest by the fire?
It's fine, my wrath has clarified. You were never the problem. Live and drink.

strings.string:
喔，是你啊。需要坐在火堆旁休息一下嗎？
沒關係，我的怒火已經平息了。你從來不是問題所在。活下去吧，盡情飲酒。

string.ID: I think this poem is yours.

strings.string: 我想這首詩是你的。

string.ID: You're just trying to keep dear Esk informed, then? Or could it be that you're wondering if that home may be Bey Lah?

strings.string: 你只是想讓親愛的 Esk 知情嗎？還是說，你在想那個家會不會是 貝拉(Bey Lah)？

string.ID: You have my thanks, Hindriarch.

strings.string: 感謝你，欣德里亞克(Hindriarch)。

string.ID:
I am afeared to even mention this notion to the villagers. Can you imagine my epitaph?
"Here lies the youngest Hindriarch in Bey Lah's history, trampled to death because she suggested we invite in a people most readily described as 'lah with legs'."
If they trusted you more, maybe we could put it to a vote. But as it is? No. Sorry, =name=.

strings.string:
我甚至不敢向村民提起這個念頭。你能想像我的墓志銘嗎？
「此處安息著 貝拉(Bey Lah) 的歷史中最年輕的 欣德里亞克(Hindriarch)，因她建議邀請一群最容易被描述為『長了腿的啦』的人群而遭踐踏致死。」
如果他們更信任你，或許我們可以進行投票。但就現狀而言？不行。抱歉，=name=。

string.ID: We are on the tips of our hooves, =name=! Any word about the slynth?

strings.string: 我們正踮著蹄子等著，=name=！有關於 slynth 的消息嗎？

string.ID:
Never greater has been my desire to be voted out of office.
Oh, not because of the slynth! Well, yes, because of the slynth, but it's because I'd rather be out there with them – scouting, guarding, even tending to lah would be better than all this dry supervisory work.
Room, board, assignments... it never occurred to me that immigration would require such intensive logistics.

strings.string:
我被投票罷免的渴望從未如此強烈。
喔，不是因為 斯林斯！好吧，是的，是因為 斯林斯，但那是因為我寧願去外面和他們在一起——偵察、守衛，甚至去照料 lah，都比這些枯燥的監督工作好。
食宿、任務分配……我從未想過移民竟然需要如此密集的物流支援。

string.ID: My thanks, Hindriarch.

strings.string: 謝謝你，欣德里亞克(Hindriarch)。

string.ID:
Live and drink, =name=!
At long last I bear a lighter load of work coordinating our new family members. I won't claim that all of my people are fully comfortable with the slynth, but the faundren love them.

strings.string:
活下去並盡情飲酒吧，=name=！
終於，我在協調我們新家庭成員的工作上負擔輕了一些。我不敢說我的族人都能完全接受 斯林斯，但 faundren 非常愛他們。

string.ID: My thanks again, Hindriarch.

strings.string: 再次感謝你，欣德里亞克(Hindriarch)。

string.ID: I'm sorry.

strings.string: 我很抱歉。

string.ID: {{emote|*The hindren pariah ignores you.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*希德倫賤民無視了你。*}}

string.ID:
Don't you have someone else to bother?
Live and drink piss.

strings.string:
你難道沒有別人可以騷擾了嗎？
活著並喝尿吧。

string.ID: I think this poem is yours.

strings.string: 我想這首詩是你的。
真沒禮貌。

string.ID:
Oh, so you have! Amazing work, kendren. We owe you more than we can give, but here is what we can give nonetheless.
You are more than welcome here in Bey Lah any time.

strings.string:
喔，原來你做到了！做得太棒了，kendren。我們欠你的比我們能給予的多，但儘管如此，這是我們目前能提供的。
隨時歡迎來到 貝拉(Bey Lah)。

string.ID: Live and drink, Hindriarch.

strings.string: 活著，且盡情飲酒，欣德里亞克(Hindriarch)。

string.ID:
Extremely frustrating! But I am yet hopeful.
My people are resistant to change, but they don't seem opposed to the idea of a Democracy. I need to give them a measure of time before we hold an election, but they'll ultimately agree as long as I am acting Hindriarch.
Then, fates willing, they will vote me out. I'll be voting for Isahind, myself. Once I convince her to run.

strings.string:
極度令人沮喪！但我仍抱持希望。
我的族人對改變具有抵抗性，但他們似乎並不反對民主的概念。在舉行選舉之前，我需要給他們一些時間，但只要我表現得符合 欣德里亞克(Hindriarch)，他們最終都會同意。
然後，若命運允許，他們會投票把我趕走。而我也會投票給 伊薩欣德，我自己。一旦我說服她參選。

string.ID: May fortune favor you. Live and drink.

strings.string: 願好運與你同在。生存下去，盡情暢飲。
=name=。
艾斯金德。

string.ID: Bey Lah is gone. I hope you're happy.

strings.string: 貝拉已經不在了。我希望你覺得開心。

string.ID: Our world is ending...

strings.string: 我們的世界正在走向終結...

string.ID: Live and drink, =name=.

strings.string: 盡情生活與飲酒吧，=name=。

string.ID:
Perhaps it was too much to wish that Bey Lah would change.
But Esk is happy again. That makes me feel happy too.

strings.string:
或許希望 貝拉(Bey Lah) 會改變是太過分的要求了。
但 Esk 又開心起來了。這也讓我感到開心。

string.ID: I can't imagine why you would think we want your company, kendren.

strings.string: 我無法想像你為什麼會覺得我們想要你的陪伴，kendren。

string.ID: Leave us alone.

strings.string: 別來煩我們。

string.ID: Thank you for what you've done for our sister.

strings.string: 感謝你為我們的姐妹所做的一切。

string.ID: If you've nothing you need of me, kendren, I'd just as soon hold my peace.

strings.string: 肯德倫（kendren），如果你沒有任何需要我的事，我寧願保持沉默。

string.ID: Does this poem belong to you?

strings.string: 這首詩是你的嗎？

string.ID: May I ask you some questions?

strings.string: 我可以問你幾個問題嗎？

string.ID: Very well. Live and drink.

strings.string: 很好。盡情生活與飲酒吧。

string.ID: I suppose.

strings.string: 我想是吧。

string.ID: Tell me about your family.

strings.string: 跟我說說你的家人吧。

string.ID: Keh told me that Eskhind has a brother.

strings.string: Keh 告訴我 艾斯金德 有個兄弟。

string.ID: Who do you think stole Kindrish?

strings.string: 你覺得是誰偷走了 Kindrish？

string.ID: Never mind. Live and drink.

strings.string: 沒關係。活下去，盡情飲酒吧。

string.ID: ... did she.

strings.string: ……她確實如此。

string.ID: Where is he? Tell me what happened to him.

strings.string: 他在哪裡？告訴我他發生了什麼事。

string.ID: But she doesn't, does she? Only sisters.

strings.string: 但她並沒有，不是嗎？只有姐妹而已。

string.ID:
I don't like to speculate on a matter I know so little of, nor one whose outcome so dearly affects my life.
If what you want is a strongly-worded accusation based on nothing, Liihart is the sister to talk to.

strings.string:
我不喜歡對我如此陌生的事情進行推測，也不喜歡對那些結果會嚴重影響我生活的事件妄下定論。
如果你想要的是基於空穴來風的強烈指控，利哈特 是最適合談話的人。

string.ID: That's all for now. Live and drink.

strings.string: 目前就先這樣。活著，盡情飲酒吧。

string.ID: That's all for now. Live and drink.

strings.string: 目前就先這樣。活著，盡情飲酒吧。

string.ID: {{emote|*Meyehind's glare turns withering for the few seconds it takes before she turns her face and body away from you.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*梅耶欣德的眼神轉冷，幾秒內她便別過臉和身體。*}}

string.ID:
What's to tell? We are outcasts, pushed to the margins by our people for the crime of harmless deviance.
It's beyond perverse to call us back just so Grand-Doe can punish us further.

strings.string:
有什麼好說的？我們是被放逐者，因為那種無害的偏差行為而被族人推向邊緣。
僅僅為了讓大牝鹿能進一步懲罰我們而把我們召回，這簡直是扭曲至極。

string.ID: That's all for now. Live and drink.

strings.string: 目前就先這樣。活著，盡情飲酒吧。

string.ID:
Hm! No, Eskhind wrote that, but I thought she burned it.
If you return it to anyone, you should return it to her.

strings.string:
嗯！不，那是 艾斯金德 寫的，但我以為她把它燒了。
如果你要把它還給任何人，你應該還給她。

string.ID: Thank you. Live and drink.

strings.string: 謝謝你。盡情生活，盡情暢飲。

string.ID: Hey, =name=. Live and drink.

strings.string: 嘿，=name=。活著並盡情飲酒吧。

string.ID:
This sucks.
...but you're not so bad.

strings.string:
這真糟透了。
……但你也還不算太差。

string.ID: ... what a waste.

strings.string: ...真是浪費。

string.ID:
Oh! =name=.
It makes me happy to see you.

strings.string:
喔！=name=。
見到你真令我開心。

string.ID:
Um... thank you.
Live and drink.

strings.string:
嗯... 謝謝你。
盡情生活與飲酒吧。

string.ID:
{{emote|*Liihart stares at you for several quiet seconds.*}}
Live and drink.

strings.string:
{{emote|*利哈特 靜靜地盯著你看了好幾秒鐘。*}}
盡情生活與飲酒吧。

string.ID: Does this poem belong to you?

strings.string: 這首詩是你的嗎？

string.ID: May I ask you some questions?

strings.string: 我可以問你幾個問題嗎？

string.ID: Live and drink, reticent one.

strings.string: 活下去，盡情飲酒吧，沉默寡言的人。

string.ID: I said, may I ask you some questions?

strings.string: 我是說，我可以問你幾個問題嗎？

string.ID: You are not partial to talking.

strings.string: 你不怎麼喜歡說話。

string.ID: Well then. Live and drink.

strings.string: 那麼，盡情生活，盡情暢飲。

string.ID: {{emote|*she glares in silence*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*她沉默地瞪著你*}}

string.ID: Answer me.

strings.string: 回答我。

string.ID: You are not partial to talking.

strings.string: 你不怎麼喜歡說話。

string.ID: Never mind. Live and drink.

strings.string: 沒關係。活下去，盡情飲酒吧。

string.ID: ... correct.

strings.string: ……正確。

string.ID: I'm trying to exonerate your sister. Can you help?

strings.string: 我正試著為妳的姊姊洗刷冤屈。妳能幫忙嗎？

string.ID: So you can answer my questions. You just don't want to.

strings.string: 所以妳可以回答我的問題。妳只是不想回答而已。

string.ID: Never mind. Live and drink.

strings.string: 沒關係。活下去，盡情飲酒吧。

string.ID:
Eskhind didn't do it. It was probably Keh.
That's all I know. I mind my business.
Wish you would too.

strings.string:
艾斯金德沒做這件事。很可能是 Keh。
我只知道這些。我只管自己的事。
希望你也一樣。

string.ID: Fair enough. Live and drink.

strings.string: 好吧。盡情生活與飲酒吧。

string.ID:
Oh! Eskhind wrote that.
You should give that to Neelahind. It was supposed to go to Neelahind.

strings.string:
喔！那是 Eskhind 寫的。
你應該把它給 妮拉欣德(Neelahind)。它原本應該是要給 妮拉欣德(Neelahind) 的。

string.ID: Not Eskhind?

strings.string: 不是 艾斯金德 嗎？

string.ID: Thank you. Live and drink.

strings.string: 謝謝你。盡情生活，盡情暢飲。

string.ID:
No, no, give it to Neelahind.
Esk will thank you later.

strings.string:
不，不，把它給妮拉欣德吧。
Esk 之後會感謝你的。

string.ID: I see, thank you. Live and drink.

strings.string: 我明白了，謝謝。祝你生存並暢飲。

string.ID: I'd rather not talk. Sorry.

strings.string: 我不想說話。抱歉。

string.ID:
Strange and rocky times have befallen Bey Lah.
But I'm confident that we can get through this, as we always do. Shall we trade?

strings.string:
奇異且艱險的時光降臨在 貝拉(Bey Lah) 之身上。
但我有信心我們能渡過難關，一如既往。要交易嗎？

string.ID:
My friend! Thank you so much for helping our village!
Our prosperity means that I have new goods for you to peruse, if you're interested.

strings.string:
我的朋友！非常感謝你幫助我們的村莊！
我們的繁榮意味著如果你有興趣，我有新貨物讓你挑選。

string.ID:
As if a new Hindriarch weren't enough, I hear we might become a Democracy! How thrilling.
This is a new chapter in Bey Lah's history, kendren. Would you care to trade?

strings.string:
彷彿還不夠多一個新的 欣德里亞克似的，我聽說我們可能要變成民主制了！真令人興奮。
這是 貝拉(Bey Lah) 歷史的新篇章，kendren。你想要交易嗎？

string.ID:
Amazing! The youngest hindriarch in Bey Lah's preserved history, if only temporarily so.
Care to buy a souvenir to commemorate this historic occasion?

strings.string:
太驚人了！這是 貝拉(Bey Lah) 的保存歷史中最年輕的 欣德里亞克(Hindriarch)，即便只是暫時的。
想買件紀念品來慶祝這個歷史性的時刻嗎？

string.ID:
Oh! A real live kendren, here in our village! Live and drink, lovely friend!
If you'd care to trade, I have a modest amount of local goods I can offer.

strings.string:
喔！一個活生生的 Kendren，就在我們的村莊裡！盡情生活與飲酒吧，親愛的朋友！
如果你想交易，我有一些當地的物資可以提供。

string.ID: Does this poem belong to you?

strings.string: 這首詩是你的嗎？

string.ID: I have all I need. Live and drink.

strings.string: 我已經擁有一切所需。生存與飲酒。

string.ID: No, that's not mine. But it looks lovely!
