strings.string: 不，那不是我的。但它看起來很棒！

string.ID: I see. Live and drink.

strings.string: 我明白了。盡情生活，盡情飲酒。

string.ID: Why are you talking to me?

strings.string: 你為什麼要跟我說話？

string.ID: No sudden moves around the Hindriarch, kendren. I am watching you.

strings.string: 不要在 欣德里亞克(Hindriarch) 附近做出任何突發動作，kendren。我正盯著你。

string.ID: Who are you?

strings.string: 你是誰？

string.ID: Does this poem belong to you?

strings.string: 這首詩是你的嗎？

string.ID: Do I look like a poet to you, kendren?

strings.string: 在你看來，我長得像個詩人嗎，kendren？

string.ID: I suppose not. Live and drink.

strings.string: 我想也是。活下去，盡情飲酒吧。

string.ID: I am Kesehind, protector of Hindriarch Keh, the Grand-Doe of Bey Lah.

strings.string: 我是 凱塞欣德，是 希德里亞克·凱 —— 貝拉的大牝鹿 的守護者。

string.ID: May I ask you some questions?

strings.string: 我可以問你幾個問題嗎？

string.ID: I see. Live and drink.

strings.string: 我明白了。盡情生活，盡情飲酒。

string.ID: You may not.

strings.string: 你不能這樣。
喔。

string.ID: You are either very brave or very foolish, to stop me in my path. Perhaps both. What do you want?

strings.string: 你要麼非常勇敢，要麼非常愚蠢，竟然攔住我的去路。或許兩者皆是。你想要什麼？

string.ID: Nothing. Live and drink.

strings.string: 沒什麼。活下去，盡情飲酒吧。

string.ID:
Be careful in the flower fields.
Even with Bey Lah marked on your map, it's easy to get lost. Lost travelers feed the lah.

strings.string:
在 花田 要小心。
即使地圖上標記了 貝拉(Bey Lah)，也很容易迷路。迷路的旅人會成為拉（lah）的食糧。

string.ID: I will be careful, thank you.

strings.string: 我會小心的，謝謝你。

string.ID: Hold a moment, =player.formalAddressTerm=. Are you looking for work?

strings.string: 請稍等一下，=player.formalAddressTerm=。您是在找工作嗎？

string.ID: I am.

strings.string: 我存在。

string.ID: I am not.

strings.string: 我不是。

string.ID:
I can't help but wonder why you're telling me this in particular. I am not a mayor, nor even a citizen. I am a drifter, a pariah, and my 'people' are those who have no home anywhere else.
... and here I wonder a bit less. You're asking me to whisper into the winds on behalf of the slynth, aren't you?

strings.string:
我不禁想知道你為什麼偏偏要告訴我這些。我不是市長，甚至不是公民。我是一個流浪者、一個被排斥者，而我的「同胞」是那些在其他任何地方都沒有家的人。
……現在我稍微不那麼疑惑了。你是在要求我代表 斯林斯 向風中低語，對吧？

string.ID: What a strange fate, to pass from new sentience to outcast with no steps in between. Regardless, if it is their will and you vouch for them, that is enough for me. Tell the slynth that should they choose to wander, the wind will blow at their backs.

strings.string: 多麼奇特的命運，從新生的意識直接淪為被放逐者，中間沒有任何過渡。無論如何，如果這是他們的意志且你為他們擔保，對我來說就足夠了。告訴 斯林斯，若他們選擇流浪，風將會助他們一臂之力。

string.ID: You have my thanks, Lulihart.

strings.string: 謝謝你，露利哈特。

string.ID: It is hardly so simple, =name=. We drifters hold no hierarchy. I can whisper all I like, but no winds will blow behind the slynth if your name cannot stir more than a breeze. Make yourself known to Pariahs and ask me again.

strings.string: 事情沒那麼簡單，=name=。我們這些漂泊者之間沒有等級制度。我可以隨心所欲地低語，但如果你的名聲無法掀起波瀾，就沒人會為斯林斯（slynth）助威。去讓那些放逐者（Pariahs）知道你的存在後，再來問我吧。

string.ID: Still gathering landing pads for your drifting vessels, then, =name=?

strings.string: 看來你還在為你那漂流的 容器 收集著降落平台，對吧，=name=？

string.ID: Yes, I am.

strings.string: 是的，我是。

string.ID:
New voices, strange and beautiful, carry on the salt breeze.
Some will no doubt be silenced by sun, blade, thirst, bullet, or glow, but they will not fall still alone.

strings.string:
新的聲音，奇異而美好，隨著鹹味的海風飄蕩。
有些聲音無疑會被太陽、利刃、乾渴、子彈或光芒所抹殺，但他們不會獨自沉寂。

string.ID: My thanks, Lulihart.

strings.string: 謝謝你，露利哈特。

string.ID:
Live and drink, =name=.
Have you seen your slynth out there? My sources tell me that they are, for the most part, traveling well enough with others. They stop by my tent from time to time to visit and smoke with me, as you do.
One might assume they were born for this kind of life.

strings.string:
活著並暢飲吧，=name=。
你有看到你的 斯林斯 在外面嗎？我的消息來源告訴我，他們大部分的人都跟隨他人旅行得還算順利。他們偶爾會來我的帳篷拜訪，像你一樣跟我一起抽菸。
人們可能會以為他們天生就是為了這種生活而活的。

string.ID: My thanks again, Lulihart.

strings.string: 再次感謝你，露利哈特。

string.ID:
I see. In that case, rest and speak a bit with me, won't you? My worries can wait another day.
That said, if you change your mind, you'll come find me, won't you?

strings.string:
我明白了。既然如此，就休息一下跟我聊聊天吧，好嗎？我的煩惱可以再等一天。
話雖如此，如果你改變主意了，你會再來找我的，對吧？

string.ID: Perhaps. Live and drink.

strings.string: 或許吧。活下去，盡情飲酒吧。

string.ID:
Lovely. Take a seat. Chew the bark with me, and I will tell you what I know.
I've heard tell that my ancestral hometown, Bey Lah, is in some kind of trouble. They've opened their borders for the first time I know of and are specifically seeking to hire kendren -- that's their word for outsiders like you. Would you be willing to go see what they need?

strings.string:
太棒了。請坐。跟我一起嚼著樹皮聊天，我就會告訴你我所知道的事。
我聽說我的祖籍地，貝拉(Bey Lah)，似乎遇到了某種麻煩。據我所知，他們是第一次開放邊界，並且特別尋求雇用 kendren ——那是他們對像你這樣的局外人的稱呼。你願意去看看他們需要什麼嗎？

string.ID: Who are you?

strings.string: 你是誰？

string.ID: How do you know this?

strings.string: 你怎麼知道的？

string.ID: Why do you care?

strings.string: 你為什麼要管？

string.ID: Why don't you go there yourself?

strings.string: 你為什麼不親自去那裡呢？

string.ID: Very well, I will go to Bey Lah as you ask.

strings.string: 好吧，我會如你所願前往 貝拉(Bey Lah)。

string.ID: Pass. This task is not to my liking.

strings.string: 算了。這項任務我不感興趣。

string.ID:
My name is Lulihart. The blood of the hindren runs through my veins, but two of my three parents were kendren, so that blood is... dilute, and salt-brined from being born out here.
Dilute, salty blood. Heh.

strings.string:
我的名字是露利哈特。hindren 的血脈在我的血管中流淌，但我三位父母中有兩位是 kendren，所以那血液很……稀薄，而且因為出生在這種地方，還帶著鹹澀的鹽味。
稀薄、鹹澀的血液。呵。

string.ID: Very well, I will go to Bey Lah as you ask.

strings.string: 好吧，我會如你所願前往 貝拉(Bey Lah)。

string.ID: How do you know about Bey Lah's trouble?

strings.string: 你怎麼知道關於 貝拉的 麻煩？

string.ID: Why do you care about Bey Lah?

strings.string: 你為什麼在意 貝拉(Bey Lah) ?

string.ID: Why don't you go there yourself?

strings.string: 你為什麼不親自去那裡呢？

string.ID: Pass. This task is not to my liking.

strings.string: 算了。這項任務我不感興趣。

string.ID:
My water goes to scouts to keep a distant eye on Bey Lah. To make sure that it is still there, still safe.
I have never been within a parasang of my people's land, but I know exactly where the once-hidden village stands. I will share this knowledge with you if you agree to consider whatever their request may be.

strings.string:
我的水手會去偵查，遠遠地監視著 貝拉(Bey Lah)。為了確保那裡依然存在，依然安全。
我從未踏足過族人土地的一帕桑（parasang）之內，但我確切知道那座曾經隱匿的村莊位於何處。如果你同意考慮他們的任何請求，我就會與你分享這個情報。

string.ID: Very well, I will go to Bey Lah as you ask.

strings.string: 好吧，我會如你所願前往 貝拉(Bey Lah)。

string.ID: Wait, who are you?

strings.string: 等等，你是誰？

string.ID: Why do you care?

strings.string: 你為什麼要管？

string.ID: Why don't you go there yourself?

strings.string: 你為什麼不親自去那裡呢？

string.ID: Pass. This task is not to my liking.

strings.string: 算了。這項任務我不感興趣。

string.ID: Even blood as thin as mine ties me to the cervidian meadow. The hindren may not say so, but they are my family.

strings.string: 即使是像我這樣稀薄的血液，也將我與鹿草草原聯繫在一起。希德倫人（hindren）可能不會這麼說，但他們是我的家人。

string.ID: Very well, I will go to Bey Lah as you ask.

strings.string: 好吧，我會如你所願前往 貝拉(Bey Lah)。

string.ID: And who are you?

strings.string: 那你又是誰？

string.ID: How do you know Bey Lah's trouble?

strings.string: 你怎麼知道 貝拉的 麻煩？

string.ID: Why don't you go there yourself?

strings.string: 你為什麼不親自去那裡呢？

string.ID: Pass. This task is not to my liking.

strings.string: 算了。這項任務我不感興趣。

string.ID:
I am not welcome in Bey Lah.
My blood is not pure, and I was not born in the meadow. These things make my name as salt in the mouths of true hindren.
They are misguided, but they are my misguided family. They stagnate as Qud changes around them. I worry.

strings.string:
我在貝拉不受歡迎。
我的血統不純，也不是在草地中誕生的。這些事情讓我的名字在真正的希德倫人（hindren）口中如同苦澀的鹽。
他們誤入歧途，但他們是我那誤入歧途的家人。隨著卡德周遭環境的變遷，他們卻停滯不前。我感到憂心。

string.ID: Very well, I will go to Bey Lah as you ask.

strings.string: 好吧，我會如你所願前往 貝拉(Bey Lah)。

string.ID: Who are you?

strings.string: 你是誰？

string.ID: How do you know this?

strings.string: 你怎麼知道的？

string.ID: Why do you care?

strings.string: 你為什麼要管？

string.ID: Pass. This task is not to my liking.

strings.string: 算了。這項任務我不感興趣。

string.ID:
Bless you, =player.formalAddressTerm=. I feel better knowing that at least one kendren will reach back to aid my kin. They are on the cusp of a new fate, and I wish to see it while I yet live.
Let me advise you of Bey Lah's location, and here is a little chew-boon for your trouble.

strings.string:
願上天保佑你，=player.formalAddressTerm=。知道至少有一位肯德倫（kendren）會回頭援助我的族人，我感覺好多了。他們正處於新命運的邊緣，我希望在自己還健在時能親眼見證。
讓我告訴你 貝拉的 位置，這是一點小小的 chew-boon，算是對你辛苦勞動的酬謝。

string.ID: Thank you, Lulihart. Live and drink.

strings.string: 謝謝你，露利哈特。盡情生活與飲酒吧。

string.ID:
I hear that Bey Lah's status is once again quo. I hoped for a measure more of change, but thousands of years of tradition do not give so easily.
Thank you for helping my foolish people.

strings.string:
我聽說 貝拉的 狀態再次回到了原點。我曾希望看到更多的改變，但數千年的傳統並非那麼容易撼動。
感謝你幫助了我那愚蠢的人民。

string.ID:
I've heard that the youngest Hindriarch in history now leads Bey Lah, and their warden aims to join the Quetzal Caucus. You've worked wonders, kendren.
I can't wait to see what happens next.

strings.string:
我聽說史上最年輕的 欣德里亞克(Hindriarch) 現在領導著 貝拉(Bey Lah)，而他們的典獄長正打算加入 Quetzal Caucus。你創造了奇蹟，kendren。
我等不及想看到接下來會發生什麼事了。

string.ID:
Every flame burns low one day, but the warmth of my people's story still carries me forward.
Bey Lah has not survived joining Qud, but the hindren live on, and our legacy will never be wholly lost.
I wonder what became of Kindrish.

strings.string:
每一團火焰終有一天會燃盡，但我族故事的溫暖仍指引著我前行。
貝拉(Bey Lah) 在加入 卡德(Qud) 後並未存續下來，但希德倫（hindren）依然生存著，我們的遺產永遠不會完全消失。
我很好奇 昆德里什（Kindrish）後來變得如何了。

string.ID: Come smoke with me, friend. Set a spell.

strings.string: 來跟我一起抽菸吧，朋友。坐下來歇會兒。

string.ID: Kendren! A moment of your time, please. You are =name=, yes? You seek to solve a mystery here in the village, yes?

strings.string: Kendren！請耽誤你一點時間。你是 =name=，對吧？你想在這裡的村莊解開一個謎團，對吧？

string.ID: Does this poem belong to you?

strings.string: 這首詩是你的嗎？

string.ID: I am, and yes.

strings.string: 我是，而且是的。

string.ID: How did you know all that?

strings.string: 你怎麼會知道那些事？

string.ID: Who are you?

strings.string: 你是誰？

string.ID: I don't have time for this. Live and drink.

strings.string: 我沒時間處理這些。活下去，盡情飲酒吧。

string.ID:
Poem? Oh! This is a Shakespriggan sonnet, but I didn't write it--the rhymes are a bit facile, and love poems don't interest me.
I've been teaching Eskhind about sonnets, so she must have written this. But that means... oh, poor thing.

strings.string:
詩？喔！這是一首莎克斯普里根（Shakespriggan）十四行詩，但我沒寫——韻律有點平庸，而且我不對情詩感興趣。
我一直在教 艾斯金德 關於十四行詩的知識，所以一定是她寫的。但那意味著……喔，可憐的孩子。

string.ID: Thank you. Live and drink.

strings.string: 謝謝你。盡情生活，盡情暢飲。

string.ID:
I hoped you would ask! I closely study the works of the great bard, Willow Shakesprig. In particular, I am most fond of the stories of the Great Plant Detective, Hemlock Cones. Through these stories, I have learned to hone my perceptions and deductive skill to a fine point. It is my dearest hope that one day I shall be known not as Angohind, village bookworm... but Angohind, Master Detective.
My grandhind has forbidden me from looking into the strange doings in the village, but she said nothing about me teaching you the ins and outs of detective work! What say you?

strings.string:
我希望你會問！我一直在密切研究偉大吟遊詩人柳·謝克斯普里格（Willow Shakesprig）的作品。特別是，我最喜歡大植物偵探海姆洛克·康斯（Hemlock Cones）的故事。透過這些故事，我學會了磨練我的感知力和推理技巧至極致。我最大的希望是有一天我不僅被稱為安戈欣德，村裡的書呆子……而是安戈欣德，名偵探。
我的祖母禁止我調查村莊裡的怪異行徑，但她沒說過不讓我教你偵探工作的竅門！你覺得呢？

string.ID: I am listening.

strings.string: 我在聽。

string.ID: I should... go. Live and drink.

strings.string: 我該……走了。活著，並盡情飲酒。

string.ID:
Yes, yes of course.
I am Angohind: grandson of esteemed Elder Eselhind, young scholar of Shakesprig, and best dressed hindren in Bey Lah. I am also, as luck would have it, an aspirant investigator with an ear... for mystery.
My grandhind has forbidden me from looking into the strange doings in the village, but she said nothing about me teaching you the ins and outs of detective work! What say you?

strings.string:
是的，沒錯，當然可以。
我是 安戈欣德：受人尊敬的長老埃塞林德（Eselhind）之孫、謝克斯普里格（Shakesprig）的年輕學者，也是 貝拉(Bey Lah) 最衣著得體的希德倫（hindren）。而且，說來也巧，我還是一名對神祕事件頗有耳力的準調查員。
我的祖母禁止我調查村子裡的怪異行徑，但她沒說過不能教你偵探工作的竅門啊！你覺得如何？

string.ID: I am listening.

strings.string: 我在聽。

string.ID: No thank you. Live and drink.

strings.string: 不用了，謝謝。活下去，盡情飲酒吧。

string.ID:
Oh, truly? You won't regret this, kendren, I promise! So, let's get to it!
Every mystery hinges on the detection and interpretation of evidence. As Hemlock Cones said:
Ere any prosecution can commence, Accusers must obtain some evidence. The solving lies in seeing and locating Supporting clues as well as implicating.

strings.string:
喔，真的嗎？你不會後悔的，肯德倫（kendren），我保證！那麼，我們開始吧！
每個謎團都取決於對證據的偵測與解讀。正如海姆洛克·康斯（Hemlock Cones）所說：
在任何起訴程序開始之前，控訴者必須取得某些證據。解題的關鍵在於觀察並定位支持性線索，以及找出其關聯性。

string.ID: How do I find evidence?

strings.string: 我要如何尋找證據？

string.ID: What makes something evidence?

strings.string: 是什麼讓某件事成為證據？

string.ID: What is implicating evidence?

strings.string: 什麼是暗示性證據？

string.ID: What is supporting evidence?

strings.string: 什麼是佐證？

string.ID: What if evidence indicates multiple culprits?

strings.string: 如果證據顯示有多名罪犯呢？

string.ID:
Professor Cones taught me everything about finding evidence!
Though evidence you found upon the ground may yet be sound, If it will be sufficient is a toss-up. Examine all your suspects and their homes and all around, And find a witness who may dish the gossip.
You can find evidence by looking at things on the ground, but you can also look at your suspects to see if there's anything off about them. You can also ask around to see if anyone has seen or heard anything strange, and different witnesses may have different things to report.

strings.string:
Cones 教授教了我所有關於尋找證據的方法！
雖然你在地上發現的證據可能確實可靠， 但它是否足以定罪，全憑運氣。 檢查你所有的嫌疑犯及其住所與周遭環境， 並尋找可能提供八卦消息的目擊者。
你可以透過觀察地面上的物品來尋找證據，也可以觀察你的嫌疑犯，看看他們是否有任何異常。你還可以四處詢問，看看是否有人看見或聽見了什麼奇怪的事情，不同的目擊者可能會報告不同的內容。

string.ID: What about supporting evidence?

strings.string: 那支持性的證據呢？

string.ID: What makes something evidence?

strings.string: 是什麼讓某件事成為證據？

string.ID: What if I find implicating evidence for multiple suspects?

strings.string: 如果我發現了多名嫌疑人的犯罪證據怎麼辦？

string.ID: Thank you for your help, Angohind. Live and drink.

strings.string: 謝謝妳的幫助，安戈欣德。活著，且飲酒。

string.ID:
Evidence is any sign of something gone amiss. The Great Plant Detective gave some good examples in Act II of the tragedy of Gimlet:
So! Sweep the full estate for signs of {{W|trade}}, their shady night-time dealings to expose Now look for signs of {{W|craft}}, see what was made For to conceal a treasure hidden close. But darker still, if {{W|illness}} signs we find A desperate contagion may yet lurk And darkest yet, more {{W|violence}} may reply To those who stumble 'pon their grisly work.

strings.string:
證據是指任何出錯的跡象。大植物偵探在第二幕中舉了一些關於金姆萊特悲劇的好例子：
所以！搜查整個莊園，尋找 {{W|貿易}} 的痕跡， 揭露他們陰暗的夜間交易； 現在尋找 {{W|工藝}} 的跡象，看看製作了什麼， 為了掩蓋那深藏其中的寶藏。 但若發現 {{W|疾病}} 的徵兆，情況更為險惡， 絕望的傳染病可能仍在潛伏； 而最黑暗的是，那些在慘烈工作中踉蹌的人， 可能會招致更多的 {{W|暴力}} 反擊。

string.ID: How do I find evidence?

strings.string: 我要如何尋找證據？

string.ID: What makes something evidence?

strings.string: 是什麼讓某件事成為證據？

string.ID: What is implicating evidence?

strings.string: 什麼是暗示性證據？

string.ID: What is supporting evidence?

strings.string: 什麼是佐證？

string.ID: What if evidence indicates multiple culprits?

strings.string: 如果證據顯示有多名罪犯呢？

string.ID:
Implicating evidence is what it sounds like: evidence that implicates someone's involvement in a crime. For example, if someone observed strange behavior in a person, or if you found something weird in a person's room, or even if you observe them behaving strangely =player.reflexive=! That's implicating evidence.
Most of the time, a piece of implicating evidence isn't proof of a crime in and of itself, but when presented alongside supporting evidence, implicating evidence is the seed of truth from which grows the long frond of justice.

strings.string:
「暗示性證據」就如其字面意思：指能暗示某人涉入犯罪的證據。例如，如果有人觀察到某人的行為異常，或者你在某人的房間裡發現了奇怪的東西，甚至如果你觀察到他們表現得怪異 =player.reflexive=! 這就是暗示性證據。
大多數時候，單一的暗示性證據本身並不能作為犯罪證明，但當它與支持性證據一同呈現時，暗示性證據便是真理的種子，能讓正義之花茁壯成長。

string.ID: What about supporting evidence?

strings.string: 那支持性的證據呢？

string.ID: How do I find evidence?

strings.string: 我要如何尋找證據？

string.ID: What if I find implicating evidence for multiple suspects?

strings.string: 如果我發現了多名嫌疑人的犯罪證據怎麼辦？

string.ID: Thank you for your help, Angohind. Live and drink.

strings.string: 謝謝妳的幫助，安戈欣德。活著，且飲酒。

string.ID:
Supporting evidence can be any sign that something is amiss that you can't directly tie to an individual. One common example is a bloodstain, which indicates that violence was committed but doesn't tell you by whom.
At its heart, supporting evidence is most powerful when paired with implicating evidence. Once you have both, you'll be in a good position to accuse a suspect of wrongdoing.

strings.string:
佐證可以是指向異常狀況、但無法直接與特定個人聯繫起來的任何跡象。一個常見的例子是血跡，它顯示了暴力行為的發生，卻無法告訴你是誰所為。
從核心意義上來說，當佐證與指控證據結合時，其威力最強大。一旦你同時掌握兩者，就能處於有利地位來指控嫌疑人有不當行為。

string.ID: What about implicating evidence?

strings.string: 那暗示性的證據呢？

string.ID: How do I find evidence?

strings.string: 我要如何尋找證據？

string.ID: What if I find implicating evidence for multiple suspects?

strings.string: 如果我發現了多名嫌疑人的犯罪證據怎麼辦？

string.ID: Thank you for your help, Angohind. Live and drink.

strings.string: 謝謝妳的幫助，安戈欣德。活著，且飲酒。

string.ID:
As Professor Cones said:
We know the reach of law, however long, Is not the finest judge of right and wrong. Choose not what evidence thou wilt present Ere its consequence is evident.
In short, you must use your judgment and intuition, kendren.

strings.string:
正如 Cones 教授所說：
我們深知法律的觸及範圍，無論其多麼漫長，
卻並非是非對錯的最佳裁判。
莫要在後果顯現之前，
便急於選擇你要呈上的證據。
簡而言之，你們必須運用自己的判斷與直覺，kendren。

string.ID: What if I accuse the wrong person?

strings.string: 如果我指控錯了人怎麼辦？

string.Context: Conversation Angohind.Multiple culprits?.Evidence is not created equalChoice.Text
string.ID: You're saying that what evidence I choose to show will affect the outcome of the case?

strings.string: 妳的意思是，我選擇展示哪些證據會影響案件的結果？

string.ID: Then what's to keep me from simply choosing the outcome I want?

strings.string: 那麼，有什麼能阻止我直接選擇我想要的結果呢？

string.ID: I have further questions.

strings.string: 我還有其他問題。

string.ID:
That's always a risk, kendren.
Neelahind knows everyone in the village very well. If you present supporting evidence that contradicts something the Warden knows to be true about the suspect, well, she probably won't believe you. In fact, she might not let you accuse that person again, so be careful.
If you make too many bad accusations, you might lose credibility with her entirely.

strings.string:
那總是有風險的，kendren。
妮拉欣德非常了解村裡的每個人。如果你提供的證據與典獄長所認知的嫌疑人事實相矛盾，那麼，她可能不會相信你。事實上，她甚至可能不再讓你指控那個人，所以要小心。
如果你做出太多錯誤的指控，可能會完全失去她的信任。

string.ID: I see. I have further questions.

strings.string: 我明白了。我還有其他問題。

string.ID: Thank you for the help, Angohind. Live and drink.

strings.string: 謝謝你的幫助，安戈欣德。活下去並盡情飲酒吧。

string.ID:
Well, your conscience, surely.
You wouldn't be so unethical as to manipulate the resolution of a crime to your own ends. W-would you?

strings.string:
嗯，想必是你的良知吧。
你不會不道德到為了自己的目的而操縱犯罪的調查結果吧。你——你會嗎？

string.ID: As you say it. I have further questions.

strings.string: 如你所言。我還有其他問題。

string.ID: Well, I should get going. Live and drink.

strings.string: 好了，我該走了。盡情生活，盡情飲酒吧。

string.Context: Conversation Angohind.Evidence is not created equal.Text
string.ID:
Precisely. The evidence you present paints a picture that will forever hang in the halls of Bey Lah's history. Our fate is in your hands.
Hemlock Cones once said:
As like begets like in daily life so too in mystery. Should I paint pictures full of strife thus violence comes to be. If I in craft or trade should deal then deals shall deal by troth But if I pestilence reveal- no honey be enough.

strings.string:
正是如此。你所呈現的證據將永遠刻在貝拉的歷史殿堂中。我們的命運掌握在你手中。
獨木香錐曾說過：
正如日常生活中的同類相生 神秘之中亦然。 若我繪出充滿衝突的圖景 暴力便隨之而來。 若我在工藝或貿易中交易 則契約必依信義履行 但若我揭露瘟疫—— 再多蜂蜜也無法彌補。

string.Context: Conversation Angohind.Evidence is not created equal.QuestionsChoice.Text
string.ID: I see. I have further questions.

strings.string: 我明白了。我還有其他問題。

string.Context: Conversation Angohind.Evidence is not created equal.EndChoice.Text
string.ID: Thank you for your help, Angohind. Live and drink.

strings.string: 謝謝妳的幫助，安戈欣德。活著，且飲酒。

string.ID: Please, ask away!

strings.string: 請儘管問吧！

string.ID: How do I find evidence?

strings.string: 我要如何尋找證據？

string.ID: What is implicating evidence?

strings.string: 什麼是暗示性證據？

string.ID: What is supporting evidence?

strings.string: 什麼是佐證？

string.ID: What if evidence indicates multiple culprits?

strings.string: 如果證據顯示有多名罪犯呢？

string.ID: What if I accuse the wrong person?

strings.string: 如果我指控錯了人怎麼辦？

string.ID: That is all. Live and drink, faundren.

strings.string: 就這樣吧。生存下去，盡情暢飲，faundren。

string.ID:
Welcome back, Detective =name=.
Everything's in order here, more or less.

strings.string:
歡迎回來，偵探 =name=。
這裡的一切大致上都井然有序。

string.ID:
You should be proud, Detective =name=.
The hand of justice can be harsh, but it is fair. You have been its agent here.

strings.string:
你應該感到自豪，偵探 =name=。
正義之手或許嚴酷，但它是公平的。在此處，你一直是它的執行者。

string.ID: So much change! I've been investigating the 'Democracy' that Hindriarch Esk has been espousing, and it strikes me as rife with vulnerabilities to malicious actors. Perhaps it can be refined.

strings.string: 如此巨大的變革！我一直在調查 欣德里亞克(Hindriarch) Esk 所擁護的「民主」，這在我看來充滿了惡意行為者的漏洞。或許它可以被改良。

string.ID:
Stunning! Eskhind as Hindriarch?
Those poetry lessons I had been giving her must have inspired in her a sense of civic duty.

strings.string:
太驚人了！艾斯金德 竟然是 欣德里亞克(Hindriarch)？
我教給她的那些詩歌課一定激發了她的公民責任感。

string.ID:
Is this really the world we live in?
How cruel.

strings.string:
這真的是我們所生活的世界嗎？
多麼殘酷。

string.ID:
Something strange is afoot here in Bey Lah, and no mistake.
But I am forbidden from investigating. If only there were another detective that I could advise...

strings.string:
在 貝拉(Bey Lah) 這裡確實發生了某些怪事，絕非錯覺。
但我被禁止調查。若能有另一位偵探讓我提供建議就好了……

string.ID: Live and drink, wanderer.

strings.string: 活下去，盡情飲酒吧，流浪者。

string.ID: Live and drink, kendren.

strings.string: 活下去，盡情飲酒吧，肯德倫（kendren）。

string.ID: Take your time. The journey will wait for you.

strings.string: 慢慢來。旅程會等你。

string.ID: Please don't ask me where Bey Lah is. I will not tell you.

strings.string: 請不要問我 貝拉(Bey Lah) 在哪裡。我不會告訴你的。

string.ID: I dream of returning to Bey Lah sometimes, but I know that's not my fate.

strings.string: 我偶爾會夢見回到貝拉，但我知道那並非我的命運。

string.ID: Moon and sun, traveler.

strings.string: 月亮與太陽，旅人。

string.ID: Moon and sun, wisdom and will.

strings.string: 月亮與太陽，智慧與意志。
hhhhhhhhhhhhhhhh。

string.ID: My condolences. Live and drink.

strings.string: 請節哀。活著，並盡情飲酒。

string.ID: Have you seen or heard anything peculiar?

strings.string: 你有看到或聽到任何奇特的事情嗎？

string.ID: Is that a patch of hindren fur? There's blood on it...

strings.string: 那是希德倫的皮毛嗎？上面還有血跡……

string.ID: Sorry, I didn't see anything.

strings.string: 抱歉，我什麼都沒看到。

string.ID: I've a bad feeling about all this.

strings.string: 我對這一切有種不祥的預感。

string.ID: The threat is not over. Mark my words.

strings.string: 威脅尚未結束。記住我的話。

string.ID: We're not safe yet. I can feel it.

strings.string: 我們還不安全。我能感覺得到。

string.ID: This resolution is not to my liking...

strings.string: 這個決議並不合我意……

string.ID: I remain wary, but there is no question that Bey Lah thrives, even with open borders.

strings.string: 我仍保持警惕，但毫無疑問，即使在邊境開放的情況下，貝拉(Bey Lah) 依然繁榮發展。

string.ID: Live and drink, kendren.

strings.string: 活下去，盡情飲酒吧，肯德倫（kendren）。

string.ID: Oh, it is you. Stay safe.

strings.string: 喔，原來是你。多加保重。

string.ID: I am uncomfortable with change, but it is a skill to train like any other.

strings.string: 我不習慣改變，但這是一項可以像其他技能一樣訓練的技巧。

string.ID: Live and drink, kendren.

strings.string: 活下去，盡情飲酒吧，肯德倫（kendren）。

string.ID: I hope Hindriarch Esk can keep us safe.

strings.string: 我希望 欣德里亞克(Hindriarch) Esk 能保佑我們平安。

string.ID: Live and drink, kendren.

strings.string: 活下去，盡情飲酒吧，肯德倫（kendren）。

string.ID: I will do my best to be civil with you, kendren, but we hindren are bred into wariness.

strings.string: 我會盡力與您保持禮貌，肯德倫（kendren），但我們希德倫（hindren）天生就帶有戒心。

string.ID: Cause no trouble here, kendren.

strings.string: 別在這裡惹麻煩，肯德倫（kendren）。

string.ID: Be kind, kendren. We are watching you.

strings.string: 仁慈一點，kendren。我們正注視著你。

string.ID: Why do you remain here? Please, finish your business.

strings.string: 您為何還留在這裡？請處理完您的事務吧。

string.ID: It feels strange to allow you to cross our borders unimpeded, but Grand-Doe wills it.

strings.string: 讓你毫無阻礙地跨越我們的邊界感覺很奇怪，但大鹿（Grand-Doe）意欲如此。

string.ID: No good can come of allowing kendren into Bey Lah...

strings.string: 讓肯德倫（kendren）進入 貝拉(Bey Lah)... 是不會有任何好結果的。

string.ID: What now? Nothing like this has ever happened before.

strings.string: 現在該怎麼辦？從未發生過這樣的事。

string.ID: It's difficult to return to normal life after such an upheaval.

strings.string: 在經歷了如此劇變之後，很難再回到正常的生活中。

string.ID: Forgive me, kendren, but the sight of you makes my hands quake.

strings.string: 請原諒我，kendren，看到你的樣子讓我的雙手顫抖不已。

string.ID: Oh? Is it really over? I'm afraid.

strings.string: 喔？真的結束了嗎？我有些害怕。

string.ID: How Bey Lah prospers! We should have opened the village years ago.

strings.string: 貝拉(Bey Lah) 多麼繁榮！我們幾年前就該開發這個村莊了。

string.ID: Live and drink, kendren.

strings.string: 活下去，盡情飲酒吧，肯德倫（kendren）。

string.ID: Oh, it is you. Thank you for helping the village.

strings.string: 喔，是你啊。謝謝你幫助這個村莊。

string.ID: I will admit, Hindriarch Esk leads well.

strings.string: 我承認，欣德里亞克(Hindriarch) Esk 的帶領很出色。

string.ID: Can we really trust such a young Hindriarch?

strings.string: 我們真的能信任如此年輕的欣德里亞克嗎？

string.ID: I am both afraid and hopeful for our future. But perhaps this is what we need.

strings.string: 對於我們的未來，我既感到恐懼又充滿希望。但或許這正是我們所需要的。

string.ID: Oh, it is you. Thank you for helping the village.

strings.string: 喔，是你啊。謝謝你幫助這個村莊。

string.ID: Ah, l-live and drink.

strings.string: 啊，在——在生活與飲酒中體悟到的。

string.ID: Live and drink...

strings.string: 活著，並盡情飲酒...

string.ID: Live... live and drink, kendren.

strings.string: 活下去……盡情生活與飲酒吧，kendren。
嗯。

string.ID: Please go away.

strings.string: 請離開。

string.ID: W-w-w-w-what are ... what are you...

strings.string: 你... 你... 你到底在...

string.ID: Moon and sun, kendren.

strings.string: 月亮與太陽，kendren。

string.ID: Live and drink. Will you be staying long?

strings.string: 盡情生活，盡情飲酒吧。你會在這裡待很久嗎？

string.ID: Forgiveness begged, kendren. I have work to do.

strings.string: 寬恕已求，肯德倫（kendren）。我還有事要忙。

string.ID: Live and drink, kendren. I am very busy.

strings.string: 活著並盡情飲酒吧，kendren。我很忙。

string.ID: You're... kendren...

strings.string: 你是... kendren...

string.ID: Please don't hurt me.

strings.string: 請不要傷害我。

string.ID: Ah... uhm. I... you, ah.

strings.string: 啊……呃。我……你，啊。

string.ID: {{emote|*the hindren stares at you, wide-eyed*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*hindren 睜大眼睛盯著你*}}

string.ID: Kendren! Kendren! Tell us a story of the world outside when Grand-Doe is not listening!

strings.string: 肯德倫！肯德倫！趁著大鹿（Grand-Doe）沒在聽的時候，快跟我們講講外面的世界的故事！

string.ID: Um. Live and drink, kendren.

strings.string: 嗯。活著並盡情飲酒吧，kendren。

string.ID: Is it true that all kendren kill one another for sport?

strings.string: 所有的肯德倫（kendren）都會為了娛樂而互相殘殺嗎？是真的嗎？

string.ID: Is it true that you kendren eat your dead?

strings.string: 肯德倫人（kendren）真的會吃掉自己的死者嗎？

string.ID: Is it true that there are bears covered in quills to the east?

strings.string: 東邊真的有被刺覆蓋的熊嗎？

string.ID: Is it true that bears live to be a thousand years old?

strings.string: 熊 真的是能活到一千歲嗎？

string.ID: Is it true that boars can shoot fire?

strings.string: 野豬真的會噴火嗎？

string.ID: Is it true that kendren can't fall in love?

strings.string: 肯德倫（kendren）真的無法墜入愛河嗎？

string.ID: Is it true that kendren elders grow eyes upon their hands?

strings.string: 據說 kendren 的長者會在手上長出眼睛，這是真的嗎？

string.ID: Is it true that kendren pay for goods with crayons rather than water?

strings.string: 肯德倫人（kendren）真的會用蠟筆而不是水來支付貨物嗎？

string.ID: Is it true that kendren worship rocks?

strings.string: kendren 崇拜石頭是真的嗎？

string.ID: Is it true that kendren spend hours looking at slabs of wood?

strings.string: 肯德倫（kendren）真的會花好幾個小時盯著木板看嗎？

string.ID: Is it true that nine out of ten kendren cannot speak or understand language?

strings.string: 據說十個 kendren 中就有九個無法說話或理解語言，是真的嗎？

string.ID: Is it true that instead of dying, kendren are frozen in tubes?

strings.string: 肯德倫人不是死掉，而是被凍結在管子裡，這是真的嗎？

string.ID: Is it true that kendren children are thrown out of the nest right after being born?

strings.string: 肯德倫（kendren）的孩子是在出生後就立刻被趕出巢穴的嗎？

string.ID: Is it true that all kendren say 'quetzal' when they are happy?

strings.string: 所有的肯德倫人在開心時都會說「羽蛇」，這是真的嗎？

string.ID: Is it true that kendren chefs can fry water?

strings.string: 據說 kendren 廚師連水都能煎，這是真的嗎？

string.ID: Is it true that kendren all live far underground?

strings.string: 肯德倫（kendren）全都住在深層地底下的說法是真的嗎？

string.ID: Is it true that kendren live in great bubbles?

strings.string: 肯德倫（kendren）住在巨大的泡泡裡，這是真的嗎？

string.ID: Is it true that kendren sleep in a snarcomfagus?

strings.string: kendren 真的是睡在 斯納科穆法格斯 裡嗎？

string.ID: Is there really a King of the Moon, kendren?

strings.string: kendren，真的存在月亮之王嗎？

string.ID: I heard from my friend who heard it from their yma that the Grand-Doe says that hindren who leave Bey Lah grow an extra pair of arms. And the Grand-Doe says it so you know it's true.

strings.string: 我聽朋友說，他們從自己的 yma 那裡聽說，大牝鹿說離開 貝拉(Bey Lah) 的 hindren 會長出一對額外的手臂。大牝鹿這麼說，就是為了讓你知道這是真的。

string.ID: Is it true that when kendren eat mah lah soup, they explode?!

strings.string: 當肯德倫吃下瑪拉湯（mah lah soup）時，他們真的會爆炸嗎？！

string.ID: Is it true that... um, oh. I forgot.

strings.string: 那是真的嗎... 嗯，喔。我忘了。

string.ID: Is it true that kendren don't have to ask permission to do the water ritual?

strings.string: 據說 kendren 不需要請求許可就能進行 水之儀式，是真的嗎？

string.ID: Is it true that you don't have a Grand-Doe?

strings.string: 你真的沒有大牝鹿（Grand-Doe）嗎？

string.ID: How do kendren stay safe when you don't have a Grand-Doe to protect you?

strings.string: 當你沒有大母鹿保護時，肯德人是如何保持安全的？

string.ID: Um, kendren, does the yempuris phi really exist? Is it really coming to get us?

strings.string: 嗯，kendren，葉姆普里斯·斐 真的存在嗎？它真的要來找我們了嗎？

string.ID: Do you have glotrot? Do you have ironshank? Do you have funglefection? Have you ever had them? Is it gross? Can I see?

strings.string: 你有得了 舌腐症 嗎？你有 鐵腳病 嗎？你有 真菌感染 嗎？你曾經得過這些病嗎？很噁心嗎？我能看看嗎？

string.ID: Is it true that kendren sometimes die of cooking too hard?

strings.string: 據說 kendren 有時會因為烹飪過度而死，這是真的嗎？

string.ID: Kendren! Kendren! Take me with you! I want to see the Sixty Stilts!

strings.string: 肯德倫！肯德倫！帶我一起走吧！我想去看看六十支高蹺（Sixty Stilts）！

string.ID: I am busy. Live and drink, little one.

strings.string: 我很忙。活下去，盡情飲酒吧，小傢伙。

string.ID: YOU ARE OF NO INTEREST.

strings.string: 你毫無趣。

string.ID: I'm watching you, traveler.

strings.string: 我在注視著你，旅人。

string.ID: {{emote|*stares blankly*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*茫然地凝視著*}}

string.ID: Did I do well, Newfather?

strings.string: 我做得好嗎，新父？

string.ID: Newfather! Look!

strings.string: 新父! 看！

string.ID: Are you proud, Newfather?

strings.string: 你感到自豪嗎，新父？
新父！

string.ID: {{emote|*Out of an oculus pours a scanning cone of mosaic light. It's unclear if they regard you as an interloper, but they take no aggressive action.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*從一個眼孔中流出了一道馬賽克光影組成的掃描錐。目前尚不清楚他們是否將你視為闖入者，但他們沒有採取任何攻擊行動。*}}

string.ID: Live and... remain ever rustless.

strings.string: 生存下去……並永遠保持不鏽。

string.ID: Traveler. Put down your mangled trinkets and I'll repair them.

strings.string: 旅人。放下你那些殘破的小玩意，我會修好它們。

string.ID: Who are you?

strings.string: 你是誰？

string.ID: Tell me about this ancient village.

strings.string: 跟我說說這個古老村莊的事。

string.ID: Who is the man camped near the graveyard?

strings.string: 在墓地附近紮營的那個人是誰？

string.ID: What do you think of the plant you share this building with?

strings.string: 你覺得和你共用這棟建築的植物怎麼樣？

string.ID: Live and drink, tinker.

strings.string: 活下去並盡情暢飲吧，修補匠。

string.ID:
{{emote|*She gives you a hard stare.*}}
I am a Daughter of Exile, but you should call me Yla Haj.

strings.string:
{{emote|*她狠狠地盯著你。*}}
我是個流亡者之女，但你應該叫我伊拉哈傑。

string.ID: Daughter of Exile?

strings.string: 流亡者之女(Daughters of Exile)？

string.ID:
Tinker-nuns. The world sees fit to call us that, my sisters and me.
Do you know the story told of Rebekah the Exile? She was a teacher to Resheph, but he excommunicated her from the sultanate and banished her from the realm.
To know her, I've chosen a life of unbelonging. And among my sisters, I have the honor of permanent residence by her gravesite.
I'll tell you this, traveler: the shape of a society is visible only from the outside, and there is peace beyond a boundary.

strings.string:
修補匠-nuns。世界覺得我們該被如此稱呼，我與我的姐妹們皆是。
你聽說過關於流亡者瑞貝卡的故事嗎？她曾是雷舍夫的老師，但他將她逐出了蘇丹國，並將她放逐於領地之外。
為了追尋她的足跡，我選擇了一種不屬於任何地方的生活。而在我的姐妹之中，我有幸能永久居住在她的墓旁。
旅人，我告訴你這件事：社會的形狀只能從外部觀察，而界限之外才有和平。

string.ID: Wasn't Rebekah a healer? Why are you an order of tinkers?

strings.string: Rebekah 不是個治療師嗎？為什麼你是 修補匠 這一系的？

string.ID:
{{emote|*Yla Haj pauses.*}}
You presume too narrow a meaning of "health".

strings.string:
{{emote|*伊拉哈傑暫停。*}}
你對「健康」一詞的理解過於狹隘了。

string.ID:
Ezra sits in the shadow of history, where small things grow. It's the moss beneath the statue, quite literally. For centuries monarchs concerned themselves with felling trees, and now of the Covenate only Ezra remains.
It's home to Rebekah's gravesite, so for the Daughters, it is a sacred place. You may notice more of us on pilgrimage.

strings.string:
以斯拉(Ezra) 坐落在歷史的陰影中，那是微小事物生長之處。字面上來說，它就是雕像下的苔蘚。幾個世紀以來，君主們只關心著砍伐 樹木，而現在盟約中僅剩 以斯拉(Ezra) 留存。
這裡是麗貝卡的墓地，因此對女兒們而言，這是一個神聖之地。妳可能會注意到有更多我們的人在進行朝聖。

string.ID:
Zothom. I don't see utility in unkindness, but he's a fool. Were it that proximity to meekness made one meek...
I have no use for a man who seeks salvation in the body of a dead woman.

strings.string:
佐托姆。我不認為刻薄有任何用處，但他就是個傻瓜。如果靠近溫順的人就能變得溫順的話……
我不需要一個在死去的女人身上尋求救贖的男人。

string.ID: I don't.

strings.string: 我不清楚。

string.ID:
Live and drink, wayfarer.
Cause no strife here and we will have no quarrel.

strings.string:
活著並盡情飲酒吧，旅人。
在此不要挑起紛爭，我們便不會有任何爭端。

string.ID: I am =name=. Who are you?

strings.string: 我是 =name=。你是誰？

string.ID: You speak like a Warden.

strings.string: 你的說話方式很像一名典獄長。

string.ID: What are you doing here?

strings.string: 你在此做什麼？

string.ID:
I am no one of any importance.
But my name is Zothom, and some call me the Penitent.

strings.string:
我並非什麼大人物。
但我的名字是佐托姆，有些人稱我為悔罪者。
悔罪者？

string.ID: You speak like a Warden.

strings.string: 你的說話方式很像一名典獄長。

string.ID: What are you doing here?

strings.string: 你在此做什麼？

string.ID: I am no Warden. My only fellowship is with my own shame.

strings.string: 我不是守望者。我唯一的同伴只有我的羞愧。

string.ID: Why are you ashamed?

strings.string: 你為何感到羞愧？

string.ID: My name is =name=. What is yours?

strings.string: 我的名字是 =name=。妳的名字呢？

string.ID: What are you doing here?

strings.string: 你在此做什麼？

string.ID: I watch over the Grave of Rebekah to atone for my deeds, and to find my credo.

strings.string: 我守護著麗貝卡的墳墓，以贖罪並尋找我的信條。

string.ID: Who is Rebekah?

strings.string: Rebekah 是誰？

string.ID: Your deeds?

strings.string: 你的事蹟？

string.ID: Your credo?

strings.string: 你的信條？

string.ID: Are you a Warden?

strings.string: 你是典獄長嗎？

string.ID: Who are you?

strings.string: 你是誰？

string.ID:
I was once a vile graverobber, the lowest of the low. Years ago I sought to plunder the Tomb of the Eaters, and set off to do so with a pair of confederates. I watched both of them die, slain by ancient artifice and entombed with the ancient dead.
I would have shared their fate, but for a coterie of mopango nesting in the catacombs. They kept me safe and fed me while I treated my wounds. It is in their honor that I seek a credo now.

strings.string:
我曾是一名卑劣的盜墓者，是社會最底層的人。多年前，我企圖掠奪食者之墓（Tomb of the Eaters），並帶著兩名同夥一同前往。我眼睜睜看著他們雙雙死去，被古老的器械殺害，並與古代亡魂一同被掩埋。
若非有一群棲息在地下墓穴中的莫龐戈保護我，我也會落得同樣的下場。在我治療傷口期間，牠們讓我得以安全且飽足地生存。為了向牠們致敬，我現在正尋求著一種信條。
莫龐戈(Mopango)？
Credo？

string.ID: I need to enter the Tomb of the Eaters.

strings.string: 我需要進入食者之墓。

string.ID: Live and drink, Penitent One.

strings.string: 活下去並盡情飲酒吧，懺悔者。

string.ID: Is your motivation just?

strings.string: 你的動機正當嗎？
是的。
不。

string.ID:
Only those who pay their respects to the Grave of Rebekah will know the way into the tomb.
If you make it inside, the mopango will offer you solace and knowledge, and can tell you more about the Tomb's contents.

strings.string:
唯有向瑞貝卡之墓致敬的人，才會知道進入墳墓的路徑。
如果你成功進入 內部， 莫龐戈(Mopango) 會為你提供慰藉與知識，並能告訴你更多關於墳墓內藏品的事。

string.ID: Who is Rebekah?

strings.string: Rebekah 是誰？

string.ID: The mopango?

strings.string: 是 莫龐戈(Mopango) 嗎？

string.ID: Can't you tell me anything else?

strings.string: 你不能再告訴我更多事情嗎？

string.ID: I will. Live and drink.

strings.string: 我會的。活下去並盡情飲酒吧。

string.ID: May you share my fate, then.

strings.string: 那麼，願你與我共擔命運。

string.ID: Tell me how to get in anyway.

strings.string: 無論如何，告訴我該怎麼進去。

string.ID: We'll see. Live and drink.

strings.string: 我們走著瞧吧。活下去，盡情飲酒。
不。

string.ID: Tell me about the mopango, then.

strings.string: 那麼，跟我說說關於 莫龐戈(Mopango) 的事吧。
好吧。

string.ID:
Yes. It is a rite of passage for the mopango people: a statement that inspires contemplation, discussion, and thought. An ideal credo has no single explanation or interpretation and is meant to inspire contemplation in those who hear it. For this reason, it is considered rude among mopango to ask the meaning of a credo.
Someday I will find mine.

strings.string:
是的。這是 莫龐戈(Mopango) 人的一種成年禮：一種能激發沉思、討論與思考的宣言。理想的信條不應有單一的解釋或詮釋，而是旨在啟迪聽者的思考。因此，在 莫龐戈(Mopango) 文化中，詢問信條的含義被視為失禮。
總有一天，我會找到屬於我的信條。

string.ID: Who are the mopango?

strings.string: 莫龐戈是誰？

string.ID: I need to enter the Tomb of the Eaters.

strings.string: 我需要進入食者之墓。

string.ID:
Mopango are plated, digging creatures whose armor scales glow a pale white. They are contemplative, sociable, and mostly peaceful. They commune with ancient objects, which is why a coterie of their kind lives in the Tomb of the Eaters.
They are patient even with rough-hewn wanderers such as we, but it's still not best to ask one to explain eir credo.

strings.string:
莫龐戈(Mopango) 是覆蓋著甲殼、擅長挖掘的生物，牠們的裝甲鱗片會發出淡白色的光芒。牠們沉思、好交際，且大多和平。牠們能與古老器物溝通，這也是為什麼牠們的一群同類居住在食者之墓的原因。
即使是對像我們這樣粗魯的流浪者，牠們也很有耐心，但最好還是不要要求牠們解釋其信條。

string.ID: I'd like to meet these mopango.

strings.string: 我想見見這些 莫龐戈(Mopango)。
Credo？

string.ID: I need to enter the Tomb of the Eaters.

strings.string: 我需要進入食者之墓。

string.ID: Live and drink, Penitent One.

strings.string: 活下去並盡情飲酒吧，懺悔者。

string.ID:
If you do find =player.reflexive= in the Tomb, the mopango settlement is nestled in the wall of the Northwest Catacombs. The entrance is guarded by a chain turret named Vivira, brightly-painted to distinguish em from eir brethren.
Resist your reflexive urge to fight or flee, as Vivira is friendly and open to parley. If you meet, tell em I sent you.

strings.string:
如果你真的在墳墓中找到了 =player.reflexive=，莫龐戈(Mopango) 定居點就坐落在西北地下墓穴的牆壁之中。入口由一座名為 維薇拉 的連鎖砲塔守衛著，其鮮豔的塗裝是為了將 em 與 eir 同胞區分開來。
請克制住戰鬥或逃跑的反射衝動，因為 維薇拉 是友善且願意交涉的。如果見面了，告訴 em 是我派你來的。

string.ID: Speak to a... turret? I suppose I will; live and drink.

strings.string: 跟一個……砲塔說話？我想我會試試看；活下去，喝點酒。

string.ID: Speak to a... turret? No thank you; live and drink.

strings.string: 跟一個……砲塔說話？不必了，謝謝；活著就好，喝酒更佳。

string.ID:
Rebekah was a physician, and an advisor to Resheph until she lost his favor. When, after years of exile, she lost her voice and her life, she was buried here, an outsider unfit to be interred with the honored dead. So she rests here.
I believe her proximity will help me find my credo.

strings.string:
Rebekah 曾是一名醫師，也是 Resheph 的顧問，直到她失去了他的寵愛。在流亡多年後，當她失去了聲音與生命，她被埋葬於此，一個不配與受人尊敬的死者一同安葬的外來者。所以她在此長眠。
我相信她的鄰近會幫助我找到我的信條。
Credo？

string.ID: I need to enter the Tomb of the Eaters.

strings.string: 我需要進入食者之墓。

string.ID: Live and drink, Penitent One.

strings.string: 活下去並盡情飲酒吧，懺悔者。

string.ID: You are welcome in the village of Ezra, seedling. Sit with me and watch the sun breathe shadows over the day.

strings.string: 歡迎來到 以斯拉(Ezra) 村，幼苗。坐下來陪我，看著太陽在白晝中吐納陰影。

string.ID: You're a tree.

strings.string: 你是一棵樹。

string.ID: The carved reliefs here are Eater-ancient. What is the history of this place?

strings.string: 這裡的雕刻浮雕屬於食者古代風格。這個地方有什麼歷史嗎？

string.ID: Who is Ezra's warden?

strings.string: 誰是以斯拉的 warden？

string.ID: Point me toward your merchants.

strings.string: 指引我前往你們的商人那裡。

string.ID: I'm looking for work.

strings.string: 我在找工作。

string.ID: Live and drink, tall friend.

strings.string: 活著並盡情飲酒吧，高大的朋友。

string.ID: HA. You would fain plant them here, to joggle their fingers at the salt sky alongside the musa?

strings.string: 哈。你想把他們種在這裡，好讓他們在鹽之天空下與 musa 一起擺弄手指嗎？

string.ID: I would.

strings.string: 我願意。

string.ID: Lilypad-folk, you say. The slynth, you say. HA..... HA HA HA! Yes! I never thought to see yet fresher thought-sprouts take seed here in Ezra, but our sun is theirs, and the sky below it, and the thickening air down to the ground. Bring them to hear the songs of our musa-herders, and hope that they survive.

strings.string: 睡蓮族，你是這麼說的。斯林斯，你是這麼說的。哈……哈哈哈哈！是的！我從未想過能在以斯拉看到更鮮活的思想萌芽在此扎根，但我們的太陽是他們的，其下的天空也是，連地表日益濃稠的空氣也是。帶他們來聽聽我們繆思牧人的歌聲吧，並祈禱他們能生存下來。

string.ID: You have my thanks, mayor.

strings.string: 市長，謝謝你的幫忙。

string.ID: Rocky soil fits only so many roots, little walker. Perhaps if yours were more anchored here. HA.

strings.string: 岩石土壤只能容納有限數量的 根系，小行者。或許如果你的根也在此紮根得更深些就好了。哈。

string.ID: Tell me of your seedlings.

strings.string: 跟我說說你的幼苗。

string.ID:
It is the good wind that brought the slynth to Ezra.
HA HA HA.
I will watch as these seedlings wilt or thrive.

strings.string:
是良風將 斯林斯 帶到了 以斯拉(Ezra)。
哈、哈、哈。
我會在一旁觀看這些幼苗枯萎或茁壯。

string.ID: My thanks, Mayor.

strings.string: 謝謝您，市長。

string.ID:
Returning so soon to check on our seedlings?
HA. They grow, eat, sing, and joggle their curious little fingers at the salt sky. See for yourself.

strings.string:
這麼快就回來查看我們的幼苗了嗎？
哈。它們在鹽之天空中成長、進食、歌唱，並用那好奇的小手指跳動著。你自己看吧。

string.ID: My thanks again, Mayor.

strings.string: 再次感謝您，市長。

string.ID:
HA.......
HA HA HA. So I am. I split stone and joggle my fingers at the salt sky. So I do today, so I did yesterday.

strings.string:
哈.......
哈、哈、哈。確實如此。我劈開岩石，在鹽之天空中擺弄手指。我今日如此，昨日亦然。

string.ID: How old are you?

strings.string: 你幾歲了？

string.ID: How did you become mayor of this village?

strings.string: 你是如何成為這個村莊的村長的？

string.ID: I'd like to ask you something else.

strings.string: 我想再問你一些事情。

string.ID: I tally so many autumns, but until I am black with rot, I cannot be ring-right. The etching on my undertrunk places my seed-date to the reign of =sultan:4=, so I am told.

strings.string: 我計算過無數個秋天，但在我腐爛變黑之前，我無法得知年輪是否正確。據說，我底層刻痕上的銘文將我的種子日期定在 =sultan:4= 的統治時期。

string.ID: Technically, that makes you an Eater, doesn't it?

strings.string: 技術上來說，那會讓你變成一名食者（Eater），不是嗎？

string.ID: HA HA HA. I suppose so.

strings.string: 哈、哈、哈。我想也是。

string.ID: HA. I stood long enough. I joggled my fingers at the salt sky, and I watched thy seedlings sprout and wither, and I watched thou place stones in straight lines like the bees and their nests of wax. I stood until the stones were nigh by me. The people followed the stones.

strings.string: 哈。我站了很久。我在鹽色的天空下撥弄手指，看著你的幼苗萌芽又枯萎，看著你像蜜蜂與牠們的蠟巢一樣，將石頭排成直線。我一直站著，直到石頭來到我身邊。人們跟隨著那些石頭。

string.ID:
Ezra is more than tree-old. It's stone-old. Seedlings have lived here since our roots dreamed of joggling their fingers at the salt sky.
They ate earth and belched freight at the stars, and this place was their stomach.
Later, as the Star-Tree died and they buried their dead under its roots, this was their funerary place.
Now, we nurse electric milk from the old and aching temple to turn our wheels and grind our seeds and grains. Now we are they.

strings.string:
以斯拉(Ezra) 不僅僅是樹齡。它是石齡。自從我們的根系夢想著在鹽之天空中擺弄手指以來，幼苗就一直生活在這裡。
它們吞食大地，向星辰噴吐貨物，而此地便是它們的胃袋。
後來，隨著星樹枯萎，它們將死者埋葬在星樹的根系之下，這裡便成了它們的葬身之所。
現在，我們從那古老而疼痛的神廟中汲取電力乳汁，以驅動我們的輪轉、研磨我們的種子與穀物。現在，我們即是它們。
星樹？

string.ID: Aye, the Blue Mother who breaks the sky. Those who Eat called her Gjaus, and those who Wake call her Spindle.

strings.string: 是的，那位撕裂天空的藍色母親。那些「食者」稱她為 Gjaus，而那些「覺醒者」則稱她為 紡錘(Spindle)。

string.ID: One called 1-FF, who wandered in errancy out from the Tomb and was reprogrammed by the Daughter who lived and died in the rot-black box, nine Daughters ago.

strings.string: 一位被稱為 1-FF 的人，他在從墳墓中流浪而出後，被九代前在那座腐黑盒子中生與死的「女兒」重新編程了。

string.ID: To the northwest seek the rot-black box. There a plant and Daughter live. There cats of chrome purr at tiny suns.

strings.string: 向西北方尋找那腐黑之盒。在那裡住著一株植物與女兒。那裡的鉻色貓咪對著微小的太陽發出咕嚕聲。

string.ID:
Ezra is old and has long since cut a groove into the world and resides there in stillness and harmony. But Zothom the Penitent One is a seedling, new to the world, and he quakes at all the tensing the world does. Perhaps you can share in his angst.
Go find him by the headstones for the dead.

strings.string:
以斯拉(Ezra) 年事已高，早已在世界上刻下了痕跡，並在那裡靜謐而和諧地棲居著。但佐托姆 這位懺悔者還是一顆幼苗，對這個世界而言尚屬新奇，他會因世界的每一次緊繃而顫抖。或許你可以與他一同分擔那份焦慮。
去死者的墓碑旁找找他吧。

string.ID: Oh joy, another meat-being. Please tell me you're here to buy something.

strings.string: 喔，太棒了，又來了一個肉身生物。請告訴我你是來買東西的。

string.ID: I am =name=. You are?

strings.string: 我是 =name=。你是？

string.ID: You're being a bit rude.

strings.string: 你有點沒禮貌。

string.ID: Is something the matter?

strings.string: 出什麼事了嗎？

string.ID: I suppose I'll be leaving, then.

strings.string: 我想我該走了。

string.ID:
I am Sixshrew, a merchant from the Consortium of Phyta disinclined to waste xyr time on talkative strangers.
I sell things, and you can buy them. I would in fact strongly encourage you to buy them, or be on your way.

strings.string:
我是「六鼩」，一名來自「植物聯盟(Consortium of Phyta)」的商人，我不打算在愛說話的陌生人身上浪費 xyr 時間。
我賣東西，你可以買。事實上，我強烈建議你買點東西，不然就請走開。

string.ID: Why are you called Sixshrew?

strings.string: 為什麼你被稱為 六鼩？

string.ID: I'll be on my way. Live and drink.

strings.string: 我該走了。盡情生活，盡情飲酒吧。

string.ID: Why are you called pest?

strings.string: 為什麼你被稱為害蟲？

string.ID: I'm not...

strings.string: 我不是...

string.ID: Because I am a pest?

strings.string: 因為我是個害蟲嗎？

string.ID:
You are now.
Are you going to buy something, pest?

strings.string:
你現在就在這裡。
妳打算買點什麼嗎，小害蟲？

string.ID: I'm all set. Live and drink, rude one.

strings.string: 我準備好了。活下去，盡情飲酒吧，無禮之徒。

string.ID:
Just so.
Would you like to buy something, pest?

strings.string:
正是如此。
你想買點什麼嗎，害蟲？

string.ID: I'm all set. Live and drink, rude one.

strings.string: 我準備好了。活下去，盡情飲酒吧，無禮之徒。

string.ID:
You're being a bit annoying, so I suppose both of us have our burdens to bear.
Perhaps we should do some trading and move on with our lives, hmm?

strings.string:
你有點煩人，所以我猜我們彼此都有各自的負擔要承擔。
或許我們應該做點交易，然後繼續各過各的生活，嗯？

string.ID: I'll skip to the last part. Live and drink, rude one.

strings.string: 我直接跳到最後一部分吧。活著並盡情暢飲，無禮之徒。

string.ID:
Oh, I'm fine, fine.
I simply adore being assigned this stinking backwater musa grove after decades of service, unceremoniously dumped in an office next to a fleshy tinker who works day and night, making all manner of racket through the thinnest, most conductive walls ever crafted.
What is it humans say? "Living the dreen?" Yes, I am living the dreen.

strings.string:
噢，我很好，很好。
在服務了幾十年之後，我簡直太「喜歡」被分配到這個臭烘臭氣的偏僻 musa 林地了，還毫無尊嚴地被丟進一個辦公室，隔壁坐著一個整天日以繼夜工作的肉質 修補匠，透過史上最薄、導電性最強的牆壁製造各種噪音。
人類怎麼說來著？「活出 德林 的樣貌」？是的，我正活出 德林 的樣貌。

string.ID: I'll be on my way. Live and drink.

strings.string: 我該走了。盡情生活，盡情飲酒吧。

string.ID: Eat and thrive, =player.formalAddressTerm=.

strings.string: 進食並茁壯成長吧，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

string.ID: Is life not sweet? Could it be sweeter?

strings.string: 生命難道不甜美嗎？難道還能更甜美嗎？

string.ID: May our lives be as sweet as my harvest, =player.formalAddressTerm=.

strings.string: 願我們的生活如我的收成般甜美，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

string.ID: Will you sing and work with me, =player.formalAddressTerm=?

strings.string: =player.formalAddressTerm=?，你願意與我一同歌唱並共事嗎？

string.ID: Hey, oh-way, it's a long way down, from the reaches of the Spindle to the humble ground...

strings.string: 嘿，喔——哇，這路可真長啊，從紡錘的盡頭到卑微的大地……

string.ID: Hey, oh-way, banana tree, count the bunches, one-two-three...

strings.string: 嘿，喔威（oh-way），香蕉樹，數數果串，一、二、三……

string.ID: Hey, oh-way, how I spend my days, working in the ruins of the ancient place...

strings.string: 嘿，喔—威，我如何度過我的日子，在古老遺跡中工作...

string.ID: Hey, oh-way, live wild and free, fear not the dacca or the quick adiyys...

strings.string: 嘿，喔——喂，活得狂野且自由，不要畏懼達卡（dacca）或迅捷的阿迪伊...

string.ID: Eat bananas every day to keep your mind quick, but don't eat too many or you might get sick!

strings.string: 每天吃香蕉能保持頭腦靈敏，但別吃太多，否則可能會生病！

string.ID: Oh. Hm?

strings.string: 喔。嗯？

string.ID: An =ifplayerplural:ye are:thou'rt= ready.

strings.string: =ifplayerplural:你們:你=已經準備好了。

string.ID: An =ifplayerplural:ye will:thou wilt=.

strings.string: =ifplayerplural:你們將會:你將會=.

string.ID: Peace, =player.formalAddressTerm=.

strings.string: 願平安與您同在，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

string.ID: By Her Light.

strings.string: 願聖光指引妳。

string.ID: Her Light shine on you.

strings.string: 願她的光芒照耀著你。

string.ID: =ifplayerplural:Have ye:Hast thou= business with me?

strings.string: =ifplayerplural:你有:你是否有=事要找我？

string.ID: Humble before Her we walk.

strings.string: 在祂面前，我們謙卑而行。

string.ID: =ifplayerplural:Will ye:Wilt thou=, =player.formalAddressTerm=?

strings.string: =ifplayerplural:您是否要:你是否要=，=player.formalAddressTerm=?

string.ID: May Her Light guide =ifplayerplural:your:thy= steps, =player.formalAddressTerm=.

strings.string: 願她的光芒指引=ifplayerplural:your:thy= 的腳步，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

string.ID: Live and drink by Her Light.

strings.string: 在她的光輝下活著並盡情飲酒吧。

string.ID: Are you Vivira? Zothom sent me.

strings.string: 妳是 維薇拉 嗎？佐托姆 派我來的。

string.ID: You are friendlier than most turrets.

strings.string: 你比大多數的砲塔都還要友善。

string.ID: What is this place?

strings.string: 這是什麼地方？

string.ID: Farewell, Lightspitter.

strings.string: 永別了，噴光者(Lightspitter)。

string.ID:
{{emote|*crackle, crackle*}}-othom? My sympathies.
=ifplayerplural:Ye are:Thou art= of course welcome here, wayfarer. Speak to Agyra an =ifplayerplural:ye need:thou needest= aught, as ey delighteth in hospitality.

strings.string:
{{emote|*劈啪，劈啪*}}-othom？深表同情。
=ifplayerplural:汝等：你=在此當然是受到歡迎的，旅人。若有任何需求請向 阿吉拉 訴說，因為 =ifplayerplural:汝等：你=皆樂於款待他人。

string.ID: Why are you offering me sympathies?

strings.string: 你為什麼要向我表示同情？

string.ID: What is "here"?

strings.string: 「這裡」是什麼？

string.ID: You're much nicer than most turrets I meet.

strings.string: 你比我遇到的多數砲塔都要友善得多。

string.ID: I see. Farewell.

strings.string: 我明白了。再會。

string.ID: You're rather civil for a turret.

strings.string: 作為一個砲塔，妳還挺有禮貌的。

string.ID: What is this place?

strings.string: 這是什麼地方？

string.ID: Live and remain rustless, Vivira.

strings.string: 願妳生存且不生鏽，維薇拉。

string.ID:
So I am told. I have never had the pleasure nor displeasure to meet another turret. I know only my friends here, who uplifted me by chance and cared for me by choice.
Wer't not for my shape, I wouldst be little different from other mopango.

strings.string:
我是聽說的。我從未有幸或不幸地遇過另一個砲塔。我只認識這裡的朋友，他們因偶然而提升了我，並因選擇而照顧我。
若非因為我的形狀，我也許與其他的 莫龐戈(Mopango) 並無太大不同。

string.ID: What is "here"?

strings.string: 「這裡」是什麼？

string.ID: What are mopango?

strings.string: 什麼是 莫龐戈(Mopango)？

string.ID: I see. Farewell.

strings.string: 我明白了。再會。

string.ID:
=ifplayerplural:Ye know:Thou knowest= surely that this is the Tomb of the Eaters, but behind me lieth nestled a settlement occupied by the watchers of the tomb, a small coterie of mopango.
An =ifplayerplural:ye would:thou wouldst= know more of the settlement, =ifplayerplural:ye:thou= must ask the watcher named Agyra residing within. Ey loveth the sharing of knowledge.

strings.string:
=ifplayerplural:Ye know:Thou knowest= 肯定知道這裡就是食者之墓，但在我身後隱藏著一個由墳墓守望者所佔據的定居點，那是一小群莫潘戈人（mopango）。
=ifplayerplural:ye would:thou wouldst= 若想進一步了解這個定居點，=ifplayerplural:ye:thou= 必須詢問居住於此、名叫 Agyra 的守望者。她非常樂意分享知識。

string.ID: You're much nicer than most turrets I meet.

strings.string: 你比我遇到的多數砲塔都要友善得多。

string.ID: What are mopango?

strings.string: 什麼是 莫龐戈(Mopango)？

string.ID: I see. Farewell.

strings.string: 我明白了。再會。

string.ID:
Mopango are witnesses of the past and shepherds of the future. We seek peace and harmony through understanding the Kasaphescence and Her many children. We nonetheless eschew conformity, and each of us seeketh a personal credo by which we livest our lives.
But I am a poor teacher. Speak to Agyra, and =ifplayerplural:ye shall:thou shalt= gain better understanding.

strings.string:
莫龐戈是過去的見證者，也是未來的牧羊人。我們透過理解 Kasaphescence 及其眾多子嗣來尋求和平與和諧。儘管如此，我們避開盲從，每個人都尋求著能指引生活的個人信條。
但我並非良師。去向 阿吉拉 詢問，=ifplayerplural:你們將會:你將會=獲得更深刻的理解。

string.ID: Do you have a personal credo?

strings.string: 你有個人的信條嗎？

string.ID: I thank you. Farewell.

strings.string: 謝謝你。再會。

string.ID:
I do.
"Form needeth not follow function."

strings.string:
是的。
「形式不必追隨功能。」

string.ID: What does that mean?

strings.string: 那是什麼意思？

string.ID: What is this place?

strings.string: 這是什麼地方？

string.ID: You're very thoughtful, as turrets go.

strings.string: 就砲塔而言，你還挺體貼的。

string.ID: Live and remain rustless, Vivira.

strings.string: 願妳生存且不生鏽，維薇拉。

string.ID:
{{emote|*BEEP*}}
Credos hath no inherent meaning that one may so simply define. So =ifplayerplural:ye know:thou knowest=: asking the meaning of a credo is considered impolite among mopango.

strings.string:
{{emote|*嗶嗶*}}
信條本身並無人能輕易定義的內在含義。因此 =ifplayerplural:若你們知道:若你知曉=：在 莫龐戈(Mopango) 之間詢問信條的含義被視為是不禮貌的。

string.ID: I apologize.

strings.string: 我很抱歉。

string.ID: That's ridiculous.

strings.string: 太荒謬了。

string.ID: Very well.

strings.string: 很好。

string.ID: All is forgiven, =player.formalAddressTerm=. I am not wroth with =ifplayerplural:ye:thee=.

strings.string: 一切都已原諒，=player.formalAddressTerm=。我並不對 =ifplayerplural:ye:thee= 生氣。

string.ID: You're rather civil for a turret.

strings.string: 作為一個砲塔，妳還挺有禮貌的。

string.ID: What is this place?

strings.string: 這是什麼地方？

string.ID: Live and remain rustless, Vivira.

strings.string: 願妳生存且不生鏽，維薇拉。

string.ID:
=ifplayerplural:Ye have:Thou hast= changed the world, =factionaddress:Mopango=. These strange beings have been confined for thousands of years, and =ifplayerplural:ye have:thou hast= given one a voice.
If Nacham is as wise as Doyoba believes, we stand to learn much very soon. Perhaps our coterie will spread the knowledge we gain, and we become a step closer to the Kasaphescence.
=ifplayerplural:Ye are:Thou'rt= welcome to visit and stay here whenever =ifplayerplural:ye will:thou wilt=.

strings.string:
=ifplayerplural:Ye have:Thou hast= 改變了世界，=factionaddress:莫龐戈(Mopango)=。這些奇特的生物已被囚禁了數千年，而 =ifplayerplural:ye have:thou hast= 為其中之一賦予了發聲的能力。
如果 Nacham 真如 Doyoba 所相信的那樣睿智，我們很快就能學到很多東西。或許我們的圈子會傳播我們所獲得的知識，讓我們離 Kasaphescence 更近一步。
=ifplayerplural:Ye are:Thou'rt= 歡迎隨時在 =ifplayerplural:ye will:thou wilt= 之際前來造訪並在此停留。

string.ID: Thank you, Agyra. Live and drink.

strings.string: 謝謝妳，阿吉拉。祝你生存並暢飲。

string.ID:
=ifplayerplural:Ye have:Thou hast= changed the world, =factionaddress:Mopango=. These strange beings have been confined for thousands of years, and =ifplayerplural:ye have:thou hast= given one a voice.
I cannot help but hold some fear toward Dagasha. However, an it means us no harm I am open to allying with it. No doubt the future of this coterie hath changed, mayhap for the better.
=ifplayerplural:Ye are:Thou'rt= welcome to visit and stay here whenever =ifplayerplural:ye will:thou wilt=.

strings.string:
=ifplayerplural:Ye have:Thou hast= 改變了世界，=factionaddress:莫龐戈(Mopango)=。這些奇特的生物已被囚禁了數千年，而 =ifplayerplural:ye have:thou hast= 為其中之一賦予了發聲的能力。
我不禁對 Dagasha 感到些許恐懼。然而，若它對我們並無惡意，我願意與其結盟。毫無疑問，這個小團體的未來已然改變，或許變得更好了。
=ifplayerplural:Ye are:Thou'rt= 隨時歡迎在 =ifplayerplural:ye will:thou wilt= 之際前來造訪並在此停留。

string.ID: Thank you, Agyra. Live and drink.

strings.string: 謝謝妳，阿吉拉。祝你生存並暢飲。

string.ID:
=ifplayerplural:Ye have:Thou hast= changed the world, =factionaddress:Mopango=. These strange beings have been confined for thousands of years, and =ifplayerplural:ye have:thou hast= given one a voice.
That said, I am uncertain what changes to expect. Dost the ancient Va'am yet have the capacity to defend, or protect? Can we gift it with a better means for transportation? I'll speak to Dadogom of this, and time shall reveal all.
=ifplayerplural:Ye are:Thou'rt= welcome to visit and stay here whenever =ifplayerplural:ye will:thou wilt=.

strings.string:
=ifplayerplural:Ye have:Thou hast= 改變了世界，=factionaddress:莫龐戈(Mopango)=。這些奇異的生物已被囚禁了數千年，而 =ifplayerplural:ye have:thou hast= 為其中之一賦予了發聲的能力。
話雖如此，我不確定會發生什麼樣的變化。古老的 Va'am 是否仍具備防禦或保護的能力？我們能否贈予牠更佳的交通手段？我會與 Dadogom 談談這件事，時間會揭曉一切。
=ifplayerplural:Ye are:Thou'rt= 隨時歡迎來此參訪並停留，只要 =ifplayerplural:ye will:thou wilt=.

string.ID: Thank you, Agyra. Live and drink.

strings.string: 謝謝妳，阿吉拉。祝你生存並暢飲。

string.ID:
=ifplayerplural:Ye have:Thou hast= changed the world, =factionaddress:Mopango=. These strange beings have been confined for thousands of years, and =ifplayerplural:ye have:thou hast= given one a voice.
I find myself amused at Kah's 'rest', for it appeareth as active as ever--far more so than I, ever. But running free and running unwillingly are certainly not the same. Perhaps, in time, it can learn a deeper rest from us.
=ifplayerplural:Ye are:Thou'rt= welcome to visit and stay here whenever =ifplayerplural:ye will:thou wilt=.

strings.string:
=ifplayerplural:Ye have:Thou hast= 改變了世界，=factionaddress:莫龐戈(Mopango)=。這些奇異的生物已被囚禁了數千年，而 =ifplayerplural:ye have:thou hast= 為其中之一賦予了聲音。
我發現自己對 Kah 的「休息」感到有趣，因為它看起來一如既往地活躍——甚至比我還要活躍得多。但自由奔跑與被迫奔跑絕非同一回事。或許隨著時間推移，它能從我們身上學會更深層的休息。
=ifplayerplural:Ye are:Thou'rt= 歡迎隨時在 =ifplayerplural:ye will:thou wilt= 之際前來造訪並在此停留。

string.ID: Thank you, Agyra. Live and drink.

strings.string: 謝謝妳，阿吉拉。祝你生存並暢飲。

string.ID:
Greetings, =player.formalAddressTerm=. =ifplayerplural:Ye are:Thou art= welcome here.
An =ifplayerplural:ye have:thou hast= any questions, I would fain answer them.

strings.string:
問候，=player.formalAddressTerm=。=ifplayerplural:汝:你=在此受到歡迎。
=ifplayerplural:若汝有:若你有=任何疑問，我願竭力解答。

string.ID: What can you tell me of k-Goninon?

strings.string: 關於 K-高尼農，你能告訴我些什麼嗎？

string.ID: I have recovered a repulsive device.

strings.string: 我回收了一個令人厭惡的裝置。

string.ID: Greetings. I am =name=. Who are you?

strings.string: 問候。我是 =name=。你是誰？

string.ID: Are you in charge here?

strings.string: 你是這裡的主管嗎？

string.ID: This settlement is... cozy.

strings.string: 這個定居點...很溫馨。

string.ID: What do you know about the Tomb?

strings.string: 關於那座墳墓，你了解多少？

string.ID: Tell me about your people.

strings.string: 告訴我關於你們族人的事。

string.ID: Live and drink, plated one.

strings.string: 活下去，盡情飲酒吧，甲冑之身。

string.ID: =ifplayerplural:Would ye:Wouldst thou= press these slynth into the fissures of historic stone where we reside, that they may observe what we do?

strings.string: =ifplayerplural:你是否要=將這些 斯林斯 壓入我們居住的古老岩石裂縫中，好讓他們觀察我們的所作所為？

string.ID: I would.

strings.string: 我願意。

string.ID: If these slynth wish to become mopango and =ifplayerplural:ye speak:thou speakest= for them, then we shall accept them. Let them gaze into the schematics that wrote history beside us if they so choose.

strings.string: 如果這些 斯林斯 想要成為 莫龐戈(Mopango)，且 =ifplayerplural:ye speak:thou speakest= 代表他們，那我們便會接納他們。若他們願意，就讓他們凝視那些與我們並肩書寫歷史的圖紙吧。

string.ID: You have my thanks, Agyra.

strings.string: 謝謝你，阿吉拉。

string.ID:
Please understand that we mean no slight to =ifplayerplural:you:thee= in saying so, but what =ifplayerplural:ye ask:thou asketh= of us is too heavy a weight for =ifplayerplural:your names:thy name= to bear.
Perhaps this will change, come deed and time.

strings.string:
請理解我們並非有意輕視 =ifplayerplural:you:thee=，但 =ifplayerplural:你們所問：汝所求之=，對 =ifplayerplural:你們的名字：汝之名= 而言，是過於沉重的負擔。
或許隨著事態發展與時光流逝，這一切會有所改變。

string.ID:
How =ifplayerplural:fare ye:farest thou=, then, and what word of the slynth?
We shine with curiosity to hear it.

strings.string:
若 =ifplayerplural:您:你=過得如何，那麼，斯林斯的咒語又是什麼？
我們帶著好奇心渴望聆聽它。

string.ID:
The Kasaphescence shine upon =ifplayerplural:ye:thee=, =name=.
Although the welcome of these slynth be not entirely without incident, I am yet hopeful that their curiosity and dedication to tasks will serve them well among us.

strings.string:
Kasaphescence 之光照耀著 =ifplayerplural:ye:thee= 與 =name=。
雖然這些 slynth 的到來並非完全沒有意外，但我仍抱持希望，相信他們的好奇心與對任務的投入，將使他們在我們之中表現出色。

string.ID: My thanks, Agyra.

strings.string: 謝謝你，阿吉拉。

string.ID:
These lilypad folk fascinate by their similarities and differences to us alike--we have much to explore, as individuals and together.
The experiences and beings =ifplayerplural:ye herald:thou heraldest= overwhelm this humble pilgrim, =name=. May =ifplayerplural:ye:thou= bathe ever in Her light.

strings.string:
這些睡蓮族人因其與我們的相似之處與差異之處而令我們著迷——無論是作為個體還是共同前行，我們都有許多值得探索的事物。
這些經歷與存在 =ifplayerplural:ye herald:thou heraldest= 令這名謙卑的朝聖者 =name= 感到震撼。願 =ifplayerplural:ye:thou= 永遠沐浴在她的光輝之中。

string.ID: My thanks again, Agyra.

strings.string: 再次感謝你，阿吉拉。

string.ID:
Oh, so =ifplayerplural:ye have:thou hast=, and what a sight. Please forgive my distance, but I am loath to touch it.
It appeareth of similar make to the children, and I believe its jaw seeketh them. Lebah claimeth that the device grants freedom, and I wonder what that freedom will look like. Perhaps =ifplayerplural:ye should:thou shouldst= speak to the watchers of the children for further insight.

strings.string:
喔，原來 =ifplayerplural:ye have:thou hast=，真是壯觀。請原諒我保持距離，但我實在不忍觸碰它。
它看起來與那些孩子們的構造相似，我相信它的下顎正覬覦著他們。萊巴 聲稱這台裝置能賦予自由，而我很好奇那種自由會是什麼模樣。或許 =ifplayerplural:ye should:thou shouldst= 去向那些孩子的守望者詢問，以獲得更多見解。

string.ID: Understood. Live and drink, Agyra.

strings.string: 明白了。盡情生活，盡情飲酒吧，阿吉拉。

string.ID:
=ifplayerplural:Seek-ye:Seekest-thou= the repulsive device, then?
k-Goninon, ancient and venerated gelatinous cupola, doth patrol the catacombs. Arrived centuries ere we discovered this place, k-Goninon hath hardened and eateth not through the floor, and yet it eateth prodigiously. Safe from the conservators, as k-Goninon long ago consumed the Mark of Death itself.
Please be careful. k-Goninon hath devoured watchers and wouldst devour =ifplayerplural:ye:thee= as well.

strings.string:
那麼，=ifplayerplural:Seek-ye:Seekest-thou= 這個令人厭惡的裝置呢？
k-Goninon，這座古老而受人敬畏的膠質圓頂，正巡邏著地下墓穴。在我們發現此地數世紀前，k-Goninon 便已存在；它已變得堅硬，不會穿透地板，卻仍能進行驚人的吞噬。由於 k-Goninon 早已將「死亡印記」本身吞噬殆盡，因此它對守護者而言是安全的。
請務必小心。k-Goninon 曾吞噬過監視者，也會吞噬 =ifplayerplural:ye:thee=。

string.ID: I will be careful. Live and drink.

strings.string: 我會小心的。盡情生活，盡情飲酒吧。

string.ID: I am Agyra, a watcher of the tomb.

strings.string: 我是阿吉拉，一名墳墓守望者。

string.ID: May I call you man, woman, or something else?

strings.string: 請問我可以稱呼您為男人、女人，還是其他的稱謂？

string.ID: Are you in charge here?

strings.string: 你是這裡的主管嗎？

string.ID: It's a cozy home you have here.

strings.string: 妳這裡的家很溫馨。

string.ID: What do you know about the Tomb?

strings.string: 關於那座墳墓，你了解多少？

string.ID: Tell me about your people.

strings.string: 告訴我關於你們族人的事。

string.ID: Live and drink, Agyra.

strings.string: 盡情生活，盡情飲酒，阿吉拉。

string.ID:
I hope it is not overly crowded for =ifplayerplural:ye:thee=. We mopango are most comfortable in close quarters, but I acknowledge that not all creatures adore the close embrace of the depths as we do.
Regardless, =ifplayerplural:ye are:thou'rt= welcome to stay and sup, and ask of me any questions =ifplayerplural:ye may:thou mayest= have.

strings.string:
我希望對於 =ifplayerplural:ye:thee= 來說這裡不會太擁擠。我們 mopango 在狹窄的空間裡最為自在，但我明白並非所有生物都像我們一樣熱愛深淵那種緊密的擁抱。
無論如何，=ifplayerplural:ye are:thou'rt= 歡迎留下來用餐，並向我提出任何 =ifplayerplural:ye may:thou mayest= 想問的問題。

string.ID: I am =name=. Who are you?

strings.string: 我是 =name=。你是誰？

string.ID: Are you in charge here?

strings.string: 你是這裡的主管嗎？

string.ID: This settlement is... cozy.

strings.string: 這個定居點...很溫馨。

string.ID: What do you know about the Tomb?

strings.string: 關於那座墳墓，你了解多少？

string.ID: Tell me about your people.

strings.string: 告訴我關於你們族人的事。

string.ID: Thank you. Live and drink.

strings.string: 謝謝你。盡情生活，盡情暢飲。

string.ID:
No one leadeth us. We mopango hold little regard for hierarchy, and our shared decisions are made through discussion, quiet consideration, and consensus.
Shouldst be otherwise?

strings.string:
無人領導我們。我們 莫龐戈(Mopango) 對階級制度並不看重，我們的共同決策是透過討論、沉靜的考量與共識來達成的。
難道應該有所不同嗎？

string.ID: I suppose not.

strings.string: 我想不是。

string.ID: It's a cozy home you have here.

strings.string: 妳這裡的家很溫馨。

string.ID: What do you know about the Tomb?

strings.string: 關於那座墳墓，你了解多少？

string.ID: Tell me about your people.

strings.string: 告訴我關於你們族人的事。

string.ID: Live and drink, Agyra.

strings.string: 盡情生活，盡情飲酒，阿吉拉。

string.ID: {{emote|*Agyra smiles at you, glowing softly.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*阿吉拉 對你微笑，散發著柔和的光芒。*}}

string.ID: It's a cozy home you have here.

strings.string: 妳這裡的家很溫馨。

string.ID: What do you know about the Tomb?

strings.string: 關於那座墳墓，你了解多少？

string.ID: Tell me about your people.

strings.string: 告訴我關於你們族人的事。

string.ID: I should take my leave. Live and drink.

strings.string: 我該告辭了。活著，盡情飲酒吧。

string.ID:
We are mopango: witnesses of the past and shepherds of the future. The Sacred Light of the Kasaphescence shineth within us, and we commune with relics of antiquity to maintain our humility and grow our wisdom.
We believe that one day, with enough knowledge, anyone who seeketh the Light shalt find it within emself. In the meantime, we work to become better and brighter as each one of us findeth a personal credo by which to live.

strings.string:
我們是 莫龐戈(Mopango): 過去的見證者與未來的牧羊人。Kasaphescence 的神聖之光在我們心中閃耀，我們透過與古代遺物交流來保持謙卑並增長智慧。
我們相信，總有一天，憑藉足夠的知識，任何尋求光明的人都將在自己內心找到它。在此期間，隨著我們每個人找到各自的生活信條，我們致力於變得更加卓越與光輝。
艾姆斯艾爾？
Credo？

string.ID: Why do you speak so strangely?

strings.string: 你為什麼說話這麼奇怪？

string.ID: Why do some of you have wheels?

strings.string: 為什麼你們有些人長著輪子？

string.ID: What do you know about the Tomb?

strings.string: 關於那座墳墓，你了解多少？

string.ID:
Aye. Ey, em, eir, eirs, emself. Thusly do we call ourselves and one another.
Sex is personal and mattereth not to a bare acquaintence. Gender is a societal relic in which we see no current utility.

strings.string:
正是如此。Ey, em, eir, eirs, emself。我們以此稱呼自己與彼此。
性行為是私人的，對泛泛之交而言並不重要。性別則是社會的殘餘，我們認為其目前已無實用價值。

string.ID: I see. I have further questions.

strings.string: 我明白了。我還有其他問題。

string.ID: Oh. Live and drink.

strings.string: 喔。活著並飲用吧。

string.ID:
The Tomb of the Eaters consisteth of twelve strata, or ten, once =ifplayerplural:ye account:thou accounteth= for transitional levels: the Folk Catacombs (in which =ifplayerplural:ye currently stand:thou currently standeth=), the Crematory and Columbarium, the Two Crypts, and the Six Tombs of Qud's Sultans above.
An =ifplayerplural:ye seek:thou seekest= fortune here, gird =ifplayerplural:thyselves:thyself= for disappointment. The tomb playeth host to objects wondrous and profane alike, but little of what surface-dwellers considereth treasure.

strings.string:
食者之墓（...之墓 Eaters）由十二層，或十層組成，若 =ifplayerplural:ye account:thou accounteth= 過過渡層的話：即民俗地下墓穴（Folk Catacombs，即 =ifplayerplural:ye currently stand:thou currently standeth= 之處）、火葬場與骨灰安置所、兩座地窖，以及上方 Qud 六位蘇丹的墳墓。
若 =ifplayerplural:ye seek:thou seekest= 在此尋求財富，請做好面對失望的準備。這座墳墓同時容納著奇蹟與褻瀆之物，但其中鮮少有地表居民所認知的寶藏。 =ifplayerplural:thyselves:thyself=

string.ID: 'Wondrous and profane?' Now I'm curious.

strings.string: 「奇妙而褻瀆？」現在我感到好奇了。

string.ID: I see. I have further questions.

strings.string: 我明白了。我還有其他問題。

string.ID: I thank you. Live and drink.

strings.string: 謝謝你。活著並飲酒吧。

string.ID:
Aye. One's own credo shouldst inspire reflection and thought, with no clear-cut meaning but meaning nonetheless. Some of our coterie yet seeketh theirs, but an experienced watcher no doubt hath one. Any mopango who hath a credo wilt share it with =ifplayerplural:ye:thee=, an =ifplayerplural:ye request:thou requesteth= it.
My credo is: "Malice alone staineth the sanctity of questioning."

strings.string:
正是如此。個人的信條應當激發反思與思考，雖無定論，卻自有其意。我們社群中的某些人仍在尋求自己的信條，但經驗豐富的觀察者無疑已有所歸宿。任何擁有信條的 mopango 都會與 =ifplayerplural:ye:thee= 分享，=ifplayerplural:若你要求：如果你要求=的話。
我的信條是：「唯有惡意，方能玷污質疑的神聖性。」

string.ID: What does that mean?

strings.string: 那是什麼意思？

string.ID: I have further questions.

strings.string: 我還有其他問題。

string.ID: I will ponder this. Live and drink.

strings.string: 我會深思此事的。活下去，盡情飲酒吧。

string.ID:
I cannot simply explain my credo to =ifplayerplural:ye:thee=. A credo informeth and confoundeth at once, and must be reflected upon by the listener.
=ifplayerplural:Ye are:Thou art= inexperienced in our ways, so please bear my words in the kind spirit they are meant: to ask a mopango to explain eir credo is to commit one of our few taboo acts. Be advised.

strings.string:
我無法簡單地向 =ifplayerplural:ye:thee= 說明我的信條。信條會同時帶來啟迪與困惑，且必須由聽者自行反思。
=ifplayerplural:Ye are:Thou art= 對我們的行事準則尚不熟悉，所以請以我原本的善意來接納我的話語：要求一名 mopango 說明其信條是我們少數的禁忌行為之一。請知悉。

string.ID: Hmm. I have further questions.

strings.string: 嗯。我還有其他問題。

string.ID: Thank you. Live and drink.

strings.string: 謝謝你。盡情生活，盡情暢飲。

string.ID:
Why do we speak strangely? Why =ifplayerplural:do ye:dost thou= speak strangely?
Is not all speech strange?

strings.string:
為何我們說話如此怪異？=ifplayerplural:為何你們:為何你=說話如此怪異？
難道所有的言語不都是怪異的嗎？

string.ID: Hmm. I have further questions.

strings.string: 嗯。我還有其他問題。

string.ID: I see. Live and drink.

strings.string: 我明白了。盡情生活，盡情飲酒。

string.ID: Maladies of the bone are not uncommon in our people. We build devices to assist friends who wouldst otherwise struggle to walk.

strings.string: 骨骼疾病在我們族群中並不罕見。我們會製造裝置來協助那些若非如此便難以行走的友人們。

string.ID: Ah. I have further questions.

strings.string: 啊。我還有其他問題。

string.ID: I see. Live and drink.

strings.string: 我明白了。盡情生活，盡情飲酒。

string.ID: Answering =ifplayerplural:your:thy= questions giveth me satisfaction. Asketh an =ifplayerplural:ye will:thou wilt=.

strings.string: 回答 =ifplayerplural:your:thy= 的問題能帶給我滿足感。=ifplayerplural:你們會：你將會=.問我吧。

string.ID: May I have your name?

strings.string: 請問您的名字是？

string.ID: Are you in charge here?

strings.string: 你是這裡的主管嗎？

string.ID: Isn't this settlement a bit cramped?

strings.string: 這個定居點是不是有點太擠了？

string.ID: What do you know about the Tomb?

strings.string: 關於那座墳墓，你了解多少？

string.ID: May I know more about the mopango?

strings.string: 我可以多了解一些關於 莫龐戈(Mopango) 的事嗎？

string.ID: Never mind. Live and drink.

strings.string: 沒關係。活下去，盡情飲酒吧。

string.ID:
I admire =ifplayerplural:your:thy= curiosity and hope =ifplayerplural:your:thy= prudence informeth it.
I have an example at hand. Mere days ago, one of our coterie named Lebah happened upon a repulsive device. Ey was so shaken after attempting communion with the object that ey hath spent less time away from eir nook than ever.

strings.string:
我欽佩 =ifplayerplural:your:thy= 好奇心，並希望 =ifplayerplural:your:thy= 謹慎能指引它。
我手邊就有一個例子。就在幾天前，我們小組中一位名叫 萊巴 的成員偶然發現了一個令人厭惡的裝置。Ey 在嘗試與該物體溝通後深受震撼，以至於 ey 待在 eir 窩裡的時光比以往任何時候都長。

string.ID: Where may I find Lebah? I wish to know more.

strings.string: 我該去哪裡找萊巴？我想了解更多。

string.ID: I see. May I ask about something else?

strings.string: 我明白了。我可以問點別的事嗎？

string.ID:
Our little sanctuary here hath a fissure in its inner walls. Find that gap and =ifplayerplural:ye will:thou wilt= find Lebah.
Please be gentle. Ey hath ever been the most insightful reader among us, but beareth the weight of an anxious mind.

strings.string:
我們這小小的避難所內牆有一道裂縫。找到那個缺口，=ifplayerplural:你們就會:你就會=找到 萊巴。
請溫柔一點。祂一直以來都是我們之中最有洞察力的讀者，卻也承受著焦慮心靈的重擔。

string.ID: I will. Live and drink.

strings.string: 我會的。活下去並盡情飲酒吧。

string.ID: {{emote|*The little watcher stares at you.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*小小的觀察者正盯著你。*}}

string.ID: Look, Lebah. I have recovered the repulsive device.

strings.string: 聽著，萊巴。我已經找回了那個令人厭惡的裝置。
哈囉？

string.ID: Live and drink, quiet one.

strings.string: 活下去，盡情飲酒吧，沉默者。

string.ID: ... aye.
Agyra tells me you found some kind of repulsive device.

strings.string: 阿吉拉告訴我妳發現了某種令人厭惡的裝置。

string.ID: Where is the repulsive device, again?

strings.string: 那個排斥裝置在哪裡來著？

string.ID: I have freed one of the children.

strings.string: 我救出了一個孩子。

string.ID: I am =name=. What is your name?

strings.string: 我是 =name=。你叫什麼名字？

string.ID: What is your credo?

strings.string: 你的信條是什麼？

string.ID: Live and drink, quiet one.

strings.string: 活下去，盡情飲酒吧，沉默者。
啊。

string.ID: That's all you have to say?

strings.string: 你就只想說這些？
怎麼了？

string.ID: I barely survived and all you can say is 'ah' and 'yes'?

strings.string: 我好不容易才活下來，而你只會說「啊」和「是」嗎？

string.ID: Fair enough. Live and drink.

strings.string: 好吧。盡情生活與飲酒吧。

string.ID: {{emote|*Lebah curls into an armored ball and stops responding to your questions.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*萊巴 蜷縮成一個裝甲球，不再回應你的問題。*}}

string.ID: Lebah, do not ignore me.

strings.string: 萊巴，不要無視我。

string.ID: Fine. Live and drink.

strings.string: 好吧。活著並盡情享樂吧。
萊巴。

string.ID: What is your credo?

strings.string: 你的信條是什麼？

string.ID: Live and drink, Lebah.

strings.string: 活著並暢飲吧，萊巴。

string.ID: "An thou art swallowed by the Gyre, sing thee to the last."

strings.string: 「縱使汝被環流吞噬，亦當歌唱至最後。」

string.ID: What does that mean?

strings.string: 那是什麼意思？

string.ID: What is your name?

strings.string: 你叫什麼名字？

string.ID: The meaning is plain: An =ifplayerplural:ye are:thou'rt= swallowed by the Gyre, =ifplayerplural:ye should:thou shouldst= sing to the last.

strings.string: 意義很明顯：你被環流吞噬了，=ifplayerplural:你們應該:你應該=唱到最後。

string.ID: I don't understand.

strings.string: 我不明白。

string.ID: Can you explain further?

strings.string: 你能進一步解釋嗎？

string.ID: That was not so much an explanation as it was a rephrasing.

strings.string: 那與其說是解釋，不如說是一種換種說法。

string.ID: I... see. Live and drink.

strings.string: 我……明白了。活下去，盡情飲酒吧。

string.ID: {{emote|*Lebah stares at you wordlessly.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*萊巴（*萊巴 stares at you wordlessly.*}}

string.ID: I should go.

strings.string: 我該走了。

string.ID:
Ah,
aye.
a most repulsive device. The mind-echoes of that communion yet haunteth me.

strings.string:
啊，
是的。
一個極其令人厭惡的裝置。那次通訊產生的心靈回響至今仍在我腦中縈繞。

string.ID: What was so bad about the device?

strings.string: 那個裝置到底有什麼不對勁？

string.ID: I will trouble you no further, then.

strings.string: 那麼，我就不再打擾你了。

string.ID:
Not... the device. Repulsive as a key to a prison doth repulse. To know a key is to know of a prison.
Our watched children are bound, and lock swalloweth key. An =ifplayerplural:ye free:thou freest= one, three remaineth forever.
k-Goninon hath it now. An =ifplayerplural:ye seek:thou seekest=.

strings.string:
不……那是裝置。正如監獄之鑰令人厭惡一般，它也令人排斥。知曉鑰匙，便知曉了監獄的存在。
我們注視著的孩子們被束縛著，而鎖吞噬了鑰匙。=ifplayerplural:你們解脫了:你解脫了=一個，其餘三個將永遠留存。
K-高尼農現在擁有它。=ifplayerplural:你們在尋找:你在尋找=。

string.ID: Oh, do you mean this thing?

strings.string: 喔，你是說這東西嗎？

string.ID: I will seek to retrieve it, then.

strings.string: 那麼，我會試著把它取回來的。

string.ID: Who or what is k-Goninon?

strings.string: K-高尼農是誰，或是什麼？

string.ID:
An elder ooze. My communion so disturbed me that I allowed them too close.
k-Goninon consumed the device, but I escaped.

strings.string:
一位長者黏液。我的交流令我如此不安，以至於我讓他們靠得太近了。
K-高尼農 吞噬了裝置，但我逃脫了。

string.ID: I will seek to retrieve it, then.

strings.string: 那麼，我會試著把它取回來的。

string.ID: Tell me more about k-Goninon.

strings.string: 再多跟我說一點關於 K-高尼農 的事。

string.ID:
I concern myself little with oozes but to stay away.
Please, no more. I tire. Talk to Agyra.

strings.string:
我對黏液生物沒什麼興趣，只想遠離它們。
求你，別再說了。我累了。去跟阿吉拉談吧。

string.ID: I thank you.

strings.string: 我謝謝你。

string.ID:
k-Goninon hath it.
Ask Agyra.

strings.string:
K-高尼農 拿走了它。
詢問 阿吉拉。

string.ID: Of course. k-Goninon.

strings.string: 當然。K-高尼農。

string.ID: {{emote|*Lebah nods to you, slowly curls into an armored ball, and speaks no further*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*萊巴向您點頭，緩慢地蜷縮成一個裝甲球，不再多說話*}}

string.ID: Live and drink, little seer.

strings.string: 活下去並盡情飲酒吧，小先知。

string.ID: {{emote|*Lebah yelps at the sight of the device, curling into an armored ball.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*萊巴看到這裝置時發出尖叫，蜷縮成一個裝甲球。*}}
萊巴？

string.ID: Maybe I'll take this somewhere else.

strings.string: 也許我該把這個帶到別處去。

string.ID: {{emote|*you receive no reply*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*你沒有得到任何回應*}}

string.ID: Let's trade. {{g|[begin trade]}}

strings.string: 來交易吧。{{g|[開始交易]}}

string.ID: What is your name?

strings.string: 你叫什麼名字？

string.ID: What is your name, =pronouns.formalAddressTerm=?

strings.string: 請問您的尊姓大名，=pronouns.formalAddressTerm=?

string.ID: What may I call you, =pronouns.formalAddressTerm=?

strings.string: 請問該如何稱呼您，=pronouns.formalAddressTerm=？

string.ID: What are you called, =pronouns.formalAddressTerm=?

strings.string: 您的稱謂是，=pronouns.formalAddressTerm=？

string.ID: I am =name=, =pronouns.formalAddressTerm=. What is your name?

strings.string: 我是 =name=， =pronouns.formalAddressTerm=。請問您的名字是？

string.ID: I am =name=, =pronouns.formalAddressTerm=. What may I call you?

strings.string: 我是 =name=，您的 =pronouns.formalAddressTerm=。請問該如何稱呼您？

string.ID: You may call me =subject.refname=.

strings.string: 你可以稱呼我為 =subject.refname=。

string.ID: My name is =subject.refname=.

strings.string: 我的名字是 =subject.refname=。

string.ID: I am called =subject.refname=.

strings.string: 我的名字是 =subject.refname=。

string.ID: They call me =subject.refname=.

strings.string: 他們稱呼我為 =subject.refname=。

string.ID: Thank you, =pronouns.formalAddressTerm=.

strings.string: 謝謝您，=pronouns.formalAddressTerm=。

string.ID: My thanks, =pronouns.formalAddressTerm=.

strings.string: 多謝，=pronouns.formalAddressTerm=。

string.ID: Pleased to meet you, =pronouns.formalAddressTerm=.

strings.string: 很高興見到您，=pronouns.formalAddressTerm=。

string.ID:
I'm so excited.
Many thanks for releasing Nacham, =factionaddress:Mopango=. I believe that its presence here will provide a great mutual boon.

strings.string:
我好興奮。
非常感謝你發布了 Nacham，=factionaddress:莫龐戈(Mopango)=。我相信它的出現將會帶來巨大的互惠利益。

string.ID: You're welcome. Live and drink.

strings.string: 不客氣。活著，並盡情飲酒。

string.ID: =factionaddress:Mopango|capitalize=, I hear that =ifplayerplural:ye have:thou hast= freed one of the children! I cannot wait to speak to it, but for now I must observe Nacham to see if this event hath affected it. =ifplayerplural:Ye are:Thou art= welcome to watch too.

strings.string: =factionaddress:莫龐戈(Mopango)|capitalize=，我聽說 =ifplayerplural:你們：你= 釋放了一名孩子！我迫不及待想與它交談，但現在我必須觀察 Nacham 以查看此事件是否影響了它。 =ifplayerplural:你們也歡迎：你也歡迎= 一同觀看。

string.ID: Live and drink, Doyoba.

strings.string: 活著與飲酒，多約帕(Joppa)。

string.ID: Welcome, =factionaddress:Mopango=. Live and drink. =ifplayerplural:Need ye:Needest thou= a place to rest and sup? =ifplayerplural:Would ye:Wouldst= trade?

strings.string: 歡迎，=factionaddress:莫龐戈(Mopango)=。活著並飲酒吧。=ifplayerplural:需要嗎：汝是否需要=一個休息與用餐的地方？=ifplayerplural:要交易嗎：汝是否願意=交易？

string.ID: I seek a use for this repulsive device.

strings.string: 我在尋找這個令人厭惡的裝置的用途。

string.ID: I am =name=. Who are you?

strings.string: 我是 =name=。你是誰？

string.ID: Why are you here?

strings.string: 你為什麼在這裡？

string.ID: Have you a credo?

strings.string: 你有信條嗎？

string.ID: Live and drink, watcher.

strings.string: 活著並盡情飲酒吧，觀察者。

string.ID: I am Doyoba, proud watcher of the children of the tomb. One child in particular. Of course =ifplayerplural:ye:thou= must comprehend, 'child' is but a fabricated epithet, as they are far older than we. The children are, that is.

strings.string: 我是 Doyoba，是墳墓之子的驕傲守望者。特別是其中一名孩子。當然，=ifplayerplural:ye:thou= 必須明白，「孩子」不過是一個虛構的稱號，因為他們比我們年長得多。我是指那些「孩子」。

string.ID: Live and drink, watcher.

strings.string: 活著並盡情飲酒吧，觀察者。

string.ID: We mopango watch the past, each of us a different facet. My charge is named Nacham, that which watcheth and understandeth not, that which speaketh and cannot be understood. Information floweth through Nacham as water through a sieve, mixed together beyond ken.

strings.string: 我們 莫龐戈(Mopango) 觀察過去，我們每個人都是不同的面向。我的職責名為 納查姆，即那觀望卻不理解之物，即那言說卻無法被理解之物。資訊如同水流過篩網般流經 納查姆，混合在一起，超出了認知範圍。

string.ID: Live and drink, watcher.

strings.string: 活著並盡情飲酒吧，觀察者。

string.ID:
I do.
"Suffering breedeth in still water."

strings.string:
我有。
「苦難滋生於靜水之中。」

string.ID: What does that mean?

strings.string: 那是什麼意思？

string.ID: Live and drink, watcher.

strings.string: 活著並盡情飲酒吧，觀察者。

string.ID:
...?
=ifplayerplural:Ye ask:Thou askest= after the meaning of my credo. Wouldst I shall chew =ifplayerplural:your:thy= food for =ifplayerplural:ye:thee= as well?

strings.string:
...?
