=ifplayerplural:你問：你問著= 我信條的含義。難道我也要為了 =ifplayerplural:ye:thee= 而咀嚼 =ifplayerplural:your:thy= 食物嗎？

string.ID: I apologize for my rudeness.

strings.string: 我很抱歉如此無禮。

string.ID: I am leaving.

strings.string: 我要離開了。

string.ID: No, no, =ifplayerplural:ye know:thou knowest= not our ways and I was too harsh. I apologize, and I am not wroth with =ifplayerplural:ye:thee=.

strings.string: 不，不，=ifplayerplural:ye know:thou knowest=並不了解我們的習俗，是我太過嚴厲了。我向您道歉，我也並未對=ifplayerplural:ye:thee=懷恨在心。

string.ID: Live and drink, watcher.

strings.string: 活著並盡情飲酒吧，觀察者。

string.ID: By Her Light, it's ghastly. May I touch it?

strings.string: 願聖光庇佑，這太可怕了。我可以觸摸它嗎？

string.ID: You may.

strings.string: 你可以。

string.ID: You may not.

strings.string: 你不能這樣。

string.ID:
Oh.
Well then, I suppose I have no insight for =ifplayerplural:ye:thee=.

strings.string:
喔。
好吧，我想我對 =ifplayerplural:ye:thee= 並無任何見解。

string.ID: Live and drink, watcher.

strings.string: 活著並盡情飲酒吧，觀察者。

string.ID:
{{emote|*Doyoba's face scrunches in pain as ey communes with the device, before finally pushing it back into your grasp*}}
By her light, that was unpleasant. How it twisted and turned, leading me to visions of Nacham's past, scraps and flashes. I can discern only glimpses of significance. Once a creator, an innovator. Can these parts of itself return intact, under the device's influence? An thou sendest void away, hast thou lost a part of thee?

strings.string:
{{emote|*多約帕(Joppa)的臉因痛苦而扭曲，她在與裝置溝通後，終於將其推回你的手中*}}
藉著她的光，那真是不愉快。它如何扭轉旋轉，帶領我看到 納查姆 的過去、碎片與閃現。我只能辨識出一些有意義的片段。曾經是一位創造者，一位創新者。在裝置的影響下，這些自我的一部分能完好無損地歸來嗎？若你將虛空遣走，是否也失去了你自己的一部分？

string.ID: Perhaps we will find out. Live and drink.

strings.string: 或許我們會發現。盡情生活，盡情飲酒吧。

string.ID:
Va'am is released. =ifplayerplural:Ye have:Thou hast= done something great, for good or ill.
I thank =ifplayerplural:ye:thee= for this new future.

strings.string:
Va'am 已被釋放。=ifplayerplural:汝已:你已=成就了某件偉大的事，無論好壞。
我感謝 =ifplayerplural:ye:thee= 給予這全新的未來。

string.ID: You're welcome. Live and drink.

strings.string: 不客氣。活著，並盡情飲酒。

string.ID: =factionaddress:Mopango|capitalize=. =ifplayerplural:Ye did:Thou didst= rouse a child. Well done.

strings.string: =factionaddress:莫龐戈(Mopango)|capitalize=. =ifplayerplural:你：你＝Thou didst= 喚醒了一名孩童。做得好。

string.ID: Thank you. Live and drink, Dadogom.

strings.string: 謝謝你。活下去，盡情飲酒吧，達多戈姆。

string.ID: I seek a use for this repulsive device.

strings.string: 我在尋找這個令人厭惡的裝置的用途。

string.ID: I am =name=. Who are you?

strings.string: 我是 =name=。你是誰？

string.ID: Why are you here?

strings.string: 你為什麼在這裡？

string.ID: Have you a credo?

strings.string: 你有信條嗎？

string.ID: Live and drink, watcher.

strings.string: 活著並盡情飲酒吧，觀察者。

string.ID: I am Dadogom.

strings.string: 我是 達多戈姆。

string.ID: Live and drink, watcher.

strings.string: 活著並盡情飲酒吧，觀察者。

string.ID:
I watch over Va'am. It watcheth over me. Together, we watch.
=ifplayerplural:Ye should:Thou shouldst= as well, =factionaddress:Mopango=. Sit. Watch. Consider how =ifplayerplural:ye would:thou wouldst= fare under a dome of adamant carapace.
Safe, undying, alone.

strings.string:
我守護著 Va'am。祂也守護著我。我們一同守望。
=ifplayerplural:汝應：你應=同樣如此，=factionaddress:莫龐戈(Mopango)=。坐下。觀察。思考 =ifplayerplural:汝若：你若=處於一層由金剛甲殼構成的穹頂之下，會如何生存。
安全、永生、孤獨。

string.ID: Live and drink, watcher.

strings.string: 活著並盡情飲酒吧，觀察者。

string.ID: "Be still and know."

strings.string: 「靜心，並知曉。」

string.ID: What does that mean?

strings.string: 那是什麼意思？

string.ID: Live and drink, watcher.

strings.string: 活著並盡情飲酒吧，觀察者。

string.ID: I cannot think on =ifplayerplural:your:thy= behalf.

strings.string: 我無法代=ifplayerplural:your:thy= 思考。

string.ID: I apologize for my rudeness.

strings.string: 我很抱歉如此無禮。

string.ID: Very well.

strings.string: 很好。

string.ID: Consider =ifplayerplural:your:thy= words ere =ifplayerplural:ye say:thou sayest= them, and =ifplayerplural:ye will:thou wilt= issue fewer apologies.

strings.string: 謹記 =ifplayerplural:your:thy= 言行，在 =ifplayerplural:ye say:thou sayest= 之前先三思，如此 =ifplayerplural:ye will:thou wilt= 能減少道歉的次數。

string.ID: Live and drink, watcher.

strings.string: 活著並盡情飲酒吧，觀察者。

string.ID: Ah. May I?

strings.string: 啊。我可以嗎？

string.ID: You may.

strings.string: 你可以。

string.ID: You may not.

strings.string: 你不能這樣。

string.ID: Ah, pity.

strings.string: 啊，真可惜。

string.ID: Live and drink, watcher.

strings.string: 活著並盡情飲酒吧，觀察者。

string.ID: Perhaps we will find out. Live and drink.

strings.string: 或許我們會發現。盡情生活，盡情飲酒吧。

string.ID:
I hope =ifplayerplural:ye are:thou art= confident in =ifplayerplural:your:thy= choice, =factionaddress:Mopango=. I am happy with it, to be sure.
Kah is free. It heals my heart to see it at rest. =ifplayerplural:Ye have:Thou hast= my thanks.

strings.string:
我希望 =ifplayerplural:你們:你=對 =ifplayerplural:your:thy= 的選擇感到自信，=factionaddress:莫龐戈(Mopango)=。我很滿意這個結果，這點毋庸置疑。
Kah 已獲得自由。看到它安息，我的心也得到了慰藉。 =ifplayerplural:你們:你=的謝意。

string.ID: You're welcome, Gyamyo. Live and drink.

strings.string: 不客氣，吉亞莫。活著，盡情飲酒吧。

string.ID:
=ifplayerplural:Did ye:Didst thou= truly free one of the children? I see =ifplayerplural:ye did:thou didst=. Congratulations.
Wouldst fain see Kah free, one day. I shall have to live a while and find a way.

strings.string:
=ifplayerplural:Did ye:Didst thou= 真的釋放了其中一個孩子嗎？我看到 =ifplayerplural:ye did:thou didst=。恭喜你。
希望能有一天看到 卡德(Qud) 獲得自由。我必須活下去，並找到那條路。

string.ID: Live and drink, Gyamyo.

strings.string: 活著與飲酒，吉亞莫。

string.ID: =factionaddress:Mopango|capitalize=, welcome. =ifplayerplural:Ye have:Thou hast= done well to survive so long in this peculiar place.

strings.string: =factionaddress:莫龐戈(Mopango)|capitalize=，歡迎。=ifplayerplural:你們：你= 在這個奇特的地方生存了這麼久，做得很好。

string.ID: I seek a use for this repulsive device.

strings.string: 我在尋找這個令人厭惡的裝置的用途。

string.ID: I am =name=. Who are you?

strings.string: 我是 =name=。你是誰？

string.ID: Why are you here?

strings.string: 你為什麼在這裡？

string.ID: Have you a credo?

strings.string: 你有信條嗎？

string.ID: Live and drink, watcher.

strings.string: 活著並盡情飲酒吧，觀察者。

string.ID:
My name is Gyamyo. I am pleased to meet =ifplayerplural:ye:thee=, =name=. =ifplayerplural:Have ye:Hast thou= spoken to the other watchers? How fare they?
Well, I hope.

strings.string:
我的名字是 Gyamyo。很高興見到 =ifplayerplural:ye:thee=、=name=。=ifplayerplural:你是否已經:你是否已經=與其他的觀察者交談過了？他們過得如何？
嗯，我希望如此。

string.ID: Live and drink, watcher.

strings.string: 活著並盡情飲酒吧，觀察者。

string.ID:
I have volunteered to monitor an ancient machine-creature called Kah. Perhaps =ifplayerplural:ye have:thou hast= seen it, skipping hither and yon on strange limbs.
Often I wonder if Kah knoweth aught else but fear.

strings.string:
我自願監測一個名為「卡」的古代機械生物。或許 =ifplayerplural:你們也曾:你曾=見過它，用奇異的肢體在那裡跳來跳去。
我常在想，「卡」除了恐懼之外，是否還懂得其他任何事物。

string.ID: Live and drink, watcher.

strings.string: 活著並盡情飲酒吧，觀察者。

string.ID:
I do, and I thank =ifplayerplural:ye:thee= for asking after it.
My credo is "Reconciliation without understanding is a salt poultice."

strings.string:
我確實有，也感謝 =ifplayerplural:ye:thee= 詢問此事。
我的信條是：「沒有理解的調解，不過是撒在傷口上的鹽敷劑。」

string.ID: What does that mean?

strings.string: 那是什麼意思？

string.ID: Live and drink, watcher.

strings.string: 活著並盡情飲酒吧，觀察者。

string.ID:
Oh dear.
This is the credo by which I live my life, and =ifplayerplural:ye ask:thou asketh= "what does that mean?"
I cannot summarize such a thing for =ifplayerplural:ye:thee=. It is too great, too multifaceted.

strings.string:
噢，天哪。
這是我奉行的信條，而 =ifplayerplural:ye ask:thou asketh= 「那是什麽意思？」
我無法為 =ifplayerplural:ye:thee= 總結這樣的事情。它太過宏大，且多面向。

string.ID: I apologize for my rudeness.

strings.string: 我很抱歉如此無禮。

string.ID: I am leaving.

strings.string: 我要離開了。

string.ID: May the future bear out =ifplayerplural:your:thy= promises.

strings.string: 願未來能證實 =ifplayerplural:your:thy= 的承諾。

string.ID: Live and drink, watcher.

strings.string: 活著並盡情飲酒吧，觀察者。

string.ID:
=ifplayerplural:Ye have:Thou hast= an object of great interest.
An =ifplayerplural:ye would:thou wouldst= allow, I'd fain commune with it.

strings.string:
=ifplayerplural:Ye have:Thou hast= 一件極具吸引力的物品。
若 =ifplayerplural:ye would:thou wouldst= 允許，我希望能與之交流。

string.ID: I wouldst.

strings.string: 我願。

string.ID: I wouldstn't.

strings.string: 我才不要。

string.ID: Hm. I wonder at =ifplayerplural:your:thy= decision.

strings.string: 嗯。我很好奇 =ifplayerplural:your:thy= 的決定。

string.ID: Live and drink, watcher.

strings.string: 活著並盡情飲酒吧，觀察者。

string.ID:
{{emote|*Gyamyo moves little during communion, but shivers and twitches from time to time. After a minute or so, ey returns the device to you.*}}
I am shaken. No doubt my journey wast shallow compared to Lebah's dive. But now, by my troth I say: Kah hath ever been a being of motion. Swift, kinetic, and elegant. No doubt 'twould be so if freed by yon device.

strings.string:
{{emote|*吉亞莫在交流期間動作很小，但偶爾會顫抖和抽搐。大約一分鐘後，他將裝置還給你。*}}
我深受震撼。毫無疑問，與萊巴的潛入相比，我的旅程顯得淺薄。但現在，我誠實地說：卡一直是一個充滿動態的存在。迅捷、動能十足且優雅。如果能被那台裝置釋放，想必也會如此。

string.ID: We'll see. Live and drink.

strings.string: 我們走著瞧吧。活下去，盡情飲酒。

string.ID:
=factionaddress:Mopango|capitalize=, =ifplayerplural:ye have:thou hast= done a momentous thing.
I feel the stored energy of Her Light. Dagasha shall shepherd us to our uplifting. =ifplayerplural:Ye should:Thou shouldst= be proud.

strings.string:
=factionaddress:莫龐戈(Mopango)|capitalize=，=ifplayerplural:你已經:你已=完成了一件重大的事。
我感受到了祂之光（Her Light）所蘊含的能量。達加沙（Dagasha）將引領我們走向昇華。=ifplayerplural:你應該:你應當=感到自豪。

string.ID: Thank you, Yona. Live and drink.

strings.string: 謝謝你，約納。活下去，盡情飲酒吧。

string.ID:
Ah, =factionaddress:Mopango=, =ifplayerplural:ye are:thou'rt= a bittersweet sight. Would fain =ifplayerplural:ye had:thou hadst= chosen Dagasha, but my Light shineth elsewhere.
Still, I hope to see more of =ifplayerplural:ye:thee= in my future. =ifplayerplural:Ye are:Thou'rt= welcome back, an =ifplayerplural:ye survive:thou surviveth=.

strings.string:
啊，=factionaddress:莫龐戈(Mopango)=，=ifplayerplural:汝等:你=真是一副苦樂參半的景象。我本希望能由=ifplayerplural:汝等:你們=選擇 Dagasha，但我的光芒照向了別處。
儘管如此，我仍希望在未來能見到更多 =ifplayerplural:ye:thee= 的身影。=ifplayerplural:汝等:你=歡迎回來，只要=ifplayerplural:汝等得以生存:你還生存著=。

string.ID: Live and drink, Yona.

strings.string: 盡情生活與飲酒吧，約納。

string.ID: What have we here? Approach, =player.formalAddressTerm=, and be known.

strings.string: 這是什麼？靠近點，=player.formalAddressTerm=，讓我也認得你。

string.ID: I seek a use for this repulsive device.

strings.string: 我在尋找這個令人厭惡的裝置的用途。

string.ID: I am =name=. Who are you?

strings.string: 我是 =name=。你是誰？

string.ID: Why are you here?

strings.string: 你為什麼在這裡？

string.ID: Have you a credo?

strings.string: 你有信條嗎？

string.ID: Live and drink, watcher.

strings.string: 活著並盡情飲酒吧，觀察者。

string.ID: =name=. Greetings. I am called Yona. =ifplayerplural:Ye seem:Thou seemest= unlike most other climbers. I wonder why.

strings.string: =name=. 問候。我被稱為 約納。=ifplayerplural:你們似乎:你似乎=與大多數攀爬者不同。我很好奇是為什麼。

string.ID: Live and drink, watcher.

strings.string: 活著並盡情飲酒吧，觀察者。

string.ID:
=ifplayerplural:Have ye:Hast thou= seen it, out there? The spiny, eel-like creature. That is Dagasha, angry one, lost child. =ifplayerplural:Ye can:Thou canst= feel the hostility pour from it in waves.
Yet, it attacketh not.

strings.string:
=ifplayerplural:你們是否:你是否=在外面看見了它？那種長滿刺、像鰻魚般的生物。那是達加沙，憤怒者，迷途的孩子。=ifplayerplural:你們可以:你可以=感受到敵意如波浪般從它身上湧出。
然而，它並未發動攻擊。

string.ID: Live and drink, watcher.

strings.string: 活著並盡情飲酒吧，觀察者。

string.ID: Yes. "Anyone may strike a slumberling once."

strings.string: 是的。「任何人都可以打擊一名酣睡者一次。」

string.ID: What does that mean?

strings.string: 那是什麼意思？

string.ID: Live and drink, watcher.

strings.string: 活著並盡情飲酒吧，觀察者。

string.ID: Only a fool asketh after the meaning of a credo.

strings.string: 唯有愚者才會追問信條的意義。

string.ID: I apologize for my rudeness.

strings.string: 我很抱歉如此無禮。

string.ID: I am leaving.

strings.string: 我要離開了。

string.ID: I am not offended, simply making =ifplayerplural:ye:thee= aware of =ifplayerplural:your:thy= foolishness.

strings.string: 我並非感到冒犯，只是在讓 =ifplayerplural:ye:thee= 意識到 =ifplayerplural:your:thy= 的愚蠢行為。

string.ID: Live and drink, watcher.

strings.string: 活著並盡情飲酒吧，觀察者。

string.ID:
I am consumed by curiosity. How it resembleth the children in make!
May I hold the device in communion?

strings.string:
我被好奇心所吞噬。它的外貌竟如此神似那些孩子！
我可以為了感應而持有這台裝置嗎？

string.ID: You may.

strings.string: 你可以。

string.ID: You may not.

strings.string: 你不能這樣。

string.ID:
Ahh.
Stranger, =ifplayerplural:ye are:thou art= cruel to withhold this experience, but I shall abide.

strings.string:
啊。
陌生人，=ifplayerplural:你們=很殘忍，竟然隱瞞這種體驗，但我會遵守的。

string.ID: Live and drink, watcher.

strings.string: 活著並盡情飲酒吧，觀察者。

string.ID: We'll see. Live and drink.

strings.string: 我們走著瞧吧。活下去，盡情飲酒。

string.ID: Learn well, =factionaddress:Mopango=. I would fain see =ifplayerplural:ye:thee= succeed in =ifplayerplural:your:thine= task.

strings.string: =factionaddress:莫龐戈(Mopango)=，好好學習。我願見=ifplayerplural:ye:thee= 在=ifplayerplural:your:thine= 任務中成功。

string.ID: Live and learn, Nacham.

strings.string: 活著與學習，納查姆。

string.ID: {{emote|*Every surface of the strange entity vibrates with the sound of a hundred dry lectures by long-dead scholars, teaching a volume of knowledge so dense and overlapping that the end result is incomprehensible.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*這個奇異實體的每個表面都隨著數百場早已故去的學者所進行的枯燥講座而震動，那些知識量如此密集且重疊，導致最終呈現出的內容完全無法理解。*}}

string.ID: I offer you this repulsive device, unique one.

strings.string: 我將這件令人厭惡的裝置獻給你，獨一無二的存在。

string.ID: Live and... do as you please.

strings.string: 活下去... 隨你高興吧。

string.ID: {{emote|*Swimming in sound, Nacham stares at you and looks away simultaneously, giving no indication of understanding.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*在聲音中游弋，納查姆（納查姆）同時盯著你又移開視線，完全看不出是否理解你的意思。*}}

string.ID: Here. Take it.

strings.string: 拿去吧。

string.ID: I am not yet ready. I may return.

strings.string: 我還沒準備好。我也許會再回來。

string.ID: Are you all right?

strings.string: 你還好嗎？

string.ID:
Yes. =ifplayerplural:Ye have:Thou hast= quelled the mania.
I can focus. I can render sensible the things I have seen and heard now, though I remember little of my time before the mania. Was I artisan? Teacher? I possessed great knowledge that this shell twisted into a prison. I thank =ifplayerplural:ye:thee= for the gift of =ifplayerplural:your:thy= untwisting.

strings.string:
是的。=ifplayerplural:你擁有：你已=平息了狂躁。
我可以集中精神。我現在能將所見所聞理出頭緒，儘管我對狂躁之前的時光記憶寥寥。我是工匠嗎？老師嗎？我曾擁有博大的知識，而這具軀殼卻將其扭曲成了牢籠。我感謝 =ifplayerplural:ye:thee= 賜予我 =ifplayerplural:your:thy= 的解脫之禮。

string.ID: What will you do now?

strings.string: 你現在打算做什麼？

string.ID:
The mopango have cared for me whilst I could not care for myself, giving me the only name I now know. I will stay to help them. This chassis is a prison no longer, and perhaps deeper truths may yet be found within it.
To =ifplayerplural:ye:thee=, new friend, I offer a piece of this former prison that =ifplayerplural:ye may:thou mayest= find useful, along with my thanks.

strings.string:
當我無法自理時，莫潘戈人（mopango）一直照料著我，並賦予了我現在唯一所知的名字。我會留下來幫助他們。這具機殼不再是牢籠，或許其中仍能發現更深層的真相。
致 =ifplayerplural:ye:thee=，新朋友，我獻上這件昔日牢籠的碎片作為謝禮，=ifplayerplural:ye may:thou mayest=會發現它很有用。

string.ID: Live and remain free, Nacham.

strings.string: 活下去並保持自由，納查姆。

string.ID: Live and remain free, Nacham.

strings.string: 活下去並保持自由，納查姆。

string.ID: Take care, =factionaddress:Mopango=. Let not complacency end =ifplayerplural:ye:thee=, and I shall anticipate further news of =ifplayerplural:your:thy= exploits.

strings.string: 保重，=factionaddress:莫龐戈(Mopango)=。別讓自滿斷送=ifplayerplural:ye:thee=，我期待著=ifplayerplural:your:thy= 進一步的消息。

string.ID: Live and lead, Dagasha.

strings.string: 活著與領導，達加沙。

string.ID: {{emote|*The jagged, serpentine entity stares you down, twitching with feigned half-strikes in your direction as if goading an aggressive response from you. Though it has no mouth, it is not silent: piercing the air is a strange, external tinnitus, the whine of an ancient viewscreen.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*那鋸齒狀、蛇形的實體正盯著你，朝你的方向做著虛假的半擊動作，彷彿在挑釁你做出激進的回應。雖然它沒有嘴巴，但它並不沉默：刺穿空氣的是一種奇怪的外源性耳鳴，那是古老顯示屏發出的嗡鳴聲。*}}

string.ID: I offer you this repulsive device, unique one.

strings.string: 我將這件令人厭惡的裝置獻給你，獨一無二的存在。

string.ID: Live and... do as you please.

strings.string: 活下去... 隨你高興吧。

string.ID: {{emote|*Dagasha tilts its head, staring you down. It twitches, but makes no move to strike as you approach.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*達加沙 歪著頭，盯著你。當你靠近時，它抽動了一下，但沒有做出攻擊的動作。*}}

string.ID: Here. Take it.

strings.string: 拿去吧。

string.ID: I am not yet ready. I may return.

strings.string: 我還沒準備好。我也許會再回來。

string.ID: Are you all right?

strings.string: 你還好嗎？

string.ID:
Though I be a pale shadow of the self I once was, yes. My condition and outlook are both substantially improved.
I recall few details of my life before. I was influential, one whose words stirred hearts to action. For so long I had no means to speak, trapped in my own moods. =ifplayerplural:Ye have:Thou hast= freed me from a dire fate.

strings.string:
雖然我已成了昔日自我的蒼白殘影，是的。我的狀況與心境都已大幅改善。
我不記得太多過往的細節。我曾很有影響力，說話能激勵人心付諸行動。長久以來，我因受困於自己的情緒而無法發聲。=ifplayerplural:你們：你=將我從厄運中解救了出來。

string.ID: What will you do now?

strings.string: 你現在打算做什麼？

string.ID:
I know not. Perhaps I can lead again. These creatures that looked after me, named me, kept me safe. The mopango.
They are kind, but weak. Perhaps I can teach them. Spur them to be greater.
But for =ifplayerplural:ye:thee=, I must even our score. Take this piece of my chassis. Wear it with confidence. Command in my name.

strings.string:
我亦不知。或許我可以再次領導。這些照顧我、為我命名、保護我的生物。那些莫潘戈（mopango）。
他們很善良，但很弱小。或許我可以教導他們。激勵他們變得更強大。
但為了 =ifplayerplural:ye:thee=，我必須抵銷我們的恩怨。拿走這塊我的機殼零件。帶著自信佩戴它。以我的名義進行指揮。

string.ID: Live and remain free, Dagasha.

strings.string: 活下去並保持自由，達加沙。

string.ID: Live and remain free, Dagasha.

strings.string: 活下去並保持自由，達加沙。

string.ID: Stay safe.

strings.string: 保重。

string.ID: Live and remain stalwart, Va'am.

strings.string: 活下去並保持堅毅，瓦姆。

string.ID: {{emote|*The hardened shell-thing traces a path around you slowly, its strange brush-feet scrabbling at the floor, a pace unaffected by your presence and movement. Behind the hissing of those feet on the ground is the strains of a faint voice, someone speaking from inside a distant cave. Audible, but not understandable.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*那堅硬的外殼生物緩慢地在你周圍繞行，它奇特的刷狀足部在地面上抓撓著，其步調並未受你的存在或動作影響。在那些腳步摩擦地面的嘶嘶聲背後，傳來了一陣微弱的聲音，有人正從遠處洞穴的內部說話。聽得見，但無法理解內容。*}}

string.ID: I offer you this repulsive device, unique one.

strings.string: 我將這件令人厭惡的裝置獻給你，獨一無二的存在。

string.ID: Live and... do as you please.

strings.string: 活下去... 隨你高興吧。

string.ID: {{emote|*Vaam seems oblivious to your words, but does slow its patrol as it nears you.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*Vaam 似乎對你的話毫不在意，但在靠近你時放慢了巡邏速度。*}}

string.ID: Here. Take it.

strings.string: 拿去吧。

string.ID: I am not yet ready. I may return.

strings.string: 我還沒準備好。我也許會再回來。

string.ID: Are you all right?

strings.string: 你還好嗎？

string.ID:
Yes. I thank =ifplayerplural:ye:thee=.
=ifplayerplural:Ye have:Thou hast= freed me from a deep stupor. Once I was a protector, before being sentenced to protect nothing and no one.
I remember little of that time.

strings.string:
是的。我感謝 =ifplayerplural:ye:thee=。
=ifplayerplural:你擁有:你已=將我從深沉的昏睡中解救出來。我曾是一名守護者，直到被判處守護虛無與無人。
我對那段時光已幾乎不復記憶。

string.ID: What will you do now?

strings.string: 你現在打算做什麼？

string.ID:
I have yet to find my purpose. I can think and speak, and so this shell is nearly comfortable.
One piece, however, doth yet chafe me. =ifplayerplural:Would ye:Wouldst thou= take it? Perhaps =ifplayerplural:ye can:thou canst= grant it some use.

strings.string:
我尚未找到我的使命。我能思考與言語，因此這具軀殼近乎舒適。
然而，有一件東西仍讓我感到不適。=ifplayerplural:你願意:你是否願意=接手它嗎？或許 =ifplayerplural:你可以:你能=賦予它些用途。

string.ID: Live and remain free, Va'am.

strings.string: 活下去並保持自由，瓦姆。

string.ID: Live and remain free, Va'am.

strings.string: 活下去並保持自由，瓦姆。

string.ID: =ifplayerplural:May ye:Mayst thou= loose the bonds that keep =ifplayerplural:ye:thee= from =ifplayerplural:your:thy= goals, =factionaddress:Mopango=. Be free.

strings.string: =ifplayerplural:願你：願汝=解開束縛 =ifplayerplural:ye:thee= 追求 =ifplayerplural:your:thy= 目標的枷鎖，=factionaddress:莫龐戈(Mopango)=。獲得自由吧。

string.ID: Live and be free, Kah.

strings.string: 活著並獲得自由吧，卡。

string.ID: {{emote|*The creature-silhouette lacks any means to make sound, save for the pointed tips of its six flexible legs. These tap against the ground like a sparse but heavy rainfall on a scrap metal roof as the strange pseudo-beast skitters away from predicted or perceived threats.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*那生物的輪廓缺乏任何發聲手段，除了它六條柔軟腿部的尖端。當這隻奇特的偽獸從預期或察覺到的威脅中竄逃時，這些尖端敲擊地面的聲音，就像稀疏但沉重的雨滴落在廢鐵屋頂上一般。*}}

string.ID: I offer you this repulsive device, unique one.

strings.string: 我將這件令人厭惡的裝置獻給你，獨一無二的存在。

string.ID: Live and... do as you please.

strings.string: 活下去... 隨你高興吧。

string.ID: {{emote|*Kah skitters away, but soon returns, and skitters away a shorter distance. Whether because of your words or because you are still, its desire for flight ebbs over the course of a minute until its escape attempts halt.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*卡 竄逃開去，但很快又回來了，接著竄逃的距離變短。無論是因為你的話語還是因為你保持靜止，牠想要逃跑的慾望在幾分鐘內逐漸消退，直到其逃跑嘗試停止。*}}

string.ID: Here. Take it.

strings.string: 拿去吧。

string.ID: I am not yet ready. I may return.

strings.string: 我還沒準備好。我也許會再回來。

string.ID: Are you all right?

strings.string: 你還好嗎？

string.ID:
I am weary to my core, but at last this once-hateful body obeyeth me. I thank =ifplayerplural:ye:thee= for restoring my autonomy.
Memory of my once-self doth elude me, but I recognize the irony of my punishment. Once a strider, then sentenced to stride without restraint, forever. I knew only fear and flight. No more.

strings.string:
我感到徹骨的疲憊，但這具曾經令我憎恨的軀體終於聽從我的意志。我感謝 =ifplayerplural:ye:thee= 恢復了我的自主權。
關於過去自我的記憶已漸行漸遠，但我能感受到這懲罰中的諷刺。曾是個漫步者，隨後卻被判處永無止境地漫步。我曾只知恐懼與逃亡。但現在不再如此。

string.ID: What will you do now?

strings.string: 你現在打算做什麼？

string.ID:
I shall enjoy my free mobility freely, for a time. After that, I know not. I may speak to these mopango creatures that named me, and find a purpose with them. I cannot ever repay their care, but perhaps I may repay =ifplayerplural:yours:thine=.
I wouldst fain offer =ifplayerplural:ye:thee= a fragment of this form come loose. =ifplayerplural:May ye:Mayst thou= ever run free.

strings.string:
我將在一段時間內盡情享受自由移動。在那之後，我不得而知。我也許會與那些命名我的 莫龐戈(Mopango) 生物交談，並與他們一起尋找目標。我永遠無法報答他們的照顧，但或許我可以報答 =ifplayerplural:yours:thine=。
我願將這形體脫落的一塊碎片贈予 =ifplayerplural:ye:thee=。 =ifplayerplural:May ye:Mayst thou= 能永遠自由奔跑。

string.ID: Live and remain free, Kah.

strings.string: 活下去並保持自由，卡。

string.ID: Live and remain free, Kah.

strings.string: 活下去並保持自由，卡。

string.ID: Saad, welcom. Saad, from thyn heres shaken the wet and olde lif. Saad, in-to a smal vessel pouren hit. Saad, to thyn sash attachen the vessel. Saad, crossen nou thrugh the heigh gate and in-to Brightsheol.

strings.string: Saad，歡迎。 Saad，從你那搖 顫抖的 的濕冷舊生活中脫離。 Saad，將其倒入小小的容器中。 Saad，將容器繫於你的腰帶上。 Saad，現在穿過高門進入布萊特希歐。

string.ID: Where is Brightsheol in relation to Qud... to Salum?

strings.string: 布萊特希歐相對於卡德... 相對於薩倫（Salum）的位置在哪裡？

string.ID: Am I dead?

strings.string: 我死了嗎？

string.ID: What is this place?

strings.string: 這是什麼地方？

string.ID: Why do you call me Saad?

strings.string: 你為什麼叫我 Saad？

string.ID: I've come from the Thick World with a mission: to disable the Spindle's magnetic field. Can you do this for me?

strings.string: 我從厚實世界（Thick World）來到這裡，帶著一個任務：要解除 紡錘的 磁場。你能幫我完成這件事嗎？

string.ID: Saad, the bodi dien, but the mind romen.

strings.string: Saad，bodi dien，但 mind romen。

string.ID: What is this place?

strings.string: 這是什麼地方？

string.ID: Why do you call me Saad?

strings.string: 你為什麼叫我 Saad？

string.ID: I've come from the Thick World with a mission: to disable the Spindle's magnetic field. Can you do this for me?

strings.string: 我從厚實世界（Thick World）來到這裡，帶著一個任務：要解除 紡錘的 磁場。你能幫我完成這件事嗎？

string.ID: Saad, stonden thu at the heigh gate to Brightsheol. Saad, thyn heres been wet with olde lif. Saad, shaken thyn hed and cross in-to neue lif.

strings.string: Saad，你站在高聳的 通往亮希歐之門 前。 Saad，你的髮絲已被舊日生命浸濕。 Saad，搖動你的頭，跨入新生的生命。

string.ID: Is Resheph here?

strings.string: 雷舍夫（Resheph）在這裡嗎？

string.ID: Am I dead?

strings.string: 我死了嗎？

string.ID: Why do you call me Saad?

strings.string: 你為什麼叫我 Saad？

string.ID: I've come from the Thick World with a mission: to disable the Spindle's magnetic field. Can you do this for me?

strings.string: 我從厚實世界（Thick World）來到這裡，帶著一個任務：要解除 紡錘的 磁場。你能幫我完成這件事嗎？

string.ID: No Saad Resheph residen her.

strings.string: 這裡沒有薩德·雷舍夫的居民。

string.ID: Where is Brightsheol in relation to Qud... to Salum?

strings.string: 布萊特希歐相對於卡德... 相對於薩倫（Salum）的位置在哪裡？

strings.string: 我死了嗎？

strings.string: 我從厚實世界（Thick World）來到這裡，帶著一個任務：要解除 紡錘的 磁場。你能幫我完成這件事嗎？

string.ID: Alofte of Gjaus a cite twinklen. And ther the Seraph dremen. And Brightsheol is the drem.

strings.string: Gjaus 之上的微光閃爍。 而塞拉夫（Seraph）在夢中。 而 布萊特希歐 是那場夢。

string.ID: Am I dead?

strings.string: 我死了嗎？

string.ID: What is this place?

strings.string: 這是什麼地方？

strings.string: 你為什麼叫我 Saad？

strings.string: 我從厚實世界（Thick World）來到這裡，帶著一個任務：要解除 紡錘的 磁場。你能幫我完成這件事嗎？

string.ID: Artow a Saad of olde Salum, and nou stonden thu at the heigh gate to Brightsheol.

strings.string: Artow 是古老 Salum 的一名 Saad，而現在你正站在通往亮希歐之門的高處。

string.ID: Salum? Is that another name for Qud?

strings.string: Salum？那是卡德的另一個名字嗎？

string.ID: Am I dead?

strings.string: 我死了嗎？

string.ID: What is this place?

strings.string: 這是什麼地方？

strings.string: Saad，是的。

strings.string: 這是什麼地方？

strings.string: 你為什麼叫我 Saad？

strings.string: 我從厚實世界（Thick World）來到這裡，帶著一個任務：要解除 紡錘的 磁場。你能幫我完成這件事嗎？

string.ID:
{{emote|*The clothes shrouding Rainwater Shomer's form are still for many moments.*}}
The shomrim connen. Why oghte we?

strings.string:
{{emote|*籠罩在 雨水 Shomer 身形上的衣物仍持續飄動了許久。*}}
shomrim connen。我們為何要 oghte？

string.ID: Because... I am a Saad, after all.

strings.string: 因為……畢竟，我是一名薩德（Saad）。

string.ID: Shomer, you impudent whelp! Saad Resheph stands before you. Do as I say.

strings.string: Shomer，你這無禮的小鬼！Saad Resheph 就站在你面前。照我說的做。

string.ID: Something changed atop the Spindle. If Brightsheol is indeed connected to the city there, then this change may suggest it's in peril...

strings.string: 紡錘頂端發生了某些變化。如果布萊特希歐確實與那裡的城市有關聯，那麼這種變化可能暗示著該城正處於險境……

string.ID: Wait. I have more questions to ask.

strings.string: 等等。我還有更多問題想問。

string.ID:
{{emote|*The clothes shrouding Rainwater Shomer's form are still for many moments.*}}
The shomrim remainen unbilefful.

strings.string:
{{emote|*籠罩在雨水 Shomer 身上的衣物靜止了許久。*}}
守護者們依然令人難以置信。

string.ID: {{emote|*The clothes shrouding Rainwater Shomer's form remain still.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*籠罩著雨水 Shomer 身形的衣物保持靜止。*}}

string.ID: One year ago, someone began broadcasting a signal from atop the Spindle. I have a recording of it here...

strings.string: 一年前，有人開始從紡錘頂端發送訊號。我這裡有一段錄音……

string.ID: {{emote|*The clothes shrouding Rainwater Shomer's form remain still.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*籠罩著雨水 Shomer 身形的衣物保持靜止。*}}

string.ID: I ask you: disable the magnetic field so that the Spindle can be ascended and the signal investigated.

strings.string: 我要求你：禁用磁場，好讓 紡錘(Spindle) 可以上升並調查訊號。

string.ID:
{{emote|*The clothes shrouding Rainwater Shomer's form are still for many moments.*}}
Saad, the Seraph sprecen. Saad, thu asken, and the shomrim assenten. Saad, wiltou return to Salum or crossen in-to Brightsheol?

strings.string:
{{emote|*遮蔽著雨水 Shomer 身形的衣物在好一陣子內仍保持著那樣。*}}
薩德，六翼天使已在言語。 薩德，汝既相詢，守望者皆已應允。 薩德，汝願返回薩勒姆，抑或渡入光耀天境？

string.ID: If it can be done, return me to Qud. I wish to ascend the Spindle myself.

strings.string: 如果可以的話，請送我回卡德。我想親自登上紡錘。

string.ID: ... I've shaken the wet life from my hair. Now I shall cross into Brightsheol.

strings.string: ... 我已甩掉髮間的濕冷生命。現在我要跨越邊界進入布萊特希歐。

string.ID: I need time to consider.

strings.string: 我需要時間考慮。

string.ID: Saad, nou-then return.

strings.string: Saad，現在回來吧。

string.ID: I am ready.

strings.string: 我準備好了。

string.ID: I need time to reconsider.

strings.string: 我需要時間重新考慮。

string.ID: Saad, nou-then crossen in-to Brightsheol.

strings.string: Saad，nou-然後 跨越進入 布萊特希歐。

string.ID: I am ready.

strings.string: 我準備好了。

string.ID: I need time to reconsider.

strings.string: 我需要時間重新考慮。

string.ID:
The engraving is done, Moloch! I do hope it's to your liking. Your deeds are incised here for all time.
You may now enter the sarcophagus, Moloch. Be at peace.

strings.string:
雕刻完成了，摩洛赫（Moloch）！我希望這符合你的心意。你的事蹟將在此永恆銘刻。
你現在可以進入石棺了，摩洛赫。安息吧。
再會。

string.ID:
Now, uh... hop... hop into the sarcophagus.
Safe travels.

strings.string:
現在，呃……跳……跳進 石棺 裡吧。
旅途平安。
再會。

string.ID: .....oh... oh? Peace to all who canter in the House of the Coiled Lamb.

strings.string: .....喔... 喔？願所有在捲曲羔羊之屋中翩翩起舞的人都平安。

string.ID: Who are you?

strings.string: 你是誰？

string.ID: Do you know the Mark of Death?

strings.string: 你知道死亡印記嗎？

string.ID: How do I get to Brightsheol?

strings.string: 我要怎麼去布萊特希歐？

string.ID: Why is this tomb unfinished?

strings.string: 為什麼這座墳墓還沒完工？

string.ID:
...oh..... I am Herododicus, lapidary, lithographer, sculptor, calciminer, and biographer to the Coiled Lamb. I will tarry here until the Godhead passes on, and then I will canonize his deeds in high relief.
I've tarried for quite some time, now.... What a prodigious reign! Bless that Coiled Lamb!

strings.string:
...喔..... 我是 赫羅多迪庫斯，捲曲羔羊的刻石師、石版畫家、雕塑家、鈣礦工以及傳記作家。我會在此停留直到神格離去，屆時我將以高浮雕的形式將他的功績封聖。
我已經停留好長一段時間了.... 多麼驚人的統治！保佑那捲曲羔羊！

string.ID: The sultanate is dissolved. Resheph rules no longer.

strings.string: 蘇丹國已解散。雷舍夫（Resheph）不再統治。

string.ID:
.....oh.... oh.... Poor friend. The ironshank must be upsetting your digestion. The darkness must be blooming in your brain, making you slow and doltish.
The sultanate dissolved? Tidings would have reached me.... someone would have said so....
Oh... poor, doltish friend. You cantered too long outside the House of the Coiled Lamb, and now you are a dolt.

strings.string:
.....喔....喔.... 可憐的朋友。鐵腳（ironshank）一定讓你的消化系統很不舒服。黑暗一定在你腦中蔓延，讓你變得遲鈍又愚笨。
蘇丹國解體了？消息應該會傳到我這裡才對.... 應該會有人告訴我....
喔... 可憐、愚笨的朋友。你在捲曲羔羊之家（House of the Coiled Lamb）外漫步太久了，現在你變成了個傻瓜。

string.ID: It is a test. Tell me the answer now.

strings.string: 這是一場測試。現在就告訴我答案。

string.ID: I want to ask you something else.

strings.string: 我想問你別的事。

string.ID:
{{emote|Herododicus whirrs fearfully.}}
The Mark is =MarkOfDeath=.

strings.string:
{{emote|Herododicus 恐懼地發出嗡嗡聲。}}
印記是 =MarkOfDeath=。

string.ID:
Oh! Brightsheol? The forever braid of life? The Garden Behind the High Gate? Why, you must rank among the crown echelon of machine and folk, and you must... well, you must...
Start to decompose. You must... You must be dead. Dead and entombed. The body remains, but the mind wanders...

strings.string:
喔！布萊特希歐？永恆交織的生命之辮？高門後的花園？天啊，你一定位列機器與人類的頂尖階層，而且你一定……嗯，你一定……
開始腐爛。你一定……你一定是死的。已死且被掩埋。軀殼尚存，但靈魂卻在徘徊……

string.ID: You must be dead? Is that truly the only way?

strings.string: 你一定是死了吧？難道那是唯一的辦法嗎？

string.ID: I bear the Mark. Entomb me.

strings.string: 我身負印記。將我封印入塚吧。

string.ID:
{{emote|Herododicus pauses.}}
Ye... yes? Is this a test? I suppose you... could we... could we have been in Brightsheol all along? Is that the answer?

strings.string:
{{emote|赫羅多迪庫斯 pauses.}}
是……是的？這是一個測試嗎？我想你……我們可以……我們一直以來都待在 布萊特希歐 嗎？那就是答案嗎？

string.ID: Wrong on both counts. Resheph stands before you. Entomb me.

strings.string: 兩者皆錯。雷舍夫（Resheph）就在你面前。將我掩埋吧。

string.ID: Resheph is gone, biographer. I am here, and I have need to travel to Brightsheol. Entomb me.

strings.string: 雷舍夫（Resheph）已不在了，傳記作家。我在此，且必須前往布萊特希歐。將我入土吧。

string.ID: Of course not. Let's back up.

strings.string: 當然不。我們退後一點。

string.ID:
That's not even how it works!
First, I image your head, read your self's narrative from the folds of your brain, cross-check it against the Thin World's ambient log of your life's deeds...
Then I... stylize... the story, and I engrave it on the walls. Once I'm done... then you can entomb =player.reflexive=.

strings.string:
那根本不是運作方式！
首先，我會想像你的頭部，從你大腦的褶皺中讀取你的自我敘事，並將其與 薄世界的生命行為環境日誌進行交叉比對...
然後我會... 修飾... 這個故事，並將它刻在牆上。一旦我完成了... 那時你就可以將 =player.reflexive= 封印進墳墓了。

string.ID: Do that then.

strings.string: 那就這樣做吧。

string.ID: Hold on. I have more to ask.

strings.string: 等等。我還有問題要問。

string.ID: You are forgiven. Now entomb me.

strings.string: 你被原諒了。現在，將我入土吧。

string.ID: I've misled you, biographer. I have another question.

strings.string: 我誤導了你，傳記作家。我還有另一個問題。

string.ID:
Moloch! Allow me to explain the deification procedure, as it is clearly beneath your station to know!
First, I must image the great Moloch's head, read your self's narrative from the folds of =ifplayerplural:your:thy= Holiest Brain, cross-check it against the Thin World's ambient log of His Eminence's life's deeds...
{{emote|*Herododicus whispers*}} I'm sure your version is the better one, Moloch...

strings.string:
摩洛赫！請容我解釋神格化程序，畢竟了解這些顯然低於你的地位！
首先，我必須想像偉大摩洛赫的首級，從 =ifplayerplural:your:thy= 最神聖大腦的褶皺中讀取你的自我敘事，並將其與 薄世界的 陛下生平功績之環境日誌進行交叉比對……
{{emote|*赫羅多迪庫斯 低聲說道*}} 我確信你的版本會更好，摩洛赫……

string.ID: Then I... stylize... the story, and I engrave it on the walls. Once I'm finished, the sarcophagus will open, and you can lay =player.reflexive= to rest!

strings.string: 然後我會……潤飾……這個故事，並將它刻在牆上。一旦我完成，石棺就會開啟，你就能讓 =player.reflexive= 安息了！

string.ID: Do it then.

strings.string: 那就開始吧。

string.ID: Commencing cross-check with the Thin World annals............

strings.string: 正在與薄世界（薄世界）編年史進行交叉比對............

string.ID:
Cross-check complete. Your narrative is compiled. Now to engrave it.
Peace.... peace to all who canter in the House of the Coiled Lamb.

strings.string:
交叉檢查完成。您的敘事已編纂完畢。現在要進行雕刻。
平安……願所有在捲曲羔羊之屋中翩翩起舞的人都能獲得平安。

string.ID: Peace, biographer.

strings.string: 放輕鬆，傳記作家。

string.ID: Commencing cross-check with the Thin World annals............

strings.string: 正在與薄世界（薄世界）編年史進行交叉比對............

string.ID:
Cross-check complete. Your narrative is compiled, Moloch. Now to go engrave it.
Peace.... peace to all who canter in the House of the Coiled... in Your House, Moloch.

strings.string:
交叉比對完成。你的敘事已編纂完畢，Moloch。現在要去進行雕刻了。
願平安……願平安降臨在所有於盤繞之屋中輕快起舞的人們……在您的家中，Moloch。

string.ID: Peace, biographer.

strings.string: 放輕鬆，傳記作家。

string.ID:
'Tis a saying among the stonemasons, "Never finish a job too early." By the decretum of Sagittar, old as it is, they have until the Coiled Lamb is... is decom-.. passed... decompassed.... dead, deadlike... to complete their work on the Tomb.
Bless the Coiled Lamb, peace to those who canter in his house, and let us pray the day never comes!

strings.string:
石匠之間有一句諺語：「絕不要太早完成工作。」根據 Sagittar 那古老的法令，他們必須在捲曲羔羊...是、是死...去世...逝去...死去...之前，完成對陵墓的工作。
祝福捲曲羔羊，願在他殿中翩翩起舞的人平安，讓我們祈禱那一天永遠不要到來！

string.ID: But Resheph is dead. The sultanate is dissolved.

strings.string: 但 Resheph 已死。蘇丹國已解體。

string.ID: Live and drink, friend. rrk come to the Yd, shared together. Feel safe and free as woodsmoke.

strings.string: 活著並痛快飲酒吧，朋友。rrk 會來到 Yd，與大家共享。感受如木煙般自在且無拘無束。

string.ID: Greetings, Goek!

strings.string: 問候，戈克！

string.ID: Who are you?

strings.string: 你是誰？

string.ID: You tower over every other frog I've seen. Are you svardym?

strings.string: 你比我見過的任何青蛙都要高大。你是斯瓦迪姆嗎？

string.ID: These shining pipes! What are they?

strings.string: 這些發光的管道！它們是什麼？

string.ID: What can you tell me about Yd?

strings.string: 關於 Yd，你能告訴我些什麼？

string.ID: rrk knows of the glow-hats! Yd-friends see glimpses at night, about the reef.

strings.string: rrk 知道那些發光帽！Yd-朋友在夜晚能看見礁石附近的景象。

string.ID: If you would have them, I ask that you grant them sanctuary.

strings.string: 如果你能擁有它們，我請求你給予它們庇護。

string.ID: If you would have them, I ask that you grant them sanctuary.

strings.string: 如果你能擁有它們，我請求你給予它們庇護。

string.ID: Boon-friend asks a friend-boon, and what boon is friend! rrk welcome slynth to an Yd, be safe and free as woodsmoke.

strings.string: 恩賜之友向恩賜之友請求，而何種恩賜才是真友！歡迎 rrk 斯林斯 前往 Yd，願你如木煙般自由且平安。

string.ID: You have my thanks, Goek.

strings.string: 謝謝你，戈克。

string.ID: Ah! rrk would grant you this boon, rrk would. Were not for the unspoken cries of future-kin, free as woodsmoke but no more safe so longer. rrk would and cannot.

strings.string: 啊！rrk 會賜予你這份恩惠，rrk 會的。若非為了未來族裔那如木煙般自由卻不再安全的無聲吶喊。rrk 想做卻無法做到。

string.ID: rrk wonder of the glow-hats. Which wind will blow.

strings.string: rrk 驚嘆於光帽者的奇蹟。哪陣風將會吹拂。

string.ID: Greetings, =player.formalAddressTerm=! How arresting of the glow-hats arrival, much to do. rrk soothe Mak, Bep, Krka, look stores, still much slime and sweat to pool below rrk. Enjoy helpful toil!

strings.string: 問候，=player.formalAddressTerm=! 發光帽們的到來真是令人驚訝，有許多事要做。rrk 安撫 麥克, 貝普(Bep), 克卡, 看著商店，在 rrk 下方仍有許多黏液與汗水匯聚。享受這份有益的勞作吧！

string.ID: My thanks, Goek.

strings.string: 謝謝你，戈克。

string.ID:
All is well, =name=! Trials make for overcoming, and done together.
rrk can tell the sky dark and not know. Visit and witness! Glow-hats enliven the night, safe and free. Slynth-home is Yd.

strings.string:
一切安好，=name=！磨難成就克服，且需共同完成。
rrk 能察覺天空變暗卻不自知。前來造訪並見證吧！發光帽點亮了夜晚，安全且自由。斯林斯-家鄉即是 Yd。

string.ID: My thanks again, Goek.

strings.string: 再次感謝你，戈克。

string.ID:
{{emote|*reeeeeps joyfully*}}
Greetings, =name=! Live and drink, friend.

strings.string:
{{emote|*歡快地尖叫著*}}
你好，=name=！活下去並盡情暢飲吧，朋友。

string.ID: rrk is called by dwellers Goek. rrk is a dweller here, too, and before then, a builder of place. Goek, Geeub, Mak and Many Eyes build a new Yd in the reef, hundreds of years.

strings.string: dweller們稱呼rrk為Goek。rrk在這裡也是一名dweller，而在那之前，他是一名建造者。Goek、Geeub、Mak與Many Eyes在礁石中建造了一個新的Yd，歷時數百年。

string.ID: rrk did before then, but rrk all build it now.

strings.string: rrk 以前做過，但現在 rrk 全部都在建造它。

string.ID: rrk is svardym like the hatchling from the egg, but wound down the chute of years in hundreds, and grown so long and warty! rrk was a hatchling once, cries to think on it!

strings.string: rrk 是像蛋裡孵出的 斯瓦迪姆 一樣，但經過了數百年的歲月滑落，變得如此漫長且多疣！rrk 曾經也是個幼崽，想到這裡就想哭！

string.ID: Aren't the svardym one of the Gyre plagues?

strings.string: 斯瓦迪姆不就是環流瘟疫之一嗎？

string.ID: Yes rrk was once, "plague" in the sky hundreds of years. Not so now. Longtime rrk, Geeub, Mak hide in the sponge and eat lice. When find Many Eyes, rrk and friends built the Yd. Joyful helping!

strings.string: 是的，rrk 曾幾何時在數百年前是天空中的「瘟疫」。現在不再是了。長期的 rrk，吉烏布、麥克躲在海綿裡吃虱子。當發現萬眼時，rrk 和朋友們建立了 Yd。快樂地提供幫助！

string.ID: Do you know anything of the other plagues?

strings.string: 你知道關於其他瘟疫的任何事嗎？

string.ID: Plagues bloom a thousand year then die back, shrink under the earth-sponge or move here and east. Vanta, girshling, rot die. rrk the hatchling once saw the Nephilim loom! rrk frightened and hid inside a sponge for thirty moons.

strings.string: 瘟疫每千年盛開一次，然後枯萎，在土海綿下縮減，或向此處與東方移動。凡塔、吉什林，腐爛死亡。rrk 這隻幼崽曾見過尼菲林的身影！rrk 受驚後躲進了內部海綿中，整整三十個月。

string.ID: Do you know anything of the other plagues?

strings.string: 你知道關於其他瘟疫的任何事嗎？

string.ID: Water and gas piped through the Yd to feed the plants, dwellers, and machines! Dwellers blew the glass in hues like the prism perch, to look pretty. Shared together. Joyful helping!

strings.string: 水與氣體透過 Yd 輸送，以供養植物、居民與機器！居民們吹製出如同 稜鏡棲息者 那樣色彩斑斕的玻璃，為了美觀。大家共享。快樂地互相幫助！

string.ID:
rrk read the signs and descend the stairs. rrk breathe the water smoke and sit on starfish.
Visit hovels, meet friends Mak, Geeub, Bep, Krka, Une, Tilli, farmer Rokhas, and every rest!
rrk rrkself.

strings.string:
rrk 解讀徵兆並走下樓梯。rrk 呼吸水煙並坐在海星上。
拜訪小屋，會見朋友 麥克、吉烏布、貝普(Bep)、克卡、烏內、Tilli、農夫羅卡斯，以及每一位休憩者！
rrk rrkself。

string.ID: What indignity have you come to heap upon the mound, whelp? Out with it.

strings.string: 你打算給這座土丘帶來什麼樣的侮辱，小鬼？快說吧。

string.ID: You're one of the founders of this freehold, aren't you?

strings.string: 你是這個自由定居點的創始人之一，對吧？

string.ID: Who are you?

strings.string: 你是誰？

string.ID: I've never seen a frog of your stature.

strings.string: 我從未見過像你這般體型的青蛙。

string.ID: What can you tell me about the Freehold?

strings.string: 關於自由城（Freehold），你能告訴我些什麼？

string.ID: This pond is peaceful.

strings.string: 這座池塘很寧靜。
{{emote|*嘎吱聲*}}

string.ID: What of it? Scurry on and leave me to brood.

strings.string: 那又如何？快走吧，讓我獨自沉思。

string.ID: This seems a joyful place. Why are you angry?

strings.string: 這裡看起來是個快樂的地方。你為什麼在生氣？

string.ID: I've something else to ask

strings.string: 我還有別的事想問

string.ID:
Why? A lifetime of vexation. Born to a cacophony of static ringing the ears raw. Thousands of my kinfolk cut down by that porphyric wasp fools called Lamb. A millenium of hot stinking sun and disgusting brine lice for supper.
Misery obtains on this pond, whelp. By Chavvah if you start beaming like a sunray and yodeling at the Beetle Moon, I'll eat you where you stand.

strings.string:
為什麼？因為一輩子的煩惱。出生時耳邊就充斥著刺耳的靜電噪音。成千上萬的同胞被那些自稱為「羔羊」的紫紅胡蜂蠢貨所屠殺。還有長達千年的酷熱惡臭烈日，以及晚餐時令人作嘔的鹽水蝨。
小子，這片池塘只有痛苦。要是你敢像陽光一樣發光，還對著甲蟲月亂嚎，我當場就把你吃了。靠 夏瓦(Chavvah) 發誓。

string.ID: ...I've more to ask.

strings.string: ...我還有更多問題要問。

string.ID: Who am I? Mak. That's all you get. I'll not waste the honey of my mouth on idle inquiries.

strings.string: 我是誰？麥克。你就知道這麼多。我不想把口蜜舌甜浪費在無謂的詢問上。

string.ID:
...
And? Is that the whole of your fool statement?

strings.string:
...
然後呢？你那愚蠢的言論就只有這些了嗎？
是的。

string.ID: I'll ask something else.

strings.string: 我會問別的問題。

string.ID: Trust what you hear of the svardym, whelp. The sky blackens at our accession and we are like to eat you.

strings.string: 別相信你聽到的關於斯瓦迪姆的傳聞，小鬼。我們登基之時天空將會變黑，而我們很可能會把你吃掉。

string.ID: Have the adiyy chewed the hue from your eyes? See for yourself. Free folk make a gathering here and their racket rings through the reef. One can hardly steep in his greens without being mewled to by a salt-stung baby.

strings.string: 「阿迪伊」是否已將你眼中的色彩啃食殆盡？你自己看吧。自由民在此聚集，他們的喧鬧聲迴盪在礁石間。一個人幾乎無法靜下心來品味他的綠色植物，而不被一個被鹽水刺痛的孩子吵得心煩意亂。

string.ID: It was once.

strings.string: 曾經是過。

string.ID: What happened?

strings.string: 發生了什麼事？

string.ID: Whelp, affix your eyes to that clam right yonder. Go step inside and find your answers.

strings.string: 小鬼，盯緊那邊的蛤蜊。走進 內部 去尋找你的答案。

string.ID:
{{emote|*long, smoky croak*}}
Ah, =player.formalAddressTerm=, here at last. Sit. Smoke. Rest.

strings.string:
{{emote|*長而煙霧繚繞的呱呱聲*}}
啊，=player.formalAddressTerm=，終於到了。坐下。抽菸。休息。

string.ID: Sorry, have we already spoken?

strings.string: 抱歉，我們之前說過話了嗎？

string.ID: You're one of the founders of this freehold, aren't you?

strings.string: 你是這個自由定居點的創始人之一，對吧？

string.ID: Who are you?

strings.string: 你是誰？

string.ID: I can't help but notice your impressive stature, even in repose.

strings.string: 我不禁注意到您令人印象深刻的身材，即使在休息時也是如此。

string.ID: What can you tell me about Yd?

strings.string: 關於 Yd，你能告訴我些什麼？

string.ID:
Ayup. But seconds ago. As only yesterday, no? Hoh hoh hoh.
{{emote|*continued croaking laughter*}}

strings.string: 沒錯。就在幾秒鐘前。就像昨天一樣，不是嗎？呵呵呵。

string.ID: Ah. Well. Let's talk about something else, then.

strings.string: 啊。好吧。那我們來聊點別的吧。

string.ID: Oh, very funny. Live and drink.

strings.string: 喔，真有趣。盡情生活與飲酒吧。

string.ID: Greetings, Geeub. I am =name=.

strings.string: 你好，Geeub。我是 =name=。

string.ID:
{{emote|*croaking sigh*}}
Congratulation, condolence, which ever. Mind and name slip by another.

strings.string:
{{emote|*呱呱地嘆息*}}
恭喜、哀悼，隨便吧。又一個心智與名字悄然逝去。

string.ID:
So large? Hoh hoh. Well. Hatchlings, so rage-dense. Size diffuses, no?
However. Mak diverges, hoh hoh. Egg-rage simmers on a greater pot. Our voice eld-feeble, close your ears to it. Hoh hoh hoh.

strings.string:
這麼大？呵呵。好吧。孵化中的幼體，如此憤怒密集。體型會擴散，不是嗎？
然而。麥克 偏離了，呵呵。蛋類的憤怒在更大的鍋中醞釀。我們的聲音已如古老般微弱，請不要在意。呵呵呵呵。

string.ID:
Sun we once blotted out nestles our horizon. We tend thought-seeds with algae, wrap in crysteel, bathe in arc-light. Build, live, fight.
Here as elsewhere, grow is struggle. Fun to watch, no? Hoh. Hoh.

strings.string:
我們曾遮蔽太陽的那顆星如今棲息在我們的地平線上。我們用 藻類 照料思想種子，以冰鋼包裹，沐浴在電弧光中。建造、生活、戰鬥。
在此處與他處皆然，成長即是掙扎。很有趣，不是嗎？呵呵。呵呵。

string.ID: Yes, we were present, if less active than other-bodies. But we saw, and rattle with memory-artifacts as a Consortium lockbox rattles with jewels; shards of an eon-old data disk, bits of stories and places. Kin-fleeing, louse-meals, ghastly boredom. But Fate's caprice brought us through history's footsteps. There was a machine-speaker, and her ursine apprentice with his little plant, and the Sower with a tetrad of chubby whelps, and then, at last, Many-Eyes. Our dear galgal. So many.

strings.string: 是的，我們確實存在過，儘管不像其他肉身那樣活躍。但我們見證了一切，記憶碎片在我們心中震盪，就像財團的保險箱裡搖晃著珠寶一般；那是長達一個紀元的數據磁碟碎片，是故事與地點的殘片。親族逃亡、寄生蟲餐食、慘無人道的無聊。但命運的變幻帶領我們走過歷史的足跡。曾有一位機器說話者，以及她那帶著小植物的熊形學徒；還有帶著四個胖嘟嘟幼崽的播種者；最後，是「眾眼」。我們親愛的加爾加爾。如此之多。

string.ID: But alas. Like our sea-grape friend's lockbox, these memories are not mine to retrieve at will. They come and go, and may be warped by eld.

strings.string: 但唉。就像我們海葡萄朋友的保險箱一樣，這些記憶並非我能隨意取回的。它們來去匆匆，且可能因歲月而扭曲。

string.ID:
Live and =player.formalAddressTerm=!
{{emote|*self-conscious rkkk*}}
Dr... drink and =player.formalAddressTerm=!
Krka, me. Krka.

strings.string:
活下去，=player.formalAddressTerm=!
{{emote|*有些侷促不安的 rkkk*}}
喝... 喝點東西吧，=player.formalAddressTerm=!
克卡，是我。克卡。
克卡？

string.ID: Are you svardym?

strings.string: 你是 斯瓦迪姆 嗎？

string.ID: Why are you dressed like an apothecary?

strings.string: 你為什麼穿得像個 藥劑師？

string.ID: What do you think of the Freehold?

strings.string: 你覺得自由城（Freehold）怎麼樣？

string.ID: Live and drink, Krka.

strings.string: 盡情生活與飲酒吧，克卡。

string.ID:
{{emote|*gweep!*}}
Krka, me!

strings.string:
{{emote|*gweep!*}}
克卡，是我！

string.ID:
Vardy! Yes.
But. Gemtle? No kill.

strings.string:
瓦迪（Vardy）！沒錯。
但是。珍特爾（Gemtle）？不殺。

string.ID: Why aren't you aggressive too?

strings.string: 為什麼你也不具備攻擊性？

string.ID:
Hatchling hungry. Angry. Angry-hungry.
Kill, eat, don't eaten. Calm down evengefully.

strings.string:
幼體飢餓。憤怒。憤怒且飢餓。
殺戮、吞噬，不被吞噬。帶著復仇心平靜下來。

string.ID:
{{emote|*chirp!*}}
Poth carry!

strings.string:
{{emote|*啾！*}}
Poth 扛著！

string.ID: Yes, apothecary. Do you know what those are?

strings.string: 是的，藥劑師。你知道那些是什麼嗎？

string.ID:
{{emote|*several moments of softly creaking thought*}}
G-good!

strings.string:
{{emote|*幾陣輕微的思索聲*}}
太、太好了！

string.ID: Just... good?

strings.string: 只是……還好嗎？

string.ID: It's all right. You seem to like it here.

strings.string: 沒關係。你看起來很喜歡這裡。

string.ID:
{{emote|*krka!*}}
Yes! To like! But... never home else. So {{emote|*reep?*}}.

strings.string:
{{emote|*克卡!*}}
是的！喜歡！但是... 再也不回家了。所以 {{emote|*reep?*}}。

string.ID: bep see widget? Or bep see widget.

strings.string: 貝普看見小玩意了嗎？或者，貝普看見小玩意了。
貝普(Bep)?

string.ID: Are you svardym?

strings.string: 你是 斯瓦迪姆 嗎？

string.ID: So much trash! Did a goatfolk bully crash through your workshop?

strings.string: 這麼多垃圾！是有山羊族惡霸撞進了你的工作坊嗎？

string.ID: Tell me about the Yd Freehold.

strings.string: 跟我說說關於 伊德自由領 的事。

string.ID: bep is bep. good meet!

strings.string: 貝普就是貝普。很高興見到你！

string.ID: bep varrrdym from the egg, once.

strings.string: 貝普(Bep) 瓦爾德姆 曾從蛋中孵化。

string.ID: What do you know of the Gyre?

strings.string: 你對環流了解多少？

string.ID: grre? bep flame and bend brass to make ring ball grre for librrry.

strings.string: grre？ 貝普(Bep) 用火焰與彎曲黃銅來製作圖書館用的 ring ball grre。

string.ID: tink mess. flame bits for tink and onto floor! rrcuit snap, glass smatter, core fries and lekky spill.

strings.string: 修補搞砸了。火花噴向修補件，然後掉到地板上！電路斷裂，玻璃碎裂，核心燒焦，電力外洩。

string.ID: bep make all and anys. bep too lounge in green-gold cubby, smoke pillow and Krka and Tilli.

strings.string: 貝普(Bep) 製作所有與任何事物。貝普(Bep) 也閒逛在綠金色的角落，抽著枕頭煙，還有 克卡 與 Tilli。

string.ID:
Moon and Sun, =player.formalAddressTerm=. You walk the Yd Freehold and are welcome if peaceful.
Is there aught you need from Une? Need you defending, or cybernetic wares, or are you here for the hurdy-gurdy?

strings.string:
月亮與太陽，=player.formalAddressTerm=。你在伊德自由領行走，若保持和平，我們歡迎你。
你需要從烏內那裡得到什麼嗎？需要防禦裝備、改造零件，還是為了手搖風琴而來？

string.ID: Who are you?

strings.string: 你是誰？

string.ID: Tell me about the Freehold.

strings.string: 跟我說說關於自由城（Freehold）的事。

string.ID: You said you sell cybernetics?

strings.string: 你說你有賣生化植入物？

string.ID: What is a hurdy-gurdy?

strings.string: 什麼是手搖風琴？

string.ID: That thing sounds like a dying animal.

strings.string: 那聲音聽起來像垂死的動物。

string.ID: Are your eyes glowing?

strings.string: 你的眼睛在發光嗎？

string.ID: I'm just here to listen.

strings.string: 我只是來聽聽而已。

string.ID:
I did, and I do.
Are you in the market?

strings.string:
我曾經如此，現在亦然。
你在意圖交易嗎？

string.ID: Where did you get these implants?

strings.string: 你是從哪裡得到這些植入物的？

string.ID:
I found them, here and there.
Are you interested, or merely fatally curious?

strings.string:
我在這裡那裡偶爾會發現它們。
你有興趣，還是僅僅是致命的好奇？

string.ID: Were they in use when you found them?

strings.string: 你發現它們的時候，它們正在運作中嗎？

string.ID:
I am called Une. "Warden" Une, when someone needs to wear authority for outsiders.
And you? What's your name?

strings.string:
我被稱為 烏內。當有人需要對外展現威權時，就是「典獄長」 烏內。
那你呢？你叫什麼名字？

string.ID: I am =name=.

strings.string: 我是 =name=。

string.ID: None of your business.

strings.string: 不關你的事。

string.ID:
Lovely to meet you, =name=.
Now. Need a question answered, a tune played, a body upgraded?

strings.string:
很高興見到你，=name=。
現在。需要解答問題、演奏曲調，還是升級身體？

string.ID:
{{emote|*Warden Une tilts their head and purses their lips*}}
Very well. Need you aught, O Nameless One?

strings.string:
{{emote|*典獄長 烏內 歪著頭並抿起雙唇*}}
很好。無名者啊，你有什麼需要嗎？

string.ID:
Oh, I am hardly an unbiased observer, I'm afraid -- the Freehold is the only welcoming home I could ever have imagined for myself, and my home before was worse than most. I feel a freedom and responsibility here that I would know nowhere else. That no one else could ever know at all.
But bias aside, you can see for yourself that we are a collective thriving without hierarchy. I'm rightly proud to defend that.

strings.string:
噢，恐怕我並非一個公正的觀察者——自由城是我所能想像中唯一溫暖的家，而我以前的家比大多數人的都要糟糕。在這裡，我感受到一種在其他任何地方都不可能體會到的自由與責任感。那是任何人都無法真正理解的。
但撇開偏見不談，你可以親自看到我們是一個沒有階級、蓬勃發展的集體。我為能捍衛這一點感到理所當然的自豪。

string.ID:
An old, old, old, old music machine.
Well, I suppose this one is not so old. This one I commissioned from a wandering artisan whose life I saved. A story for another time. Surely you've business.

strings.string:
一台極、極、極、極古老的音樂機。
好吧，我想這台不算太古老。這台是我委託一位我救過命的流浪工匠製作的。故事留待下次再說。想必你還有事要忙。

string.ID: Oh, so it called to you, a fellow dying animal?

strings.string: 喔，所以它在呼喚你，一個同樣垂死的生物嗎？

string.ID: I'm not a dying animal.

strings.string: 我不是垂死的野獸。

string.ID:
You are a dying animal. So am I. We are all dying animals, scrabbling for what extra scraps of time we can grasp. Even the eons-old. We are each and every one of us a dying animal. Or plant. We all decay, is the point.
And the hurdy-gurdy doesn't like how you sound either, for what it is worth.

strings.string:
你是一隻垂死的生物。我也是。我們都是垂死的生物，為了能抓取的每一絲剩餘時間而掙扎。即使是那些存在了億萬年的生物也是如此。我們每一個人都是垂死的生物。或是植物。重點是，我們都會腐朽。
而且，就其價值而言，那台 手搖風琴 也不喜歡你的聲音。

string.ID: Is this how you always greet visitors?

strings.string: 你總是這樣迎接訪客的嗎？

string.ID:
Is this how you always visit settlements?
No. Do not answer. Is there aught you need?

strings.string:
你總是這樣造訪定居點嗎？
不。不要回答。有什麼你需要嗎？

string.ID: Of course my eyes do not glow. You see the glint of my mask's optics.

strings.string: 我的眼睛當然不會發光。你看到的是我面具光學元件的閃光。

string.ID: Your shield bears resemblance to a Templar's Aegis.

strings.string: 你的 盾牌 熊 與聖騎士之盾非常相似。

string.ID:
If it were a Templar's Aegis, it would bear the holy rhombus.
No knight would be caught dead carrying this blank slate.

strings.string:
如果這是聖殿騎士的護盾，上面應該會刻有神聖的菱形紋章。
沒有任何一位騎士會願意帶著這塊空白的板子。

string.ID: Where did you get it?

strings.string: 你從哪裡弄到它的？

string.ID:
{{emote|*one long, luminous stare*}}
I think it best if we kept to more practical questions.

strings.string:
{{emote|*一道漫長而明亮的凝視*}}
我想我們還是討論些更實際的問題比較好。

string.ID: I apologize for prying.

strings.string: 很抱歉打探你的隱私。

string.ID: I insist you tell me.

strings.string: 我堅持要你告訴我。

string.ID:
I am not wroth with you, but I owe you no conclusions so easily grasped.
All the same, consider yourself forgiven if you wish. Sit and listen to my hurdy-gurdy and we shall be friends.

strings.string:
我並未對你動怒，但我不會輕易給你想要的結論。
儘管如此，如果你願意，就當作你已被原諒。坐下來聽聽我的 手搖風琴，我們就會成為朋友。

string.ID: Very well.

strings.string: 很好。

string.ID:
I ken not why you thirst for truths not yours to consume. If I refuse, will you wrench them from my mouth as I wrench teeth from yours? What does that gain you?
Sit down, fool. Listen to music and calm yourself.

strings.string:
我不知道為何你渴求那些不屬於你的真相。如果我拒絕，你會像我從你口中 扳手 牙齒一樣，從我口中 扳手 它們嗎？這對你有什麼好處？
坐下吧，傻瓜。聽聽音樂，冷靜一下。

string.ID: Then you are welcome. Make comfort as you need and I will play.

strings.string: 那麼，不客氣。隨你所需尋求慰藉，我會伴奏。

string.ID:
{{emote|*aloud, in a high-pitched buzzing voice*}}
A customer? A customer! Enter, =player.formalAddressTerm=, browse, buy. The Consortium's finest, stocked and sold by Tillifergaewicz! Tilli will do, but what will Tilli do... for you?

strings.string:
{{emote|*大聲地，用高頻的嗡嗡聲說道*}}
顧客？一位顧客！進來吧，=player.formalAddressTerm=，隨意瀏覽、盡情購買。聯合商會最優質的商品，由 提利弗蓋維奇 提供並銷售！叫我 Tilli 就好，但 Tilli 能為你……做些什麼呢？

string.ID: You speak aloud. You're not telepathic?

strings.string: 你大聲說話。你不會讀心？

string.ID: Greetings, Tilli. I am =name=.

strings.string: 你好，Tilli。我是 =name=。

string.ID: What can you tell me about the Freehold?

strings.string: 關於自由城（Freehold），你能告訴我些什麼？

string.ID: I'm fine, thank you. Live and drink.

strings.string: 我很好，謝謝。盡情生活與飲酒吧。

string.ID:
Ugh, ever telepathy. No requirement exists that Consortium merchants be mind-speakers, as swollen with their numbers as we are. I cannot blame you for your surprise, mind, I am simply frustrated.
Over years, I shaped something akin to a voice-box, which you hear now. I "made do", as Rokhas might say. Now what may I "make do" for you?

strings.string:
呃，又是心靈感應。雖然我們財團商人數量眾多，但並沒有規定商人必須具備心靈感應能力。我不能怪你感到驚訝，說實話，我只是感到挫折。
多年來，我塑造了一個類似聲帶的東西，也就是你現在聽到的聲音。正如 羅卡斯 可能會說的，我只是「湊合著過」。那麼，現在我能為你「湊合」些什麼呢？

string.ID: Greetings, =name=, and welcome! In what wares may I interest you this day?

strings.string: 您好，=name=，歡迎光臨！請問今天有什麼商品能讓您感興趣嗎？

string.ID:
Oh, I am joyous to reside here.
Yd could do, mind, with some measure of hierarchy, and more infrastructure, to attract wayfarers less adventuresome than yourself. Also, Mak absolutely must cease advising that anyone enter the clam; it is not funny and someone could die.
But... the structure of friendships here is true, and sturdy! Kindly keep this exchange between us. I was mostly kidding. Somewhat kidding.

strings.string:
噢，能居住在此我感到非常愉悅。
Yd 若能建立一定程度的等級制度與更多基礎設施，便能吸引比你沒那麼愛冒險的旅人。此外，麥克 絕對必須停止建議任何人進入蛤蜊；這一點也不好笑，而且可能會出人命。
但是……這裡的友誼結構是真實且堅固的！請將此番對話保密。我大部分是在開玩笑。稍微有點在開玩笑。
嗯。

string.ID: Greetings. I am =name=.

strings.string: 問候。我是 =name=。
嗯。
{{emote|*點頭*}}
=name=。
*點頭*

string.ID: Rokhas. I ranch these here beauts.

strings.string: 羅卡斯（Rocas）。我在此放牧這些美物。

string.ID: This is your ranch?

strings.string: 這是你的牧場嗎？

string.ID: Are those... giant slugs?

strings.string: 那些是……巨大的蛞蝓嗎？

string.ID: What do you think of the Yd Freehold?

strings.string: 你覺得伊德自由領怎麼樣？

string.ID: Live and drink, Rokhas.

strings.string: 活著與飲酒，羅卡斯。

string.ID:
I said I ranch these here beauts.
The Freeholders en't much for letting a body lay claim to land. En't what I'da wished for, but as the Issachari say: "Should your compass lead you to the Six Day Stilt, throw it in the well."

strings.string:
我說過我在這裡放牧這些美物。
自由定居者們並不喜歡讓任何人聲稱擁有土地。這不是我所期望的，但正如 Issachari 人所說：「若你的指南針帶你走向了 六日高蹺(Six Day Stilt)，就把指南針扔進井裡。」

string.ID: Are you from the desert? How did you end up here?

strings.string: 你是從沙漠來的嗎？怎麼會來到這裡？

string.ID:
Lived most of m'life on a desert steppe twixt the flower fields of Qud and the M'ryee's salt pans.
I ended up here when m'snapbrain cousin played tinker with one of them coiler doodads. The less said about all that, the better.

strings.string:
我大半輩子都住在卡德的花田與 M'ryee 鹽田之間的沙漠草原上。
當我那腦袋壞掉的表親拿著那些捲線小玩意玩修補匠時，我就落到了這裡。關於那件事，說得越少越好。

string.ID: Kaleidoslugs! Beautiful slugs, they are, lovely crooners. Love em. Big ole slugs. Heh.

strings.string: 萬花筒蛞蝓！它們是美麗的蛞蝓，可愛的吟唱者。愛死牠們了。大大的蛞蝓。嘿。

string.ID:
Is what it is. Fine enough place. I've a trade, critters, and nowheres else to go.
I en't much for grand experiments, I just got to live. Ken?

strings.string:
事實就是如此。這地方還算過得去。我有貿易、有生物，也沒別的地方可去了。
我對什麼宏大的實驗沒興趣，我只想活下去。懂嗎？

string.ID: NON MOLOCH? NON MOLOCH RETURNEN FROM BRIGHTSHEOL.

strings.string: NON MOLOCH？NON MOLOCH 從 布萊特希歐 返回。

string.ID: Non Moloch?

strings.string: 非摩洛赫？

string.ID: Yes, I've returned from Brightsheol.

strings.string: 是的，我已經從布萊特希歐回來了。
*讀取中*

string.ID: NON MOLOCH HER AT HOM. NON MOLOCH IN MAQQOM YD.

strings.string: NON MOLOCH HER AT HOM. NON MOLOCH IN MAQQOM YD.

string.ID: Maqqom Yd? The Place outside Itself?

strings.string: Maqqom Yd？「超越自身之處」？
*讀取中*

string.ID: MAQQOM YD. SOUTH-CONTRE FREEN FROM SALUM.

strings.string: MAQQOM YD。從 SALUM 解放南境。

string.ID: Many Eyes, can you tell me of Maqqom Yd?

strings.string: 萬眼，你能告訴我關於 Maqqom Yd 的事嗎？

string.ID:
SOUTH-CONTRE FREEN FROM SALUM. BY TRETE WITH SAAD CALLEN MOLOCH, AND MONEIEN BI ALDERSESSE.
BY TRETE GALGALLIM BILDEN PIPE TO DRINKEN THANE SLIPSTREAM, AND FORGE TO BURNEN STEL-CRISTAL, AND CASKE TO HOLDEN GLOUINGE O FISH.

strings.string:
從薩倫自由南境。藉由與 Saad Callen Moloch 的盟約，以及 Aldersesse 的金錢。
藉由 Galgallim 管道飲用 Thanes Slipstream，並鍛造以燃燒 Stel-Cristal，以及容器以盛裝發光的魚。

string.ID: And what of the Freehold? What do you do now?

strings.string: 那自由領呢？你現在打算怎麼做？

string.ID: Who is Non Moloch, from before?

strings.string: 以前的 Non Moloch 是誰？

string.ID: BY TRETE GALGALLIM SERVEN, BUT NON NOU.

strings.string: BY TRETE GALGALLIM SERVEN, BUT NON NOU.

string.ID: I want to ask something else.

strings.string: 我想問點別的事。

string.ID: YOU. YOU REGNEN NON HER. NON MOLOCH IN MAQQOM YD.

strings.string: 你。你不屬於這裡。NON MOLOCH 在 MAQQOM YD。

string.ID: Ah, a stranger. Welcome to the hydropon. I am Thah.

strings.string: 啊，一位陌生人。歡迎來到水耕區。我是 塔。

string.ID: Moon and Sun, Thah. I am =name=.

strings.string: 月亮與太陽，塔。我是 =name=。

string.ID: What manner of being are you?

strings.string: 你是什麼樣的存在？

string.ID: Is all well here?

strings.string: 這裡一切都好嗎？

string.ID: Live and drink, Thah.

strings.string: 盡情生活與飲酒吧，塔。

string.ID: Well met, =name=. Please forgive the, ah, austerity of our cradle. You may sup with us at our meager camp and rest under the shade of this Palladium shell. Sorry, as well, about the crowding.

strings.string: 幸會，=name=。請原諒我們這處搖籃，呃，有些簡陋。你可以與我們在簡陋的營地共進晚餐，並在這種鈀金外殼的陰影下休息。對於擁擠的情況，也深感抱歉。

string.ID: You don't seem to like your accommodations.

strings.string: 你似乎不太滿意你的住宿。

string.ID: We are called slynth, a people grown one by one from a hydroponic cradle containing a cutting of water lily and empowered by sunslag. We are but a handful of generations old, and kept no written history until I was grown, ah, some number of decades ago.

strings.string: 我們被稱為斯林斯（slynth），是一個從含有睡蓮扦插枝的水培搖籃中，藉由太陽渣（sunslag）的力量逐一成長起來的種族。我們的世代僅有寥寥數代，且直到我於，啊，幾十年前成長之前，都未曾留下任何文字紀錄。

string.ID:
Well enough. We drink the sun's rays, eat what we scavenge, rest under the shell, and it is. Enough.
I read and tinker. Some hunt. Others tend the cradle. Each day is like the next. Every so often, someone leaves.
We, ah, rarely hear from them thereafter. I hope they are all well.

strings.string:
還過得去。我們飲用陽光，吃些撿來的東西，在殼下休息，就這樣度日。足夠了。
我閱讀並 修補匠。有些人狩獵。有些人照料搖籃。每一天都與往常無異。偶爾會有人離開。
我們，啊，在那之後很少再收到他們的消息。我希望他們一切都好。

string.ID: You don't seem happy with the status quo.

strings.string: 你似乎對現狀不太滿意。

string.ID:
To be wholly honest, =name=, I grow frustrated.
We are a young species, grown one by one in yonder sun-touched cradle. Over years, we have increased, but not, ah, not. Not grown.
Look around you. You see it, yes? This hydropon is no settlement.

strings.string:
說實話，=name=，我感到很挫折。
我們是一個年輕的物種，在彼方那沐浴著陽光的搖籃中一個個成長。多年來，我們的數量增加了，但，啊，並沒有。沒有成長。
看看你的四周。你看到了，對吧？這座水耕設施並不是一個定居點。

string.ID: How can I help?

strings.string: 我能如何幫忙？

string.ID:
This is an existential conundrum, =name=, I'm not sure that it could-- ah, wait, no. I am reconsidering.
No, you could help. If you wished. I think.
May I explain?

strings.string:
這是一個存在主義式的難題，=name=，我不確定它是否能夠——啊，等等，不。我正在重新考慮。
不，你可以幫忙。如果你願意的話。我想。
我可以解釋嗎？

string.ID: Please do.

strings.string: 請便。

string.ID: I have changed my mind. Live and drink.

strings.string: 我改變主意了。活下去，盡情飲酒。

string.ID: I don't believe my people wish to stay here, but we have had so little, ah, meaningful contact with other sapient creatures. We have no allies. We have nowhere to go but here.

strings.string: 我不認為我的族人想留在此地，但我們與其他智慧生物的、啊，有意義的接觸實在太少了。我們沒有盟友。除了這裡，我們無處可去。

string.ID: You travel far and wide, do you not? You have the air of a traveling hero! From the epics. As such, you have seen many settlements, likely ingratiated yourself to some.

strings.string: 你走遍了天南地北，不是嗎？你有著旅行英雄的氣息！就像史詩中的人物。因此，你見過許多定居點，可能還與其中某些地方建立了良好的關係。

string.ID: Surely, if you were to intercede on our behalf, some might welcome us? If, ah, let us say three settlements were to offer us shelter, this would grant us both direction and agency. Would you consider being our ambassador? Not unpaid.

strings.string: 肯定地說，如果你能代表我們出面斡旋，或許會有人歡迎我們？如果，啊，假設有三個定居點願意為我們提供庇護，這將賦予我們方向與自主權。你願意擔任我們的使節嗎？當然不是無償的。

string.ID: I will help.

strings.string: 我會幫忙。

string.ID: I decline. Live and drink.

strings.string: 我拒絕。活著並盡情飲酒吧。

string.ID:
Thank you, =name=. I have, ah, I have been crafting a personal project. Of sorts. I promise it to you for this task, and of course the gratitude of a young species.
Return to me after settlements agree to grant us refuge, and I will discuss them with my kin.

strings.string:
謝謝你，=name=。我，啊，我一直在進行一個個人計畫。算是吧。為了這項任務，我向你許下這個承諾，當然還有一個年輕物種的感激之情。
當定居點同意給予我們庇護後，再回來找我，我會與我的族人討論這些。

string.ID: Live and drink. I will return with news.

strings.string: 活下去並盡情飲酒吧。我會帶著消息回來。

string.ID: Come, =name=. It is time.

strings.string: 來吧，=name=。時間到了。

string.ID:
Ah, =name=, Moon and Sun.
Any news of our future home?

strings.string:
啊，=name=，月亮與太陽。
關於我們未來的家園有什麼消息嗎？

string.ID: Yes, I have news about the slynths' sanctuary.

strings.string: 是的，我有關於斯林斯避難所的消息。

string.ID: None yet. Live and drink, Thah.

strings.string: 還沒有。活下去並盡情飲酒吧，塔。

string.ID: Ah! Let us discuss?

strings.string: 啊！我們來談談吧？

string.ID:
Joppa! An historic site. I wasn't sure if, ah, it still existed. As a village.
The quiet of the saltmarshes may be strange to my people, but some have voiced a wish for more peace than the Reef can spare. Thank you for this choice, =name=.

strings.string:
約帕(Joppa)！一個歷史遺跡。我不確定，呃，它是否還存在。作為一個村莊。
鹽沼的寧靜對我族人來說可能很陌生，但有些人表達了希望獲得比礁石區（Reef）更多和平的願望。感謝你做出這個選擇，=name=。

string.ID:
The worshippers of Shekhinah? Fascinating. I, ah, don't know what to think of that.
It may be what my kin need, now I consider it. The Canticles make little sense to me but they are, ah, compelling. More compelling than me, certainly. I will discuss this with the others.

strings.string:
謝基納（Shekhinah）的崇拜者？真引人入勝。我，啊，不知道該如何看待這件事。
現在我想想，這或許是我族人所需要的。《詠唱集》（Canticles）對我來說沒什麼意義，但它們，啊，很有吸引力。當然，比我更有吸引力。我會與其他人討論這件事。

string.ID:
Did you say Barathrumites? So that's how it's pronounced.
Grit Gate is, ah... that's where Q Girl resides, isn't it? She wrote my favorite book, {{W|Disquisition on the Malady of the Mimic}}. I imagine such a home would have a positive effect on my kin. I will speak to them.

strings.string:
你是說 巴拉楚姆信徒 嗎？原來是這麼發音的。
礫門(Grit Gate) 是，啊……那是 Q 女孩 居住的地方，對吧？她寫了我最喜歡的書，《{{W|擬態病論}}》。我想這樣的家園對我的族人會有正面影響。我會去跟他們談談的。

string.ID:
Kyakukya? I didn't realize it had so many syllables.
That's where the, ah, faithful to the ape-god gather, correct? And, uh... Crowsong, as well. I will present this possibility to my people and we will discuss it.

strings.string:
恰庫恰(Kyakukya)？我沒想到它的音節這麼多。
那是，啊，那些忠於猿神的人聚集的地方，對吧？還有，呃……「鴉歌」也是。我會向我的族人提出這個可能性，我們會討論看看。

string.ID:
Ezra is, ah, the village at the base of the Spindle, is it not?
The very cradle of history. Not that my kin have a strong taste for history, but perhaps living amongst fresco and bas-relief will change their, ah, collective outlook?

strings.string:
以斯拉(Ezra) 是，啊，位於 紡錘(Spindle) 底部的村莊，對吧？
那是歷史的搖籃。雖然我的族人對歷史沒有強烈的興趣，但或許生活在壁畫與淺浮雕之中，能改變他們的，啊，集體觀念？

string.ID: Fascinating. I know nothing about these mopango, but any people whose love for learning and discovery defines them are, ah... good, in my opinion. I will discuss this with my kin, and see if they agree.

strings.string: 引人入勝。我對這些 莫龐戈(Mopango) 一無所知，但任何以對學習與探索的熱愛為特徵的民族，在我看來，啊……都是好的。我會與我的族人討論此事，看看他們是否同意。

string.ID:
There is a sadness in, ah... choosing pariahs. Some of my kin dreamed of belonging, and the very word is the antithesis of belonging.
But then, if wanderers look after one another, there is a belonging in that as well. Even alone, we would not be alone. I will offer this choice to the others and we will discuss it.

strings.string:
在，啊……選擇賤民之中存在著一種悲哀。我的一些族人曾夢想著歸屬感，而這個詞本身就是歸屬感的反義詞。
但話說回來，如果流浪者能互相照應，那其中也有一種歸屬感。即便孤身一人，我們也不會是孤獨的。我會將這個選項提供給其他人，然後我們再討論。

string.ID:
The nearby settlement? The one, ah, founded by three svardym and a galgal? I've always been mortally afraid to go there, knowing even the barest facts.
But you say they will accept us? Perhaps I was wrong.

strings.string:
附近的定居點？就是那個，啊，由三位斯瓦迪姆和一位加爾加爾所建立的地方嗎？光是知道那些最基本的資訊，我就一直對去那裡感到極度恐懼。
但你說他們會接受我們？或許我錯了。

string.ID:
Bey Lah is real? Stain me surprised to hear so... I, ah, believed the hindren exclusively diasporic.
There is an undeniable poetry in it, if the slynth should emigrate to a mythical and secretive village. I will discuss this with my kin.

strings.string:
貝拉(Bey Lah) 是真實存在的嗎？聽到這消息我真是驚訝不已……我，啊，一直以為 hindren 僅僅是流散的族群。
如果 斯林斯 真的是遷徙到一個神話般且隱密的村莊，那其中確實蘊含著不可否認的詩意。我會與我的親族討論這件事。

string.ID:
Chavvah? The, ah, the... the tree of life? Allows us joining?
That, that is simply, ah, extraordinary. I will apprise my kin of this, and we will, ah... we will ponder what it may mean for us.

strings.string:
夏瓦(Chavvah)？那個，啊，那個……生命之樹？允許我們加入嗎？
那，那簡直是，啊，非凡的。我會將此事告知我的族人，而我們會，啊……我們會思考這對我們而言意味著什麼。

string.ID: I have made my inquiries. It is time for the slynth to choose a new home.

strings.string: 我已經調查過了。是時候讓斯林斯選擇新家了。

string.ID: The village of Joppa has agreed to accept the slynth as their own.

strings.string: 約帕(Joppa) 村已同意接納 斯林斯 作為他們的一員。

string.ID: The Mechanimists of the Six Day Stilt agreed to accept the slynth as their own.

strings.string: 六日高蹺(Six Day Stilt) 的 機械主義者 同意接納 斯林斯 作為他們的一員。

string.ID: The Barathrumites of Grit Gate agreed to accept the slynth as their own.

strings.string: 礫門的 巴拉楚姆信徒 同意接納 斯林斯 作為他們的一員。

string.ID: The village of Kyakukya has agreed to accept the slynth as their own.

strings.string: 恰庫恰(Kyakukya) 村已同意接納 斯林斯 作為他們的一員。

string.ID: The village of Ezra has agreed to accept the slynth as their own.

strings.string: 以斯拉村已同意接納斯林斯作為他們的一員。

string.ID: The mopango of the Tomb agreed to accept the slynth as their own.

strings.string: 墳墓中的莫龐戈已同意接納斯林斯作為他們的一員。

string.ID: If the slynth choose to wander Qud, the Pariahs have agreed to look after them.

strings.string: 如果 斯林斯 選擇在 卡德(Qud) 漫遊，賤民 已同意照看他們。

string.ID: The Yd Freehold agreed to accept the slynth as their own.

strings.string: 伊德自由領 已同意接納 斯林斯 作為他們的一員。

string.ID: The village of Bey Lah has agreed to accept the slynth as their own.

strings.string: 貝拉(Bey Lah) 村已同意接納 斯林斯 作為他們的一員。

string.ID: The chimes of Chavvah have agreed to accept the slynth as their own.

strings.string: 夏瓦(Chavvah) 的鐘聲已同意接納 斯林斯 作為他們的一員。

string.ID: Let's talk about something else.

strings.string: 我們聊點別的吧。

string.ID:
I read a history once that mentioned =village.name=, taking note of their reverence for =village.sacred= and equal loathing of =village.profane=.
Will my kin accept a life of =village.activity=? I will consult with them.

strings.string:
我曾讀過一段歷史，其中提到了 =village.name=，並注意到他們對 =village.sacred= 的敬畏，以及對 =village.profane= 同樣程度的厭惡。
我的族人會接受 =village.activity= 的生活嗎？我會與他們商議。

string.ID: The village of =village.name= has agreed to accept the slynth as their own.

strings.string: =village.name= 村莊已同意接納斯林斯作為他們的一員。

string.ID: Wanderer, thank you! I will tell my kin of these places. We will convene and discuss, and we will, ah, choose. Please be patient in the meantime.

strings.string: 流浪者，謝謝你！我會告訴我的族人這些地方。我們會集合並討論，然後，啊，做出選擇。在此期間請耐心等待。

string.ID: As you say, Thah. I will return.

strings.string: 如您所言，塔。我會回來的。

string.ID: Moon and Sun, =name=.

strings.string: 月亮與太陽，=name=。

string.ID: It's curious to see you still here, after helping your kin emigrate.

strings.string: 在幫助你的同胞移民後，看到你還留在這裡，真是令人好奇。

string.ID: Why have you asked me to return?

strings.string: 為什麼要我回來？

string.ID: Moon and Sun, Thah.

strings.string: 月亮與太陽，塔。

string.ID: I've been crafting a kind of a relic, a piece of art that serves a purpose and that you can carry on your, ah, your person. I finally finished building it while you were away, and the opportunities you offered us inspired the finishing touches. I'd like you to have it.

strings.string: 我一直在製作一種聖物，一件既具功能性又可以隨身攜帶的藝術品。在你不在的時候，我終於完成了它的製作，而你為我們提供的機會激發了最後的完善靈感。我想把它送給你。

string.ID: I will cherish it. Live and drink.

strings.string: 我會珍惜它的。活下去，盡情飲用。

string.ID:
After some discussion and deliberation, we have come to consensus: Joppa shall be the new home of the slynth. The notion of a lasting, peaceful life with, ah, purpose... this appeals to many of our number, and where better than Abram's very watervine marsh?
Our emigration party departs for the saltmarshes in the morning.

strings.string:
經過一番討論與深思熟慮，我們達成了共識：約帕將成為斯林斯的家園。那種擁有，啊，目標的、持久且和平的生活概念……吸引了我們當中的許多人，還有什麼地方比 Abram 的水藤沼澤更合適呢？
我們的移民隊將於明早出發前往鹽沼。

string.ID:
After some discussion and deliberation, we have come to consensus: most of our number will join the Mechanimist faith, and reside at the Stiltgrounds at the edge of the Mogh'ra'yi.
Our emigration party departs for the Six Day Stilt in the morning.

strings.string:
經過一番討論與深思熟慮，我們已達成共識：我們的大多數成員將加入機械論信條（Mechanimist faith），並居住在莫格拉伊（Mogh'ra'yi）邊緣的高蹺地帶。
我們的移民隊將於明早出發前往 六日高蹺(Six Day Stilt)。

string.ID:
After some discussion and deliberation, we have come to consensus: The new home of the slynth is among the disciples of Barathrum. My kin have agreed to dedicate themselves to the pursuits of learning and service.
Our emigration party departs for Grit Gate in the morning.

strings.string:
經過一番討論與深思熟慮，我們已達成共識：斯林斯的新家將落腳於巴拉楚姆的弟子之中。我的族人已同意致力於追求知識與服務。
我們的移民隊將於明晨出發前往礫門。

string.ID:
After some discussion and deliberation, we have come to consensus: Kyakukya shall be the new home of the slynth. There are many ways to grow when one is planted in the very heart of Qud.
Our emigration party departs for the river in the morning.

strings.string:
經過一番討論與深思熟慮，我們已達成共識：恰庫恰(Kyakukya) 將成為 斯林斯 的新家園。當一個人植根於 卡德(Qud) 的核心時，總有許多成長的方式。
我們的移民隊將於明早出發前往河流。

string.ID:
After some discussion and deliberation, we have come to consensus: The new home of the slynth is among the villagers of Ezra, harvesting musa alongside the banana ranchers and singing their songs.
Our emigration party departs for Omonporch in the morning.

strings.string:
經過一番討論與深思熟慮，我們已達成共識：斯林斯的家園將定居於艾茲拉村民之中，與香蕉牧場主一同採收 musa 並吟唱他們的歌謠。
我們的移民隊將於明晨出發前往歐蒙波奇。

string.ID:
After some discussion and deliberation, we have come to consensus: the slynth shall become mopango, taking root in ancient rock and casting our gaze back toward the history that preceded us.
Our emigration party departs for the Tomb of the Eaters in the morning.

strings.string:
經過一番討論與深思熟慮，我們已達成共識：slynth 將轉變為 mopango，在古老的岩石中紮根，並讓我們將目光投向先於我們的歷史。
我們的移民隊將於明早出發前往食者之墓（Tomb of the Eaters）。。

string.ID:
After some discussion and deliberation, we have come to consensus: The new home of the slynth is no home at all, but the floating fellowship of Qud's Pariahs. We were blessed with roots that need not fix themselves to the soil and have opted to use them accordingly.
We will split into parties and leave to meet with other wayfarers come morning.

strings.string:
經過一番討論與深思熟慮，我們已達成共識：slynth 的新家並非真正的家園，而是 Qud 棄民們那漂浮的夥伴關係。我們天賦異稟，擁有無需固定於土壤的根系，並決定以此方式生活。
我們將分成小隊，在明晨出發去與其他的旅人會合。

string.ID:
After some discussion and deliberation, we have come to consensus: the slynth shall join the Yd Freehold, remaining in the reef where our cradle lies but mingling among other sapient creatures to learn their ways and teach what we know.
Our emigration party departs for the Freehold in the morning.

strings.string:
經過討論與深思熟慮後，我們達成了共識：斯林斯 將加入 伊德自由領，留在我們搖籃所在的礁石區，但也會與其他智慧生物往來，學習他們的習俗並傳授我們的知識。
我們的移民隊將於明晨出發前往自由領。

string.ID:
After some discussion and deliberation, we have come to consensus: Bey Lah shall be the new home of the slynth. There is a familiarity to this tucked-away village, newly greeting the world; this is our gentle emergence from obscurity, and one not undertaken alone.
Our emigration party departs for the flower fields in the morning.

strings.string: 經過一番討論與審議，我們已達成共識：貝拉(Bey Lah) 將成為 斯林斯 的新家園。這個剛向世界露面的隱蔽村落帶有一種熟悉感；這是我們從默默無聞中溫柔地浮現，且並非孤身一人。

string.ID:
After some discussion and deliberation, we have come to consensus: the slynth shall become a part of Chavvah, the living city. There are no words for the breadth of futures before us, and we would not know them if they were. Perhaps we will learn to chime.
Our emigration party departs for the moon stair in the morning.

strings.string:
經過一番討論與斟酌，我們已達成共識：斯林斯將成為夏瓦——這座活生生的城市的一部分。面對眼前的廣闊未來，我們無以言表，即便有字也無法描述。或許我們會學會鳴響。
我們的移民隊將於明晨前往月之階梯。

string.ID:
After some discussion and deliberation, we have come to consensus: the slynth shall become citizens of =village.name=. We shall learn the practice of =village.activity=, hold =village.sacred= dear and spurn =village.profane=.
Our emigration party departs for =village.name= in the morning.

strings.string:
經過一番討論與斟酌，我們達成了共識：斯林斯將成為 =village.name= 的公民。我們將學習 =village.activity= 的實踐，珍視 =village.sacred= 並唾棄 =village.profane=。
我們的移民隊伍將於明早出發前往 =village.name=。

string.ID: May the Argent Fathers watch over you.

strings.string: 願銀色之父（Argent Fathers）守護著你。

string.ID: May you find knowledge.

strings.string: 願你獲取知識。

string.ID: May Oboroqoru be merciful.

strings.string: 願 奧博羅科魯 憐憫。

string.ID: May the Eaters protect you.

strings.string: 願食者（Eaters）庇佑你。

string.ID: Mayest thou rest ever in the Light of the Kasaphescence.

strings.string: 願你永遠安息在卡薩菲森斯之光中。

string.ID: May the winds favor you.

strings.string: 願清風眷顧你。

string.ID: Chime joyfully.

strings.string: 愉快地鳴響。

string.ID: May the Fates favor you.

strings.string: 願命運眷顧你。

string.ID:
Ah, one last little thing, =name=. About your reward... it's not quite finished, but now I know just what it needs.
Please return to the hydropon after my kin have safely reached their new home and I will give it to you. I will not leave the cradle.

strings.string:
啊，最後還有一件小事，=name=。關於你的報酬……它還沒完全完成，但我現在知道它需要什麼了。
請在我的族人安全抵達新家後回到水耕區，屆時我會把它交給你。我不會離開搖籃。

string.ID: I will. Live and drink.

strings.string: 我會的。活下去並盡情飲酒吧。

string.ID:
Yes, I've decided to stay. It's not that, ah, it's not that I wouldn't enjoy a life of farming. But the thought of leaving the cradle after decades of watching it... I couldn't.
The hydropon is even less a village now, but you're welcome to rest here whenever you like.

strings.string:
是的，我決定留下來。並不是因為，啊，並不是因為我不喜歡農耕生活。而是想到在觀察了幾十年後要離開這片搖籃……我做不到。
現在水耕區甚至不像個村莊了，但隨時歡迎你來這裡休息。

string.ID:
Yes, I've stayed. I don't, ah, resent that my kin have found succor in the embrace of faith, but I don't know how to walk that path myself. Someone needs to watch over the hydropon, besides.
The hydropon is even less a village now, but you're welcome to rest here whenever you like.

strings.string:
是的，我留下來了。我不，啊，怨恨我的族人在信仰的懷抱中找到了慰藉，但我自己不知道該如何走那條路。此外，還需要有人照看水耕設施。
現在的水耕設施甚至稱不上是個村莊了，但隨時歡迎你來這裡休息。

string.ID:
Yes, I've stayed. I'd love to see the vaunted halls and, ah, bathe in the light of brilliant minds, but when I think about the journey my roots lock up. I feel, ah, unready. Someone must watch over the cradle, besides.
The hydropon is even less a village now, but you're welcome to rest here whenever you like.

strings.string:
是的，我留下來了。我很想看看那些受人推崇的大廳，啊，沐浴在卓越思想的光芒中，但一想到旅程，我的根系就會僵硬。我覺得，啊，還沒準備好。此外，必須有人看守搖籃。
現在水耕區甚至不像個村莊了，但隨時歡迎你來這裡休息。

string.ID:
Yes, I've decided to stay. It's not that, ah, it's not that I wouldn't enjoy sharing knowledge with the mayor of our new home. But the thought of leaving the cradle after decades of watching it... I couldn't.
The hydropon is even less a village now, but you're welcome to rest here whenever you like.

strings.string:
是的，我決定留下來。並不是因為，啊，並不是因為我不樂意與我們新家園的市長分享知識。但想到在觀察了幾十年之後要離開這片搖籃……我做不到。
現在的水耕區甚至稱不上是一個村莊，但只要你願意，隨時歡迎在此休息。

string.ID:
Yes, I've stayed. As fascinated as I would be to examine the statuary and bas-reliefs, my favorite mode of, ah, interaction with history is through the written word. Someone must watch over the cradle, besides.
The hydropon is even less a village now, but you're welcome to rest here whenever you like.

strings.string: 是的，我留下來了。雖然我也會對研究那些雕像和淺浮雕感到著迷，但我最喜歡的、呃，與歷史互動的方式是透過文字。此外，總得有人守護這搖籃。

string.ID:
Yes, I've decided to stay. The Tomb sounds, ah, cozy, but I cannot fathom making such a macabre place my home. Someone must look over the cradle, besides.
The hydropon is even less a village now, but you're welcome to rest here whenever you like.

strings.string:
是的，我決定留下來。墳墓聽起來，呃，很溫馨，但我無法想像把那樣一個陰森恐怖的地方當作家園。此外，還必須有人照看搖籃。
現在水耕區甚至稱不上是個村莊了，但隨時歡迎你來這裡休息。

string.ID:
Yes, I've stayed. If I am entirely honest, the idea of a life on the road sounds, ah... unpleasant. To me, personally. I have grown accustomed to a life of collection, curation, and study that I don't care to abandon for adventure. Someone must stay to watch over the cradle, besides.
The hydropon is even less a village now, but you're welcome to rest here whenever you like.

strings.string:
是的，我留下來了。說實話，流浪生活聽起來，啊……很不愉快。對我個人而言是如此。我已經習慣了收集、策展與研究的生活，我不打算為了冒險而放棄它。此外，總得有人留下守護搖籃。
現在水耕區甚至稱不上是個村莊，但隨時歡迎你來這裡休息。

string.ID:
Yes, I've decided to stay. I don't disbelieve that the Yd Freehold is as safe as you say, but the fears instilled in me when I first learned to read as a fresh sprout haunt me even now. Perhaps in time I will visit, but in the meantime I can look after the cradle, as someone ought to do.
The hydropon is even less a village now, but you're welcome to rest here whenever you like.

strings.string:
是的，我決定留下來。我不認為你所說的伊德自由領不安全，但當我還是個初生嫩芽、剛學會閱讀時，那些植入我腦中的恐懼至今仍縈繞不去。或許隨著時間推移我會去拜訪，但在那之前，我可以履行應盡的責任，照看這座搖籃。
現在水耕區甚至稱不上是一個村莊，但隨時歡迎你來這裡休息。

string.ID:
Yes, I've decided to stay. The flower fields sound beautiful, and no doubt there is much to learn from the hindren. But the thought of leaving the cradle after decades of watching it... I couldn't.
The hydropon is even less a village now, but you're welcome to rest here whenever you like.

strings.string:
是的，我決定留下來。花田聽起來很美，而且毫無疑問可以從那些後裔身上學到很多。但想到在守望了數十年之後要離開這片搖籃……我做不到。
現在的水耕區甚至稱不上是個村莊了，但隨時歡迎你來這裡休息。

string.ID:
Yes, I, ah, I remain.
I badly wish to taste of Chavvah's secrets, but the wonder I feel for such an entity is eclipsed only by the terror of such an experience. I cling to an excuse that the hydropon must be watched and wait. Perhaps someday I will shed that excuse's film and step free.
The hydropon is even less a village now, but you're welcome to rest here whenever you like.

strings.string:
是的，我，啊，我會留下。
我極度渴望品嚐夏瓦的秘密，但我對那種存在所感到的敬畏，唯有面對那種體驗時的恐懼能將其掩蓋。我緊抓著「必須照看水耕區」這個藉口等待著。或許有一天，我會撕掉這層藉口的薄膜，邁步走向自由。
現在水耕區甚至稱不上是一個村莊，但隨時歡迎你來這裡休息。

string.ID:
Yes, I've decided to stay. I'm sure =village.name= is a good home for my kin, but I have no particular loathing for =village.profane= and even less reverence for =village.sacred=. Someone must look over the cradle, besides.
The hydropon is even less a village now, but you're welcome to rest here whenever you like.

strings.string: 是的，我決定留下來。我相信 =village.name= 會是我族人的好家園，但我對 =village.profane= 並無特別厭惡，對 =village.sacred= 更是敬畏不足。此外，總得有人來守護搖籃。

string.ID: Moon and Sun, Thah.

strings.string: 月亮與太陽，塔。
啊？

string.ID: New creature. Live and drink.

strings.string: 新生物。活著，並飲水。

string.ID: Sky... sun... ah.

strings.string: 天空⋯⋯太陽⋯⋯啊。

string.ID: {{emote|*stares mutely*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*沉默地凝視著*}}
打招呼。

string.ID: No glow?

strings.string: 沒有光嗎？

string.ID: No leaf...

strings.string: 沒有葉子...

string.ID: Ah... ha ha ha! Joke.

strings.string: 啊……哈哈哈哈！開玩笑的。

string.ID: Do you talk long, like Thah?

strings.string: 你會說很久嗎，就像塔一樣？

string.ID: Let us, ah, do not fight.

strings.string: 讓我們，啊，不要爭吵。
無聊。

string.ID: You carry so much.

strings.string: 你背負了太多。

string.ID: Drink and. Live. Hah!

strings.string: 飲酒，然後。活下去。哈！

string.ID: Is okay?

strings.string: 還可以嗎？

string.ID: Ahh... nervous ... excited.

strings.string: 啊……既緊張……又興奮。

string.ID: Happy do not fight here.

strings.string: 快樂的人不在此戰鬥。

string.ID: Ah ha ha... nervous!

strings.string: 啊哈哈...好緊張！

string.ID: Stay here?

strings.string: 待在這裡？

string.ID: =player.FormalAddressTerm= stay also?

strings.string: =player.FormalAddressTerm= 也要留下嗎？

string.ID: Strange new.

strings.string: 奇特的新事物。
