string.ID: This is home.

strings.string: 這裡是家。

string.ID: Welcome here.

strings.string: 歡迎來到這裡。

string.ID: Good meeting.

strings.string: 很高興見到你。

string.ID: Ah... good.

strings.string: 啊⋯⋯很好。

string.ID: We chose our new home well.

strings.string: 我們選了一個很棒的新家。

string.ID: Happy here.

strings.string: 在此很開心。

string.ID: Ha ha ha! Joyful!

strings.string: 哈哈哈！真快樂！

string.ID: Ah =player.formalAddressTerm= visit, good.

strings.string: 啊，=player.formalAddressTerm= 來訪了，很好。

string.ID: Care you to trade?

strings.string: 想交易嗎？

string.ID: I aggress not.

strings.string: 我不具攻擊性。

string.ID: You peaceful, =player.formalAddressTerm=?

strings.string: 您很和平，=player.formalAddressTerm=?

string.ID: Wish trade?

strings.string: 想要交易嗎？

string.ID: Good scavenge?

strings.string: 撿到好東西了嗎？

string.ID: Ah! You seem wanderer. How fare?

strings.string: 啊！你看起來像個流浪者。近況如何？

string.ID: Live and grow, =player.formalAddressTerm=.

strings.string: 生存並茁壯成長吧，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

string.ID: =player.FormalAddressTerm=, I greet in peace.

strings.string: =player.FormalAddressTerm=，我帶著和平之意向您致意。
啊？

string.ID: Greet, =player.formalAddressTerm=.

strings.string: 問候您，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

string.ID: Who are you?

strings.string: 你是誰？

string.ID: I am of slynth, a people grown by hydropon.

strings.string: 我來自斯林斯，一個透過水耕培育而成的民族。

string.ID: What are slynth?

strings.string: 什麼是 斯林斯？

string.ID: What is a hydropon?

strings.string: 什麼是水耕植物？

string.ID: I see. Live and drink.

strings.string: 我明白了。盡情生活，盡情飲酒。

string.ID:
What see. Leg plant, glow crest.
Grow from sun-crungled hydropon and depart siblings.

strings.string:
所見之物。腿狀植物，發光冠冕。
從太陽灼傷的水耕設施中生長，並離開同胞。

string.ID: What is a hydropon?

strings.string: 什麼是水耕植物？

string.ID:
Cradle glaze in sun-melt. Plant stuff molded to man-shape.
Within grow slynth. Only slynth, now.

strings.string:
搖籃在陽光融化中閃爍著釉光。模塑成人類形狀的植物。
其中生長著斯林斯。現在只有斯林斯。

string.ID: Where is the hydropon?

strings.string: 水耕設施在哪裡？

string.ID: What are slynth?

strings.string: 什麼是 斯林斯？

string.ID:
The cracked egg from we crawl yet rest, in the Reef.
Siblings there. One speak very well: Thah.

strings.string:
我們從裂開的蛋中爬出，卻在礁岩中棲息。
那裡有同胞。其中一個說得很流利：塔。

string.ID: Perhaps I shall visit. Live and drink.

strings.string: 或許我會去拜訪。活下去，盡情飲酒。

string.ID: Welcome to the village of *villageName*, =spice.commonPhrases.adventurer.!random=

strings.string: 歡迎來到 *villageName* 村，=spice.commonPhrases.adventurer.!random=

string.ID: Is that so? I imagine you are wondering whether =village.name= will host these slynth, to partake in =village.activity= alongside us.

strings.string: 是嗎？我想你一定在想 =village.name= 是否會接納這些 斯林斯，讓他們能與我們一同參與 =village.activity=。

string.ID: You have done much for =village.name=, =name=, and your request befits your stature. If these slynth will join us in =village.activity= and if they can come to cherish =village.sacred= as we do, then they are welcome here.

strings.string: 你為 =village.name= 做了很多，=name=，你的請求與你的地位相稱。如果這些 斯林斯 會加入我們的 =village.activity=，且他們能像我們一樣珍視 =village.sacred=，那麼這裡歡迎他們。

string.ID: You have my thanks, friend.

strings.string: 謝謝你，朋友。

string.ID: We have not come so far from the founding of =village.name= to allow these strangers in. What if they worship =village.profane=? No, we simply cannot do such a great favor for you.

strings.string: 自 =village.name= 建立以來，我們走了這麼遠，絕不能讓這些陌生人進來。萬一他們崇拜 =village.profane=? 不，我們實在無法為你們提供如此大的恩惠。

string.ID: Do you have news of the slynth?

strings.string: 你有關於斯林斯的消息嗎？

string.ID: Ah, =name=, the slynth are here, and it is a slow process for these plant-folk and the people of =village.name= to grow accustomed to one another. By the goodness of =village.sacred= may the slynth find their place here soon.

strings.string: 啊，=name=，斯林斯就在這裡，而這些植物人與 =village.name= 的居民要習慣彼此需要一段時間。願憑藉著 =village.sacred= 的仁慈，讓斯林斯能早日在此找到歸屬感。

string.ID: My thanks, =subject.t=.

strings.string: 謝謝你，=subject.t=。

string.ID: Praise =village.sacred=, the slynth learn our ways and we theirs. Some do not wholly accept the depravity of =village.profane=, but their ways are born of kindness, and so =village.name= will be kind in kind.

strings.string: 讚美 =village.sacred=，斯林斯學習我們的習俗，我們也學習他們的。有些人並不完全接受 =village.profane= 的墮落，但他們的行徑源於仁慈，因此 =village.name= 也將以仁慈回報仁慈。

string.ID: My thanks again, =subject.t=.

strings.string: 再次感謝你，=subject.t=。

string.ID: We share the bright and now, traveler =name=.

strings.string: 我們共享著光輝，而現在，旅人 =name=。

string.ID: What is this place?

strings.string: 這是什麼地方？

string.ID: Who are you?

strings.string: 你是誰？

string.ID: The entity I spoke with at Eyn Roj mentioned a chiming rock...

strings.string: 我在恩羅傑交談過的那個實體提到了鳴響石...

string.ID: Explain once more what I must do with Tau's chime.

strings.string: 再解釋一次我該如何處理 Tau 的鈴鐺。

string.ID: I've reunited Tau with her chime.

strings.string: 我已經讓 Tau 與她的鐘聲重聚了。

string.ID: I've destroyed the chime, Dyvvrach.

strings.string: 我已經摧毀了鐘聲，迪夫拉克。

string.ID: I have completed the ritual of -elseing. Will you power Barathrum's starclimb, as you said?

strings.string: 我已經完成了「-轉生儀式」的儀式。你會如你所說的那樣，為巴拉楚姆的星攀（starclimb）注入力量嗎？

string.ID: I come in the name of need. Barathrum asks the strength of your psyche to power our starclimb.

strings.string: 我因需求而來。巴拉楚姆(Barathrum) 要求你的心靈強度，以驅動我們的星際攀升（starclimb）。

string.ID: This keter roams above my trunk at Eyn Roj, traveler =name=, and across the Stair I dream. You found me, this keter where I chime in dozens.

strings.string: 這隻 keter 在恩羅傑 的我軀幹上方徘徊，旅人 =name=，並在階梯彼端讓我夢迴。你找到了我，這隻在我鳴響成群之處的 keter。

string.ID: Ah, I am in need, and so I turned my chimes trunkward to tune. You struck the chime and now you are here. Are you a waterhand, and free?

strings.string: 啊，我正有所需求，因此我將風鈴轉向鐘塔以進行調音。你敲響了風鈴，現在你就在這裡。你是水手（waterhand），而且是自由身嗎？

string.ID: What do you need?

strings.string: 你需要什麼？

string.ID:
My chimeling Tau leaves Chavvah, leaves me. It is her choice.
Her transit-psyche manifests at the bottom of Taproot, where we cannot consciously go. To finish the ritual of -elseing, to let Tau become -else, I need a traveler such as you, =name=.

strings.string:
我的奇美拉族（chimeling）陶（Tau）離開了夏瓦，離開了我。這是她的選擇。
她的轉移心靈顯現於根源（Taproot）的底部，那是我們無法有意識抵達的地方。為了完成「他者化」（-elseing）儀式，讓陶成為「他者」，我需要像你這樣的旅人，=name=。

string.ID: What must I do?

strings.string: 我該做什麼？

string.ID: Who is Tau?

strings.string: 陶是誰？

string.ID:
Take Tau's chime, silent and still. Carry it to the bottom of Taproot, deep under my trunk, where she will make the chime her transit-body and walk away forever. Finish the ritual of -elseing.
At the bottom of Taproot, Tau manifests. She tells us, too, that another waits for her there.

strings.string:
取走 Tau 的鐘聲，靜謐而沉寂。將它帶到 Taproot 的底部，在我樹幹深處，在那裡她會將鐘聲作為她的過渡之軀，並永遠離去。完成「非此」的儀式。
在 Taproot 的底部，Tau 顯現了。她也告訴我們，另一個人正在那裡等著她。

string.ID: I will do as you ask.

strings.string: 我會照你要求的去做。

string.ID: I have more to ask, first.

strings.string: 首先，我還有更多事要問。

string.ID:
Take Tau's chime, silent and still. Carry it to the bottom of Taproot, deep under my trunk, where she will make the chime her transit-body and walk away forever. Finish the ritual of -elseing.
At the bottom of Taproot, Tau manifests. She tells us, too, that another waits for her there.

strings.string:
取走 Tau 的鐘聲，靜謐而沉寂。將它帶到 Taproot 的底部，在我樹幹深處，在那裡她會將鐘聲作為她的過渡之軀，並永遠離去。完成「非此」的儀式。
在 Taproot 的底部，Tau 顯現了。她也告訴我們，另一個人正在那裡等著她。

string.ID:
So you have, and what proceeds, proceeds.
I felt your coming here, =name=, in Gyredream. I've felt this moment. I feel it now.
The ritual of -elseing is complete, waterhand. You are done, and with our thanks.

strings.string:
既然如此，那就隨它去吧。
我在 Gyredream 中就感覺到你的到來了，=name=。我早已預感到了這一刻。我也正感受著它。
-轉生儀式 的儀式已經完成，水手（waterhand）。你已圓滿達成任務，並獲得我們的謝意。

string.ID: Thank you, traveler =name=.

strings.string: 謝謝你，旅人 =name=。

string.ID: My chimeling, burning bright, all starlight and right angles in her heart. She leaves Chavvah; it is her choice. I..

strings.string: 我的奇美林，閃耀著光芒，她的心中滿是星光與直角。她離開了 夏瓦(Chavvah)；這是她的選擇。我..

string.ID: What must I do?

strings.string: 我該做什麼？

string.ID:
A sophist of the Self spilled ink and called me, long ago, the Tree of Life. To me, I am the many Selves pinched up my taproot from the permeating Soft.
I am Chavvah, and I am dyvvrach.

strings.string:
很久以前，一位自我的詭辯家潑灑了墨水，稱我為生命之樹。對我而言，我是從滲透的「軟體」中，由我的主根所擷取的眾多自我。
我是 夏瓦(Chavvah)，也是 迪夫拉克。

string.ID: Many selves? What does this mean?

strings.string: 許多自我？這是什麼意思？

string.ID: As Chavvah I am many. As dyvvrach I am one. I am one and many. One-selves have called me tree city, the sentient place. You may think of the Selves this way, sprouted in keter from Twofirm.

strings.string: 作為 夏瓦(Chavvah) 我是眾多；作為 迪夫拉克 我是一體。我是合一也是眾多。那些「自我」稱我為樹城，一個有意識的地方。你可以這樣看待這些「自我」，它們從 Twofirm 在 keter 中萌芽。
兩倍？

string.ID: Deep under earth and permeating our roots is Soft, our feeling substance. Ground pressure pushes it up the taproot to our trunk, where it condenses into Twofirm: the biformal phase that contains the two sefirots, -then and -else.

strings.string: 深埋於大地並滲透我們的 根系 之中的是「柔」，那是我們的感官物質。地壓將其從主根推向我們的樹幹，在那裡它凝聚成「雙實」：包含兩個瑟菲羅特（sefirots）——「當時」與「否則」的雙態階段。

string.ID: *continue listening*

strings.string: *繼續聆聽*

string.ID: This is the genesis my distinct Self, an awareness that contains both -then, what I will become, and -else, what I will not. Twofirm flows up my sapwood to the keter, where -then manifests as an entity and I chime: I speak and hear the world.

strings.string: 這是我的獨特自我之起源，一種包含「若——則」我將成為之物，以及「否則——」我將不會成為之物的意識。兩股流向沿著我的木質部向上流向冠層（keter），在那裡，「若——則」顯化為一個實體，而我發出鳴響：我說話，並聆聽世界。

string.ID: {{emote|*Dyvvrach chimes*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*迪夫拉克 chimes*}}

string.ID:
You have completed the ritual of -elseing. You have set bright Tau free.
Yes, =name=. I will turn my chimes Spindleward to tune, then vibrate at our verve frequency. I will power your starclimb.
Be vested to tell whoever you must that Chavvah has made this commitment.

strings.string:
你已完成了 -轉生儀式 的儀式。你釋放了明亮的 Tau。
是的，=name=。我會將我的風鈴轉向紡車方向進行調音，然後以我們的活力頻率震動。我會為你的星際攀升提供動力。
請務必告知任何你需要的人，夏瓦(Chavvah) 已做出了這項承諾。

string.ID: Thank you, Dyvvrach. Live and drink.

strings.string: 謝謝你，迪夫拉克。盡情生活與飲酒吧。

string.ID: I start at this but Tikva settles me. I remember now: from a cub I've known Barathrum to be weak in telling but bold in asking. A starclimb? You mean, an ascent to the long chiming rock?

strings.string: 我以此開始，但 提克瓦 讓我平靜下來。我現在想起來了：從我認識巴拉楚姆還是幼崽時起，他就知道如何示弱，卻也敢於索求。星際攀升？你是說，向著漫長的 鳴響石 之升騰嗎？

string.ID: Barathrum intends to ascend the Spindle to discover the source of the Signal, yes. He needs a power source for the climber, one shielded from electromagnetic disturbance.

strings.string: 巴拉楚姆打算登上 紡錘(Spindle) 以尋找信號的源頭，沒錯。他需要一個攀爬器的動力源，且必須能屏蔽電磁干擾。

string.ID: oh. This. Was this felt in gyredream? Your coming to keter? I ask, do not answer.

strings.string: 喔。這。這是在旋轉夢境中感受到的嗎？你來到了 keter？我問，但請不要回答。

string.ID: What is gyredream?

strings.string: 什麼是旋夢(gyredream)？

string.ID:
A future shock. My chimeling _ is vision-gifted, a lichen who clings to shorerock on the straits of Tomorrow. Just a short time ago a sea wave crested and broke beneath her, and she saw in its recession all the bright and violent channel paths.
We all felt it. A recoming, and the gyre in final tension. I felt...

strings.string:
一個未來的震撼。我的奇美林（chimeling） _ 擁有天賦視覺，她是附著在「明日」海峽岸邊岩石上的地衣。就在不久前，一道海浪在她身下翻騰破碎，她在退潮中看見了所有明亮而狂暴的河道路徑。
我們都感受到了。一種重臨，以及 環流(Gyre) 在最終的張力之中。我感覺到...

string.ID: *continue listening*

strings.string: *繼續聆聽*

string.ID: It was too much for my chimeling Tau. She gasped for air and her chime stilled. She leaves us now, to become -else. It is her choice.

strings.string: 這對我的鐘鳴族 Tau 來說負擔太重了。她喘不過氣，她的鐘聲也隨之靜止。她現在離開了我們，去成為「他者」。這是她自己的選擇。

string.ID: I am sorry. But will you help Barathrum do as he asks?

strings.string: 我很抱歉。但你會幫 巴拉楚姆(Barathrum) 照他要求的去做嗎？

string.ID: I am sorry. But will you help Barathrum do as he asks?

strings.string: 我很抱歉。但你會幫 巴拉楚姆(Barathrum) 照他要求的去做嗎？

string.ID: {{emote|*Dyvvrach chimes*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*迪夫拉克 chimes*}}

string.ID: I will power his starclimb. If you take Tau's chime to taproot, for her to walk away. If you finish the ritual of -elseing.

strings.string: 我將為他的星攀（starclimb）注入力量。若你帶著陶（Tau）的鐘聲前往根鬚，讓她離去。若你完成了「非此」（-elseing）的儀式。

string.ID: The ritual of -elseing?

strings.string: -轉生儀式 的儀式？

string.ID: I see.

strings.string: 我明白了。

string.ID: {{emote|*Dyvvrach chimes*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*迪夫拉克 chimes*}}

string.ID: Again I must be calmed, but the startling gives way to a curiosity. You speak of the glowfolk, belimbed and free. You asking that they join us, like our Sant?

strings.string: 我必須再次平靜下來，但驚愕轉化成了好奇。你說到了那些擁有肢體且自由的光芒族（glowfolk）。你是要求他們加入我們，就像我們的 Sant 一樣嗎？

string.ID: We find no precedent for this, yet is there space upon our crystal arms and an openness within us. It is agreed: if these slynth will be of us, we will have them here.

strings.string: 我們找不到先例，但我們的水晶手臂仍有空間，內心也保持開放。大家達成共識：如果這些斯林斯要加入我們，我們就在這裡接納他們。

string.ID: You all have my thanks.

strings.string: 感謝各位。

string.ID: I startle, and the roiling is felt before the calm. I cannot find a consensus for the housing of these beings, =name=. I am sorry.

strings.string: 我感到驚嚇，在平靜降臨前感受到了一陣翻騰。我無法就這些生物的安置達成共識，=name=。我很抱歉。

string.ID: We await the decision of the glowfolk. Our imaginations run with the possibilities.

strings.string: 我們正等待著發光族（glowfolk）的決定。我們的想像力已隨著各種可能性飛馳。

string.ID:
How this keter rustles! The slynth are among us and we adapt, our impressions a melange of excitement, apprehension, and wonder.
Though I have no single sentiment to express, we nonetheless approach -then with our new companions.

strings.string:
這 keter 搖曳得真美！斯林斯 在我們之中，而我們正在適應，我們的感受是興奮、憂慮與驚奇的混合體。
雖然我無法表達單一的情感，但我們仍帶著我們的新夥伴前行。

string.ID: My thanks, dyvvrach.

strings.string: 謝謝你，迪夫拉克。

string.ID: You are well-found, =name=. Though several have chosen their -else, the first of the slynth have joined to us like our Sant, mobile and apart but shared and together. This is a strange -then, but what branches may spill forth from it? I anticipate the witnessing.

strings.string: 你已準備就緒，=name=。雖然有幾個人選擇了「他方」，但首批 斯林斯 已加入我們，如同我們的 Sant 一般，靈動且獨立，卻又共享且共存。這是一個奇特的「轉折」，但從中會分支出什麼樣的枝椏呢？我期待見證這一刻。

string.ID: Live and drink together, Chavvah.

strings.string: 一起生活與飲酒吧，夏瓦(Chavvah)。

string.ID: Strange creatures can be so cruel and arbitrary, I say in greeting.

strings.string: 「奇怪的生物有時是如此殘酷且隨心所欲，」我打招呼時說道。

string.ID: Tau has departed.

strings.string: Tau 已離去。

string.ID: I see you.

strings.string: 我看到你了。

string.ID: Tau has departed.

strings.string: Tau 已離去。

string.ID:
I do not know how to remember beloved Tau, struggling like a minnow in Soft. In a place between death and living.
Leave me, please.

strings.string:
我不知道該如何記住親愛的 Tau，就像在 Soft 中掙扎的小魚一樣。在那處於生與死之間的地方。
請離開我。

string.ID: No parting is simple. I see you, -elser.

strings.string: 離別從不簡單。我注視著你，-elser。

string.ID: Tau has completed the -elseing ritual.

strings.string: Tau 已完成了「-轉生儀式」儀式。

string.ID:
And the sole tether she reached for severed. I mourn for the future she built for herself, now, and worry for Tau herself.
Thank you, all the same, for taking part in this. May you find your comfort.

strings.string:
而她所伸手抓取的唯一紐帶也斷裂了。我為她曾為自己建立的未來感到哀悼，並為陶（Tau）本人感到憂慮。
無論如何，感謝各位參與其中。願你們找到屬於自己的慰藉。

string.ID: You are welcome. I yet have questions.

strings.string: 不客氣。但我還有疑問。

string.ID: No parting is simple. I see you, fair -elser.

strings.string: 離別從不簡單。我看到了你，美麗的 -elser。

string.ID: Tau has completed the -elseing ritual.

strings.string: Tau 已完成了「-轉生儀式」儀式。

string.ID: You are welcome. I yet have questions.

strings.string: 不客氣。但我還有疑問。

string.ID: Oh? A traveler? I see you, then. Live... and drink.

strings.string: 喔？一名旅者？那我瞧見你了。活下去……並盡情飲用吧。

string.ID: I am =name=. Who are you?

strings.string: 我是 =name=。你是誰？

string.ID: Your chime is cracked and ribboned on inside with starless clouds. Why?

strings.string: 你的鐘聲已破碎，且在內部被無星的雲朵所纏繞。為什麼？

string.ID: Were you affected by gyredream?

strings.string: 你受到旋夢（gyredream）影響了嗎？

string.ID: I am to carry Tau's chime to Taproot, so she can leave Chavvah.

strings.string: 我必須將 Tau 的鐘帶到 Taproot，這樣她才能離開 夏瓦(Chavvah)。

string.ID: Oh? Please, then, friend, ask.

strings.string: 喔？那麼，朋友，請說吧。

string.ID:
{{emote|*Miryam chimes in deep tones.*}}
I am Miryam, friend.

strings.string:
{{emote|*米里亞姆 以低沉的音調回應著。*}}
我是米里亞姆，朋友。

string.ID:
{{emote|*Miryam chimes in long tones.*}}
It's the kriah, traveler. I am in mourning, and I chime in low tones.

strings.string:
{{emote|*米里亞姆 發出長音。*}}
這是克里亞（kriah）哀悼期，旅人。我正處於哀悼之中，所以發出低沉的鳴響。

string.ID: I am sorry, Miryam. Did you lose someone close to you?

strings.string: 我很抱歉，米里亞姆。你失去身邊親近的人了嗎？

string.ID:
{{emote|*Miryam chimes in deep tones.*}}
I swim in cool and dark waters, traveler. For me, it is Shiva, the lament of seven thousand years.
I mourn the passing of all life, and all the necessity of death life must bring. For you, traveler, to come here, how many had to die? I mourn them.
Or are you the rarest one, who walks below the bright arches and claims no such cost? Even then, what losses did {{M|you}} suffer to come, traveler? What selves of yours had you to shed? Those are -else to us, and I mourn them as well.

strings.string:
{{emote|*米里亞姆 以低沉的音調介入。*}}
我游弋在冰冷而幽暗的水域中，旅人。對我而言，那是希瓦，是七千年的哀歌。
我哀悼所有生命的逝去，以及生命必須帶來的死亡之必然。對於你，旅人，來到這裡時，有多少人必須死去？我為他們哀悼。
或者你是最罕見的那種人，行走在明亮的拱門之下卻無需付出這樣的代價？即便如此，{{M|你}}為了抵達此地承受了什麼損失，旅人？你不得不捨棄多少個自我？對我們而言那些都是——別人的事，而我也同樣為他們哀悼。

string.ID: *continue listening*

strings.string: *繼續聆聽*

string.ID:
{{emote|*Miryam chimes in aching tones.*}}
...but, too, someone close. Tau. Bright tau. She is gone.

strings.string:
{{emote|*米里亞姆以哀傷的語調插話。*}}
……但是，也有一個親近的人。陶（Tau）。明亮的陶。她不在了。

string.ID: *continue listening*

strings.string: *繼續聆聽*

string.ID: {{emote|*Miryam chimes in aching tones.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*米里亞姆以隱隱作痛的語調插話。*}}

string.ID:
{{emote|*Miryam chimes in melodic tones.*}}
Oh? You would finish the -elseing act?
I am your debtor, =name=. The ritual is how we organize the anguished practice of being. Now my grieving can begin.
Bright Tau shines always, here or there.

strings.string:
{{emote|*米里亞姆 以旋律般的音調鳴響。*}}
喔？你想完成那場「否則」的演出嗎？
我是你的債務人，=name=。儀式是我們組織那痛苦存在的實踐方式。現在，我的哀悼可以開始了。
明亮的陶（Tau）無論在此或彼，始終閃耀。

string.ID: {{emote|*The chiming rock burns in soft light.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*鳴響石在柔和的光芒中燃燒著。*}}

string.ID: ...what are you?

strings.string: ...你到底是什麼？

string.ID: [Touch the chiming rock and attune to Chavvah.]

strings.string: [觸碰 鳴響石 並與 夏瓦(Chavvah) 同調。]

string.ID:
{{emote|*The chiming rock rings a sonorous tone.*}}
Touch the chiming rock and seek me at the keter. Will you?

strings.string:
{{emote|*鳴響石 發出洪亮的聲響。*}}
觸碰 鳴響石，並在 keter 尋找我。你願意嗎？

string.ID: What does that mean?

strings.string: 那是什麼意思？

string.ID: {{emote|*The chiming rock is silent and still.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*鳴響石靜默且沉寂。*}}

string.ID: {{emote|*You are already attuned.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*你已然契合。*}}

string.ID:
{{emote|*The chime rings a bone-shaking alarm.*}}
Is this a taunt? A challenge? What cruelty drives you to attempt communication after what you have done?

strings.string:
{{emote|*鐘聲響起，發出令人骨頭顫抖的警報。*}}
這是嘲諷嗎？還是挑戰？在你做了那些事之後，是什麼樣的殘酷驅使你試圖進行溝通？

string.ID: How do you feel about Tau's departure?

strings.string: 對於 Tau 的離去，你感覺如何？

string.ID: Your mockery disgusts me. You disgust me. I will not be calmed, Tikva!

strings.string: 你的嘲弄令我作嘔。你令我作嘔。我不會平靜下來的，提克瓦！

string.ID:
{{emote|*The chime rings a knell.*}}
O gesticulating hand.

strings.string:
{{emote|*鐘聲敲響了喪鐘。*}}
噢，那揮舞著的手。

string.ID: How do you feel about Tau's departure?

strings.string: 對於 Tau 的離去，你感覺如何？

string.ID:
We are adrift now. I will seek signs of her, or whatever she becomes. What do you care?
Do not answer.

strings.string:
我們現在漂流著。我會尋找她的蹤跡，或是她將會變成什麼樣的存在。你在乎嗎？
不必回答。

string.ID:
{{emote|The chime rings loud and sharp.}}
Heavy the hand. Heavy the head.

strings.string:
{{emote|鐘聲響得既大且尖銳。}}
手沉重，頭亦沉重。

string.ID: Tau has completed her -elseing.

strings.string: Tau 已經完成了她的——「他者化」（elseing）。

string.ID:
I wonder how it must feel to be =name=, so loath to see the pen of fate in another's grasp that you see fit to wrench it away. Does it bring exultation of control, or relief from a gnawing insecurity?
Do not answer. I will not be calmed. Ask if asking.

strings.string:
我很好奇身為 =name= 是什麼感覺，如此不忍看著命運之筆落在他人手中，以至於你覺得有必要將其奪走。這會帶來掌控的狂喜，還是從揮之不去的焦慮中解脫？
不要回答。我不會被安撫。若要問，才准問。

string.ID: I do have questions, still.

strings.string: 我還是有些疑問。

string.ID:
You. I roil to see you. I welcome you. I churn.
Do you know this weight, I wonder? Can you?

strings.string:
你。見到你，我心潮澎湃。我歡迎你。我翻騰著。
我在想，你是否了解這種重量？你能嗎？

string.ID: Tau has completed the -elseing ritual.

strings.string: Tau 已完成了「-轉生儀式」儀式。

string.ID:
I am torn asunder! This outcome, this outcome, the shear splits me. Why Ptoh? How? Has this always been us? Which of us yet carry this -else to reify under pressure to our extancy?
Do not answer. There is no word-answer, and perhaps none at all. You have done us a service and I thank you for this -elseing.

strings.string:
我心碎神傷！這個結果，這個結果，將我徹底撕裂。為什麼是 普托(Ptoh)? 為什麼？我們一直以來都是如此嗎？我們之中還有誰帶著這份——「他物」，在壓力之下將其具象化到我們的存在之中？
不要回答。沒有言語上的答案，或許根本沒有答案。妳為我們提供了服務，我感謝妳的這次——「他物化」。

string.ID: You are welcome. I yet have questions.

strings.string: 不客氣。但我還有疑問。

string.ID:
{{emote|*the chime rings a sharp, urgent gonging tone*}}
Entity! You are given persistent will and agency, twice-hewn architecture of body and strong fiber that pulls. You bolt upright and damp-haired into fullness, your grasp abrading the threads of existence. Your responsibility remains whether acknowledged or not. Have strength, the time is now.

strings.string:
{{emote|*鐘聲響起，發出尖銳而緊急的鑼聲*}}
實體！你被賦予了持久的意志與自主權，那是身體與強韌纖維構成的雙重建築。你猛然坐起，濕漉漉的頭髮顯得有些狼狽，你的感知正磨擦著存在的絲線。無論是否被承認，你的責任依然存在。保持力量，時機已至。
抱歉？

string.ID: I am =name=. Who are you?

strings.string: 我是 =name=。你是誰？

string.ID: I am =name=. Who are you?

strings.string: 我是 =name=。你是誰？

string.ID: Is something the matter?

strings.string: 出什麼事了嗎？

string.ID: Is all this about gyredream?

strings.string: 這一切都與 環流之夢 有關嗎？

string.ID: I am to carry Tau's chime to Taproot, so she can leave Chavvah.

strings.string: 我必須將 Tau 的鐘帶到 Taproot，這樣她才能離開 夏瓦(Chavvah)。

string.ID: I accept. Ask if asking.

strings.string: 我接受。若要詢問請提問。

string.ID:
{{emote|*the chime rings again, echoing louder in the walls of your mind*}}
Hear me! It is more important than ever to know that you are a driver, reforged and honed. You tool yourself to apply selective atrocity. It cannot be helped. You shape this, your path bloody and blooming. You start in sleep and shake the ground.
All must, but you most of all. The weight may have been negligent once, but it is terribly heavy now.
Do you accept responsibilty?

strings.string:
{{emote|*鐘聲再次響起，在你的腦海牆壁中迴盪得愈發響亮*}}
聽著！知道自己是個被重塑與磨練過的驅動者，比以往任何時候都更重要。你將自己工具化，以施展選擇性的暴行。這也是無可奈何的事。你塑造了這一切，讓你的道路血跡斑斑且繁花盛開。你在沉睡中開始，並震動大地。
眾生皆然，但你更是如此。那份重量或許曾被忽視，但現在卻沉重得可怕。
你接受責任嗎？

string.ID: I do.

strings.string: 我做。

string.ID: I do not.

strings.string: 我不。
什麼？

string.ID:
Yet, what you break is broken. -else is not -then regardless of will. This way split me again from Tikva, sundered early the love I knew, the denial. Our cowardice.
Ignore this digression. Ask, if asking.

strings.string:
然而，你所破碎的即是破碎。——無論意志如何，否則便非如此。這再次使我與提克瓦分離，割裂了我曾熟知的愛，那份否定。我們的懦弱。
忽略這段離題的話。若要詢問，請開口。

string.ID: You loved another chime?

strings.string: 你愛上了另一個鐘鳴者嗎？

string.ID:
You are encysted as Tikva, just as they! Milky white keratinous thoughts melt to a sick mass, wrapped in a protective membrane. I tremble. So it is.
Ask, if asking.

strings.string:
你正像他們一樣，以 Tikva 的身分被囊封著！乳白色的角質思緒融化成一團病態的物質，包裹在保護性的薄膜中。我顫抖著。原來如此。
若要詢問，便請發問。

string.ID: That's disgusting.

strings.string: 真噁心。

string.ID: What's that about Tikva?

strings.string: 關於 提克瓦 的那是怎麼回事？

string.ID: Just as Tikva, you turn away from your self-disgust. Yet, it is you and within you. You contain that you cannot tolerate.

strings.string: 就像 提克瓦 一樣，你轉身避開了對自我的厭惡。然而，那正是你，且存在於你的內心之中。你包含了你自己無法容忍的部分。

string.ID:
{{emote|*Tzedech emits a powerful, body-thrumming chime*}}
Yes. You understand destroying. You know the weight. We are past time of querulous inquisition, of confessions on lined parchment. Was the whole of this in your weight? It no longer matters. Scale the firmament, smite or soothe what rouses there.

strings.string:
{{emote|*策德赫發出一聲強大、令身體震顫的鳴響*}}
是的。你明白毀滅的意義。你了解那份重量。我們早已過了那些抱怨式審問與在橫線羊皮紙上寫下供詞的時代。這一切都在你的責任之中嗎？那已不再重要。攀登蒼穹，擊碎或撫慰在那裡甦醒的事物。

string.ID:
{{emote|*the chime rings clear and loud*}}
This called Tzedech. Compass, judgment, motivation. Once lover of Tikva, apart now after gyredream.

strings.string:
{{emote|*鐘聲清脆而響亮地響起*}}
這被稱為策德赫。指南針、判斷、動力。曾是提克瓦的愛人，在旋夢之後如今已分開了。

string.ID: You were another chime's lover?

strings.string: 你是另一位鐘鳴者的戀人？

string.ID:
{{emote|*Tzedech chimes, buzzing with agitation*}}
Twofirm roils in me with the enormity. Can it contain so much gone and unremunerated? Tau, Tikva, and more to come. Consumed, we, and paralyzed.

strings.string:
{{emote|*策德赫 叮噹作響，因焦躁而嗡嗡作動*}}
巨大的規模在我心中翻騰著兩股力量。它能容納如此多已逝去且未獲報酬的事物嗎？Tau, 提克瓦, 以及更多即將到來的事。我們被吞噬，並陷入癱瘓。

string.ID:
It consumes me. I witnessed so little from the weave of outcomes. If I could remember them all, could I influence the course? Would I know what safe means? Too many questions with no conceivable answer. Was your rekindling the spark that caught fire? I do not know.
We are adrift.

strings.string:
它吞噬了我。我在結果的織網中僅見到了如此微小的片段。如果我能記住所有的一切，我能否影響進程？我會知道什麼叫做安全嗎？有太多無法想像答案的問題。你的重燃是否就是那點燃火焰的火星？我不知道。
我們正漂流不定。

string.ID:
Tau. We ache in her empty space. Who awaits at taproot? What fate is this?
This is the path. Be wary.

strings.string:
Tau。我們在她的 真空空間 中感到痛苦。誰在根部等待？這是什麼命運？
這是道路。務必小心。

string.ID:
Tikva. Once lover, now foil, perhaps lover again.
Its light invites and overwhelms, a hope blind and blinding. Cruel frustration at storm-time. When its eyes are needed they turn away. I will not be calmed. I will not be calmed!

strings.string:
提克瓦。曾經是愛人，現在是對照，或許會再次成為愛人。
它的光芒既誘惑又令人窒息，是一種盲目且致盲的希望。風暴時分的殘酷挫折。當需要它的眼睛時，它卻轉向一旁。我不會平靜下來。我絕不會平靜下來！

string.ID: How can chimes in a tree be lovers?

strings.string: 樹上的風鈴怎會是戀人？

string.ID: You'll be together again?

strings.string: 你們會再次在一起嗎？

string.ID: I should go. Live and drink.

strings.string: 我該走了。去生活，去飲酒。

string.ID:
You are terribly small. Your love, small. Confined.
I cannot will not uplift your little concept. Do it yourself.

strings.string:
你太渺小了。你的愛，也如此渺小。受限且侷促。
我不會、也不願提升你那微小的概念。自己去實現吧。

string.ID:
As seasons cycle, so Chavvah cycles. We are not as you, our love is not as you. But it is come early, this winter. Gyredream shakes us.
This is insufficient and I cannot bridge understanding. Consider questions of greater utility.

strings.string:
隨著季節輪轉，夏瓦(Chavvah) 也隨之循環。我們不像你們，我們的愛也不像你們。但這個冬天來得太早了。旋夢（Gyredream）震撼著我們。
這還不夠，我無法 橋 理解。請考慮更有實用價值的問題。

string.ID:
{{emote|*the sound of the chime rings querulous and faint, its light flickering.*}}
Please… no…

strings.string:
{{emote|*鐘聲聽起來抱怨且微弱，其光芒閃爍不定。*}}
請……不要……

string.ID: Tau has departed.

strings.string: Tau 已離去。

string.ID: It ignores the monster. It ignores it. It ignores it.

strings.string: 它無視那隻怪物。它無視它。它無視它。

string.ID:
{{emote|*the sound of the chime rings querulous.*}}
The light shines upon you but illuminates nothing. It quails.

strings.string:
{{emote|*鐘聲發出抱怨般的鳴響。*}}
光芒照耀著你，卻無法照亮任何事物。它在畏縮。

string.ID: Tau has departed.

strings.string: Tau 已離去。

string.ID: It stares into the light and wishes away the monster.

strings.string: 它凝視著光芒，祈求怪物消失。

string.ID: Relief, relief. Relief from the void, safety from its creases.

strings.string: 解脫，解脫。從虛空中解脫，從其褶皺中獲得安全。

string.ID: How do you feel about Tau's departure?

strings.string: 對於 Tau 的離去，你感覺如何？

string.ID:
The light shines so bright, the voidshadow folds not upon it. It exults. It relaxes. It wills this troubled feeling away.
Thank you for clearing Tau's path, =name=. This is better.

strings.string:
光芒如此耀眼，虛空之影無法在其上籠罩。它在歡欣，它在放鬆。它正試圖驅散這份不安的感覺。
謝謝你為 Tau 開闢道路，=name=。這樣好多了。

string.ID: You are welcome. I yet have questions.

strings.string: 不客氣。但我還有疑問。

string.ID: It is happy, it lies. It swells to witness Tau's choice, in pantomime of shared joy.

strings.string: 它是快樂的，它在撒謊。它膨脹著以見證 Tau 的選擇，如同對共同喜悅的默劇表演。

string.ID: How do you feel about Tau's departure?

strings.string: 對於 Tau 的離去，你感覺如何？

string.ID:
It wills this troubled feeling away. It looks to the light with something in its eyes. It tries to blink the something away, but it cannot. The light is dim through the something in its eyes.
But the light yet shines. It will blink and it will see the light in searing glory. I thank you, I thank you, I thank you.

strings.string:
它將這份不安感驅散。它的眼中閃爍著某種東西，凝視著光芒。它試圖眨眼以驅除那種感覺，卻無濟於事。透過眼中那種東西，光芒顯得黯淡無光。
但光芒依然閃耀。它會眨眼，並在灼熱的榮光中看見光芒。我感謝你，我感謝你，我感謝你。

string.ID: You are welcome. I yet have questions.

strings.string: 不客氣。但我還有疑問。

string.ID:
{{emote|*the chime rings a long, clarion tone.*}}
You are as beautiful as imagined. You ring with a shining purpose. This chime is awed to bask in your presence.

strings.string:
{{emote|*鐘聲響起，發出悠長而清脆的音調。*}}
妳正如想像中那般美麗。妳帶著閃耀的使命感共鳴著。這口鐘因能沐浴在妳的身影中而感到敬畏。

string.ID: I am =name=. Who are you?

strings.string: 我是 =name=。你是誰？

string.ID: Your chime shines with such painful light.

strings.string: 妳的鳴響閃爍著如此痛苦的光芒。

string.ID: Were you affected by gyredream?

strings.string: 你受到旋夢（gyredream）影響了嗎？

string.ID: I am to carry Tau's chime to Taproot, so she can leave Chavvah.

strings.string: 我必須將 Tau 的鐘帶到 Taproot，這樣她才能離開 夏瓦(Chavvah)。

string.ID: Yes. It looks into the light with you.

strings.string: 是的。它與你一同注視著光芒。

string.ID:
{{emote|*the chime rings again*}}
It is called Tikva, low and humble. The chime rests in a web of strong love, a little piece of something greater and so much more beautiful. As are you, but a gestalt unto yourself. A world to be orbited.

strings.string:
{{emote|*鐘聲再次響起*}}
它被稱為提克瓦，低微而謙遜。鐘聲棲息在強大愛情的網絡中，是某種更偉大、更美麗事物的微小碎片。你也一樣，但你是屬於你自己的整體。是一個值得環繞的世界。

string.ID: It channels the breathtaking things seen and heard and known. Bathe your senses in it until they grow accustomed. You will see nothing else.

strings.string: 它引導著所見、所聞與所知的壯麗事物。讓你的感官沐浴其中，直到它們變得習慣。你將不再看見其他任何東西。

string.ID:
{{emote|*the chime rings, a querulous and tinny sound*}}
It... can scarce find the dream in this light. It thinks of Tzedech and weeps. It was not here, last time the static was in high pitch, but it remembers the pain and fear. It is not ready to feel these, it cannot. Gaze into its light and speak not of nightmares.

strings.string:
{{emote|*鐘聲響起，發出抱怨般且刺耳的金屬聲*}}
它……在這光芒下幾乎無法尋得夢境。它想起了策德赫並流淚了。上次靜電頻率升高時它並不在這裡，但它記得那種痛苦與恐懼。它還沒準備好去感受這些，它做不到。凝視它的光芒時，請不要談論噩夢。
策德赫?

string.ID: 'Your' Tzedech?

strings.string: 「你的」策德赫？

string.ID: {{emote|*A long chime rings. The bed of a shallow creek teems with brief life.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*一聲長鳴響起。淺溪的河床裡湧動著短暫的生命。*}}

string.ID: Tau has met her fate.

strings.string: Tau 已迎來她的宿命。

string.ID: {{emote|*You tumble from the jar, your sinewy body twisting against the electric emptiness in your belly, the weight of eggs. You discover a morsel and consume it soft and delicious. You will spawn here. You will eat the morsels. Your babies will eat all of the morsels.}}

strings.string: {{emote|*你從罐中跌落，你那筋骨強健的身軀在腹部電力的空虛感中扭動著，那是蛋的重量。你發現了一塊碎屑並溫柔美味地將其吞下。你將在此產卵。你會吃掉這些碎屑。你的寶寶會吃光所有的碎屑。}}

string.ID: I... have more to ask you.

strings.string: 我……還有更多事要問你。

string.ID: {{emote|*A long chime rings. The bed of a shallow creek teems with life and death, nature's self-consuming ouroboros.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*一聲長鳴響起。淺溪的河床充滿了生與死，如同大自然自我吞噬的銜尾蛇。*}}

string.ID: Tau is gone.

strings.string: Tau 已消失。

string.ID: {{emote|*Wielding an oversized jar in little hands, a child tips it into the running current of a softly burbling creek. Tiny creatures that had been living in the jar spill into the creek, protected from the killing current by a clump of slimy biofilm. The child peers at a little fry swimming in the jar.}}

strings.string: {{emote|*一個孩子用小手握著一個巨大的罐子，將它傾倒進緩緩流動、發出咕嚕聲的小溪中。原本住在罐子裡的小生物們湧入溪流，受到一團黏糊糊的生物膜保護，免於被致命的水流沖走。孩子凝視著罐子裡游動的一條小魚}}

string.ID: I... have more to ask you.

strings.string: 我……還有更多事要問你。

string.ID: {{emote|*A long chime rings. The bed of a shallow creek teems with life and death, nature's self-consuming ouroboros.}}

strings.string: {{emote|*一聲長鳴響起。淺溪的河床充滿了生與死，宛如大自然自我吞噬的銜尾蛇。}}

string.ID: Tau has completed the -elseing ritual.

strings.string: Tau 已完成了「-轉生儀式」儀式。

string.ID:
{{emote|*From the banks of a shallow creek, you watch a toad floating on the water, belly up. It flails, helpless against even the gentle current of the water in which you placed it seconds ago. You watch it float away, toward the rushing currents ahead.
Helpless to myriad unknowable fates, the toad disappears from view into the rapids, sent there by your hand.*}}

strings.string:
{{emote|*在淺溪的岸邊，你注視著一隻肚皮朝上、漂浮在水面上的蟾蜍。它胡亂地掙扎著，面對幾秒前被你放入的那股輕微水流也顯得無力招架。你注視著它隨波逐流，向著前方湍急的水流漂去。
面對無數無法預知的命運，這隻蟾蜍在你的手下，消失在激流之中，沒入視線之外。*}}

string.ID: I... have more to ask you.

strings.string: 我……還有更多事要問你。

string.ID: {{emote|*A long chime rings. The bed of a shallow creek teems with life and death, nature's self-consuming ouroboros.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*一聲長鳴響起。淺溪的河床充滿了生與死，如同大自然自我吞噬的銜尾蛇。*}}

string.ID: Tau has completed the -elseing ritual.

strings.string: Tau 已完成了「-轉生儀式」儀式。

string.ID: {{emote|*From the mouth of the jar in your little hands, you watch a frog leap into the water of a softly burbling creek. The gentle current sweeps the frog's little body away to an unknown fate as curious crayfish peek out from their hiding places. The jar in your hands is empty.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*從你小手裡的罐口看去，你注視著一隻青蛙跳進了輕輕潺潺的小溪中。溫柔的流水將青蛙嬌小的身體沖向未知的命運，而好奇的小螯蝦正從隱蔽處窺視著。你手中的罐子空了。*}}

string.ID: I... have more to ask you.

strings.string: 我……還有更多事要問你。

string.ID:
{{emote|*the chime rings*}}
{{emote|*In your mind's eye, you see yourself touching a mirror. You tap the glass and it ripples like the surface of a placid lake.*}}

strings.string:
{{emote|*鐘聲響起*}}
{{emote|*在你的心靈之眼中，你看到自己正觸碰著一面鏡子。你輕敲玻璃，它像平靜湖泊的表面一樣泛起漣漪。*}}

string.ID: Your name is pronounced as the pause between two words, friend. How do I know this?

strings.string: 朋友，你的名字讀音就像是兩個單字之間的停頓。我怎麼知道的？

string.ID: Tell me of gyredream.

strings.string: 告訴我關於旋夢（gyredream）的事。

string.ID: I am to carry Tau's chime to Taproot, so she can leave Chavvah.

strings.string: 我必須將 Tau 的鐘帶到 Taproot，這樣她才能離開 夏瓦(Chavvah)。

string.ID: {{emote|*The moment stretches on into a steep asymptote, the peaks and valleys of possible outcomes speeding by in an imaginary blur. You imagine the sound of a tiny metal thread brushing across the bottom of a dusty valley, amplified a thousand times.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*那一刻不斷延伸，化作一條陡峭的漸近線，各種可能結果的高峰與低谷在想像的模糊中疾馳而過。你想像著一根微小的金屬絲劃過塵封山谷底部的聲音，被放大了千倍。*}}

string.ID: {{emote|*the entity chimes, and you witness water lapping at the long edge of a pebble beach. Slowly, the tide brushes clean the surface of each rock, etching time's passage onto millions of tiny canvases. Somewhere, something dies.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*該實體發出叮嚀聲，你目睹海水拍打著鵝卵石海灘的長岸。潮汐緩慢地刷洗著每一塊岩石的表面，將時間的流逝刻劃在數百萬個微小的畫布上。在某處，某物正在死去。*}}

string.ID: {{emote|*Your entire self buzzes at the sound of _'s chime, a shock from the center and radiating outward. Sensation bubbles up to the surface, a tightening of the self. It is as if cresting a great hill atop a cathedra or an oncoming witchwood overdose; the void yawns under you. Something terrible is born.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*當 _ 的鐘聲響起時，你的全身都在震顫，那是一種從中心迸發並向外擴散的衝擊。感官湧向表面，自我變得緊繃。彷彿正翻越座教座頂端的高山，或是迎來一場巫林過量；虛空在你腳下張開巨口。某種恐怖的事物正在誕生。*}}

string.ID: I don't understand. What could it mean?

strings.string: 我不明白。這可能意味著什麼？

string.ID: Let... let us speak of other things.

strings.string: 讓……讓我們談談別的事吧。

string.ID: Excuse... excuse me.

strings.string: 抱歉...不好意思。

string.ID: {{emote|*You are a little sapfly resting in the crook of a swarmshade tree. The boughs stretch in great barkish deserts before exploding into a tangle of branches. Your brethren buzz in an agitated cloud, feeling fear or excitement or hunger. Something buzzes beyond the leafy reaches of your sight, all-consuming but unclear.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*你是一隻小小的樹汁蠅，正棲息在 一棵 群影樹 的彎曲枝幹上。樹枝在爆裂成糾結的枝椏前，向外延伸成巨大的樹皮荒漠。你的同類在焦躁的雲霧中嗡嗡作響，感受著恐懼、興奮或飢餓。在你的視線範圍之外，有某種東西正在嗡嗡作響，那股力量吞噬一切卻又模糊不清。*}}

string.ID: I... wish to speak of other things.

strings.string: 我……想談談別的事。

string.ID: I will think on this... live and drink.

strings.string: 我會思考這件事……活下去，盡情飲酒。

string.ID: {{emote|*Just as you activate an artifact listening device that ceased to exist centuries ago, you hear the end of an emotional song. The space between relief and sorrow throbs with uncomfortable tension. You ache with it.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*就在你啟動了一個已在數世紀前消失的文物聽音裝置時，你聽到了一首情感充沛之曲的尾聲。那種介於解脫與悲哀之間的空隙，正隨著令人不安的張力而悸動。你因之感到隱隱作痛。*}}

string.ID:
Shivering stillness, coldbark pricking with each thump.
It comes.

strings.string:
顫抖的寂靜，寒皮在每一次重擊中刺痛。
它來了。

string.ID: Tau has departed.

strings.string: Tau 已離去。

string.ID:
Can you feel the stillness? The drycrackle of space between as you thump my crystal arms.
Life flees you. Motion flees you.

strings.string:
你能感覺到那份寂靜嗎？當你敲擊我的水晶手臂時，空間在你之間發出乾裂的聲響。
生命正從你身邊逃離。律動正從你身邊逃離。

string.ID:
{{emote|*the chime rings a long and pensive tone.*}}
How something stirs, deep in Soft.

strings.string:
{{emote|*鐘聲迴盪著悠長而沉思的音調。*}}
某種東西在「柔」的深處蠢蠢欲動。

string.ID: Tau has departed.

strings.string: Tau 已離去。

string.ID: Soft churns Tau in beingstuff. She will -then, but perhaps not Taulike.

strings.string: Tau 在存在物質中輕柔地攪動。她會——接著，但或許不會像 Taulike 那樣。

string.ID:
{{emote|*through the chime you hear an echoing cacophony, muted by distance and matter.*}}
How we ring with it. Your kicksoft drowns under the beat of our selfcries.

strings.string:
{{emote|*隨著鐘聲，你聽到一陣迴盪的嘈雜聲，因距離與物質而顯得沉悶。*}}
我們隨之共鳴。你的輕聲細語淹沒在我們自我哀嚎的節奏之下。

string.ID: Tau has completed the -elseing ritual.

strings.string: Tau 已完成了「-轉生儀式」儀式。

string.ID:
{{emote|*the chime is hard to distinguish from the rising cacophony.*}}
Crungled allway. Soft reaches through the bounds of everyshape and afflicts us with fireless hotbark. It resonates through Tau's cavernous absence. Arid tearsalt dries between the Lovers.

strings.string:
{{emote|*那鐘聲難以與漸起的嘈雜聲區分。*}}
萬物皆已崩解。柔和的力量穿透了所有形狀的邊界，使我們遭受無火之熱皮之苦。它在 Tau 的空洞虛無中迴盪。乾涸的淚鹽在戀人們之間乾燥。

string.ID: I have questions.

strings.string: 我有問題。

string.ID:
{{emote|*through the chime you hear an echoing cacophony, muted by distance and matter.*}}
How we ring with it. Your kicksoft drowns under the beat of our selfcries.

strings.string:
{{emote|*隨著鐘聲，你聽到一陣迴盪的嘈雜聲，因距離與物質而顯得沉悶。*}}
我們隨之共鳴。你的輕聲細語淹沒在我們自我哀嚎的節奏之下。

string.ID: How does Tau's departure find you?

strings.string: 陶（Tau）的離去，對你而言感覺如何？

string.ID:
{{emote|*the chime is hard to distinguish from the rising cacophony.*}}
Crungled allway. Soft reaches through the bounds of everyshape and afflicts us with fireless hotbark. It resonates through Tau's cavernous absence. Touchloss blooms, each facet trembling for shearpull.

strings.string:
{{emote|*鐘聲已難以從漸起的嘈雜聲中分辨出來。*}}
萬物皆在崩解。柔軟的力量穿透了所有形狀的界限，並以無火之熱皮令我們受苦。它在陶（Tau）那空洞的存在中迴盪。觸感喪失正在蔓延，每一面都在為撕裂而顫抖。

string.ID: I have questions.

strings.string: 我有問題。

string.ID: Who thumps my crystal arms, and kicksofts me at windfall? I feel you here, friend.

strings.string: 是誰在敲擊我的水晶手臂，並在豐收時將我踢開？朋友，我感覺到你在這裡。

string.ID: I am =name=. Who are you?

strings.string: 我是 =name=。你是誰？

string.ID: You... feel me?

strings.string: 你……能感覺到我嗎？

string.ID: Did you experience the gyredream?

strings.string: 你經歷過旋轉之夢（gyredream）嗎？

string.ID: I am to carry Tau's chime to Taproot, so she can leave Chavvah.

strings.string: 我必須將 Tau 的鐘帶到 Taproot，這樣她才能離開 夏瓦(Chavvah)。

string.ID:
{{emote|*there is an agitation in Thicksalt's accepting chime.*}}
Pluck the air, then, with your mouth sounds.

strings.string: {{emote|*厚鹽的接受鐘聲中傳來一陣騷動。*}}

string.ID:
{{emote|*Thicksalt chimes a single, outstretched tone.*}}
The naming act is imponderable. So Tau called me Thicksalt, one brickword in a towerful poem whose everyshape I forget, but whose flushing of Soft in afterfeel I am in allway.

strings.string:
{{emote|*厚鹽 敲響了一聲悠長而單調的音調。*}}
命名的行為是難以揣測的。所以 Tau 稱我為厚鹽，這是一首塔式詩篇中的一個磚塊詞，我忘記了它所有的形狀，但在餘韻中那種對「柔」的湧動感，卻始終與我同在。

string.ID: *continue listening*

strings.string: *繼續聆聽*

string.ID:
...
{{emote|*Thicksalt chimes in gentle tones.*}}

strings.string:
...
{{emote|*厚鹽 以柔和的語調插話。*}}

string.ID: {{emote|*Tammuz chimes a quiet tone.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*塔姆茲 發出一聲輕微的鳴響。*}}

string.ID:
{{emote|*Tammuz is nearly silent but for a soft, shaky resonance*}}
...

strings.string: {{emote|*塔姆茲幾乎保持沉默，只發出輕微且顫抖的共鳴聲*}}

string.ID: Tau is gone.

strings.string: Tau 已消失。

string.ID: You m-m-moon king. Madhand.

strings.string: 你是月亮之王。瘋手（Madhand）。

string.ID:
{{emote|*the chime rings shaky and loud*}}
Wh-what is this? H-how is it meant? This outcome j-judders within and w-without us.

strings.string:
{{emote|*鐘聲搖晃且響亮地鳴響著*}}
這、這是什麼？這、這該怎麼辦？這個結果讓我們內外都感到震顫。

string.ID: Tau has departed.

strings.string: Tau 已離去。

string.ID: Wh-what will Tau b-be after soft? You, did, did you mean... wh-what c-could you say? Tau spins within, the g-gyre spins without.

strings.string: Tau 在柔軟之後會變——變成什麼？你，你是說……你剛才說了什麼？Tau 在內旋，g-環流(Gyre) 在外旋。

string.ID:
{{emote|*Tammuz chimes a querulous tone*}}
O-oh. Elsefolder... th-this path you have l-laid upon Tau, it-it is best. It is good? P-please be good.

strings.string:
{{emote|*塔姆茲 發出抱怨的鳴響*}}
喔——喔。Elsefolder... 你在 Tau 上鋪設的這條路，它、它是最好的。它是好的嗎？請務必是好的。

string.ID: How does Tau's departure find you?

strings.string: 陶（Tau）的離去，對你而言感覺如何？

string.ID:
{{emote|*Tammuz's chime rings even quieter and more tremulous*}}
Un, un-uncertain. Tau l-leaves unfolded but the g-g-g-gyre yet s-spins. The s-spinning leaves me dizzy.

strings.string:
{{emote|*塔姆茲的 chime rings even quieter and more tremulous*}}
不、不確定。陶的葉子展開了，但環流還在旋轉。這旋轉讓我感到暈眩。

string.ID: I have questions.

strings.string: 我有問題。

string.ID:
{{emote|*Tammuz rings a wavering chime*}}
Y-you are here. Elseing h... hand.

strings.string:
{{emote|*塔姆茲 搖響了顫動的鈴鐺*}}
你、你在這裡。艾爾辛的手……手。

string.ID: How does Tau's departure find you?

strings.string: 陶（Tau）的離去，對你而言感覺如何？

string.ID:
{{emote|*the chime is louder this time, but just as querulous*}}
Sh-sh-she, th-this fate, it. It is a d-deep dark. Will Tau f-fold herself, I wonder?

strings.string:
{{emote|*這一次鐘聲更響了，但同樣地尖銳刺耳*}}
命、命運，這件事。它是一片深沉的黑暗。我好奇 Tau 會不會因此而蜷縮起來？

string.ID: I have questions.

strings.string: 我有問題。

string.ID:
{{emote|*Tammuz chimes a broad and booming tone.*}}
You! Purpose-driven mad... madhand. You've come here, right? Then you must know power is our... the domain of being is one of power, wouldn't you say? W-Would you please agree with that?

strings.string:
{{emote|*塔姆茲鳴響了寬廣且洪亮的音調。*}}
你！目標明確的瘋... 瘋狂之手。你來到這裡了，對吧？那麼你一定知道力量是我們的... 存在的領域即是力量，你不這麼認為嗎？請、請你同意這點好嗎？

string.ID: I am =name=. Who are you?

strings.string: 我是 =name=。你是誰？

string.ID: Did you experience the gyredream?

strings.string: 你經歷過旋轉之夢（gyredream）嗎？

string.ID: I am to carry Tau's chime to Taproot, so she can leave Chavvah.

strings.string: 我必須將 Tau 的鐘帶到 Taproot，這樣她才能離開 夏瓦(Chavvah)。

string.ID: If y-y, th-that... yes. Ask if, if asking.

strings.string: 如果、如、如果那樣……是的。問問看，如果想問的話。

string.ID:
{{emote|*Tammuz quiets, then chimes in tottering, unsure tones.*}}
You beast! You m-moon king! You... Our roars are beastial! Would you say so?

strings.string:
{{emote|*塔姆茲 靜了下來，接著搖搖晃晃地加入對話，語氣猶豫不決。*}}
你這畜生！你這——月之王！你... 我們的咆哮是野獸般的！你會這麼說嗎？

string.ID: This is all nonsense.

strings.string: 這全是胡言亂語。

string.ID: You sound very unsure of yourself.

strings.string: 你聽起來非常缺乏自信。

string.ID: {{emote|*Tammuz makes a hollow peep.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*塔姆茲 發出一聲空洞的啾啾聲。*}}

string.ID: Be uncertain, friend. You have my permission.

strings.string: 保持謹慎，朋友。我准許你了。

string.ID: {{emote|*Tammuz is silent and still.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*塔姆茲 保持沉默且靜止。*}}

string.ID: I will give you a moment.

strings.string: 我會給你們一點私人空間。

string.ID:
{{emote|*Tammuz chimes a small and bright noise.*}}
Ta- Tammuz. Who becomes. Who is Twofirm even in -then.

strings.string:
{{emote|*塔姆茲 發出了一聲清脆的小響聲。*}}
塔— 塔姆茲。成為者。即便在——之後，Twofirm 是誰。
兩倍？

string.ID:
The t-two sephirots. -then and -else. I cannot be -else. *I* cannot, of course. But -then? It does not seem so.
Their chimes ring at the right frequencies, others. But not so, mine.

strings.string:
t-二 賽菲羅特（sephirots）。「然後」與「否則」。我無法成為「否則」。*我*當然不行。但「然後」呢？似乎並非如此。
其他的鐘聲頻率都對，但我的卻不對。
兩倍？

string.ID:
{{emote|*Tammuz quivers and chimes a jarring tone.*}}
O-Oh. Oh u-uh oh oh. By contrasts, a q-quake stills even the most anxious trembling...
The world... the world becomes and unbecomes. All the nervous, volcanic energy of being. Who becomes who? Three became one, but what of them now?
And w-what becomes of Tau? Of me? Of y-you?

strings.string:
{{emote|*塔姆茲 顫抖著，發出刺耳的鳴響。*}}
喔——喔。喔，喔、喔喔喔。相比之下，一場地震甚至能平息最焦慮的顫抖……
世界……世界在生成與消亡之間。所有那種不安、火山般的生命能量。誰變成了誰？三者合而為一，但現在他們又如何了？
而 T-Tau 會變成什麼樣？我呢？妳——妳又會變成什麼樣？

string.ID: {{emote|*The chime is silent and still.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*鳴響靜默且沉寂。*}}

string.ID:
You have severed the hand outstretched to me. Why?
What have you done? What am I to do?

strings.string:
你切斷了向我伸出的手。為什麼？
你做了什麼？我該怎麼辦？

string.ID: Your will would have been suborned to Ptoh.

strings.string: 你的意志本會被收買給普托。

string.ID: That's not my problem.

strings.string: 那不是我的問題。

string.ID: I am sorry.

strings.string: 我很抱歉。

string.ID: You will be happier this way.

strings.string: 這樣你會更快樂。

string.ID: How are you feeling?

strings.string: 你感覺如何？

string.ID: It seems that someone is waiting for you.

strings.string: 似乎有人在等著您。

string.ID: You would suborn your will to Ptoh?

strings.string: 你竟然願意屈從於 普托(Ptoh) 的意志？

string.ID:
{{M|You}} suborn my will! You allow me to start upon this path and block it. Yes?
Now I am truly adrift.

strings.string:
{{M|你}}收買了我的意志！你讓我踏上這條道路，卻又將其阻斷。對吧？
現在我真的漂泊無依了。

string.ID:
Ah.
Well. You have my thanks for your help in -elseing, but by blocking my path you create fresh problems. Yes?
I do not wish to know you.
Live and drink.

strings.string:
啊。
好吧。感謝你在「其他事情」上的協助，但阻擋我的去路會製造新的問題。對吧？
我並不想認識你。
活下去，盡情飲酒吧。

string.ID:
I resent what has befallen me, but I am yet embodied. You have still helped me live, yes?
I forgive you, but I don't wish to know you. Live and drink.

strings.string:
我對我所遭遇的一切感到憤恨，但我尚有肉身。你仍然幫助我活了下來，不是嗎？
我原諒你，但我不想認識你。去生活、去飲酒吧。

string.ID:
Perhaps. My future is hazy. My future twists in the chill wind of the Gyre. I can have no faith in your vision. You understand this, yes?
I do not wish to know you.
Live and drink.

strings.string:
或許吧。我的未來模糊不清。我的未來在 環流(Gyre) 的寒風中扭曲。我無法相信你的預見。你明白嗎？
我不想要了解你。
活下去，盡情飲用吧。

string.ID: Present. Alone, afraid, but anticipating my return to the embrace of a collective.

strings.string: 現身。孤獨、恐懼，但正期待著重新回到集體的懷抱中。

string.ID:
More than someone. My liaison is the extended, outstretched hands of a greater mind-haven than I have otherwise known. I might not have had the courage to -else without knowing that a collective awaited me.
My future is hazy, my future is bright.

strings.string:
不只是某個人。我的聯絡人是比我以往所知的更宏大的心靈避風港所延伸出的雙手。如果不知道有一個集體在等待著我，我也許沒有勇氣去進行「他者化」。
我的未來模糊不清，我的未來一片光明。

string.ID:
Speaking creatures seem very engrossed in this 'will' idea, but few agree what it is. Your mind is under influence from other thinkbeings the moment you observe them, yes? You 'learn' by imitating, your values and beliefs are adopted from observation. Yes?
I have made a choice to offer my consciousness to a new paradigm, but this choice seems distinct from your conception of 'will'. We speak past one another.

strings.string:
會說話的生物似乎對這個「意志」的概念非常著迷，但很少有人能達成共識它究竟是什麼。當你觀察其他思考生物時，你的心智就會受到他們的影響，對吧？你透過模仿來「學習」，你的價值觀與信仰是從觀察中採納而來的。沒錯吧？
我選擇將我的意識奉獻給一個新的範式，但這個選擇似乎與你們對「意志」的理解有所不同。我們根本不在同一個層次上溝通。

string.ID: The Seekers of the Sightless Way hunt espers.

strings.string: 盲道尋求者獵殺心靈感應者。

string.ID: May the Fates favor you, Tau-no-Longer.

strings.string: 願命運眷顧你，Tau-no-Longer。

string.ID: May the Fates favor you, Tau-no-Longer.

strings.string: 願命運眷顧你，Tau-no-Longer。

string.ID: I leave you to your fate, then.

strings.string: 那麼，我便隨你的命去了。

string.ID: I leave you to your fate, then.

strings.string: 那麼，我便隨你的命去了。

string.ID:
Oh, yes? I see. Well.
Do you... not hunt? Or align with hunters? You reek of predation yourself. You kill, yes?
I recall no promise to become a grazing hedonist. If I am called to hunt I will hunt.

strings.string:
喔，是嗎？我明白了。好吧。
你... 不狩獵嗎？還是與獵人結盟？你自己身上散發著掠食者的氣息。你會殺戮，對吧？
我不記得曾承諾要成為一個放任享樂的草食者。如果我被召喚去狩獵，我就會狩獵。

string.ID: I wish the same for you, =name=. Live and drink.

strings.string: =name=，我也同樣祝福你。活下去，盡情飲酒吧。

string.ID:
I wish the same for you, =name=.
Before you go, take this, a piece of my bodystuff, as thanks for completing the -elseing.
Then live and drink.

strings.string:
=name=，我也同樣祝福你。
在你離開之前，收下這個，這是我身體的一部分，以感謝你完成了 -轉生儀式。
然後去生活與飲酒吧。

string.ID: As I you to yours, =name=. Live and drink.

strings.string: 我將妳歸於妳自己，=name=。生存並飲啜吧。

string.ID:
As I you to yours, =name=.
But before you go, take this, a piece of my bodystuff, as thanks for completing the -elseing.
Then live and drink.

strings.string:
正如我對你所做的一樣，=name=。
但在你走之前，收下這個，這是我身體的一部分，以感謝你完成了 -轉生儀式。
然後去生活吧，去飲酒吧。

string.ID:
Before you go, take this, a piece of my bodystuff, as thanks for completing the -elseing.
Then live and drink, =name=.

strings.string:
在你離開之前，收下這個，這是我身體的一部分，感謝你完成了 -轉生儀式。
然後活下去吧，盡情飲酒，=name=。

string.ID:
The echoes of ending reverberate from the roots I once called mine.
My liaison is severed. Why?

strings.string:
終結的迴響從我曾稱之為我的 根系 中盪漾開來。
我的聯繫已斷絕。為什麼？

string.ID: How are you feeling?

strings.string: 你感覺如何？

string.ID: Your will would have been suborned to Ptoh.

strings.string: 你的意志本會被收買給普托。

string.ID: You are free to do as you please.

strings.string: 你可以隨心所欲地行動。

string.ID: I am sorry.

strings.string: 我很抱歉。

string.ID: You will be happier this way.

strings.string: 這樣你會更快樂。

string.ID: Live and drink, Wandering Tau.

strings.string: 活著並暢飲吧，流浪的 Tau。

string.ID: Live and drink, Wandering Tau.

strings.string: 活著並暢飲吧，流浪的 Tau。

string.ID: I should be wary of you, yes? You have helped me to my -else, but I find my chosen path blocked.

strings.string: 我應該對你保持警惕，對吧？你助我走向了「他處」，但我發現我選擇的道路被阻斷了。

string.ID:
It is not Ptoh that has suborned my will in this case.
I had chosen a path.

strings.string:
在此案中，並非 普托(Ptoh) 賄賂了我的意志。
我曾選擇了一條道路。

string.ID:
And yet, I find my choices undermined, yes? You have my thanks for your help in -elseing, but do not convince yourself that you have 'freed' me from my own choices.
Live and drink.

strings.string:
然而，我發現我的選擇被削弱了，不是嗎？感謝你在「其他事情」上的協助，但不要說服你自己你已經從我的選擇中「解放」了我。
生存並飲酒吧。

string.ID:
I resent what has befallen me, but I am yet embodied. You have still helped me live.
My future is free. My future is murky, and I am freshly tender from the burn of your hand. I feel I had rather not encounter you for a time. Live and drink, =player.formalAddressTerm=.

strings.string:
我對我遭遇的一切感到憤恨，但我依然擁有肉身。你仍然幫助了我活下去。
我的未來是自由的。我的未來是模糊的，且你的手留下的灼傷讓我仍感到鮮嫩疼痛。我覺得我暫時不想與你相遇。去生活吧，去飲酒吧，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

string.ID:
Will I?
Your prediction warms little against the chill wind of the Gyre. My future is free. My future is murky. I am freshly tender from the burn of your hand.
I feel I had rather not encounter you for a time. Live and drink, =player.formalAddressTerm=.

strings.string:
我會嗎？
妳的預言在環流的寒風面前顯得微不足道。我的未來是自由的，也是模糊的。妳手心的灼熱感仍讓我感到隱隱作痛。
我覺得暫時還是不要與妳相遇為好。生活吧，盡情飲酒吧，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

string.ID: Before you go, rootclimber. I've shed a piece of me in the -elseing. Take it. I have no use for it now.

strings.string: 在你走之前，攀根者。我在「非此地」丟下了一部分的自我。拿去吧。我現在用不到它了。

string.ID: Live and drink, Wandering Tau.

strings.string: 活著並暢飲吧，流浪的 Tau。

string.ID: Begone from me, stardimmer. Your own hand has vaporized your purpose.

strings.string: 離我遠去，星黯者。你自己的手已將你的使命化為烏有。

string.ID:
You thrived at the performance of a pruning motion, utensil. Now store yourself until Fate reshapes you.
The end.

strings.string:
你在修剪動作的表演中茁壯成長，器具。現在請收斂自身，直到命運重塑你的形體。
終局。

string.ID: The utensil arrives. You, to prune the fate-rhizome and free our girl. Go now and perform the motion.

strings.string: 器皿已抵達。你，去修剪命運根莖並解救我們的女孩。現在就去執行那項動作吧。

string.ID: You're a seeker of the Sightless Way?

strings.string: 你是盲道（Sightless Way）的尋求者？

string.ID: Where are you taking Tau?

strings.string: 你要帶 Tau 去哪裡？

string.ID: Give her your parting words, utensil. Our hearts are in elsewhere.

strings.string: 對她說些告別的話吧，工具。我們的心已不在這裡。

string.ID: Begone. Fate has not yet shaped you, utensil.

strings.string: 滾開。命運尚未塑造你，工具。

string.ID: Utensil? That is my avocation, yes. A million sun-dead homes I've roved, a trillion more await. I'm a worm in the loam of a cosmic wood, perched on a cosmic gulf, swathed in the god-manifold.

strings.string: 器皿？沒錯，那是我的愛好。我流浪過一百萬座太陽已逝的家園，還有一兆座正等待著我去探索。我是宇宙森林土壤中的一條蠕蟲，棲息在宇宙深淵之上，被神之流形所包裹。

string.ID:
Prune! The utensil prunes! -but no, the utensil quivers in uncertainty and vibrates out a question?
The self is riddled with category errors. The thinking brain mistakes formation for meaning.

strings.string:
修剪！工具在修剪！——但不是，工具在不確定中顫抖，並震盪出一個問題？
自我充滿了範疇錯誤。思考的大腦將形式誤認為意義。

string.ID: Tell me. I wish to understand.

strings.string: 告訴我。我想了解一下。

string.ID: Maggot! What do you think words are? Arrows of inquiry? Words are bricks. Each spoken is laid in bond and builds your prison. There is no understanding.

strings.string: Maggot！你以為言語是什麼？是探詢的箭矢嗎？言語是磚塊。每一句說出之語都是在築牆，最終建造出你的牢籠。這裡沒有所謂的理解。

string.ID: Bricks can be thrown, too.

strings.string: 磚塊也可以投擲。

string.ID: You tarry on the future's boundary with abandon, utensil. Throw your brick if you dare.

strings.string: 工具，你正肆無忌憚地徘徊在未來的邊界。若有膽量，就扔出你的磚頭吧。

string.ID: {{emote|*The chime is silent and still.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*鳴響靜默且沉寂。*}}

string.ID: [touch Tau's chime to softthing]

strings.string: [觸碰 塔 的鈴鐺以接觸軟物]

string.ID:
Oh wow, an animal.
Congratulations for... not dying.
... wanna buy something?

strings.string:
喔哇，一隻動物。
恭喜你……沒死掉。
……想買點什麼嗎？

string.ID: I am =name=. Who are you?

strings.string: 我是 =name=。你是誰？

string.ID: Are you part of this tree?

strings.string: 你是這棵樹的一部分嗎？

string.ID: Why are you selling goods in such a remote and dangerous place?

strings.string: 為什麼要在如此偏遠且危險的地方販售商品？

string.ID: Don't call me "an animal."

strings.string: 別叫我「畜生」。

string.ID:
I am Santalalotze.
... of ... the Consortium of Phyta. Some call me 'Sant', I think, in fantasy or memory.

strings.string:
我是 桑塔拉洛策。
……來自……植物聯盟(Consortium of Phyta)。我想，在幻想或記憶中，有人稱呼我為「Sant」。

string.ID: You don't remember?

strings.string: 你不記得了嗎？

string.ID:
No. Well... no, no. I don't think so.
We're just... sharing nutrients.

strings.string:
不。嗯... 不，不。我不這麼認為。
我們只是在... 分享養分。

string.ID: So you're a parasite?

strings.string: 所以你是一個寄生蟲？

string.ID: You don't seem sure.

strings.string: 你看起來不太確定。

string.ID: May I change the subject?

strings.string: 我可以更換主題嗎？

string.ID: I see. Live and drink.

strings.string: 我明白了。盡情生活，盡情飲酒。

string.ID:
Would you? Yes.
What may... can I help with?

strings.string:
你願意嗎？願意。
有什麼我可以……幫上忙的嗎？

string.ID:
'Parasite' so negative. It's like... ah... economic symbiosis?
Chavvah sustains me, and we are, I am not... them. We are in a... beneficial arrangement, you know. Yes?

strings.string:
'寄生'這個詞太負面了。這就像是……啊……經濟上的共生關係？
夏瓦維持著我的生存，而我們、我並不是……他們。我們處於一種……互惠的安排中，你懂嗎？對吧？

string.ID: You don't seem sure about any of this.

strings.string: 你看起來對這一切並不確定。

string.ID: I'd like to ask you about something else.

strings.string: 我想問您一些別的事情。

string.ID: Fair enough. Live and drink.

strings.string: 好吧。盡情生活與飲酒吧。

string.ID:
It is safe here.
Business is slow, but I've... gotten attached, ahaha.

strings.string:
這裡很安全。
生意很清淡，但我已經... 產生依戀了，啊哈哈。

string.ID:
Buy something, and I will call you 'customer'.
If I remember to.

strings.string:
買點東西吧，我才會稱呼你為「顧客」。
如果我有記住的話。

string.ID: Are you having some memory trouble?

strings.string: 你的記憶出了什麼問題嗎？

string.ID:
It's fine. I... forget nothing important.
Or, I don't remember. So no sense worrying. Right?

strings.string:
沒關係。我……不會忘記重要的事。
或者，我也想不起來了。所以沒必要擔心，對吧？

string.ID: Perhaps being Chavvah's parasite is affecting your mind.

strings.string: 或許成為夏瓦的寄生者正在影響你的心智。

string.ID: I'd like to ask you about something else.

strings.string: 我想問您一些別的事情。
好吧。

string.ID:
Well. Nothing... is like Chavvah. Nothing at all.
I once thought ... my haustorium carried only lifestuff. Now I am unsure. Am I of Twofirm, now?
It's fine.
Let's... change subjects.

strings.string:
好吧。沒有任何東西……能像 夏瓦(Chavvah) 那樣。完全沒有。
我曾以為……我的吸器只攜帶著生命物質。現在我不確定了。我現在是「雙實體」了嗎？
沒關係。
讓我們……換個話題吧。

string.ID: Will you resign your charge and swear to unvex the beings of this world?
O! O! A new life obtains? You musn't shudder at old Death!

strings.string: 喔！喔！獲得了新生命嗎？你絕不能對舊有的死亡感到畏縮！

string.ID: When an eremite consults the teraphim and sees the eyes of Death, only the fools frets! There is Change but no Ending.

strings.string: 當隱士諮詢 特辣菲姆 並看見死亡之眼時，唯有愚者才會焦慮！只有「變遷」，沒有「終結」。

string.ID: A plague is what burns the core out and lets the berries grow.

strings.string: 瘟疫燒盡了核心，才讓漿果得以生長。

string.ID: O Nephilim! Come for our star bath??

strings.string: 喔，尼非林！要來參加我們的星浴嗎？？

string.ID: I want salt in my mouth, dead eyes in radiating darkness, and a frog for a friend.

strings.string: 我想要口中有鹽味，在放射狀的黑暗中擁有死寂的雙眼，並以青蛙為友。

string.ID: O Life, O Change! Embrace us, entangle us...

strings.string: 噢 生命，噢 變革！擁抱我們，糾纏我們……

string.ID: I can lick the flanges free of their pipe milk and hear my tongue fizzle in foam!

strings.string: 我可以舔掉法蘭上的管奶，並聽到我的舌頭在泡沫中嘶嘶作響！

string.ID: Girsh Agolgot! Red dusts in my nails and burning hot bubbles swell in my glands! Now I point to the future.

strings.string: 吉爾什 阿格爾戈特！紅塵入我指甲，灼熱之泡於腺體膨脹！現在，我指向未來。

string.ID: The world stews and titrates

strings.string: 世界在燉煮、在滴定

string.ID: O, the thrill of coursing Change within. Each pump of the heart drives it deeper. Each breath a breath of new life.

strings.string: 喔，感受著「變革」在體內奔流的快感。每一次心跳都將其推向更深處。每一口呼吸都是新生的氣息。

string.ID: Roil with me, and bubble over. Let us exceed ourselves!

strings.string: 隨我一同翻騰、湧動吧。讓我們超越自我！

string.ID: Do you wish for a gleaming bath, and fractal veins that pump the continuity of life?

strings.string: 你是否渴望一場閃耀的沐浴，以及泵動著生命連續性的分形脈絡？

string.ID: You've a twin across the boundary of the future, where new life blooms in rot. Are you with them?

strings.string: 在未來的邊界另一頭，有著你的雙胞胎，在那裡新生命於腐朽中綻放。你與他們同在嗎？

string.ID: Would you kill your double? Would you let it kill you?

strings.string: 你會殺掉你的分身嗎？你會讓它殺了你嗎？

string.ID: It is to witness the scalpel parting tissue. The beauty of division and resection.

strings.string: 那是為了見證「手術刀」切開組織。那種分裂與切除的美感。

string.ID: Bore ribbons in the chrome like wild ants and see a cross-section of human and shell!

strings.string: 像狂亂的螞蟻般在鉻合金中鑽出絲帶，看見人類與外殼的橫截面！

string.ID: I dream of a crawl nook on a nether stratum where I out-sweat the burning Gyre, and then peek an eye across a new horizon.

strings.string: 我夢想著在下層地層的一個爬行角落裡，在那裡我能比灼熱的 環流(Gyre) 汗水更多，然後向著新的地平線窺探一眼。

string.ID: Thirteen years in the ground. Seventeen years in the ground. A thousand years in the ground!

strings.string: 在地底待了十三年。在地底待了十七年。在地底待了一千年！

string.ID: The Fishhead will catalyze the electric lake, and sure we as fossils will brick the ground but what a dais it will be!

strings.string: 魚頭將會催化這座電湖，雖然我們這些化石肯定會讓地面變得僵硬，但那將會是一座多麼壯麗的講台！

string.ID: The electric sizzle of life! Prickling and crisping skin, red and raw and beautiful beneath.

strings.string: 生命那電擊般的嘶嘶聲！皮膚感到刺痛與焦灼，下方是鮮紅、生澀且美麗的。

string.ID: Eaten by the air. Death by life. O Rermadon!

strings.string: 被空氣吞噬。死於生命。O 雷馬東！

string.ID: Live mites in the burning gas will appear green to the Future.

strings.string: 在灼熱氣體中生存的蟎蟲，在未來看來會是綠色的。

strings.string: 噢 生命，噢 變革！擁抱我們，糾纏我們……

string.ID: The bell sounds wheel at right angles and shock the wet meat off our perfect bones! I was made to be bones.

strings.string: 鐘聲以直角旋轉，將濕軟的肉從我們完美的骨骼上震落！我生而為骨。

string.ID: The moon is their marriage light! And then a whole world for the Girsh daughters of nephilim!

strings.string: 月亮是他們的婚姻之光！接著將為吉爾什的尼非林女兒們開啟整個世界！

string.ID: Reach out and touch the heart. Our bonds transcend distance!

strings.string: 伸手觸碰那顆心。我們的羈絆超越了距離！

string.ID: Push out the walls of the new world, Qas, to be its center!

strings.string: 推開新世界的牆壁吧，卡斯，成為它的中心！

string.ID: O Life, O Change! Embrace us, entangle us...

strings.string: 噢 生命，噢 變革！擁抱我們，糾纏我們……

string.ID: Primrose and witchwood will boil the boundaries of sense into death-pleasure!

strings.string: Primrose 與 witchwood 將把感官的邊界熬煮成死亡之樂！

string.ID: The Grounded Mind cannot soar. The Mind Aloft is limitless.

strings.string: 沉重的心靈無法翱翔。高遠的心靈則無窮無盡。

string.ID: Be open. Receive the Greatest Dreams. Hear the Girsh Sing.

strings.string: 敞開心扉。接收最偉大的夢境。聆聽吉爾什之歌。

string.ID: You can be it. We can all be it! Behold Nephilim!

strings.string: 你可以成為它。我們都能成為它！瞻仰尼非林吧！
